description: Create an ERC20-style token contract named SimpleToken with a fixed supply minted to the deployer, transfer and approve/transferFrom, and Transfer/Approval events.
description_long: This contract creates a fungible digital asset, SimpleToken, and custodies the total supply of these tokens. It maintains a record of each account's token balance and a record of approvals allowing one account to spend another account's tokens. Callers can transfer tokens to another account, approve another account to spend a specific amount of their tokens, and transfer tokens from an account that has approved them. The deployer of the contract is privileged and receives the entire initial supply of 1,000,000 tokens upon deployment. The total supply of tokens is fixed at 1,000,000 and cannot be increased or decreased. Transfers of zero tokens are permitted. The contract announces Transfer events when tokens are moved between accounts and Approval events when an account grants spending permission to another.

description: Design an Escrow contract holding funds for a buyer and seller with an arbiter that can release funds to the seller or refund the buyer.
description_long: This contract facilitates secure transactions between a buyer and a seller, holding an agreed-upon amount of a single fungible token in escrow. It maintains the current state of each escrow agreement, including the buyer, seller, arbiter, the token amount, and its status (awaiting deposit, funded, or resolved). Callers can initiate an escrow, deposit funds, release funds to the seller, or refund funds to the buyer. The designated arbiter is privileged to release funds or refund funds, and the buyer is privileged to initiate an escrow. An escrow agreement must be funded within 24 hours of its creation, otherwise it is automatically cancelled. The maximum amount that can be held in a single escrow is 1000 tokens. The contract announces the creation of new escrows, the funding of escrows, and the resolution (release or refund) of escrows.

description: Model a Voting contract where an owner registers proposals and whitelisted voters cast one vote each; expose the winning proposal.
description_long: This contract manages a voting system for proposals, holding no custodied assets. It maintains a list of registered proposals, a record of which voters have cast a vote, and the current vote count for each proposal. Callers can register proposals, whitelist voters, and cast a vote for an existing proposal. The contract owner is privileged and can register new proposals and whitelist voters. A maximum of 10 proposals can be active at any given time, and each whitelisted voter may only cast one vote. The contract announces when a new proposal is registered, when a voter is whitelisted, and when a vote is cast.

description: Create a MultiSigWallet requiring M-of-N owner confirmations before executing a queued transaction.
description_long: This contract is a multi-signature wallet designed to custody arbitrary digital assets, including native currency and fungible tokens. It maintains a list of designated owners, a required confirmation threshold, and a queue of proposed transactions awaiting sufficient confirmations. Callers can propose a transaction, confirm a proposed transaction, revoke a confirmation, and execute a fully confirmed transaction. Only a designated owner may propose, confirm, or revoke a transaction. The contract requires at least one and at most ten designated owners, and a proposed transaction must receive confirmations from at least half of the current owners before it can be executed. The contract announces when a new transaction is proposed, when a confirmation is added or revoked, and when a transaction is successfully executed.

description: Specify a Crowdsale contract that sells tokens at a fixed rate during a time window and forwards raised ETH to a wallet.
description_long: This contract facilitates a token sale, holding the tokens to be sold and any raised Ether. It maintains the total tokens sold, the start and end times of the sale, the token price, and the wallet designated to receive raised Ether. Callers can purchase tokens by sending Ether, and the owner can finalize the sale. Only the owner can set the sale start and end times, the token price, and the recipient wallet. The sale will last exactly 7 days, and the token price is fixed at 1000 tokens per 1 Ether. The contract announces when tokens have been purchased and when the sale has been finalized.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Kasu and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin deposits, acting as a vault for funds designated for real-world asset lending. It maintains a total deposit balance, a record of each depositor's individual balance, and a configurable lending rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool and withdraw their deposited stablecoins plus accrued interest. A designated operator can initiate a loan from the pool, specifying the amount and terms, and can also repay a loan back into the pool. The owner can set the lending rate, which must be between 1% and 10% annually, and can also pause all deposits and withdrawals. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay after the request is made. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, loan initiation, or loan repayment occurs, including the relevant amounts and participant addresses.
source_description: Kasu is a real-world asset protocol bridging institutional-grade private credit yields to DeFi, enabling lenders to earn sustainable returns from tokenised private debt, invoice finance, and other high-grade credit products. It connects TradFi lenders and DeFi liquidity through a hybrid capital stack with transparent, on-chain yield

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Roll Fun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of new token launches, holding deposited collateral tokens for each launch. It maintains a record of each launch, including its unique identifier, the total collateral deposited, the target raise amount, the token being launched, and the current state of the launch (e.g., active, funded, failed). Callers can create a new launch by depositing the required collateral and specifying the launch parameters, contribute to an active launch by depositing the designated contribution token, and claim their launched tokens or refund their contributions once a launch concludes. Only the contract owner can set the fee percentage for successful launches, which is fixed at 2% of the total raised amount, and pause or unpause the contract's core functionalities. A launch must raise at least 80% of its target amount to be considered successful, and each launch has a maximum duration of 7 days from its creation. The contract announces events for new launch creations, contributions received, and the finalization of a launch, indicating its success or failure.
source_description: Create a Roll launchpad token on Form

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Cattos and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming currency, holding a reserve of the token used for in-game purchases and rewards. It maintains individual player balances for the in-game currency, a global total supply of the currency, and a configurable exchange rate between the native blockchain token and the in-game currency. Callers can deposit native blockchain tokens to mint in-game currency, withdraw native blockchain tokens by burning in-game currency, and transfer in-game currency to other players. A designated operator can adjust the exchange rate and mint new in-game currency directly into player accounts. The exchange rate can only be adjusted by a maximum of 10% in any 24-hour period. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals of native blockchain tokens. The contract announces the current exchange rate and all transfers of in-game currency.
source_description: CATTOS is an on-chain RPG played through Telegram on the Aptos blockchain, where players tap to battle with cat heroes and earn tradable CATTOS tokens in a play-to-earn system

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on token.select and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the launch of new tokens, holding contributions of a base currency and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each contributor's base currency deposit and their pro-rata share of project tokens, along with the total base currency collected, the total project tokens held, and a fixed launch price for the project token. Callers can contribute base currency to a launch, claim their pro-rata share of project tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their base currency if a launch fails. The owner can initiate a launch, finalize a successful launch by transferring collected base currency and project tokens to a designated concentrated-liquidity pool, and cancel a launch, refunding all contributions. A launch requires a minimum of 100,000 base currency units to be considered successful, and the launch price is fixed at 0.001 base currency units per project token. The contract announces when a launch is initiated, when a contribution is made, when a launch is finalized, and when a launch is cancelled.
source_description: A custom launchpad on Robinhood Chain that aligns community and creator incentives. Contributors fund a launch at a fixed price, the launch migrates into Uniswap V3 pools with contributors earning a pro-rata share of the fees for life.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Monday Trade Perps and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages perpetual futures positions, holding collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions including margin, leverage, and open orders, alongside global configuration parameters like funding rates and available trading pairs. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, and place or cancel limit orders. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters, update funding rates, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all executed trades. The contract emits events for position openings, closures, liquidations, and collateral deposits or withdrawals.
source_description: Monday Trade is an all-in-one DEX for onchain trading on Monad that offers the best of CEX and DEX trading experiences. Monad’s low latency enables Monday Trade to execute trades within milliseconds without giving up their asset ownership to centralized exchanges.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on BCraft and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a player's in-game currency balance, which it custodies as fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each player's current currency balance and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can deposit fungible tokens to increase their balance, withdraw fungible tokens from their balance, and spend fungible tokens for in-game actions. A designated operator can mint new fungible tokens into a player's balance, burn fungible tokens from a player's balance, and update the game's configuration parameters. The maximum amount of fungible tokens a player can deposit in a single transaction is 1000. A 1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, minted, or burned, and when the game configuration is updated.
source_description: Basecraft is an onchain PVP game built on base.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on PerpMe and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of new token launches by deploying a new token and establishing a concentrated-liquidity pool for it, permanently locking the initial liquidity. It custodies the non-fungible token representing the locked liquidity position for each launched token. The contract maintains a record of each launched token's address, its creator, the associated liquidity pool's address, and the accumulated trading fees for both the creator and the platform. Callers can initiate a new token launch, claim their accumulated creator fees, and the designated platform operator can claim the platform's accumulated fees. Only the designated platform operator can set the fee split ratio and designate new platform operators. A new token launch requires a minimum initial liquidity contribution of 100 base tokens, and the trading fees generated by each pool are split 60% to the token creator and 40% to the platform. The contract announces the creation of a new token launch, the claiming of creator fees, and the claiming of platform fees.
source_description: PerpMe is a token launchpad on HyperEVM. Every launch mints its full supply into a single-sided Uniswap V3 position on PRJX and sends the LP NFT to the PerpMe locker, which has no function to decrease liquidity or move the position — so the liquidity is locked permanently. Trading fees from each pool are split 60/40 between the coin's creator and the platform.

description: Create a lending protocol based on 40 Acres and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates self-repaying, non-liquidating loans by accepting collateral deposits and issuing debt. It maintains individual loan positions, tracking deposited collateral amounts, outstanding debt, and accrued interest for each borrower, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and accepted collateral types. Callers can deposit approved collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay their outstanding debt, and withdraw excess collateral once debt is fully repaid. A designated owner can add or remove approved collateral tokens, adjust the global interest rate, and pause or unpause borrowing operations. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 50%, and the annual interest rate is fixed at 3%. The contract announces events for loan creation, collateral deposits, debt repayments, and changes to the global interest rate.
source_description: 40acres is a pioneering DeFi platform and community DAO that empowers users to unlock the potential of their assets through Self-Repaying, non-liquidating loans

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on KronosDAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, holding various digital assets as backing for a native stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances of the stablecoin, a treasury of collateral assets, and configuration parameters for minting and redemption. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for underlying collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other users. The owner can add new collateral types, adjust the collateralization ratio, and pause minting or redemption in emergencies. A minimum collateralization ratio of 150% must always be maintained for the stablecoin, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces successful minting events, redemption events, and stablecoin transfers.
source_description: Kronos DAO is the next evolution of the reserve currency protocol. Nodes, Kronoscharger, Kronospad, Swap, Farms and Pools.

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on Cronos zkEVM Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the secure transfer of fungible tokens between a Layer 1 network and a Layer 2 zero-knowledge rollup, holding deposited tokens in escrow on Layer 1. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance on Layer 1, a mapping of Layer 1 token addresses to their corresponding Layer 2 token addresses, and a global configuration for transfer fees. Callers can deposit tokens to the contract, initiate a withdrawal request from Layer 2 to Layer 1, and claim their withdrawn tokens on Layer 1 after a successful proof verification. Only a designated operator can finalize Layer 2 withdrawal requests by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof and update the Layer 1 to Layer 2 token address mapping. A fixed fee of 0.01 tokens is charged for each withdrawal, and the maximum number of pending withdrawal requests at any time is 10,000. The contract emits an event upon every successful deposit, withdrawal request, and finalized withdrawal.
source_description: The next generation zero-knowledge layer 2 chain

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on R-Planet and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages resource production and asset ownership for a strategic game, holding deposited game assets and fungible resource tokens. It maintains individual player balances for multiple resource types, a registry of owned game assets per player, and global configuration parameters for resource generation rates. Callers can deposit game assets, withdraw game assets, claim accumulated resources, and transfer resource tokens to other players. A designated operator can set resource generation rates, register new game asset types, and pause all resource generation. Resource generation rates are capped at 100 units per asset per hour, and a 5% fee is applied to all resource token transfers, payable to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when game assets are deposited, withdrawn, or when resource generation rates are updated.
source_description: R-Planet is a free-to-play strategy game where players own and use game assets across multiple purposes, build bases, mine resources, train armies, and strategize for survival and rewards

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Wrap Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset wrapping, holding original ERC-20 and ERC-721 tokens in custody to back their wrapped representations on a different blockchain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited tokens, the total supply of each wrapped asset, and configurable parameters for wrapping and unwrapping. Callers can deposit ERC-20 or ERC-721 tokens to mint wrapped tokens, and they can burn wrapped tokens to withdraw their original assets. A designated operator can pause all wrapping and unwrapping operations, and the owner can update the fee percentage. A 0.5% fee is applied to all unwrapping operations, and the maximum number of unique ERC-20 token types that can be wrapped is limited to 100. The contract announces events for successful deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the fee percentage.
source_description: Through Wrap, users issue wTokens (wrapped tokens) which are representations of ERC20 and ERC721 tokens on the Tezos blockchain. wTokens can then be used on the Tezos blockchain, and their value is pegged to the original tokens.

description: Design a token locking contract based on CryptEx Locker and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, designed to custody arbitrary ERC-20 tokens for a specified duration. It maintains records of locked token amounts, the designated unlock time for each lock, and the recipient address for each lock. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, extend the unlock time of an existing lock, and withdraw tokens from an expired lock. A designated owner can set the fee percentage for new locks and designate a fee recipient address. The fee for creating a new lock is 1% of the deposited amount, paid in the locked token. The minimum lock duration for any deposit is 30 days. The contract announces when new tokens are locked, when a lock's duration is extended, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: CryptEx Locker is part of CryptEx ecosystem which provide LP locker and Team Token Vesting services. CryptEx also providing staking service. Stake CRX to earn 50% of CryptEx locker platform fees.

description: Specify a payments contract based on Peer and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer cryptocurrency to fiat currency swaps, holding cryptocurrency deposits in escrow during the swap process. It maintains individual user balances for deposited cryptocurrency, a global configuration for swap parameters, and a list of active swap orders. Callers can deposit cryptocurrency, create new swap orders specifying a fiat amount and desired cryptocurrency price, accept existing swap orders, confirm fiat receipt for an accepted order, and withdraw their cryptocurrency deposits. Only a designated operator can adjust the global swap fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of the cryptocurrency amount, and set the maximum allowed cryptocurrency deposit per order, which is capped at 1000 units of the deposited cryptocurrency. The contract announces when new swap orders are created, when orders are accepted, and when fiat receipt is confirmed.
source_description: ZKP2P is a peer-to-peer, non-custodial protocol that enables seamless crypto <> fiat on and off ramping. Liquidity providers earn yield by pricing above market rate with zero platform fees, often making ZKP2P cheaper for users than traditional on-ramp options (such as Moonpay, Ramp Network). Built on privacy-preserving zero-knowledge proofs, ZKP2P offers a trustless and user-owned alternative to centralized ramps.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on TermMax and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fixed-rate, fixed-term lending and borrowing positions, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains individual user position data, including collateral amounts, borrowed amounts, and maturity dates, along with global configuration parameters for interest rates and available liquidity pools. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their collateral once loans are repaid or mature. A designated operator can adjust interest rate curves and add or remove supported collateral and borrowable assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any position is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new loans, deducted from the borrowed amount. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the user's identifier, asset type, and amount.
source_description: TermMax is a DeFi AMM protocol that allows users to lend, borrow and one-click leverage at fixed-rates and with maturity dates. Users may earn passive yields via Vaults without the hassle of managing positions. Curators and Order Makers are empowered by the Range Order Tool to set their pricing curves and slippages to manage risk and return efficiently with ease

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on MatrixDock STBT and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token representing fractional ownership of short-term US Treasury bills and reverse repurchase agreements, holding no assets directly but reflecting an off-chain portfolio. It maintains each account's current token balance and a global daily interest rate. Callers can mint new tokens by depositing US Dollars, redeem tokens for US Dollars, and transfer tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the daily interest rate and pause all transfers. The daily interest rate cannot exceed 0.001 (0.1%) and redemptions incur a 0.1% fee. The contract announces token transfers, minting events, redemption events, and daily interest rate updates.
source_description: Short-Term US Treasury Bill Token enables risk-free yields from U.S. Treasury securities and reverse repos. Pegged 1:1 to USD, interest is rebased to holders STBT balances daily.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Mezo Vaults and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating vault that accepts and custodies a single designated base asset. It maintains a total amount of the base asset deposited, a total amount of vault shares minted, and for each user, their individual share balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive vault shares, withdraw their base asset by burning vault shares, and redeem their shares for the underlying base asset. A designated operator can initiate a rebalance of the vault's underlying strategy, and the owner can set the designated operator. Deposits are capped at 1,000,000 units of the base asset per transaction, and withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events including the depositor and amount, and withdrawal events including the withdrawer and amount.
source_description: Mezo Vaults are yield-generating strategies that deploy your assets across DeFi to earn returns. Deposit into a vault, receive a receipt token representing your position, and let the strategist optimize for yield

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on CroVegas and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a prediction market for coin flips, holding user bets until the outcome is determined. It maintains a record of each user's outstanding bets, the total amount staked on heads, and the total amount staked on tails for each flip, along with a configuration for the house edge and minimum bet. Users can place a bet on heads or tails, and after a flip's outcome is determined, they can claim their winnings or retrieve their losing bet. A designated operator can initiate a new coin flip, record the outcome of a flip, and update the house edge. The house edge is fixed at 2.5% of the winning pot, and the minimum bet for any flip is 100 units of the accepted token. The contract announces when a new flip is initiated, when a bet is placed, and when a flip's outcome is recorded.
source_description: CroVegas by KitCoin is a Web3 casino on Cronos featuring multi-token lotteries, coin flip, and a CRC20 swap aggregator (Cashier), with roulette and blackjack coming soon. Any CRC20 token can be whitelisted for games and swaps, with integrated projects earning a share of revenue their token generates

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Beratlas Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized representation of staked network tokens, allowing users to deposit network tokens and receive an equivalent amount of liquid staking tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited network tokens, the total supply of liquid staking tokens, and a global exchange rate between the two. Callers can deposit network tokens, withdraw their staked network tokens, and redeem liquid staking tokens for network tokens. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on external oracle data, and only this operator can pause all withdrawals. The maximum number of network tokens that can be deposited in a single transaction is 1000, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when a withdrawal occurs, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: Beratlas is a DeFi protocol on the Berachain that utilizes $BERA and $BATLAS to create a stable and potentially increasing value mechanism

description: Create a staking contract based on Bedrock uniETH and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract issues a non-rebasing receipt token representing staked Ether and its accumulated rewards, holding deposited Ether and any earned staking rewards. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, a total amount of Ether held, and a conversion rate between the receipt token and Ether, which continuously increases over time. Callers can deposit Ether to receive receipt tokens, and they can redeem receipt tokens for Ether. A designated operator can deposit earned staking rewards into the contract, and a designated operator can pause and unpause all deposit and redemption operations. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all redemptions, and the redemption conversion rate is updated at least once every 24 hours. The contract emits an event whenever Ether is deposited, receipt tokens are redeemed, or staking rewards are added.
source_description: uniETH represents the staked ETH in Bedrock plus all future staking rewards. uniETH is non-rebasing, i.e. does not grow in quantity over time but grows in value instead. In other words, 1 uniETH will be worth more than 1 ETH as time goes on, and its value will continue to increase as more time passes

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Gamblefi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of various fungible tokens and distributes a portion of its holdings to eligible participants. It maintains a total balance for each held token, a record of each participant's share of the distribution pool, and a configuration for distribution parameters. Callers can deposit supported tokens into the treasury, withdraw their accumulated distributions, and stake a specific token to earn a share of future distributions. Only a designated operator can add new supported tokens, adjust the distribution rate, or initiate a distribution event. The maximum distribution rate is 5% of the treasury's total value per distribution event, and a minimum of 24 hours must pass between distribution events. The contract announces when a new token is supported and when a distribution event has occurred, including the total amount distributed.
source_description: GambleFi is a Rebasing DAO protocol that features various external services meant to increase the protocol's treasury and redistribute dividends to users.

description: Define a lending protocol based on Zest V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of a single fungible token, enabling users to deposit and borrow against it. It maintains individual deposit balances, outstanding loan amounts per borrower, and a global configuration for interest rates and collateral requirements. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their deposited tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and liquidate undercollateralized loans. A designated operator can adjust the borrowing interest rate and the collateralization ratio. The maximum borrowing interest rate is 15% annually, and the minimum collateralization ratio for new loans is 150%. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made, a loan is taken out, a loan is repaid, or a liquidation occurs.
source_description: Zest Protocol is an open-source, on-chain lending platform built for Bitcoin, allowing users to earn or borrow against their BTC

description: Design a lending protocol based on Cooler Loans and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a fixed-rate lending pool, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued stablecoin tokens. It maintains individual loan positions, tracking collateral deposited, stablecoins borrowed, and accrued interest for each borrower, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and collateralization requirements. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust the fixed interest rate and the minimum collateralization ratio. The fixed interest rate for new loans is 0.5% APR, and the minimum collateralization ratio is 150%. The contract announces events for loan creation, repayment, and collateral adjustments.
source_description: Cooler Loans is Olympus DAO's native lending protocol. Borrowers deposit gOHM as collateral to borrow stablecoins at a fixed 0.5% APR.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on moonthat and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch and initial distribution of new tokens, holding deposited base currency and newly minted tokens. It maintains records of each participant's base currency contribution and their allocated token share, along with global configuration parameters for each launch. Callers can contribute base currency to an active launch, claim their allocated tokens after a launch concludes, and withdraw any unclaimed base currency if a launch fails to meet its minimum target. A designated operator can initiate new launches, set launch parameters, finalize successful launches, and cancel unsuccessful ones. Each launch must have a minimum base currency target of at least 100 base currency units, and a maximum contribution per participant is capped at 1000 base currency units. The contract emits an event when a new launch is started, when a contribution is made, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: A way to launch/buy memecoins

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on Rise.rich and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad that custodies deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each project's launch configuration, including its sale parameters and the amounts of base tokens contributed by each participant. Callers can create new project launches, contribute base tokens to active sales, claim their purchased project tokens after a successful sale, and withdraw their contributed base tokens if a sale fails. A designated administrator can pause or unpause the contract, set global fees, and upgrade the contract's logic. Each project launch has a maximum base token contribution cap of 1000 base tokens per participant, and a 2% fee is applied to all successful base token contributions, directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event when a new project launch is created, when base tokens are contributed, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: RISE is the first floor-backed, permissionless token launchpad on Solana, enabling creators to launch tokens instantly while embedding capped downside risk mechanics and in-house lending from day one

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Poseidollar and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized, algorithmic stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a collateral asset to back the stablecoin. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, a collateral reserve balance, and a redemption rate for the stablecoin against the collateral. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem collateral, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the redemption rate within a predefined range and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The redemption rate can be adjusted by a maximum of 0.5% in any 24-hour period. A 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemption operations, payable in the collateral asset. The contract emits events for all minting, burning, and transfer operations, and for changes to the redemption rate.
source_description: Poseidollar - the first algorithmic stablecoin pegged to $USDC running on the Sui Network.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Circle Gateway and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain transfers of a stablecoin, holding the stablecoin in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's stablecoin balance on the source chain and a global count of stablecoins locked. Callers can initiate a transfer by locking stablecoins, and designated operators can mint stablecoins on a destination chain or burn them on the source chain to complete a transfer. A designated operator is the only entity that can approve minting or burning operations. Each transfer incurs a flat fee of 0.01 stablecoins, deducted from the amount transferred, and a single transfer cannot exceed 1,000,000 stablecoins. The contract emits an event upon stablecoin lock and another upon stablecoin unlock.
source_description: Circle Gateway enables a unified USDC balance, unlocking on-demand liquidity and redefining crosschain UX

description: Define a governance contract based on Almanak and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a strategy vault for automated financial agents, holding deposited user funds in various tokens. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token, a global configuration for allowed tokens, and a record of active agent strategies. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their tokens, and approve agent strategies to manage their deposited funds. A designated operator can add new allowed tokens, pause deposits, and update agent strategy configurations. The contract imposes a maximum of 10 active agent strategies per user, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all withdrawals. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when a withdrawal occurs, and when an agent strategy is approved or revoked.
source_description: Almanak is an innovative DeFi Agent Platform designed to create and deploy automated financial strategies using financial Agents. The platform combines advanced automation with emerging AI technologies to help strategies adapt to market conditions more effectively than traditional tools

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on Pixie Chess and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the core game logic and custody of non-fungible tokens representing unique game pieces. It maintains a record of each player's owned game pieces, their current in-game state (e.g., health, upgrades), and a global registry of available piece types and their base attributes. Callers can register new game pieces, initiate game matches by burning specific pieces, and upgrade their existing game pieces. Only a designated operator can define new game piece types and set their initial attributes. A maximum of 10,000 unique game piece types can be registered, and initiating a game match always requires burning at least two game pieces. The contract announces when new game piece types are registered and when game pieces are burned.
source_description: Pixie Chess is a Web3 strategy game on Base that turns chess pieces into on-chain collectible assets with custom abilities, letting players compete in tournaments that use tokenized game pieces and burn-based entry mechanics.

description: Model a lending protocol based on Hydration Lending and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates collateralized lending and borrowing of various fungible tokens, holding deposited collateral tokens and borrowed tokens in escrow. It maintains individual account records for each user's deposits, borrows, and collateralization ratios, along with global pools for each supported asset and configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral; designated liquidators can liquidate undercollateralized positions. The contract owner can add or remove supported collateral and borrow tokens, adjust interest rate models, and set liquidation parameters. A borrower's collateralization ratio must always exceed 120% to avoid liquidation, and a liquidation fee of 5% of the liquidated amount is applied. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Hydration Lending is a decentralized lending protocol on Hydration.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Bloom Trading Bot and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user trading strategies and holds user-deposited tokens for automated execution. It maintains individual user balances, active strategy configurations including token pairs and trade parameters, and a global fee structure. Callers can deposit tokens, create new trading strategies, modify existing strategies, pause or resume their strategies, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can adjust the global trading fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of each successful trade, and pause all trading activity across the platform. A user's maximum number of active strategies is capped at 5. The contract announces strategy creations, modifications, and successful trade executions.
source_description: Bloom is a cross-chain trading bot offering fast, automated trading with features like sniping, AFK trading, spot buys, quick sells, and limit orders

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Belief Market and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users can bet on the outcome of future events using a designated stablecoin. It maintains records of each market's parameters, the total stablecoin staked on each outcome, and individual user positions within each market. Callers can create new markets, stake stablecoin on a specific outcome, withdraw their staked stablecoin before market resolution, and claim their winnings after market resolution. The owner can pause all market activity and designate a market resolver who alone can declare a market's final outcome. A market must remain open for staking for at least 24 hours after creation, and a 1% fee is applied to all winnings, which is directed to the owner. The contract announces market creation, staking events, withdrawals, and market resolutions.
source_description: Opinion markets where users can bet on various beliefs using stablecoins

description: Outline a governance contract based on Snowbl Capital and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a stablecoin, allocating deposited funds across various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance and the total stablecoin held in the vault, along with configuration parameters for approved strategies and their allocation weights. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the vault, withdraw their deposited stablecoins, and claim any accumulated yield. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, update the allocation weight for existing strategies, and initiate rebalancing of funds across strategies. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins and a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or strategy rebalance occurs.
source_description: Snowbl Capital is an on-chain capital allocator with an USDC vault diversifying across funding, lending, farming, and market-neutral arbitrage to pursue risk-managed yield.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Morph Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the transfer of an arbitrary fungible token from an origin chain to a destination chain, holding deposited tokens in escrow on the origin chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount for each token, and a mapping of canonical token addresses between chains. Callers can deposit tokens, initiate a withdrawal request for tokens, and finalize a withdrawal on the destination chain. Only a designated relayer can finalize withdrawal requests on the destination chain, and only the owner can update the mapping of canonical token addresses. A withdrawal request must wait a minimum of 7 days before it can be finalized. A fee of 0.1% is applied to all finalized withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, when a withdrawal request is initiated, and when a withdrawal is finalized, including the sender, recipient, token, and amount.
source_description: Bridge between Ethereum and Morph L2

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Polkamarkets and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized prediction market that custodies user deposits in a designated base currency. It maintains a record of open markets, each with a unique identifier, a set of possible outcomes, and the total liquidity provided for each outcome, along with individual user positions (outcome chosen, amount staked) within each market. Callers can create new markets, deposit funds into an outcome of an existing market, withdraw their share of funds from a market before it resolves, and claim winnings after a market has resolved. Only a designated operator can resolve a market by declaring a winning outcome and only after a specified resolution time has passed. Market creation requires a minimum initial deposit of 100 units of the base currency, and a 2% fee is applied to all winnings claimed. The contract announces market creation, deposits, withdrawals, market resolution, and winnings claims as events.
source_description: Polkamarkets is an Autonomous Prediction Market Protocol built for cross-chain information exchange and trading, where users take positions on outcomes of real-world events in a decentralized and interoperable platform, running on EVM.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on basedbid and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract orchestrates permissionless token launches, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each launch's configuration, including its bonding curve parameters, collected fees, and participant balances. Callers can initiate a new launch, deposit base tokens to purchase project tokens along the curve, withdraw their purchased project tokens, and claim their share of collected fees. The launch creator can set the initial bonding curve parameters and withdraw unsold project tokens after the launch concludes. A designated operator can adjust the global fee percentage, which is capped at 5%, and pause all new launch creations. Each launch must run for a minimum duration of 24 hours. The contract emits an event upon every new launch creation, every token purchase, and every fee withdrawal.
source_description: A permissionless multi-chain launchpad with bonding curves, Flash Tokens, and white-label Boards. Boards let anyone run a branded launchpad and earn from every launch under their name. Fee routing is programmable via the Fee Builder, split to holders, buybacks, liquidity, or any wallet.

description: Model a lending protocol based on EtherFi Borrowing Market and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for a specific collateral asset and a specific borrowable asset, holding deposited collateral from lenders and borrowed assets awaiting repayment. It maintains individual records for each user's deposited collateral, borrowed amount, and accrued interest, along with a global pool balance for both assets and a configuration for interest rates. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay borrowed assets, and withdraw their available collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause or unpause borrowing. A minimum collateralization ratio of 150% must be maintained for all active loans, and a fixed fee of 0.1% is applied to all borrowed amounts at the time of borrowing. The contract announces events for every deposit, borrow, repayment, and withdrawal, including the user's address, the asset amount, and the transaction type.
source_description: Take control of your crypto. Save, grow, and spend. Start now at www.ether.fi

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Centrifuge Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages and custodies tokenized real-world assets, representing fractional ownership in a diversified portfolio of private credit investments. It maintains per-investor records of their asset holdings, a total value locked for the portfolio, and configuration parameters for asset eligibility. Callers can deposit stablecoins to acquire asset tokens, redeem asset tokens for stablecoins, and transfer asset tokens to other investors. A designated operator can add new real-world assets to the portfolio and approve or reject investor redemption requests. The maximum individual investor holding is capped at 10,000,000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% redemption fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces successful deposits, redemptions, and asset additions through public events.
source_description: Centrifuge protocol enables asset managers to tokenize, manage, and distribute tokenized funds onchain, while providing investors access to a diversified portfolio of high-quality tokenized assets.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Nation Wars Base and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a strategic game where players stake fungible tokens into designated country vaults, forming alliances and competing in recurring elimination epochs. It maintains a record of each player's staked token balance per country, the current epoch number, and the total token supply held within each country vault. Players can stake tokens into an available country vault, transfer their staked tokens between allied country vaults, and withdraw their staked tokens from any country vault they are part of. A designated operator can initiate a new epoch, declare a country eliminated, and distribute a portion of the eliminated country's vault tokens to its conquerors. Staking into a country vault requires a minimum of 100 tokens. A 5% fee is applied to all token withdrawals, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event when tokens are staked, transferred, or withdrawn, and when a country is eliminated.
source_description: NationWars is an onchain strategy game where players stake NWT into country vaults, form alliances, and compete in recurring elimination epochs that redirect captured value into buybacks and burns

description: Create a governance contract based on Puffer Vaults and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an automated vault that custodies a liquid staking derivative token and earns rewards from an external yield-generating protocol. It maintains a record of each user's deposited liquid staking derivative tokens, their share of the vault's total assets, and the current configuration parameters. Callers can deposit liquid staking derivative tokens, withdraw their share of the vault's assets, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the external yield-generating protocol's strategy and adjust the vault's fee structure. The maximum fee for withdrawals is 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and a minimum deposit of 0.01 liquid staking derivative tokens is enforced. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and reward claim events to observers.
source_description: An automated vault that earns you Nucleus and Puffer points on your liquid staking assets through Unifi Vaults.

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Quickswap Dex and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and custodies deposited token pairs. It maintains a separate liquidity pool for each unique pair of tokens, tracking the reserves of each token within the pool and the total supply of liquidity provider tokens for that pool. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap one token for another within a pool. The contract owner can set the swap fee percentage and pause all swapping operations. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the input token amount for each trade. Adding liquidity to a pool requires depositing both tokens in the current ratio of the pool's reserves. The contract announces liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps, including the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: AMM

description: Outline a staking contract based on Marinade Select and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a proof-of-stake blockchain, custodying deposited native tokens and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a registry of approved validator identities, the total amount of native tokens staked with each validator, and each user's balance of liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, unstake their liquid staking tokens to initiate a withdrawal of native tokens, and claim their withdrawn native tokens after a cooling-off period. A designated operator can add new validators to the approved list, remove existing validators, and adjust the staking allocation among approved validators. The cooling-off period for unstaking is 3 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all unstaking operations. The contract announces deposit events, unstake requests, and successful withdrawals, including the amounts involved and the associated user addresses.
source_description: Marinade Select is a staking option that delegates to a set of validators chosen based on identity verification, performance metrics, and MEV policies, targeting users who prioritize transparency

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Echo Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the bridging and restaking of a specific wrapped Bitcoin asset, holding custody of all deposited wrapped Bitcoin and any generated yield. It maintains individual account balances for wrapped Bitcoin deposits, staking positions, and accrued rewards, along with global parameters like the current staking rate and a list of approved external restaking operators. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin, initiate a restake operation by selecting an approved operator, claim earned rewards, and withdraw their original wrapped Bitcoin deposit. A designated owner role can approve or revoke restaking operators, adjust the staking rate, and set a protocol fee. The maximum staking rate is capped at 10% per annum, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all reward claims. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, restaking operations, reward claims, and changes to the staking rate or approved operators.
source_description: Bridge BTC assets, restaking, earn interest & borrow on Move

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Vesta Equity and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractionalized ownership shares of real estate assets, holding no direct assets itself but representing claims on off-chain property. It maintains a record of each user's total shares across all properties, along with a registry of all tokenized properties and their current valuations. Callers can purchase fractional shares in available properties, sell their existing fractional shares, and transfer fractional shares to other users. A designated administrator can add new properties to the registry, update the valuation of existing properties, and pause all share trading for a specific property. The minimum purchase amount for any property share is 0.01 units. A 0.5% fee is applied to all share sale transactions. The contract announces when new properties are added, when property valuations are updated, and when shares are purchased, sold, or transferred.
source_description: Build wealth with a portfolio of tokenized, regulatory-compliant, and verified fractionalized home equity investments in top residential properties.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Joystick Club and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's reward system, custodying a fungible reward token. It maintains individual player balances of the reward token, a global pool of tokens available for distribution, and a configuration for various game parameters. Callers can play a game to earn tokens, spend tokens to mint unique digital collectibles, and stake those collectibles to earn additional yield. The owner can set the reward rate for playing games, adjust the staking yield percentage, and pause all token transfers in an emergency. Each game play costs 0.01 units of the native blockchain currency, and the maximum number of unique digital collectibles a single player can mint is 10. The contract announces when a player earns tokens, when a collectible is minted, and when a collectible is staked.
source_description: Joystick.club is the first play to earn arcade on SmartBCH. Play games and earn JOY tokens, save up your JOY tokens to mint NFT Prizes which you can use to stake and earn yield and enhance your gameplay and rewards per play.

description: Define a staking contract based on Vault Liquid Staking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract custodies deposited base tokens and issues liquid staking tokens representing a share of the pooled staked assets. It maintains a global total of deposited base tokens, a global total of issued liquid staking tokens, and a per-user record of their liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, and can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw an equivalent share of base tokens. The owner can set the staking reward fee and can update the underlying staking strategy. The contract charges a 5% fee on all staking rewards. Redemptions are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract announces deposit events including the depositor's address and the amount deposited, and redemption events including the redeemer's address and the amount redeemed.
source_description: vSOL is a stake pool that supports community-focused validators. Stake with us now to support the Solana native communities! At The Vault, we believe the Solana network will be the strongest if the network is secured by validators that have a large social stake in Solana. Most top validators by stake amount are not Solana focused entities, but instead represent the crypto industry in general. The Vault stake pool will strive to bring the financial stake in-line with the existing social stake of Solana-centric communities.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Lorenzo enzoBTC and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the issuance and redemption of a wrapped Bitcoin token, holding native Bitcoin as collateral in a designated multi-signature wallet. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped token and a record of each user's wrapped token balance. Callers can mint new wrapped tokens by providing proof of a Bitcoin deposit to the multi-signature wallet, and they can burn wrapped tokens to initiate a Bitcoin withdrawal from the multi-signature wallet. A designated operator is privileged to approve minting requests after verifying Bitcoin deposits and to initiate Bitcoin withdrawals from the multi-signature wallet upon burning of wrapped tokens. Each minting operation requires a minimum deposit of 0.001 Bitcoin, and a 0.1% fee is levied on all redemptions, payable in the wrapped token. The contract announces the total supply of the wrapped token and the current wrapped token balance of any user.
source_description: enzoBTC is Lorenzo Wrapped Bitcoin.

description: Design a payments contract based on Solayer Card and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a payment gateway for a crypto debit card, holding user-deposited stablecoins to back card spending. It maintains individual user balances, a total outstanding balance for all cards, and a configurable fee structure. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their available balance, and initiate a card top-up request. Only a designated operator can approve card top-up requests and update the fee percentages. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is required for card activation, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all card top-up transactions. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and card top-ups, along with the associated amounts and user identifiers.
source_description: The Solayer Emerald Card is a Visa-based crypto debit card integrated with the Solayer ecosystem that lets users spend on-chain assets anywhere Visa is accepted

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Opyn Squeeth and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates perpetual squared exposure to a base asset, holding deposited collateral to back these positions. It maintains individual user positions, a global funding rate, and configuration parameters like the base asset and oracle addresses. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, withdraw excess collateral, and claim funding payments. A designated operator can update the oracle address and adjust the funding rate calculation parameters. The contract imposes a minimum collateralization ratio of 150% for all open positions and charges a 0.1% fee on all collateral withdrawals. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closings, along with the updated global funding rate.
source_description: Squeeth perpetual exposure to ETH²

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Wei Name Service and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized name service that custodies unique domain names. It maintains a registry of owned domain names, their associated resolver addresses, and expiration dates for each name. Callers can register a new domain name, renew an existing domain name, transfer ownership of a domain name to another address, and set the resolver address for a domain name. The owner can set the registration fee and the renewal fee. A domain name registration costs 0.01 ether per year, and renewals cost 0.005 ether per year. All domain names must be between 3 and 64 characters long. The contract announces when a domain name is registered, renewed, transferred, or when its resolver is updated.
source_description: Wei Name Service is a decentralized name service for the Ethereum blockchain.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on PHAME Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, custodying various collateral tokens and a native governance token. It maintains individual user positions including margin, leverage, and open orders, a global pool of liquidity provider assets, and system-wide configuration parameters like trading fees and maximum leverage. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, add or remove collateral, place limit orders, and swap between supported assets. A designated operator can update asset configurations, adjust trading parameters, and pause trading in emergencies. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all trades. The contract announces position liquidations, new order placements, and collateral adjustments to observers.
source_description: Decentralized Perpetual DEX on PulseChain with noval design of LP (PHLP) & governance token staking (PHAME)

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on TrueFeedBack and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a reward distribution system, holding a pool of reward tokens. It maintains a record of each user's accumulated rewards and a global configuration for reward rates. Callers can register for the reward system, claim their accumulated rewards, and view their current reward balance. A designated operator can update the reward rate, add reward tokens to the pool, and pause the reward distribution system. The reward rate cannot exceed 100 units per action. A minimum of 50 reward tokens must be added to the pool in a single transaction. The contract emits an event when rewards are claimed and when the reward rate is updated.
source_description: TrueFeedBack builds a blockchain-based data collection and analysis platform, enabling users to earn TrueFeedBack Tokens (TFBX) as a reward for their actions with the features on their mobile application.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Kizzy and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users can bet on the outcome of social media trends, holding deposited tokens as collateral. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction markets with their associated stakes and outcomes, and a global configuration for fees and market parameters. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit tokens into their account, place bets on open markets, claim winnings from resolved markets, and withdraw their available balance. A designated administrator can resolve markets, set the global fee percentage, and pause all betting activity. New prediction markets must have a minimum stake of 100 tokens, and a 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when a bet is placed, and when a market is resolved.
source_description: Kizzy is a social media betting app where you can bet on the popularity of influencers and their content.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Chocodoge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a seigniorage-based stablecoin system, holding reserve tokens and newly minted stablecoins. It maintains a total supply for the stablecoin, a redemption pool of reserve tokens, and a per-account stablecoin balance. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing reserve tokens, redeem stablecoins for reserve tokens, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target stablecoin price within a 1% deviation band, and can initiate a system-wide redemption pause lasting no more than 24 hours. Redemptions incur a 0.5% fee, and the system will not allow the stablecoin supply to exceed 1,000,000,000 units. The contract announces stablecoin transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: The first seigniorage stablecoin on Dogechain.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Frax Swap and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding reserves of two distinct fungible tokens for each pair. It maintains a record of each trading pair's token reserves, an accumulated fee for each pair, and a global protocol fee percentage. Callers can add liquidity to a trading pair, remove liquidity from a trading pair, swap one token for another within a pair, and initiate a time-weighted average swap for larger orders. A designated operator can update the global protocol fee percentage, but only within a range of 0% to 10% inclusive. The contract charges a 0.3% fee on all swaps, with a portion of this fee (determined by the global protocol fee percentage) accruing to the protocol and the remainder to liquidity providers. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added or removed, or when a swap occurs, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: Fraxswap is the first constant product automated market maker with an embedded time-weighted average market maker (TWAMM) for conducting large trades over long periods of time trustlessly. It is fully permissionless and the core AMM is based on Uniswap V2.

description: Specify a governance contract based on MORE Vaults and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and rebalancing various digital assets, issuing a single fungible receipt token representing a user's share of the vault's total value. It maintains records of each user's deposited assets, their corresponding share of the vault, and the current configuration of the vault's investment strategies. Callers can deposit assets, withdraw their share, and redeem their receipt tokens for underlying assets. A designated operator can upgrade the vault's investment strategy, rebalance assets among strategies, and set fees. The operator may set a maximum of 10 active strategies at any given time, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy upgrade events.
source_description: More Vaults is a DeFi portfolio management that enables users to compose, rebalance, and upgrade any DeFi portfolio atomically without redeploying. Depositors hold one familiar receipt token through every strategy upgrade, providing seamless portfolio management and yield optimization.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on RollX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral funds deposited by users. It maintains individual account balances, open positions with their associated leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and trading fees. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading fees, update oracle price feeds, and pause trading in emergency situations. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.10% fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closures, including the account involved, asset, amount, and relevant parameters.
source_description: RollX is the fastest-growing perpetual DEX on Base. Supporting multi-asset and BTC-native collateral, it serves the largest user base on Base.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Dinari and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues and manages tokenized representations of real-world equity shares, holding no assets itself but relying on an off-chain custodian for the underlying shares. It maintains a record of each user's balance of these tokenized shares and a global configuration for operational parameters. Callers can mint new tokenized shares by providing proof of underlying share acquisition, transfer their tokenized shares to another account, and burn tokenized shares upon redemption of the underlying equity. Only a designated operator can mint or burn tokenized shares, and only the contract owner can set the operator or adjust the minting fee. A minting fee of 0.1% is applied to all new tokenized share issuances, and the maximum number of tokenized shares that can be minted in a single transaction is 1,000,000. The contract announces all minting, burning, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Dinari dShares revolutionizes access to global stock markets by leveraging blockchain technology, enabling seamless, transparent trading of real-world assets worldwide. Our platform bridges traditional finance and DeFi, democratizing investment in major stocks for a global audience.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Bucket Protocol V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateralized debt positions, holding various approved digital assets as collateral and issuing a stablecoin against them. It maintains individual user accounts tracking deposited collateral, issued stablecoin debt, and liquidation status, alongside global configuration for supported collateral types and their associated parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral, borrow stablecoin against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can initiate liquidations on undercollateralized positions, and an owner can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and set liquidation fees. Each collateral type must have a minimum collateralization ratio of 110% and a liquidation fee of 5% of the liquidated debt. The contract announces events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Bucket Protocol is the leading Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) protocol within the Sui ecosystem, supporting multiple assets for collateralization while extending stablecoin loans in $BUCK at a fixed low-cost. Its real-time liquidation mechanism ensures both security and capital efficiency, and the inbuilt flash loan services facilitate the price stability of the stablecoin BUCK.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Phi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized identity credentialing system, custodying no assets directly but tracking user progress and achievements. It maintains per-account records of earned credentials, associated metadata, and a global configuration for credential definitions. Callers can claim new credentials, view their credential history, and transfer ownership of their identity. The owner can define new credential types, update existing credential metadata, and pause or unpause the entire system. A maximum of 10,000 unique credential types can be defined, and a fee of 0.01 ether is charged for claiming each credential. The contract announces events for credential claimed, credential definition updated, and system paused/unpaused.
source_description: An open credentialing protocol for on-chain identity that revolutionizes how users build, visualize, and showcase their on-chain identity

description: Outline a payments contract based on Pay Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a non-custodial payment system, facilitating direct token transfers between payers and payees without holding funds itself. It maintains a registry of configured payment processors, each with its supported tokens and associated fees, and tracks the total volume processed by each processor. Callers can initiate a payment by specifying the payee, the token, the amount, and the chosen payment processor, which then triggers a transfer from the caller to the payee. A designated operator can add new payment processors, update their supported tokens and fees, and pause or unpause the entire payment system. Each payment incurs a fixed fee of 0.5% of the transferred amount, payable in the same token as the payment, and the maximum number of supported tokens for any single payment processor is limited to 10. The contract announces successful payments, including the payer, payee, token, amount, and fee collected, and also announces when a payment processor's configuration is updated.
source_description: Pay Protocol is the first and only non-custodial decentralized crypto payment system. Our mission is to create and offer a secure, efficient, and true sense of decentralized payment infrastructure that empowers businesses and individuals in the Web3 industry.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Firelight and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract mints a synthetic token representing staked assets on an external ledger, and custodies the total supply of this synthetic token. It maintains a record of each user's staked balance, the total amount of assets locked on the external ledger, and a global fee rate. Callers can deposit native assets to receive synthetic tokens, redeem synthetic tokens to initiate an unstaking process on the external ledger, and claim their unstaked native assets once available. A designated operator can update the total amount of assets locked on the external ledger, reflecting changes from the external staking mechanism. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 native assets and charges a 0.5% fee on all synthetic token redemptions. The contract announces events for deposits, redemptions, and the completion of unstaking claims.
source_description: When a user stakes XRP through Firelight, the XRP is locked on the XRPL, and a liquid staking token (LST) is minted on the Flare Network. This LST allows stakers to participate in further DeFi opportunities without losing exposure to their underlying XRP.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Convex Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-boosting vault for a specific liquid staking token, holding deposited liquid staking tokens and their associated reward tokens. It maintains individual user balances of deposited liquid staking tokens, a global count of total deposited tokens, and a configuration for the reward distribution strategy. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accumulated reward tokens. A designated operator can update the reward distribution strategy and trigger the distribution of accumulated reward tokens. The maximum deposit amount per user is 100,000 liquid staking tokens. A 0.5% fee is applied to all reward token claims. The contract emits an event upon successful deposit, withdrawal, and reward claim, specifying the user, amount, and relevant token.
source_description: Convex simplifies your Curve-boosting experience to maximize your yields.

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on MiningTycoon and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming asset marketplace, holding digital item tokens and the native platform currency. It maintains individual balances for each player, a global listing of available items with their prices, and a configurable transaction fee. Players can list items for sale, purchase listed items, and withdraw their earnings. A designated operator can set the transaction fee and pause all trading activity. The maximum transaction fee is 5%, and all item listings are valid for a maximum of 30 days. The contract emits events for item listings, purchases, and withdrawals.
source_description: NEXTYPE is an integrated application ecosystem among game, NFT and DeFi that can be cross-chain (cross platform), which will create a more efficient and free NFT asset swapping protocol for the blockchain world, and provide users with high-quality multiform Dapps based on games + DeFi, games + NFT synthesis, and NFT + DeFi.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on GoonFi and describe its main flows at a high level.
