description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for synthetic assets, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains a record of each user's collateral balance, open positions for each synthetic asset, and global configuration parameters for each market. Callers can deposit collateral, open a long or short position on a synthetic asset, close an existing position, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust market parameters, including the maximum leverage, and pause all trading operations in an emergency. The maximum leverage for any synthetic asset market is 50x. A 0.1% fee is applied to the notional value of every trade. The contract announces all position openings, closures, and collateral deposits or withdrawals.
source_description: Prop AMM on Solana

description: Model an on-chain insurance contract based on Cover Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a peer-to-peer coverage market, holding deposited collateral for active coverage policies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, the active coverage policies they hold, and the policies they have underwritten, along with a global configuration for coverage terms and fees. Callers can deposit collateral, request new coverage, underwrite existing coverage requests, and claim against their active coverage policies. A designated operator can adjust the global coverage terms, including the maximum coverage duration and the claim assessment period, and can also pause or unpause the entire contract. The maximum coverage duration for any policy is 365 days, and a flat 0.5% fee is applied to all successful coverage claims. The contract emits an event upon the creation of a new coverage policy, the successful underwriting of a policy, and the approval or rejection of a claim.
source_description: A peer-to-peer coverage market.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Portal and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token bridge for moving wrapped tokens between different blockchain networks, holding deposited native tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of registered token addresses for each supported network, a mapping of wrapped token addresses to their native counterparts, and a configurable fee for each bridge operation. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing native tokens and specifying the destination network and recipient address, or redeem wrapped tokens by presenting a valid proof of transfer from the origin network. A designated operator can register new token addresses for bridging and update the transfer fee. The maximum transfer fee is 0.5% of the transferred amount, and the minimum transfer amount for any token is 1 unit of that token. The contract emits an event upon successful token deposit and another upon successful token redemption, including the amount, token address, and recipient.
source_description: A token bridge built on Wormhole.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on VanEck Treasury Fund and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized fund representing fractional ownership of short-term government debt instruments, holding an equivalent amount of a stablecoin in reserve. It maintains each investor's balance of fund shares and the total stablecoin held by the fund. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new fund shares, redeem fund shares to withdraw stablecoins, and transfer their fund shares to other addresses. A designated operator can pause and unpause all deposit and redemption operations, and can update the stablecoin reserve balance to reflect rebalancing activities. The fund charges a 0.05% fee on all redemptions, which is deducted from the stablecoin amount received by the investor. All deposits must be at least 100 stablecoins. The contract emits an event when shares are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when the fund's stablecoin reserve balance is updated.
source_description: VBILL (VanEck Treasury Fund, Ltd.) is a tokenized, U.S. Treasury-backed fund launched via Securitize, offering institutional investors real-time on-chain exposure to T-bills

description: Design a staking contract based on Phase Delegation and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool that custodies staked tokens and issues liquid staking tokens representing proportional shares of the pool. It maintains a registry of approved validator addresses, a total staked amount, a total liquid token supply, and per-user balances of liquid tokens. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid tokens, withdraw native tokens by burning liquid tokens, and claim rewards. A designated operator can add or remove validators from the approved list and update the fee percentage. The maximum number of approved validators is 25. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event whenever native tokens are deposited, liquid tokens are minted or burned, or the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: pdSOL is a multi-validator liquid staking pool on Solana

description: Model a prediction market contract based on BetMode and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized gaming platform, holding deposited funds for players to use in various games. It maintains individual player balances, a global treasury balance, and configuration settings for each game type. Callers can deposit funds, withdraw their available balance, and initiate game plays by specifying a game type and a bet amount. A designated operator can add new game types, update game parameters like minimum and maximum bets, and set the platform's house edge. The minimum bet for any game is 100 units of the deposited currency, and the maximum house edge across all games is 5%. The contract announces when a player deposits funds, when a player withdraws funds, and the outcome of each game played, including the player's win or loss.
source_description: BetMode is a decentralized gaming platform that brings classic games such as Blackjack, Slots, and Plinko on chain

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on RealT Tokens and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes real estate ownership, representing fractional interests in specific properties as fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each property's total token supply, the current owner of each token, and a mapping of property identifiers to their associated legal documentation hashes. Callers can purchase tokens for available properties, transfer their owned tokens to another address, and redeem their tokens for an equivalent share of the property's rental income. A designated operator can mint new tokens for a property up to a predefined cap of 1,000,000 tokens per property, and can also burn tokens. The owner can set a one-time property onboarding fee of 0.5% of the initial token issuance value, which must be paid before any tokens for that property can be minted. The contract emits events for token transfers, token minting, token burning, and property onboarding.
source_description: RealToken provides investors with a simple, intelligent, and user-friendly method to buy into fractional, tokenized properties, leveraging the U.S. legal system and the permissionless, unrestricted token issuance of Ethereum.

description: Create a payments contract based on HypeFuel and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates gasless token swaps, holding a reserve of a stablecoin and a native network token. It maintains a stablecoin balance for each user, a total stablecoin reserve, and a configurable exchange rate between the stablecoin and the native token. Callers can deposit stablecoins, request a native token swap for their deposited stablecoins, and withdraw their stablecoin balance. A designated operator can update the exchange rate, replenish the native token reserve, and withdraw excess stablecoins. The exchange rate is fixed at 100 native tokens per 1 stablecoin. A 0.5% fee is applied to all native token swaps, deducted from the stablecoin amount. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when a swap is executed, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: Swap USDC for native HYPE on HyperEVM without holding any gas.

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on AlphaFi Agg and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield optimizer designed to maximize returns on deposited tokens by strategically allocating them across various external yield-generating strategies. It custodies deposited tokens and their corresponding yield. The contract maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, the specific strategy their funds are allocated to, and their accumulated yield, alongside a global configuration for each available strategy. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their principal and accumulated yield, and claim accumulated yield without withdrawing principal. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, update existing strategy parameters, and pause or unpause deposits for specific strategies. The contract imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all principal withdrawals. Each yield strategy has a maximum allocation cap of 10,000 units of the underlying token. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address, the amount, and the strategy identifier.
source_description: Premier Yield Optimizer on the SUI Blockchain. Earn Safe, Real Yields with AlphaFi.

description: Outline a staking contract based on Origin Ether and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating liquid staking token, holding Ether and various yield-bearing tokens from external strategies. It maintains a total supply of its own token, the total amount of Ether and other assets it controls, and a per-account balance for each user's share of the total supply. Callers can deposit Ether to mint new tokens, redeem their tokens for Ether, and approve other accounts to spend their tokens. A designated operator can rebalance assets between different external yield strategies, and update the addresses of approved external strategies. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, and a maximum of 75% of the total assets can be allocated to any single external strategy. The contract emits an event when tokens are minted, when tokens are redeemed, and when assets are rebalanced between strategies.
source_description: Origin Ether engages with Ethereum staking pools and LP strategies. It uses platforms like Convex and Curve, and plans to integrate with other AMMs, aiming to provide higher yield opportunities

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Fortunafi and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues and manages a tokenized representation of short-term U.S. government debt, holding no custodied assets itself but relying on an external system of record for underlying asset ownership. It maintains individual user balances of the tokenized debt, a total supply, and a configurable fee rate for redemptions. Callers can mint new tokens by providing proof of external asset ownership, transfer tokens to other users, and redeem tokens for the underlying asset. A designated operator can pause all minting and redemption operations, and can adjust the redemption fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the redeemed amount. The contract will emit events for all minting, redemption, and transfer actions, and for any changes to the redemption fee.
source_description: Tokenized U.S. Treasury bills for U.S. residents

description: Model a staking contract based on Drift Staked SOL and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking token for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing a corresponding receipt token. It maintains a global record of the total base assets staked, the total receipt tokens minted, and a per-user balance of receipt tokens. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive receipt tokens, and redeem receipt tokens to withdraw their proportional share of the staked base asset. A designated operator can initiate staking of deposited base assets with an external staking provider and claim staking rewards. The owner can set the operator address and adjust the redemption fee, which is initially 0.1% and cannot exceed 1%. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, redemption, and reward claim, detailing the amount and the involved addresses.
source_description: Liquid Staking token on Solana

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Superform and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator that custodies user-deposited ERC-20 tokens. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token and tracks the total amount of each token held within the contract. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim earned yield. A designated operator can add new supported ERC-20 tokens and update the underlying yield-generating strategies for each token. The contract imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals, and a maximum of 10 distinct ERC-20 tokens can be supported at any given time. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address, the token involved, and the amount.
source_description: Superform is the onchain wealth app. Superform earns you the best returns on your crypto to grow your onchain wealth. Use SuperVaults to automatically optimize your earnings, or build your customized portfolio by directly depositing into over 800 earning opportunities

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on Durianfun Launchpad and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad facilitating fair-launch meme-token distribution and custodying KUB and newly minted tokens. It maintains a record of each launched token's current bonding curve parameters, the total KUB contributed to each token's launch, and the amount of newly minted tokens held for each contributor. Callers can contribute KUB to a token's bonding curve, claim their newly minted tokens, and withdraw their tokens from the subsequent liquidity pool. A designated operator can initiate a new token launch and transition a token from its bonding curve phase to a sealed liquidity pool. The initial bonding curve phase for any token must last exactly 24 hours, and 14.3% of all trading fees generated in the subsequent liquidity pool are shared back to the token's creator. The contract announces when a new token launch begins, when KUB is contributed, and when a token transitions to a liquidity pool.
source_description: Fair-launch meme-token launchpad on KUB. Tokens start on an exponential bonding curve, then graduate to a sealed DurianAMM liquidity pool. No presale, no team allocation, 14.3% of trading fees shared back to creators

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on LayerZero V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain message passing, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a mapping of source chain identifiers to their respective message verification configurations, alongside a global message nonce for each source chain. Callers can send messages to a destination chain, specifying the destination chain identifier, recipient address, and message payload, and can also retry failed messages. A designated operator can update the message verification configuration for a specific source chain, and only the owner can set the designated operator. Each message sent incurs a fixed fee of 0.01 ether, and the maximum message payload size is 2048 bytes. The contract announces successful message deliveries and failed message attempts to observers.
source_description: LayerZero is a technology that enables applications to move data across blockchains, uniquely supporting censorship-resistant messages and permissionless development through immutable smart contracts.

description: Define a staking contract based on Obol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of distributed validator clusters for Ethereum staking, custodying deposited Ether and associated validator credentials. It maintains a registry of active validator clusters, each with its designated operators, the amount of Ether staked by each participant within the cluster, and the current operational status of the cluster. Callers can create new validator clusters, deposit Ether into existing clusters, withdraw their staked Ether and earned rewards from completed clusters, and operators can attest to validator duties. Only the owner can set the global staking fee, pause all deposits, or add new designated operators to the system. Each validator cluster must have a minimum of 4 operators and a maximum of 7 operators, and a staking fee of 10% of all earned rewards will be applied to withdrawals. The contract announces when a new validator cluster is created, when Ether is deposited into a cluster, and when rewards are distributed.
source_description: The Obol Collective is the largest Decentralized Operator Ecosystem. Powered by Obol Distributed Validators, the end game of Ethereum staking.

description: Define a token locking contract based on Bitbond Lockers and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, holding arbitrary ERC-20 tokens deposited by users for a specified duration. It maintains a record for each locked token deposit, including the depositor's address, the token's contract address, the amount locked, and the unlock timestamp. Callers can deposit tokens, extend the lock duration of their own deposits, and withdraw their tokens once the lock duration has expired. A designated owner can set a deposit fee, which is a percentage of the deposited amount, and can withdraw collected fees. The maximum lock duration for any deposit is 104 weeks, and the minimum deposit amount for any token is 1 unit of that token. The contract announces an event when tokens are deposited, when a lock duration is extended, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Lock team and liquidity tokens in a few clicks - no coding required

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Gensokishi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming item crafting system, holding deposited fungible tokens and non-fungible tokens used as crafting materials. It maintains a registry of crafting recipes, each specifying required input tokens and the resulting output non-fungible token, along with individual user balances of deposited materials. Callers can deposit fungible and non-fungible tokens, craft items by consuming deposited materials according to a recipe, and withdraw any of their deposited tokens. A designated operator can add new crafting recipes, remove existing recipes, and set the crafting fee. Each crafting recipe has a fixed crafting fee of 50 units of the primary fungible token, and a maximum of 10 distinct crafting recipes can be active at any given time. The contract announces when a new recipe is added, when a recipe is removed, and when a user successfully crafts an item.
source_description: GensoKishi Online, the only GameFi with a 13 year history.

description: Design a token contract based on Ducky City SOFI and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a content creator rewards system, holding a pool of a designated reward token. It maintains individual balances of reward tokens for each user, along with a global configuration for reward distribution rates. Callers can deposit reward tokens into the contract, claim their accumulated rewards, and register as a content creator. Only a designated owner can set the reward token address, adjust the reward distribution rate, or pause the claiming functionality. The maximum reward distribution rate is 0.05 tokens per unit of content engagement, and a 10% fee is applied to all claimed rewards, which is sent to a specified treasury address. The contract emits an event whenever rewards are claimed, detailing the user and the amount.
source_description: Ducky SOFI is a social network in the Ducky City ecosystem that allows users to make money from the content they share

description: Model a lending protocol based on Kamino Lend and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-pool lending and borrowing, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains per-user records of deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global pools for each supported asset and configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay borrowed amounts, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new supported assets, adjust interest rate models, and initiate liquidations for undercollateralized positions. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a 0.1% origination fee is applied to all new borrows. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Kamino Lend (K-Lend) is a novel peer-to-pool borrowing primitive designed as foundational infrastructure to power complex financial products with leverage and automation and as a decentralized matchmaker between borrowers and lenders

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Ethena USDtb and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for a synthetic dollar, which is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar, and it custodies all of the underlying collateral backing the issued tokens. It maintains the total supply of issued tokens, individual account balances, and a record of approved allowances for token transfers. Callers can mint new tokens by depositing approved collateral, burn tokens to redeem collateral, transfer tokens to other accounts, and approve other accounts to spend their tokens. A designated operator is privileged to pause all token transfers and minting, and to unpause them. The contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 100% for all issued tokens, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all token redemptions. The contract announces when tokens are transferred, when tokens are minted, and when tokens are burned.
source_description: USDtb is a digital dollar, otherwise known as a USD stablecoin. USDtb can be used the same way a holder would use any other dollar, whether to send and receive payments, acquire and trade assets, or to simply hold dollars.

description: Specify a token contract based on Brokkr Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user investments in a diversified portfolio of underlying assets, holding various ERC-20 tokens representing those assets. It maintains individual user balances for each portfolio, the current allocation percentages for each asset within the portfolio, and a global fee percentage for withdrawals. Users can deposit ERC-20 tokens into the portfolio, withdraw their share of the portfolio's assets, and rebalance the portfolio's asset allocations. Only a designated operator can rebalance the portfolio's asset allocations and update the withdrawal fee. The withdrawal fee is capped at 5% of the withdrawn amount, and rebalancing operations can only be performed once every 24 hours. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and portfolio rebalancing action, including the affected user, asset, amount, and the new allocation percentages.
source_description: Brokkr is an investment platform that abstracts DeFi complexity into simple indexes, strategies, and portfolios

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Seer and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains records of open markets, individual user positions within each market, and the total collateral locked per market. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit collateral into existing markets, trade outcome tokens, and withdraw their share of settled markets. A designated operator can resolve markets, determining the winning outcome, and can adjust the market creation fee. Market creation requires a minimum collateral deposit of 100 units of the designated collateral token, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all outcome token trades, directed to the protocol treasury. The contract announces market creation, market resolution, and all outcome token trades.
source_description: A decentralized protocol allowing users to create markets, trade yield bearing tokens, use outcome tokens compatible with other exchanges, and offering new types of prediction markets

description: Design an NFT contract based on Foundation and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and auctioning of unique digital assets, holding the digital assets themselves and any associated bid funds. It maintains a record of each digital asset, its current owner, its auction status, the highest bid, and the current reserve price, along with a global platform fee percentage. Callers can mint new digital assets, place bids on active auctions, accept bids to conclude an auction, and withdraw their owned digital assets or successful bid funds. Only the contract owner can adjust the platform fee percentage and designate approved minters. The platform fee is fixed at 10% of the final sale price, and auctions must have a minimum duration of 24 hours. The contract announces when a new digital asset is minted, when a bid is placed, and when an auction concludes.
source_description: We build the most powerful tools for the most creative people in the world.

description: Specify a payments contract based on CoinDrip and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates continuous, time-based token transfers from a sender to a recipient, holding the transferred tokens in escrow until claimed. It maintains individual stream configurations for each sender-recipient pair, including the total amount to be streamed, the start time, and the end time, along with the amount already streamed and the last time a stream was updated. Callers can create new streams, deposit tokens into existing streams, withdraw available tokens from their streams, and cancel their own streams. Only the contract owner can pause all streaming activity or update the protocol-wide streaming fee. A stream must have a minimum duration of 60 seconds, and the protocol charges a 0.1% fee on all tokens withdrawn by recipients. The contract announces stream creations, stream cancellations, and successful token withdrawals.
source_description: CoinDrip is the first token streaming protocol launched on MultiversX that opens the door to an entirely new DeFi space for recurring payments, token vesting, subscriptions, and more.

description: Model a governance contract based on StakeStone Berachain Vault and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a deposit vault for native blockchain currency and a wrapped version of a prominent cryptocurrency, holding these assets on behalf of users. It maintains individual user deposit balances for both asset types, a total deposited amount for each asset, and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit native blockchain currency, deposit wrapped cryptocurrency, and withdraw their deposited assets. Only the contract owner can set the deposit fee, which must be between 0% and 5% inclusive, and only the contract owner can pause and unpause deposits. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and fee updates to observers.
source_description: Deposit ETH / BTC into the Berachain Vault to participate in the Boyco pre-deposit campaign and tap into future PoL incentives — all in one simple and seamless experience. Receive beraSTONE / beraSBTC to unlock more DeFi opportunities in trading, lending, and leveraging

description: Create a governance contract based on D2 Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for tokenized derivatives strategies, holding deposited base tokens and issuing vault shares representing a pro-rata claim on the vault's assets. It maintains records of each user's deposited base token balance and their corresponding vault share balance, along with the total supply of vault shares and the current strategy configuration. Callers can deposit base tokens to mint vault shares, withdraw base tokens by burning vault shares, and redeem their vault shares for the underlying assets. An owner role can update the strategy parameters, pause deposits, and set the management fee. A designated operator can initiate rebalancing of the vault's assets according to the current strategy. The management fee is fixed at 0.5% of the vault's total value annually. The minimum deposit amount for base tokens is 100 units. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, and strategy parameter updates.
source_description: Tokenized Derivatives Strategies, dynamically managing risk and reward efficiently. Offering a robust suite of institutional-grade managed strategies within innovative, non-custodial single-click vault architecture.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Velodrome V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity positions within a decentralized exchange, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, including token amounts, price ranges, and accumulated fees, along with global pool configurations such as fee tiers and active tick. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, add to existing positions, remove liquidity, and claim accumulated fees. A designated operator can adjust global protocol parameters like the maximum number of fee tiers and the base fee rate for new pools. The contract enforces a maximum of 5 distinct fee tiers per token pair. All liquidity removal operations incur a 0.05% protocol fee on the withdrawn token value. The contract emits events for all new position creations, liquidity adjustments, and fee claims.
source_description: The primary objective of Slipstream is to add support for concentrated liquidity pools as an additional option on top of our existing sAMM and vAMM models in a way that uniquely leverages the Velodrome flywheel.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Aevo Perps and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposits and tracking open positions. It maintains individual user account balances, active perpetual positions including margin and unrealized profit/loss, and global configuration parameters for each trading pair. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new perpetual positions, close existing positions, and modify their leverage on open positions. A designated operator role can add new perpetual trading pairs, adjust trading fees, and pause all trading activity. A maximum leverage of 100x is enforced for all trading pairs, and a trading fee of 0.05% of the notional value is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract emits events upon successful deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and any changes to trading pair configurations.
source_description: Trade crypto options on the world's first high-performance decentralized options exchange.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Echelon Prime and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming ecosystem's core utility token, holding a reserve of the token for distribution and staking. It maintains individual account balances for staked tokens, a global total supply of staked tokens, and a configuration for staking rewards. Callers can deposit tokens to stake them, withdraw their staked tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and initiate new reward periods. The maximum staking reward rate is 10% annually, and a withdrawal incurs a 0.5% fee. The contract emits events when tokens are staked, unstaked, or rewards are claimed.
source_description: Powering parallel TCG and beyond with prime.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Metars GO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital collectibles, each representing a generative AI art piece. It maintains a record of each collectible's owner, its unique identifier, and a reference to its off-chain metadata. Callers can mint new collectibles, transfer ownership of their owned collectibles, and approve other accounts to transfer their collectibles. Only a designated operator can mint new collectibles, up to a maximum supply of 10,000 collectibles. A fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each mint operation, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces when a new collectible is minted and when ownership of a collectible changes.
source_description: METARS utilizes AI deep learning to provide you with a more seamless, engaging and personalized user experience.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on RocketSwap Anubis and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and liquidity provision, holding deposited token pairs in liquidity pools. It maintains records of token balances for each liquidity pool and tracks each liquidity provider's share of those pools. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove their liquidity, and swap one token for another within a pool. The owner can set the swap fee percentage and add new token pairs to be supported. The swap fee percentage is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount. A new token pair can only be added if both tokens are ERC-20 compliant and their combined initial liquidity exceeds 100 units of a designated base token. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added or removed, and when a swap occurs, including the tokens involved and the amounts transferred.
source_description: RocketSwap is a Uniswap V2 fork DEX deployed on Anubis.

description: Define a token contract based on Fractional Art and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables fractional ownership of a single, specified non-fungible token (NFT) by issuing fungible tokens representing shares in that NFT. It maintains the total supply of fractional tokens, the current price and reserve of the NFT, and a record of each user's fractional token balance. Callers can deposit an amount of the underlying NFT to create new fractional tokens, redeem fractional tokens for a proportional share of the underlying NFT, and participate in a Dutch auction to purchase the entire NFT. Only a designated operator can set the initial NFT and its reserve price, initiate an auction for the entire NFT, and withdraw the proceeds from a successful auction. The initial reserve price for an NFT must be at least 100 units of the underlying currency, and the auction duration is fixed at 24 hours. The contract announces when an NFT is fractionalized, when fractional tokens are minted or burned, and when an auction for the entire NFT begins or ends.
source_description: Fractional ownership of the world’s most sought after NFTs. Fractional reduces entry costs, increases access, and enables new communities.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Pika and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by users to back their trading positions. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each user on various trading pairs, and global configuration parameters such as funding rates and margin requirements. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify their leverage, and withdraw available collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters, pause trading for specific pairs, or initiate emergency settlements. A minimum initial margin of 10% of the position value is required for all new positions, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closures, including the user's address, the asset involved, and the quantity.
source_description: A Perpetual Swap Exchange

description: Model a price oracle contract based on Pyth Network and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized price feed aggregator, storing and distributing validated financial market data. It maintains a registry of data providers, the latest submitted price for each asset from each provider, and a consolidated aggregate price for each asset. Callers can fetch the latest aggregated price for any listed asset, and designated operators can submit new price updates for assets they are authorized to cover. The owner can add or remove data providers, set their authorized assets, and adjust the aggregation parameters, including a minimum of 3 valid provider submissions required for an aggregate price to be considered valid. A fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each price submission, which is directed to a treasury controlled by the owner. The contract announces new aggregate price updates for each asset.
source_description: Secure your smart contracts with reliable, low-latency market data from institutional sources. Build apps with high-fidelity oracle feeds designed for mission-critical systems.

description: Define a derivatives contract based on IntentX and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetuals trading platform, holding user collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters for each supported trading pair. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can add new trading pairs, adjust trading fees, and pause all trading activity. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all trades. The contract announces position openings, position closures, and liquidations to observers.
source_description: IntentX is a perpetuals platform based on intent technology.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on PulseChain Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the transfer of a specific fungible token between two distinct blockchain networks by holding tokens in escrow on one chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance and a global configuration for operational parameters. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract, initiate a withdrawal request for their deposited tokens, and claim their tokens after a successful cross-chain transfer. A designated operator can approve withdrawal requests, cancel pending withdrawal requests, and update the fee percentage. The maximum fee percentage is 0.5% of the transferred amount, and a withdrawal request remains pending for at least 30 minutes before it can be approved. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, when a withdrawal request is initiated, when a withdrawal request is approved, and when the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: Bridge between PulseChain and Ethereum

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Connext and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fast, non-custodial transfers of tokens between different blockchain domains, holding transferred tokens in escrow until a corresponding release on the destination domain. It maintains records of each transfer's unique identifier, the amount transferred, the token type, the sender's address, the recipient's address on the destination domain, and the status of the transfer (e.g., pending, completed, disputed). Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing tokens and specifying destination details, and designated operators can confirm transfer completions on the destination domain or dispute invalid transfers. Only the owner can set the transfer fee, which is fixed at 0.05% of the transfer amount, and only designated operators can approve a transfer for release after a minimum 10-block confirmation period on the origin domain. The contract announces the initiation of each transfer, its unique identifier, and the final resolution status of each transfer to observers.
source_description: Fast, non-custodial L1-L2 and cross-L2 communication.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Arbitrum Nova Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for transferring assets between a Layer-1 and a Layer-2 network, holding deposited tokens securely on Layer-1 until they are released on Layer-2. It maintains a record of each user's deposited Layer-1 tokens awaiting withdrawal on Layer-2, and a configuration for the minimum deposit amount and withdrawal delay. Callers can deposit Layer-1 tokens, initiate a Layer-2 withdrawal, and claim Layer-1 tokens after a Layer-2 withdrawal. A designated operator can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and set the minimum deposit amount and the withdrawal delay. The minimum deposit amount is 0.001 ETH. A withdrawal from Layer-2 to Layer-1 has a mandatory 7-day delay before Layer-1 tokens can be claimed. The contract announces when a deposit occurs and when a withdrawal is initiated.
source_description: The Arbitrum Nova Bridge acts as a secure channel connecting Ethereum's mainnet (Layer-1) with the Arbitrum Rollup (Layer-2). This bridge allows users to transfer assets, like ETH or ERC-20 tokens, between these layers

description: Create a staking contract based on SSV Network and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized validator operation by distributing duties across multiple operators, and it custodies deposited Ether. It maintains a registry of registered operators, a mapping of validator keys to their assigned operator sets, and a record of each operator's performance metrics and associated stake. Callers can register as an operator, deposit Ether to fund a validator, propose a new validator key for operation, and withdraw their deposited Ether if their validator is no longer active. A designated administrator can set the minimum stake required for an operator, pause all new validator registrations, and remove a non-performing operator from the registry. The minimum operator stake is 32 Ether, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all Ether withdrawals. The contract announces when a new operator registers, when a validator key is assigned to an operator set, and when an operator's performance metrics are updated.
source_description: SSV Network enables decentralized Ethereum validation by distributing validator operations across multiple nodes, providing infrastructure for secure and decentralized staking.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on popi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launch, holding deposited base currency and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each user's base currency contribution and their corresponding allocation of project tokens, along with the current bonding curve parameters and the total base currency raised. Callers can deposit base currency to acquire project tokens, claim their project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw their base currency if the launch fails to meet its minimum. A designated operator can set the bonding curve parameters, initiate the launch, finalize the launch, and transfer the raised base currency to a designated recipient. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the base currency, and a 5% fee is applied to all base currency withdrawals before the launch concludes. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when project tokens are claimed, and when the launch state changes.
source_description: Gacha bonding-curve memecoin launchpad; raises are escrowed on the curve until graduation, then migrated to the chain's DEX (PumpSwap on Solana, Uniswap v3 on Robinhood Chain).

description: Specify a staking contract based on STKESOL by SOL Strategies and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking pool for a base asset, issuing a liquid staking token representing staked principal and accrued rewards. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the total amount of the base asset staked, and the current exchange rate between the liquid staking token and the base asset. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw the base asset. A designated operator can initiate staking of the pooled base asset and unstaking operations, and can update the exchange rate based on external oracle data. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.01 units of the base asset. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: Liquid staked SOL backed by SOL Strategies' (Nasdaq:STKE|CSE:HODL) compliant infrastructure.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Pascal and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market where users can bet on the outcome of future events, holding user stakes in escrow until event resolution. It maintains records of active markets, individual user positions within each market, and a global configuration including fees and administrative addresses. Callers can create new prediction markets, place bets on market outcomes, claim winnings from resolved markets, and withdraw their initial stakes from unresolved markets under specific conditions. A designated operator is exclusively permitted to resolve markets by declaring a winning outcome and to adjust the market creation fee. The market creation fee is fixed at 0.01 units of the native currency, and users cannot withdraw their stakes from a market within 24 hours of its scheduled resolution time. The contract emits events when a new market is created, a bet is placed, a market is resolved, and winnings are claimed.
source_description: Pascal is a noncustodial prediction market exchange on Solana.

description: Specify a token contract based on PostTechSoFi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages unique digital assets representing social network profiles, enabling users to trade ownership of these profiles. It maintains a mapping of profile identifiers to their current owner, a price curve for each profile based on its total shares outstanding, and a global fee percentage for all trades. Callers can buy shares of a profile, sell shares of a profile, and withdraw their accumulated earnings from selling shares. The contract owner can update the global fee percentage, set a new beneficiary for collected fees, and pause all trading activity. A buyer must purchase at least 1 share, and the global fee percentage is fixed at 5%. The contract emits an event whenever shares are bought, shares are sold, or the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: Web3 social network on Arbitrum, where profiles become assets and interactions turn into profits.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Umia and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and the project tokens allocated for distribution. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their claimable project token allocation, alongside a global configuration for the launch event. Callers can deposit a specified token, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch, and withdraw any unspent deposited tokens if the launch fails. An owner role can set the launch parameters, including the project token address and the total allocation, and initiate or cancel the launch. The maximum individual deposit is 1000 units of the deposit token, and the project token claim period begins exactly 24 hours after the launch is initiated. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made, when project tokens are claimed, and when the launch status changes.
source_description: Umia is the onchain venture protocol: a full-stack platform for launching, funding, and governing token-based projects onchain.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Savanna Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a base asset to back a synthetic asset. It maintains individual account balances for the synthetic asset, a global supply of the synthetic asset, and a record of the current peg ratio between the synthetic asset and the base asset. Callers can mint new synthetic assets by depositing the base asset, redeem synthetic assets for the base asset, and participate in a seigniorage mechanism by staking the synthetic asset to earn newly minted synthetic assets. A designated operator can adjust the peg ratio within a 1% deviation per 24-hour period and can initiate a system-wide rebase event. A 0.5% fee is applied to all redemptions of the synthetic asset, and a minimum of 100 base assets must be deposited to mint new synthetic assets. The contract emits events for all minting, redemption, and rebase operations, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: The first and also largest algorithmic stablecoin platform on Cronos. $SVN is pegged to the price of 1 MMF via seigniorage.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Ape Church and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a provably fair on-chain game for a single fungible token, holding player deposits and game rewards. It maintains a record of each player's active game session, including their initial wager and their current multiplier, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can deposit tokens to initiate a game, make a decision within an active game that affects their multiplier, and withdraw their accumulated winnings or remaining wager. Only the owner can set the base game parameters, such as the initial multiplier range and the maximum number of game steps, and only a designated operator can trigger the random number generation process for each game step. Each game step increases the player's multiplier by a minimum of 5% and a maximum of 20%, and a player's total winnings are capped at 100 times their initial wager. The contract emits an event when a new game session begins, when a player makes a decision, and when a game session concludes, indicating the final multiplier and the amount won or lost.
source_description: Ape In, Cash Out. Use your Apecoin to play our provably fair on chain games and watch your potential rewards multiply. Get ApeCoin.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Current and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides an isolated lending market for various digital assets, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains per-account records of deposits, borrows, and collateral ratios, along with global pools for each asset and configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit assets as collateral, borrow available assets against their collateral, repay outstanding borrows, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can add new lendable assets, adjust interest rate models, and set liquidation parameters. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 5% liquidation penalty is applied to the borrower's position during liquidation. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected account, asset, and amount.
source_description: Current is the capital efficiency layer for all future assets on Sui. One click multiply yield, isolated lending market, your capital has never worked this hard before.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on EclipseFi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens for sale and collected funds from purchases. It maintains a list of active sales, each with its own sale token, payment token, start time, end time, and individual user allocations, along with a global record of total funds raised per sale. Callers can deposit payment tokens to participate in a sale, claim purchased tokens after a sale concludes, and withdraw their unsold deposited payment tokens if a sale fails to meet its minimum target. The owner can create new sales, set sale parameters, and withdraw collected funds from completed sales. Each sale must have a minimum purchase amount of 100 payment tokens and a maximum individual allocation of 10,000 payment tokens. The contract announces when a new sale is created, when a user participates in a sale, and when a user claims tokens.
source_description: EclipseFi dismantling predatory systems to build a launch and DeFi hub for sustainable growth—aligning and empowering communities and innovative builders to thrive together

description: Design a lending protocol based on Granite and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates collateralized stablecoin loans against a liquid staking token, holding both deposited liquid staking tokens as collateral and stablecoins for lending. It maintains individual loan positions, tracking collateral amount, borrowed stablecoin amount, and a cumulative interest accrual for each borrower, alongside a global pool of available stablecoins for lending. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens to open a loan, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay their stablecoin loans, and withdraw their liquid staking token collateral once their loan is fully repaid. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate and liquidate undercollateralized loans. The maximum loan-to-value ratio is 70%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new stablecoin borrowings. The contract announces loan origination events, loan repayment events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Granite Protocol is an autonomous Bitcoin Liquidity Protocol on the Stacks blockchain. The protocol allows borrowers to take stablecoin loans using Stacks’ sBTC as collateral while eliminating rehypothecation risk. Liquidity providers can earn yield on stablecoins by providing liquidity to the pool, which is then lent to borrowers. Granite is a project incubated by Trust Machines. For more information about Granite, please visit granite.world

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Sonic Gateway and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a cross-chain asset bridge, holding deposited tokens from one chain to facilitate their representation on another. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance, a total supply of wrapped tokens minted on the destination chain, and a configurable bridge fee percentage. Callers can deposit supported tokens, initiating a transfer, and can withdraw their corresponding wrapped tokens from the destination chain. A designated operator can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The bridge fee is fixed at 0.1% of the transfer amount for all transactions. The maximum single deposit amount is capped at 1,000,000 units of any supported token. The contract emits an event upon successful deposit, indicating the sender, amount, and destination chain identifier, and another event upon successful withdrawal, indicating the recipient, amount, and source chain identifier.
source_description: Canonical Bridge for Sonic chain

description: Design a payments contract based on Cypher Card and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits of a stablecoin, enabling them to fund spending accounts for real-world purchases. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoin, a total supply of spending account tokens, and a global fee percentage. Callers can deposit stablecoin, withdraw their stablecoin balance, and convert stablecoin to spending account tokens. Only a designated operator can mint new spending account tokens for users, burn spending account tokens, and update the global fee percentage. The maximum deposit per user is 10,000 stablecoins, and the fee for converting stablecoin to spending account tokens is fixed at 0.5%. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and conversions to observers.
source_description: Cypher Card is a crypto card issuer that allows you to pay for your purchases with crypto.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Keep3r Network and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized execution of off-chain tasks, holding no custodied assets directly but managing job registrations and keeper assignments. It maintains a registry of available jobs, each with its associated parameters, and a list of registered keepers along with their staked collateral. Callers can register new jobs, update existing job parameters, add themselves as a keeper by staking collateral, signal their readiness to perform a specific job, and claim rewards for successfully completed jobs. Only the contract owner may pause all job executions or set the base reward for job completion. A keeper must stake a minimum of 100 units of the designated collateral token to register, and a job's reward claim must occur within 24 hours of its successful execution. The contract announces job registrations, job updates, keeper registrations, and successful job completions.
source_description: Keep3r Network is a decentralized keeper network for projects that need external devops and for external teams to find keeper jobs

description: Outline a payments contract based on Holyheld Card and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user balances for a crypto-linked debit card service, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user account balances for each supported ERC-20 token, along with a global configuration of supported tokens and their associated fees. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens into their account, withdraw their deposited tokens, and initiate a card payment request that debits their account. A designated operator can add or remove supported ERC-20 tokens, set the withdrawal fee for each token, and approve or reject pending card payment requests. The withdrawal fee for any token is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. All card payment requests must be approved by a designated operator within 24 hours of submission. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made, when a withdrawal is processed, and when a card payment request is approved or rejected.
source_description: Holyheld is a self-custodial Web3 wallet and payments platform that lets users store, send, receive, and spend cryptocurrencies and NFTs, with built-in services such as on-chain swaps, portfolio tracking, fiat on-ramp/off-ramp, and a crypto-linked Visa debit card

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Toros and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages an automated yield-generating vault, holding deposited base tokens and investing them into various strategies to maximize returns. It maintains a record of each user's deposited shares, the total value locked in the vault, and configuration parameters for strategy allocation. Callers can deposit base tokens, withdraw their shares for base tokens, and claim any accumulated rewards. The owner can add new investment strategies, update existing strategy allocations, and set the vault's performance fee. A designated operator can pause and unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum performance fee is 10%, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.01 base tokens. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to strategy allocations.
source_description: Automated Vaults to maximize your returns.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on ObeliskBTC and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the deposit and withdrawal of a wrapped Bitcoin token, serving as a vault for user-deposited assets. It maintains individual user balances of the wrapped Bitcoin token, a total deposited amount, and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and initiate a withdrawal of their restaked assets from an external restaking protocol. Only a designated operator can set the withdrawal fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and only the owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.0001 wrapped Bitcoin. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and fee update.
source_description: Obelisk is a Bitcoin asset management protocol enhancing value and liquidity through restaking and diverse yield strategies.

description: Outline a token contract based on cipher.rip and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token distribution and bonding curve, holding the native blockchain currency and the issued social tokens. It maintains a record of each user's purchased social tokens, their corresponding native currency contributions, and the current price and supply of the social tokens. Callers can purchase social tokens by sending native currency, sell social tokens to receive native currency, and claim any native currency from sales of their social tokens. Only a designated operator can set the initial price of the social token and adjust the bonding curve parameters. The initial price of a social token is 0.001 native currency, and a 5% fee is applied to all social token sales, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces social token purchases and sales, including the buyer, seller, amount of social tokens, and amount of native currency exchanged.
source_description: Social Finance project on Arbitrum

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on OnRe and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin deposits, acting as a capital buffer for real-world insurance risks. It maintains a total deposited amount, individual user deposit records, and a configuration for risk exposure limits. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their deposited stablecoins, and claim rewards accrued from the underlying risk coverage. A designated operator can initiate new risk tranches, settle risk outcomes, and adjust the maximum allowed capital deployment. The total capital deployed across all active risk tranches cannot exceed 80% of the total deposited capital. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and risk tranche settlement outcomes.
source_description: Connecting on-chain capital to real-world reinsurance risk — unlocking stable, uncorrelated returns that are liquid, composable and accessible for the first time

description: Create an NFT contract based on Morkie and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for non-fungible tokens, allowing users to deposit and borrow against them. It maintains individual records of deposited non-fungible tokens, outstanding loan amounts, and accrued interest for each borrower, alongside a global configuration for lending parameters and a pool of fungible tokens available for loans. Callers can deposit non-fungible tokens, borrow fungible tokens against their deposits, repay loans, and withdraw their deposited non-fungible tokens after full repayment. A designated administrator can adjust lending parameters, including the interest rate and the maximum loan-to-value ratio, and can initiate liquidations of undercollateralized loans. The maximum loan-to-value ratio is fixed at 50% of the non-fungible token's appraised value. The annual interest rate for loans is 10%. The contract announces when a non-fungible token is deposited, when a loan is taken out, when a loan is repaid, and when a non-fungible token is withdrawn.
source_description: Morkie is an NFT-FI platform designed to make NFTs accessible to everyone.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on SUNSwap V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token swaps and liquidity provision, custodying deposited tokens within various trading pools. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, global pool configurations including swap fees, and per-user token balances. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove their liquidity, swap tokens between pools, and collect earned fees. Only the designated owner may create new trading pools, update the protocol-wide swap fee, or pause all trading activity. The maximum swap fee is 0.5%, and new pools can only be created for ERC-20 compatible tokens. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps to observers.
source_description: SUNSwap V3 is a TRON-based decentralized trading protocol for automated liquidity provision and an open financial market accessible to all.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on PredMart and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a non-custodial lending protocol for prediction market shares, facilitating leveraged positions and yield generation. It custodies USDC supplied by lenders and prediction market shares deposited as collateral by borrowers. The contract maintains a global pool of available USDC, individual borrower positions tracking collateral, borrowed amount, and accrued interest, and a global configuration for interest rates and liquidation parameters. Callers can supply USDC to the lending pool, withdraw their supplied USDC and accrued interest, deposit prediction market shares as collateral, borrow USDC against their collateral, repay borrowed USDC, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rate models and liquidation thresholds, and pause borrowing or lending in emergencies. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any position is 80%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: PredMart is the margin account for Polymarket — trade prediction markets with up to 5x leverage in one click, or unlock USDC from Polymarket outcome shares you already hold without selling. It's a non-custodial lending protocol on Polygon: borrowers post Polymarket shares (ERC-1155 outcome tokens) as collateral to borrow USDC and open leveraged positions on any market, while lenders supply USDC to the pool and earn yield on otherwise idle capital.

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on GTON Capital and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collateralized stablecoin system, holding various approved collateral tokens and minting a synthetic stablecoin. It maintains individual user collateral balances, outstanding stablecoin debt, and global configuration parameters like collateral types and their associated minting limits. Callers can deposit approved collateral, mint stablecoins against their deposited collateral, repay stablecoins to retrieve collateral, and withdraw unencumbered collateral. Only the contract owner can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, or pause minting operations. A user's total stablecoin debt cannot exceed 80% of the value of their deposited collateral, and a 0.5% minting fee is applied to all newly minted stablecoins. The contract emits events for all collateral deposits, stablecoin mints, stablecoin repayments, and collateral withdrawals.
source_description: GTON Capital Ecosystem unites several mutually reinforcing DeFi 2.0 protocols with the aim of conducting algorithmic governance of liquidity and volume

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Avalanche Core Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for transferring a specific wrapped asset between an EVM chain and an external, non-EVM blockchain, holding the wrapped asset in escrow. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped asset on the EVM chain, and for each user, it tracks their individual balance of the wrapped asset. Callers can deposit the wrapped asset into the contract to initiate a transfer to the external chain, and they can request a withdrawal of the wrapped asset from the contract, which requires a corresponding deposit on the external chain. A designated operator can mint new wrapped assets on the EVM chain after verifying a deposit on the external chain, and they can burn wrapped assets from the EVM chain after verifying a withdrawal request. The contract will not allow a single mint operation to exceed 1000 units of the wrapped asset. All withdrawal requests will incur a fixed fee of 0.01 units of the wrapped asset, deducted from the withdrawal amount. The contract announces when wrapped assets are minted, burned, deposited, or withdrawn.
source_description: Native Bitcoin Bridge. ETH EVM support. No added fees or middlemen, ever.

description: Create a token contract based on FriendRoom and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for unique digital rooms, custodying an ERC-20 token used for purchases and a unique ERC-721 token representing room ownership. It maintains records of room ownership, room prices, and a global fee recipient. Callers can create new rooms, buy existing rooms, and set the price for rooms they own. A designated operator can set the creation fee and the marketplace fee percentage. The creation fee for a new room is fixed at 100 of the ERC-20 token, and the marketplace fee is 5% of the sale price, deducted from the seller. The contract announces when a room is created, when a room is bought, and when a room's price is updated.
source_description: Buy, create, explore & Speculate on rooms with friends.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Clusters and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a universal name service, managing the registration and ownership of unique, human-readable names. It maintains a record for each registered name, storing its owner, a resolver contract address, and a time of expiration. Callers can register a new name, transfer ownership of a name they own, renew the expiration time of a name, and configure the resolver for a name they own. A designated operator can set the registration fee and the renewal fee. The minimum registration period for a new name is 365 days. The fee for registering a new name is 0.01 ether per year. The contract emits an event when a new name is registered, when a name's ownership is transferred, when a name's expiration is renewed, and when a name's resolver is updated.
source_description: The leading universal name service

description: Model a staking contract based on Swell Liquid Staking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to deposit an underlying asset and receive a liquid staking token in return, representing their staked position and accruing rewards. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total amount of underlying asset staked, and a configurable exchange rate between the underlying asset and the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit the underlying asset, withdraw their staked underlying asset, and redeem their liquid staking tokens for the underlying asset. A designated operator can update the exchange rate and set the staking fee. The staking fee is fixed at 10% of generated rewards. Withdrawals are subject to a 7-day unbonding period after a withdrawal request is initiated. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: Swell is a non-custodial liquid staking protocol

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Plume Vaults and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for tokenized real-world assets, holding various ERC-20 tokens representing fractional ownership of physical goods. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their share balance within the vault, and a global configuration for fees and asset whitelisting. Callers can deposit whitelisted ERC-20 tokens, redeem their vault shares for underlying assets, and transfer their vault shares to other accounts. A designated operator can whitelist new ERC-20 assets for deposit, update the redemption fee, and pause or unpause all deposits and redemptions. The maximum redemption fee is 5%, and a minimum of 100 shares must be held to initiate a redemption. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, redemption, and share transfer, and when the redemption fee is updated.
source_description: Plume Vaults is Plume's flagship real-world asset protocol, built to enable onchain access to real world yield through structured vaults

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Eclipse Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance and a global configuration for transfer parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, initiate a transfer to the destination chain, and claim transferred tokens on the destination chain. A designated operator is privileged to update the transfer fee and pause all transfer operations. A minimum transfer amount of 100 units of the deposited token is enforced, and a transfer fee of 0.1% is applied to all outgoing transfers. The contract announces events for successful deposits, initiated transfers, and claimed transfers, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Solana on Ethereum - Ethereum's first SVM L2

description: Outline a staking contract based on StakeWise V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault that custodies deposited Ether and issues two ERC-20 tokens: one representing the principal deposit and another representing accrued yield. It maintains per-account records of deposited principal, earned yield, and active withdrawals, along with a global configuration for fees and withdrawal delays. Callers can deposit Ether to receive principal tokens, redeem principal tokens for Ether, or initiate a withdrawal of earned yield. The owner can set the deposit fee, adjust the withdrawal delay, and designate operators who can pause deposits. The maximum deposit fee is 0.5%, and the minimum withdrawal delay is 24 hours. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and successful Ether transfers to observers.
source_description: Stake your ETH and manage your capital flexibly with the principal and yield tokens from StakeWise.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Lofty and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractional ownership of real-world assets, specifically real estate properties, and custodies the digital representations of these property fractions. It maintains a record of each property, including its total fractional units and the current owner of each unit, alongside a global configuration for fees and administrative addresses. Callers can purchase fractional units, transfer their owned units to another address, and sell their units back to the system. A designated operator can add new properties, set the total fractional units for a property, and adjust the purchase and sale prices. The contract charges a 1% fee on all unit transfers, and a property must have at least 100 fractional units before any units can be purchased. The contract emits an event whenever fractional units are transferred or a new property is added.
source_description: Fractionalized real estate on Algorand.

description: Model a staking contract based on Crypto.com Liquid Staking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables liquid staking for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains per-account records of deposited base assets and issued liquid staking tokens, along with a global exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset. A designated operator can update the exchange rate to reflect staking rewards and can pause deposits and redemptions. The initial exchange rate is 1 base asset per 1 liquid staking token, and a 0.5% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces deposit and redemption events, including the amount of base asset and liquid staking token involved.
