source_description: Liquid staking is available for ETH and Solana! Earn rewards and receive tradeable CDCETH and CDCSOL

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Blur Bids and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized NFT bidding system, holding deposited fungible tokens as collateral for bids. It maintains a record of each user's fungible token balance, active bids for specific NFT collections, and a global configuration for fees and minimum bid amounts. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, place bids on NFT collections specifying a price and quantity, cancel their active bids, and withdraw their fungible token balance. A designated operator can update the fee percentage and the minimum bid amount for any collection. A 0.5% fee is applied to successful bid fulfillments, and the minimum bid amount for any collection must be at least 0.001 of the fungible token. The contract emits events upon successful deposits, bid placements, bid cancellations, and bid fulfillments.
source_description: The NFT marketplace for pro traders

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Arca Labs ArCoin and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes ownership of shares in a regulated financial fund, holding no assets itself but representing claims on an external custodian. It maintains a record of each account's token balance and a global total supply, along with configuration parameters for minting and burning. Callers can transfer tokens to other accounts, approve spending by third parties, and redeem their tokens for the underlying fund shares through an off-chain process. A designated operator can mint new tokens to specified accounts and burn tokens from specified accounts, but only after a 24-hour time lock has passed for any minting request. The contract owner can set the designated operator and pause all token transfers. All token transfers incur a 0.1% fee, deducted from the sender's amount. The contract announces token transfers, approvals, minting events, and burning events to observers.
source_description: Arca Labs ArCoin is a tokenized version of the Arca U.S. Treasury Fund

description: Define a token contract based on Bundles and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a diversified investment vehicle, holding various approved ERC-20 tokens in a curated portfolio. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their proportional share of the total portfolio, and the current composition of the portfolio. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their share of the underlying assets, and redeem their portfolio tokens for the underlying assets. A designated operator can adjust the portfolio's asset allocation and add or remove approved ERC-20 tokens, while the owner can set the operator and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. A deposit fee of 0.5% is applied to all incoming assets, and the portfolio must always contain at least 3 distinct ERC-20 tokens. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and portfolio rebalances to observers.
source_description: Invest and diversify your portfolio in a snap

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Ryoshi Royale and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a competitive gaming platform, holding deposited game tokens and non-fungible hero tokens. It maintains individual player records including hero token ownership, hero statistics, equipped item identifiers, and accumulated training points, alongside global configuration for battle schedules and reward distribution. Callers can deposit game tokens, register hero tokens, equip items to their heroes, allocate training points, enter heroes into battles, and claim earned rewards. A designated operator can initiate battles, determine battle outcomes, and distribute rewards based on results. The contract enforces a maximum of 5 equipped items per hero and a 2% fee on all claimed rewards, deducted at the time of claim. The contract announces battle commencements, battle results, and reward distributions to observers.
source_description: Ryoshi Royale is an NFT-based battle arena platform built on the Cronos blockchain that transforms Ryoshi NFTs into playable heroes for competitive gaming. Players can customize their Ryoshi with equipment and training points in order to compete in strategic daily and weekly battles to earn cryptocurrency rewards

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on Rain and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized prediction markets, holding deposited collateral in an escrow. It maintains a record of each market's parameters, including its question, resolution source, and outcome states, along with individual user positions for each market and the total collateral pooled per outcome. Callers can create new markets, deposit collateral into an existing market to take a position on an outcome, withdraw their collateral if the market is unresolved, or claim their winnings after a market has been resolved. A designated market creator can resolve a market by providing the final outcome, and only the owner can set the market creation fee or pause all market activity. New markets require a minimum collateral deposit of 100 units of the designated stablecoin, and a 1% fee is charged on all market winnings, deducted at the time of claiming. The contract announces market creation, collateral deposits, position withdrawals, market resolutions, and winning claims to observers.
source_description: Rain | Decentralized Prediction markets Protocol. Predict anything. Create markets. Trade options. Own the future!.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Frigg.eco and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin deposits, allowing users to invest in tokenized real-world assets. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoins and records of their proportional shares in various asset portfolios, along with a global configuration for investment strategies. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, redeem their stablecoin balance, and initiate an investment into a specific asset portfolio which converts their stablecoin balance into portfolio shares. Only a designated operator can approve new asset portfolios for investment and adjust the stablecoin deposit fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the deposited amount. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, an investment is executed, or a redemption occurs, including the user's identity and the amount involved.
source_description: Frigg - Invest in a sustainable Future.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Scientix and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates interest-free, self-repaying loans by accepting yield-generating collateral and issuing synthetic tokens representing future yield. It maintains individual loan positions tracking collateral deposited, synthetic tokens minted, and accrued yield, alongside global configuration parameters like the collateralization ratio and supported collateral types. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic tokens against their collateral, repay synthetic tokens, and withdraw their collateral once the loan is fully repaid. A designated operator can add new supported collateral types and adjust the collateralization ratio, which must always be between 120% and 200%. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all minted synthetic tokens, payable to a treasury address. The contract emits events for all loan creations, repayments, and collateral withdrawals, including the borrower's address, the amount of collateral, and the amount of synthetic tokens involved.
source_description: Future-yield-backed Synthetic Token. Interest-free, Self-repaying and Liquidation-free Loans. Your collateral earns you yields in the background

description: Design a payments contract based on PagCrypto and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fiat-to-crypto payment processing by holding deposited stablecoins, which are then used to fulfill fiat payment requests. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoins and a global configuration for processing fees and supported fiat currencies. Callers can deposit stablecoins, request fiat payouts to specified bank accounts, and view their current stablecoin balance. A designated operator can approve or reject fiat payout requests, update the processing fee, and add or remove supported fiat currencies. The maximum stablecoin deposit per transaction is 10,000 units, and the processing fee for fiat payouts is fixed at 0.5% of the fiat amount. The contract emits an event when stablecoins are deposited, when a fiat payout request is made, and when a fiat payout request is approved or rejected.
source_description: PagCrypto is a crypto-to-fiat payments infrastructure that enables on-chain assets to be used for real-world payments through local payment rails such as PIX, with multi-chain support.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on GumBall Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of fractionalized non-fungible tokens, holding the underlying non-fungible tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each fractionalized token's total supply, the current reserve of fungible tokens backing it, and the bonding curve parameters for each fractionalized token. Callers can create new fractionalized tokens by depositing a non-fungible token, buy fractionalized tokens from the reserve, sell fractionalized tokens back to the reserve, and withdraw the underlying non-fungible token if they hold all fractionalized tokens. Only the owner can set the protocol fee percentage and update the allowed non-fungible token collection list. The protocol fee is fixed at 0.5% of each buy or sell transaction. A minimum of 100 fractionalized tokens must be minted when a new fractionalized token is created. The contract announces when new fractionalized tokens are created, when fractionalized tokens are bought or sold, and when underlying non-fungible tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: GumBall Protocol is a Liquid NFT creation and trading hub.

description: Create a payments contract based on Nexo Card and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a credit line collateralized by user-deposited digital assets, enabling users to spend against their crypto holdings without selling them. It maintains individual user accounts, tracking each user's collateral balances, outstanding credit, and accrued interest, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and supported collateral types. Callers can deposit supported digital assets as collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay outstanding credit, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add or remove supported collateral tokens, adjust interest rates, and initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral asset is 50%, and the annual interest rate for borrowed stablecoins is fixed at 12%. The contract announces when a user's collateral balance changes, when a loan is taken out or repaid, and when a liquidation occurs.
source_description: Nexo Card is a crypto card issuer that allows you to pay for your purchases with crypto.

description: Design an NFT contract based on 1155Tech and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a digital art registry and marketplace, holding non-fungible tokens representing unique artworks. It maintains per-artwork records including creator, ownership, royalty percentages, and sale listings, along with a global fee configuration. Callers can mint new artwork tokens, transfer ownership of tokens, list tokens for sale at a fixed price, purchase listed tokens, and delist their own tokens. Only the designated owner can set the global platform fee, which is capped at 5%, and designate approved minters. Each artwork token must specify a royalty percentage between 0% and 15% for its creator, which is enforced on all secondary sales. The contract announces all token mints, transfers, listings, and purchases to observers.
source_description: 1155Tech is a new art platform that puts creators first, protects royalties, boosts discovery, and makes art markets liquid

description: Create an NFT contract based on Emporium and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the trading of unique digital collectibles representing vaulted physical assets, holding no fungible tokens itself but tracking ownership of these non-fungible tokens. It maintains individual records for each collectible, including its current owner, a listing status, and an optional sale price, alongside a global configuration for platform fees. Callers can list a collectible for sale, purchase a listed collectible, delist a collectible they own, and transfer ownership of a collectible to another account. Only a designated operator can set the platform fee percentage and withdraw accumulated fees. The platform fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price for every successful purchase, and a collectible cannot be listed for sale if it is already actively listed. The contract announces collectible listings, purchases, and transfers to observers.
source_description: Emporium is a Solana marketplace for trading digitized versions of vaulted collectible cards, with built-in royalties and portfolio tracking.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Chainflip AMM and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset swaps without wrapped tokens, holding deposited assets in escrow until a swap is completed. It maintains a global configuration for swap parameters, a record of active swap requests including source and destination chain details, and a balance for each supported asset. Callers can initiate a swap by depositing funds, claim swapped funds after a successful cross-chain transfer, and cancel their own pending swap requests. A designated operator can register new supported assets, update swap fees, and finalize cross-chain swap outcomes. The maximum swap fee is 0.5% of the swapped value, and a swap request automatically expires if not finalized within 24 hours. The contract emits events for every initiated swap, successful swap completion, and cancelled swap.
source_description: Chainflip is a cross-chain AMM enabling native asset swaps without wrapped tokens or specialised wallets.

description: Model a staking contract based on Phantom SOL and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates liquid staking of a native blockchain asset, holding deposited assets and issuing a liquid staking token in return. It maintains a mapping of each user's deposited native assets, their corresponding liquid staking token balance, and the current exchange rate between the native asset and the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit native assets to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for native assets, and claim rewards accrued from the underlying staking mechanism. Only a designated operator can update the exchange rate between the native asset and the liquid staking token, and only the contract owner can set the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed native assets, and the minimum deposit amount for native assets is 0.1 units. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: With Phantom, you can easily stake your SOL natively or opt for liquid staking—whatever suits your strategy.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on PancakeSwap AMM and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding reserves of two distinct tokens for each pair. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, a global trading fee, and a per-pool swap fee. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap one token for another within a pool, and transfer their liquidity provider tokens. A designated owner can set the global trading fee, create new token pairs, and update the swap fee for any existing pool. The global trading fee is 0.25% of the input amount for any swap. Adding liquidity to a pool requires depositing both tokens in proportion to their current reserves. The contract emits an event for every liquidity addition, removal, and token swap, including the amounts involved and the affected pool.
source_description: The #1 AMM and yield farm on Binance Smart Chain

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on BitFi Basis and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding underlying collateral tokens that back its value. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, the amount of collateral deposited by each user, and a global exchange rate between the stablecoin and its underlying collateral. Callers can deposit collateral to mint stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for the underlying collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the global exchange rate and set a redemption fee. The redemption fee is capped at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and the exchange rate can only be increased, never decreased. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, along with any changes to the exchange rate or redemption fee.
source_description: Reliable returns with bfUSD, our yield-bearing stablecoin that fuels stability while amplifying your earnings in a dynamic ecosystem.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Babylon Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the staking of a base asset, enabling users to lock their holdings to secure a proof-of-stake chain and earn rewards, without custodying the underlying base asset directly. It maintains individual user staking positions, tracking the amount staked and accumulated rewards for each staker, along with a global pool of available rewards and a configurable unbonding period. Callers can initiate a stake by locking their base asset, claim accumulated rewards, and request an unbonding of their staked amount, which becomes withdrawable after a delay. Only a designated operator can deposit rewards into the contract's reward pool and update the unbonding period. The unbonding period is fixed at 14 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all claimed rewards. The contract emits events when a stake is initiated, rewards are claimed, an unbonding request is made, and when unbonded funds are withdrawn.
source_description: Bitcoin holders can earn yields from their idle bitcoins in a secure way: no third-party trust, no bitcoin bridging to any other chain. Bitcoin holders simply lock their bitcoins in a self-custodial way to gain the rights to validate PoS chains and earn yields as a return. Powered by the fast unbonding and scalable restaking features of the protocol, bitcoin stakers can also enjoy maximal liquidity and yields.

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Magic Eden and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the trading of non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and associated payments in escrow. It maintains a record of listed NFTs with their seller, price, and status, alongside user balances for native currency. Callers can list an NFT for sale, cancel a listing, and purchase an NFT from a listing. A designated operator can pause all trading activity and update the platform fee. The platform fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price, and listings expire after 30 days if not purchased or canceled. The contract announces when an NFT is listed, when a listing is canceled, and when an NFT is successfully purchased.
source_description: The largest NFT marketplace and Runes platform. Buy, sell and discover Ordinals and NFTs across Solana, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Base, ApeChain, Abstract, Berachain, Monad Testnet, Arbitrum, Sei, BNB Chain, and Polygon.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Crovia NFT Marketplace and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace for non-fungible tokens (NFTs), holding NFTs and the native blockchain currency in escrow during sales. It maintains a record of listed NFTs including their seller, price, and status, and tracks the marketplace's accumulated fees. Callers can list an NFT for sale, purchase a listed NFT, cancel their own NFT listing, and update the price of their listed NFT. A designated owner can withdraw accumulated fees and pause all marketplace activity. A listing fee of 0.01 native currency is charged upon successful sale, and the maximum number of NFTs a single address can list concurrently is 10. The contract announces NFT listings, purchases, and cancellations to observers.
source_description: Cronos NFT Marketplace & Analytics Hub.

description: Design a payments contract based on Pulsar Money and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates scheduled, recurring token transfers, acting as an escrow for the tokens designated for future payments. It maintains individual payment schedules for each sender, including the recipient, amount, frequency, and start time, along with a total balance of tokens held in escrow. Callers can create a new payment schedule, deposit tokens into an existing schedule, withdraw available tokens from a schedule if the recipient has not claimed them, and cancel their own active schedules. A designated operator can pause all transfers in an emergency and update the fee percentage. Each new payment schedule incurs a one-time setup fee of 0.05 ether, and a maximum of 100 active schedules are permitted per sender. The contract announces when a new schedule is created, when tokens are deposited, when a payment is executed, and when a schedule is cancelled.
source_description: Pulsar Money is a Smart Payments Hub reshaping on-chain payments through advanced transfer modules.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Siren and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized options market, holding collateral tokens deposited by writers and premiums paid by buyers. It maintains a record of each user's collateral balance, their active option positions, and market configuration parameters for each option series. Callers can create new option series, buy options, exercise options, deposit collateral, and withdraw collateral. A designated operator can pause trading for specific option series, and the owner can adjust global trading fees. The maximum number of option series active at any time is 200. A 0.1% fee is charged on option purchases, paid to a treasury address. The contract announces events for new option series creation, option purchases, option exercises, and collateral deposits and withdrawals.
source_description: Decentralized option markets on Ethereum.

description: Design a staking contract based on stake.link liquid and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies an underlying proof-of-stake asset, allowing users to deposit the asset and receive a liquid staking token representing their staked position. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a mapping of user balances for the liquid staking token, and a record of the total underlying asset deposited and staked. Callers can deposit the underlying asset, withdraw their deposited underlying asset by burning the liquid staking token, and claim staking rewards. A designated operator can initiate staking and unstaking operations with the underlying asset, and can set the protocol fee up to a maximum of 10%. The owner can upgrade the contract and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. Withdrawals are subject to a 7-day unbonding period after the request is made. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: Effortlessly stake your crypto assets with stake.link's easy to use, secure liquid staking protocol.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Jupiter Gacha and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a marketplace for unique, graded digital collectibles, holding the digital collectibles themselves in escrow during active listings. It maintains a registry of all listed collectibles, their current asking prices, and the identity of their sellers, along with a configurable platform fee percentage. Callers can list a collectible for sale, purchase a listed collectible, and delist their own active listings. Only a designated operator can adjust the platform fee, which is capped at a maximum of 5% of the sale price. The contract announces when a collectible is listed, when it is successfully sold, and when a listing is canceled.
source_description: Buy and sell graded, tokenized cards with other collectors.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Francium and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a leveraged yield farming vault, holding deposited base tokens and borrowed quote tokens. It maintains per-user records of deposited base tokens and borrowed quote tokens, and global configuration for available farming strategies and associated risk parameters. Callers can deposit base tokens, borrow quote tokens against their collateral, open a farming position, close a farming position, and withdraw their base tokens and any accrued yield. A designated operator can add new farming strategies, update strategy parameters, and pause all new position openings. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 5x the deposited collateral. A 0.5% fee is charged on all profits realized from closed positions. The contract emits an event when a new position is opened, when a position is closed, and when a strategy's parameters are updated.
source_description: Francium is a DeFi yield strategy Platform on Solana, providing leveraged/hedged farming, DeFi strategies & on-chain trading strategies. Francium also help users to build their own yield strategy through strategy dev toolbox. Granted by Solana & Serum.

description: Design a lending protocol based on marginfi Lending and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for various crypto assets, holding deposited tokens as collateral. It maintains individual account balances for each user's deposits and borrows, a global record of total liquidity and outstanding debt per asset, and configuration parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit supported tokens, borrow available assets against their collateral, repay their loans, and withdraw their excess collateral. A designated operator can update interest rate models, add new supported assets, and pause borrowing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.05% protocol fee is charged on all new borrows. The contract emits events for every deposit, borrow, repayment, and withdrawal, including the user's address, the asset, and the amount.
source_description: Connecting liquidity across DeFi.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Kraken Bitcoin and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for a wrapped Bitcoin token, custoding native Bitcoin deposits in an off-chain vault and issuing an equivalent amount of wrapped tokens on-chain. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped token and individual balances for each account, along with a mapping of Bitcoin deposit addresses to user accounts. Callers can deposit native Bitcoin to a generated address to mint wrapped tokens, transfer wrapped tokens to other accounts, and redeem wrapped tokens to receive native Bitcoin from the off-chain vault. A designated operator can pause all minting and redeeming operations, and can update the Bitcoin deposit address generation logic. The minimum amount of native Bitcoin that can be deposited or redeemed is 0.0001 BTC. A redemption fee of 0.1% is applied to all redeemed amounts. The contract announces token transfers, minting events, and redemption requests to observers.
source_description: The kBTC token lets you leverage the power of Bitcoin while interacting with Ethereum, OP Mainnet, and other growing DeFi ecosystems. Fully-backed. Fully exchangeable anytime.

description: Create a staking contract based on RHEA LST and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism that custodies a base asset and issues a liquid staking token representing staked positions. It maintains individual user balances of the base asset deposited, the corresponding liquid staking token minted, and a global record of the total base asset staked and the total liquid staking token in circulation. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset, and transfer liquid staking tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can initiate staking of the base asset with an external validator set and claim rewards from those validators. The contract charges a 1% fee on all redeemed base assets, and the redemption queue processes a maximum of 100 requests per block. The contract emits events for all deposits, redemptions, and transfers of liquid staking tokens.
source_description: Liquid staking for the Rhea Finance ecosystem.

description: Model a token locking contract based on GoPlus Locker V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, designed to custody various fungible tokens for a specified duration. It maintains records of each locked token, including the token's address, the amount locked, the unlock time, and the beneficiary of the locked tokens. Callers can deposit tokens into the locker, withdraw tokens once their lock duration has expired, and extend the lock duration for existing deposits. The contract owner is privileged to set a deposit fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited amount, and to designate up to five trusted addresses as operators who can initiate emergency withdrawals in extreme circumstances. All token deposits must have a minimum lock duration of 24 hours and a maximum of 365 days. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, when tokens are withdrawn, and when a lock duration is extended.
source_description: A multi-chain token and liquidity locker by GoPlus Security.

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on Citrea Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the bridging of a fungible token between two chains, holding deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance awaiting withdrawal on the destination chain, and a global configuration for fees and operator addresses. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract, initiate a withdrawal request for their deposited tokens to the destination chain, and claim their tokens on the destination chain after a successful bridge. A designated operator can approve withdrawal requests, effectively releasing tokens on the destination chain, and set the bridge fee. The owner can add or remove designated operators. A withdrawal request must be approved within 24 hours of its initiation, otherwise it expires. The bridge charges a fixed fee of 0.1% on all withdrawals. The contract announces withdrawal request initiations, approvals, and claims, including the user's address, amount, and destination chain identifier.
source_description: Citrea Bridge is a bridge that allows users to bridge tokens to and from Citrea.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Crypto Lottery and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lottery, holding deposited funds and distributing prizes. It maintains a record of each participant's ticket purchases, the current lottery round number, the total prize pool for the current round, and a list of winning numbers for past rounds. Participants can purchase tickets for the current round, and a designated operator can initiate new lottery rounds and draw winning numbers. Only the owner can set the ticket price and the operator address. The ticket price is fixed at 0.01 ether per ticket, and a new lottery round can only be initiated if at least 100 tickets have been sold in the previous round. The contract announces when a new round begins, when tickets are purchased, and when winning numbers are drawn.
source_description: The Crypto Lottery is an honest and scalable lottery built on the blockchain technology for the million people around the world.

description: Design a governance contract based on Arkonix and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes and manages non-custodial vaults for executing automated trading strategies, holding user-deposited base tokens and strategy-generated profit tokens. It maintains a record of each vault's current strategy, its allocated capital, its profit and loss, and a global registry of approved trading strategies and their associated parameters. Callers can create a new vault, deposit base tokens into an existing vault, withdraw their share of vault tokens, and initiate a strategy execution cycle. A designated operator can approve new trading strategies, update the parameters of existing strategies, and pause or unpause the entire system. A vault creation requires a minimum initial deposit of 100 base tokens. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, directed to a designated treasury address. The contract announces the creation of new vaults, all deposits and withdrawals, and any changes to strategy parameters.
source_description: Non-custodial onchain vaults running systematic, rules-based trading strategies.

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on USDCx and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a private, programmable stablecoin, backed 1:1 by a designated reserve stablecoin held in an external, off-chain reserve. It maintains each account's balance of the private stablecoin and a global total supply. Callers can mint new private stablecoin by depositing the designated reserve stablecoin, transfer private stablecoin to other accounts, and redeem private stablecoin for the designated reserve stablecoin. A designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers and redemptions. The owner can set the designated reserve stablecoin address and upgrade the contract. The maximum total supply of the private stablecoin is 1,000,000,000 units. All redemptions incur a 0.1% fee, paid in the designated reserve stablecoin, which is sent to a predefined treasury address. The contract announces Transfer and Mint events for all balance changes.
source_description: USDCx is a private, programmable stablecoin built with Circle, backed 1:1 by USDC held in Circle xReserve

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Flamix and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in various tokens. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and supported collateral types. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close leveraged positions, adjust margin on existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update global configuration parameters, liquidate undercollateralized positions, and pause trading in emergencies. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closings, and liquidations.
source_description: Perpetuals DEX offering high-leverage trading using any token as collateral.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on AlphaX and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures, holding collateral in various approved digital assets. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each account, and global funding rates for each trading pair. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, adjust leverage, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can add new trading pairs, update oracle prices, and adjust risk parameters like initial margin requirements. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x. A trading fee of 0.1% of the notional value is charged on all trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closures.
source_description: AlphaX DEX provides 100% on-chain trading with decentralized security, self-custody wallet integration, and a permanent NO-KYC policy, ensuring complete privacy. With ultra-fast transaction speeds and access to high-potential assets, AlphaX is a versatile platform for traders looking for flexibility and reliability in their trading journey.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on OKX xBTC and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a wrapped asset issuance mechanism, custodying a reserve of a base asset. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped asset and individual balances for each holder. Callers can mint new wrapped assets by depositing the base asset, and redeem wrapped assets for the base asset. A designated operator can pause all minting and redemption operations. The redemption fee is 0.1% of the redeemed amount. The maximum amount of base asset that can be deposited in a single minting operation is 100 base asset units. The contract announces the total supply of the wrapped asset and individual balance changes for all holders.
source_description: xBTC is a wrapped token issued by OKX that strictly follows a 1:1 reserve mechanism

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Temple and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for tokenized real-world assets, holding various asset tokens and a native governance token. It maintains a registry of approved asset tokens, per-user balances for each token, and configurable trading pair parameters including fees and liquidity. Callers can deposit and withdraw approved asset tokens, create new trading pairs, provide and remove liquidity, and swap tokens within established pairs. A designated operator can approve new asset tokens, adjust trading pair fees within a range of 0.05% to 0.50%, and pause all trading operations. The contract enforces a maximum of 100 distinct trading pairs and requires that all new trading pairs are created with an initial liquidity provision of at least 100 units of each asset in the pair. It announces events for deposits, withdrawals, liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and all token swaps, including the tokens involved and the quantities exchanged.
source_description: Temple is building private and compliant financial market infrastructure for the world’s institutions on the Canton Network.

description: Specify a payments contract based on GrowStreams and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates continuous, real-time token transfers between accounts, holding deposited tokens in escrow until streamed. It maintains a record for each sender detailing their deposited balance, the recipient of their stream, the rate of transfer per second, and the start time of the stream. Callers can deposit tokens into their account, create a new stream specifying a recipient and a rate, update an existing stream's recipient or rate, and withdraw any unstreamed or received tokens. Only the designated owner can pause all streaming activity or update the fee percentage applied to all outgoing streams. A stream's rate must be greater than zero and cannot exceed 1,000 tokens per second. All outgoing stream payments incur a 2.5% fee, deducted from the sender's balance and transferred to a designated fee recipient. The contract emits an event whenever a new stream is created, an existing stream is updated, or tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Real-time token streaming on Vara Network. Composable smart contracts for payroll, subscriptions, bounties, grants, and revenue sharing. Fees adapter tracks 2.5% streaming fee on wVARA flows.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Universal Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped versions of various cryptocurrencies. It maintains a mapping of each user's balance for every wrapped asset, along with a global configuration for each asset's bridging parameters. Callers can deposit an asset to receive its wrapped equivalent, redeem a wrapped asset for its native form on a different chain, and query their wrapped asset balances. Only a designated operator can add new wrapped assets, adjust bridging fees, or pause transfers for a specific asset. The maximum bridging fee for any asset is 0.5% of the transfer amount, and a minimum transfer amount of 0.001 wrapped asset units is enforced for all redemptions. The contract announces events for successful deposits, successful redemptions, and changes to an asset's bridging fee.
source_description: Trade crypto’s most popular assets from your onchain wallet. 80+ 1:1 backed wrapped uAssets. uXRP, uSUI, uSOL

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Ready Cards and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital collectibles, custodying the collectible tokens themselves. It maintains a record of each collectible's unique identifier and its current owner, along with a global count of total collectibles minted and a mapping of pack identifiers to their contents. Callers can open a pack to receive collectibles, transfer a collectible they own, and view the contents of any pack. Only a designated operator can create new packs of collectibles and set the probability distribution for collectible rarity within those packs. A maximum of 10,000 unique collectibles can ever be minted, and opening a pack costs a fixed fee of 0.01 units of the native blockchain currency. The contract announces when a new pack has been created and when a collectible has been transferred.
source_description: A proprietary card pack-opening platform, built on real-time VRFs where every pull, every card, and every unit of company inventory is verifiable on-chain, by anyone

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on Grave Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages an algorithmic stablecoin pegged to a target value of 0.1 units of a base asset, minting and burning the stablecoin to maintain its peg. It maintains the total supply of the stablecoin, the current target price of the base asset, and a record of each user's stablecoin balance. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing the base asset, burn stablecoins to redeem the base asset, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target price of the base asset, but only by a maximum of 0.001 units per 24-hour period. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all stablecoin minting operations, deducted from the base asset deposit. The contract announces all stablecoin minting, burning, and transfer events to observers.
source_description: Grave is an algorithmic stable coin protocol pegged to the price of 0.1 AVAX.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Hero Blaze and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's in-game currency, holding a reserve of the primary game token. It maintains individual player balances for the in-game currency and a global configuration for conversion rates. Players can convert the primary game token into in-game currency, and convert in-game currency back into the primary game token. A designated operator can adjust the conversion rate and mint new in-game currency. The conversion rate from the primary game token to in-game currency is fixed at 1 primary game token to 100 in-game currency, and there is a 5% fee on all conversions from in-game currency back to the primary game token. The contract announces conversion events, including the player's address, the amount of primary game token involved, and the resulting in-game currency amount.
source_description: Hero Blaze is a BNB Chain based casual RPG mobile game integrated with Play and Earn

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Aerodrome Slipstream and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's liquidity pools, holding deposited token pairs. It maintains records of each liquidity provider's deposited amounts and accrued fees within specific token pair pools, along with global configuration settings for fees and emissions. Callers can deposit token pairs to provide liquidity, withdraw their liquidity and accumulated fees, swap one token for another within a pool, and claim accumulated emissions. A designated administrator can adjust the base swap fee, which is initially 0.05%, and update the emission schedule for new tokens. All swaps incur a fee, with a minimum of 0.01% and a maximum of 1%, and the contract ensures that a user cannot withdraw more liquidity than they have provided. The contract announces successful token swaps, liquidity additions, and liquidity removals through events.
source_description: A central trading and liquidity marketplace on Base.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Opensea Seaport and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the peer-to-peer exchange of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and fungible tokens, holding deposited items in escrow during active offers. It maintains a record of all active offers, including the items offered, the items requested, and the offer's expiration time, along with a global fee percentage and a designated operator address. Callers can create new offers to exchange specific NFTs for fungible tokens or other NFTs, accept existing offers by fulfilling the requested items, and cancel their own active offers. A designated operator can update the global fee percentage and withdraw accumulated fees. The contract enforces a maximum offer duration of 30 days and applies a 2% fee on all successful exchanges, deducted from the fungible token portion of the trade. The contract emits an event when a new offer is created, when an offer is successfully accepted, and when an offer is cancelled.
source_description: OpenSea is the world's first and largest web3 marketplace for NFTs and crypto collectibles.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Yield Guild Games and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming guild's treasury, holding various fungible tokens and non-fungible tokens representing in-game assets. It maintains a record of each member's delegated voting power and a configurable list of whitelisted game asset contracts. Members can deposit fungible tokens, request withdrawals of fungible tokens, and propose the purchase or sale of non-fungible tokens. The owner can add or remove whitelisted game asset contracts, approve or reject non-fungible token proposals, and initiate fungible token transfers from the treasury. A member's delegated voting power is capped at 10% of the total outstanding governance tokens. All withdrawal requests for fungible tokens are subject to a 72-hour delay before funds are released. The contract announces when new non-fungible token proposals are created and when fungible token withdrawals are processed.
source_description: The world's first and biggest web3 gaming guild where you can make friends, discover games, and level up.

description: Define an NFT contract based on CARDZ.GAME and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and ownership of unique digital collectible tokens, each representing a physical trading card, and custodies the associated physical card inventory. It maintains a record of each digital token's owner, its unique identifier, and its corresponding physical card's status (e.g., "vaulted", "redeemed"). Callers can open digital packs to receive new tokens, transfer tokens to other accounts, redeem tokens for their physical counterparts, or sell tokens back to the contract. Only a designated operator can mint new digital packs and update the physical card inventory status, while only the contract owner can set the pack opening fee. A pack opening always costs 0.05 units of the native currency, and a maximum of 10,000 unique digital tokens can ever be minted. The contract announces when a new pack is opened, when a token is transferred, and when a token is redeemed.
source_description: CARDZ.GAME is a Sui-based physical TCG platform where users open verifiably fair digital packs, receive on-chain ownership records for real trading cards, and can vault, sell back, trade, or redeem the underlying physical assets.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Alt Fun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited collateral in an escrow for new tokens. It maintains a record of each user's collateral deposits, their allocated new tokens, and the total collateral pooled for each launched token. Users can deposit collateral, claim their allocated new tokens after a launch, and withdraw any unallocated collateral. A designated operator can initiate new token launches, set the collateral requirements for each launch, and finalize the distribution of new tokens. A minimum deposit of 100 units of collateral is required for any participation, and a 2% fee is applied to all claimed new tokens, deducted from the claimed amount. The contract announces the start of new token launches and the completion of token distributions.
source_description: Launch coins backed by Hyperliquid perps

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on KaspaCom LFG and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a launchpad for new tokens, holding contributions of a base currency and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's contribution in the base currency and their allocated project tokens, along with the current state of the launch event and its configuration parameters. Callers can contribute base currency to participate in a launch, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any excess base currency if the project token allocation is not fully subscribed. The contract owner can initiate a new launch, set the project token allocation and contribution limits, pause and unpause contributions, and finalize the launch to enable token claims. A launch event must have a minimum contribution period of 24 hours and a maximum individual contribution cap of 1000 base currency units. The contract announces the start and end of a launch, successful contributions, and token claims.
source_description: KaspaCom LFG is a launchpad on Igra chain.

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on InsureDAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for decentralized insurance underwriting, custodying staked collateral in a designated stablecoin to back insurance policies. It maintains per-policy records including coverage amount, premium paid, expiration date, and claim status, along with a global pool of staked collateral and a list of supported insurance products. Callers can stake collateral, purchase insurance policies for supported products, file claims against their active policies, and withdraw their unstaked collateral. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, add new insurance products, and adjust premium rates for existing products. The maximum coverage amount for any single policy is 10,000 units of the stablecoin. A 5% fee is deducted from all successfully paid claims, which is added to the collateral pool. The contract announces policy purchases, claim filings, claim approvals, and claim rejections.
source_description: What makes InsureDAO different is our ability to handle everything from creating and selling insurance, to managing surplus funds. We enable DeFi protocols to easily provide full-featured insurance services to users, whilst ensuring maximum returns for our underwriters.

description: Model an NFT contract based on PumpBox and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation, distribution, and opening of digital mystery boxes, holding deposited tokens and non-fungible tokens (NFTs) as potential box contents. It maintains a registry of defined box types, each with its probability distribution of contents, and tracks the quantity of each box type owned by individual users. Callers can purchase boxes using an accepted token, open owned boxes to receive a random item, and claim any physical assets associated with opened boxes. Only a designated operator can define new box types, add items to existing box types, deposit tokens and NFTs into the contract for box contents, and withdraw unallocated assets. A box purchase costs 100 units of the accepted token, and the probability distribution for items within a box must sum to exactly 10,000 basis points. The contract announces when a box type is created, when a box is purchased, and when a box is opened revealing its contents.
source_description: Pump Box is a decentralized on-chain mystery box (Gacha) platform that allows users to open mystery boxes and instantly receive randomized digital and physical assets. The platform supports a wide range of assets, including NFTs, RWAs (Real World Assets) such as TCG cards, sports star cards, and more. Built with full on-chain transparency and provably fair randomness, Pump Box delivers a frictionless, 24/7 collecting experience for global users.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Sky Lending and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending protocol, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued stablecoin tokens. It maintains individual user accounts tracking deposited collateral, borrowed stablecoin, and accrued interest, along with global configuration parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoin against their collateral, repay stablecoin loans, and withdraw their collateral. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate model and add new collateral types, while an owner can pause all borrowing and lending activity. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75%, and the stablecoin borrowing annual interest rate is fixed at 5%. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, and repayments, including the user's address, asset, and amount.
source_description: The USDS stablecoin powers the open Sky ecosystem. It is the upgraded version of DAI, providing new ways for you to have more rewarding crypto experiences.

description: Specify a smart account contract based on Phantom Wallet and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a secure, non-custodial wallet for managing digital assets across multiple chains, specifically holding fungible tokens and non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each user's owned tokens, approved spending allowances for other contracts, and a list of authorized linked accounts for cross-chain interactions. Users can deposit tokens, transfer tokens to other addresses, approve spending by other contracts, and initiate cross-chain transfers to their linked accounts. Only the owner can upgrade the contract's logic or pause all transfers in an emergency. A transfer fee of 0.1% is applied to all outgoing fungible token transfers, and a maximum of 10 linked accounts can be associated with a single wallet. The contract emits an event whenever tokens are deposited, transferred, or a cross-chain transfer is initiated.
source_description: The friendly crypto wallet built for DeFi & NFTs

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on wstGBP and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a wrapper for a stablecoin pegged to a fiat currency, holding the underlying stablecoin as its sole asset. It maintains a total supply of wrapper tokens and a per-account balance of wrapper tokens. Callers can deposit the underlying stablecoin to mint wrapper tokens, and redeem wrapper tokens for the underlying stablecoin. A designated operator is privileged to update the exchange rate between the wrapper token and the underlying stablecoin, and only the owner can set the designated operator. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount, and the exchange rate can only be updated once every 24 hours. The contract announces when the exchange rate is updated and when tokens are minted or burned.
source_description: wstGBP is a non-rebasing, NAV-accruing wrapper for tGBP. Its GBP-denominated redemption value accrues through regular oracle updates while token balances remain constant

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Bounce.Tech and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables the creation and redemption of leveraged tokens, which represent exposure to an underlying asset's perpetual futures price, and custodies the underlying collateral used to back these tokens. It maintains a record of each user's token balances, the total supply of each leveraged token, and a configuration for each token including its leverage factor and associated fees. Callers can mint new leveraged tokens by depositing collateral, redeem existing leveraged tokens for collateral, and transfer their leveraged tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the leverage factor for a specific token and adjust the minting and redemption fees. The maximum leverage factor for any token is capped at 10x, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all minting and redemption operations. The contract announces all token minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the token type, amount, and involved addresses.
source_description: Bounce.Tech is a non-custodial leveraged token protocol on Hyperliquid that lets users mint and redeem ERC-20 tokens representing rebalanced perpetual futures exposure to underlying assets.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Liqwid and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool for a single fungible token, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual balances for each user's deposits and borrowed amounts, the total supply of receipt tokens, and a global interest rate model configuration. Callers can deposit tokens to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens by burning receipt tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay borrowed tokens, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can update the interest rate model parameters and pause borrowing and depositing in emergencies. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75% of the collateral's value, and a 5% liquidation penalty is applied to the borrower's collateral value during liquidation events. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the affected user, token amounts, and new balances.
source_description: Decentralized interest rate curves for lending and borrowing on Cardano

description: Design a smart account contract based on Defiway and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a secure, non-custodial cross-chain transfer hub, holding various fungible tokens temporarily during bridging operations. It maintains a record of each user's pending transfers, including the destination chain, recipient address, and token amount, alongside a global configuration for supported tokens and their associated transfer fees. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing tokens, claim a transfer on the destination chain, or cancel a pending transfer if it has not yet been processed. Only a designated operator can approve or reject cross-chain transfer requests and update the supported token list or transfer fees. Each transfer incurs a flat fee of 0.1% of the transferred amount, and a transfer must be claimed within 72 hours of its approval or it will be automatically cancelled and refunded. The contract announces events for initiated transfers, approved transfers, claimed transfers, and cancelled transfers, including relevant details like the user, token, amount, and status.
source_description: All-in-one crypto wallet (iOS/Android). Fast cross-chain bridge and all-in-one crypto wallet

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Solv Basis Trading and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basis trading vault, holding user-deposited stablecoins and a wrapped version of a major cryptocurrency. It maintains individual user balances for deposited stablecoins and wrapped cryptocurrency, as well as a global pool of each asset, and records for open basis positions including their size and collateralization. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their stablecoin deposits, deposit wrapped cryptocurrency, and withdraw their wrapped cryptocurrency deposits. An owner can set the stablecoin deposit fee and the wrapped cryptocurrency withdrawal fee, and can initiate and close basis trading positions. A designated operator can adjust the collateral ratio of open basis positions. The stablecoin deposit fee is 0.1% of the deposited amount. The minimum stablecoin deposit is 100 units. The contract emits an event when stablecoins are deposited, when wrapped cryptocurrency is deposited, when a basis position is opened, and when a basis position is closed.
source_description: Solv Basis Trading offers products that use advanced strategies, like basis trades and hedging, to deliver consistent, low-risk returns. By balancing market movements, these solutions allow Bitcoin holders to generate steady profits.

description: Specify a token contract based on Picnic and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a batching service for DeFi interactions, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow during processing. It maintains individual user balances for each supported token, a list of approved target protocols and their associated interaction recipes, and a global fee percentage. Callers can deposit tokens, initiate a batched interaction by selecting a recipe and specifying parameters, and withdraw their remaining tokens. Only the owner can add new interaction recipes, modify existing recipes, or change the global fee percentage. The maximum number of steps in any single interaction recipe is limited to 5. A 0.1% fee is applied to the value of tokens processed in each successful batched interaction. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, when a batched interaction is successfully executed, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Investing in DeFi can be time consuming and complicated. We batch the transactions needed to interact with your favorite protocols so you don't waste time and effort on it.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on PepeDex and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collectible card game's digital assets, specifically unique game cards and an in-game currency, ensuring their secure custody and transfer. It maintains individual player inventories of cards and currency balances, along with global game configuration parameters like card pack prices and generation rates. Players can purchase card packs using the in-game currency, trade cards with other players, and redeem cards for in-game currency. A designated operator can mint new cards, create new card types, and adjust the price of card packs. Card pack purchases are limited to a maximum of 10 packs per transaction, and a 2% fee is applied to all card trades, payable in the in-game currency. The contract emits events for card transfers, card pack purchases, and changes to card pack prices.
source_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Degen Battleground, a web3 card game built on Pepechain

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Sky RWA and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the collateralization of real-world assets, holding a designated stablecoin as backing for issued debt. It maintains a record of each asset's collateralization ratio, its current valuation, and the total outstanding debt associated with it. Callers can deposit stablecoin collateral, withdraw excess collateral, draw debt against collateral, and repay debt. A designated operator can approve new real-world assets for collateralization, update their valuations, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The minimum collateralization ratio for any asset is 150%, and a 0.5% liquidation penalty is applied to the liquidated amount. The contract announces when new assets are approved, when collateralization ratios change, and when liquidations occur.
source_description: Real World Assets (RWAs) are a collateral type in the Maker Protocol which require legal entities to represent the MakerDAO in order to interact with real world counterparties in deals ratified by governance.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Perion and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of a fungible governance token and a non-fungible asset representing a gaming item, distributing them to eligible participants. It maintains a record of each participant's allocated governance token balance and their owned gaming item identifiers. Callers can claim their allocated governance tokens, deposit gaming items into the treasury, and withdraw gaming items they own. A designated operator can allocate governance tokens to participants, mint new gaming items, and transfer gaming items to participants. The maximum number of gaming items that can be minted is 10,000, and a participant can only claim governance tokens once every 30 days. The contract announces when governance tokens are claimed, when gaming items are deposited, and when gaming items are transferred to participants.
source_description: Perion is a multifaceted DAO on a mission to back and build next generation products and teams at the intersect of web3, eSports, gaming and NFTs. We see web3 as being synonymous with the future of gaming and culture, a future that we will build upon utilitarian web3 technology.

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on SpinUp Launchpad and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and launch of new fungible tokens, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's base token contributions and their allocated share of project tokens, along with a global configuration for launch parameters. Callers can deposit base tokens to participate in a launch, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent base tokens if the launch fails to meet its funding goal. Only the designated owner can initiate a new token launch, set the minimum funding goal for a launch, and finalize a successful launch to enable token claims. A launch must reach a minimum funding goal of 100 base tokens within 72 hours to be considered successful, otherwise all deposited base tokens are refundable. The contract announces events for deposits, claims, and launch finalization.
source_description: One-Click MEME Launch

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Robots.Farm and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gamified token exchange and farming system, holding deposited fungible tokens and non-fungible game items. It maintains individual player balances for fungible tokens, ownership records for non-fungible items, and a global configuration for exchange rates and farming rewards. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, exchange fungible tokens for other fungible tokens, purchase non-fungible items using fungible tokens, stake fungible tokens to earn rewards, claim earned rewards, and withdraw unstaked fungible tokens or sold non-fungible items. A designated operator can set exchange rates, configure farming reward rates, and mint new non-fungible items. The maximum exchange fee is 0.5% of the swapped amount, and the minimum staking period for rewards is 24 hours. The contract emits events for token deposits, token withdrawals, item purchases, item sales, token exchanges, and reward claims.
source_description: Robots.Farm is a Gamified Trading Platform that merges decentralized finance with a gaming experience. Engage in gameplay, swap tokens, farm rewards, and enhance your profile with XP points while collecting unique items to unlock special features.

description: Model a prediction market contract based on EtherFlip and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a simple coin flip prediction game, holding user deposits of the native blockchain currency. It maintains individual player balances, a total contract balance, and a record of active bets including the predicted outcome and wagered amount for each. Callers can place a bet on heads or tails, providing a wager, and can claim winnings if their bet was successful. A designated operator can resolve a bet by providing a random outcome, and can withdraw collected fees. The minimum bet amount is 0.01 units of the native currency, and a 2% fee is deducted from all winning payouts. The contract emits an event when a new bet is placed and when a bet is resolved.
source_description: A Dice/Farm DeFi App with a Twist

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Usual USD0 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin, USD0, and custodies its underlying collateral, which consists solely of USDC. It maintains individual account balances for USD0, the total supply of USD0, and a record of the current collateralization ratio. Callers can mint new USD0 by depositing USDC, redeem USD0 for USDC, and transfer USD0 between accounts. A designated operator can pause or unpause minting and redemption, and can adjust the fee for minting. The contract ensures that the collateralization ratio never falls below 100%, and a minting fee of 0.1% is applied to all new USD0 minted. The contract emits an event whenever USD0 is minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when the minting fee is updated.
source_description: The Usual protocol is a decentralized finance framework centered around USD0, a stablecoin designed as a liquid deposit token. It embodies the principle of redistributing value generated by users through a revenue-based token, USUAL. This approach enables users to access yields while simultaneously gaining exposure to the protocol’s growth and long-term success.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Crypto Valleys and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a virtual farming game, holding player-owned land parcels and various in-game resources. It maintains individual player inventories of resources, a global registry of land parcels with their ownership and current crop status, and a configuration for resource generation rates and adventure difficulty. Players can plant seeds on their land, harvest mature crops, send their characters on adventures to acquire resources, and craft new items from existing resources. A designated game administrator can adjust resource generation rates, introduce new adventure types, and mint new land parcels up to a total supply cap of 10,000 parcels. Harvesting crops incurs a 5% tax on the harvested resources, which is sent to a treasury address. Players must wait at least 24 hours between consecutive adventures with the same character. The contract emits events when crops are planted, resources are harvested, and items are crafted.
source_description: Farm, Adventure, Compete, Craft & Trade.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on RockSolid Network and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator vault that custodies various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount for each supported token, the total amount of each token held in the vault, and a configuration for each yield strategy, including its associated external vault address and a performance fee percentage. Callers can deposit supported tokens into the vault, withdraw their deposited tokens plus accrued yield, claim rewards generated by the vault's strategies, and approve external spending of their deposited tokens. Only a designated owner can add or remove supported tokens, update the external vault address for a strategy, adjust the performance fee for a strategy, or pause and unpause all deposits and withdrawals. The maximum performance fee for any strategy is 10%, and a 0.1% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events, including the user's address, the token involved, and the amount.
source_description: RockSolid is a single-click integrated DeFi Vault platform that makes it simple for users to access the best DeFi rewards.

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Ensuro and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a risk pool for insurance policies, holding stablecoins deposited by investors to cover potential claims. It maintains individual investor balances, a total pool balance, and a registry of active insurance policies including their coverage amount and premium. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and propose new insurance policies for underwriting. A designated operator can approve or reject proposed policies, and disburse funds for approved claims. The contract enforces a minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins for new investors and a maximum coverage limit of 50,000 stablecoins for any single policy. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, policy approvals, and claim payouts.
source_description: Ensuro is a decentralized capital provider for insurance risk. We use smart contracts to curate competitive insurance portfolios. We allow anyone to invest in insurance risk and reap its benefits. By opening up the insurance market to new players, we fuel innovation for established and upcoming insurance partners.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on dotMEGA Domains and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a decentralized domain name service, holding ownership records for unique, human-readable names and their associated subdomains. It maintains a registry of owned top-level domains, each mapping to an owner and a list of subdomains, and also stores configuration parameters like registration fees. Callers can register a new top-level domain, transfer ownership of a domain, create a subdomain under a domain they own, and set resolution data for any domain they control. Only the designated administrator can set the base registration fee and withdraw collected fees. New top-level domain registrations cost 0.01 ETH, and a domain name must be at least 3 characters long. The contract emits an event whenever a new domain is registered or its ownership is transferred.
source_description: .MEGA Domains is a MegaETH naming service that lets users buy human-readable .mega names and create or sell subdomains onchain

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on TxFlow Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a cross-chain asset transfer bridge, holding deposited tokens on the source chain until a corresponding withdrawal is initiated on the destination chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance for each supported token, along with a global total supply for each wrapped asset minted on the destination chain. Callers can deposit tokens, initiate a withdrawal request, and claim wrapped tokens on the destination chain. Only a designated relayer may finalize withdrawal requests and mint or burn wrapped tokens. A deposit must be at least 10 units of the deposited token. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made or a withdrawal is processed.
source_description: TxFlow is an open Layer 1 with multi-application ecosystem around TIP Liquidity Standards — where every Channel shares on-chain liquidity, settlement, and market data without bridging

description: Create a lending protocol based on BIMA CDP and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collateralized debt position system, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing stablecoin tokens against them. It maintains individual user positions tracking deposited collateral, issued stablecoin debt, and a global system configuration including the collateralization ratio and stability fee. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins, repay stablecoins, and withdraw collateral. A designated operator can adjust the stability fee and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and the stability fee is 0.5% per year, applied continuously. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations.
source_description: Bitcoin-backed Stablecoin for Universal Yield.
