description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Looped Hype and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-maximizing wrapper for a base staking token, holding deposited base tokens and their yield-bearing derivatives. It maintains a total supply of its own liquid staking token, a record of each user's liquid staking token balance, and a configuration for the looping strategy. Callers can deposit the base staking token to receive the liquid staking token, redeem the liquid staking token for the base staking token, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can initiate and close looping positions, adjust the looping strategy parameters, and withdraw protocol fees. The owner can upgrade the contract logic and set the designated operator. Deposits and redemptions are subject to a 0.5% protocol fee, deducted from the base token amount. The maximum looping leverage allowed is 5x, meaning the total value of borrowed assets in looping positions cannot exceed five times the value of the initially staked base tokens. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, reward claims, and changes to the looping strategy parameters.
source_description: Looped Hype (LHYPE) is an automated looping protocol that maximizes yield on staked HYPE and other yield bearing tokens. Users simply deposit HYPE to get LHYPE, then behind the scenes the protocol uses an automated looping strategy to generate additional yield, on top of any network rewards earned from staking

description: Design a token contract based on Sanko GameCorp and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token distribution for a new game release, holding a fixed supply of game tokens. It maintains each player's claimable token balance and a global total of tokens distributed. Callers can claim their allocated tokens and transfer their tokens to other players. The contract owner can set the initial allocation for players and pause all token transfers. A maximum of 1,000,000 tokens will ever be distributed, and each player's initial allocation cannot exceed 100,000 tokens. The contract announces when tokens are claimed and when transfers occur.
source_description: Fabled game publisher Sank GameCorp releases long delayed title.

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Axis and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a synthetic dollar minting and staking vault, holding collateral in an internal reserve. It maintains a total supply of the synthetic dollar, a total staked amount of the yield-bearing synthetic dollar, and for each user, their individual synthetic dollar balance and their individual staked synthetic dollar balance. Callers can mint synthetic dollars by depositing collateral, transfer synthetic dollars, stake their synthetic dollars to receive yield-bearing synthetic dollars, unstake yield-bearing synthetic dollars to receive synthetic dollars, and burn synthetic dollars. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and initiate a rebalance of the collateral. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 1.05:1, meaning 1.05 units of collateral are required for every 1 unit of synthetic dollar minted. A 0.1% fee is applied to all unstaking operations, deducted from the returned synthetic dollars. The contract announces all minting, burning, staking, unstaking, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Quantitative yield protocol that issues USDx, a synthetic dollar backed by a cross-venue arbitrage engine. sUSDx is the staked yield-bearing vault.

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on SX Rollup Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the transfer of an arbitrary fungible token from a source chain to a destination chain, holding locked tokens on the source chain as collateral. It maintains a record of each user's locked token balance and the total amount of tokens locked in the contract. Callers can deposit tokens, initiating a transfer to the destination chain, and can withdraw their locked tokens if the corresponding transfer is cancelled or fails. A designated relayer is authorized to finalize transfers by burning tokens on the destination chain and releasing an equivalent amount from this contract. The contract imposes a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of the fungible token. A 0.1% fee is applied to each successful transfer, deducted from the deposited amount. The contract emits an event upon every deposit and every successful transfer finalization, detailing the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Bridge between Ethereum and SX Network

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Equilibria and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized representation of boosted yield positions, holding deposited yield-bearing tokens and their associated voting power. It maintains a mapping of user addresses to their deposited token balances and their corresponding liquid wrapper token balances, along with a global configuration for fees and operator addresses. Callers can deposit yield-bearing tokens to receive liquid wrapper tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens by burning liquid wrapper tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust the fee percentage for withdrawals and update the address of the underlying yield-bearing token contract. Withdrawal fees are capped at 5% of the withdrawn amount, and a minimum deposit of 100 of the yield-bearing token is required. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, and fee updates.
source_description: Equilibria Finance is a platform made for $PENDLE holders and liquidity providers, aiming to optimize profits through a tokenized version of vePENDLE, ePENDLE. It capitalizes on Pendle Finance's veToken/boosted yield model to enhance yields and reward PENDLE holders.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Paladin DAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency protocol, holding various reserve assets to back a native stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin and various staked derivatives, a global treasury of reserve assets, and configurable parameters for bonding and staking. Callers can mint the stablecoin by depositing approved reserve assets, stake their stablecoin for yield, unstake their staked stablecoin, and claim rewards. A designated operator can adjust bonding terms, add or remove approved reserve assets, and initiate treasury disbursements. The maximum annual inflation rate for the stablecoin is capped at 10%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin transfers. The contract emits events for all stablecoin transfers, staking and unstaking operations, and changes to treasury assets.
source_description: Paladin DAO is the decentralized reserve currency protocol available on the BSC (Binance Smart Chain) based on the PD token.

description: Model a staking contract based on Rocket Pool and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized ETH staking by pooling user deposits and pairing them with operator-supplied ETH to create new validators. It maintains a record of each user's deposited ETH, the total pooled ETH, and the current exchange rate between deposited ETH and the liquid staking token, along with a list of registered node operators and their associated validator states. Callers can deposit ETH to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their deposited ETH and accrued rewards by burning liquid staking tokens, and node operators can register their nodes, deposit their required ETH, and claim rewards from their validators. Only a designated owner can set the protocol fee, pause deposits, or update the exchange rate oracle address. A minimum deposit of 0.01 ETH is required for users, and node operators must supply exactly 16 ETH per validator. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, new validator creations, and changes to the protocol fee.
source_description: Rocket Pool is the first truly decentralised Ethereum staking pool. Liquid Staking, Audited SC, and Minimised Penalty Risk. Unlike solo stakers, who are required to put 32 ETH up for deposit to create a new validator, Rocket Pool nodes only need to deposit 16 ETH per validator. This will be coupled with 16 ETH from the staking pool (which stakers deposited in exchange for rETH) to create a new ETH2 validator.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Based Alpha and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and launch of new token projects, holding the native blockchain currency and newly created tokens in escrow. It maintains a registry of launched tokens, each with its current bonding curve liquidity, total supply, and a record of individual user balances within the curve. Callers can create a new token by providing an initial supply of the native currency, buy tokens from an existing bonding curve, sell tokens back to a bonding curve, and finalize a launched token to enable external trading. A designated operator can set the base fee for creating new tokens, which is fixed at 0.1 native currency units, and can also set the percentage of native currency from sales that is allocated to the protocol, which is capped at 5%. The contract announces the creation of new tokens, all buy and sell orders, and the finalization of a token launch.
source_description: Based Alpha — pump.fun-style token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Saphyre V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer trading of tokenized assets by holding user deposits and managing open orders. It maintains individual account balances for each token, a global order book for each trading pair, and per-user open order records. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens, place new limit orders, cancel existing orders, and fill existing orders. A designated operator can pause trading activity and update trading pair configurations. The maximum number of open orders per user is 100. A 0.1% fee is charged on all filled order volume, paid by the taker. The contract emits an event when an order is placed, cancelled, or filled, and when tokens are deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: Execution Infrastructure for On-Chain Trading.

description: Outline a privacy-preserving contract based on Zama and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a confidential computation vault, holding user-deposited tokens to enable privacy-preserving operations. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance and a global total of all deposited tokens. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and submit encrypted computation requests. A designated operator can set the fee for computation requests and pause or unpause deposits. The maximum fee for a computation request is 0.05 ether. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour time lock after the request is initiated. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, and successful computation request submissions.
source_description: Zama is an open source cryptography company building state-of-the-art Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) solutions for blockchain

description: Design an NFT contract based on leNFT and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer non-fungible token lending and borrowing, holding non-fungible tokens offered as collateral and the principal amounts of loans. It maintains individual loan records including the non-fungible token collateral, the principal amount, the interest rate, and the repayment due date, alongside a global configuration for default loan terms and supported non-fungible token collections. Callers can offer non-fungible tokens for collateralized loans, take out loans against offered collateral, repay outstanding loans, and reclaim collateral upon full repayment or loan default. A designated operator can pause all lending and borrowing activity and update the list of supported non-fungible token collections. The maximum loan duration is 30 days, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all interest payments. The contract emits events for new loan originations, loan repayments, and collateral reclamations.
source_description: NFT Trading and Lending Market.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Yield Basis and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool, holding deposited base assets and issuing yield-bearing tokens representing a claim on those assets plus accrued interest. It maintains individual account balances for deposited base assets, issued yield tokens, and accrued interest, alongside a global pool balance and a configuration for interest rates. Callers can deposit base assets, withdraw their deposited base assets and accrued interest, and transfer their yield tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate parameters and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the base asset, and the maximum annual interest rate is capped at 15%. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, detailing the account involved and the amount transferred.
source_description: YieldBasis is an on-chain liquidity protocol solving Impermanent Loss problem in AMM pools. It turns crypto into productive assets starting from Bitcoin. Using Yield Basis, LPs have a direct spot exposure to an asset and earn organic yield with significantly improved risk/reward profile (compared to conventional AMMs).

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on AILayer farm and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a specific fungible token, enabling users to deposit and earn rewards. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total staked amount for the pool, and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their staked tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate and pause/unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum reward rate is 10% per day, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is sent to a treasury address. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and reward rate updates.
source_description: Staking tokens via AILayer Dataset counts as TVL.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on SolvBTC and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a Bitcoin-backed reserve token, designed to custody wrapped Bitcoin and issue an equivalent amount of a fungible ERC-20 token. It maintains a total supply of the issued token, a transparent reserve balance of wrapped Bitcoin, and individual user balances of the issued token. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin to mint new tokens, withdraw wrapped Bitcoin by burning tokens, and transfer their issued tokens to other accounts. Only a designated operator can pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals, and only the contract owner can update the operator address or set the withdrawal fee. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% is applied to all withdrawals, and the maximum daily withdrawal limit for any single address is 10 wrapped Bitcoin. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: SolvBTC is a universal Bitcoin reserve token that connects Bitcoin’s value across blockchains, backed 1:1 by a transparent, secure reserve. It empowers you to tap into DeFi and CeFi markets effortlessly, transforming idle Bitcoin into a dynamic asset for lending, trading, or yield generation—while keeping you in full control.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Wan Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers, holding wrapped tokens on behalf of users. It maintains a mapping of original chain asset addresses to their wrapped token equivalents on this chain, and tracks each user's wrapped token balances. Callers can deposit native assets on a source chain to mint wrapped tokens on this chain, or burn wrapped tokens on this chain to release native assets on a destination chain. A designated operator is privileged to register new cross-chain asset mappings and to pause or unpause all transfer operations. Each cross-chain transfer incurs a fixed fee of 0.1% of the transfer amount, and the maximum single transfer amount is capped at 1,000,000 units of any supported asset. The contract announces successful deposits, successful withdrawals, and changes to asset mappings.
source_description: Wanchain, the Wide Area Network chain, is the worlds premier decentralised blockchain interoperability solution.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Harvest Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator vault for a single designated ERC-20 token, holding user deposits of that token and deploying them into various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a total deposited amount, individual user balances, and a record of which strategies are active along with their allocated capital. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their share of tokens, and claim any accumulated rewards. The owner can add new strategies, remove existing strategies, adjust the allocation of capital to strategies, and set the fee percentage applied to profits. A maximum of 10 strategies can be active at any given time, and the profit-sharing fee is capped at 15% of realized gains. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when a withdrawal occurs, and when a profit harvest has been completed.
source_description: Harvest - grows your crypto with automated yield strategies

description: Create an NFT contract based on Chapool and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tiered NFT staking system, holding staked non-fungible tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains individual records for each staker, tracking their staked NFTs, accumulated rewards, and current staking tier, along with a global configuration for reward rates and tier thresholds. Callers can stake their non-fungible tokens, claim accumulated rewards, and unstake their non-fungible tokens. Only a designated operator can adjust the reward rates for each tier and set the non-fungible token collection that can be staked. The maximum staking duration for any non-fungible token is 365 days, and a 5% unstaking fee is applied to any non-fungible token unstaked before 30 days. The contract emits events when non-fungible tokens are staked, rewards are claimed, and non-fungible tokens are unstaked.
source_description: Chapool is a Web3+AI+RWA platform on opBNB, offering tiered NFT staking rewards. It blends IP, toy trading, and consumer finance, generating revenue via NFT minting and a C2C marketplace.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Avalps and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized reserve currency protocol that custodies a basket of stablecoin assets and a native protocol token. It maintains a global treasury balance for each stablecoin asset, a total supply of the native protocol token, and individual user balances for both stablecoins and the native token. Callers can deposit supported stablecoins to mint native protocol tokens, and they can burn native protocol tokens to redeem stablecoins. Callers can also stake their native protocol tokens to earn rewards, and unstake them. A designated operator can adjust the redemption fee, add new supported stablecoin assets, and update the oracle price for each asset. The redemption fee for stablecoins is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount. The maximum number of supported stablecoin assets is 5. The contract announces when native protocol tokens are minted or burned, and when stablecoins are deposited or redeemed.
source_description: Avalps is a decentralized reserve currency protocol available on the Avalanche Network based on the $BLANC token

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Mixoor and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates privacy-preserving transfers of fungible tokens by acting as a temporary custodian for deposited assets. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a record of spent nullifiers, but no per-account balances or user-specific data. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens using a valid zero-knowledge proof, and submit a batch of nullifiers for processing. The contract owner can set the deposit fee, update the Merkle tree verifier, and pause deposits. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited amount. Withdrawals are subject to a minimum delay of 10 minutes between consecutive withdrawals to the same recipient address. The contract emits events for successful deposits, withdrawals, and nullifier submissions.
source_description: Mixoor is a privacy protocol for Solana that enables unlinkable $SOL, $USDC and any other SPL token transfers. Users can deposit funds from A wallet into the protocol and later (or instantly) withdraw them to B wallet without creating any on-chain connection between the two wallets involved.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Rezerve Money and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of Ether and a native protocol token, facilitating the accumulation of Ether through token sales. It maintains a total supply of the native token, individual account balances for the native token, and the current price of the native token in Ether. Callers can purchase the native token by sending Ether, and they can sell the native token to receive Ether back. A designated operator can adjust the native token's price, and can withdraw accumulated Ether from the treasury. The contract enforces a minimum purchase amount of 0.01 Ether. All sales of the native token incur a 0.5% fee, deducted from the Ether returned to the seller. The contract emits events for every token purchase, token sale, and Ether withdrawal from the treasury.
source_description: RZR is a decentralized treasury accumulation protocol with one mission to accumulate 1 million ETH. With the power of Community & DeFi.

description: Define a governance contract based on Agua and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield vault for trusted real-world asset strategies, holding deposited stablecoins. It maintains individual deposit records for each user, tracking their principal and accrued yield, and a global record of the total assets under management within the vault. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, and claim any available rewards. Only a designated operator can update the vault's strategy parameters and initiate yield harvesting. A minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins is enforced for all new deposits. The vault emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when new yield is harvested.
source_description: Agua is a vault infrastructure provider for trusted yield. Vaults combine real-world asset and DeFi strategies into permissionless products that allocators and institutional partners can deposit, lend to, and borrow against

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Metastrike and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique in-game items, specifically weapon skins, and holds the underlying digital assets representing these skins. It maintains a registry of all minted weapon skins, including their unique identifiers, current owner, and a set of immutable attributes like rarity and visual effects. Callers can mint new weapon skins, transfer ownership of their owned skins to another address, and burn their owned skins. A designated operator is privileged to mint new weapon skins, set the maximum supply for each skin type, and pause all transfer operations. The maximum supply for any single weapon skin type is capped at 10,000 units, and a 2% fee is applied to all successful transfers, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces the minting of new skins, the transfer of skin ownership, and the burning of skins to observers.
source_description: Metastrike is a Metaverse FPS Blockchain Game project that includes many essential and advanced features of a shooting game, with VR feature gameplay and high effort investment in both visuals and gameplay.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Asseto CASH+ and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized money market fund, representing shares in a pool of short-term, high-quality USD instruments. It maintains individual account balances for token holders and a total supply of tokens, reflecting the net asset value of the underlying assets. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new tokens, redeem tokens to withdraw stablecoins, and transfer tokens between accounts. Only a designated operator can adjust the exchange rate between the stablecoin and the token, and only the owner can pause all deposit and redemption operations. A minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins is enforced for all new deposits, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces token transfers, deposit events, and redemption events to observers.
source_description: CASH+ is a 1:1 asset-backed token collateralized by the CMS USD Money Market Fund, which invests in high-quality short-term USD instruments. It offers both individual and institutional investors instant stablecoin liquidity combined with low-risk yields that track money-market rates.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Yuzu Money and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing yield. It maintains individual user balances of the base stablecoin and a yield-bearing derivative, a global total supply for both tokens, and a configuration for yield distribution. Callers can deposit stablecoins to receive the yield-bearing token, redeem the yield-bearing token for the base stablecoin, and claim accrued yield. A designated operator can adjust the yield distribution rate and pause/unpause deposits and redemptions. The maximum annual yield distribution rate is 10%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces deposit, redemption, and yield claim events, including the amounts involved and the user's address.
source_description: An overcollateralized stablecoin backed by curated on-chain strategies designed to offer some of the highest yields in DeFi. Users can stake yzUSD to receive the yield-bearing syzUSD. Depositors in yzPP accept first-loss risk on the underlying strategies in exchange for a higher target yield, which is partially funded by a Reserve Fund.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Uranium.io and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes fractional ownership of physical uranium concentrate, acting as a ledger for these ownership shares. It maintains individual account balances representing ownership shares, a total supply of tokenized shares, and a record of the current custodian's address. Callers can acquire new shares by depositing funds, transfer their existing shares to another account, and redeem their shares for physical uranium concentrate. Only a designated operator can mint new shares, burn existing shares, and update the custodian's address. A minimum redemption amount of 100 shares is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all share transfers. The contract announces share transfers, share minting, and share burning events.
source_description: Uranium.io (XU3O8) enables investors to own and trade Uranium ore concentrate (U3O8), also known as ‘yellowcake; in an investment friendly and transparent manner by administering fractional ownership of physical uranium in the form of a smart contract ledger.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Sandbox and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a virtual world's land parcels, holding non-fungible tokens representing unique land plots. It maintains records of each land plot's owner, its coordinates, and any associated metadata, along with a global configuration for land sales. Callers can purchase available land plots, transfer ownership of their plots, and approve other accounts to manage their plots. A designated operator can list new land plots for sale, set the price for each plot, and update the global sale configuration. The maximum number of land plots an individual account can own is 100, and a 2% royalty fee is applied to all secondary market land transfers, payable to a designated treasury account. The contract announces when a land plot is purchased, when its ownership is transferred, and when its metadata is updated.
source_description: The Sandbox is a virtual gaming world where players can build, own, and monetize their gaming experiences.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Cabal and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-boosting vault that custodies fungible tokens and liquid staking derivative tokens. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited asset, a global tally of total deposits for each asset, and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can deposit fungible tokens or liquid staking derivative tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, claim accumulated rewards, and delegate their voting power to a designated address. A designated operator can update the reward distribution schedule and adjust the fee percentage, while the contract owner can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and can transfer ownership to a new address. A withdrawal fee of 0.5% is applied to all withdrawals, and the maximum number of unique assets that can be deposited into the vault is limited to 10. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and delegation changes.
source_description: Cabal is an incentive layer that automates governance, staking, and reward capture. Users deposit base assets such as INIT or LP tokens to earn boosted yields from governance bribes and staking

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Pharaoh DLMM and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity positions for token pairs, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users. It maintains records of individual user positions, each with a specific token pair, price range, and deposited amounts, alongside global configuration parameters like trading fees and administrative addresses. Callers can deposit tokens to create new positions, add liquidity to existing positions, remove liquidity from positions, and claim accumulated trading fees. A designated operator can adjust trading fees, pause all trading activity, and upgrade the contract implementation. The maximum trading fee is 0.5% of the swap amount, and a minimum of 100 base tokens or 100 quote tokens must be deposited to open a new position. The contract emits events for new position creation, liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and fee claims.
source_description: Pharaoh is a concentrated liquidity layer and exchange built on the Avalanche C-Chain, powered by the latest metaDEX x(3,3) methodology—a more fluid and accessible version of the popular ve(3,3) model.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Only1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for unique digital assets, holding deposited funds and escrowed assets during sales. It maintains a registry of listed assets with their prices, ownership records for minted assets, and balances for each user. Callers can list an asset for sale, purchase an asset, mint a new asset, or withdraw their earned funds. The contract owner can set the platform fee and designate approved minters. The platform fee is fixed at 2% of each sale. A user can only mint a maximum of 100 assets. The contract emits an event when an asset is listed, when an asset is sold, and when a new asset is minted.
source_description: Buy and Sell NFTs from your favorite content creators, earn crypto by interacting with these creators, or mint your own NFTs and start earning rewards today. Powered by Solana.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Dolomite and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending and borrowing platform, holding deposited collateral tokens and borrowed asset tokens. It maintains individual account records for each user, tracking their deposited amounts, borrowed amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration parameters for each supported asset. Callers can deposit tokens as collateral, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new supported assets, adjust interest rate models, and pause borrowing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset pair is 75%, and a 0.05% liquidation fee is applied to all liquidated positions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, and repayments.
source_description: A next-gen money market and DeFi prime brokerage.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Nava finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for a stablecoin system, minting and burning a synthetic asset pegged to a reference asset, and it custodies reserves of the reference asset. It maintains a total supply of the synthetic asset, individual account balances for the synthetic asset, and the current reserve ratio. Callers can mint new synthetic assets by depositing the reference asset, burn synthetic assets to redeem the reference asset, and transfer synthetic assets between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target reserve ratio and pause/unpause minting and burning. The initial target reserve ratio is 1.0, meaning one unit of the reference asset backs one unit of the synthetic asset. A 0.5% fee is charged on all redemptions, payable in the reference asset. The contract emits an event whenever synthetic assets are minted, burned, or transferred.
source_description: NAVA.FINANCE, home to the first algorithmic token pegged to $REI on the REI network.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Arbitrum Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for transferring assets between a Layer-1 network and a Layer-2 rollup, holding deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposited tokens awaiting transfer to Layer-2, and a configuration for the bridge's operational parameters. Callers can deposit tokens on Layer-1 for transfer to Layer-2, initiate withdrawals from Layer-2 back to Layer-1, and claim withdrawn tokens after a waiting period. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals, and upgrade the Layer-2 bridge contract. Deposits have a minimum value of 0.001 Ether, and withdrawals incur a fixed fee of 0.0005 Ether. The contract announces successful deposits, initiated withdrawals, and claimed withdrawals.
source_description: The Arbitrum Bridge acts as a secure channel connecting Ethereum's mainnet (Layer-1) with the Arbitrum Rollup (Layer-2). This bridge allows users to transfer assets, like ETH or ERC-20 tokens, between these layers

description: Define a token contract based on DeHive and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a portfolio management vault, designed to custody various ERC-20 tokens representing diversified investment strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their proportional share of the vault's total assets, and the current configuration of the underlying investment strategies. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their proportional share of the vault's assets, and claim any accrued rewards. The owner can add or remove supported tokens, adjust the allocation of assets among strategies, and set the management fee. A management fee of 0.5% of the total vault assets will be charged annually, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of any supported token is enforced. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the management fee.
source_description: DeHive is a multi-chain asset management protocol that provides smart asset management of tokenized portfolios.

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on SushiSwap V3 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and concentrated liquidity provision, custodying deposited tokens within various trading pools. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, including deposited token amounts, price ranges, and accumulated fees, alongside global pool configurations like swap fees and tick spacing. Callers can create new trading pools, add or remove liquidity from existing pools, swap tokens, and collect accrued fees. A designated operator can update the protocol's treasury address and modify the base swap fee for new pools. The maximum swap fee for any pool is 1%, and the minimum tick spacing is 1. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, detailing the affected pool, amounts, and participants.
source_description: SushiSwap V3: A Uniswap V3 fork

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Astroport and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for swapping tokens, holding deposited token reserves in various liquidity pools. It maintains records for each liquidity pool, including its token pair, current reserves, and accumulated swap fees, along with global configuration parameters like the protocol fee. Callers can create new liquidity pools, add liquidity to existing pools, remove liquidity from pools, and swap tokens between pools. A designated operator can adjust the protocol fee percentage and pause or unpause all swapping activity. The protocol fee is fixed at 0.3% of each swap value, and a newly created liquidity pool must be seeded with at least 100 units of each token. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps as events.
source_description: The meta AMM of Cosmos

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Coinbarrel and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad, holding newly minted tokens and collected funds from participants. It maintains a record of each participant's committed funds, the total funds raised for each launch, and the configuration parameters for each token launch. Callers can commit funds to a specific token launch, claim their allocated tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their unspent funds if a launch fails. The owner can initiate new token launches, set the token allocation ratio, and finalize successful launches. A token launch must raise at least 100 units of the funding currency to be considered successful, and the owner can set a maximum individual commitment of 500 units for any launch. The contract announces when a new token launch is initiated, when funds are committed, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: Coinbarrel is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Big Time and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital collectibles representing in-game assets, holding no custodied value itself. It maintains a record of each collectible's unique identifier, its current owner, and its specific attributes, along with a global counter for the total number of collectibles minted and a configuration for the maximum supply. Callers can mint new collectibles, transfer ownership of their owned collectibles to another account, and burn collectibles they own. A designated operator is privileged to set the base URI for collectible metadata and to pause or unpause all minting operations. The maximum total supply of collectibles is capped at 100,000, and a minting fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each new collectible created. The contract announces when a new collectible is minted, when a collectible is transferred, and when a collectible is burned.
source_description: Onchain gaming.

description: Outline an on-chain insurance contract based on Nsure and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a coverage pool for insuring against smart contract vulnerabilities, holding deposited stablecoins as collateral. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, their active coverage policies, and the total stablecoins available in the pool. Callers can deposit stablecoins, purchase coverage policies specifying a target contract and coverage amount, file claims against active policies, and withdraw their available stablecoin balance. Only a designated operator can approve or reject claims, and only the owner can update the premium rate or add new target contracts for coverage. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is required to purchase a policy, and a 5% fee is deducted from all approved claim payouts. The contract announces when a new policy is purchased, when a claim is filed, and when a claim is approved or rejected.
source_description: Open Insurance Platform for Open Finance

description: Create a token contract based on Qrolli and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized social network's native token, facilitating user engagement and content creation. It maintains individual user balances, a global content creator fund, and configuration parameters for network operations. Callers can transfer tokens, stake tokens to support creators, claim rewards from staked tokens, and withdraw unstaked tokens. A designated administrator can adjust the staking reward rate, pause token transfers, and initiate upgrades. Staking rewards are distributed proportionally to staked amounts, with a minimum staking period of 7 days before rewards can be claimed. A 0.5% fee is applied to all token transfers, which is directed to the content creator fund. The contract announces token transfer events, staking events, and reward claim events.
source_description: Connect, Create, and Own Your Experience

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Hoodbets and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a parimutuel prediction market for asset price movements, holding user deposits in an escrow. It maintains records of active prediction pools, each with a designated asset, a target price, an expiry timestamp, and the total amount staked on "up" or "down" outcomes, alongside individual user stakes within each pool. Callers can create a new prediction pool, deposit funds into an existing pool, choose an outcome (up or down), and withdraw their winnings after a pool has expired and been settled. Only a designated operator can settle an expired prediction pool by providing the final asset price, and only the owner can set the operator address or adjust the fee percentage. A new prediction pool must have a minimum deposit of 100 units of the base currency to be considered active, and a 1% fee is applied to all winnings. The contract emits an event when a new prediction pool is created, when a deposit is made, and when a pool is settled, including the final outcome.
source_description: HoodBets is a parimutuel betting pool on real stock prices, running on Robinhood Chain.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Frontier and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens via a bonding curve, holding the newly issued tokens and the underlying collateral until the launch concludes. It maintains a record of each token launch's current bonding curve parameters, the total amount of collateral deposited, and the amount of new tokens minted for each participant. Callers can initiate a new token launch, deposit collateral to purchase new tokens, and claim their purchased tokens once the launch is complete. Only a designated operator can approve new token launches and set the initial bonding curve parameters. Each token launch has a hard cap of 10,000,000 new tokens that can be minted, and a 0.5% fee on all collateral deposits is directed to the protocol treasury. The contract announces events for new token launches, collateral deposits, and token claims.
source_description: Bonding-curve token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Tokens trade on a shared bonding curve until it fills, then graduate to a Uniswap V4 pool

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Monster Gameverse and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital character assets and their associated in-game items, holding no custodied value itself. It maintains a record for each character asset, detailing its unique attributes, current experience points, and equipped items, alongside a global registry of all available item types and their properties. Callers can create new character assets, assign experience points to their owned characters, equip or unequip items from their characters, and transfer character assets to other accounts. A designated operator can define new item types and their properties, and also mint initial quantities of these items into the game's ecosystem. A character asset's experience points are capped at 10,000, and equipping an item requires the character to have at least 500 experience points. The contract announces when a new character asset is created, when an item is equipped or unequipped, and when a character asset is transferred.
source_description: Metaland is the first play-to-earn game based on Andre Cronje's Rarity Manifested, a Dungeons And Dragons-inspired character creator on the Fantom Opera blockchain.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Spark Liquidity Layer and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized liquidity provisioning system for a stablecoin, holding user-deposited stablecoins and their synthetic equivalents. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, their synthetic stablecoin balance, and a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw stablecoins, convert stablecoins to synthetic stablecoins, and convert synthetic stablecoins back to stablecoins. Only a designated operator can adjust the conversion fee, which is capped at 0.5%, and only the owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, and conversions, including the amount and the involved addresses.
source_description: The Spark Liquidity Layer (SLL) automates liquidity provision of USDS, sUSDS, and USDC directly from Sky across various blockchain networks, DeFi protocols, and RWA

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on Meme Cooking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fair token launches by holding deposited funds and newly minted tokens in escrow until a launch concludes. It maintains a registry of active launch campaigns, each with its own pool of deposited funds, allocated tokens, and participant contributions, alongside a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can initiate new launch campaigns, contribute funds to open campaigns, claim their allocated tokens and any refunded contributions after a campaign ends, and withdraw their initial campaign creation deposit. A designated owner can set the global fee percentage, pause or unpause the contract, and designate operators who can approve or reject new launch campaigns. Each launch campaign requires a minimum of 100 units of the base currency to be deposited by the creator, and the contract charges a 2% fee on all successfully raised funds, deducted before tokens are distributed. The contract emits an event whenever a new launch campaign is created, funds are contributed, or tokens are claimed.
source_description: The first truly fair meme token launchpad on Near

description: Specify a payments contract based on Bleap Card and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prepaid crypto card system, holding user-deposited stablecoins to back card spending. It maintains individual user balances, a total stablecoin reserve, and a configurable transaction fee. Users can deposit stablecoins to increase their card balance, and initiate spending transactions which deduct from their balance. A designated operator can approve or reject spending transactions, and set the transaction fee. The maximum daily spending limit per user is 1000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% transaction fee is applied to all approved spending. The contract emits events for deposits, approved spending transactions, and rejected spending transactions.
source_description: Bleap Card is a crypto card issuer that allows you to pay for your purchases with crypto.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Badger DAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and earning yield on wrapped Bitcoin, holding wrapped Bitcoin tokens and an interest-bearing receipt token from an external yield-generating protocol. It maintains a record of each user's deposited wrapped Bitcoin balance and their corresponding share of the vault's total interest-bearing tokens, along with a global configuration for the external yield protocol's address. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin into the vault, withdraw their deposited wrapped Bitcoin and accrued yield, and claim any accumulated rewards from the external protocol. Only a designated owner can update the external yield protocol's address or adjust the vault's operational parameters. A deposit fee of 0.5% is applied to all new deposits, and withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour time lock after the initial deposit before any funds can be removed. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and any changes to the external yield protocol's address.
source_description: BadgerDAO is a decentralized collective of builders supporting community driven growth for Bitcoin across DeFi.

description: Define a smart account contract based on Rabby Wallet and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a secure, on-chain registry for user-defined spending policies, enabling automated transaction execution and custodying no assets directly. It maintains a record of each user's configured policies, including associated spending limits and designated beneficiary addresses. Callers can create new policies, update existing policy parameters, and revoke policies entirely. A designated operator can pause all policy execution in an emergency, and only the owner can change the designated operator. Each policy must specify a maximum daily spending limit, which cannot exceed 10 ether, and a minimum of 24 hours must pass between any two updates to the same policy's spending limit. The contract announces the creation, update, and revocation of any spending policy.
source_description: A wallet for Ethereum and all EVM chains By DeBank

description: Outline a token contract based on Tomo and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token for a decentralized social network, holding user-deposited base tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's social token balance, a global supply of the social token, and a configuration for the conversion rate between the base token and the social token. Callers can deposit base tokens to mint social tokens, transfer social tokens to other users, and burn social tokens to withdraw their proportional share of the underlying base tokens. Only a designated operator can adjust the social token minting and burning rate, which is initially set to 1 base token per 100 social tokens. The contract enforces a maximum transfer amount of 1,000,000 social tokens per transaction. The contract emits an event whenever social tokens are minted, transferred, or burned.
source_description: Trade, chat and meet your next Tomo now

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Finext Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding collateral in a designated asset to back the issuance of a stable token. It maintains a global supply of the stable token, a collateral reserve balance, and per-account balances for both the stable token and the collateral asset. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stable tokens against their deposited collateral, redeem stable tokens for collateral, and withdraw their unencumbered collateral. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause or unpause minting and redemption. The initial collateralization ratio is 150%, meaning 1.5 units of collateral are required to mint 1 unit of stable token, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stable token redemptions. The contract announces stable token minting and redemption events, as well as changes to the collateralization ratio.
source_description: FINEXT is a decentralized finance (DeFi) with a seigniorage algorithmic token on Arbitrum, bringing a model that follows the price of a defined asset (ETH in this case).

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on four.meme and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a launchpad for new tokens, custodying deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a list of active token launch campaigns, each with its own target raise amount, current raised amount, and a mapping of participant addresses to their deposited base token contributions. Callers can deposit base tokens into an active campaign, claim their allocated project tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their base tokens if a launch fails. The owner can create new launch campaigns, set their parameters, finalize successful campaigns to enable project token claims, and cancel failed campaigns to enable base token withdrawals. Each launch campaign has a minimum base token contribution of 0.01 base tokens and a maximum contribution of 100 base tokens per participant. The contract emits an event when a new launch campaign is created, when a deposit is made, and when project tokens are claimed or base tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Four.meme is a premier fair launch platform for meme coins on the BSC chain. Our platform is dedicated to empowering creators and communities to launch successful meme coin projects with ease.

description: Model a token contract based on friend.tech V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a social token exchange, holding Ether and custom social tokens. It tracks the price curve for each social token, the Ether balance of each social token, and the Ether balance of each user. Callers can buy social tokens, sell social tokens, and withdraw their Ether. A designated operator can set the base price curve parameters and withdraw accumulated fees. The initial supply of each social token is zero, and the price increases quadratically with each token bought. A 5% fee is applied to all buy and sell transactions, split between the social token creator and the protocol. The contract emits events for all buy and sell actions, fee withdrawals, and changes to the base price curve.
source_description: Your network is your net worth.

description: Outline a payments contract based on Plasma One and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-bearing stablecoin, custodying deposited stablecoins and distributing earned yield. It maintains individual account balances for each user, a total supply of the yield-bearing stablecoin, and a global exchange rate between the deposited stablecoin and the yield-bearing stablecoin. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint the yield-bearing stablecoin, redeem their yield-bearing stablecoin for the underlying stablecoin, and transfer their yield-bearing stablecoin to other accounts. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on external yield accrual, and can pause all deposit and redemption operations in an emergency. The minimum deposit amount is 10 deposited stablecoins. A 0.1% fee is applied to all redemption transactions, deducted from the redeemed amount. The contract announces deposit, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Plasma One is a next-generation card product built on the Plasma Chain, an EVM-compatible L1 optimised for stablecoin payments and everyday spending. It combines a yield-bearing Earn product (P1USD) with gasless Checkings accounts, giving users a seamless on-chain banking experience

description: Design a governance contract based on Avant avETH and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking derivative token, representing staked Ether and accruing yield, and custodies deposited Ether. It maintains each user's deposited Ether amount, their share of the total staked Ether, and the current exchange rate between the derivative token and Ether. Callers can deposit Ether to mint the derivative token, redeem the derivative token for Ether, and transfer their derivative tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the Ether balance representing staked assets and adjust the exchange rate. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, and a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 Ether is required. The contract emits an event when Ether is deposited, when Ether is redeemed, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: avETH is a stable-value token that can be staked to earn yield with savETH

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on FermiSwap and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for two tokens, holding reserves of both tokens in a liquidity pool. It maintains the current reserves of each token in the pool, a trading fee percentage, and the total liquidity tokens minted. Callers can add liquidity by depositing both tokens, remove liquidity by burning their liquidity tokens, and swap one token for the other. The owner can set the trading fee percentage and withdraw accumulated fees. The trading fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount. Swaps must maintain a product of reserves that is at least 99.7% of the product before the swap, accounting for fees. The contract announces liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and successful token swaps.
source_description: FermiSwap is a prop AMM on Ethereum.

description: Create an on-chain insurance contract based on Bright Union and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of funds to provide coverage against smart contract exploits and other defined risks, holding various digital assets as collateral. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, active coverage policies, and any outstanding claims, alongside global configuration parameters like coverage premiums and claim processing delays. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase coverage policies specifying a covered asset and duration, file claims against active policies, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated administrator can adjust coverage premiums, approve or reject claims, and pause new policy purchases. Coverage policies have a minimum duration of 7 days and a maximum duration of 365 days, and a 2% fee is applied to all policy purchases. The contract emits events when collateral is deposited, a policy is purchased, a claim is filed, and a claim is resolved.
source_description: DeFi coverage aggregator

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on SuperEarn and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-earning vault that custodies deposited ERC-20 tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, the total assets under management, and a list of approved earning strategies. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim earned yield. A designated operator can add new earning strategies, remove existing strategies, and adjust the allocation of assets to different strategies. The contract will support a maximum of 10 active earning strategies at any given time. A 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield distribution events.
source_description: SuperEarn is a decentralized yield-earning DeFi protocol that allows users to deposit supported crypto assets and earn returns by allocating those assets into on-chain earning strategies.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Pac Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for various collateral types, holding deposited tokens and tracking outstanding loans. It maintains per-user records of deposited collateral, borrowed assets, and accumulated interest, alongside global pools for each supported asset and configuration parameters for each market. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new collateral and borrowable assets, adjust interest rate models, and set liquidation thresholds. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset pair is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new loans. The contract announces deposit, borrow, repay, and withdrawal events, including the user, asset, and amount.
source_description: A self-repaying lending and margin trading protocol on Blast

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Curve DEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract creates and manages liquidity pools for exchanging stable-value tokens, holding deposited tokens as reserves. It maintains a record of each pool's deposited token balances, a global list of available pools, and configuration parameters for each pool. Callers can deposit stable-value tokens into a pool, withdraw their share of tokens from a pool, and exchange one stable-value token for another within a pool. A designated owner can create new pools, set pool parameters such as the amplification factor, and update the contract's fee recipient. The maximum number of tokens in any pool is 8, and the default swap fee is 0.04%. The contract emits an event whenever tokens are deposited, withdrawn, or exchanged, including the pool identifier, the tokens involved, and the amounts.
source_description: Curve is a decentralized exchange liquidity pool on Ethereum designed for extremely efficient stablecoin trading

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on BulbaSwap V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's concentrated liquidity positions, holding deposited tokens for users who provide liquidity. It maintains individual liquidity positions for each user, tracking their deposited amounts, chosen price ranges, and accumulated fees, along with global configuration parameters like the base fee rate and protocol-wide accumulated fees. Callers can create new liquidity positions by depositing tokens, add more liquidity to existing positions, remove liquidity from their positions, collect accumulated fees, and swap tokens through existing liquidity pools. A designated operator can update the base fee rate, which is initially set at 0.3%, and pause all swapping operations in an emergency. The maximum number of active liquidity positions per token pair is capped at 10,000. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, fee collections, and token swaps, including the affected token amounts and the current state of the liquidity pool.
source_description: BulbaSwap, the central trading and liquidity marketplace on MorphL2

description: Model a token contract based on JamFrens and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social key exchange, holding fungible tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's purchased keys, the current price of each key, and a global fee percentage. Callers can purchase keys for a specific user, sell keys they own, and withdraw their share of the collected fees. The contract owner can update the global fee percentage and designate an operator who can pause all key trading. A purchase or sale of keys incurs a 5% fee on the transaction value. The maximum number of keys a single user can own for any other user is 100. The contract announces an event when keys are bought, sold, or when the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: Building the first Web3 native “Friend Tech” app based on Farcaster and LensProtocol

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Stealcam and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and sale of digital content items, holding the content's ownership rights until purchased. It maintains a record of each content item, including its current owner, its sale price, and a unique identifier, along with a global fee percentage and a designated fee recipient. Callers can create new content items, transfer ownership of their content items, list their content items for sale at a specified price, purchase listed content items, and delist their content items. Only the contract owner can set the global fee percentage and change the fee recipient. The initial sale price for any content item must be at least 0.001 ether, and the global fee percentage cannot exceed 10%. The contract announces when a new content item is created, when a content item is listed for sale, and when a content item is purchased.
source_description: Stealcam is a mobile camera web app that lets you create and share photos and videos on the blockchain

description: Create an NFT contract based on XOXNO NFT Marketplace and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and associated payment tokens in escrow during sale periods. It maintains individual account balances for payment tokens, records of active NFT listings including seller, price, and NFT identifier, and a global configuration for marketplace fees. Callers can list NFTs for sale, purchase listed NFTs, cancel their own listings, and withdraw their available payment token balances. A designated administrator can adjust the marketplace fee percentage and pause all listing and purchasing activities. The maximum marketplace fee is 5%, and all listed NFTs must be unique within the marketplace. The contract emits events upon successful NFT listings, purchases, and cancellations, and when the marketplace fee is updated.
source_description: A marketplace on MultiversX to discover, collect, create and sell digital assets

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Ape Express and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and the project tokens being distributed. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited funds, their allocated project tokens, and the current phase of the launch. Callers can deposit funds during the funding phase, claim their allocated project tokens after the distribution phase begins, and withdraw any unspent deposited funds if the launch fails to meet its minimum target. A designated operator can set the launch parameters, advance the launch phase, and initiate the distribution of project tokens. The maximum deposit per participant is 1000 units of the deposited token, and a 2% fee is applied to all successfully claimed project tokens, deducted from the project token amount. The contract announces when a new launch phase begins and when project tokens are successfully claimed.
source_description: The meme coin hub of ApeChain

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on GraFun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a fair launch mechanism for new tokens, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's purchased project token balance and their corresponding base token contribution, along with a global pool of base tokens and project tokens. Participants can deposit base tokens to acquire project tokens, claim their purchased project tokens, and withdraw any remaining base tokens after the launch concludes. Only the owner can set the initial project token supply, adjust the launch phase parameters, and finalize the launch. The initial project token supply must be between 1,000,000 and 10,000,000,000 tokens, and a 2% fee on base token deposits is automatically transferred to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when a new project token launch begins, when a participant makes a deposit, and when a participant claims project tokens.
source_description: GraFun is revolutionizing meme coins by introducing unique and actual fair launch mechanics. Meme pads usually rely on a standard exponential Bonding Curve model (x*y=k). This simple model opens the door to market manipulation, rug pulls, and other exploitative practices. Gra Fun has refined this approach, developing its distinct style of meme token launches that address these issues head-on

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Hakka Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized options trading platform, holding collateral tokens deposited by users and minted option tokens. It maintains individual user balances of collateral and option tokens, global pools of available collateral, and configuration parameters for each option type. Callers can deposit collateral, mint option tokens against their deposited collateral, exercise option tokens, and withdraw their unencumbered collateral. A designated operator can create new option types, adjust margin requirements, and pause or unpause trading for specific option types. The contract enforces a maximum collateralization ratio of 150% for minting new options and charges a 0.1% fee on all option exercise operations, payable in the underlying collateral token. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, option mints, and option exercises, including the user's identifier, the token amount, and the option type.
source_description: Hakka Decentralized Finance Ecosystem Warped Spacetime with Crypto Native Primitives.

description: Create a payments contract based on Lightning Network and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates instant, off-chain transfers of a fungible token by acting as a secure escrow for channel participants. It maintains individual channel states, recording the current balance for each participant within open channels. Callers can open a new channel, update a channel's state with a new agreed-upon balance, and close a channel to settle the final balances on-chain. Only the designated owner can set the base fee for opening new channels. A channel must remain open for a minimum of 100 blocks before it can be closed, and the base fee for opening a new channel is fixed at 50 units of the fungible token. The contract announces when a new channel is opened, when a channel's state is updated, and when a channel is closed, including the final settled balances.
source_description: Scalable, Instant Bitcoin/Blockchain Transactions

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Streamlock and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens by managing a bonding curve and price-gated escrows, holding deposited native currency and newly issued tokens. It maintains a record of each launched token's configuration, including its bonding curve parameters and price milestones, alongside individual user purchase positions detailing their locked token amounts and unlock eligibility. Callers can purchase new tokens by depositing native currency, claim unlocked tokens once price milestones are met, and the designated operator can register new token launches and update their price milestones. Only the owner can set the protocol fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of all native currency purchases, and pause all purchase and claim operations. Purchases are limited to a maximum of 100 native currency units per transaction. The contract announces token purchases, token claims, and changes to token launch configurations.
source_description: Solana token launchpad with price-gated locks. Users buy launched memecoins via a bonding-curve AMM; purchases sit locked in on-chain escrows until each token hits its configured price milestones. Idle SOL reserves are staked as JitoSOL for yield that accrues to the protocol.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on BDEX V3 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token swaps, holding deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, including token amounts and price ranges, and global pool configurations such as swap fees. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, withdraw tokens from existing positions, swap tokens between supported pairs, and collect accrued swap fees. Only a designated operator can adjust the base swap fee for a pool, which is initially set at 0.05% and cannot exceed 1%. The contract emits an event whenever a new liquidity position is created, and another event for every token swap, detailing the tokens involved and their quantities.
source_description: BDEX V3 is a concentrated-liquidity decentralized exchange on BOT Chain

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Aegis YUSD and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding deposited stablecoins as collateral. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total supply of the yield-bearing token, and a global profit distribution rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint the yield-bearing token, withdraw their deposited stablecoins by burning the yield-bearing token, and claim accumulated profits. Only a designated operator can update the profit distribution rate and initiate profit distributions. The maximum deposit amount per transaction is 10,000 stablecoins, and a 0.1% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, profit claims, and profit distribution rate updates.
source_description: Aegis performs funding rate arbitrage through delta-neutral trades in spot and perpetual markets, effectively generating profits from funding fees. These fees, disbursed three times daily, align perpetual contract and spot prices, ultimately rewarding YUSD holders.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Envelop and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract creates and manages wrapped tokens, where each wrapped token is backed by a basket of other fungible or non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each wrapped token's unique identifier, its underlying collateral assets, and its current owner. Callers can create new wrapped tokens by depositing collateral, transfer ownership of existing wrapped tokens, and redeem wrapped tokens to retrieve their underlying collateral. A designated operator can set the fee for creating wrapped tokens, which is fixed at 0.5% of the total collateral value, and can add or remove supported collateral types. The contract will emit an event whenever a new wrapped token is created, transferred, or redeemed.
source_description: Envelop is a collateralized derivatives protocol.

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Moonlander and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This is a perpetual futures trading contract, holding collateral deposited by traders and funds for the insurance pool. It maintains individual trader accounts with their collateral balances and open positions, a global insurance pool balance, and system-wide configuration parameters like funding rates and fees. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close long or short positions, add margin to existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update funding rates and adjust system parameters, and the owner can pause all trading operations. A maximum leverage of 50x is enforced for all positions, and a 0.1% trading fee is charged on each position's notional value at opening. The contract announces position openings and closings, and collateral deposits and withdrawals.
source_description: Moonlander is a decentralized perpetual trading platform on Cronos zkEVM chain that offers both a staking pool and on-chain perpetuals, primed to empower all traders and stakers with galactic opportunities. Leveraging on the latest layer 2 zk-technology, transactions on Moonlander are executed at higher speed and lower fees

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on ApeX Pro and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in various approved tokens. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters for each trading pair.
