The contract announces market creation, order placements, order cancellations, and market settlements to observers.
source_description: Gnosis builds new market mechanisms for decentralized finance.

description: Design a governance contract based on Sommelier and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized investment strategy vault, holding various liquid tokens and their interest-bearing derivatives. It maintains a record of each user's deposited tokens, their share of the vault, and the current configuration of the active investment strategy. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their share of the vault, and propose new investment strategies. A designated governance committee can approve or reject proposed strategies, and only they can adjust the vault's operational fee, which is capped at 0.5% of all withdrawals. New strategies, once approved, have a mandatory 48-hour timelock before activation. The contract emits events upon successful deposits, withdrawals, and strategy changes.
source_description: Provider of automated vaults that find best-in-class yields while mitigating risk.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on NewThrone and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a player-versus-player gaming system, custodying wrapped ether for battle rewards. It maintains individual player balances of wrapped ether, a global game configuration, and a record of active battles. Players can initiate attacks against other players, claim rewards from won battles, and withdraw their wrapped ether balance. A designated operator can set the attack cost, adjust battle parameters, and pause the system. Each attack costs 0.001 wrapped ether, and a player can only initiate one attack every 5 minutes. The contract announces when a battle is initiated, when a battle concludes, and when a player claims rewards.
source_description: Join NewThrone today, a browser-based PVP Game project built on the Base Chain. NewThrone delivers an easy-to-use and profitable experience, as playing engages you in attacking enemies with the end goal of stealing WETH as a reward for battles won.

description: Design a staking contract based on Marinade Liquid Staking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates liquid staking of a base asset, issuing a liquid staking token in return, and custodies the deposited base asset. It maintains a global pool of staked base assets, a record of each user's deposited base asset balance, and their corresponding liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their staked base asset by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards accrued from the staking process. A designated operator can update the staking strategy and adjust parameters. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount for the base asset is 0.01 units. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and reward distributions.
source_description: The easiest way to stake Solana - liquid staking

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Cellula and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and evolution of digital life forms, holding no custodied assets directly but tracking ownership of unique digital entities. It maintains a record of each digital entity's attributes, its current evolutionary stage, and its owner, along with a global configuration for creation parameters. Callers can create new digital entities, evolve an existing entity using specific resources, and transfer ownership of their entities. Only a designated operator can adjust the global configuration parameters, such as the initial creation cost and the resource requirements for evolution. New digital entity creation requires a fixed fee of 0.01 ether, and an entity can only evolve a maximum of 5 times. The contract announces when a new digital entity is created and when an existing entity completes an evolutionary stage.
source_description: Cellula, a fully on-chain AI game that offers users the ability to create, compose and evolve their digital life. Its unique Virtual Proof of Work (vPOW) asset distribution method provides an innovative incentive layer for games within the Cellula ecosystem.

description: Create a governance contract based on Mellow Core and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract defines and enforces the operational parameters for a capital allocation vault, holding various fungible tokens. It maintains a configuration for each vault instance, detailing permitted integrations, allowed actions, and capital flow rules. Callers can deposit tokens into a vault, initiate approved capital movements between integrated protocols, and withdraw their share of tokens. Only a designated operator can update the vault's configuration, which includes adding or removing approved integrations and modifying capital allocation strategies. A vault must always maintain at least 10% of its total capital in a designated reserve pool, and any single capital movement action cannot exceed 50% of the vault's current non-reserve capital. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the vault's operational configuration.
source_description: Core Vaults encode strategy constraints directly into the vault configuration. This includes which integrations can be used, which actions are permitted, and how capital can move between execution paths. Enforcement happens onchain, making strategy behavior inspectable and resistant to off-policy execution.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Hotfriescoin and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin, holding a reserve of a designated collateral token to back its own issued token. It maintains the total supply of its issued token, the amount of collateral held, and each account's balance of the issued token. Callers can mint new tokens by depositing collateral, burn tokens to redeem collateral, and transfer their issued tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause or unpause all minting and burning operations. The initial collateralization ratio is 1.05, meaning 1.05 units of collateral are required to mint 1 unit of the stablecoin. A 0.1% fee is applied to all token transfers, which is sent to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when tokens are minted, burned, or transferred, and when the collateralization ratio is updated.
source_description: A new Asset Class called Stable Progressive Coin. We aim to be the World's Most Powerful Reserve and Store of Value Currency.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on AptosLaunch and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages token launches, holding deposited tokens from participants and the project's launch tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited funds and their allocated launch tokens, along with the current launch phase and configuration parameters. Callers can deposit funds during the deposit phase, claim their allocated launch tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent deposited funds if the launch is canceled. A designated operator can initiate new launches, set launch parameters including the token to be launched and its total supply, transition between launch phases, and cancel a launch. The maximum individual deposit is capped at 1000 units of the deposit token. A launch must proceed through deposit, allocation, and claim phases in that strict order. The contract emits an event when a new launch is initiated, when a participant deposits funds, and when a participant claims tokens.
source_description: Empower Your Crypto Project with Community-Powered Liquidity. Aptos Web 3.0 Launchpad on the Safest and Scalable Layer 1 Blockchain.

description: Outline a token contract based on stake.link index and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of yield-bearing tokens, specifically liquid staking derivatives, allowing users to deposit and withdraw a base currency. It maintains individual balances for each user's share of the basket, along with the current composition of the basket and configuration parameters like fees and rebalancing thresholds. Callers can deposit the base currency to receive basket shares, withdraw their share of the underlying liquid staking derivatives, and claim any accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust the basket's composition by swapping underlying assets, and set the deposit and withdrawal fees. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited amount, and withdrawals are subject to a maximum 2% fee. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the basket's composition.
source_description: Earn blended returns on the top LSDs available today.

description: Model a token contract based on Valoro and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a fund management protocol that custodies various fungible tokens. It maintains per-account records of deposited tokens, a list of approved investment strategies, and a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their share of the fund, and propose new investment strategies. Only the owner can approve new investment strategies and set the management fee. The maximum management fee is 2%, and withdrawals are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the account involved and the amount of tokens transferred.
source_description: Valoro is a fund management and investment protocol on MultiversX

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Mezo Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the secure bridging of a specific wrapped Bitcoin asset from a source chain to a destination chain, holding the wrapped Bitcoin in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, the total amount of wrapped Bitcoin locked in the contract, and a configurable bridging fee. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin into the contract, initiate a bridge transfer to the destination chain, and claim their bridged assets on the destination chain once confirmed. Only a designated operator can approve bridge transfers and update the bridging fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the transfer amount. A minimum deposit of 0.001 wrapped Bitcoin is required for any transfer. The contract announces events for successful deposits, initiated bridge transfers, and completed claims.
source_description: Mezo is the Bitcoin Economic Layer: a Bitcoin-first network with a dual staking model for rewards and validation.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Radpie and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator for a lending protocol, holding deposited tokens and their corresponding interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens and receipt tokens, a global configuration for approved lending pools, and a record of the current yield-bearing strategy for each supported token. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, claim accumulated yield, and stake their receipt tokens to earn additional rewards. The owner can add or remove supported tokens, update the yield strategy for a token, and set the platform fee. A maximum of 10 supported tokens can be configured at any time. A 5% platform fee is applied to all claimed yield. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, a withdrawal occurs, yield is claimed, or the platform fee is updated.
source_description: Radpie is a Next-Generation SubDAO by @magpiexyz_io that leverages @RDNTCapital's robust infrastructure

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Tornado Cash and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates anonymous transfers of a single, specified ERC-20 token by allowing users to deposit tokens and later withdraw them to a different address without linking the two. It maintains a list of unspent commitment hashes, a list of spent nullifier hashes, and a configurable fee percentage for withdrawals. Callers can deposit tokens by providing a commitment hash, and they can withdraw tokens by providing a valid proof, a nullifier hash, and a recipient address. The owner can update the withdrawal fee percentage and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 1% of the withdrawn amount, and the maximum deposit amount is 1000 of the specified ERC-20 token. The contract announces the commitment hash upon a successful deposit and the nullifier hash upon a successful withdrawal.
source_description: Non-custodial anonymous transactions on Ethereum.

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Nexus Mutual and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides decentralized coverage against smart contract vulnerabilities, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains a global pool of collateral, individual user coverage policies with associated premium payments, and a configuration for coverage types and pricing. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase coverage for a specified smart contract, file a claim against an active policy, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, update coverage parameters, and pause new policy purchases. Claims must be filed within 90 days of a reported vulnerability, and approved claims pay out 90% of the covered amount. The contract announces policy purchases, premium payments, claim filings, and claim resolutions.
source_description: Nexus Mutual offers decentralized cover against smart contract failure.

description: Model a payments contract based on CheapGM and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a simple on-chain greeting service with a referral mechanism, holding only the native blockchain token collected as fees. It maintains a record of each user's referral count and a global configuration for the greeting fee and the referral reward percentage. Callers can initiate a greeting, optionally providing a referrer, and claim their accumulated referral rewards. Only the contract owner can set the greeting fee, set the referral reward percentage, or withdraw accumulated fees. The greeting fee is fixed at 0.001 native tokens per greeting, and the referral reward percentage is fixed at 20% of the greeting fee. The contract announces a greeting event when a greeting is successfully performed, including the greeter's address, the referrer's address if any, and the fee paid.
source_description: GM is a minimalist on-chain “gm/mint” service with referral logic and a fixed fee in the native token.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on HeadStarter and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a crowdfunding campaign, holding deposited tokens from participants. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and a total accumulated amount for the campaign. Callers can deposit tokens into the campaign, claim their allocated tokens after the campaign concludes, and withdraw their initial deposit if the campaign fails. Only the owner can start the campaign, set the funding goal, and finalize the campaign. The campaign has a minimum funding goal of 100,000 tokens and a maximum duration of 30 days. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made and when the campaign status changes.
source_description: Hedera-focused Web3 launchpad and crowdfunding platform with acceleration, incubation, and grants programs

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on LuckyChip and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lottery where users predict the outcome of a random number. It custodies user deposits in the native blockchain currency. The contract maintains a record of each user's current prediction, their deposited amount, and the total prize pool for the current round. Callers can deposit funds to make a prediction, withdraw their prediction and deposit before the round closes, and claim their winnings after a round concludes. Only a designated operator can initiate a new round, set the winning number for a closed round, and withdraw a portion of the prize pool as a platform fee. A minimum deposit of 0.01 native currency is required for each prediction. The platform fee is fixed at 5% of the total prize pool. The contract announces when a new round begins, when a round closes, and the winning number for a concluded round.
source_description: 1st Web3 Casino with PlaytoEarn and StaketoEarn.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on GOLDSTATION RWA and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for a gold-backed stablecoin, custodying no assets directly but representing a claim on physical gold held by a designated custodian. It maintains per-account balances of the stablecoin and a global total supply, alongside a configurable minting fee and redemption fee. Callers can mint new stablecoins by providing an equivalent value in a specified stablecoin, transfer their stablecoin balances to other accounts, and redeem their stablecoins for the equivalent value in the specified stablecoin. Only a designated operator can pause and unpause minting and redemption, and only the owner can update the designated operator, set the minting fee, and set the redemption fee. The minting fee is fixed at 0.1% of the minted amount, and the redemption fee is fixed at 0.2% of the redeemed amount. The contract announces all minting, transfer, and redemption events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: GPC(Gold-Pegged coin) is 100% physical gold-based RWA issued on Kaia network

description: Design a smart account contract based on Sign and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for managing verifiable attestations and does not custody any tokens. It maintains a registry of unique attestation identifiers, each linked to an issuer's address, a schema identifier, and a cryptographic hash of the attestation data. Callers can issue new attestations, revoke existing attestations they previously issued, and query the status and details of any attestation by its identifier. Only the original issuer of an attestation may revoke it. A maximum of 10,000 attestations can be issued per schema identifier. The contract announces when an attestation is issued and when an attestation is revoked.
source_description: An omni-chain attestation protocol for issuing, verifying, and querying cryptographically signed identities, credentials, and other verifiable claims.

description: Specify a payments contract based on Bitget Wallet Card and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoins that back a crypto-linked debit card system, allowing users to fund their cards with cryptocurrency and spend fiat. It maintains individual user balances of stablecoins, a global stablecoin reserve, and a record of each user's linked external card identifier. Users can deposit stablecoins into their balance, initiate a fiat spending transaction by specifying an amount and their card identifier, and withdraw any remaining stablecoin balance. A designated operator can approve or reject pending fiat spending transactions, and set the transaction fee. The maximum stablecoin deposit per user is 10,000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all fiat spending transactions. The contract announces when stablecoins are deposited, when fiat spending transactions are initiated, and when fiat spending transactions are approved or rejected.
source_description: The Bitget Wallet Card is a crypto-linked payment card issued through Bitget Wallet that lets users fund a card with cryptocurrencies for real-time crypto-to-fiat spending

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Taiko Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain message passing between a Layer 1 and a Layer 2, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a mapping of message hashes to their current status (pending, relayed, failed) and the block number at which they were initiated, along with a configurable relay fee and a list of authorized message relayer addresses. Callers can initiate a message on Layer 1, and authorized relayers can relay a message to Layer 2, or prove a message failed on Layer 2. Only the contract owner can update the relay fee or add/remove authorized relayer addresses. The relay fee must be at least 0.001 ether, and a message can only be relayed to Layer 2 if at least 100 Layer 1 blocks have passed since its initiation. The contract announces when a message is initiated, when it is successfully relayed, and when a relay attempt fails.
source_description: A Based Contestable Rollup, Ethereum-equivalent ZK-EVM

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Mintiq Market and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited tokens for sale and the proceeds from sales. It maintains a record of listed tokens, their prices, the seller for each listing, and the current balance of marketplace fees collected. Callers can list a non-fungible token for sale, purchase a listed token, cancel their own listing, and withdraw their sales proceeds. Only the owner can set the marketplace fee percentage, which defaults to 2.5% and cannot exceed 10%, and only the owner can withdraw accumulated marketplace fees. A token can only be purchased if its listed price is paid in full, and a listing can only be cancelled by the original seller. The contract announces when a token is listed, when a token is sold, and when a listing is cancelled.
source_description: An NFT Marketplace on XRPL EVM, Katana, Plume Mainnet

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Midas RWA and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the tokenization of real-world assets, specifically private credit facilities, and custodies the underlying asset tokens representing fractional ownership in these facilities. It maintains a record of each user's deposited asset tokens, their corresponding ownership shares in the credit facilities, and a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can deposit asset tokens to acquire ownership shares, redeem ownership shares to withdraw asset tokens, and transfer their ownership shares to other eligible users. A designated operator can pause or unpause deposits and redemptions, and an owner can set the redemption fee and add or remove approved asset tokens. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and a maximum of 10 distinct asset tokens can be approved for deposit at any time. The contract announces when asset tokens are deposited, ownership shares are redeemed, and the redemption fee is updated.
source_description: Midas is an asset tokenization protocol bringing regulatory-compliant exposure to institutional-grade assets onchain, unlocking DeFi composability for real-world assets (RWA).

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on AZverse Perps and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages perpetual futures positions, holding collateral tokens deposited by traders. It maintains individual account balances for collateral, open positions including their size and entry price, and a global configuration for each supported trading pair. Callers can open new positions, increase or decrease existing positions, close positions, deposit collateral, withdraw collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters such as funding rates and liquidation thresholds, and can pause all trading activity. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract announces position openings, position closures, liquidations, and collateral deposits and withdrawals.
source_description: AZverse is a DEX infrastructure protocol providing shared liquidity and a trading engine for DEX builders.

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on MovePump and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of new token launches, holding the newly minted tokens and any collected base currency. It maintains a record for each launched token, tracking its total supply, the amount of base currency raised, and individual participant contributions. Callers can initiate a new token launch, contribute base currency to an active launch, and claim their proportional share of the launched tokens once the launch concludes. The contract owner can set the base currency for new launches and pause or unpause all launch activity. A launch must raise at least 1000 base currency units to be considered successful, and a 2% fee on all base currency contributions is automatically directed to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when a new token launch begins, when contributions are made, and when a launch concludes.
source_description: Launch your token on Move Pump

description: Outline a token contract based on StakeStone SBTC and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract mints a liquid, index-backed token representing a diversified basket of wrapped Bitcoin assets, and it custodies the underlying wrapped Bitcoin tokens. It maintains a total supply of the index token, a balance of the index token for each user, and a record of the underlying wrapped Bitcoin tokens held. Callers can deposit supported wrapped Bitcoin tokens to mint new index tokens, and they can redeem their index tokens to receive a proportional share of the underlying wrapped Bitcoin tokens. A designated operator can add or remove supported wrapped Bitcoin tokens from the basket, and they can adjust the weighting of each wrapped Bitcoin token in the basket. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.001 wrapped Bitcoin tokens. Redemptions incur a 0.1% fee, deducted from the redeemed wrapped Bitcoin tokens. The contract announces the total supply of the index token and the current composition of the underlying wrapped Bitcoin basket.
source_description: SBTC is designed to act as a liquid, index BTC, addressing the issue of illiquid native BTC assets by providing robust omnichain liquidity. This innovative solution will facilitate BTC asset trading and enhance the utility of native BTC within EVM ecosystems as well as other Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks. SBTC will be composed of a diversified basket of ERC20 tokens, primarily BTCB, ensuring a solid foundation of liquidity.

description: Create a payments contract based on Giveth and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates charitable donations and manages a pool of matching funds for public goods. It maintains records of individual project registrations, the total amount donated to each project, and the current balance of the matching fund pool. Callers can register new projects, donate to existing projects, and claim matching funds for eligible projects. A designated operator can approve project registrations and disburse matching funds. Donations to a project must be at least 0.01 ether, and matching funds are disbursed at a 1:1 ratio up to a maximum of 10 ether per project per funding round. The contract announces when a new project is registered and when matching funds are disbursed.
source_description: Crypto donations since 2016 | $900K+ in $GIV rewarded | $3.8M+ raised for impact projects | Quadratic Funding since 2023 | Evolving Nonprofits: https://blog.giveth.io/the-power-of-giv-reimagining-public-goods-funding-1c5ab2a867e9

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on TiTi Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized algorithmic stablecoin, holding collateral in a basket of yield-bearing assets. It maintains individual user balances of the stablecoin, a global reserve pool of collateral, and a configuration for various protocol parameters. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for their underlying collateral, and stake stablecoins to earn yield. A designated operator can adjust the collateral asset whitelist and update oracle prices, while the owner can set global fees and pause operations. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and the maximum minting capacity is capped at 100,000,000 stablecoins. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and staking events, including the amounts and involved addresses, to observers.
source_description: TiTi Protocol is a decentralized, use-to-earn algorithmic stablecoin offering diversified financial services

description: Model a token contract based on Ethos Network and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for managing reputation scores and is the canonical source of truth for user credibility within the ecosystem. It maintains a mapping of unique user identifiers to their current credibility score, a history of score adjustments, and a record of staked tokens supporting those scores. Callers can register a new user identifier, stake tokens to support their own or another user's credibility score, transfer staked tokens between users, and challenge a user's credibility score. Only a designated operator can adjust a user's credibility score, resolve a challenge, or set the staking token address. A user must stake a minimum of 100 tokens to register a new user identifier, and a challenge incurs a 5% fee on the staked amount, which is distributed to successful challengers. The contract announces when a user's credibility score changes and when a challenge is initiated or resolved.
source_description: Ethos is a credibility platform that creates a more trusted web3 ecosystem

description: Specify an NFT contract based on ImmutableX and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a central registry and escrow for digital collectibles, holding non-fungible tokens on behalf of users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited non-fungible tokens and their associated metadata, along with a global configuration for fees and operators. Callers can deposit their non-fungible tokens into the contract, withdraw their previously deposited non-fungible tokens, and transfer ownership of deposited non-fungible tokens to another user within the system. A designated operator can register new non-fungible token collections for deposit and update the metadata associated with registered collections. The owner can set the deposit fee, which is fixed at 0.01 ether per deposit, and can designate or revoke operator privileges. All withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour time lock after initiation. The contract announces when a non-fungible token is deposited, withdrawn, or transferred, and when a new collection is registered.
source_description: Immutable is the leading platform for building web3 games on Ethereum. Powering the next generation of web3 games

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on BLUE Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury-backed reserve currency, holding various stablecoin and liquidity provider tokens. It maintains individual account balances for staked tokens, a global total supply of the reserve currency, and configuration parameters for rebase rewards. Callers can stake their tokens to receive the reserve currency, unstake their reserve currency to redeem underlying assets, and claim periodic rebase rewards. Only a designated operator can initiate rebase events, which distribute newly minted reserve currency to stakers, and only the owner can adjust the rebase reward rate or add new treasury assets. The rebase reward rate is fixed at 0.05% per 4-hour period, and unstaking incurs a 0.5% fee on the redeemed amount. The contract announces rebase events, new treasury asset additions, and changes to the rebase reward rate.
source_description: BLUE Protocol is a treasury-backed reserve currency on BNB Chain built on Olympus DAO mechanics, offering auto-rebasing staking rewards every 4 hours. The wrapped gBLUE token bridges to Abstract Chain via LayerZero, unlocking dual-stack yield through Aborean Finance LP incentives.

description: Design a staking contract based on CatFee Staking Vault and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base-layer cryptocurrency, holding deposited amounts of that cryptocurrency. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount and their accumulated rewards, along with a global total of staked funds and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit the base-layer cryptocurrency, withdraw their deposited amount and accrued rewards, and claim only their accrued rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate and trigger the distribution of rewards from the vault's balance to user accounts. The minimum deposit amount is 1 unit of the base-layer cryptocurrency, and the reward rate cannot exceed 0.05% per day. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: CatFee Staking Vault aims to bring staking and on-chain earnings to small TRX holders by eliminating all traditional barriers: no minimum TRX, no wallet approvals, no lockups, and no platform custody. Users can stake directly to a vault and receive rewards — with just 1 TRX.

description: Define a governance contract based on Berachain and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking mechanism for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native tokens and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a record of each staker's deposited amount and the amount of liquid staking tokens they hold, along with a global total of staked tokens and a current exchange rate between the native token and the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their native tokens by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards accrued from staking. A designated operator can update the staking rewards distribution and set the protocol fee. The minimum deposit amount is 10 native tokens, and the protocol charges a 5% fee on all staking rewards before distribution. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events to observers.
source_description: An EVM identical L1 aligning security and liquidity through Proof of Liquidity

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Stargate V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens in escrow on the source chain until they are minted on the destination chain. It maintains a record of each pending transfer, including the destination chain identifier, recipient address, asset type, and amount, along with a global configuration for fees and supported chains. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing wrapped tokens, cancel a pending transfer if it has not been processed, and claim refunded tokens from a failed transfer. Only a designated operator can mark a transfer as completed, refund a transfer, or update the list of supported chains and their associated transfer fees. Each transfer incurs a flat fee of 0.05 wrapped tokens, and a transfer must be claimed within 7 days of being refunded or the funds are returned to the contract's treasury. The contract emits an event upon the initiation of a new transfer, the completion of a transfer, and the refunding of a transfer.
source_description: Stargate V2 offers reduced bridging costs, expands chain connectivity, and improves capital efficiency using transaction batching, Hydra, and an AI-driven Planning Module (AIPM).

description: Specify a staking contract based on Tonstakers LSD and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This smart contract facilitates liquid staking for a base network's native token, holding deposited native tokens and issuing a corresponding liquid staking derivative token. It maintains a record of each user's deposited native tokens and issued liquid staking derivative tokens, along with the current exchange rate between the two tokens and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking derivative tokens, withdraw their deposited native tokens by burning liquid staking derivative tokens, and claim rewards accrued from staking operations. A designated operator can update the staking rewards distribution and adjust the exchange rate, while the contract owner can set the operator, modify the deposit fee, and pause or unpause the contract's core functionalities. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited amount, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 native tokens. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and exchange rate updates to observers.
source_description: The Open Network Liquid Staking protocol empowering TON DeFi ecosystem

description: Create a token contract based on PowerPool and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for managing a decentralized network of compute providers and their staked collateral, which it custodies. It maintains records of each provider's staked amount, their current compute power rating, and their accumulated rewards, alongside a global configuration for staking parameters and reward rates. Callers can stake tokens to become a provider, unstake their tokens after a cooldown period, claim earned rewards, and delegate their compute power to other entities. Only a designated operator can adjust the global reward rate, which is capped at 0.05% per block, and set the minimum staking amount, which must be at least 1000 units of the staked token. The contract announces when a provider stakes new tokens, when rewards are claimed, and when the global reward rate is updated.
source_description: DePIN layer powering AI Agents and DeFi automation in multichain universe

description: Outline an NFT contract based on ArtCPAClub and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital art tokens and facilitates their exchange, holding the tokens themselves in escrow during sales. It maintains a registry of all minted art tokens, their current owner, and their listing status, along with a global fee percentage and a record of all sales. Callers can mint new art tokens, list their owned tokens for sale at a specified price, purchase listed tokens, and withdraw their sales proceeds. Only a designated administrator can set the minting fee, update the global sales fee percentage, or pause all sales. The minting fee is fixed at 0.01 ether per token, and the global sales fee is 2.5% of the sale price. The contract emits an event upon each successful token mint, each token listing, and each token sale.
source_description: Unique NFTs and Marketplace on MultiversX NFT Staking & ESDT Staking Platform

description: Define a token locking contract based on UNCX Network V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the locking of arbitrary fungible tokens for a specified duration, holding the locked tokens in escrow. It maintains records of each lock, including the depositor, the token type, the amount, the unlock time, and whether the lock has been withdrawn. Callers can create new locks by depositing tokens, and once the unlock time has passed, they can withdraw their locked tokens. A designated operator can extend the unlock time of an existing lock, but only before the original unlock time has passed. The contract owner can set a fee percentage for new locks, which defaults to 0.5% and must be between 0% and 5%, and can also designate new operators. The contract emits an event when a new lock is created, when a lock's unlock time is extended, and when tokens are withdrawn from a lock.
source_description: UNCX Network is a one-stop shop with providing its customers with everything they need to launch and maintain a sustainable and secure protocol. Create your token, secure your LP with our liquidity lockers, vest your supply according to your tokenomics and create farming/staking incentives with customisable rewards.

description: Define a smart account contract based on MetaMask Wallet and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a simple, non-custodial smart wallet for individual users, allowing them to manage their own digital assets on the blockchain. It maintains a record of each user's owned tokens and their associated allowances for other contracts. Callers can deposit supported tokens, transfer tokens to other addresses, approve spending limits for other contracts, and revoke existing approvals. Only the designated owner of the contract can add new supported token addresses to the whitelist. A user's total token deposits cannot exceed 100 ether for any single token type, and a transfer of tokens incurs a flat fee of 0.001 ether, deducted from the transferred amount. The contract announces all successful token deposits, transfers, and approval changes.
source_description: MetaMask is the leading self-custodial wallet. A simple way to access blockchain applications and web3

description: Model a token contract based on time.fun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes a creator's time, measured in minutes, and custodies Ether from trading fees and redemptions. It maintains a total supply of time tokens for the creator, a current price for each time token, and individual balances of time tokens for each holder. Callers can buy time tokens, sell time tokens, and redeem time tokens directly from the creator. The creator is privileged and can set their initial time token supply, withdraw accumulated Ether, and pause trading. The initial supply of time tokens for a creator must be between 100 and 10,000, and a 5% fee is applied to all buy and sell transactions, distributed to the creator. The contract announces all token transfers and price updates.
source_description: Tokenize your time, in minutes, and let fans trade & redeem time with you. Exclusively on Base. Earn ETH from trading fees & redemptions whenever people trade your time

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on NOXA Fun and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized token launchpad, custodying deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains records of each project's launch configuration, including its associated concentrated-liquidity pool, the amount of base tokens contributed by each participant, and the project tokens allocated to them. Callers can create new project launches, deposit base tokens into active launches, claim their allocated project tokens, and withdraw any remaining base tokens after a launch concludes. A designated operator can set the fee percentage for new project launches and pause or unpause the entire launchpad. Each project launch must specify a minimum base token deposit of 100 units and a maximum launch duration of 30 days. The contract emits an event when a new project launch is created, when base tokens are deposited, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: Hybrid launchpad with V3 single-sided LP and graduation mechanics. Instant DEX trading, no LP migration, no token taxes. Creators earn fees

description: Define a governance contract based on Orai Quant Terminal and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a strategy vault for managing and allocating user deposits into various external yield-generating vaults, and it custodies deposited ERC-20 tokens. The contract maintains a record of each user's deposited amount for each supported ERC-20 token, as well as the current allocation strategy for each external vault. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens into the contract, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim any accumulated yield. Only the owner can add new external vaults to the approved list, update the allocation strategy for existing vaults, or set the withdrawal fee. A withdrawal fee of 0.5% is applied to all withdrawals, and the maximum number of supported external vaults is capped at 10. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the allocation strategy.
source_description: Quant is an Oraichain strategy vault product on Arbitrum that allocates deposited assets into ERC-4626 quant vaults

description: Outline a governance contract based on Brink and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield optimization vault that custodies deposited tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, their share of the vault's total value, and the current allocation of vault funds across various external strategies. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their share of tokens, and claim any accumulated rewards. Only a designated operator can rebalance the vault's allocation to different strategies and update the list of approved strategies. A minimum deposit of 100 tokens is enforced, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and rebalancing events.
source_description: Brink is a yield optimization platform that uses predictive algorithms to allocate and compound user deposits based on projected risk-adjusted returns..

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Stake DAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and staking a specific yield-bearing token, holding deposited tokens and their accumulated yield. It maintains individual account balances for deposited tokens, the current total staked amount, and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit the yield-bearing token, withdraw their deposited tokens plus any accrued yield, and claim rewards generated from staking activities. Only a designated operator can initiate staking of deposited tokens into an external yield-generating protocol and unstake them, and only the contract owner can set the staking fee, which must be between 0% and 10% inclusive, and update the address of the external yield-generating protocol. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour unbonding period after an unstake request is made. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the staking fee.
source_description: Stake DAO is a non-custodial decentralized protocol enabling users to access optimized yield opportunities in DeFi

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on Easedefi.org and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a decentralized coverage mechanism for digital assets, holding deposited tokens as collateral. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a global coverage pool, and configuration parameters like coverage limits and fees. Callers can deposit tokens to provide coverage, withdraw their deposited tokens, and initiate a claim for covered assets. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, and the owner can adjust coverage limits and fees. The maximum coverage claimable per incident is 1000 tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all approved claims. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and claim status changes.
source_description: Ease is a decentralized coverage protocol that enables users to protect their DeFi tokens without a premium while earning compounding yield.

description: Design a privacy-preserving contract based on Tonnel Network and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a privacy mixer for a fungible token, holding user deposits of that token. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments, a mapping of nullifiers to booleans indicating spent commitments, and a configuration for deposit sizes and fees. Callers can deposit a specific amount of the fungible token, providing a zero-knowledge proof of a secret and a commitment, and can withdraw a previously deposited amount by providing a zero-knowledge proof of a nullifier and a Merkle proof. The owner can update the fee percentage and add new deposit sizes. Each deposit must be one of the pre-configured amounts, and a withdrawal incurs a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events including the commitment hash, and withdrawal events including the nullifier hash and recipient.
source_description: TONNEL uses ZK technology to bring privacy to the SocialFi ecosystem on TON Blockchain which is deeply integrated into Telegram.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on MegaETH Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on the source chain and releasing native tokens on the destination chain, or vice-versa, effectively custodying wrapped tokens. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped token balances, a total supply of wrapped tokens, and a global transfer fee percentage. Callers can deposit native tokens to mint wrapped tokens, burn wrapped tokens to withdraw native tokens, and initiate a cross-chain transfer by burning wrapped tokens on one chain to trigger a release on another. A designated operator can approve cross-chain transfer requests and update the transfer fee. The maximum transfer fee is 0.5% of the transferred amount. All cross-chain transfer requests must be approved by the designated operator within 24 hours of initiation. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, or transferred across chains, including the sender, recipient, amount, and any associated fees.
source_description: Decentralized exchange on MegaETH.

description: Model a smart account contract based on Zerion Wallet and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a personal asset management vault, designed to hold and manage a user's various digital assets including fungible tokens and non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their current balance, and a history of their transactions within the vault. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, deposit non-fungible tokens, withdraw fungible tokens, withdraw non-fungible tokens, and delegate spending authority for specific assets to other addresses. A designated operator can set a global withdrawal fee and pause all withdrawal operations. The maximum number of unique non-fungible tokens a single user can deposit is 100, and any withdrawal of fungible tokens incurs a 0.1% fee. The contract announces asset deposit events, asset withdrawal events, and delegation of spending authority events.
source_description: A crypto wallet for everything onchain

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on ArbiTen and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin pegged to a fraction of the value of Ether, holding Ether and a volatile reserve token to back the stablecoin supply. It maintains the total supply of the stablecoin, the amount of Ether held as collateral, the amount of reserve token held, and a target collateralization ratio. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing Ether, redeem stablecoins for Ether, or swap stablecoins for the reserve token. A designated operator can adjust the target collateralization ratio and deposit or withdraw the reserve token. The target collateralization ratio must always be between 50% and 100%. Swapping stablecoins for the reserve token incurs a 0.5% fee, which is added to the reserve token pool. The contract emits events when stablecoins are minted, redeemed, or swapped, and when the collateralization ratio is updated.
source_description: Algorithmic stablecoin on Arbitrum One pegged to 0.1 ETH by both Seigniorage and Fractional Collateralization.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Deri V4 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized perpetual futures trading, holding user collateral in a designated base asset. It maintains individual user account balances, open positions including margin and unrealized profit/loss, and global pool liquidity and funding rates for each trading pair. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, add or remove margin from their positions, and deposit or withdraw collateral. A designated operator can update oracle prices, adjust funding rates, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed is 100x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all position changes, collateral deposits and withdrawals, and liquidations.
source_description: Deri Protocol is a decentralized protocol for users to exchange risk exposures precisely and capital efficiently. It is the DeFi way to trade derivatives: to hedge, to speculate, to arbitrage, all on chain.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Steer Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for managing automated liquidity positions in concentrated liquidity pools, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token, records of active liquidity positions including their range and pool identifier, and global configuration settings such as fees and allowed pools. Callers can deposit tokens, create new liquidity positions within a specified range, adjust existing positions by adding or removing liquidity, and withdraw their deposited tokens or earned fees. Only a designated operator can set the management fee percentage, add or remove allowed concentrated liquidity pool addresses, and pause all new position creation. The maximum management fee is 10% of earned fees. A user must deposit at least 0.01 ETH worth of tokens to open a new position. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, position creations, and position adjustments.
source_description: Steer is a decentralized compute protocol that provides a scaling solution for data processing through its robust off-chain infrastructure. Services are targeted at leveraging off-chain data for on-chain automation, such as automated liquidity management in DeFi.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Amogus DAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve-backed stable asset, holding various reserve tokens and a native governance token. It maintains a treasury balance for each reserve token, a total supply of the stable asset, and individual balances of the stable asset for each account. Callers can deposit approved reserve tokens to mint the stable asset, stake the stable asset to earn rewards, and unstake the stable asset to reclaim it. A designated operator can adjust the minting rate, distribute rewards to stakers, and add or remove approved reserve tokens. The maximum minting rate for the stable asset is 1000 units per unit of reserve token, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stable asset unstaking operations. The contract announces all minting, staking, and unstaking events, including the account involved and the amount.
source_description: Enhanced OHM Fork protocol on AVAX. Very sussy.

description: Define a payments contract based on Ajira Pay Finance V2 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a payment routing hub, holding user-deposited stablecoins for secure transfers. It maintains individual user balances, a list of registered merchants, and a configurable transaction fee. Callers can deposit stablecoins, initiate payments to registered merchants, and withdraw their available balance. The contract owner can register new merchants, update the transaction fee, and pause all payment operations. A maximum of 1000 merchants can be registered, and all payments incur a 0.5% fee, deducted from the sender's balance. The contract announces successful deposits, completed payments, and withdrawals through emitted events.
source_description: Ajira Pay Finance is a Multichain Decentralized Web3 protocol for secure and seamless crypto payments.

description: Create a token contract based on Indexed Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of ERC-20 tokens, allowing users to deposit and withdraw from the basket. It maintains the current composition of the basket, the total supply of basket tokens, and each user's balance of basket tokens. Callers can deposit a specific set of ERC-20 tokens into the basket to mint new basket tokens, or redeem basket tokens to withdraw a proportional share of the underlying ERC-20 tokens. A designated operator can adjust the target weights of the underlying ERC-20 tokens within the basket, but only after a 24-hour time lock has passed since the proposed change was announced. The owner can set a deposit fee, which is currently 0.1% of the value deposited, and can also pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The contract announces when new basket tokens are minted, when basket tokens are burned, and when the target weights of the underlying tokens are updated.
source_description: Indexed Finance is a project focused on the development of passive portfolio management strategies for the Ethereum network.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Maple and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates institutional lending and borrowing, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued loan tokens. It maintains records of each borrower's outstanding loan principal, accrued interest, and collateral provided, alongside a global pool of available liquidity and configuration parameters like interest rates. Callers can deposit collateral, request a loan, repay a loan, or withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and approve new loan requests. A borrower's collateralization ratio must always be at least 120% of their outstanding loan value, and the maximum loan term is 180 days. The contract announces loan origination, loan repayment, and collateral liquidation events.
source_description: Maple Finance is an institutional capital marketplace powered by blockchain technology.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on GmCash and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic asset that tracks the price of a target asset, holding a reserve of a base stablecoin to back the synthetic asset. It maintains an account balance for each user of the synthetic asset, a total supply of the synthetic asset, and a global reserve of the base stablecoin. Callers can mint new synthetic assets by depositing base stablecoins, burn synthetic assets to redeem base stablecoins, and transfer synthetic assets between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the minting and burning fees, and only the owner can pause all operations. The minting fee is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited base stablecoins, and the burning fee is 0.1% of the redeemed base stablecoins. The contract emits an event whenever synthetic assets are minted, burned, or transferred.
source_description: The revolutionary Defi Protocol on Arbitrum designed to follow the price of GMX.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on MUX Perps and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages leveraged perpetual futures positions, holding collateral in various accepted tokens. It maintains individual account balances for each collateral token, open position details including size, entry price, and liquidation price, and global configuration parameters like maximum leverage and trading fees. Callers can open new positions, increase or decrease existing positions, close positions, deposit collateral, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update global configuration parameters, adjust oracle addresses, and pause trading in emergencies. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 100x. A trading fee of 0.08% of the position's notional value is charged on opening and closing positions. The contract emits events for position openings, closures, collateral deposits, and withdrawals.
source_description: MUX Protocol Suite contains the MUX Leveraged Trading Protocol and MUX Aggregator. MUX offers optimized trading cost, deep aggregated liquidity, diverse market options and a wide range of leverage options for traders.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on Gwei Name Service and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages domain name registrations on the blockchain, holding ownership records for each registered name. It maintains a registry of owned names, their expiration dates, and the associated resolver addresses. Callers can register new names, renew existing names, transfer name ownership, and set a name's resolver. A designated operator can pause new registrations and renewals. New name registrations incur a flat fee of 0.01 ether, and name renewals extend ownership for exactly one year from the current expiration date. The contract emits an event when a name is registered, renewed, or transferred.
source_description: Ownerless, neutral fork of wei-names: .gwei names on Ethereum.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on eva Markets and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a system for issuing and redeeming portable tokens backed by isolated credit positions, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains records of each user's credit limit, their current outstanding balance, and the total supply of issued tokens. Callers can request to mint new tokens up to their available credit limit, repay outstanding balances to reduce their debt, and redeem tokens to decrease their outstanding balance. A designated operator can adjust individual user credit limits and pause or unpause the entire token issuance and redemption system. The maximum credit limit for any single user is 1,000,000 units of the underlying credit, and a 0.1% fee is applied to each token minting operation. The contract announces events for token mints, token redemptions, and credit limit adjustments.
source_description: eva Markets allows users to mint portable tokens backed by isolated credit.

description: Create a smart account contract based on Human Passport and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized identity registry, custodying no assets directly but managing attestations of human uniqueness. It maintains a record for each registered identity, storing a boolean indicating its verified status and a timestamp of its last verification. Callers can register a new identity, submit proof for verification, and query the verification status of an identity. A designated operator is privileged to approve or reject verification proofs, and to revoke an identity's verified status. A maximum of 10,000 identities can be registered in total. Each identity verification is valid for 365 days. The contract announces an event when a new identity is registered, when an identity's verification status changes, and when an identity's verification is revoked.
source_description: An identity verification application and Sybil resistance protocol.

description: Specify a governance contract based on weBribe DAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a governance power acquisition vault that custodies various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balances and their accumulated governance power, along with a global configuration for accepted deposit tokens and their respective power multipliers. Callers can deposit approved ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim their share of accumulated governance power. A designated operator can add new approved deposit tokens, update existing token power multipliers, and initiate governance power distribution. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 units for any approved token and a 24-hour withdrawal delay after a withdrawal request is made. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and governance power distribution events to observers.
source_description: WeBribe Dao is founded with the single objective to acquire governance power over ve(3,3) AMM. Participants can farm $VBRB (https://twitter.com/search?q=%24VBRB&src=cashtag_click) tokens by depositing various assets

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Ramses CL V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's concentrated liquidity positions, holding deposited tokens for trading pairs. It maintains individual user positions, global pool configurations including fee tiers, and aggregated liquidity for each token pair. Callers can create new positions, add or remove liquidity from existing positions, collect accrued fees, and swap tokens between supported pairs. A designated operator can adjust trading fees within a range of 0.01% to 1.00% and add new token pairs, while the contract owner can pause all trading activity and upgrade the contract implementation. Each liquidity position has a maximum of 100 distinct tick ranges, and a 0.25% protocol fee is levied on all collected trading fees. The contract announces events for new position creation, liquidity changes, token swaps, and fee collections.
source_description: RamsesX is a ve(3,3) exchange on Arbitrum with legacy liquidity pools and x(3,3) governance.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Junoswap.trade Launchpad and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad, designed to facilitate the initial distribution of new tokens and custodies deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's base token contributions and their allocated project token entitlements, along with a global configuration for each launch event including the project token address, the base token address, the total project tokens offered, and the target base token raise amount. Callers can contribute base tokens to a live launch, claim their allocated project tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their base tokens if a launch fails. The owner can initiate new launch events, finalize successful launches, and cancel failed launches, while a designated operator can adjust the contribution period start and end times for an active launch. A launch event must have a minimum contribution period of 24 hours and a maximum of 7 days, and a 5% fee on all successfully raised base tokens is automatically transferred to a designated treasury address upon launch finalization. The contract announces events for new launch creations, contributions received, project tokens claimed, and launch status changes.
source_description: Launchpad on KUB Chain

description: Specify a token contract based on Plur and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss creator funding platform, holding staked Ether and distributing native yield. It maintains records of individual user deposits, creator pools, and the allocation of yield to each pool. Callers can create a new creator pool, deposit Ether into an existing pool, withdraw their deposited Ether, and claim their accumulated yield and bonus rewards. A designated operator can set the bonus reward rate and update the external yield source address. A newly created pool must have a minimum initial deposit of 0.1 Ether, and a 5% fee is applied to all claimed yield. The contract emits events when Ether is deposited, Ether is withdrawn, yield is claimed, and a new pool is created.
source_description: Plur is a platform for backing creators with no loss. You can create pools to earn native yield from the ETH staked by your followers and gain extra PLUR & Blast points.

description: Define a token contract based on Velvet V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user investment portfolios, holding various tokens and potentially other financial instruments. It maintains individual user portfolio balances, a global list of supported assets, and configuration parameters for fees and operational limits. Callers can deposit tokens into their portfolios, withdraw tokens, rebalance their portfolio allocations, and transfer portfolio ownership to another address. A designated operator can add or remove supported assets, adjust trading fees, and pause all user operations in an emergency. The maximum number of supported assets is capped at 50, and a 0.1% management fee is applied annually to the total value of each portfolio, deducted monthly. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, portfolio rebalances, and changes to the supported asset list.
source_description: Velvet Capital is a social trading terminal for non-custodial crypto trading — spot, perpetual futures (perps) and yield strategies on Robinhood Chain, Solana, Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Hyperliquid, Ink, Monad, Sonic and other chains. Its social layer includes a wallet tracker for following top traders and smart-money flows, alongside AI trading agent for token research and onchain analysis. Trades route through aggregated DEX liquidity with MEV protection and advanced order types (limit orders, TP/SL), executing from users' own wallets

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Futarchy AMM and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of new protocol tokens by allowing users to deposit a base currency in exchange for these new tokens, effectively bootstrapping a new decentralized autonomous organization. It maintains a pool of deposited base currency, a record of each user's deposited amount and corresponding token allocation, and a configurable exchange rate for the new tokens. Callers can deposit base currency to mint new tokens, withdraw their deposited base currency if the project fails to meet a minimum funding threshold, and claim their vested new tokens after a specified period. A designated operator can set the initial exchange rate for the new tokens, and initiate the project's launch after the minimum funding threshold is met. The initial exchange rate is fixed at 1000 new tokens per 1 unit of base currency, and the minimum funding threshold is 5000 units of base currency. The contract announces when a deposit is made, when a withdrawal occurs, and when the project is successfully launched.
source_description: Raise money while putting ownership into the hands of your early users and believers.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Tigris Mezo V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding deposited tokens within concentrated liquidity pools. It maintains records for each liquidity position, including deposited amounts, earned fees, and the price range for which liquidity is provided, along with global pool configurations like swap fees. Callers can create new liquidity positions, add or remove liquidity from existing positions, swap tokens within a pool, and claim accumulated fees. A designated operator is privileged to adjust swap fees for a pool, add new token pairs, and pause all trading activity. Swap fees are capped at 1% of the swapped amount, and a minimum of 100 base tokens must be deposited to create a new liquidity position. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, swaps, and fee claims to observers.
source_description: A concentrated liquidity DEX based on Velodrome Slipstream

description: Define a token contract based on StakeEase and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for aggregating multiple liquid restaking tokens (LRTs) into a single, diversified position. It maintains a record of each user's deposited LRTs, the total amount of each LRT held in the vault, and the current configuration parameters. Callers can deposit supported LRTs into the vault, withdraw their deposited LRTs, and redeem their share of the aggregated position for underlying LRTs. Only a designated operator can add new supported LRTs, update the redemption fee, or pause deposits. The vault charges a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, and a maximum of 10 different LRTs can be supported at any given time. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, redemptions, and changes to the supported LRTs or redemption fee.
source_description: StakeEase is a restaking index platform designed to unify the fragmented liquid restaking landscape. By consolidating multiple LRTs into a single vault, StakeEase simplifies the restaking experience for the user, gives them access to diversified rewards, opens up new yield-generating avenues, and reduces LRT fragmentation in the L2s.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on FootballManager and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages player NFT assets and their associated training progress within a strategic gaming ecosystem. It maintains individual player records including their unique identifier, current statistics (e.g., speed, strength), and accumulated training points, alongside a global configuration for training costs and experience thresholds. Callers can acquire new player NFTs, initiate training sessions for their players, and transfer player NFTs to other accounts. Only a designated operator can mint new player NFTs and adjust the global training cost, which is capped at 0.05 units of the platform's native token per training session. Training sessions require a minimum of 10 accumulated training points to be consumed. The contract announces player NFT transfers and the completion of training sessions.
source_description: Football Manager is a new generation of strategy GameFi based on Arbitrum.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Koral Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield vault that custodies stablecoins deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, the total stablecoins held, and the current yield strategy configuration. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their deposited stablecoins, and claim accumulated yield. A designated operator can update the active yield strategy and adjust the withdrawal fee. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins and charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events.
source_description: Koral Finance is a vault that helps users access yield opportunities in the Sui ecosystem. Koral's technology enables the execution of high-performance yield strategies while ensuring safety and low risk based on underlying assets that are stablecoins such as: Circle USD (USDC), Tether (USDT), Agora USD (AUSD) and First Digital USD (FDUSD)

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on BlackRock BUIDL and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized fund representing fractional ownership of a portfolio of short-term US Treasury bills and repurchase agreements, acting as a digital custodian for these underlying assets. It maintains individual balances for each token holder, a total supply of tokens, and a daily net asset value (NAV) per token. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new fund tokens, redeem fund tokens for stablecoins, and transfer their fund tokens to other addresses. Only a designated operator can update the daily NAV, pause or unpause deposits and redemptions, and set the redemption fee. A redemption fee of 0.05% is applied to all redemptions, and redemptions are subject to a 24-hour processing delay after the request is submitted. The contract announces all deposit and redemption events, including the amount of stablecoins involved and the number of tokens minted or burned.
source_description: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund

description: Outline a staking contract based on Benqi Staked Avax and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism for a base network asset, holding deposited base network assets and issuing a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a total amount of deposited base network assets, and a per-account balance of the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit base network assets to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw base network assets. A designated operator can adjust the staking yield rate, and the owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. A minimum deposit amount of 0.1 base network assets is enforced for all deposits, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the base network assets returned to the user. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and staking yield rate updates to observers.
source_description: Stake AVAX on BENQI's Liquid Staking Protocol and freely utilize it within powerful Decentralized Financial applications.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Fluxion Network and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's concentrated liquidity pools, custodying deposited tokens for trading pairs.
