It maintains per-pool records of token reserves, tick ranges, and liquidity depth, alongside per-user records of active positions and their associated liquidity. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, add liquidity to existing positions, remove liquidity from positions, and swap tokens between pairs. Only a designated operator can adjust global trading fees, add new whitelisted token pairs, or pause trading for specific pools. A maximum of 100 distinct liquidity positions are allowed per user, and the protocol charges a fixed 0.25% trading fee on all swaps. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps as events, including the affected pool, user, and token amounts.
source_description: A RWA-optimized Native DEX on Mantle. AMM v2/v3 and order book hybrid, 24/7 full cycle RWA trading experience with low slippage.

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Optimism Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the transfer of Ether and ERC-20 tokens between a Layer 1 blockchain and a Layer 2 blockchain, holding deposited assets in escrow on Layer 1. It maintains a mapping of Layer 1 transaction hashes to Layer 2 transaction hashes for withdrawals, and a configuration for the Layer 2 system's state root. Callers can initiate a deposit of Ether or ERC-20 tokens to Layer 2, withdraw previously deposited assets from Layer 2 back to Layer 1, and prove the inclusion of a Layer 2 transaction in the Layer 2 state. A designated operator can update the Layer 2 system's state root, and only this operator can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. A withdrawal request must wait a minimum of 7 days after the Layer 2 transaction is proven on Layer 1 before the funds can be claimed. The contract charges a fixed fee of 0.001 Ether for every withdrawal operation, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces the initiation of a deposit, the successful finalization of a withdrawal, and any updates to the Layer 2 state root.
source_description: Bridge between Optimism and Ethereum

description: Model a governance contract based on Service Nervous Systems and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the lifecycle and governance of a decentralized application, holding the application's native governance tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's staked token balance, their voting power, and the current state of active and pending governance proposals, along with a configuration for proposal submission and voting parameters. Callers can stake their tokens to gain voting power, unstake their tokens, submit new governance proposals, vote on active proposals, and execute proposals that have passed. A designated administrator can update core governance parameters like the minimum staking amount or proposal submission fee. Staking requires a minimum of 100 tokens, and unstaking incurs a 2% fee on the unstaked amount. The contract emits events for every token stake, unstake, proposal submission, vote cast, and successful proposal execution.
source_description: Service Nervous Systems (SNSs) are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that allow developers to hand over their dapps to decentralized, token-based governance systems. SNSs enable Web3 services to be owned and governed by their communities, evolving through proposals that respond to the desires, feedback, and voting of those communities.

description: Design a payments contract based on Retreeb and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a payment network's transaction fees and their distribution to social impact projects. It maintains a global fee percentage, a list of approved social impact projects with their respective funding allocations, and a ledger of all transactions including their associated fees and project contributions. Callers can initiate payments, claim their portion of collected fees if they are a designated project, and query their transaction history. The owner can set the global transaction fee, add or remove social impact projects, and adjust their funding allocations. The global transaction fee is fixed at 0.5% of the payment amount, and 33% of all collected fees are automatically allocated to the approved social impact projects. The contract emits an event when a payment is successfully processed and when funds are claimed by a project.
source_description: Retreeb is the first distributed payment solution that shares one third of its network fees to funding social and solidarity project

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Euler V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a lending market for a specific token, holding deposited tokens as collateral. It maintains individual account balances for deposits and borrows, a global pool of available liquidity, and market-specific configuration parameters like interest rates. Callers can deposit tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding borrows, withdraw their collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust market parameters such as interest rates and collateral factors, and pause borrowing or depositing in emergencies. The maximum collateral factor for any market is 90%, meaning borrowers can borrow up to 90% of the value of their collateral. A 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator's reward. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: Euler revolutionizes DeFi by letting any asset become collateral for a lending market. Lenders and borrowers get market leading risk-adjusted rates. Builders can create and manage markets exactly how they want them, with institutional-grade security.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Astro and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a provably fair prediction game where users bet on a multiplier reaching a certain value before a "crash" event. It custodies a stablecoin used for betting and payouts. The contract maintains a global game state including the current round number, the crash multiplier for the previous round, and a pool of stablecoin for house liquidity. For each player, it tracks their current bet amount, their chosen cash-out multiplier, and their stablecoin balance. Callers can place a bet, cash out their active bet, or withdraw their available stablecoin balance. A designated operator can initiate new game rounds and set the outcome of a round. The minimum bet amount is 10 stablecoins, and the house takes a 1% fee on all winning bets. The contract announces the start of a new round, the crash multiplier of a completed round, and player bet placements and cash-outs.
source_description: Astro is a provably fair crash game that settles in USDG. Users can either play or deposit and hold ASTROLP shares to take the House side

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on VersaGames and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native token, holding a reserve for game rewards and platform operations. It tracks each player's token balance, their accumulated reward points, and the current reward rate configuration. Callers can deposit tokens into the platform, withdraw their tokens, claim accumulated reward points, and stake tokens to earn additional rewards. Only a designated operator can adjust the reward rate, mint new tokens up to a daily cap, and pause all token transfers. The maximum daily token minting is capped at 10,000 tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all token withdrawals. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, rewards are claimed, and the reward rate is updated.
source_description: NFT Gaming Platform powered by $VERSA token. Join the future of Web 3.0 Gaming

description: Specify a staking contract based on Meta Pool ETH and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to deposit a base asset and receive a liquid staking token representing their staked position, while also holding the deposited base assets in escrow. The contract maintains a record of each user's deposited base asset balance, their corresponding liquid staking token balance, and a global pool of staked base assets, alongside configuration parameters like the staking fee and the reward rate. Callers can deposit base assets to mint liquid staking tokens, withdraw their staked base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. The owner can set the staking fee, adjust the reward rate, and designate an operator who can pause deposits and withdrawals in emergencies. A staking fee of 5% is applied to all rewards distributed, and a minimum deposit of 0.01 base assets is required for staking. The contract announces events for successful deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and changes to the staking fee or reward rate.
source_description: Meta Pool is a liquid staking protocol built on the NEAR and Ethereum blockchain.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on BetHash and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction game based on future block hashes, holding user wagers in an escrow pool. It maintains individual user balances, active game rounds with their associated wagers, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can place a wager on the parity of a future block hash, claim winnings from past rounds, and withdraw their available balance. Only the owner can set the wager amount, the game duration in blocks, and the commission percentage. The minimum wager is 0.01 ether and the commission on winnings is 5%. The contract emits an event when a new game round begins, when a wager is placed, and when winnings are claimed.
source_description: BetHash.io uses blockchain hash value to draw the game results to guarantee absolute fairness.

description: Design an NFT contract based on HoneyPlay Marketplace and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the trading of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) from designated collections, holding listed NFTs in escrow during active listings. It maintains a record of all active listings, including the seller, the NFT identifier, the asking price, and any active bids for each listed NFT. Callers can list an NFT for sale, make an offer on a listed NFT, accept an offer, cancel their own listing, and withdraw an NFT they previously listed if it has not been sold. Only a designated operator can add or remove approved NFT collections for listing. A listing fee of 0.02 ether is charged upon successful sale, and the maximum number of active listings per seller is 100. The contract announces when an NFT is listed, when an offer is made, when an offer is accepted, and when a listing is canceled.
source_description: Trade, bid, and list NFTs across all HoneyPlay collections.

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Circle USYC and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of tokenized short-term debt instruments, representing exposure to US Treasury bills and repurchase agreements. It maintains individual account balances for each user's share of the pooled assets, along with a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can deposit supported stablecoins into the pool, redeem their shares for stablecoins, and transfer their shares to other accounts. A designated operator can pause and unpause all deposit and redemption operations, and can adjust the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount. A minimum deposit of 1000 units of stablecoin is required for new deposits. The contract announces all deposit, redemption, and transfer events to observers.
source_description: Circle USYC is a regulated DeFi platform with permissioned smart contracts, on-chain transparency, and customizable investment strategies for optimized risk-reward profiles. USYC is a Hashnote product which provides exposure to short duration US Treasuries and Reverse Repo on US Treasuries

description: Specify a payments contract based on Kivach and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates donations to open-source projects and automatically distributes a portion of those donations to their dependencies. It custodies donated cryptocurrency tokens. The contract maintains a registry of projects, each with a designated wallet address, a list of dependent projects, and a configurable distribution ratio for each dependency. Callers can donate to a project, register a new project, update a project's wallet address, add or remove a dependency for a project, and adjust the distribution ratio for a dependency. Only the owner can register new projects, update project wallet addresses, or modify dependency relationships and ratios. A project's distribution ratio to any single dependency must be between 1% and 50%, and the sum of all distribution ratios for a project cannot exceed 80%. The contract announces when a donation is received and when funds are distributed to a project or its dependencies.
source_description: Support open-source projects with donations in crypto, and they will automatically forward a part of your donation to other open-source projects that made them possible

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on MoneyOnChain and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin pegged to a fiat currency, holding a reserve of a major cryptocurrency to back its value. It maintains individual stablecoin balances for each user, a total reserve balance of the backing cryptocurrency, and a global configuration for fees and parameters. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing the backing cryptocurrency, redeem stablecoins for the backing cryptocurrency, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. Only a designated operator can adjust the stablecoin's peg ratio to the backing cryptocurrency and set the maximum daily minting limit. The minting fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited amount, and the maximum daily minting volume is capped at 1,000,000 stablecoins. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Money On Chain is a self-contained DeFi protocol (a stablecoin, HODL token, leveraging mechanism, and more) which empowers Bitcoiners to improve performance of their assets while also retaining full control of their private keys.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on KUMA Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for interest-bearing tokens, specifically designed to hold and manage deposit receipts representing regulated non-fungible tokens (NFTs) backed by real-world assets. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount of the interest-bearing token, the total supply of the vault's own fungible token, and a configuration for the annual interest rate. Callers can deposit interest-bearing tokens to receive vault tokens, withdraw their deposited interest-bearing tokens by burning vault tokens, and redeem their vault tokens for the underlying interest-bearing tokens plus accrued interest. A designated operator can adjust the annual interest rate, which is initially set at 5.00% and can be changed by a maximum of 0.50% in any 24-hour period. The contract emits an event when a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the interest rate is updated.
source_description: The KUMA Protocol is a decentralized protocol issuing interest-bearing tokens backed by regulated NFTs, themselves backed by Real World Assets (RWA). At start the KUMA Protocol accepts regulated KUMA NFTs that are backed by sovereign bonds

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Byzanlink RWA Markets and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for tokenized real-world assets, holding various ERC-20 tokens representing fractional ownership in yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their share of the vault, and the total value of assets under management, along with configuration parameters for each strategy. Users can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their share of the underlying assets, and claim accrued yield. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, update strategy parameters, and initiate rebalancing operations. The vault imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions, and a maximum of 10 new strategies can be added per month. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, yield claims, and strategy additions.
source_description: Byzanlink RWA Markets is a decentralised, non-custodial RWA yield platform where users access curated tokenised real-world yield strategies through standardised onchain vaults.

description: Model a payments contract based on Gitcoin and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a public goods funding round, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing them to approved projects. It maintains a registry of approved projects, their funding requests, and the total stablecoin balance available for distribution, along with a record of each contributor's stablecoin deposits. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the round, register a new project for consideration, and claim their allocated stablecoin funds if their project is approved. A designated operator can approve or reject project registrations, set the maximum funding amount for any single project, and initiate the distribution of funds to approved projects. The maximum funding amount for any single project is 100,000 stablecoins. A 2% fee is automatically deducted from all stablecoin deposits and directed to a pre-configured treasury address. The contract announces when a new project is registered, when a project is approved or rejected, and when funds are distributed to a project.
source_description: Empowering communities to fund, build, & protect what matters

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Merlins Seal and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking mechanism for a new governance token launch, custodying deposited fungible tokens. It maintains individual user deposit balances, accumulated reward points for each staker, and a global configuration for reward point accrual rates. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim their accumulated reward points. The contract owner can set the reward point accrual rate and designate an address to distribute the new governance tokens. A minimum deposit of 100 units of the fungible token is required for each deposit. Reward points accrue at a rate of 1 point per 10 units of deposited fungible token per day. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, a withdrawal occurs, or reward points are claimed.
source_description: Merlin's Seal is an event associated with the Merlin Chain, focusing on the fair launch of its governance token, $MERL. Users stake assets to earn M-points, which are then used to determine the distribution of $MERL rewards

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on AnyHedge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged long and short positions on an underlying asset, holding the collateral for these positions. It maintains individual position records, each tracking the collateral amount, the leverage ratio, the position's direction (long or short), and its opening price. Callers can open new positions, add collateral to existing positions, close positions, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can update the external price oracle's address and adjust the liquidation threshold. New positions require a minimum collateral of 0.01 units of the base asset, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract announces position openings, closures, and liquidations, including the position identifier and relevant financial details.
source_description: AnyHedge allows users to take leveraged long or short positions against main-chain BCH. It is permissionless, non-custodial, and on-chain. The contracts are fully funded on creation and have no counterparty risk. The risks are early liquidation, slippage, and oracle risks.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Sigmausd and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized stablecoin protocol that custodies a reserve cryptocurrency and issues two tokens: a stable token pegged to a fiat currency and a reserve token that absorbs volatility. It maintains a global reserve pool of the reserve cryptocurrency, a total supply for both the stable token and the reserve token, and a configuration for various parameters. Callers can mint stable tokens by depositing the reserve cryptocurrency, redeem stable tokens for the reserve cryptocurrency, mint reserve tokens by depositing the reserve cryptocurrency, and redeem reserve tokens for the reserve cryptocurrency. A designated operator is privileged to adjust the oracle price feed for the reserve cryptocurrency and update system parameters. The stable token always maintains a minimum collateralization ratio of 400% by the reserve cryptocurrency, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stable token redemption operations. The contract announces the current reserve ratio, the total supply of both tokens, and the current oracle price of the reserve cryptocurrency.
source_description: AgeUSD is a novel crypto-backed algorithmic stablecoin protocol that has been created in joint partnership by the Ergo Foundation, EMURGO, and IOG on top of the Ergo Blockchain.

description: Model a staking contract based on Liquid Collective and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies staked Ether. It maintains a global pool of staked Ether, a record of each user's deposited Ether, and their corresponding liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit Ether to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for a pro-rata share of staked Ether, and claim rewards. A designated operator can initiate staking of deposited Ether and unstake Ether from the underlying validator set. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 Ether and charges a 10% fee on all staking rewards, which is distributed to the protocol's treasury. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: Liquid Collective is a non-custodial staking protocol launched on Ethereum. Liquid Collective is built and run by a collective of leading web3 teams. The protocol was initially launched in 2023.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Bucket Farm and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield farm that custodies deposits of a single designated ERC-20 token. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, a global reward pool of a second designated ERC-20 token, and a configuration for the reward rate. Callers can deposit the designated deposit token, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim their accumulated rewards. Only the owner may set the reward rate, update the designated reward token address, or pause all deposits and withdrawals. The maximum reward rate is 1000 reward tokens per block, and the initial deposit token address is fixed upon deployment. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events.
source_description: Deposit tokens to earn $DROPS token for the upcoming token $BUT

description: Model a lending protocol based on Rhea Lend and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a pool-based lending facility that custodies supplied digital assets. It maintains records of individual user deposits, outstanding loans, collateral ratios, and global pool-specific configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can supply assets to earn interest, borrow against their supplied collateral, repay loans, and withdraw their unencumbered deposits. A designated operator can adjust interest rate models and liquidation parameters. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrowed asset is 75%, and a 0.05% origination fee is applied to all new loans. The contract announces all supply, borrow, repay, and withdraw actions, including the affected user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Rhea Lending is a decentralized, non-custodial, pool-based interest rates platform that enables users to supply assets to earn interest, and to borrow against them to unlock liquidity. Burrow is similar in nature to Aave, Compound, and other pool-based protocols.

description: Design a privacy-preserving contract based on Nata Network and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private, cross-chain asset transfers by holding deposited assets in escrow. It maintains a record of each deposit's unique identifier, the asset deposited, the deposit amount, and the recipient's shielded address. Callers can deposit assets, provide proofs to withdraw assets to a shielded address, and emergency withdraw their own assets if a withdrawal fails. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals, and set the withdrawal fee. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.05 units of the deposited asset. The maximum deposit amount for any single transaction is 10,000 units of the deposited asset. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and emergency withdrawal, detailing the transaction's unique identifier, the asset, and the amount.
source_description: A cross-chain privacy protocol built using LayerZero and Aztec.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Polygon zkEVM Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers between an Ethereum-based network and a zero-knowledge rollup network, holding transferred tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a mapping of asset addresses to their corresponding rollup network addresses, a record of each pending deposit including the recipient and amount, and a configurable withdrawal delay for each asset. Callers can initiate a deposit of supported tokens from the Ethereum-based network to a specified address on the rollup network, and can claim a withdrawal on the Ethereum-based network after a corresponding burn on the rollup network. A designated operator can add new supported tokens, update the rollup network address for an existing token, and set the withdrawal delay for any token. The maximum withdrawal delay for any asset is 7 days, and a deposit must be at least 100 units of the deposited token. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, indicating the sender, recipient on the rollup network, token, and amount.
source_description: Transfer assets between Polygon zkEVM and Ethereum

description: Define a governance contract based on OpenEden PRISM and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic yield token, representing diversified exposure to various yield-generating strategies, and custodies underlying yield-bearing assets. It maintains each user's balance of the synthetic token, the total supply of the synthetic token, and a list of approved underlying asset strategies with their current allocations. Callers can deposit approved underlying assets to mint new synthetic tokens, redeem synthetic tokens for a proportional share of the underlying assets, and transfer synthetic tokens to other users. Only a designated operator can add or remove approved underlying asset strategies, adjust the allocation of assets to each strategy, and set the redemption fee. A redemption fee of 0.5% is applied to all redemptions, and the total allocation across all strategies must always sum to 100%. The contract announces events for token transfers, deposits, redemptions, and changes to strategy allocations.
source_description: PRISM (OpenEden Multi Strategy Yield Token) is a synthetic, multi-strategy yield token

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Defa By InvoiceMate and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the lifecycle of tokenized real-world trade receivables, holding stablecoins deposited by liquidity providers. It maintains a registry of all issued receivable tokens, each linked to its underlying stablecoin collateral, and tracks the total stablecoin balance available for lending. Callers can deposit stablecoins to become liquidity providers, withdraw their stablecoin deposits, and redeem receivable tokens for stablecoins once matured. Designated operators can issue new receivable tokens against verified real-world assets, approve specific receivable tokens for redemption, and pause or unpause all contract operations. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all stablecoin withdrawals, and a receivable token can only be redeemed after its maturity date has passed. The contract emits an event whenever stablecoins are deposited, whenever stablecoins are withdrawn, and whenever a new receivable token is issued.
source_description: DeFa by InvoiceMate is a full-stack RWAFi protocol that transforms verified trade receivables into liquid, yield-bearing assets and connects liquidity providers with stable & secured yield backed by real-world economic activity.

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Etherfuse and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages tokenized real-world assets, specifically fixed-income debt instruments, and custodies the underlying stablecoin collateral. It maintains a record of each user's bond holdings, the total outstanding tokenized bonds, and a configuration for accepted collateral types. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new bond tokens, transfer bond tokens to other accounts, and redeem bond tokens for the underlying stablecoin collateral. A designated operator can pause minting and redemption, and the owner can set the collateralization ratio and update the list of approved collateral tokens. The collateralization ratio for minting new bonds is fixed at 100%, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces events for bond token minting, redemption, and transfers.
source_description: Stablebonds are tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) backed by government-issued bonds from stable economies such as the USA, Mexico, and the European Union.

description: Model a governance contract based on Aera V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized autonomous organization's treasury, holding various ERC-20 tokens and potentially other digital assets. It maintains records of approved investment strategies, each with a unique identifier, and tracks the current allocation of treasury funds across these strategies. Callers can propose new investment strategies, deposit funds into existing strategies, withdraw funds from strategies, and redeem their share of strategy returns. Only a designated operator can approve new strategies, pause or unpause existing strategies, and set the maximum allowable capital for any single strategy. A new strategy proposal must be open for community review for at least 48 hours before it can be approved. The maximum capital allocated to any single strategy cannot exceed 25% of the total treasury value. The contract announces events for strategy approvals, fund deposits, fund withdrawals, and strategy pauses.
source_description: Autonomous onchain treasury management protocol for DAOs, built by the team at Gauntlet.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Merchant Moe Liquidity Book and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquidity book automated market maker that custodies pairs of fungible tokens, allowing users to swap between them. It maintains per-pool records of token reserves, a list of active price bins, and per-user liquidity positions within those bins. Callers can deposit liquidity into specific price bins, withdraw their deposited liquidity, and swap one token for another. Only the owner can set the swap fee, which is initially 0.25% and can be changed within a range of 0.01% to 1.00%. The contract emits events for all liquidity deposits, withdrawals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected price bins.
source_description: Liquidity Book is an AMM on Merchant Moe offering low-cost trading, higher fee potential for providers, and requires less capital. It features zero slippage, surge pricing, and high efficiency

description: Design a governance contract based on Grove Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a capital allocation vault for a decentralized autonomous organization, holding various tokenized real-world assets, interest-bearing deposit receipts, and liquidity provider tokens. It maintains a record of each member's deposited capital, their allocated voting power, and the current configuration of investment strategies. Callers can deposit capital, withdraw their allocated capital, propose new investment strategies, and vote on active proposals. A designated operator can execute approved investment strategies, update the list of approved real-world asset providers, and set the fee for withdrawals. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and new investment strategies require a minimum of 60% of the total voting power to pass. The contract announces when new investment strategies are proposed, when proposals pass or fail, and when capital is deployed or redeemed.
source_description: Grove is a capital allocation protocol within the Sky (formerly MakerDAO) ecosystem, launched June 2025. It deploys capital into tokenized RWA assets, Aave lending, Morpho vaults, and Curve LP positions across Ethereum, Base, Avalanche, and Plume

description: Model an NFT contract based on Sweep n Flip and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the automated trading of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and custodies both NFTs and fungible tokens used for purchases. It maintains individual user balances of fungible tokens, a global fungible token reserve, and specific buy and sell orders for each supported NFT collection, including their current price and available quantity. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, create a new NFT buy order, create a new NFT sell order, fill an existing buy order, fill an existing sell order, and withdraw their fungible tokens. Only a designated operator can add new NFT collections for trading and adjust the trading fee. A trading fee of 0.5% is applied to all successful NFT trades, and the maximum number of NFTs that can be bought or sold in a single order is 100. The contract announces successful NFT purchases, successful NFT sales, and changes to the trading fee.
source_description: Sweep n' Flip is increasing liquidity and volume of NFT collections through a powerful AMM with simple UI/UX.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Juicebox V1 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates community-funded projects by accepting contributions of a designated base currency and managing a corresponding project token supply. It maintains a record of each contributor's base currency balance and their proportional share of the project's total token supply, along with a global configuration for the project. Callers can contribute base currency to the project, claim their accrued project tokens, and redeem project tokens for a pro-rata share of the remaining base currency. A designated project owner can configure the project's funding cycle parameters, withdraw accumulated base currency, and mint additional project tokens. The project owner can set a maximum funding duration of 90 days for any single funding cycle. A 5% fee is applied to all contributions, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces when a new funding cycle begins, when contributions are made, and when project tokens are claimed or redeemed.
source_description: The programmable crypto fundraising protocol for builders and creators. Light enough for a group of friends, powerful enough for a global network of anons. Community-owned, on Ethereum

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Invesco USTB and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized fund representing ownership in a portfolio of short-duration government securities, and it custodies no assets directly, instead tracking ownership of an off-chain fund. It maintains per-account balances of fund units, a total supply of fund units, and a daily net asset value per unit. Callers can subscribe to the fund by depositing a stablecoin, redeem fund units for stablecoin, and transfer fund units to other accounts. A designated operator can update the daily net asset value and pause or unpause subscriptions and redemptions. Subscriptions and redemptions are processed daily at 5 PM UTC, and a 0.10% fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces subscription events, redemption events, and daily net asset value updates.
source_description: The Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund (the Fund) offers Accredited Investors and Qualified Purchasers access to short-duration Treasury Bills. The Fund's investment objective is to seek current income as is consistent with liquidity and stability of principal. Ownership in the Fund is represented by USTB, held either as a token or in book-entry record keeping. Subscriptions and redemptions are facilitated through USD or USDC, with liquidity each market day.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on PandaLand and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital assets representing in-game items and their associated metadata, holding no custodial funds. It maintains a record of each asset's current owner, its unique identifier, and a URI pointing to its off-chain metadata, alongside a global counter for total assets minted and a mapping of approved operators for each asset owner. Callers can mint new assets, transfer ownership of an asset to another account, approve an operator to manage a specific asset on their behalf, or approve an operator to manage all their assets. Only a designated minter role can create new assets, and only the contract owner can assign or revoke the minter role. A maximum of 10,000 assets can ever be minted by this contract. Each successful asset transfer will emit an event detailing the previous owner, the new owner, and the asset's unique identifier.
source_description: Pandaland is a blockchain game interactive platform based on SmartBCH. It starts with games and will gradually expand to NFT exchanges, NFT staking, DEX, and more.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Meteora DLMM and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity pools for token pairs, holding deposited tokens as reserves. It maintains per-pool records including token addresses, current prices, and liquidity bin configurations, along with per-user positions detailing their deposited amounts and active bins. Callers can deposit tokens to create or add to a liquidity position, withdraw their liquidity and accrued fees, and swap tokens within a pool. A designated operator can adjust pool parameters like fee tiers and bin widths, and pause trading in an emergency. The maximum number of active bins per pool is 100, and a 0.05% swap fee is applied to all trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and successful swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected user.
source_description: Meteora's DLMM introduces a zero-slippage, bin-based concentrated liquidity AMM on Solana, enhancing LP profitability with dynamic fees and enabling precise liquidity strategies and shapes for deeper market liquidity

description: Model a token contract based on Domani Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of tokenized portfolios, holding deposited base tokens as collateral. It maintains a record of each portfolio's constituent tokens and their target weights, the total supply of each portfolio token, and a global configuration for fees and minimum deposit amounts. Callers can create new portfolio types, deposit base tokens to mint portfolio tokens, redeem portfolio tokens for their underlying base tokens, and transfer portfolio tokens. Only a designated operator can adjust the global minting fee, which is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited value, or update the minimum deposit amount for any portfolio type, which is set to a minimum of 100 units of the base token. The contract announces events for portfolio creation, token minting, and token redemption, including the portfolio identifier, the amount of tokens involved, and the address of the interacting caller.
source_description: Empowering anyone to mint, trade and redeem non-custodial oracle-less tokenized portfolios.

description: Design a token contract based on Hot Takes and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social impact fund, holding deposited base tokens and distributing them to approved projects. It maintains a record of each user's total deposited amount, the current balance of the fund, and a list of approved project addresses with their allocated funding caps. Callers can deposit base tokens into the fund, propose new projects for funding, and claim their allocated funds if they are an approved project. Only the owner can approve new projects, set the funding cap for an approved project, and pause or unpause deposits. A minimum deposit of 10 base tokens is required for any deposit operation. Approved projects can claim up to their allocated funding cap, and a 1% fee is applied to all claimed funds, which is sent to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when new projects are approved, when funds are deposited, and when funds are claimed.
source_description: The Hottest SoFi Platform in Web3

description: Outline a price oracle contract based on Mycelia Signal and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates on-demand, verifiable data retrieval by acting as a payment gateway for external data providers. It custodies user deposits of a stablecoin, held in individual user balances. The contract maintains a mapping of user addresses to their deposited stablecoin amounts and a single, global data request fee. Callers can deposit stablecoins into their balance, withdraw any available balance, and request data by paying the current fee. A designated administrator is privileged to set the data request fee and to update the public key used for signature verification. The data request fee must be a positive integer, and the maximum deposit allowed per user is 10,000 stablecoins. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and data requests, along with the current data request fee whenever it is updated.
source_description: Sovereign HTTP oracle serving Ed25519-signed market data via x402 (USDC on Base, pay-per-call). 131 endpoints covering crypto prices, FX, commodities, US/EU macro indicators, volatility surfaces, and structured products. No API keys, no token, no subscriptions — every response is independently verifiable against a published public key

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Kanvas and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for non-fungible tokens and custodies deposited tokens and non-fungible tokens awaiting sale or transfer. It maintains a record of listed non-fungible tokens with their prices and sellers, and a balance of fungible tokens held for each user. Callers can list a non-fungible token for sale, purchase a listed non-fungible token, cancel a listing, and withdraw their fungible token balance. A designated operator can pause all listing and purchasing activities and update the marketplace fee percentage. The marketplace charges a 2.5% fee on all successful non-fungible token sales, deducted from the seller's proceeds. A non-fungible token listing remains active for a maximum of 30 days unless purchased or canceled. The contract announces when a non-fungible token is listed, purchased, or a listing is canceled.
source_description: Kanvas is the first NFT marketplace on Kava EVM and combines DeFi principles with NFTs. We plan on being an NFT marketplace, launchpad, and incubator that aims to expand the bounds of what is possible with NFTs.

description: Define a payments contract based on Exa Card and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages credit lines backed by deposited collateral, enabling users to spend against their crypto assets. It maintains individual user credit positions, including deposited collateral amounts, outstanding debt, and available credit limits, alongside global configuration parameters like interest rates and collateralization ratios. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust global interest rates, update approved collateral tokens, and pause all borrowing operations in an emergency. The minimum collateralization ratio for any active credit line is 150%, and the maximum annual interest rate is 20%. The contract emits events for every deposit, borrow, repayment, and withdrawal, and for every change to the global interest rate or collateralization ratio.
source_description: The Exa Card is a Visa-linked crypto credit/debit card integrated with the Exactly Protocol and Exa App that lets users spend crypto or take onchain credit against crypto collateral, enabling payment anywhere Visa is accepted

description: Model an NFT contract based on Vexy and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace aggregator for non-fungible tokens representing vote-escrowed positions, holding deposited non-fungible tokens in escrow. It maintains a global configuration for marketplace fees, a record of all listed non-fungible tokens including their current asking price, and a record of all outstanding global buy offers for specific non-fungible token types. Callers can list their non-fungible tokens for sale, make global buy offers for any non-fungible token type, accept an offer for their listed non-fungible token, and withdraw their non-fungible tokens if unlisted or their offer funds if unmatched. The owner can set the marketplace fee percentage and designate operators who can pause or unpause trading activity. The marketplace fee is fixed at 0.5% of the sale price, and global buy offers must be at least 0.01 ether. The contract announces when a non-fungible token is listed, when a global buy offer is made, and when a sale is completed.
source_description: Vexy is a specialized NFT marketplace aggregator for vote‑escrowed tokens (like veAERO and veVELO), enabling unified listings, global buy offers, and smooth custodial workflows across Base and Optimism

description: Outline a payments contract based on LlamaPay and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates automated, continuous token streams between accounts, holding deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains per-sender records of active streams, including the recipient, the token being streamed, the total amount to stream, the start time, and the per-second rate, along with a total balance of each token held in the contract. Callers can create new streams, deposit tokens into existing streams, and recipients can withdraw their accrued stream amounts. Only the contract owner can pause all streaming activity or update the global streaming fee. A stream cannot be created for less than 100 units of the streaming token, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces stream creation, stream deposits, and stream withdrawals.
source_description: LlamaPay is a multi-chain protocol that allows you to automate transactions and stream them by the second. The recipients can withdraw these funds at any time. This eliminates the need for manual transactions

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on VaultWin and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss lottery, holding deposited funds in an interest-bearing vault. It maintains a record of each participant's current deposit amount and the total pooled funds, along with a configurable lottery duration. Callers can deposit funds into the current lottery round, withdraw their deposited funds at any time, and claim their prize if they are the winner of a completed round. A designated operator can start new lottery rounds, select the winner of a completed round, and update the interest-bearing vault address. Each lottery round must last exactly 7 days, and the operator may only select a winner after the round duration has elapsed. The contract announces the start of new lottery rounds, the winner of each round, and the amount of any prize awarded.
source_description: VaultWin is a non-custodial lottery game where participants have the opportunity to win a prize without any risk. Regardless of the lottery outcome, your funds are always safely returned to you

description: Outline an NFT contract based on manifold.xyz and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables creators to mint and manage unique digital assets, acting as a registry for these assets and their associated metadata. It maintains a record of each digital asset's creator, current owner, and a URI pointing to its off-chain metadata, along with a global fee configuration. Callers can mint new digital assets, transfer ownership of their owned assets, and approve other accounts to transfer their assets. Only the designated owner of the contract can set the global minting fee and designate an operator account. The minting fee is fixed at 0.005 Ether per asset, and a creator can mint a maximum of 100 assets per transaction. The contract announces when a new digital asset is minted, when its ownership changes, and when an approval for transfer is granted.
source_description: Create, share, and sell your work with the best creator tools for Ethereum, Base and Farcaster

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Mento V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for stable value assets, holding reserves of various tokens. It maintains a registry of supported stable tokens, their corresponding reserve tokens, and per-pair exchange configurations including a target price and a deviation tolerance. Callers can exchange one supported token for another, deposit reserve tokens to increase liquidity, and withdraw reserve tokens. A designated operator can add new stable token pairs, update exchange parameters for existing pairs, and pause all exchange operations. The maximum deviation from the target price allowed for any exchange is 0.5%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all exchange operations, directed to a treasury. The contract announces successful exchanges, liquidity additions, and liquidity withdrawals.
source_description: Mento, an open source and permissionless protocol live on the Celo network. It facilitates the launch of stablecoins such as cUSD, cEUR, and cREAL

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Scroll Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the transfer of an arbitrary fungible token between a Layer 1 blockchain and a Layer 2 blockchain, holding deposited tokens in escrow on Layer 1. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance awaiting withdrawal on Layer 2, and a mapping of unique message identifiers to their processing status. Callers can deposit tokens to be bridged, initiate a withdrawal of their tokens from Layer 2 back to Layer 1, and claim their withdrawn tokens on Layer 1 after a successful Layer 2 withdrawal. A designated relayer can finalize a Layer 2 withdrawal on Layer 1 by providing proof of the Layer 2 transaction. The owner can set the fee for withdrawals and pause deposits. The maximum deposit amount per transaction is 100,000 tokens, and the withdrawal fee is 0.05% of the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, when a withdrawal is initiated, and when a withdrawal is finalized.
source_description: Transfer assets between Scroll and Ethereum

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on CANA Holdings California Carbon Credits and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized representation of real-world environmental assets, specifically carbon allowances, and it custodies no digital assets directly. It maintains a total supply of tokens, individual account balances, and a configurable price floor for the token. Callers can acquire new tokens by depositing an approved stablecoin, transfer tokens to other accounts, and redeem tokens for the underlying real-world asset. A designated operator can adjust the price floor, pause token transfers, and initiate redemption of the underlying assets. The price floor will increase by 0.4% each month. A 0.5% fee is applied to all token redemptions. The contract announces all token transfers and price floor updates.
source_description: CANA gives DeFi users direct exposure to California Carbon Allowances—a $78B regulated commodity—with a CPI+5% rising price floor. Fully tradable ERC-20. Offers inflation protection, uncorrelated returns, and full DeFi composability

description: Create a token contract based on Mellow and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social media platform's core token, which represents a user's stake in creator communities. It maintains individual user balances of the platform token, a global supply of the token, and a mapping of creators to their associated community tokens. Callers can acquire platform tokens, transfer platform tokens to other users, stake platform tokens with a creator to receive community tokens, and unstake platform tokens to redeem their community tokens. Only a designated operator can mint new platform tokens, up to a maximum of 1,000,000 tokens per month. The staking fee is fixed at 0.5% of the staked amount, deducted from the platform tokens. The contract emits an event whenever platform tokens are transferred, staked, or unstaked.
source_description: Mellow is a new take on social media that connects creators and their communities

description: Create a payments contract based on Kolo Card and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin tokens to facilitate instant, on-chain settlements for off-chain digital asset spending. It maintains a total stablecoin balance, a record of each user's available spending limit, and a configuration for settlement fees. Callers can deposit stablecoins to increase their spending limit, initiate a spending settlement request, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can approve or reject settlement requests, and only the owner can update the settlement fee percentage or transfer ownership. Each settlement request incurs a 0.5% fee on the settled amount, and a user's total spending limit cannot exceed 10,000 stablecoins. The contract announces successful deposits, approved settlements, and rejected settlements.
source_description: Kolo Card is a crypto payment card and wallet for spending digital assets, with on-chain card settlements processed through Rain.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Arcus Perps and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates self-custodial peer-to-peer trading of tokenized real-world assets and perpetual futures, holding deposited collateral in various supported cryptocurrencies. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each trader, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and supported asset lists. Callers can deposit collateral, open new perpetual future positions, close existing positions, withdraw available collateral, and claim funding payments. Only a designated operator can adjust global trading parameters, add new tradable assets, or pause trading in emergencies. A maximum leverage of 20x is enforced for all perpetual future positions, and a trading fee of 0.05% of the notional value is applied to all trades. The contract broadcasts events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and funding payment settlements.
source_description: Built by the team behind dYdX in partnership with Robinhood Crypto. Arcus is a blockchain-based smart contract protocol that permits self-custodial peer-to-peer trading of Stock Tokens, cryptoassets and perpetual futures.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on dripit and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages prediction markets for artist hype scores, holding user stakes in an ERC-20 token. It maintains individual user balances, active market configurations including artist pairs and prediction windows, and the current state of each prediction, such as total staked for each outcome. Callers can create a new prediction, stake tokens on an artist to win, and claim winnings after a market concludes. A designated operator can initiate new prediction markets and resolve existing ones by providing the final hype scores. Each prediction market must have a minimum stake of 100 tokens, and a 5% fee is applied to all winnings, directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when a user stakes tokens, and when a market is resolved.
source_description: dripit is a niche-specific Prediction Market for Music. Markets(Battles) on dripit are powered by our Hypemeter data layer, which aggregates data from streaming platforms, social media & music discovery tools and distills that info to a single score, updated daily. Users speculate on the Hype score artists have on various timeframes, in weekly 1v1 Battles or monthly Hypeboard battles..

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Noon and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a yield optimization strategy, holding deposited stablecoins and their corresponding yield-bearing derivatives. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoins and their share of the strategy's total value, along with a global configuration for fees and strategy parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their share of stablecoins, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can rebalance the strategy's assets, update strategy parameters, and initiate emergency withdrawals. The owner can set the operator address and adjust the withdrawal fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. All withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay after the request is made. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and significant configuration changes.
source_description: Noon is a yield optimization protocol that generates delta-neutral returns, maximizes governance token utility, and ensures fair, sustainable value distribution

description: Model a smart account contract based on Base App and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user-owned digital asset accounts, holding various fungible tokens and non-fungible tokens on behalf of individual users. It maintains per-user balances for each fungible token and a list of non-fungible tokens owned by each user. Callers can deposit tokens into their account, transfer tokens to another user's account, and withdraw tokens from their account to an external address. A designated operator can pause all transfer and withdrawal operations. The maximum number of non-fungible tokens a single user account can hold is 100. All withdrawals incur a fixed fee of 0.01 units of the withdrawn token, which is sent to a treasury address. The contract announces successful deposits, transfers, and withdrawals, including the sender, recipient, token type, and amount.
source_description: Crypto wallet and dapp browser

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Bitway Earn and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits of a specified ERC-20 token, acting as a gateway to external yield-generating strategies. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens and a total supply of shares representing their proportional ownership in the pooled assets. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and redeem their shares for underlying tokens. A designated operator can initiate rebalancing operations to allocate funds to external strategies and harvest yield from those strategies. The contract imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions. A minimum deposit amount of 100 units of the deposited token is enforced. The contract emits an event when a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the operator rebalances funds or harvests yield.
source_description: Bitway Earn is an asset management product from the Bitway suite that allows users to deploy on-chain capital into global investment opportunities. It functions as a comprehensive gateway for both retail and institutional players seeking to access yield globally.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Polynomial Trade and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for structured options, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user balances, active option positions, and a global configuration for available option series. Callers can deposit collateral, open new option positions, exercise expiring options, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can create new option series and adjust risk parameters for existing series. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on all collateral withdrawals. New option positions can only be opened if the total collateral in the vault exceeds 100,000 units of the base collateral token. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and option position changes.
source_description: Leveraging decentralised finance derivatives to their fullest potential

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Collector Crypt and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the tokenized sale of real-world collectible cards, holding the digital representations of these cards as non-fungible tokens. It maintains a registry of each card's unique identifier, its current owner, and its associated physical location for redemption, alongside a global configuration for sale parameters. Callers can list a card for sale, purchase an available card, or initiate a redemption process for a card they own. A designated administrator can add new cards to the registry, update the physical location of a card, or adjust the global sale fee. The contract imposes a 2% fee on all successful card sales, payable in the purchase currency, and a maximum of 1000 unique cards can be registered at any given time. The contract emits an event upon a card being listed for sale, purchased, or redeemed.
source_description: A protocol to sell RWA Pokemon cards on Solana

description: Specify a payments contract based on Ready Card and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user balances of a stablecoin for a debit card spending platform, holding deposited stablecoin tokens in escrow. It maintains individual stablecoin balances for each user and stores a global spending limit configuration. Users can deposit stablecoin into their account, withdraw available stablecoin, and initiate a spending transaction that debits their balance. A designated operator can approve or reject pending spending transactions and set the global daily spending limit. Each user has a daily spending limit of 1,000 stablecoins, and a fee of 10 basis points is applied to each successful spending transaction. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal, and approved spending transaction, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Ready Card is a self-custodial crypto debit card integrated with the Ready wallet that lets users spend USDC directly anywhere Mastercard is accepted

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on SpiritDAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, holding various digital assets as treasury backing. It maintains a treasury balance for each accepted asset, a total supply of the reserve currency, and individual user balances of the reserve currency. Callers can deposit accepted assets to mint the reserve currency, stake their reserve currency to earn rewards, and unstake their reserve currency to withdraw it. The owner can add new accepted assets to the treasury, adjust the minting ratio for new deposits, and initiate bond offerings. A minimum of 10 units of an accepted asset must be deposited to mint reserve currency, and the staking reward rate is fixed at 0.05% per block. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, staking events, and unstaking events.
source_description: SpiritDAO is a decentralized reserve currency, forked from the successful and secure Olympus DAO. Spirit will rely on the bond-and-stake methodology, in order to raise treasury funds and reward early supporters.

description: Design a token contract based on DiversiFi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages onchain portfolio vaults, holding baskets of ERC-20 tokens. It maintains a record of each vault's current token balances, its target token weights, and a global fee configuration. Callers can create new vaults, deposit tokens into an existing vault, withdraw tokens from a vault, and trigger a rebalance of a vault's token holdings. A designated operator can adjust the target token weights for any vault, and only the owner can set the global rebalancing fee. New vaults must be initialized with at least two different ERC-20 tokens, and the rebalancing fee is fixed at 0.5% of the value rebalanced. The contract announces when a vault is created, when tokens are deposited, when tokens are withdrawn, and when a rebalance operation completes.
source_description: DiversiFi provides onchain portfolio vaults that hold baskets of tokens and automatically rebalance them toward predefined target weights as prices move

description: Model a lending protocol based on Exactly and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending and borrowing market, custodying deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains records for each user's deposits and loans, market-wide interest rate parameters, and a pool of available liquidity for each supported asset. Callers can deposit assets as collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust market parameters, including interest rates and collateral factors, and can pause borrowing or depositing in an emergency. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrowed asset is 80%, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all interest payments. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and changes to market parameters.
source_description: Exactly is a decentralized, non-custodial, open-source protocol that provides an autonomous fixed and variable interest rate market, enabling users to frictionlessly exchange their assets' time value and complete the DeFi credit market.

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on Cork Phoenix and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a risk hedging mechanism that custodies a designated collateral asset. It maintains a global configuration for each unique asset pair, including the current minting ratio, and per-user records of deposited collateral and minted tokens. Callers can deposit collateral to mint principal and swap tokens, redeem principal tokens for the collateral asset at expiry, and swap the reference asset for the collateral asset using swap tokens before expiry. A designated operator can adjust the minting ratio within predefined bounds and set the expiry time for new asset pairs. The initial minting ratio for principal and swap tokens is always 1:1, and the swap fee is fixed at 0.1% of the swapped amount. The contract announces successful minting events, redemptions, and swaps, including the quantities involved.
source_description: Cork Phoenix is a programmable risk layer for onchain assets. Users deposit a Collateral Asset to mint cPT (principal token) and cST (swap token). cST holders can swap their Reference Asset for the Collateral Asset at any time before expiry — providing guaranteed redemption liquidity against depeg risk.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Synthetix V4 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a synthetic asset issuance and trading platform, custodying collateral tokens and synthetic tokens. It maintains per-account records of collateral deposited, synthetic tokens minted, and open positions for various synthetic assets, along with global configuration parameters for each asset. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic tokens against their collateral, burn synthetic tokens to reclaim collateral, and trade synthetic tokens for other synthetic tokens. A designated operator can adjust asset parameters, including collateralization ratios and trading fees, and pause trading for specific synthetic assets. The minimum collateralization ratio for any synthetic asset is 150%, and a 0.2% fee is applied to all synthetic token trades. The contract announces events for all collateral deposits, synthetic token mints, burns, and trades, including the involved accounts, asset types, and amounts.
source_description: Synthetix provides liquidity for permissionless derivatives like perpetual futures, options, parimutuel markets, and more across EVM chains. Powering the next generation of permissionless protocols.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Life DAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a treasury for a decentralized reserve currency, holding a basket of approved collateral tokens. It maintains a global reserve ratio, a list of approved collateral tokens with their individual target weights, and a total supply of the protocol's native token. Callers can deposit approved collateral to mint the native token, redeem the native token for a proportional share of the collateral, and transfer the native token. A designated operator can adjust the target weights of approved collateral tokens, add new collateral tokens to the approved list, and remove existing collateral tokens. The reserve ratio must always be at least 100%, and the maximum number of approved collateral tokens is 10. The contract announces all minting and redemption events, including the amount of native token minted or redeemed and the collateral involved.
source_description: LifeDAO is a decentralised, reserve currency protocol built on the Avalanche network by the LifeDAO team. The LF (Also sometimes called LIFE) token is the protocol's main asset.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Alpha Arcade and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding collateral tokens deposited by users for their predictions. It maintains individual user balances for each market, the total collateral locked per market, and the final outcome for each market. Callers can create new prediction markets, place predictions on market outcomes, claim winnings from resolved markets, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator is privileged to resolve markets by declaring the final outcome, and to pause or unpause the contract. Each prediction market must have a resolution delay of at least 24 hours from its creation. A 1% fee is applied to all market winnings, deducted at the time of claiming. The contract announces market creation, prediction placements, market resolution, and winning claims.
source_description: Alpha Arcade is a decentralized prediction marketplace built on the Algorand blockchain, empowering users to forecast outcomes across sports, geopolitics, crypto, business, and more

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on World of Dypians and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a player's in-game virtual land parcels, acting as a secure registry and escrow for these non-fungible digital assets. It maintains records of each player's owned land parcels, their current status (e.g., undeveloped, developed, rented), and any associated upgrade levels. Players can acquire new parcels, develop existing parcels by spending in-game currency, and transfer ownership of their parcels to other players. A designated game administrator can mint new land parcels, set the development cost for each parcel type, and pause all player-initiated transfers in emergency situations. Each land parcel has a unique identifier, and development costs are fixed at 1000 units of in-game currency per level for standard parcels, with a maximum of 5 development levels per parcel. The contract announces when a new land parcel is minted, when a parcel's development level changes, and when ownership of a parcel is transferred.
source_description: World of Dypians is a blockchain-based MMORPG and metaverse game.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Aavegotchi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract mints and manages unique, non-fungible digital assets, each backed by a quantity of a specified fungible token which it custodies. It maintains a record for each asset, including its unique identifier, its current owner, the fungible token type and quantity backing it, and a set of immutable characteristics. Callers can mint new assets by depositing the required backing tokens, transfer ownership of their assets to other addresses, and burn their assets to reclaim the underlying backing tokens. A designated operator can set the types and quantities of backing tokens required for new asset minting. The contract enforces a maximum of 10,000 unique assets that can ever be minted. Minting an asset requires a deposit of at least 100 units of the specified backing token. The contract announces asset minting, asset transfers, and asset burning events.
source_description: Provably-rare DeFi-staked Crypto Collectibles, powered by Aave

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on OpenEden TBILL and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for tokenized U.S. Treasury Bills, holding a fungible token representing ownership of these bills. It maintains individual account balances for each depositor and a total supply of the tokenized bills. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new tokenized bills, and redeem tokenized bills to withdraw stablecoins. A designated operator can pause and unpause deposits and redemptions, and set the redemption fee. Only the owner can upgrade the contract logic. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redemption amount, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and changes to the redemption fee.
source_description: A Moody's A-rated smart contract vault offering 24/7 and direct access to U.S. Treasury Bills, with BNY as Manager and Custodian

description: Outline a payments contract based on Sushi Furo and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages token streaming agreements, holding deposited tokens for scheduled distribution. It maintains individual stream records detailing recipient, token type, start time, end time, and total amount, alongside a global configuration for fees. Callers can create new streams, deposit tokens into existing streams, cancel their own streams, and withdraw tokens from streams where they are the recipient. A designated operator can pause all new stream creation and update the fee percentage. Each stream must have a duration of at least 24 hours. A 0.1% fee is applied to all tokens streamed, deducted at the time of withdrawal. The contract announces when a new stream is created, when tokens are deposited into a stream, and when tokens are withdrawn from a stream.
source_description: Earn, stream and automate your DAO salaries and token vesting with Furo.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on BigPump and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the rapid creation and trading of new token pairs, holding reserves of a base currency and newly minted tokens. It maintains a record of each token pair's reserves, the total supply of each created token, and a configuration for creation fees and trading taxes. Callers can create a new token pair, add liquidity to an existing pair, remove liquidity from a pair, and swap tokens within a pair. Only the contract owner can set the creation fee, adjust the trading tax, and pause all trading activity. A new token pair creation requires a minimum initial base currency deposit of 0.1 units, and all swaps incur a 1% trading tax on the base currency side, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces the creation of new token pairs, liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and all token swaps.
source_description: Create memecoins in 30 seconds, trade, invite Frens, and make a Pump!
