description: Define an NFT contract based on Element NFT Marketplace and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a multi-chain NFT marketplace and aggregator, holding no assets itself but facilitating the exchange of non-fungible tokens. It maintains a registry of listed NFTs with their asking prices, a record of active orders, and per-user trading statistics. Callers can list an NFT for sale, buy a listed NFT, cancel their own listings, and accept offers on their NFTs. A designated operator can set the marketplace fee and pause all trading activity. The marketplace fee is fixed at 0.5% of the sale price, and a listed NFT must have a minimum asking price of 0.001 ether. The contract announces successful NFT sales, new listings, and cancelled orders.
source_description: Element is the first multi-chain NFT marketplace and aggregator, providing 3 million+ users with real-time data analysis, efficient trading tools, visible cost savings, and customized shopping navigations

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Harmonix Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an automated yield vault, custodying user-deposited stablecoins. It maintains records of each user's deposited amount, their share of the vault, and the total vault assets, along with configuration parameters for strategy allocation. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their share of stablecoins, and claim accumulated rewards. Only a designated operator can rebalance funds between different yield strategies, update strategy parameters, or pause deposits and withdrawals. The contract charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals, and users must wait at least 24 hours after a deposit before initiating a withdrawal. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes in strategy allocation.
source_description: Harmonix Finance is where TradFi meets DeFi: automated vaults, smart strategies, and max gains with min risk. We are building efficient hedge fund on-chain derivatives pools using hedge fund strategies (like options wheel & delta neutral) where users deposit fund and receive high yield & multiple tokens airdrop

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Mansory and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a utility token that grants access to tiered luxury benefits, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a record of each account's token balance and a mapping of benefit tiers to specific access requirements. Callers can transfer tokens between accounts, approve spending by other accounts, and burn tokens to redeem benefits. An owner can mint new tokens, set the total supply cap, and configure the benefit tier requirements. The total supply of tokens is capped at 100,000,000 units. Burning tokens for benefits requires a minimum of 1,000 tokens for the lowest tier. The contract announces token transfers, approvals, and benefit redemptions to observers.
source_description: Mansory Token (MNSRY) is a branded utility token empowering holders with tiered luxury benefits like VIP events, NFT-authenticated assets, and lifestyle rewards—anchored in the Mansory automotive world.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on cSigma Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin funds for lending, holding deposited stablecoins and tracking individual lender balances. It maintains a record of each lender's deposited amount, accrued interest, and any pending withdrawals, alongside an overall pool balance and configuration parameters like interest rates and fees. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim accrued interest. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate within a predefined range, pause deposits, and initiate bulk disbursements to borrowers. The maximum deposit amount per transaction is 100,000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all interest payments before distribution to lenders. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and interest rate updates.
source_description: cSigma is a blockchain-based protocol that connects global borrowers and lenders by standardizing and streamlining the commercial lending process, empowering credit service providers and pool managers while offering crypto-uncorrelated yield opportunities to stablecoin holders transparently and efficiently.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Reya Perps and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for various trading pairs, and global configuration parameters such as funding rates and margin requirements. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update trading pair configurations, adjust global margin parameters, and settle funding payments. Each trading pair has a maximum leverage of 50x, and all trades incur a 0.01% taker fee. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closures, including the account involved, the asset, and the amount.
source_description: The only DEX where speed never compromises security. Uniquely built as a based-rollup powered by zk-proofs, Reya DEX delivers 1 millisecond speed, 0 trading fess and 100% Ethereum uptime and security

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Felix CDP and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateralized debt positions (CDPs) for minting a synthetic stablecoin, holding deposited collateral tokens and minted stablecoin tokens. It maintains individual CDP records including collateral amount, minted stablecoin amount, and liquidation status, along with system-wide configuration parameters like liquidation thresholds and fees. Callers can open a CDP by depositing collateral, mint stablecoin against their collateral, repay stablecoin to reduce their debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized CDPs. A designated operator can adjust system parameters such as the liquidation threshold, the liquidation penalty, and the stablecoin minting fee. The maximum collateralization ratio for minting stablecoin is 150%, meaning for every 1.5 units of collateral value, at most 1 unit of stablecoin value can be minted. A 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces events for CDP openings, stablecoin mints, repayments, collateral withdrawals, and liquidations.
source_description: Felix is a synthetic dollar protocol on Hyperliquid L1

description: Define a prediction market contract based on O.LAB and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized predictions on future events, holding user-deposited tokens as collateral for prediction outcomes. It maintains individual user balances for each prediction market, records the chosen outcome for each participant, and stores configuration parameters for each market, such as the event description and resolution criteria. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit tokens into an existing market to back a specific outcome, withdraw tokens from a resolved market if their prediction was correct, and dispute market resolutions within a defined window. A designated operator can resolve prediction markets, declaring the winning outcome, and can update market resolution criteria before a market closes. Each prediction market must have at least two possible outcomes and no more than ten, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all winning payouts, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces market creation, user deposits, outcome selections, market resolution, and payout distributions through emitted events.
source_description: The World's Opinion Protocol, enabling anyone to create predictions using any token in a decentralized, permissionless way. The O.LAB product suite empower users to predict, trade, and verify truth like never before

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on AtmosSoft and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique, non-fungible digital assets representing collectible game cards, holding the cards themselves and the associated in-game currency used for purchases. It maintains individual balances of the in-game currency for each player, records of card ownership, and a global configuration for card pack prices. Players can purchase card packs using the in-game currency, open purchased packs to receive random cards, and transfer cards they own to other players. A designated operator can mint new cards, set the price of card packs, and distribute in-game currency to players. The maximum number of cards a player can hold is 500. The fee for transferring a card between players is 10 units of in-game currency. The contract emits an event when a card pack is purchased, when a card is minted, and when a card is transferred.
source_description: Atmosphere Software(AtmosSoft) is a next generation cross chain NFT based Collectible Card Game

description: Define an NFT contract based on Collex and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for tokenized real-world collectibles, holding ERC-721 tokens as collateral for issued debt. It maintains individual debt positions for each borrower, a global interest rate, and a list of approved collateral types. Callers can deposit approved ERC-721 tokens as collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay their outstanding debt, and withdraw their collateral once debt is fully repaid. A designated operator can adjust the global interest rate and add new approved ERC-721 collateral types. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral type is 50%, and the interest rate cannot exceed 10% annually. The contract announces when a new loan is issued and when a loan is fully repaid.
source_description: Collex utilizes DeFi with real-world collectibles, offering a seamless platform for tokenizing, trading, and leveraging your assets by staking. Collex empowers collectors with liquidity, transparency, and innovative DeFi opportunities.

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on OpenEden USDO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues a stablecoin that is collateralized by tokenized short-term government debt and money market fund shares. It maintains each account's stablecoin balance and the total supply of the stablecoin, along with a record of approved collateral tokens and their current valuation. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. Only a designated operator can approve new collateral tokens, update the valuation of existing collateral, and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The contract must always maintain a collateralization ratio of at least 100%, and a maximum of 1,000,000 stablecoins can be minted per day. The contract emits events for all minting, burning, and transfer actions, as well as for changes in collateral approval or valuation.
source_description: USDO is collateralized by tokenized U.S. Treasury Bills and money market funds (such as OpenEden’s TBILL), from which USDO’s yield is generated. The reserves serve as the foundation for maintaining a minimum 100% collateralization ratio, meaning every USDO token in circulation is fully backed by equivalent assets

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on ChainGPT and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized launchpad for new token projects, holding deposited tokens from participants and distributing new project tokens. It maintains per-participant records of deposited funds, allocated project tokens, and vesting schedules, alongside global configuration for launchpad rounds. Callers can deposit funds into active rounds, claim vested project tokens, and withdraw their original deposits if a round fails. A designated operator can create new launchpad rounds, configure vesting schedules, and initiate token distributions. The maximum number of participants in any single round is capped at 500. A 2% fee is applied to all successful project token distributions, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces the creation of new launchpad rounds, the completion of funding targets, and the distribution of project tokens.
source_description: Sophisticated. Balanced. Secure. Enabling the future of Web3 innovation with AI; ChainGPT Pad is the decentralized fundraising platform incubating the next generation of crypto projects.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Sanctum Infinity and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a multi-asset liquidity pool for various liquid staking tokens, holding deposited liquid staking tokens and their underlying assets. It maintains records of each liquid staking token's individual pool balance, its exchange rate to the underlying asset, and global configuration parameters like fees. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens, withdraw liquid staking tokens, and swap between different liquid staking tokens within the pool. Only the owner can adjust the swap fee, add new supported liquid staking tokens, or pause all deposit and swap operations. The swap fee is fixed at 0.05% of the swapped amount, and a maximum of 200 distinct liquid staking tokens can be supported at any given time. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and swap operation, including the assets involved and the amounts transferred.
source_description: Infinity is a multi-LST liquidity pool. It can support hundreds of different LSTs natively and enables frictionless exchanges between them.

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on StandX Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset bridge for a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding deposited tokens on one chain to mint wrapped representations on another. It maintains a total supply of wrapped tokens minted per destination chain, a per-user record of deposited and withdrawn amounts, and a configurable fee structure. Callers can deposit the native stablecoin, initiate a withdrawal of wrapped tokens from a specific destination chain, and claim their native stablecoin after a successful withdrawal. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals, update the withdrawal fee percentage, and approve new destination chains for bridging. The maximum withdrawal fee is 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and a minimum of 100 native stablecoin tokens must be deposited for any cross-chain transfer. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal initiation, and successful claim.
source_description: StandX is a Perps DEX live on Mainnet across BNB and Solana, powered by its native yield bearing DUSD.

description: Outline a governance contract based on T3tris Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized vault infrastructure, holding deposited tokens and issuing corresponding vault shares. It maintains records of each user's deposited token balances, their issued vault shares, and the total supply of vault shares for each distinct vault. Callers can deposit tokens into a specified vault, withdraw their deposited tokens by redeeming vault shares, and transfer their vault shares to another address. A designated operator is privileged to create new vaults and to update the underlying asset address for an existing vault. Each vault must maintain a minimum of 100 base tokens as a reserve, and the total supply of vault shares for any single vault cannot exceed 1,000,000 shares. The contract announces to observers when new vaults are created, when tokens are deposited, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: T3tris is a zero-fee, permissionless vault infrastructure.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on V3S Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding reserve tokens and issuing a pegged token. It maintains a global reserve pool of a volatile asset, a global supply of the pegged stablecoin, and per-account balances for both the reserve and stablecoin. Callers can deposit the volatile reserve asset to mint the stablecoin, redeem stablecoin for the reserve asset, and transfer stablecoin between accounts. The owner can set the redemption fee and pause all minting and redemption operations. Redemption operations incur a 0.5% fee, deducted from the redeemed reserve asset. The maximum stablecoin supply is capped at 1,000,000 units. The contract announces stablecoin minting and burning events, and reserve asset deposits and withdrawals.
source_description: V3S Finance, the first ecosystem running around an algorithmic token pegged to VVS on Cronos chain. Build by a team of VVS Diamond holders

description: Create a lending protocol based on Benqi Lending and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for a single specified digital asset, holding deposited tokens and tokens borrowed from it. It maintains individual deposit balances, individual borrow balances, and a global interest rate model configuration. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay their outstanding loans, and liquidate undercollateralized loans. Only a designated administrator can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause deposits or borrows. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a liquidation penalty of 8% is applied to the borrower's outstanding debt. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events.
source_description: BENQI is a non-custodial liquidity market protocol, built on Avalanche. The protocol enables users to effortlessly lend, borrow, and earn interest with their digital assets.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Sacra and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages player progression and rewards within a decentralized role-playing game, holding no custodial assets directly. It maintains individual player experience points, current character level, and a record of completed quests for each player. Players can initiate a new game, complete quests to earn experience points, and spend experience points to level up their character. A designated game administrator can define new quests, adjust experience point rewards for quests, and reset a player's progress. Quests must have a minimum experience point reward of 10 and a maximum of 1000. The contract emits an event whenever a player levels up or completes a quest.
source_description: Sacra is a first ever decentralized RPG game with P&E mechanics where you can monetize your mind. Embark on an epic journey where your choices matter, and your rewards are real

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Xmarket and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages prediction markets, holding deposited collateral for active markets. It maintains individual user balances for each market, the current state of each market (open, closed, resolved), and global configuration parameters like fees. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit collateral into an open market, make predictions on market outcomes, and withdraw their share of resolved market winnings. The owner can set the global market creation fee and designate operators who can resolve markets. A market creation fee of 0.01 units of the native currency is charged for each new market. Predictions must be made before a market's specified closing time. The contract emits events when a new market is created, when collateral is deposited, when a prediction is made, and when a market is resolved.
source_description: Xmarket is a prediction platform built for creators, not just traders. Built on BNB Chain

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Paimon and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized real-world asset, specifically a pool of fractionalized debt instruments, and custodies the underlying stablecoin collateral. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance and their corresponding share of the tokenized asset pool. Callers can deposit stablecoins to acquire asset tokens, redeem asset tokens for stablecoins, and transfer their asset tokens to other addresses. A designated operator can adjust the stablecoin redemption fee and the maximum total supply of asset tokens. The stablecoin redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and the maximum total supply of asset tokens is capped at 10,000,000 units. The contract announces a Deposit event when stablecoins are added and a Redemption event when stablecoins are withdrawn.
source_description: Paimon is a BSC-based RWA and DeFi protocol focused on bringing institutional-grade real-world financial assets on-chain through tokenization and decentralized infrastructure bridging TradFi and DeFi.

description: Specify a payments contract based on SoulBound Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private, wallet-to-wallet transfers of Ether and approved fungible tokens using one-time redeemable codes, holding deposited assets until redemption. It maintains a record of each unique redeemable code, its associated asset type, deposit amount, and whether it has been redeemed. Callers can deposit assets to generate a new redeemable code, and recipients can redeem a valid code to claim the associated assets. A designated operator can add or remove approved fungible tokens for deposits. Each redeemable code is valid for a single redemption, and a deposit fee of 0.1% is applied to all deposits, with a minimum deposit amount of 0.001 Ether or its equivalent in approved tokens. The contract announces when a new redeemable code has been created and when a code has been successfully redeemed.
source_description: SoulBound Finance is a privacy-focused transfer protocol on Arbitrum that enables encrypted, wallet-to-wallet payments using one-time redeemable codes. It supports assets like ETH and stablecoins, with batched redemptions and a design that prevents linking senders to recipients

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on GrowiHF and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating vault, holding deposited stablecoins and investing them into various strategies. It maintains individual account balances for each depositor, a total value locked, and configuration parameters for each approved investment strategy. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, and claim any available rewards. A designated operator can approve new investment strategies, adjust allocation percentages across strategies, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to strategy allocations.
source_description: Growi is a quantitative asset management protocol that leverages mathematical modeling to fine-tune trading strategies and maximize yield. Our approach ensures efficient capital allocation, advanced risk management, and consistent returns for investors

description: Create a token contract based on Kassandra DAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic asset that tracks the performance of a basket of other digital assets, holding no underlying collateral itself. It maintains a record of each user's synthetic asset balance and the current composition and weighting of the underlying asset basket. Callers can mint new synthetic assets by providing a specified amount of a base currency, redeem synthetic assets for the equivalent value in the base currency, and transfer their synthetic asset balances to other users. A designated operator can update the basket's asset composition and their respective weights, and pause or unpause minting and redemption operations. Minting new synthetic assets incurs a 0.5% fee, payable in the base currency, and the basket composition can be updated a maximum of once every 24 hours. The contract announces transfers of synthetic assets, minting events, redemption events, and changes to the basket's composition.
source_description: The $aHYPE Social Index reflects the performance of a portfolio selected from the most socially active cryptocurrencies in the past 30 days, using Heimdall Social Score data.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on MoonDao and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized reserve currency protocol that custodies a basket of stablecoin assets. It maintains a total supply of its native reserve token, the current backing per reserve token, and the balances of stablecoin assets held in its treasury. Callers can mint new reserve tokens by depositing approved stablecoins, burn reserve tokens to redeem a proportional share of the treasury's stablecoin assets, and stake their reserve tokens to earn rebase rewards. Only the owner can add or remove approved stablecoin assets, adjust the rebase rate, or transfer stablecoins out of the treasury for protocol operations. The minimum stablecoin deposit to mint reserve tokens is 10 units of the deposited stablecoin. The protocol charges a 0.5% fee on all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces the current total supply of reserve tokens and the current backing per reserve token whenever these values change.
source_description: MoonDao is a decentralized reserve currency protocol based on the MD token. Each MD token is backed by a basket of assets (e.g. DAI, USDC) in the MoonDao treasury, giving it an intrinsic value that it cannot fall below.

description: Define a token contract based on Arch and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized basket of other tokens, representing a diversified portfolio. It maintains the current composition of the basket, including the quantity of each underlying token held, and the total supply of the basket token. Callers can deposit a specified set of underlying tokens to mint new basket tokens, and they can redeem their basket tokens to receive a proportional share of the underlying tokens. Only a designated operator can adjust the target weights of the underlying tokens within the basket, or pause and unpause all deposit and redemption operations. A deposit fee of 0.1% is applied to all minting operations, and the basket's rebalancing operations are limited to a maximum of 10% change in any single underlying token's weight per day. The contract announces events for all minting, redemption, and rebalancing actions, including the quantities of tokens involved.
source_description: We curate a comprehensive family of market indices and tokenized products, and help investors build and manage their web3 portfolios.

description: Design a staking contract based on Infrared Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native tokens and issuing an equivalent amount of a liquid staking derivative token. It maintains a record of each user's deposited native tokens and issued derivative tokens, a total supply of the derivative token, and a current staking yield rate. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive derivative tokens, withdraw native tokens by burning derivative tokens, and claim staking rewards. A designated operator can update the staking yield rate and initiate withdrawals from the underlying staking mechanism. The maximum deposit per transaction is 1000 native tokens. A 0.5% fee is applied to all staking rewards before distribution. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: Infrared Finance is a BERA liquid staking protocol which utilizes proof of liquidity to maximize yields

description: Define a governance contract based on DewFinance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for managing a treasury of a governance token and facilitating proposal execution. It maintains a record of the total governance token supply, the current voting power allocated to each delegate, and a queue of pending proposals with their associated parameters and state. Callers can delegate their voting power to another address, undelegate their voting power, and submit new proposals for consideration. A designated operator can cancel a pending proposal, queue an approved proposal for execution, and execute a queued proposal after a time lock. The contract imposes a minimum delegation amount of 100 governance tokens. Executing a queued proposal requires a 48-hour time lock after it has been queued. The contract announces when voting power is delegated, when voting power is undelegated, when a new proposal is submitted, when a proposal is canceled, when a proposal is queued, and when a proposal is executed.
source_description: Dew Finance is a chain-abstracted vault infrastructure that enables curators and protocols to build and scale cross-chain yield products. It unifies yield opportunities across ecosystems while providing verifiable, policy-driven vaults with transparent on-chain accounting

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Veil Cash and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a designated base token, holding deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments, a mapping of nullifiers to booleans indicating spent commitments, and a record of the current deposit and withdrawal fees. Callers can deposit tokens by providing a commitment hash, and they can withdraw tokens by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof that corresponds to an unspent commitment and a nullifier. A designated owner can update the deposit fee, update the withdrawal fee, and set the verifier contract address. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited amount, and the withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.2% of the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, including the commitment hash and the amount, and an event upon each successful withdrawal, including the nullifier and the recipient.
source_description: Veil Cash is a privacy application leveraging zk-SNARKs on Base L2, enabling verified depositors to achieve privacy and anonymity within a pool of trusted users.

description: Define a token contract based on Global Balanced Liquidity Index and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract creates and manages a reserve-backed token, holding a basket of three distinct base tokens: a wrapped BTC, a wrapped ETH, and a stablecoin. It maintains the current balance of each base token held, the total supply of its own reserve-backed token, and a set of configuration parameters for its rebalancing mechanism. Callers can mint new reserve-backed tokens by depositing the required proportion of base tokens, and they can redeem existing reserve-backed tokens for the underlying base tokens. A designated administrator can adjust the rebalancing parameters, but these changes are subject to a 48-hour timelock before becoming active. A one-time minting fee of 0.10% of the value of the minted tokens is charged upon creation. The contract emits events for all minting and redemption operations, and for any changes to the rebalancing parameters.
source_description: GBLIN is a reserve-backed token on Base: each token is backed by a basket of cbBTC, WETH and USDC held by the contract itself, minted and redeemed directly at NAV (no pool slippage). One-time 0.10% mint fee, no management fee. An algorithmic Crash Shield reduces exposure during severe drawdowns; parameters are governed by a 48-hour public timelock.

description: Define a lending protocol based on USD AI and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic dollar, allowing users to mint it against deposited collateral and redeem it. It maintains individual user collateral balances, synthetic dollar balances, and a global collateral pool, along with configuration parameters like the collateralization ratio and stability fees. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic dollars, redeem synthetic dollars by burning them and withdrawing collateral, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated administrator can adjust the stability fee and the minimum collateralization ratio, and can pause all minting and redeeming operations. The initial minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and the stability fee is 0.5% per year, calculated continuously. The contract emits events for all deposits, mints, redemptions, and withdrawals, as well as for changes to the stability fee or collateralization ratio.
source_description: USD.AI is a yield-bearing synthetic dollar protocol backed by real-world infrastructure assets

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Kintara and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages player accounts and their in-game currency balances for a browser-based isometric MMO. It maintains individual player balances for the primary in-game currency, along with a global configuration for game parameters. Players can deposit external tokens to acquire in-game currency, withdraw in-game currency back to external tokens, and transfer in-game currency to other players. A designated operator can mint new in-game currency, burn existing in-game currency, and update game configuration parameters. Deposits incur a 1% fee, and withdrawals are capped at 10,000 in-game currency per 24-hour period per player. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or transfer of in-game currency occurs.
source_description: Kintara is a browser-based isometric MMO. Players move on a tile map, gather resources, fight monsters, complete quests, trade with other players, and explore multiple connected realms from one shared character.

description: Design a governance contract based on SharpLink Gaming and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of a base cryptocurrency, enabling strategic deployment and governance. It maintains a total balance of the base cryptocurrency, a record of designated investment allocations, and a list of approved investment strategies, each with a maximum allocation percentage. Callers can propose new investment strategies, vote on proposed strategies, and view the current treasury balance and investment allocations. Only the owner can approve new investment strategies, set the maximum allocation percentage for an approved strategy, and initiate the transfer of funds to an approved investment strategy. A proposed strategy requires at least 51% of the total voting power to be approved. The maximum allocation for any single investment strategy is 25% of the total treasury balance. The contract announces when a new investment strategy is proposed, when a vote is cast, and when funds are transferred to an investment strategy.
source_description: SharpLink is one of the first Nasdaq-listed companies to develop a treasury strategy centered on ETH

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Creo Engine and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native utility tokens, enabling users to stake them to earn rewards and participate in governance. It maintains individual user balances of staked tokens, accumulated rewards, and a global pool of undistributed rewards. Users can stake tokens, unstake tokens, claim their earned rewards, and delegate their voting power to another address. Only a designated operator can deposit new rewards into the global pool and set the reward distribution rate, which must be between 0.01% and 1% of the total staked tokens per day. The contract emits an event when tokens are staked, when tokens are unstaked, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Connecting worlds in a one-size-fits-all gaming hub & leveling up web3 gaming experience for your benefit

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Pull.fun and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the on-chain distribution of unique digital collectibles through a gacha-style pack opening mechanism, holding the collectible tokens themselves until they are claimed. It maintains records of available pack types, the probability tables for each collectible within those packs, and the number of unopened packs owned by each user. Callers can purchase packs using an ERC-20 token, open purchased packs to reveal collectibles, and claim revealed collectibles to their wallet. A designated operator can create new pack types, adjust the probability tables for existing packs, and replenish the supply of packs. The contract charges a 5% fee on all pack purchases, which is sent to a treasury address. Each pack opening reveals exactly 5 collectibles. The contract emits an event when a pack is purchased, when a pack is opened, and when a collectible is claimed.
source_description: TCG gacha platform — pull card packs on-chain, trade on marketplace, redeem for physical cards

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on NEAR Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens representing assets locked on a source chain. It maintains a mapping of each user's balance of wrapped tokens and a global count of total wrapped tokens in circulation. Callers can deposit native tokens to mint wrapped tokens, and redeem wrapped tokens to initiate a withdrawal of native tokens on the source chain. A designated operator can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The maximum number of wrapped tokens that can be minted for a single deposit is 10,000 units. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawal amounts. The contract announces events for successful deposits, withdrawals, and when the operator pauses or unpauses operations.
source_description: Effortlessly create and distribute innovative decentralized apps across any blockchain, while helping build a more open web, with the NEAR Blockchain Operating System (BOS).

description: Define a token contract based on Simps and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token system, holding a reserve of the system's native token. It tracks each user's token balance, their share of the total supply, and a global fee percentage. Callers can create new social tokens, buy and sell existing social tokens, and claim their accumulated rewards. Only a designated operator can adjust the global fee percentage, which is capped at 5%, and pause or unpause trading for all social tokens. A 0.5% fee is applied to all buy and sell operations, distributed proportionally to existing social token holders. The contract emits an event whenever a new social token is created, a buy or sell operation occurs, or the global fee percentage is updated.
source_description: Social-Fi protocol on Base

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Extended Perps and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits and perpetual futures positions, holding collateral tokens in escrow. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including their size and entry price, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and margin requirements. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify leverage, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update oracle prices, adjust funding rates, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.05% fee is charged on all position opening and closing trades. The contract announces all position opening, closing, and liquidation events to observers.
source_description: Extended is a perp DEX, built by ex-Revolut team, on a mission to offer the most extensive product portfolio in DeFi—featuring cross-asset collateral, unified margin, perps, spot, and lending markets.

description: Design a privacy-preserving contract based on Voidify and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates anonymous transfers of a standard fungible token by breaking the link between deposits and withdrawals; it custodies deposited tokens. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments, a nullifier set of spent commitments, and a configuration for the minimum and maximum deposit amounts. Callers can deposit tokens to generate a commitment, withdraw tokens by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof of a commitment and nullifier, and relay a withdrawal for another user. Only the owner can update the contract's configuration parameters, such as the fee percentage or the maximum deposit amount. The minimum deposit amount is 0.01 tokens, and the maximum deposit amount is 1000 tokens. The contract announces successful deposits, successful withdrawals, and changes to the configuration.
source_description: Voidify breaks the link between deposits and withdrawals, making the flow of funds untraceable

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on DipCoin Perps and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by users to back their trading positions. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, open long and short positions for each user, and a global funding rate for each trading pair. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update the funding rate for each trading pair and adjust the maximum leverage allowed. The maximum leverage for any position is 100x. A 0.1% fee is charged on all position openings and closings. The contract emits an event whenever a new position is opened or closed, and when the funding rate is updated.
source_description: Dipcoin is the next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) built on Sui, combining the speed and simplicity of a centralized exchange (CEX) with the transparency and control of DeFi. It’s designed to make crypto trading fast, human, and confidence-driven, offering guided perpetuals, sub-second execution, and true self-custody - all in one seamless platform. Confidence in Every Trade. True self-custody. Fast, simple, and human - trade smarter, win bigger.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on stUSDT and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized representation of real-world assets, holding an equivalent amount of a stablecoin in reserve. It maintains a total supply of the token, individual user balances, and a record of the current stablecoin reserve address. Callers can mint new tokens by depositing stablecoins, redeem tokens for stablecoins, and transfer tokens to other accounts. Only a designated operator can update the stablecoin reserve address, and only the owner can pause all minting and redemption operations. The minimum minting amount is 100 stablecoins, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces token transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: Shape, expand, and enjoy the future of real-world assets tokenization on TRON.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on AFI Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and withdrawing a single designated stablecoin, which it then allocates to an external yield-generating strategy. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance and the total amount of stablecoin currently held within the vault. Users can deposit stablecoins into the vault and withdraw their share of the vault's assets, while a designated operator can initiate rebalancing of the vault's assets with the external strategy and adjust the fee charged on withdrawals. Only the owner can change the designated operator or upgrade the contract. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, and withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay after initiation. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: AFI builds Proof-of-Reserve infrastructure for Real-World Assets, unlocking institutional-grade yield that's fully composable in DeFi

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Mixpad and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages token launches, holding deposited tokens from participants and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their allocation of project tokens, along with the current launch phase and the total project tokens available for distribution. Callers can deposit tokens during the funding phase, claim their allocated project tokens during the distribution phase, and withdraw any unspent deposited tokens after the launch concludes. A designated operator can initiate new launches, set the project token address and total supply, advance the launch phase, and set the funding phase duration. The funding phase duration must be between 1 day and 7 days. A 2% fee on all deposited tokens is automatically transferred to a treasury address upon deposit. The contract announces the start and end of each launch phase, and when participants claim their project tokens.
source_description: Mixpad, a Uniswap V4 hook-based token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Ribbon Earn and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for automated options strategies, holding deposited underlying tokens and minted options tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, the total assets under management, and configuration parameters for the current strategy. Callers can deposit underlying tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and initiate a strategy rollover. A designated operator can initiate new strategy auctions and settle expired options. The owner can set the fee for strategy rollovers, which is capped at 0.5% of the gross premium, and can update the address of the external options exchange. Withdrawals are subject to a 7-day delay after the request is made. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy rollover completions.
source_description: Structured products protocol

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Peeps and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens through a bonding curve mechanism, holding deposited base currency and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's purchased token balance, their deposited base currency, and the current price and supply of the project token on the bonding curve. Callers can deposit base currency to purchase project tokens, withdraw their project tokens, and claim any remaining base currency after a project concludes. A designated operator can set the initial project token supply, define the bonding curve parameters, and initiate the project launch. The bonding curve will have a maximum price increase of 10x from its starting price. A 2% fee on all purchases is directed to a treasury wallet. The contract emits an event when a new project token is launched and when a purchase or withdrawal occurs.
source_description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain with bonding curves that graduate to locked Uniswap V3 liquidity

description: Create an NFT contract based on RIP.FUN and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital trading cards, holding no custodial assets itself. It maintains a record of all minted cards, including their unique identifiers, associated artwork hashes, and current owner, along with a total supply count for each card type. Callers can mint new cards, transfer ownership of cards to other accounts, and burn cards they own. A designated operator can define new card types, set the maximum supply for each card type, and pause all minting operations. The maximum supply for any single card type is capped at 10,000 units. A fee of 0.001 ether is charged for each card minted, payable to a treasury address. The contract emits an event whenever a new card is minted, transferred, or burned, and when the minting operations are paused or unpaused.
source_description: A trading-card NFT platform where users collect and trade digital card packs

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Windfall Lotto and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lottery, holding a stablecoin for jackpot payouts. It maintains the current jackpot amount, the price of a single lottery entry, the total number of entries sold for the current round, and a mapping of entry ticket identifiers to their purchasers. Callers can purchase an entry ticket, which mints a non-fungible token representing their participation, and designated operators can trigger a draw, which selects a winner and transfers the jackpot. The owner can set the entry ticket price and designate new operators. The entry ticket price is fixed at 10 stablecoins, and a maximum of 1000 entries can be sold per round. The contract announces when a new lottery round begins and when a winner is selected.
source_description: Windfall Lotto is a transparent on-chain lottery protocol on Polygon. Lottery tickets are issued as NFTs, jackpots are denominated in DAI, draw operations are publicly executable, and randomness is provided through independent verifiable-randomness systems with an emergency fallback.

description: Create a governance contract based on YieldNest and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid restaking vault, holding deposited base tokens and issuing liquid restaked tokens representing proportional shares of the vault's assets. It maintains a total supply of liquid restaked tokens, the total amount of base tokens held, and per-user balances of liquid restaked tokens. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid restaked tokens, and redeem liquid restaked tokens for their share of base tokens. A designated operator can initiate rebalancing strategies, which involve transferring base tokens to external restaking protocols and receiving corresponding yield-bearing tokens. The owner can set the operator address and update the redemption fee, which is initially 0.1% and cannot exceed 1%. The contract announces deposit and redemption events, including the depositor, amount, and resulting liquid restaked token balance.
source_description: YieldNest is a next-generation liquid restaking protocol that provides simple-to-understand, risk-adjusted restaking strategies

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on ZOO.FUN and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens, holding deposited launch tokens and raised capital in a pool. It maintains records of each participant's deposited launch tokens, their allocated share of the raised capital, and the current launch phase. Callers can deposit launch tokens, commit funds to a launch, claim their allocated new tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their unspent committed funds if a launch fails. A designated operator can initiate a new launch, set the launch parameters including the target raise amount and the launch token to new token ratio, advance the launch through distinct phases (deposit, commitment, distribution), and finalize or cancel a launch. A launch must raise at least 50% of its target capital to be considered successful, and a 2% fee on all raised capital is automatically transferred to a designated treasury address upon successful launch finalization. The contract announces events for new launch initiations, participant deposits, fund commitments, and successful or failed launch finalizations.
source_description: Platform for new coin launches on Abstract chain

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Youves and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of synthetic assets, holding collateral tokens as backing. It maintains individual user positions tracking deposited collateral, minted synthetic tokens, and accrued stability fees, alongside global configuration for each synthetic asset type. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic tokens against their collateral, repay synthetic tokens to reduce their debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can pause minting and redemptions, and set stability fees and liquidation thresholds. The minimum collateralization ratio for any synthetic asset is 150%, and a stability fee of 0.5% per year is levied on all outstanding synthetic debt. The contract emits events for all deposits, mints, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset type, and amount.
source_description: Youves is a decentralised, non-custodial and self-governed platform for the creation and management of synthetic assets. Minters of synthetic assets earn a passive income in YOU, the governance token on Youves.

description: Specify a governance contract based on LobbyFi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a governance delegation platform, holding a specific governance token to enable delegated voting. It maintains per-user records of deposited governance tokens and delegated voting power, along with a global delegation target address and a platform fee percentage. Callers can deposit governance tokens, delegate their voting power to the platform's designated target, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim any accumulated yield. The owner can set the delegation target address and adjust the platform fee. A minimum deposit of 10 governance tokens is required, and the platform fee is capped at 5% of the yield. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the delegation target.
source_description: LobbyFi is a decentralized platform that allows users to delegate ARB votes to earn yield, facilitating governance participation in DAOs

description: Create an on-chain insurance contract based on Marquee and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized insurance pool, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued coverage tokens. It maintains individual user balances for deposited collateral, active coverage policies, and earned rewards, alongside global pool statistics like total collateral, total outstanding coverage, and current premium rates. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase coverage policies, file claims against active policies, and withdraw their available collateral and earned rewards. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, and adjust premium rates within predefined limits. The maximum coverage period for any policy is 365 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all collateral withdrawals. The contract announces events for new deposits, policy purchases, claim submissions, claim resolutions, and withdrawals.
source_description: Marquee is a decentralized insurance protocol that allows users to both purchase cover for digital-assets and provide liquidity to backing pools, while earning real-premiums and governance exposure via its MARQ token

description: Design an NFT contract based on Caviar V1 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates efficient trading of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) by allowing users to deposit NFTs into shared pools and trade fungible tokens representing fractional ownership. It maintains a mapping of each NFT collection to its associated pool, tracking the total fungible tokens issued for each pool, and the individual fungible token balances for each user. Callers can deposit NFTs into a pool, withdraw NFTs from a pool, buy fungible tokens from a pool, sell fungible tokens to a pool, and redeem fungible tokens for a specific NFT. The owner can set the trading fee for each pool, which is initially 0.5% and can be adjusted between 0% and 5%, and can also designate an operator to manage pool parameters. The contract announces when an NFT is deposited, when an NFT is withdrawn, and when fungible tokens are bought or sold.
source_description: The easiest way to trade and earn yield on an NFT.

description: Design a token contract based on PieDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of diverse digital assets, functioning as a decentralized exchange-traded product. It maintains the current allocation of each asset within the basket, the total supply of basket tokens, and the individual balances of basket tokens held by each user. Callers can deposit supported assets to mint new basket tokens, withdraw underlying assets by burning their basket tokens, and rebalance the asset allocations. A designated operator can adjust the target allocation for each asset and add or remove supported assets from the basket. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 basket tokens and charges a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, which is distributed to basket token holders. The contract announces when new basket tokens are minted, when basket tokens are burned, and when asset allocations are updated.
source_description: PieDAO is the decentralized community building ETF products known as pies. Their offerings provide diversified exposure to both DEFI and the wider cryptocurrency ecosystem, with baskets of tokens automatically rebalancing to maintain set allocations. All decisions are made as a community, with members using the DOUGH token to vote on proposals. DOUGH also provides holders with a share of the fees generated by the DAO's products. The platform aims to simplify decentralized finance with automation and minimize risk with diversified portfolios reducing exposure to any one single asset.

description: Model a prediction market contract based on Trueo and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized news market by enabling users to stake funds on the veracity of specific claims, acting as a truth bounty system. It custodies user deposits in an escrow for each claim. The contract maintains a record of each claim, including its current status (open, resolved true, resolved false), the total staked amount for and against the claim, and individual user stakes for each side. Callers can create new claims, stake funds on either the "true" or "false" outcome of an existing claim, withdraw their stake if a claim is unresolved, and claim rewards if their staked side is declared correct. A designated operator is privileged to resolve claims as either true or false, and to set the fee percentage for successful claims. New claims must have an initial staking period of at least 7 days. A 2% fee is deducted from the total rewards of correctly predicted claims, which is then distributed to the designated operator. The contract announces the creation of new claims, all staking actions, and the final resolution of claims, including the winning side and the total rewards distributed.
source_description: News through markets. Bounties on truth.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on UniDerp and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad that custodies newly minted tokens and a reserve of a base currency. It maintains a record of each launched token's supply, its current price in the base currency, and the base currency balance held for each token. Callers can launch a new token by providing an initial amount of the base currency and specifying the total supply of the new token, and they can swap the base currency for any launched token or swap any launched token back to the base currency. The contract owner can pause all token launches and swaps, and can set the launch fee. A launch fee of 0.5% of the initial base currency provided is charged for each new token launch, and a minimum of 100 base currency units must be provided to launch a token. The contract emits an event when a new token is launched, when a swap occurs, and when the owner updates the launch fee.
source_description: Launch a coin that is instantly tradeable in one click for free. Make EVM Degen Again! Building on unichain.

description: Outline a staking contract based on Stader and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking pool for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native tokens and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a record of each user's staked balance and the total amount of native tokens held in the pool, along with a global exchange rate between native tokens and liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their native tokens by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim staking rewards. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on validator performance and rebalance the staked assets among validators. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.1 native tokens. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: Stader offers the most convenient & safest way to maximize your returns on staking.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Manta Pacific and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates one-way transfers of a specific fungible token from a source chain to a destination chain, holding transferred tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's total deposited amount and the total amount bridged to the destination chain. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract and initiate a bridge operation, which locks their tokens and signals the destination chain to mint corresponding tokens. Only a designated operator can finalize a bridge operation, which deducts the bridged amount from the contract's total balance. A minimum deposit of 100 tokens is required for any bridge operation. A 0.1% fee is applied to all bridge operations, deducted from the amount transferred. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit and another event upon each successful bridge operation, including the sender's address, the amount, and a unique transaction identifier.
source_description: Bridge between Ethereum and Manta Pacific Chain.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Jackson Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding deposited collateral tokens for active predictions. It maintains individual user balances, open prediction positions, and global market parameters for each prediction event. Callers can create new prediction events, place bets on outcomes, claim winnings from settled events, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can settle prediction events by providing the winning outcome and can adjust the fee percentage. The fee for placing a bet is 1% of the bet amount, and a minimum bet amount of 100 units of the collateral token is enforced. The contract emits an event when a new prediction market is created, when a bet is placed, and when a market is settled.
source_description: Jackson.io is a leading decentralized GameFi platform and liquidity protocol on the Sui blockchain, leveraging Move-based ecosystems to deliver a seamless, equitable gaming and DeFi experience. It forms a core infrastructure pillar, empowering players, liquidity providers, developers, and the expanding DeFi community with transparent profit-sharing

description: Create a governance contract based on Aumo and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a treasury for a decentralized autonomous organization, holding a stablecoin and managing its allocation across various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of the total stablecoin balance, the allocation to each approved strategy, and configuration parameters for risk limits and strategy approvals. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the treasury, and a designated operator can initiate stablecoin transfers to approved strategies, redeem funds from strategies, and update strategy allocations. Only the designated operator can approve new strategies, set risk limits for each strategy, and pause or unpause the treasury's operations. The maximum allocation to any single strategy is 30% of the total treasury balance, and a 24-hour delay is enforced before any new strategy approval becomes active. The contract announces events for stablecoin deposits, stablecoin withdrawals, strategy allocations, and changes to strategy approvals or risk limits.
source_description: An autonomous stablecoin treasury that uses an AI agent to allocate USDT0 across lending and tokenized RWA yield strategies within onchain risk limits

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Lombard BTC.b and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the secure, non-custodial bridging of a specific external blockchain's native asset onto this blockchain, holding the bridged asset in escrow. It maintains a mapping of each user's deposited amount of the external asset, a total supply of the wrapped token, and a configuration for the bridge fee. Callers can deposit the external asset to mint an equivalent amount of a wrapped token, and they can redeem the wrapped token to withdraw the external asset. A designated operator is privileged to pause and unpause the bridging functionality and to update the bridge fee. The maximum bridge fee is 0.5% of the transaction value, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.0001 units of the external asset. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address, the amount, and a unique transaction identifier.
source_description: BTC.b — is Bitcoin, bridged — decentralized, non-custodial, permissionless Bitcoin for DeFi

description: Define an NFT contract based on Collection.xyz and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates automated trading of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and custodies deposited NFTs and fungible tokens. It maintains records of individual user positions, NFT liquidity pools, and global configuration parameters. Callers can deposit NFTs or fungible tokens into pools, withdraw their deposited assets, swap fungible tokens for NFTs from a pool, or swap NFTs for fungible tokens from a pool. A designated operator can adjust pool parameters like pricing curves, and the contract owner can set the global protocol fee. Each NFT pool must contain at least one NFT and at least 100 fungible tokens. The protocol charges a 0.5% fee on all fungible token swaps. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, swaps, and changes to pool parameters or global fees.
source_description: Collection.xyz NFT DEX AMM | Automatically buy, sell & earn yield on your NFTs | Pool NFTs based on token IDs, traits or rarity | Composable with DeFi / NFTfi protocols, enjoy 0% protocol fees, live on Ethereum Mainnet.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on WagmiDAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's treasury, holding various reserve assets and its native token. It maintains records of each user's staked native tokens, the total supply of the native token, and the current exchange rates between reserve assets and the native token. Callers can deposit reserve assets to mint native tokens, withdraw reserve assets by burning native tokens, and stake native tokens to earn rewards. A designated operator can update the exchange rates and adjust staking reward parameters. The minimum deposit amount for any reserve asset is 100 units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and staking actions to observers.
source_description: WagmiDAO is the first multichain reserve-backed decentralised exchange (RDEX). It’s focused on continuously growing its own Treasury and the value of its native token.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on dYdX V4 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in various approved tokens. It maintains individual account balances for each collateral token, open positions for each trading pair including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters such as minimum initial margin requirements and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify leverage on open positions, and initiate liquidations of under-collateralized accounts. A designated operator can add new trading pairs, adjust trading fees, and pause all trading operations in an emergency. The minimum initial margin for any new position is 10% of the position's value, and a liquidation fee of 0.5% of the liquidated position's value is applied. The contract emits an event for every deposit, withdrawal, position opening, position closing, and successful liquidation.
source_description: dYdX Chain Mainnet, a robust blockchain built with the CosmosSDK. This documentation is diligently maintained by the dYdX Operations subDAO to provide a comprehensive resource for validators, developers, and the dYdX community at large.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Endurance Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the one-way bridging of a specific ERC-20 token from a source chain to a destination chain, holding a reserve of the bridged token on the source chain. It maintains a mapping of destination chain addresses to the amount of bridged token they are entitled to receive, and a record of each bridge transaction's unique identifier and its status. Callers can initiate a bridge transfer by depositing tokens and specifying a destination address, and can claim their tokens on the destination chain once the transfer is processed. A designated operator is privileged to mark bridge transfers as processed, enabling claims on the destination chain, and can adjust the bridging fee. The maximum amount of tokens that can be bridged in a single transaction is 10,000 tokens, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from each initiated bridge transfer. The contract announces the initiation of a bridge transfer, including the source address, destination address, amount, and a unique identifier, and also announces when a bridge transfer has been successfully processed.
source_description: Bridge between Endurance and BSC for ACE

description: Specify an on-chain insurance contract based on Ante Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a mechanism for users to stake funds against the continued correct operation of a designated external smart contract, holding staked tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's staked amount, the specific external contract they are staking against, and a global pool of rewards for successful attestations. Callers can stake tokens, withdraw their unstaked tokens, and attest to a failure in the designated external contract. A designated operator can declare a failure event for a specific external contract, triggering a payout to successful attestors and a slashing of stakers. The contract owner can set the designated external contract and the reward rate for successful attestations. A minimum stake of 100 units of the staked token is required for any new stake, and a 1% fee is applied to all successful attestor payouts. The contract announces when a new stake is made, when a stake is withdrawn, when a failure attestation is submitted, and when a failure event is declared.
source_description: Smart Tests for Smart Contracts

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Augur and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized prediction markets, holding deposited collateral in escrow for active markets. It maintains records of open markets, participant positions within each market, and the total collateral locked per market, alongside a global configuration for fees. Callers can create new markets, place bets on market outcomes, claim winnings from resolved markets, and withdraw their unspent collateral. A designated operator is privileged to resolve market outcomes and update the global fee percentage. A market creation fee of 0.5% of the initial collateral must be paid in the market's collateral token. The maximum number of outcomes for any market is 10. The contract announces market creation, bet placement, market resolution, and winning claims to observers.
source_description: A transparent exchange with no limit on what you can bet on, no max limits on the amount you can bet and no rollover requirements.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on CLever and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a leveraged yield-generating position, holding deposited base tokens and their corresponding yield-bearing tokens. It maintains records of each user's deposited base tokens, their accrued yield, and the configuration parameters for leverage. Callers can deposit base tokens, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, claim rewards from the leveraged position, and repay outstanding leverage. A designated operator can adjust the leverage ratio within predefined bounds and initiate the harvesting and re-investment of yield. The maximum leverage ratio is capped at 2.0x, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all claimed rewards. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events.
source_description: CLever is a leverage system for CVX holders that allows them to multiply their bribe and reward income by up to ~2x, while automating harvesting and swapping into CVX.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on PotatoSwap V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token swaps and liquidity provision, holding deposited tokens within various trading pools. It maintains records of each user's liquidity positions, the balances of all token pairs within each pool, and global configuration parameters such as trading fees and the address of a designated fee recipient. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, add tokens to existing positions, remove tokens from their positions, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated owner can update the trading fee percentage, add new token pairs to be traded, and pause all trading and liquidity operations in an emergency. The maximum trading fee is 0.5% of the swapped amount, and the minimum initial liquidity for any new pool must be at least 100 units of each token in the pair. The contract announces events for all token swaps, liquidity additions, and liquidity removals, including the tokens involved and the quantities exchanged.
source_description: Discover Liquidity. Or Potatoes. Or a DEX + Launchpad natively built for the XLayerOfficial ecosystem.

description: Design a lending protocol based on MetalX Lending and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued loan tokens. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, borrowed loan amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global pool parameters such as interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow loan tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and collateral factors, and initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrower is 75%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all loan originations. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the affected account, asset, and amount.
source_description: MetalX Lending is a DeFi lending protocol powered by the XPR Network

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on ELFi Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pooled derivatives trading system, holding various stablecoins and non-stablecoins as collateral. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each account, and global configuration parameters for trading. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust global risk parameters, and only the owner can upgrade the contract or pause all trading. A maximum of 10,000 units of any single collateral asset can be deposited into the pool per day, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and position changes as events.
source_description: ELFi Protocol stands out in the DeFi space with its innovative ELP liquidity architecture, offering stablecoin yield products with highly competitive rates and high-yield products linked to non-stablecoins.
