As the first platform to integrate portfolio margining and pooled trading, ELFi enables zero-slippage trading and advanced risk management at the account level.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Unihood and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad and liquidity manager, responsible for creating new token pools and holding the initial supply of launched tokens. It maintains a record of each launched token's associated liquidity pool address and the distribution percentages for swap fees. Callers can launch a new token, which creates a new trading pool and seeds it with the entire initial token supply, and can swap tokens within existing pools. The designated platform administrator can set the platform fee percentage and update the fee distribution percentages for creator, bid wall, and platform shares. A new token launch always deploys one billion units of the new token into the pool as single-sided liquidity, and the platform fee is fixed at 1% of the base asset side of every swap. The contract emits an event when a new token is launched, including its address and the associated pool address, and also emits an event whenever the fee distribution percentages are updated.
source_description: UNIHOOD is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain where every token trades in a Uniswap V4 pool from launch. The factory places the full 1B supply as single-sided liquidity with no withdrawal path, and a global hook routes the 1% swap fee on the ETH side (80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform)

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Punk.Coffee and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market, custodying user deposits in an escrow pool. It maintains individual user balances for each market, a total escrow balance per market, and a global configuration for market creation parameters. Callers can create new prediction markets, place predictions on existing markets, resolve markets by providing an outcome, and claim winnings from resolved markets. A designated operator can pause and unpause all market activity, and can set the fee percentage for market creation. Market creation requires a minimum deposit of 100 base tokens. A 0.5% fee is applied to all market creation deposits, which is sent to a designated treasury address. The contract announces market creation, prediction placement, market resolution, and winning claims through events.
source_description: Punk.Coffee is an open, permissionless prediction market protocol for the crypto-native community.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Jarvis Network and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates synthetic asset creation and redemption, holding deposited collateral tokens to back the synthetic assets. It maintains individual user balances for each synthetic asset, a global collateral pool for each accepted collateral type, and configuration parameters for each synthetic asset such as its collateralization ratio and associated oracle. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic assets against their deposited collateral, redeem synthetic assets to reclaim collateral, and transfer synthetic assets to other users. A designated owner can add new synthetic assets, update oracle addresses, adjust collateralization ratios, and pause all minting and redemption operations. The minimum collateralization ratio for any synthetic asset is 150%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all synthetic asset minting operations. The contract emits an event whenever synthetic assets are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when new collateral is deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: Jarvis Network is a set of protocols to gain exposure to the price of any asset against liquidity pools.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Twyne and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates credit delegation, allowing lenders to delegate their unused borrowing capacity to borrowers, and custodies no assets directly. It maintains per-lender records of delegated credit lines, per-borrower records of active loans, and a global configuration for fees and limits. Callers can delegate credit, borrow against delegated credit, repay loans, and withdraw delegated credit. Only the owner can set the delegation fee, adjust the maximum delegation amount, or pause new delegations. The maximum delegation amount for any single lender is 100,000 units of the underlying asset, and a 0.5% delegation fee is applied to each new delegation. The contract announces events for new delegations, loan originations, loan repayments, and delegation withdrawals.
source_description: Twyne is a credit delegation protocol built on top of existing lending markets such as Aave and Euler. It lets lenders delegate their unused borrowing power to borrowers seeking higher liquidation thresholds

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Hinkal and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a single specified fungible token by acting as a temporary escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposit balance, a global total deposit, and a configuration for the current deposit fee. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract, initiate a private transfer by providing a zero-knowledge proof, and withdraw their tokens. Only the contract owner can set the deposit fee, which must be between 0 and 100 basis points, and designate an operator address allowed to pause all transfer operations. The contract announces successful deposits, successful withdrawals, and the initiation of private transfers.
source_description: Hinkal is an institutional-grade protocol enabling confidential on-chain transactions. It is a category-defining solution, that allows liquid funds and retail users to create shielded addresses and transact on major dApps in complete confidentiality (the origin and destination of transaction, value).

description: Create a lending protocol based on Wildcat Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes undercollateralized credit lines for borrowers, holding no assets itself. It maintains records of each borrower's outstanding debt, available credit, and associated interest rates, alongside a global configuration for default interest and fee percentages. Callers can borrow funds against their established credit line, repay outstanding principal and accrued interest, and deposit collateral to increase their borrowing capacity. The designated administrator can create new credit lines for approved borrowers, adjust their individual interest rates, and set the global default interest rate and protocol fee percentage. A borrower's maximum available credit is capped at 500,000 units of the underlying asset, and the protocol charges a 0.5% fee on all interest payments. The contract announces when a new credit line is established and when a borrower defaults on their obligations.
source_description: Wildcat is a protocol that allows borrowers to deploy undercollateralised credit lines.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Liminal Basis and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-bearing vault for a single designated stablecoin, custodying deposited stablecoins and managing their deployment into an external yield-generating strategy. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance and their share of the total vault, along with the current total stablecoin assets under management and the vault's share price. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their stablecoin balance, and claim any accumulated yield. Only the designated operator can initiate a rebalance of the underlying strategy or update the external yield-generating strategy's address. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is enforced, and withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, each including the user's address and the amount of stablecoins involved.
source_description: Liminal is designed to capture yield sources offered by Hyperliquid and distribute them through fully automated strategies across all ecosystems

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Metronome Synth and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for managing synthetic asset creation and exchange, and it custodies various collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user positions, recording the type and amount of collateral provided, the synthetic assets minted, and any outstanding debt, alongside global configuration parameters like collateralization ratios and supported synthetic assets. Callers can deposit collateral, mint synthetic assets against their collateral, burn synthetic assets to repay debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated administrator can set new collateralization ratios, add new synthetic asset types, and pause all user operations in an emergency. The minimum collateralization ratio for any synthetic asset is 150%, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all synthetic asset minting operations. The contract announces events for all deposits, mints, burns, and withdrawals, as well as changes to global configuration parameters.
source_description: Metronome Synth is a leading synthetic protocol that enables users to post multi-collateral assets from their existing crypto holdings and create a multitude of synthetic assets in one complete platform. Synth will enable the creation of crypto synthetic assets, and the ability to swap synthetic assets with zero-slippage.

description: Model a lending protocol based on JustLend V1 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a decentralized lending market, holding deposited fungible tokens and issuing corresponding interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains per-asset records including total supply, total borrowed, current interest rates, and per-user records of deposits and borrows, alongside global configuration parameters for interest rate models. Callers can deposit fungible tokens, borrow fungible tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding borrows, and withdraw their deposited fungible tokens. A designated administrator can adjust interest rate model parameters and pause borrowing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.05% origination fee is charged on all new borrows. The contract announces events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and changes to interest rate parameters.
source_description: JustLend is a TRON-powered coin market protocol aimed at establishing fund pools whose interest rates are determined by an algorithm based on the supply and demand of TRON assets.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Katana DEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and provides liquidity for trading pairs, custodying deposited tokens within its pools. It maintains state for each trading pair, including token reserves, accumulated fees, and liquidity provider token balances for each user. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap tokens between pairs. Only the owner can create new trading pairs and adjust the swap fee, which is initially set to 0.3% and can be changed in increments of 0.01% up to a maximum of 1%. The contract announces events for liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the users performing the actions.
source_description: Katana a DEX For Ronin

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Aztec Connect and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a privacy-preserving deposit and withdrawal gateway, holding user-deposited Ether and a single designated ERC-20 token. It maintains a Merkle tree of encrypted notes representing private balances and a public record of each user's total deposited Ether and ERC-20 token. Callers can deposit Ether or the designated ERC-20 token, withdraw their private balances using a zero-knowledge proof, and register a new recipient for a private transfer. Only a designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and process withdrawal requests after verifying the associated zero-knowledge proof. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, and the maximum deposit for a single transaction is 100 Ether or 10,000 units of the designated ERC-20 token. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and Merkle tree root update, including the relevant amounts and new state root.
source_description: Aztec is building an open source layer 2 network on Ethereum. Aztec's layer 2 network uses zkSNARK proofs to extend Ethereum's functionality with the addition of private state.

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Ekubo and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token exchange through concentrated liquidity pools and custodies deposited tokens within those pools. It maintains a record of each liquidity provider's positions, including their deposited token amounts and active price ranges, as well as global configuration parameters for each pool. Callers can create new liquidity pools, add liquidity to existing pools, remove liquidity from their positions, and swap tokens between pools. The contract owner can set the protocol fee for swaps and update the list of allowed token pairs. A swap transaction will incur a 0.05% protocol fee, and a newly created pool must have a minimum initial liquidity of 100 units of either token. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps to observers.
source_description: Ekubo Protocol is a dex built for Starknet, that features concentrated liquidity, a singleton architecture, and extensions

description: Outline a token contract based on Chainchat and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages on-chain group chat memberships and message posting. It maintains a record of each chat's members, the chat's current message count, and a global counter for unique chat identifiers. Callers can create new chats, join existing chats, post messages to chats they are members of, and leave chats. A designated operator can pause all chat creation and message posting, and can also remove any member from any chat. Creating a new chat requires a deposit of 0.01 ether, which is non-refundable. Posting a message to a chat costs 0.0001 ether per message. The contract emits an event when a new chat is created, when a user joins or leaves a chat, and when a message is posted, including the chat identifier, the sender, and a hash of the message content.
source_description: Onchain group chats. By zapper_fi. Available on BuildOnBase

description: Model a lending protocol based on Scallop Lend and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a decentralized lending market, holding deposited tokens as collateral and issuing new tokens representing debt. It maintains per-asset pools tracking total deposits, total borrows, and interest rates, alongside per-user records for individual deposits and borrows for each asset. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposits, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay their loans, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rate parameters and add or remove supported assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 80%, and a liquidation penalty of 5% is applied to the borrower's outstanding debt. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Scallop is the pioneering Next Generation Money Market for the Sui ecosystem which emphasizes institutional-grade quality, enhanced composability, and robust security.

description: Create an NFT contract based on NextRare and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital collectibles, each with a rarity and a set of attributes, and facilitates their distribution through a randomized drawing mechanism. It maintains a registry of all minted collectibles, tracking their current owner, and stores configuration parameters for the drawing process. Callers can participate in a drawing by submitting a payment, claim newly drawn collectibles, and transfer collectibles they own to other accounts. The contract owner can configure drawing parameters such as the price per drawing attempt and the probability distribution of rarities, and can mint new collectibles into the system. Each drawing attempt costs 0.01 ether, and a maximum of 10,000 collectibles can ever be minted. The contract announces when a new collectible has been minted and when a collectible has been transferred.
source_description: First perpetual TCG Gacha live on iOS and Android

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Sygnum FIUSD Liquidity Fund and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for tokenizing a share of an institutional money market fund, custodying the fund shares themselves as an off-chain asset. It maintains individual balances for each token holder and a total supply of tokens, along with a configurable daily redemption limit and a list of authorized participants. Callers can deposit fiat currency to mint tokens, redeem tokens for fiat currency, and transfer tokens between authorized participants. A designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers, update the daily redemption limit, and add or remove authorized participants. The daily redemption limit for all participants combined is capped at 1,000,000 units of the underlying asset. All redemption requests are subject to a 24-hour waiting period before processing. The contract announces token transfers, minting events, and redemption requests to observers.
source_description: This project focuses on the tokenization of Fidelity International's Money Market Fund by Sygnum Bank, specifically the Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund (ILF) USD Fund Class G Acc. Sygnum Bank is the token issuer of the above mentioned.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Revert Lend and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates borrowing ERC-20 tokens against concentrated liquidity positions, holding deposited ERC-20 tokens and non-fungible tokens representing concentrated liquidity positions as collateral. It maintains records of each user's borrowed amount, deposited collateral positions, and the configuration for each borrowable ERC-20 token, including interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit non-fungible token collateral, borrow ERC-20 tokens, repay borrowed amounts, and withdraw their collateral once all loans are repaid. A designated operator can update interest rate models and collateral factors for specific ERC-20 tokens, and the owner can pause all borrowing and lending activity. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral position is 70%, and a liquidation penalty of 5% is applied to the borrower's outstanding debt during liquidation. The contract announces events for deposits, borrows, repayments, liquidations, and configuration changes.
source_description: Revert Lend is a decentralized lending platform for Uniswap v3 Liquidity Providers. It lets users use their Uniswap v3 positions as collateral to borrow ERC-20 tokens.

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Zapfi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a privacy mixer that custodies deposited tokens. It maintains a list of unspent deposit commitments, a total deposit amount for each supported token, and a configuration for each mixer instance including its denomination and the token it accepts. Callers can deposit tokens by providing a cryptographic commitment, withdraw tokens by providing a valid proof and a nullifier, and relay a withdrawal for another user. The owner can add new mixer instances, update the fee percentage, and designate new relayers. A deposit must be for the exact denomination configured for that mixer instance, and a withdrawal incurs a 0.1% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces new deposits, successful withdrawals, and changes to the fee percentage.
source_description: Zapfi is a decentralized, non-custodial privacy protocol that allows users to send, deposit, and withdraw cryptocurrency without revealing their transaction

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Idols and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of non-fungible tokens (NFTs), each representing a share of staked Ether, and custodies the underlying staked Ether. It maintains a record for each NFT of its unique identifier, its current owner, and the amount of staked Ether it represents, along with a global total of all staked Ether held. Callers can mint new NFTs by depositing staked Ether, transfer ownership of their NFTs, and burn their NFTs to redeem the underlying staked Ether. A designated operator can pause or unpause all minting and redemption operations. The minimum amount of staked Ether required to mint a new NFT is 0.1 Ether. The contract emits an event whenever an NFT is minted, transferred, or burned, including the NFT's identifier and the relevant addresses.
source_description: The first staked ETH NFT. A 100% community aligned project which rewards NFT holders and protocol token stakers.

description: Outline a token contract based on Cook Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of diverse digital assets, enabling users to invest in predefined strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets, their shares in various index baskets, and the current composition and value of each index. Callers can deposit assets into an index, withdraw their proportional share of assets from an index, and redeem their index shares for the underlying assets. A designated operator can create new index baskets, adjust the asset allocation within an existing index, and update the fees associated with each index. The contract charges a 0.5% management fee on the total value of assets within each index, and a 0.1% redemption fee when users withdraw assets. The maximum number of distinct assets in any single index is limited to 10. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, index rebalances, and fee updates.
source_description: Cook Finance is a transparent and flexible DeFi Index platform. This two sided platform is suited to a diverse range of users to make it easy to select from a menu of indexes across multiple chains. At the same time on the other side of the platform, index creators can utilize tools to create virtually any imaginable strategy and easily offer it up to the Cook community.

description: Outline a token contract based on fan.fun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a content creator's social token, enabling fans to purchase and trade shares representing access to exclusive content. It maintains individual fan balances of the creator's social token, a total supply of the token, and a bonding curve configuration for pricing. Callers can purchase tokens from the bonding curve, sell tokens back to the bonding curve, and transfer tokens to other fans. The creator is privileged and can set the initial bonding curve parameters and withdraw accumulated protocol fees. A 5% protocol fee is applied to all token purchases and sales, and the total supply of the creator's social token is capped at 1,000,000 units. The contract announces when tokens are purchased, sold, or transferred.
source_description: fan.fun enables creators to monetize exclusive content and engage in social trading, all built on Hyperliquid

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on VVS Standard and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's liquidity pools, holding pairs of fungible tokens provided by users. It maintains records of each liquidity pool's token reserves and the total supply of its corresponding liquidity provider tokens, along with each user's balance of these liquidity provider tokens. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap tokens between pools, and approve spending of their tokens by other addresses. A designated administrator can set the swap fee percentage and add new token pairs to be traded. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and the minimum initial liquidity required to create a new pool is 100 units of each token in the pair. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added or removed from a pool, and whenever a token swap occurs, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: VVS is designed to be the simplest DeFi platform for users to swap tokens, earn high yields, and most importantly have fun!

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Silent Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables private transfers of a designated fungible token by acting as a shielded pool for deposits and withdrawals. It maintains a Merkle tree of commitment hashes for all deposited tokens, along with a mapping of each commitment hash to its corresponding nullifier, and a record of the total unspent value in the pool. Callers can deposit tokens, generating a new commitment, and withdraw tokens by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof that they possess a commitment not yet nullified. A designated operator can update the root of the Merkle tree and set the withdrawal fee. The maximum withdrawal amount per transaction is 1000 of the designated token, and a flat fee of 0.01 of the designated token is charged for each withdrawal. The contract announces the hash of each new commitment when a deposit occurs and the nullifier of each spent commitment when a withdrawal is processed.
source_description: Silent Protocol is a privacy-preserving infrastructure on Ethereum that enables compliant and composable privacy for transactions and dApps. It uses the EZEE framework to separate encryption from execution, allowing private smart contract interactions. Its modular Layer 1.5 Ghost Layer, powered by zero-knowledge proofs and 0VM, supports secure private asset transfers and privacy-enabled dApp interactions via 0dapps.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Kadena Cabinet and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a community governance system, holding deposited tokens to enable voting and reward distribution. It maintains individual user balances of locked tokens, records of votes cast per proposal, and a pool of reward tokens for distribution. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their unlocked tokens, create new proposals, vote on active proposals, and claim earned rewards. A designated administrator can initiate new voting rounds, set the reward rate, and pause deposits in emergencies. Each user must lock a minimum of 100 tokens to participate in voting, and proposals remain open for exactly 7 days. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, votes are cast, and rewards are claimed.
source_description: Kadena Cabinet is a community advisory board where users can lock their $KDA to gain the ability to vote in polls on ecosystem-based proposals. Through their participation in polls, users can earn $KDA rewards.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on HyperSwap V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token exchanges and liquidity provision, holding deposited tokens within its pools. It maintains records of each liquidity provider's deposited amounts and their corresponding shares in specific liquidity pools, along with global configuration settings for fees and protocol parameters. Callers can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their liquidity, swap tokens between supported pairs, and claim accrued trading fees. A designated administrator can set the base trading fee, add new token pairs, and update the protocol's treasury address. The maximum trading fee is 0.5% of the swapped amount, and a minimum of 100 base tokens must be deposited to create a new liquidity pool. The contract emits events for every token swap, liquidity deposit, and liquidity withdrawal, detailing the tokens involved and their quantities.
source_description: Explore token swaps, liquidity management and easy token launches

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on SoDEX Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on the source chain and releasing native tokens on the destination chain. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped token deposits and corresponding withdrawal requests, along with a global configuration for supported assets and bridge operators. Callers can deposit supported wrapped tokens, initiate a withdrawal request for native tokens on a linked chain, and claim their native tokens once the request is fulfilled. Only a designated operator can approve withdrawal requests, marking them as fulfilled. The contract charges a flat fee of 0.1% on all deposits, and a single withdrawal request cannot exceed 10,000 units of any supported token. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, a withdrawal request is initiated, or a withdrawal request is fulfilled.
source_description: SoDEX is a high-performance order book decentralized exchange (DEX) built on ValueChain.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on iDos Games and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a launchpad for new web3 projects, custodying project tokens deposited by project creators and funds contributed by participants. It maintains a list of approved projects, each with its funding goal, current contributions, and a record of individual participant contributions per project. Callers can contribute funds to an active project, and project creators can initiate a project launch, withdraw their project tokens after a successful launch, or reclaim them if the launch fails. The owner can approve new projects, set the platform fee, and designate operators. A project launch requires a minimum funding goal of 100 units of the contribution currency, and a 5% platform fee is applied to all successful project fundraises. The contract announces when a project is launched, when a project fails to meet its funding goal, and when a participant contributes to a project.
source_description: Multichain Web3 games/apps launchpad. It is a decentralized platform of the new generation that allows developers to launch their cross-platform Web3 games and AI applications with just one click. We provide a complete set of technologies and ready-to-use infrastructure, including blockchain integration, NFT support, cryptocurrency payments, cross-platform compatibility, analytics, and LiveOps services.

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Guard-Helmet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer price protection policies for various crypto assets, holding deposited collateral in an escrow. It maintains individual policy records including asset type, strike price, expiration, and collateral amount, along with a global registry of active policies and a configurable fee structure. Callers can create new policies by specifying an asset, strike price, and duration, deposit collateral to fund a policy, claim protection if the asset price falls below the strike price at expiration, and withdraw their collateral if the policy expires without a claim. An owner role can set the premium fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of the policy's value, and designate allowed collateral tokens. Policies have a minimum duration of 24 hours and a maximum duration of 90 days. The contract emits events when a new policy is created, collateral is deposited, a claim is successfully processed, or collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: Guard.insure is a peer-to-peer (P2P) price-shield insurance protocol launched on Binance Smart Chain (BSC) fistly with the form of helmet.insure and now multi-chained to support Polygon net with the aim to redefine option trading with user-friendly insurance policy wrapping. Guard allows users to create an insurance policy for any crypto asset in the market, protecting DeFi users against the risk of price fluctuations. Policy trading on Guard is market-oriented without complex mathematics. There are two kinds of policy which could be involved in mining: SHORT Tokens and LONG tokens.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Coffin Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stable token system, holding a native platform token and a volatile collateral token. It tracks each user's collateral deposits, minted stable tokens, and any accrued interest, along with global reserves of both collateral types and the current collateralization ratio. Users can deposit collateral, mint stable tokens against their collateral, repay stable tokens, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio within a range of 100% to 200% and pause minting in emergencies. Minting new stable tokens requires a minimum collateralization ratio of 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stable token minting operations. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, mints, and repayments, including the user's address, the token amount, and the transaction type.
source_description: Coffin Finance protocol is a partially collateralized stable token project. Coffin Finance team believes in the potential of Fantom Opera, so rather than using USDC, it uses FTM and COFFIN (the protocol's native token) as collaterals to mint CoUSD stable tokens. This makes it truly decentralized! A big part of the platform revenue will be given back to the community through its high yield farming options, which includes both staking liquidity pairs and single asset staking.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Inverse Finance FiRM and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a fixed-rate borrowing market for a stablecoin, holding deposited collateral tokens and stablecoin liquidity. It maintains per-account records of collateral deposited, stablecoin borrowed, and a borrowing right token balance, along with global configuration for interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin loans, withdraw excess collateral, and transfer borrowing right tokens. Only a designated administrator may adjust interest rate models, set collateral factors for approved collateral types, and pause borrowing or depositing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral type is 75%. All stablecoin loans incur a fixed annual interest rate of 5%. The contract announces events for deposits, borrows, repays, withdrawals, and administrator actions.
source_description: FiRM is a Fixed Rate Market protocol to borrow the DOLA usd stablecoin at a fixed-rate with the DOLA Borrowing Right token DBR.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on PumpSwap and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of new token pairs, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each token pair's base token reserves, project token reserves, and a trading fee percentage. Callers can create a new token pair by depositing a minimum amount of base token and specifying a project token supply, add liquidity to an existing pair, remove liquidity from a pair, and swap base tokens for project tokens or vice-versa. The contract owner can set a global trading fee, which defaults to 0.5%, and pause all trading activity. New token pairs must be initialized with at least 100 base tokens. All swaps emit an event detailing the tokens swapped, amounts, and the account performing the swap.
source_description: The native dex for pump.fun

description: Design a staking contract based on StakeStone STONE and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base asset, holding deposited tokens and issuing a liquid staking derivative in return. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking derivative, a mapping of user balances for the derivative, and a configuration for the current exchange rate between the base asset and the derivative. Callers can deposit the base asset, withdraw their deposited base asset by burning the derivative, and redeem their derivative for the underlying base asset. A designated operator can update the exchange rate and initiate rebalancing operations. The contract imposes a 0.1% withdrawal fee on all base asset withdrawals. The exchange rate can only be updated once every 24 hours. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: One-Stop Staking Protocol For Omnichain LST Liquidity.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Anzen V2 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin, USDz, backed by tokenized real-world assets held in custody. It maintains each user's USDz balance, the total supply of USDz, and a registry of approved real-world asset tokens and their current valuations. Callers can mint USDz by depositing approved real-world asset tokens, redeem USDz for an equivalent value of approved real-world asset tokens, and transfer USDz to other users. A designated operator can approve new real-world asset tokens for backing, update the valuation of approved real-world asset tokens, and pause all minting and redemption operations. Minting requires a minimum deposit value of 1000 USDz, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all redemption transactions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the amount and the involved parties.
source_description: USDz is a digital dollar backed by institutional grade real world assets

description: Outline an NFT contract based on TNA Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the registration and ownership of unique, human-readable identifiers, acting as a registry for these identifiers and their associated data. It maintains a mapping of each registered identifier to its current owner, a resolver address, and a creation timestamp, along with a global configuration for registration fees and minimum identifier lengths. Callers can register new identifiers, transfer ownership of their identifiers to another address, and update the resolver address associated with their owned identifiers. The contract owner can set the registration fee, which is a fixed amount of the native blockchain currency, and can also set the minimum allowed length for new identifiers, which must be at least 3 characters. All registration and transfer operations emit an event announcing the identifier, its new owner, and the associated resolver.
source_description: The naming protocol for Bitcoin designed to improve its usability and broaden its array of assets and primitives.

description: Define a lending protocol based on Sovryn Zero and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued loan tokens. It maintains individual loan positions, tracking collateral amounts, outstanding debt, and accrued interest for each borrower, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and liquidation parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow loan tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust the base interest rate and liquidation thresholds, and can initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions. The maximum loan-to-value ratio is fixed at 75%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to all liquidated positions. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: Sovryn is a non-custodial and permission-less smart contract based system for bitcoin lending, borrowing and margin trading.

description: Model a staking contract based on Avalon CeDeFi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing liquid staking tokens representing a claim on those assets plus accrued yield. It maintains a total supply of liquid staking tokens, a total amount of base assets deposited, and per-account balances of liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit base assets to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards from their staked position. A designated operator can initiate withdrawals from an underlying yield-generating protocol and deposit earned rewards back into the vault. The owner can set the operator address and adjust the withdrawal fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event when base assets are deposited, when base assets are withdrawn, and when rewards are added.
source_description: Powering ₿itcoin's On-Chain Capital Markets.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Enosys AMM V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity positions for token pairs, holding deposited tokens and tracking their value. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, including their token amounts, price ranges, and accumulated fees, alongside global pool state such as current prices and fee growth. Callers can create new liquidity positions, add to existing positions, remove liquidity, collect accumulated fees, and swap tokens within a pool. Only the designated owner can update the protocol-wide fee tier configuration or pause all trading activity. Each liquidity position must specify a price range with a minimum tick spacing of 10 basis points between the upper and lower bounds. A 0.3% fee is charged on all token swaps, which is distributed proportionally to active liquidity providers. The contract announces all liquidity provision events, token swaps, and fee collection actions.
source_description: Uniswap v3 fork on Songbird

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on CatsApes and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the minting and ownership of unique in-game character NFTs, representing various species and classes within the game world. It maintains a record of each character's species, class, and current owner, along with a total count of characters minted for each species. Callers can mint new characters, transfer ownership of their characters to another account, and burn characters they own. Only a designated operator can set the base minting fee for new characters and approve new species for minting. A maximum of 10,000 characters can be minted for any single species, and the initial minting fee for any character is 0.05 units of the native blockchain currency. The contract announces when a new character is minted, when a character's ownership changes, and when a character is burned.
source_description: Catsapes is a sandbox MMORPG where you can forge a unique path for yourself and your race. Catsapes is a blockchain based fantasy-survival role playing game where the users can explore the planet called Arilia.

description: Design a staking contract based on NodeDAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract custodies deposited Ether and issues a corresponding liquid staking token representing a claim on the staked Ether plus accrued rewards. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the amount of Ether deposited by each user, and a global staking ratio that determines the amount of liquid staking tokens issued per Ether. Callers can deposit Ether to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw their share of staked Ether and rewards. The owner can set the staking fee, which is initially 5%, and can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations in an emergency. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 Ether. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the staking ratio.
source_description: Experience the ease of staking on Ethereum 2.0 through NodeDAO's liquid staking service.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Forge Game and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages player progression and resource ownership within an on-chain RPG, holding player-owned tokens representing in-game items and resources. It maintains individual player records including experience points, current level, and quantities of various item types. Callers can perform actions such as leveling up their character, crafting new items from existing resources, and consuming items for in-game effects. A designated operator is privileged to mint new item tokens and adjust crafting recipes. Players must reach level 5 before they can craft rare items, and crafting a legendary item requires a 10-block delay before the item is delivered. The contract announces player level-ups and successful item crafts to observers.
source_description: Mini RPG game in Telegram.

description: Create a token contract based on Reserve Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of collateral assets to back a new stable token, holding the specified collateral tokens in escrow. It maintains the current collateral basket composition, the total supply of the stable token, and each user's balance of the stable token. Callers can mint new stable tokens by depositing the required collateral, redeem stable tokens for their underlying collateral, and transfer stable tokens to other users. A designated operator can adjust the collateral basket composition and update the oracle addresses used for pricing. The maximum number of collateral tokens in the basket is 10. A 0.1% fee is applied to all redemption operations, payable in the redeemed collateral assets. The contract announces events for all minting, redemption, and transfer operations, as well as changes to the collateral basket or oracle configurations.
source_description: The Reserve Protocol is a platform which enables anyone to create yield-bearing, decentralized, and asset-backed currencies (RTokens). RTokens provide an alternative to inflation-prone currencies, empowering people to maintain their purchasing power over time and across borders

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on CACHE.Gold and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues and manages a token representing physical gold held in secure vaults. It maintains each user's token balance and a global record of total gold ounces represented by all tokens, along with a configurable fee percentage for redemptions. Callers can mint new tokens by depositing gold, transfer tokens to other users, and redeem tokens for physical gold. A designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers and redemptions, and only the contract owner can update the redemption fee percentage. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed gold amount, and redemptions are limited to a maximum of 1000 ounces per transaction. The contract announces all token transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: CACHE Gold tokens are fully compliant, public, transparent, redeemable gold-backed tokens

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Vena Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized money market, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing corresponding debt tokens. It maintains per-account records of deposits and borrows, global pools of available liquidity for each supported asset, and configurable interest rate models. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new supported collateral and borrow assets, adjust interest rate parameters, and pause borrowing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new borrows. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, and repayment events.
source_description: Vena is the credit layer where reputation directly affects the value of capital. Vena is launching as the native money market of Fluent

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Perpetual Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposits in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each trading pair, and global funding rates. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, add margin to existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed is 10x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract announces all position changes, liquidations, and funding rate updates.
source_description: Decentralized Perpetual Contracts for Every Asset.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on Bodega Market and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits and payouts in a base currency. It maintains a record of each market's state, including its event question, possible outcomes, resolution time, total staked amount per outcome, and the market's current status (open, resolved, or canceled). Callers can create a new market, place a bet on an outcome, redeem their winnings after a market resolves, or withdraw their initial stake if a market is canceled. A designated operator can resolve a market by declaring the winning outcome or cancel a market before its resolution time. New markets require a minimum initial stake of 100 units of the base currency to be created. A 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts, deducted before distribution. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when a bet is placed, when a market is resolved, and when a market is canceled.
source_description: Bodega Market is Cardano's leading decentralized prediction market platform that lets users bet on events and create their own markets for secure, transparent wagering.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Papa DAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, holding a basket of diverse digital assets as backing. It maintains a total supply of the reserve currency, the balance of each user's reserve currency, and the current value of each backing asset as reported by an external price oracle. Callers can mint new reserve currency by depositing approved backing assets, burn reserve currency to redeem a proportional share of backing assets, and transfer reserve currency to other users. A designated operator can add new backing assets to the approved list and adjust the minting fee. The minting fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited value, and a minimum of 100 units of reserve currency must be minted in any single transaction. The contract emits an event when reserve currency is minted, burned, or transferred, and when a new backing asset is approved.
source_description: $PAPA is a decentralized reserve currency that remains unbound by a peg - that is used in the #Metaverse. We back Metaverse & GameFi Projects.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Binaryx Platform and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the tokenization of real-world assets, specifically fractional ownership of real estate properties, and custodies the underlying asset tokens. It maintains a record of each property's total token supply, the current owner of each token, and a mapping of property identifiers to their associated legal documentation hashes. Callers can purchase fractional property tokens, transfer their owned tokens to another address, and redeem tokens for their underlying real-world asset share upon property sale. Only a designated operator can register new properties, mint new tokens for a property, or initiate a property sale. A maximum of 10,000 tokens can be minted for any single property. A 0.5% fee is applied to all token transfers, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces property registration events, token transfer events, and property sale initiation events to observers.
source_description: Binaryx Platform is an infrastructure layer for RWA tokenization that opens up new real estate trading & investing opportunities for everyone with an internationally compliant legal framework.

description: Model a governance contract based on UFarm Digital and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a registry of digital asset managers and their associated performance data, but it does not custody any digital assets itself. It maintains a record for each registered manager, including their unique identifier, a score representing their historical performance, and a timestamp of their last score update. Callers can register a new asset manager, update an existing manager's performance score, and retrieve a manager's current score and registration details. Only a designated operator can register new managers and update existing manager scores. A manager's score must be a positive integer between 1 and 100, inclusive, and a manager's score can only be updated once every 24 hours. The contract announces when a new manager is registered and when an existing manager's score has been updated.
source_description: UFarm.Digital makes managing digital assets simple and secure. Institutional investors find efficiency, and private investors get the best asset managers via the web-based app with an independent scoring system.

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Swaap Maker V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an automated market maker for two tokens, holding reserves of both tokens in a liquidity pool. It maintains the current reserves of each token, a record of each liquidity provider's share of the pool, and configurable trading fees. Callers can deposit both tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their share of liquidity, and swap one token for the other. A designated operator can adjust the trading fee and pause all trading operations. The trading fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and the maximum number of liquidity providers is capped at 1000. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added, removed, or a swap occurs.
source_description: Swaap enables you to earn real yield thanks to algorithmic market making.

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on StableHodl and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating stablecoin vault that custodies a single designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total deposited amount, and a current yield rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their deposited stablecoins, and claim accumulated yield. Only the owner can set the yield generation strategy, adjust the yield rate, and pause deposits. A minimum deposit of 100 units of the designated stablecoin is enforced, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: StableHodl is a Stablecoin Yield Generation platform powered by HeLa Network. StableHodl leverages funding arbitrage within crypto exchanges to optimize returns and generates yields, rewards stakers with HLUSD, the native stable coin of HeLa network.

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Usual EUR0 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a euro-pegged stablecoin, holding collateralized assets that back its value. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, a total supply of the stablecoin, and a record of the current collateralization ratio. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. The owner can approve new collateral types, set the collateralization ratio, and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 100%, and the maximum stablecoin supply is 1,000,000,000 units. The contract announces minting events, burning events, and transfers of stablecoins.
source_description: EUR0 is a euro-pegged stablecoin fully backed by EU-issued T-Bills.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Premia V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a peer-to-pool options market, holding deposited collateral tokens and issued option tokens. It maintains records of individual user positions, global liquidity pools for each option series, and configuration parameters like fees and collateral ratios. Callers can deposit collateral, mint new option tokens, exercise options, redeem expired options, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust global fees and add new supported option series, while the owner can upgrade the contract logic. The maximum leverage for any option series is capped at 10x, and a 0.1% protocol fee is applied to all option premium payments. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, option mints, exercises, and redemptions, including the relevant token amounts and user addresses.
source_description: Premia's automated options market enables best-in-class pricing based on realtime supply and demand, bringing fully-featured peer-to-pool trading and capital efficiency to DeFi options.

description: Create a staking contract based on Lido and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to deposit Ether to receive a liquid staking token representing their staked Ether and its accrued rewards. It maintains a global pool of deposited Ether, the total supply of the liquid staking token, and per-user balances of the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit Ether, withdraw their underlying Ether and accumulated rewards by burning their liquid staking tokens, and transfer their liquid staking tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the staking reward rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, and the maximum daily withdrawal amount is capped at 1000 Ether. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward rate updates.
source_description: Liquid staking for Ethereum and Polygon. Daily staking rewards, no lock ups.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on PulseX V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates trustless exchange of two different fungible tokens, holding reserves of both tokens in a liquidity pool. It maintains the current quantity of each token in the pool and a cumulative price for each token. Callers can add liquidity by depositing both tokens in proportion to the current reserves, remove liquidity by burning their liquidity tokens and receiving a proportional share of the reserves, and swap one token for another. The contract owner can update the fee percentage charged on swaps. Swaps incur a 0.3% fee, which is added to the liquidity pool. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added, removed, or a swap occurs, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: PulseX enables you to exchange tokens ("PRC20s") on PulseChain for one another

description: Model an on-chain insurance contract based on Solace and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a risk coverage provider, holding deposited collateral tokens to back against potential smart contract exploits. It maintains individual coverage policies for each user, recording their covered protocols, coverage amount, and active period, alongside a global pool of staked collateral and a configuration for risk parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase new coverage policies, extend existing policies, claim against an active policy, and withdraw their unstaked collateral. The owner can adjust coverage pricing, add or remove supported protocols, and pause all coverage purchases. A minimum coverage purchase is 100 units of the collateral token, and claims are subject to a 7-day review period before payout. The contract announces new coverage purchases, policy expirations, and successful claim payouts.
source_description: Solace protects your funds against smart-contracts exploits across 180+ protocols with an intelligent single policy that automatically adjusts coverage to changes in your portfolio. Solace underwrites risks with its owned capital, so the revenue from protocol's activities goes to stakers.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Bitmap Game and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages ownership and access permissions for digital land parcels within a metaverse, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a record of each parcel's current owner, a list of approved editors for each parcel, and a global configuration for parcel creation fees. Callers can claim an unowned parcel, transfer ownership of a parcel they own, add or remove an editor for a parcel they own, and retrieve ownership or editor information for any parcel. Only a designated operator can set the fee for claiming new parcels and pause or unpause the ability to claim new parcels. A parcel claim fee is fixed at 0.01 ether, and a maximum of 10 editors can be assigned to any single parcel. The contract announces when a parcel has been claimed, when its ownership has been transferred, and when an editor has been added or removed.
source_description: BitmapGame is a metaverse project centered around the bitmap ecosystem. Users can freely chat, edit their owned bitmaps, and explore or enter others’ bitmaps. Within the app, users can engage in various contracts and projects related to the bitmap ecosystem.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Moth Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin system, holding collateral in a designated stable asset. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, the collateral, and records of outstanding loans, along with system-wide configuration parameters like the collateralization ratio. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay loans, and withdraw excess collateral or stablecoins. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause or unpause minting. The minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces stablecoin minting and burning events, and changes to the collateralization ratio.
source_description: Earn premium yields through novel algo-collateralized token pegged to USDC.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Riddle and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens, holding deposited funds and the newly minted tokens for distribution. It maintains a record of each launch's configuration, including the token being launched, its total supply, the fundraising goal, and individual participant contributions. Callers can deposit funds into an active launch, claim their allocated tokens after a successful launch, or withdraw their deposited funds if a launch fails. Only a designated operator can initiate a new token launch, set its parameters, or finalize a launch. Each launch has a minimum fundraising goal of 100,000 units of the designated stablecoin, and a 2% fee is applied to all successful fundraises, directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event upon a new launch being created, and another when a participant successfully deposits funds.
source_description: Riddle is the first dedicated meme token launchpad built specifically for the XRPL EVM ecosystem.

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Nocturne and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables users to deposit and withdraw standard tokens privately, acting as a shielded vault for user-controlled funds. It maintains a record of each user's private balance and a global Merkle tree of deposit commitments. Callers can deposit tokens, generate and submit zero-knowledge proofs to spend their private balance, and withdraw tokens to a public address. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and set the withdrawal fee. The maximum single deposit amount is 1000 base units of any supported token. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made and when a withdrawal is processed.
source_description: Nocturne is a protocol enabling private accounts on Ethereum

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on RealtyX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages tokenized real estate assets, representing fractional ownership of properties, and custodies the underlying asset tokens. It maintains a registry of all tokenized properties, each with its unique identifier, total supply of fractional tokens, and a record of each holder's balance. Callers can purchase fractional tokens for listed properties, transfer their fractional tokens to other accounts, and redeem fractional tokens for the underlying asset when a property is liquidated. A designated operator can list new properties, set the fractional token supply for each property, and initiate property liquidations. The maximum number of fractional tokens for any single property is 1,000,000, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all token transfers, payable to the designated operator. The contract announces property listings, token transfers, and property liquidations to observers.
source_description: RealtyX is building an RWAfi platform that brings real estate onchain, offering yield-generating opportunities backed by real assets and connecting users to RWA, DeFi, and Web3 with improved capital efficiency.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Generic.Money and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin backed by a basket of yield-bearing assets, holding the underlying collateral tokens. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, a global reserve pool of collateral, and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for the underlying collateral, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated operator can pause all minting and redemption operations, and a separate owner can update the list of approved collateral tokens and adjust the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount, and the contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 105% for all minted stablecoins. The contract emits events for all minting, redemption, and transfer actions, as well as for changes to the operational parameters.
source_description: Generic provides stablecoin-as-a-service that delivers you the best risk-adjusted onchain yield and payments-ready privacy without the overhead and cost of offchain issuers.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on BisonFi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a principal-protected automated market maker for tokenized assets, holding user-deposited base and quote tokens in distinct liquidity pools. It maintains records of each user's deposited base and quote token balances, their active positions within each pool, and global configuration parameters for trading. Callers can deposit base or quote tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, open new trading positions, close existing positions, and swap between base and quote tokens. Only a designated operator can adjust trading fees, pause trading, or add new supported token pairs. A maximum of 10 supported token pairs can be active at any time, and a 0.25% fee is applied to all swap operations. The contract announces all successful deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closings, and swap executions.
source_description: Prop AMM on Solana.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on wen markets and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and funding of new token liquidity pools, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each pool's base token deposits, project token supply, the current funding goal, and a list of comments associated with each pool. Callers can create a new pool by depositing a base token and specifying a project token address, contribute base tokens to an existing pool, claim their pro-rata share of project tokens once a pool is fully funded, and post comments on any pool. A designated administrator can set a global fee percentage for successful pool funding and pause all pool creation. New pools must specify a funding goal between 100 and 1,000,000 base tokens, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from the collected base tokens upon successful funding. The contract announces pool creation, contributions, funding completion, and new comments.
source_description: A token launchpad bulletin board where anyone can create and bootstrap ERC20 token liquidity free from rugpulls, and post comments for discussion, inspired by 4chan and the Internet culture

description: Design a staking contract based on Gate SOL and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking token that custodies staked native tokens and issues an equivalent amount of a liquid staking derivative token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking derivative token, the total amount of native tokens staked, and a per-user balance of the liquid staking derivative token. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking derivative tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking derivative tokens for native tokens. A designated operator can initiate a rebase operation to adjust the redemption rate based on staking rewards. Only the owner can set the designated operator. The redemption rate for liquid staking derivative tokens to native tokens can never decrease. A minimum deposit of 0.1 native tokens is required. The contract announces the current total supply of the liquid staking derivative token and the current redemption rate.
source_description: gtSOL is a liquid staking token that earns SOL staking rewards while remaining usable across DeFi. As rewards accrue, each gtSOL becomes redeemable for more SOL, allowing continued yield generation in Gate products and other DeFi use cases.

description: Create a token contract based on Yay! and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social platform's native token, facilitating user engagement and rewarding participation. It maintains individual user balances, a global treasury balance, and a configurable fee structure. Callers can deposit tokens into the platform, transfer tokens to other users, stake tokens to earn rewards, and withdraw their unstaked tokens. Only a designated operator can set the staking reward rate and adjust the platform's operational fees. A 5% fee is applied to all token transfers between users, and the staking reward rate is capped at 0.1% per day. The contract announces successful deposits, transfers, stakes, and withdrawals, along with any fee deductions.
source_description: Yay! is a SocialFi platform where web2 and web3 meet, offering a unique space where everyone can belong. Yay! is heading toward 10 million users, highlighting its significant growth since its launch. With seamless new web3 features, Yay! aims to accelerate onboarding and drive mass adoption through its innovative tokenomics.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on RH.fun and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new fungible tokens via a bonding curve mechanism, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each project's bonding curve state, including total base tokens deposited, total project tokens minted, and the current price, along with global configuration parameters like the launch fee. Callers can launch a new project by depositing base tokens, buy project tokens from an existing curve, sell project tokens back to the curve, and claim their share of base tokens after a project graduates. Only a designated administrator can set the global launch fee and withdraw accumulated launch fees. The launch fee is fixed at 0.5% of the initial base token deposit for new projects. Projects automatically graduate to an external decentralized exchange when their total base token deposits reach 100 base tokens. The contract announces project launches, token purchases, token sales, and project graduations.
source_description: RH.fun is a bonding-curve token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Anyone can launch a token in seconds; tokens graduate to Uniswap V2 once the curve target is reached. Supports ETH and USDG markets

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Symbiosis and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain token swaps and liquidity transfers, holding deposited tokens in escrow until a swap is completed or cancelled. It maintains a record of each pending swap, including the source chain, destination chain, input token, output token, amount, and recipient address, along with a global configuration for supported chains and minimum swap amounts. Callers can initiate a swap by depositing tokens, cancel their own pending swap if it hasn't been processed, and claim output tokens for a completed swap. A designated operator can mark a swap as processed, update the global configuration, and withdraw accumulated fees. The minimum swap amount for any supported token is 100 units of that token, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all successful swaps, deducted from the output amount. The contract emits an event whenever a swap is initiated, processed, or cancelled, and when the configuration is updated.
source_description: Symbiosis aggregates decentralized exchange liquidity across any EVM and non-EVM networks. Swap any token and transfer liquidity. Yes, any.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Bucket CDP and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateralized debt positions, holding various approved token types as collateral and minting a stablecoin against them. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, minted stablecoin debt, and a global configuration for each collateral type including its collateralization ratio and liquidation threshold. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoin, repay stablecoin debt, withdraw excess collateral, and trigger liquidations for undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can add new collateral tokens, update collateralization parameters, and pause borrowing for specific collateral types. The minimum collateralization ratio for any position is 110%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidated amount. The contract announces events for position creation, collateral deposit, stablecoin borrowing, debt repayment, collateral withdrawal, and liquidations.
source_description: Bucket Protocol is the leading Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) protocol within the Sui ecosystem, supporting multiple assets for collateralization while extending stablecoin loans in $BUCK at a fixed low-cost. Its real-time liquidation mechanism ensures both security and capital efficiency, and the inbuilt flash loan services facilitate the price stability of the stablecoin BUCK.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Antex and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and the project tokens being distributed. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their allocated project tokens, along with the total project tokens available for distribution and the current sale phase. Callers can deposit tokens during an active sale phase, claim their allocated project tokens after the sale concludes, and withdraw any unspent deposited tokens if the sale fails to meet its minimum. The contract owner can start and end sale phases, set the project token allocation rate, and withdraw any remaining project tokens after the sale. A minimum deposit of 100 base tokens is required per participant. The project token allocation rate is fixed at 100 base tokens per 1 project token. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, project tokens are claimed, and sale phases change.
source_description: Antex provides the foundational building layers for a new digital economy with following products: stable-coin, crypto/fiat, DEX, launchpad, lock liquidity and lock token and connecting crypto to the real world.
