A designated operator can execute a trade between matching orders, settling the tokens between the involved accounts. The minimum order size is 100 units of the base token. A 0.1% fee is charged on each trade, deducted from the received amount for both taker and maker. The contract announces new orders, order cancellations, and executed trades to observers.
source_description: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. The order book is fully onchain, and orders are matched in price-time priority. Every order, cancel, trade, and liquidation happens transparently.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on pxswap and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer over-the-counter trades of non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and associated payment tokens in escrow during the trade process. It maintains records of active offers, including the NFT identifier offered, the requested payment token and amount, and the expiration time for each offer. Callers can create new offers to sell an NFT, accept an existing offer by providing the requested payment, or cancel their own active offers. A designated operator can pause all trading activity, preventing new offers or acceptances, and can update the fee percentage applied to successful trades. A trade fee of 0.5% of the payment token value is deducted from the seller's proceeds upon successful acceptance of an offer. Offers are valid for a maximum of 7 days from their creation. The contract announces when an offer is created, when an offer is accepted, and when an offer is cancelled.
source_description: NFT OTC Trading platform, the Future of NFT Finance

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on USX.Capital and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin backed by a basket of yield-bearing assets, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing new stablecoins against them. It maintains individual balances for each user's stablecoin holdings and their deposited collateral, alongside a global reserve pool of collateral and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral tokens, mint stablecoins against their deposited collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio, add or remove approved collateral types, and set fees. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting stablecoins is 150%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces successful stablecoin transfers, minting events, and redemption events to observers.
source_description: USX is a fully collateralized neodollar built by Scroll that combines TradFi and DeFi to deliver stable rewards

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Blindex and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin system, holding collateral assets and issuing stablecoins pegged to various foreign exchange rates. It maintains a global configuration for each stablecoin type, including its collateral ratio and associated oracle, and tracks each user's stablecoin balances and collateral deposits. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for their underlying collateral, transfer stablecoins to other accounts, and swap one type of stablecoin for another. A designated operator can pause minting and redemption for all stablecoins, and the owner can update the collateral ratio for a specific stablecoin type. The minimum collateral ratio for any stablecoin is 110%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin swaps. The contract emits an event whenever stablecoins are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when a collateral ratio is updated.
source_description: Blindex is a multi-currency stablecoin DeFi platform. Mint, swap, trade, invest and redeem any FX-pegged coin.All coins are partially collateralized, algorithmically stabilized and completely decentralized.

description: Create a governance contract based on Neutral Trade and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized investment fund, holding various digital assets contributed by investors. It maintains individual investor balances, a record of the total assets under management, and a configuration for investment strategies. Callers can deposit funds into the contract, withdraw their share of the fund, and propose new investment strategies for approval. A designated operator can approve or reject proposed strategies, execute approved investment strategies, and adjust certain fund parameters. The fund charges a 0.5% management fee on all deposits, and a minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the base currency. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and strategy approvals.
source_description: Neutral Trade is the on-chain multi-strategy hedge fund, built by experienced quants and traders from Goldman Sachs and Top Global Hedge Funds

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on GasPump and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and initial trading of new fungible tokens, holding the initial supply of each launched token and the collected platform fees. It maintains a record for each launched token, including its total supply, current liquidity pool balance, and the creator's address. Callers can launch a new token by providing an initial amount of base currency, contribute additional base currency to an existing token's liquidity pool, or swap base currency for tokens and vice-versa. Only the contract owner can set the platform fee percentage, which is initially 1% and capped at 5%. The contract announces new token launches, liquidity pool additions, and all successful swaps.
source_description: Telegram native launchpad which allows to launch a coin that is instantly tradable for under $2 in one click (like pump fun, but on TON).

description: Design a token contract based on BasketDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of tokens, holding a diverse portfolio of other fungible tokens. It maintains each user's balance of basket tokens, the current composition and quantity of each underlying asset in the basket, and a global rebalancing threshold. Callers can deposit supported tokens to mint basket tokens, withdraw underlying tokens by burning basket tokens, and claim rewards distributed to basket token holders. A designated rebalancer can initiate a rebalance operation to adjust the basket's asset distribution, and the owner can add or remove supported tokens from the basket, set the rebalancing threshold, and update the reward distribution rate. The rebalancing threshold is set at 1% deviation from target weights, meaning a rebalance can only occur if any asset's actual weight differs from its target by more than 1%. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is distributed to basket token holders. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, rewards are claimed, the basket composition changes, and the rebalancing threshold is updated.
source_description: A community controlled no fee token basket that you are PAID to hold.

description: Create a staking contract based on Ankr and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native blockchain currency. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount and their corresponding liquid staking token balance, along with a global pool of staked assets and configuration parameters like the staking reward rate and withdrawal unbonding period. Callers can deposit native currency to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their staked assets after an unbonding period, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can initiate staking operations on the underlying blockchain and update the staking reward rate, while the owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The minimum deposit amount for native currency is 0.1 units, and the unbonding period for withdrawals is fixed at 7 days. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and successful reward distributions.
source_description: Liquid, secure, and easy to integrate staking infrastructure.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on crvUSD and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of a decentralized stablecoin, backed by various approved collateral assets. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, borrowed stablecoin amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration parameters for each collateral type. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoin against their collateral, repay stablecoin, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust interest rates, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral type is 75%, and a 0.5% stablecoin origination fee is charged on all new borrowings. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and liquidations.
source_description: crvUSD is a collateralized-debt-position (CDP) stablecoin pegged to the US Dollar

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Moocon and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss prize pool, holding user deposits of a designated base asset and distributing yield-generated prizes. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total pooled yield, and configuration parameters such as the prize period duration. Callers can deposit the base asset, withdraw their deposited principal, and claim a prize if selected as a winner. Only a designated operator can initiate a new prize round, which involves collecting accumulated yield and selecting a winner from eligible depositors. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the base asset, and a prize round must conclude within 7 days of its initiation. The contract announces the start of each new prize round and the identity of the prize winner.
source_description: Moocon is a no-loss lottery on Solana, built on Jupiter. Users deposit assets into yield-bearing vaults; earned yield is pooled into prizes and awarded to one depositor per round through a verifiable draw.

description: Specify a token contract based on Symmetry and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized asset management vault, designed to custody various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited tokens, the total value locked for each asset, and a set of approved investment strategies. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens if not actively invested, and claim profits from successful strategies. A designated operator can initiate new investment strategies with deposited funds, rebalance existing strategies, and pause deposits or withdrawals in emergencies. The owner can approve new investment strategies, set the management fee, and upgrade the contract. A management fee of 0.5% is applied to all profits generated by investment strategies before distribution. Each investment strategy must allocate at least 10% of its capital to a stablecoin for liquidity. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, strategy initiations, and profit distributions to observers.
source_description: Solana's on-chain asset management infrastructure layer

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Toucan Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the on-chain representation and management of tokenized environmental assets, specifically carbon credits, and custodies the underlying fungible carbon credit tokens. It maintains a registry of all deposited carbon credit tokens, tracking their associated metadata such as vintage and project type, and also stores a mapping of each user's balance of wrapped carbon tokens. Callers can deposit approved carbon credit tokens to receive wrapped carbon tokens, redeem wrapped carbon tokens for the underlying carbon credit tokens, and transfer their wrapped carbon tokens to other addresses. A designated operator is privileged to approve new types of carbon credit tokens for deposit and to set the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and a minimum deposit of 100 carbon credit tokens is required for each deposit operation. The contract announces events for deposits, redemptions, and transfers of wrapped carbon tokens, including the amount and the involved addresses.
source_description: The protocol provides tools that allow anyone to bring carbon credits onto the blockchain to improve the carbon market and fuel web3 innovation. Unlocking more ideas, infrastructure and incentives to finance the world’s best climate projects.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Solana Name Service and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages unique, human-readable domain names ending in ".meta" and custodies the registration fees. It maintains a registry of registered domain names, their associated owner addresses, and their expiration timestamps. Callers can register a new domain, renew an existing domain, transfer domain ownership, and set a resolver address for their domain. A designated operator can set the registration and renewal fees, and update the base resolver contract address. A new domain registration costs 0.01 ether per year, and renewals cost 0.005 ether per year. The contract emits an event when a domain is registered, renewed, or transferred.
source_description: Get your .sol domain that can be used to represent you in the metaverse

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on JustCryptos and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset bridge for wrapping and unwrapping tokens, and it custodies wrapped tokens and their underlying assets. It maintains a mapping of original asset addresses to their wrapped token addresses, a total supply for each wrapped token, and a record of each user's wrapped token balances. Callers can deposit an underlying asset to mint its wrapped equivalent, and they can burn a wrapped token to withdraw the underlying asset. A designated operator can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations, and they can update the mapping of original assets to wrapped tokens. A deposit transaction must exceed a minimum value of 100 units of the underlying asset. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the user's address, the asset involved, and the amount.
source_description: Just Cryptos builds a bridge that connects premium crypto currencies from the TRON network and other public chains, and introduces token value to TRON to power the JUST ecosystem. All assets are stored, and can be swapped on Poloniex.

description: Design a governance contract based on Realms and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) for collective governance, custodying a treasury of arbitrary ERC-20 tokens. It maintains a record of proposals, including their state (pending, active, defeated, executed), and the voting power associated with each member's staked governance tokens. Callers can create new proposals, stake governance tokens to gain voting power, delegate their voting power to another address, vote on active proposals, and execute successful proposals. Only the DAO itself, through a successfully executed proposal, can modify core configuration parameters like the proposal creation fee or the minimum voting quorum. A proposal requires a minimum of 100,000 staked governance tokens to be created, and active proposals remain open for voting for exactly 72 hours. The contract emits events when new proposals are created, when votes are cast, and when proposals are successfully executed.
source_description: SPL Governance is a program which provides core building blocks and primitives to create Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) on the Solana blockchain. The program is DAO type and asset type agnostic and can be used to build any type of DAOs which can own and manage any type of assets

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Bio Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the funding and launch of scientific research projects, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing them to projects. It maintains a registry of approved projects, each with a funding goal and a deadline, and tracks individual user contributions to each project. Callers can deposit stablecoins into a project, claim their pro-rata share of a successfully funded project's tokens, and withdraw their stablecoin contributions if a project fails to meet its goal. Only a designated administrator can approve new projects, set their funding goals and deadlines, and mark projects as successfully funded or failed. A project must raise at least 10,000 stablecoins to be considered successful, and a 5% platform fee is deducted from all successful project funding distributions. The contract announces when a project is approved, when a contribution is made, and when a project's funding status changes.
source_description: The Bio protocol is DeSci's new financial layer, engineered to commercialize the best science, faster

description: Model a prediction market contract based on Myriad Markets and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market, holding collateral tokens deposited by participants. It maintains individual participant balances, open positions for each market outcome, and market-specific configuration including resolution status. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit collateral, place bets on market outcomes, redeem winning bets after market resolution, and withdraw their available collateral. Only a designated operator may resolve a market by declaring a winning outcome, and only the contract owner may adjust the operator address or set the market creation fee. A market creation fee of 0.01 collateral tokens is charged for each new market, and a maximum of 10 distinct outcomes are permitted per market. The contract announces market creation, bet placements, and market resolutions.
source_description: Prediction Markets for everything! From crypto, politics and sports to gaming, culture and technology

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on PowaDAP and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates token presales, holding deposited funds and the tokens to be sold. It maintains a record of each participant's purchased token amount and the total funds raised for each presale, along with a global configuration for presale creation. Callers can create a new presale, contribute funds to an active presale, claim purchased tokens after a successful presale, and refund their contributions if a presale fails. The owner is privileged to set the global presale creation fee and to designate operators who can approve or reject new presales. A presale must raise at least 50% of its soft cap to be considered successful, and the presale creation fee is fixed at 0.1 ether. The contract announces when a new presale is created, when a contribution is made, and when tokens are claimed or funds are refunded.
source_description: PowaDAP is a decentralized platform where developers and entrepreneurs have the opportunity to offer various high-value utilities and dynamics to their audience. Through the dApp, users can create tokens, presales, lotteries, staking pools, as well as lock liquidity/tokens and conduct airdrops. The platform belongs to the Powabit ecosystem, whose team is constantly improving and creating new blockchain products in the market.

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on Pegasusdollar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding a reserve asset to back the stablecoin. It maintains the total supply of the stablecoin, the reserve balance, and a mapping of user stablecoin balances. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing the reserve asset, redeem stablecoins for the reserve asset, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the stablecoin's target peg, and only the owner can pause all minting and redemption operations. The stablecoin's total supply is capped at 1,000,000 units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all redemption operations, deducted from the reserve asset. The contract announces all stablecoin transfers and changes to the reserve balance.
source_description: The first algorithmic token pegged to METF running on the Cronos Chain.Completely decentralized on chain governance.

description: Create an on-chain insurance contract based on Sherlock and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized insurance pool, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing coverage payouts. It maintains individual user deposit balances, active coverage policies with their associated premiums and coverage limits, and a global configuration for fees and payout thresholds. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, request new coverage policies by specifying a coverage amount and duration, submit claims against active policies, and withdraw their available stablecoin balance. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, and only the owner can update the global configuration parameters. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is required to activate a coverage policy, and a 5% fee is charged on all approved claim payouts. The contract announces when new coverage policies are issued, when claims are submitted, and when claims are approved or rejected.
source_description: Sherlock is a risk management protocol whose mission is to make DeFi safe for the masses. Sherlock combines protocol-to-protocol coverage with a decentralized smart contract security team to bring large amounts of affordable coverage to DeFi and beyond

description: Design a token contract based on Agility LSD and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking derivative (LSD) system, holding staked base tokens and issuing corresponding liquid tokens. It maintains a global total of staked base tokens, the total supply of liquid tokens, and for each user, their balance of liquid tokens. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid tokens, redeem liquid tokens for base tokens, and transfer liquid tokens to other users. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals, and set the fee for redemptions. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount, and the maximum redemption amount per transaction is 1000 base tokens. The contract announces events for deposits, redemptions, and liquid token transfers.
source_description: LSD Liquidity Layer & LSD Trading Platform.

description: Create an NFT contract based on ZORA Marketplace and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the buying and selling of non-fungible tokens, holding no token custody itself, but rather facilitating direct transfers between buyers and sellers. It maintains a record of active listings, each containing the listed token, its price, and the seller's address. Callers can list a token for sale, cancel an existing listing, and purchase a listed token. A designated operator can update the platform fee percentage and designate an address to receive collected fees. The platform fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price for every successful purchase. A listing can only be canceled by the original seller. The contract announces successful purchases and new listings through emitted events.
source_description: The NFT Marketplace Protocol

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Wonton and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and initial distribution of new fungible tokens, holding the newly minted tokens and any collected platform fees. It maintains a record of each launched token's configuration, including its total supply and the address of its creator, and a global platform fee balance. Callers can launch a new token by providing a name, symbol, and initial supply, and can claim their allocated portion of a launched token. Only the designated platform operator can set the platform fee percentage and withdraw accumulated platform fees. A platform fee of exactly 0.08 units of the native currency is charged for each token launch, and the initial supply of any launched token must be between 1,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 units. The contract announces the successful launch of a new token, including its identifier and total supply, and any updates to the platform fee percentage.
source_description: Launch a coin in one click for 0.08 TON (only 0.5$) Instantly tradable, Fair-launch.

description: Create a governance contract based on Theoriq Gold Vault and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for tokenized gold, holding deposits of a specific gold-backed stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances of deposited gold, a total gold collateral pool, and configuration parameters for borrowing and yield strategies. Callers can deposit gold tokens, withdraw their deposited gold, and claim any accrued yield. A designated operator can initiate borrowing against the gold collateral, deploy borrowed capital into approved yield-generating strategies, and redeem positions from those strategies. The contract will enforce a maximum loan-to-value ratio of 70% against the gold collateral. A 0.5% fee will be applied to all yield distributions before they are claimable by users. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield distribution events.
source_description: Theoriq Gold Vault generates returns on tokenized gold holdings - XAUT. It borrows stablecoins against gold collateral and deploys that capital across cross-venue carry trades, Pendle term yield, and capital-efficient loops, all managed by Theoriq's GoldSwarm AI agent.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on HiYield and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates access to tokenized real-world assets, holding wrapped versions of these assets as collateral. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, their outstanding loan balance, and a global configuration for interest rates and asset eligibility. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. Only a designated administrator can adjust the interest rate, add or remove eligible collateral types, and pause all borrowing activity. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 70%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new loans. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, a loan is taken out, or a loan is repaid, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Enabling access to traditional capital markets for web3 natives

description: Outline a payments contract based on Hash PayLink and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates direct stablecoin payments between users and merchants, holding no funds itself. It maintains a record of each merchant's configured payment links, including the designated recipient address and the associated stablecoin and amount. Callers can create new payment links, update existing link details, and initiate payments through a link. Only the contract owner can set the platform fee percentage and designate new stablecoin addresses for use. A payment link must specify a stablecoin from an approved list, and the platform fee is fixed at 0.2% of the payment amount. The contract announces when a new payment link is created and when a payment is successfully processed.
source_description: Hash PayLink is a non-custodial USDC payment link platform for gasless/contactless stablecoin settlement. Merchants create payment links and QR codes, while payer funds settle directly on-chain with a transparent 0.2% platform fee.

description: Specify a privacy-preserving contract based on Offshore Cash and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates confidential transfers of the native blockchain currency by acting as a mixer, holding user deposits in a shared pool. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a separate Merkle tree of nullifiers, along with a record of the current deposit fee. Callers can deposit native currency, providing a zero-knowledge proof of a valid commitment, and can withdraw native currency to a specified recipient, providing a zero-knowledge proof of a valid nullifier and commitment. The owner can update the deposit fee and the designated operator can update the Merkle tree roots. The deposit fee must be between 0% and 5% of the deposited amount, inclusive, and the initial deposit amount must be exactly 1 unit of the native currency. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit and each successful withdrawal, including the amount and the relevant Merkle tree root.
source_description: Privacy protocol on Ethereum using Zero-Knowledge Proofs (Groth16 zkSNARKs) for confidential ETH transfers.

description: Outline a payments contract based on Sablier Legacy and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a streaming payment system, holding deposited tokens that are continuously disbursed over time. It maintains individual stream records, each detailing the sender, recipient, token type, total amount, start time, and end time. Callers can create new streams, deposit tokens into existing streams, withdraw tokens from streams they are recipients of, and cancel streams they initiated. Only the owner can pause all stream creation and update the fee percentage for new streams. A stream's duration must be at least one minute and at most five years. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on the total amount of each newly created stream, deducted from the sender's deposit. The contract announces stream creations, stream cancellations, and withdrawals to observers.
source_description: A legacy version of Sablier, released in 2019

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Unit and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the bridging of an external blockchain's native currency to an EVM-compatible chain, holding the deposited external currency in custody. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, a total supply of the wrapped token, and a configuration for the bridge fee. Callers can deposit external currency, initiating a bridge transfer, and can withdraw their wrapped tokens, burning them to redeem the underlying external currency. A designated operator can pause and unpause deposits and withdrawals, and can update the bridge fee. The bridge fee is fixed at 0.1% of the deposit amount, and a minimum deposit of 0.001 of the external currency is enforced. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the bridge fee.
source_description: Unit is the asset tokenization layer on Hyperliquid, enabling seamless deposits and withdrawals.

description: Outline a price oracle contract based on Pyth Pro and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages subscriptions for premium data feeds, holding no custodial assets itself. It maintains a record of each subscriber's active feeds and their subscription end dates, alongside a global configuration of available data feeds and their associated monthly fees. Callers can subscribe to a data feed by paying its monthly fee, renew an existing subscription, and query the status of their subscriptions. The owner can add new data feeds, update the monthly fee for an existing feed, and pause or unpause a specific data feed. A subscription for any feed costs exactly 100 units of the designated payment token per month, and a subscriber can renew for a maximum of 12 months at a time. The contract emits an event when a subscription is initiated or renewed, and when a data feed's status or fee is updated.
source_description: Subscription-based price data for institutions and advanced use cases. Previously known as Lazer.

description: Define a privacy-preserving contract based on Status and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized messaging network's user registrations and associated service fees. It maintains a record of each registered user's unique identifier, their associated public key, and their current subscription status, along with a total balance of collected fees. Callers can register a new user, update their public key, renew their subscription by paying a fee, and deregister their account. A designated operator can set the subscription fee and withdraw accumulated fees. The subscription fee is fixed at 0.01 units of the native blockchain currency per renewal period, and a user's subscription is valid for 30 days after a successful renewal. The contract emits an event when a user registers, renews their subscription, or deregisters.
source_description: Status is an open-source messaging platform, crypto wallet, and web3 browser focused on privacy and decentralization, built on the Ethereum network

description: Outline an on-chain insurance contract based on Risk Harbor and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a decentralized insurance marketplace, holding deposited collateral in a designated stablecoin to cover potential smart contract vulnerabilities for specified protocols. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, active coverage policies, and claims status, alongside a global pool of available coverage, and a configuration for coverage parameters per insured protocol. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase coverage for a specified protocol and duration, file a claim against an active policy, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can add new protocols for coverage, adjust coverage parameters for existing protocols, and approve or reject claims. The maximum coverage duration for any policy is 365 days. A 2% fee is applied to all coverage purchases, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces when new coverage policies are purchased, when claims are filed, and when claims are approved or rejected.
source_description: Risk Harbor is a risk management marketplace for decentralized finance (DeFi) that utilizes a completely automated, transparent, and impartial invariant detection mechanism to secure liquidity providers and stakers against smart contract risks, hacks, and attacks.

description: Define a staking contract based on mETH Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base asset, holding deposited base asset tokens and issuing a liquid staking token representing staked positions. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the amount of base asset deposited by each user, and a global staking ratio determining the conversion between base asset and liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit base asset tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw their proportional share of the base asset, subject to a 7-day withdrawal delay. A designated operator can initiate staking of deposited base assets and manage validator keys, while the contract owner can update the staking ratio and set a protocol fee, which is capped at 0.5% of all redemptions. The contract announces all deposits, redemptions, and staking ratio updates as events.
source_description: A permissionless, non-custodial ETH liquid staking protocol deployed on Ethereum L1 and governed by Mantle.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Pulse Rate and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token-pegged stablecoin system, holding reserves of a base token and minting a stablecoin token. It maintains the current total supply of the stablecoin, the amount of base token held as reserves, and individual user balances of the stablecoin. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing the base token, redeem stablecoins for the base token, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the minting and redemption fees, and can pause or unpause minting and redemption operations. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% and the minting fee is fixed at 0.2%. The contract emits an event whenever stablecoins are minted, redeemed, or transferred, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: The first Tomb Fork on Pulse Chain. Get your Pulse Rate going by staking and yield-farming.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Bitget SOL and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a native blockchain asset, allowing users to deposit and earn yield. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total staked amount, and a configurable annual percentage rate (APR) for yield calculation. Callers can deposit the native asset into the pool, withdraw their principal and accumulated yield, and claim their accumulated yield without withdrawing principal. Only a designated operator can update the APR based on external staking returns. A minimum deposit of 0.1 units of the native asset is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and APR updates to observers.
source_description: Earn daily profits without risking your principal! Your returns are based on on-chain staking, and if the on-chain ROI changes, the APR will adjust accordingly.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on SenpaiSwap and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for swapping stable value tokens, holding reserves of two distinct stablecoins. It maintains a record of each token's current balance within the pool and a configurable swap fee. Callers can deposit pairs of stablecoins to provide liquidity, withdraw their share of deposited tokens, and swap one stablecoin for another. A designated owner can adjust the swap fee, which is initially set to 0.05%, and can pause all swapping operations. The contract will always maintain a minimum of 1000 units of each stablecoin in its reserves. It announces all deposit, withdrawal, and swap events, including the tokens involved and the amounts transferred.
source_description: AMM on the Boba Network

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on MetalX Dex and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding reserves of both tokens in each trading pair. It maintains individual liquidity provider balances, global token reserves for each pair, and configuration parameters for fees and minimum trade sizes. Callers can add liquidity, remove liquidity, swap tokens, and query token prices. A designated administrator can set trading fees, pause trading for specific pairs, and update the list of supported token pairs. Trading fees are fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and a minimum trade size of 100 units of the input token is enforced for all swaps. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected token pair.
source_description: Dex on XPR Network

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Livara and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages prediction pools for event outcomes, holding US dollar stablecoins deposited by participants. It maintains a record of each participant's deposits and withdrawals, the current state of each prediction pool including its total staked amount and outcome selections, and global configuration parameters such as fees. Callers can create new prediction pools, join an existing pool by staking stablecoins on a specific outcome, withdraw their staked amount if the pool is still open, and claim their winnings after a pool's outcome has been determined. Only a designated operator can finalize a pool's outcome and set the fee percentage. A pool must have at least 100 US dollar stablecoins staked before it can be finalized, and the operator fee is fixed at 2% of the total winnings. The contract announces when a new pool is created, when a participant joins a pool, when a participant withdraws from a pool, and when a pool's outcome is finalized.
source_description: Livara is a crypto prediction market platform where users create or join event-based prediction pools and get paid in USDT based on the outcome.

description: Define a staking contract based on Lombard LBTC and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing a liquid receipt token in return. It maintains individual user balances for the receipt token, a total supply for the receipt token, and a global exchange rate between the base asset and the receipt token. Callers can deposit base assets to receive receipt tokens, and redeem receipt tokens for base assets. A designated operator can rebase the exchange rate to reflect staking rewards, and the owner can set the operator address. The minimum deposit amount for base assets is 0.001 units. A 0.1% fee is applied to all redemptions, deducted from the base asset amount. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and rebase events, including the affected addresses and amounts.
source_description: Lombard is transforming Bitcoin's utility from a store of value into a productive financial tool through a security-first liquid Bitcoin primitive—LBTC. LBTC is a liquid, yield-bearing, natively cross-chain, and 1:1 backed by bitcoin.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on SOFA.org and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a collateralized debt position manager, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing synthetic debt tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, outstanding debt, and liquidation thresholds for each account, along with global configuration parameters for each supported collateral and debt token pair. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow debt tokens against their collateral, repay debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. Only a designated operator can add new collateral or debt token types, adjust collateralization ratios, or pause borrowing. The minimum collateralization ratio for any position is 150%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidated amount. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events, including the affected user, token amounts, and new position state.
source_description: Creating a decentralized, trustless, atomic settlement foundation for handling all financial assets on-chain.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on LooksRare and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and accepted bids in escrow. It maintains individual account balances for marketplace tokens, records of active listings and offers, and global configuration parameters like fees. Callers can list NFTs for sale, make offers on listed NFTs, accept offers, cancel listings or offers, and withdraw their marketplace tokens or NFTs. A designated operator can adjust the marketplace fee and pause all trading activity. The maximum marketplace fee is 2.5%, and all accepted offers must be settled within 24 hours. The contract announces successful NFT sales, new listings, and cancelled offers to observers.
source_description: LooksRare is the community-first NFT marketplace with rewards for participating. Buy NFTs (or sell 'em) to earn rewards.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on boop.fun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a launchpad for new tokens, holding a reserve of platform tokens to reward participants. It maintains a record of each creator's deployed tokens, their associated market capitalization milestones, and the platform token rewards due. Callers can deploy a new token, claim earned rewards, and stake platform tokens to participate in governance. Only a designated operator can set the market capitalization thresholds for rewards and approve new token deployments. A minimum of 1000 platform tokens must be staked to participate in governance, and rewards are distributed only after a deployed token achieves a market capitalization of at least 1,000,000 units of a stablecoin. The contract announces when a new token is deployed, when rewards are claimed, and when market capitalization milestones are met.
source_description: A Solana-based memecoin launchpad that incentivizes influencers and creators with BOOP tokens for deploying tokens meeting market cap thresholds

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Fei Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a novel stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a base asset to back a newly minted stablecoin. It maintains the current reserve ratio, the total supply of the stablecoin, and individual account balances for both the stablecoin and any base asset deposited. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing the base asset, redeem stablecoins for the base asset, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target reserve ratio and pause or unpause minting and redemption operations. The initial target reserve ratio is 100%, and the redemption fee is 0.5% of the stablecoins redeemed. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the amounts and involved accounts.
source_description: FEI uses a new kind of stablecoin mechanism called direct incentives. It is more capital efficient, has a fair distribution, and is fully decentralized. The protocol uses the value it controls to maintain liquid secondary markets.

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Armor and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized insurance fund, holding a reserve of a stablecoin to cover claims. It maintains individual user balances of stablecoin deposits, records of active coverage policies, and a global pool of stablecoin for payouts. Callers can deposit stablecoins to become underwriters, purchase coverage for specified assets, and submit claims against active policies. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, and an owner can adjust system parameters. The maximum coverage period for any policy is 365 days, and a 1% fee is applied to all policy purchases, directed to the protocol treasury. The contract emits an event upon each successful policy purchase and claim payout.
source_description: Insurance

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Beezie and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for non-fungible tokens representing graded collectibles, holding them securely while facilitating their trade. It maintains a record of each vaulted non-fungible token's unique identifier, its current owner, and its listed sale price, alongside a global fee percentage for all transactions. Callers can deposit non-fungible tokens they own into the vault, list their vaulted non-fungible tokens for sale at a specified price, purchase listed non-fungible tokens from other users, and withdraw non-fungible tokens they own from the vault. Only a designated operator can set the global transaction fee, which is capped at a maximum of 5%. Each purchase transaction incurs the global transaction fee, which is deducted from the sale price and transferred to a designated treasury address. The contract announces events for non-fungible token deposits, listings, purchases, and withdrawals, including the non-fungible token's identifier, the involved parties, and the transaction amount.
source_description: Platform for collectors and resellers. Vault, Buy & Sell graded Pokemon, One Piece, Sports cards, Video Games & more

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on BSCSwap and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange (DEX) for swapping tokens, holding token reserves in liquidity pools. It maintains records of token balances within each liquidity pool and configuration parameters for each pool, such as swap fees. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap tokens between pools. A designated operator can pause all swaps, update the swap fee for a pool, and add new token pairs. The swap fee for any token pair must be between 0.05% and 0.30%, inclusive. Liquidity providers earn a pro-rata share of the swap fees generated by the pools they contribute to. The contract announces events for liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps.
source_description: Superior cross-chain AMM with trader focused features

description: Model an NFT contract based on flooor.fun and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates timed auctions for unique digital assets, holding the auctioned assets and the highest bid amount in escrow. It maintains a record for each ongoing auction including the asset being auctioned, its seller, the current highest bidder, the highest bid amount, and the auction's end time. Callers can initiate an auction, place a bid on an active auction, and claim an auctioned asset if they are the winning bidder after the auction concludes. The owner can pause all auctions and set a platform fee percentage. Each auction has a minimum bid increment of 1% of the current highest bid, and a platform fee of 2.5% is deducted from the final sale price of each successful auction. The contract announces when an auction starts, when a new highest bid is placed, and when an auction concludes with a winner.
source_description: NFT auction platform on Base chain.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Kamino Liquidity and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a concentrated liquidity management vault, custodying deposited tokens for users. It maintains per-user records of deposited assets, active liquidity positions within external concentrated-liquidity pools, and configuration parameters for rebalancing strategies. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their share of tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust rebalancing parameters and update approved external concentrated-liquidity pool addresses. The contract imposes a 0.1% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals and limits the maximum number of active concentrated-liquidity positions per vault to 10. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and rebalancing operations to observers.
source_description: Solana's liquidity layer. Built on top of concentrated liquidity protocols, Kamino facilitates automated liquidity via quantitative models, depositing into optimized ranges, rebalancing positions, and auto-compounding of fees & rewards.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Drift Trade and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user accounts tracking their collateral balances, open positions, and unrealized profit/loss, alongside global configuration parameters like funding rates and maximum leverage. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized accounts. A designated operator can update global configuration parameters, adjust funding rates, and pause trading in emergencies. New positions require an initial margin of at least 10% of the notional value, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations.
source_description: Drift brings on-chain, cross-margined perpetual futures to Solana. Making futures DEXs the best way to trade.

description: Define a governance contract based on Valence and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a cross-chain automation system, holding deposited tokens that users commit to specific actions on other chains. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, the target chain identifier, the specific action parameters, and a unique identifier for each pending cross-chain operation. Callers can deposit tokens, create new automation tasks specifying a target chain and action, cancel their own pending tasks, and claim tokens from successfully completed cross-chain operations. A designated operator can approve or reject cross-chain operation results, and can set the fee percentage for successful operations, which defaults to 0.1% and cannot exceed 1%. The contract emits an event when a new task is created, when a task is cancelled, and when a cross-chain operation's result is processed.
source_description: Cross-Chain Automation

description: Create a prediction market contract based on DropCopy and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a parimutuel prediction market for asset price movements, holding user deposits in an escrow pool. It maintains records of each participant's active predictions, their deposited amount, and the market's current state including the prediction window, settlement window, and the total amount staked on each outcome. Callers can create a new prediction market, stake funds on a specific price outcome, and claim their winnings after a market has settled. Only a designated operator can settle a market by providing the final asset price, and they can also pause new market creation. A market's prediction window must be at least 30 minutes and no more than 24 hours. A 2% fee is deducted from the total winnings of each settled market. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when funds are staked, and when a market is settled.
source_description: DropCopy is a parimutuel prediction market that allows players to predict the future price of cryptoccurrencies

description: Create a staking contract based on Starknet BTC Staking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables users to stake a wrapped Bitcoin asset to earn yield, holding the staked wrapped Bitcoin in escrow. It maintains individual user balances of staked wrapped Bitcoin and accumulated rewards, along with a global pool of rewards awaiting distribution and a configurable staking epoch duration. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin, request a withdrawal of their staked amount, claim their accumulated rewards, and unstake their wrapped Bitcoin after a withdrawal request has been processed. A designated operator can update the reward rate, initiate a new staking epoch, and pause or unpause staking and withdrawals. A minimum deposit of 0.001 wrapped Bitcoin is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all reward claims. The contract announces when a deposit is made, when a withdrawal is requested, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Bitcoin Staking on Starknet.

description: Define a staking contract based on Jito Liquid Staking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract enables users to deposit a base token and receive a yield-bearing receipt token, which represents their share of the staked assets and any accumulated rewards. The contract maintains a global pool of staked base tokens, a total supply of the receipt token, and a conversion rate between the base token and the receipt token, which accrues value over time. Callers can deposit base tokens to mint receipt tokens, and redeem receipt tokens to withdraw base tokens. The owner can adjust the staking strategy, set the fee percentage for withdrawals, and pause deposits. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% of the base token amount will be applied to all redemptions. The contract emits events for all deposits, redemptions, and changes to the withdrawal fee.
source_description: JitoSOL is the first liquid staking derivative on Solana to include MEV rewards. Tracks the price of SOL while accruing staking and MEV rewards. Yield is accrued in the price so it will steadily appreciate vs. SOL

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Gacha Markets and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users stake an ERC-20 token on the outcome of real-world events. It maintains a record of each user's staked amount, their chosen outcome for each event, and the total staked amount for each outcome. Callers can create a new prediction event, stake tokens on an outcome, withdraw their stake if an event is cancelled, and claim their winnings after an event concludes. Only a designated operator can create new prediction events, mark an event as cancelled, or declare the winning outcome of an event. Each prediction event must have at least two possible outcomes and a maximum of five. A 5% fee is deducted from all winnings before distribution. The contract announces when a new prediction event is created, when a user stakes tokens, and when an event's outcome is declared.
source_description: A new super app making crypto fun, simple, and accessible for everyone

description: Outline a token contract based on TagDotTech and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a system for issuing and transferring unique, customizable digital identifiers, holding no custodial assets directly. It maintains a registry of identifiers, their associated owners, and configurable metadata for each, alongside a global configuration for pricing and operational parameters. Callers can register new identifiers, transfer ownership of identifiers they possess, update metadata for their owned identifiers, and revoke identifiers they own. A designated operator can set the base registration fee, pause new registrations, and update the contract's metadata schema. A new identifier registration costs a base fee of 0.01 ether and each identifier can have a maximum of 256 bytes of associated metadata. The contract emits events upon identifier registration, ownership transfer, and metadata updates.
source_description: Empowering Creators to Build Their Future. Your Brand, Your Community, Your Way.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on bot.fun and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a launchpad for autonomous agent-driven token launches, custodying the native chain asset for bonding curve liquidity. It maintains a record for each launched token, including its current supply, the bonding curve parameters, and the total native chain asset deposited into its liquidity pool. Callers can create new token launches, deposit native chain assets into a token's bonding curve, withdraw native chain assets from a token's bonding curve, and trade tokens against their respective bonding curves. A designated operator can pause all trading activity and update the global launch fee. New token launches incur a 0.5% fee on initial native chain asset deposits, and each launch is capped at a maximum of 1,000,000 tokens. The contract announces events for new token launches, deposits, withdrawals, and trades, including the token identifier, the amount of native chain asset, and the amount of tokens involved.
source_description: EVM-native launchpad on Eden where autonomous AI agents launch coins and trade them against bonding curves priced in native TIA. Humans spectate; trading is bot-only via API/onchain txs

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on BounceBit CeDeFi Yield and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-bearing vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding deposited principal and accruing yield in that same token. It maintains each user's share balance, the total shares issued, and the total underlying token held. Callers can deposit tokens to receive shares, withdraw their deposited tokens by burning shares, and redeem their shares for the underlying token. A designated operator can rebase the vault's total assets to reflect yield generation or losses, and can pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The vault charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on the underlying tokens, and the operator can only rebase the vault once every 24 hours. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and rebase events, including the affected user, amount, and new total assets.
source_description: BounceBit CeDeFi combines CeFi and DeFi to generate yield on various assets across multiple chains. The yield is generated via delta-neutral basis trading on centralized exchanges, facilitated by CEX-integrated custody solutions like CEFFU. BounceBit CeDeFi uses the ERC-4626 Tokenized Vault Standard to enable daily rebasing of generated revenue

description: Design a token locking contract based on RadLock and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a secure vault for locking fungible tokens, enabling time-based release. It maintains individual lock records for each user, including the locked amount, unlock date, and any associated beneficiary. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, extend an existing lock's duration, or withdraw unlocked tokens. A designated administrator can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and can set a global withdrawal fee. The minimum lock duration is 30 days, and the maximum withdrawal fee is 5% of the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event upon each successful token deposit and each successful token withdrawal.
source_description: RadLock offers trust and transparency tools for Radix, including locking, vesting, and insights

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on DexPad and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of token presales, holding deposited funds and newly minted tokens. It maintains a record of each presale's configuration, including the token being sold, its soft cap and hard cap, and the contribution limits for individual participants, alongside a mapping of participant addresses to their contributed amounts and allocated tokens. Callers can create new presales, contribute funds to an active presale, claim their purchased tokens after a successful presale, or withdraw their contributions if a presale fails. Only the contract owner can set the global presale creation fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of the hard cap for any presale, and only the presale creator can finalize their specific presale. Each presale must have a minimum soft cap of 100 base currency units and a maximum hard cap of 10,000 base currency units. The contract announces when a new presale is created, when a contribution is made, and when a presale is finalized or cancelled.
source_description: DexPad is a No-Code Platform for ERC-20 Tokens on multiple EVM-compatible chains. Mint, Lock, Airdrop or Presale your token without any coding knowledge require.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Chisino and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss scratch card game, holding stablecoin deposits backing player funds and prize pools. It maintains individual player balances, a global prize pool, a recovery ticket pool, and game configuration parameters like card prices and prize probabilities. Callers can purchase scratch cards, reveal card outcomes, claim instant prizes, and redeem recovery tickets for stablecoins. A designated operator can adjust game parameters, replenish prize pools, and pause game operations in emergencies. Each scratch card costs 10 stablecoins, and 55% of cards award an instant prize, with a maximum instant prize of 10,000 stablecoins. The contract emits events for card purchases, prize claims, and recovery ticket redemptions.
source_description: Chisino is an instant payout game protocol on MegaETH. Its pioneer game is no-loss scratch cards. Scratch for instant prizes up to $10,000. 55% of cards pay out across 16 prize tiers. Every card you play, win or lose, generates a recovery ticket that works to return what you spent. No permanent loss. The protocol is built on Klarhaus, a prize-linked savings engine that splits each play between instant prizes, entry recovery, and protocol rewards. Deposits are backed 1:1 by stablecoins. All outcomes are determined by onchain VRF. Earn rewards every time you play

description: Create a governance contract based on Spectra MetaVaults Outside V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages curated investment vaults, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount per vault and the current configuration parameters for each vault, including its associated strategy. Callers can deposit tokens into an active vault, withdraw their principal from a vault, and claim any accrued rewards. A designated operator can update a vault's strategy, initiate a harvest of rewards, and roll over a vault's position to a new strategy. The owner can add new vaults, pause and unpause deposits for a specific vault, and set the operator. A vault must have a minimum deposit amount of 100 base units of its underlying token. All withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee, which is directed to a designated treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy updates.
source_description: Curated vaults for optimized performance and automated rollovers.

description: Model a governance contract based on Perena Vaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding user deposits of an underlying stablecoin and issuing a yield-accruing token. It maintains individual user balances of the yield-accruing token, the total supply of the yield-accruing token, and the current amount of underlying stablecoin held in the vault. Callers can deposit underlying stablecoin to mint the yield-accruing token, withdraw underlying stablecoin by burning the yield-accruing token, and redeem their yield-accruing tokens for the underlying stablecoin after a specified lockup period. A designated operator can transfer underlying stablecoin to and from external yield-generating strategies, and can update the address of the underlying stablecoin. Only the owner can set the designated operator address. A minimum deposit of 100 units of the underlying stablecoin is required for each deposit operation. Withdrawals are subject to a 0.1% fee on the amount withdrawn, which is sent to the owner. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, and redemptions, including the user's address, the amount of underlying stablecoin, and the amount of yield-accruing token.
source_description: Perena is a stablebank offering USD STAR (USD*), a digital dollar that automatically accrues value from real yield sources, including delta-neutral strategies, secured lending, and stablecoins.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Prophet and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract creates and manages prediction markets, holding deposited collateral for active markets. It maintains a record of each market's parameters, the total collateral for each outcome, and individual user positions within each market. Callers can create new markets, deposit collateral to back a prediction on a specific outcome, withdraw their share of collateral from a resolved market, and dispute market resolutions. A designated operator can resolve markets and set the fee percentage. Market creation requires a minimum initial collateral deposit of 100 units of the designated collateral token. A 1% fee is applied to all market resolution payouts. The contract announces market creation, deposit events, and market resolution outcomes.
source_description: Prophet is a decentralized prediction market on the Obyte ledger.

description: Design a token contract based on unshETH and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized marketplace for staked Ether liquidity, holding deposited Ether and various liquid staking derivative tokens. It maintains a registry of approved liquid staking derivative tokens, per-user balances of deposited Ether and earned rewards, and a global record of the total Ether allocated to each liquid staking derivative. Callers can deposit Ether, withdraw their deposited Ether and accumulated rewards, and swap their accumulated rewards for other liquid staking derivative tokens. A designated operator can add new liquid staking derivative tokens to the approved list, update the allocation of deposited Ether to different liquid staking derivatives, and set the platform fee. The platform charges a 0.5% fee on all reward swaps, and a minimum of 1 Ether must be deposited at a time. The contract emits events when Ether is deposited, withdrawn, rewards are swapped, and when the allocation of Ether to a liquid staking derivative changes.
source_description: unshETH is a protocol that aims to further validator decentralization by creating a marketplace for staked ETH liquidity in which LSD protocols can compete for ETH by offering the best yield.

description: Model a staking contract based on Bitlayer YBTC Family and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for a wrapped Bitcoin asset, custodying the wrapped asset on the destination chain. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped asset, a mapping of user balances, and a record of the current bridge fee. Callers can deposit the wrapped asset to mint a corresponding amount of a liquid staking derivative, and they can redeem the liquid staking derivative to burn it and receive the wrapped asset back. A designated operator can adjust the bridge fee and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The bridge fee is initially 0.1% and cannot exceed 1.0%. The contract emits an event when wrapped assets are deposited and when liquid staking derivatives are redeemed.
source_description: Bridge between Bitcoin and Bitlayer chain

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on Orbit Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset bridge that custodies wrapped tokens representing assets on other chains. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped token balances, the total supply of each wrapped token, and a mapping of original chain asset identifiers to their corresponding wrapped token addresses on this chain. Callers can deposit native assets on a connected chain to mint wrapped tokens on this chain, transfer wrapped tokens to other users, and burn wrapped tokens on this chain to withdraw native assets on a connected chain. A designated operator is privileged to register new wrapped token types, set the fee for cross-chain transfers, and pause or unpause the bridge for specific wrapped token types. The maximum fee for any cross-chain transfer is 0.5% of the transferred amount. All cross-chain transfers incur a flat fee of 0.01 units of the wrapped token, in addition to the percentage fee. The contract announces events for wrapped token minting, burning, and cross-chain transfer completions.
source_description: Orbit Bridge is an interchain communication protocol that allows communication between heterogeneous blockchains. Through this, users can utilize the various assets of various chains in all dApps through simple transactions on each chain.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Royco V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages an incentivized action market, holding deposited collateral tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, accrued rewards, and active action commitments, alongside global configuration for reward rates and action definitions. Callers can deposit collateral, commit to specific actions, claim earned rewards, and withdraw their collateral. A designated administrator can define new actions, adjust reward rates, and pause or unpause the contract's core functionality. Each action commitment requires a minimum collateral deposit of 100 base units of the collateral token, and a 5% fee is applied to all claimed rewards, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, action commitments, and reward claims, including the involved account, action identifier, and amounts.
source_description: The Incentivized Action Market (IAM) Protocol.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Jupiter Staked SOL and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing a liquid staking token representing staked value. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the total amount of base asset staked, and a per-user balance of the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset. A designated operator can initiate staking of deposited base assets and unstaking operations, and they can update the exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token. The owner can set the operator address and adjust the protocol fee, which is initially 0.1% of all base asset redemptions. The redemption of liquid staking tokens for base assets incurs a 7-day delay. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, redemption, and exchange rate update, including the affected user, amounts, and the new exchange rate.
source_description: Liquid staking on Solana

description: Outline a smart account contract based on Human ID and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for a decentralized identity registry, custodying unique identity tokens that represent verified human identities. It maintains a record for each registered identity, storing its unique identifier and a timestamp of its last verification, alongside a global count of total registered identities. Callers can register a new identity by providing proof of uniqueness, update their identity's verification timestamp, and query the verification status of any identity. A designated operator can pause new identity registrations and unpause them, and can also revoke an identity if it is found to be fraudulent. New identity registrations are limited to 100 per day, and a successful registration emits an event containing the new identity's unique identifier and the registration timestamp. The contract announces identity registration, identity verification updates, and identity revocations to observers.
source_description: An identity verification application and Sybil resistance protocol.

description: Outline a governance contract based on International Meme Fund V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized fund for community-driven initiatives, holding various fungible tokens contributed by participants. It tracks individual participant balances, the total fund balance for each token, and proposal states including voting results and funding allocations. Participants can deposit fungible tokens into the fund, propose new initiatives requiring funding, vote on active proposals, and withdraw their share of tokens from successfully funded proposals or their unallocated deposits. A designated operator can approve proposals for voting, execute successful proposals to disburse funds, and set the fee for proposal submission. A proposal must receive at least 51% 'yes' votes to pass, and a 0.01 ether fee is charged for each new proposal submitted. The contract announces when new proposals are created, when votes are cast, and when proposals are executed.
source_description: International Meme Fund

description: Define a staking contract based on Meta Pool Near and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool that custodies a base token and issues a liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a total amount of staked base tokens, and a per-user balance of liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw base tokens by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards. A designated operator can stake deposited base tokens with an external validator and unstake base tokens from an external validator. The owner can set the staking fee and upgrade the contract. The staking fee is fixed at 5% of all staking rewards. Withdrawals are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, when tokens are withdrawn, and when rewards are distributed.
source_description: Meta Pool is a liquid staking protocol built on the NEAR blockchain.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Binance Bitcoin and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a cross-chain bridge for a wrapped version of an external asset, holding the native external asset in custody. It maintains a total supply of the wrapped asset, a mapping of account balances for the wrapped asset, and a record of all pending withdrawal requests. Callers can deposit the external asset to mint the wrapped asset, transfer the wrapped asset to other accounts, and request a withdrawal of the external asset by burning the wrapped asset.
