A designated operator is solely responsible for approving and executing withdrawal requests, and for pausing or unpausing the contract's deposit and withdrawal functions. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, and a maximum of 100,000 units of the wrapped asset can be minted per day. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal, and transfer, announcing the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Binance Bridge pegged BTC token

description: Outline a staking contract based on Kyros and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid restaking vault, holding deposited SOL tokens and issuing a yield-bearing liquid restaking token (LRT). It maintains a total supply of the LRT, the amount of SOL deposited by each user, and a global restaking yield rate. Callers can deposit SOL to receive LRT, redeem LRT for SOL, and transfer LRT to other accounts. A designated operator can update the restaking yield rate and set a withdrawal fee. The withdrawal fee is capped at 0.5% of the redeemed SOL. Redemptions are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Kyros is a liquid restaking protocol built on Jito (Re)staking, offering uncapped yield potential through its liquid restaking token, kySOL. As a yield-bearing asset on Solana, kySOL consolidates staking rewards, MEV rewards, and restaking rewards into a single token for optimized returns.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Strike Finance Perpetuals and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages perpetual futures positions, holding collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances for collateral, open long and short positions for each trading pair, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, add collateral, withdraw excess collateral, and claim funding payments. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters, update oracle prices, and initiate liquidations for undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 10x the collateral provided. A 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions, paid in the designated stablecoin. The contract announces all position changes, liquidations, and funding rate updates.
source_description: Strike Finance is an open-source derivatives protocol built on top of Cardano offering options, forwards, and perpetual contract trading

description: Model a token contract based on Touch.fan and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social engagement token, which represents a user's commitment to a specific content creator, and custodies the native blockchain currency deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance for each creator, a total supply of engagement tokens for each creator, and a global configuration for the token's price per creator. Callers can deposit native currency to acquire engagement tokens for a chosen creator, transfer their engagement tokens to other users, and withdraw their underlying native currency by burning their engagement tokens. A designated operator can set the price of engagement tokens for any creator, and can pause all deposits and withdrawals. The price of engagement tokens for a creator must be at least 0.001 native currency per token. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the native currency returned to the user. The contract announces when engagement tokens are minted, transferred, or burned, and when native currency is deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: TOUCH your favorite celebrity make friends with similar interests.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Serum and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange order book for a single token pair, custodying deposits of both tokens. It maintains individual account balances for each token, a list of open buy orders, and a list of open sell orders, each with a price and quantity. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens, place a buy order, place a sell order, and cancel an open order. A designated operator can pause all trading operations. Order prices must be positive and divisible by 0.0001, and order quantities must be positive and divisible by 1. The contract emits an event when an order is placed, an order is canceled, or an order is filled.
source_description: Serum is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and ecosystem that brings unprecedented speed and low transaction costs to decentralized finance.

description: Specify a privacy-preserving contract based on Privacy Cash and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of the native blockchain currency by acting as a mixer, holding user deposits in a pool. It maintains a list of deposited commitment hashes and a nullifier set to prevent double-spending. Callers can deposit the native currency with a commitment hash, and later withdraw their deposited amount by providing a valid proof and a nullifier. The owner can update the fee percentage charged on withdrawals and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% of the withdrawn amount is enforced. Each deposit must be a minimum of 0.01 native currency. The contract emits an event upon successful deposits, withdrawals, and fee updates.
source_description: Privacy Cash allows users to transfer SOL privately

description: Design a governance contract based on Superfund and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pooled investment fund, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by participants. It maintains a record of each participant's share balance within the fund and the total amount of each held asset. Participants can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens to receive fund shares, redeem their shares for a proportional amount of the underlying assets, and view their current share balance. A designated fund manager can add or remove supported ERC-20 tokens, adjust the fund's investment strategy, and initiate rebalancing operations. A 0.5% fee is applied to all redemptions, and a maximum of 10 supported tokens can be held in the fund at any time. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or redemption occurs, detailing the participant, amount, and token involved.
source_description: SuperFunds are crypto-based vaults that work like mutual funds, each designed for a specific purpose and risk profile. They automatically manage assets to maximize yield, diversify risk, or support strategic borrowing

description: Design a staking contract based on Marinade Native and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a non-custodial, fee-free native staking mechanism for a base layer asset, allowing users to delegate their assets to a set of validators without relinquishing control. It maintains a registry of user-initiated staking requests, each linked to a specific validator, and tracks the total amount of the base asset delegated to each validator. Callers can initiate a new delegation, request to undelegate their assets, or claim their undelegated assets after a waiting period. A designated operator can add or remove validators from the approved list, and set the minimum delegation amount for any new delegation. The minimum delegation amount is fixed at 100 base assets. Undelegated assets become claimable after a 7-day cooldown period. The contract emits an event when a new delegation is initiated, when an undelegation request is made, and when undelegated assets are successfully claimed.
source_description: Marinade Native is a fee-free, smart contract-independent staking alternative on Solana that allows users to maintain custody of their SOL

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on BounceBit Prime and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages structured yield positions, holding user-deposited base tokens and their corresponding yield-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual user balances for deposited base tokens and accrued yield, along with a global configuration for strategy parameters and approved external venues. Callers can deposit base tokens, initiate a withdrawal of their principal and accrued yield, and claim their share of realized profits. A designated operator can deploy deposited funds into approved external venues, manage the delta-neutral strategy, and rebalance positions. The contract owner can set the maximum deposit amount to 100,000 base tokens per user, adjust the operator's permissions, and update the list of approved external venues. A 0.5% management fee is deducted from all realized profits before distribution. All withdrawals are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and successful profit distributions.
source_description: Build structured positions in Franklin's Benji & BlackRock BUIDL. Holdings remain in custody while Prime deploys them as collateral and runs delta-neutral strategies for you across approved venues.

description: Model a governance contract based on Upshift and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool for a single stablecoin, holding user deposits and distributing yield from external strategies. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total deposited amount, and configuration parameters for yield strategies. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their deposited principal and accrued yield, and claim their share of governance tokens distributed to depositors. A designated operator can add or remove approved yield strategies, adjust the interest rate spread, and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The maximum deposit per user is 100,000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, yield distributions, and changes to the operator or strategy configurations.
source_description: Upshift opens access to transparent yields backed by secure risk controls. Supply, stake and access cross-chain yields.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Solayer USD and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin backed by yield-generating real-world assets, holding tokenized representations of those assets as collateral. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, a total supply of the stablecoin, and a record of the current collateralization ratio. Callers can deposit approved collateral to mint new stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for the underlying collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. Only a designated operator can approve new collateral types and adjust the maximum minting limit. The contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 105% for all minted stablecoins, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, along with changes to the collateralization ratio.
source_description: Solayer USD (sUSD) is the yield-bearing stablecoin on Solana

description: Model a token contract based on Follows and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a system for creators to receive recurring support from fans, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a record of each fan's active subscriptions to creators, including the amount and duration of each subscription, and a global configuration for system fees. Callers can subscribe to a creator, renew an existing subscription, or cancel a subscription. Only a designated operator can set the system-wide subscription fee percentage and add new creators to the platform. The maximum subscription duration is 12 months, and a 5% system fee is applied to all new subscription payments. The contract announces when a subscription is created, renewed, or canceled, and when the system fee percentage is updated.
source_description: Follows is a new form of creator-fan relation leveraging the web3 platform

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Yield Yak Aggregator and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator that accepts and custodies a single designated base token, depositing it into various external yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, the total amount deposited in each strategy, and a configuration for each strategy including its current allocation percentage. Callers can deposit the base token, withdraw their deposited amount, and claim any accumulated yield. The owner can add new strategies, remove existing strategies, update the allocation percentage for each strategy, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The contract will only allow a maximum of 10 active strategies at any given time, and a 0.5% fee is charged on all withdrawals, which is directed to a designated treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address, the amount, and the strategy involved if applicable.
source_description: Yield Yak Aggregator is an easy-to-use tool to earn more yield from defi farming on the Avalanche network.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Belt Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregation vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding deposited user funds and their accumulated yield. It maintains per-user deposit balances, the total deposited amount, and configuration parameters for its yield-generating strategy. Callers can deposit the specified ERC-20 token, withdraw their deposited amount plus any earned yield, and claim any available rewards tokens. The owner can update the strategy contract address, adjust the fee percentage for withdrawals, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The withdrawal fee is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and the strategy contract can only be changed once every 24 hours. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Yield aggregator + AMM

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Dexioprotocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native utility token, facilitating staking and reward distribution. It maintains individual user stake balances, accumulated rewards, and a global reward pool. Callers can stake tokens, unstake tokens, claim accumulated rewards, and transfer tokens to other users. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and deposit tokens into the global reward pool, while the contract owner can pause all staking and unstaking operations. The minimum staking amount is 100 tokens, and unstaking incurs a 5% fee on the unstaked amount if performed within 7 days of staking. The contract emits events for successful staking, unstaking, reward claims, and token transfers.
source_description: A Web3 & Gaming Experience Bridging the Gap Between Traditional Enterprise & the Web3 Revolution

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on StarCrazy and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital assets, each representing a distinct in-game character, and holds a fungible utility token used for in-game transactions. It maintains a record of ownership for each unique digital asset, the current balance of the utility token for each player, and a global configuration for asset creation and modification. Players can acquire new unique digital assets, transfer their owned unique digital assets to other players, and spend utility tokens for in-game actions. A designated operator can mint new unique digital assets, burn existing unique digital assets, and adjust the utility token emission rate. New unique digital assets can only be minted if the total supply of unique digital assets does not exceed 10,000. Each transfer of a unique digital asset incurs a 2% fee, payable in the utility token, which is sent to a treasury address. The contract emits an event whenever a unique digital asset is transferred, minted, or burned, and when a player's utility token balance changes.
source_description: StarCrazy is the NFT and blockchain Play-To-Earn game. Collect, fuse, mine, and earn. GFT is its main game currency.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Homora V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a leveraged yield farming vault, holding deposited base tokens and borrowed tokens. It maintains per-account records of deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and active farming positions, along with global configuration parameters for each supported farming strategy. Callers can deposit base tokens, open new leveraged farming positions, add collateral to existing positions, close positions, and withdraw their available base tokens. Only a designated operator can register new farming strategies and adjust the maximum leverage factor for each strategy. The maximum leverage factor for any farming strategy is capped at 10x, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all profits realized from closing a farming position. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations.
source_description: Homora is the first flagship product incubated under Alpha Venture DAO (previously Alpha Finance Lab) deployed on the Ethereum network in October, 2020. It is the largest multi-chain lending and leveraged yield farming protocol. Homora V2 is currently available on Ethereum, Avalanche, Fantom, Optimism and more coming soon.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Crack And Stack and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a multiplayer game where players collect and risk Ether. It maintains each player's current Ether balance within the game, their total Ether collected across all games, and a global high score for the largest single game collection. Players can enter a new game by depositing Ether, collect additional Ether within the game, attempt to escape a game to claim their collected Ether, or be eliminated from a game, losing their collected Ether. Only a designated game operator can initiate new game rounds and eliminate players. A player's initial deposit to enter a game must be at least 0.01 Ether, and the operator can set a maximum of 10 active games concurrently. The contract announces when a player enters a game, collects Ether, escapes with Ether, is eliminated, and when the global high score is updated.
source_description: Crack & Stack is the leading multiplayer Web3 game on Taiko. Enter the mines, collect ETH and try to escape with your bounty.

description: Design a token contract based on Money Mates and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for creator-economy projects, holding wrapped native tokens and a project-specific fungible token. It maintains individual balances for each user's wrapped native token deposits and project token holdings, along with a global total supply of the project token and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit wrapped native tokens, withdraw their wrapped native tokens, mint new project tokens by locking wrapped native tokens, burn project tokens to unlock wrapped native tokens, and transfer project tokens to other users. Only the owner can set the fee percentage, pause all minting and burning operations, or designate an operator who can also pause operations. A minimum deposit of 0.01 wrapped native tokens is required for minting, and the maximum fee percentage that can be set is 5%. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, mint, burn, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Empowering the creator economy with tailored financial tools

description: Define a smart account contract based on Rainbow Wallet and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a multi-chain asset bridge, enabling users to transfer a specific fungible token between an origin chain and a destination chain, and it custodies the bridged tokens on the origin chain. It maintains a record of each user's locked token balance on the origin chain, a global total supply of bridged tokens on the destination chain, and a mapping of transaction nonces to their completion status. Callers can initiate a transfer on the origin chain, claim a transfer on the destination chain, or cancel an unfulfilled transfer on the origin chain. A designated operator can approve a transfer for claiming on the destination chain and can pause or unpause the bridging functionality. Each transfer initiated on the origin chain must be for a minimum of 100 tokens. A transfer claim on the destination chain must occur within 7 days of its approval by the operator. The contract announces when a transfer is initiated, when a transfer is approved, and when a transfer is claimed.
source_description: The fun, simple, & secure way to explore Web3, NFTs, & Ethereum

description: Design a governance contract based on Solv Strategies and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages automated investment strategies, holding user-deposited Bitcoin-backed tokens. It maintains individual user balances for each strategy, a global configuration for active strategies, and records of current allocations within external DeFi protocols. Callers can deposit Bitcoin-backed tokens into a chosen strategy, withdraw their share from a strategy, and claim earned rewards. A designated operator can add new strategies, adjust strategy parameters, and initiate rebalancing operations across strategies. Each strategy has a maximum deposit cap of 1000 Bitcoin-backed tokens, and a 0.5% performance fee is applied to all earned rewards before distribution. All deposits and withdrawals emit an event detailing the user, strategy, and amount.
source_description: Solv Strategies simplifies DeFi with automated solutions that put your Bitcoin to work. From liquidity provision to sophisticated yield farming, these curated strategies make it easy to earn rewards across DeFi protocols—no expertise required.

description: Create an NFT contract based on JPG Store and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a non-custodial marketplace for unique digital assets, holding only the specific digital assets offered for sale and the proceeds from their successful sale. It maintains a record of each listed asset, including its current seller, its asking price, and whether it has been sold, along with a configurable marketplace fee percentage. Callers can list a digital asset for sale, purchase a listed digital asset, and cancel their own active listings. Only a designated marketplace administrator can adjust the marketplace fee percentage. The marketplace fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price for every successful transaction, and a listed asset's price cannot be changed once it is active; it must be delisted and relisted to adjust the price. The contract announces when an asset is listed, when an asset is purchased, and when a listing is cancelled.
source_description: The leading Cardano NFT marketplace. Find and discover upcoming NFT drops, and buy and sell your favorite NFTs and collectibles with just a few clicks. No escrow, no delays, just connect your wallet and buy with our smart contracts

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on DarkCrypto and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token-pegged algorithmic stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a base asset to back the stablecoin. It maintains the current supply of the stablecoin, the amount of the base asset held in reserve, and a record of each user's stablecoin balance. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing the base asset, redeem stablecoins for the base asset, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can adjust the target peg ratio and initiate emergency shutdowns. The minimum minting amount is 100 base units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all redemption operations. The contract announces stablecoin minting events, stablecoin burning events, and transfers of stablecoins.
source_description: DarkCrypto Finance is the first ecosystem running around an algorithmic token pegged to CRO on Cronos chain. DarkVerse will be our ecosystem using DARK as the main token. It contains: DeFi App (Vaults, Stablecoin swap, lending), GameFi, NFT Apps, Betting DApps, MetaVerse applications

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Lighter Robinhood Perps and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral in a stablecoin for all open positions. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters for trading pairs. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, modify existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update oracle prices, liquidate undercollateralized positions, and adjust trading pair parameters. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 20x. A 0.1% fee is charged on all trades, deducted from the collateral. The contract announces position openings, position closures, liquidations, and collateral deposits and withdrawals.
source_description: Lighter is a decentralized trading platform that is designed to deliver unmatched security and scale. Lighter provides verifiable matching and liquidations, while operating at the best-in-class traditional exchange level performances.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Synapse Cross Chain Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on the source chain and releasing native tokens on the destination chain, or vice-versa. It maintains a record of deposited amounts for each user, a total supply of wrapped tokens, and a configuration for each supported token including its destination chain identifier and associated bridge agent. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing tokens, redeem tokens on a destination chain after a successful transfer, and claim refunds for failed transfers. A designated operator can pause and unpause transfers for specific tokens, and update the bridge agent for a given token. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all transfers, and a minimum transfer amount of 100 units for any supported token. The contract emits an event upon successful deposit, successful redemption, and when a transfer is refunded.
source_description: Synapse is a universal cross-chain liquidity network. Synapse connects blockchains by offering an extensible cross-chain communication protocol that supports assets, smart contract calls, and more

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Gate Fun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a token launchpad, allowing creators to issue new tokens and establish initial liquidity. It maintains a record of each launched token project, including its creator, the total supply of the new token, and the amount of base currency committed for liquidity. Callers can initiate a new token launch, contribute base currency to an ongoing launch, and claim their share of newly created tokens after a successful launch. Only the contract owner can set the platform fee for new token launches and pause all new launch initiations. A platform fee of 0.5% of the total base currency committed for liquidity is charged for each successful launch. Each token launch must raise a minimum of 1000 base currency to be considered successful. The contract announces the initiation of a new token launch and the successful completion of a launch.
source_description: Gate Fun, built on Gate Layer, is a creator-friendly launchpad that offers no-code token issuance, low-cost deployment, and seamless liquidity building

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Function FBTC and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for a wrapped asset, custodying the underlying asset in a vault. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped asset balance and the total supply of the wrapped asset. Callers can deposit the underlying asset to mint the wrapped asset, and they can redeem the wrapped asset to withdraw the underlying asset. A designated operator can pause or unpause all minting and redeeming operations. The redemption fee is 0.1% of the amount redeemed, and a minimum deposit of 0.001 units of the underlying asset is required for minting. The contract announces to observers when assets are deposited, when assets are redeemed, and when the operator changes the contract's paused status.
source_description: Function is building the standard infrastructure that transforms Bitcoin into a capital-efficient, hyperliquid, and composable asset through ƒBTC (FBTC). By enabling Bitcoin to flow freely across financial markets, Function is positioning BTC as the reserve asset for both traditional and decentralized finance. ƒBTC is powered by core contributors Antalpha Prime, Mantle, and Galaxy Digital.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on tBTC and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the bridging of a specific external digital asset to a fungible token on the Ethereum network, holding the external digital asset in custody. It maintains a record of each user's deposited external asset amount and their corresponding minted token balance, alongside a global configuration for fees and minimum deposit sizes. Callers can deposit the external asset to mint tokens, redeem tokens to withdraw the external asset, and approve token transfers. A designated operator can adjust the deposit fee and the minimum deposit amount, and can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited amount, and the minimum external asset deposit is 0.01 units. The contract announces events for all successful deposits, withdrawals, and fee updates.
source_description: tBTC is Threshold's decentralized and permissionless bridge to bring BTC to the Ethereum network. tBTC has been designed to allow bitcoin holders to participate in Ethereum's Decentralized Finance (DeFi) applications. Users wishing to utilize their bitcoin on Ethereum can use the tBTC decentralized bridge to deposit their bitcoin into the system and get a minted tBTC token in their Ethereum wallet

description: Outline a governance contract based on Rigoblock and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages investment pools, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's share balance within each pool, along with pool-specific configurations for allowed assets and trading strategies. Callers can create new pools, deposit ERC-20 tokens into existing pools to receive pool shares, withdraw their deposited tokens by redeeming shares, and propose trades for a pool's assets. A designated operator is privileged to approve or reject proposed trades, set the management fee for each pool, and add or remove allowed assets for a pool. The maximum management fee that can be set for any pool is 5% annually, and a 0.1% performance fee is charged on all profitable trades. The contract announces events for pool creation, deposits, withdrawals, and approved trades.
source_description: Swap, earn and interact with DeFi through smart pools.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Fren Pets and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages unique digital pet tokens, serving as a staking vault for these non-fungible tokens (NFTs). It maintains individual records of staked pets per user, along with global configurations for staking rewards and pet attributes. Callers can stake their pet NFTs, claim accrued rewards, and withdraw their staked pets. A designated operator can adjust the daily reward rate for staked pets, and the owner can pause all staking and withdrawal operations. The maximum number of pets a single user can stake is 5, and the daily reward rate for staking cannot exceed 0.01 units of the reward token per pet. The contract announces events for pet staking, reward claims, and pet withdrawals.
source_description: Grow and battle fren pets with frens. A gaming "P2E" NFT project with staking and farm attributes

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on OrderNChaos and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, specifically the minting and burning of a metastable token and a superstable token. It maintains a record of the total supply of both the metastable token and the superstable token, and a global configuration for minting and burning parameters. Callers can mint the metastable token by depositing a base asset, burn the metastable token to redeem the base asset, mint the superstable token by depositing the metastable token, and burn the superstable token to redeem the metastable token. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio for minting the superstable token and set the stability fee for burning the superstable token. The collateralization ratio for minting the superstable token must always be between 100% and 150%, inclusive. A stability fee of 0.5% is applied when burning the superstable token. The contract announces the current total supply of both the metastable token and the superstable token, and the current collateralization ratio and stability fee.
source_description: OrderNChaos(ONC) is a twin system of algorithmic stable coins. ONC produces the $CHAOS token: an algorithmic metastable token that serves as a store of wealth. And it produces the $ORDER token: a decentralized superstable store of value.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Native Credit Pool and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a single-asset lending pool, holding deposited tokens and tracking outstanding loans. It maintains the total amount of tokens deposited, the total amount borrowed, and for each borrower, their current outstanding principal and accrued interest. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, borrow tokens against a pre-approved credit line, repay their outstanding loans, and withdraw their available deposits. The owner can set the interest rate model, adjust the total credit available to a specific borrower, and pause or unpause borrowing and lending operations. The maximum annual interest rate is 25%, and a borrower's outstanding principal plus accrued interest cannot exceed 110% of their approved credit line. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and withdrawal events, including the amount and the involved account.
source_description: Native Credit Pool is a unified, single-sided asset supply pool that enables market makers to borrow assets for trading, thereby enhancing liquidity in the on-chain spot market.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on SuiBridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain bridge for transferring a specific wrapped asset between two networks, holding custody of the wrapped asset on this network. It maintains a record of each user's pending withdrawals and a global counter for total wrapped assets bridged. Callers can initiate a transfer of wrapped assets to the other network, claim wrapped assets received from the other network, and cancel a pending withdrawal before it is finalized. A designated operator can approve a transfer from the other network and finalize a withdrawal to the other network. The maximum amount that can be transferred in a single transaction is 1000 wrapped assets. A 0.1% fee is charged on all transfers initiated from this network. The contract announces when a transfer is initiated, when a transfer is approved, and when a withdrawal is finalized.
source_description: Sui Bridge is a cutting-edge native bridge on Sui, designed to enhance interoperability between Sui and Ethereum. It enables users to securely and efficiently transfer native and wrapped ETH to and from Sui. The bridge leverages the unique capabilities of the Sui network to offer fast transaction speeds, lower transaction costs, and a decentralized architecture.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on DxSale and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of token launch events, holding deposited tokens for distribution. It maintains a record of each launch event's configuration, including the token being sold, the fundraising token, soft cap, hard cap, and individual participant allocations. Callers can create a new launch event, contribute fundraising tokens to an active event, claim purchased tokens after a successful event, or withdraw their contributions if an event fails. A designated owner can set the platform fee percentage, cancel an ongoing launch event, or withdraw accumulated platform fees. The platform fee is fixed at 2% of all raised funds. Each launch event must have a minimum soft cap of 100 fundraising tokens and a maximum hard cap of 10,000 fundraising tokens. The contract emits events when a new launch event is created, a contribution is made, tokens are claimed, or an event is cancelled.
source_description: With currently 16 supported chains, Dx is the biggest IDO Launchpad in the crypto space. As a truly decentralized token management platform, we aim for a low-barrier approach to launching your project. Instead of a steep learning curve and cumbersome interfaces, our platform will provide all the necessary tools to create and launch your project with no prior coding skills required. Of course, you can also use our platform if you're just here to invest in a project you deem interesting. This will be the first decision you will face

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Ink Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a cross-chain bridge for a specific fungible token, enabling users to lock tokens on this chain and mint equivalent wrapped tokens on a connected destination chain, or burn wrapped tokens on the destination chain and unlock original tokens here; it custodies the locked fungible tokens. The contract maintains a total supply of locked tokens, a mapping of each user's locked token balance, and a record of all completed bridge operations including a unique identifier and the amount transferred. Callers can initiate a lock operation by depositing tokens, and can request an unlock operation by providing proof of a burn event on the destination chain. A designated operator is responsible for approving unlock operations and setting the bridge fee, which is fixed at 0.1% of the transfer amount, and can only be changed once every 24 hours. The maximum single transfer amount is 1,000,000 tokens. The contract announces events for successful lock operations, successful unlock operations, and changes to the bridge fee.
source_description: Bridge for Ink chain by Kraken

description: Define an NFT contract based on Immutable Orderbook and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This smart contract establishes a shared orderbook for non-fungible tokens, holding no custody over assets directly but facilitating their exchange. It maintains a record of active listings and bids for specific non-fungible tokens, including the token identifier, the desired price, and the seller or bidder's address. Callers can create new listings, place bids on existing listings, cancel their own listings or bids, and execute a trade when a matching listing and bid are present. A designated operator is privileged to pause all trading activity and to update the royalty enforcement mechanism. The contract imposes a maximum of 100 active listings per unique non-fungible token collection and charges a fixed 0.5% protocol fee on all successful trades, deducted from the seller's proceeds. The contract emits events upon the creation of new listings and bids, their cancellation, and the successful execution of a trade.
source_description: Immutable Orderbook is a shared liquidity layer for NFT trading on Immutable zkEVM, enabling marketplaces and developers to share listings and bids across all integrated platforms while enforcing royalties

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on Nirvana V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding a reserve of various collateral assets. It maintains individual user balances for the stablecoin, the reserve token, and collateral deposits, along with system-wide configuration parameters like the current collateralization ratio and fee rates. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem underlying collateral, and stake stablecoins to earn reserve tokens. A designated operator can adjust the list of approved collateral assets and their individual collateral factors, and can also update the system's target collateralization ratio. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract emits events for all stablecoin mints, burns, and reserve token distributions.
source_description: Anchored by an algorithm-owned reserve, the Nirvana platform guarantees a floor price for ANA that permanently ascends with demand, while NIRV provides zero-risk credit. Together the pair harmonizes risk with reward, and transforms digital assets into durable wealth

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on Gluon Gold and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin protocol that mints a digital gold token, backed by a reserve asset. It maintains individual balances of the digital gold token for each user, a total supply of the digital gold token, and the current balance of the reserve asset held within the contract. Callers can mint new digital gold tokens by depositing the reserve asset, redeem digital gold tokens for the reserve asset, and transfer digital gold tokens to other users. A designated operator can adjust the minting fee and the redemption fee. The minting fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited reserve asset, and the redemption fee is fixed at 0.75% of the redeemed digital gold tokens. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Gluon is a novel stabilization protocol inspired by nuclear physics, offering reliable stability or exposure to volatility based on your needs. Have digital Gold on-chain, backed by ERG, without the risks and inconveniences of physical gold.

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on Farm Hero and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized gaming platform's core mechanics, specifically handling the creation and management of unique digital creature tokens and their associated in-game resources. It maintains individual creature records, including their type, level, and current resource balances, as well as a global configuration for creature generation parameters. Callers can mint new creatures, feed their creatures to increase their level, and harvest resources from their creatures. A designated operator can adjust the resource generation rate and introduce new creature types. New creature minting is capped at 1000 creatures per day, and harvesting resources incurs a 5% platform fee. The contract announces creature minting events, creature level-ups, and resource harvesting events.
source_description: FarmHero is a novel protocol that mixes NFT, gaming and DEFI concepts.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Showdown and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages competitive gaming matches, holding a designated stablecoin for match entry fees and prize pools. It maintains a record of active matches, including their current state, participating players, and the stablecoin amount committed by each player, alongside a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can create a new match, join an existing match by depositing the entry fee, submit game results, and claim their winnings from completed matches. Only a designated operator can create new matches and resolve disputes by unilaterally declaring a match winner. The maximum number of players in any match is fixed at 8. A 5% fee is deducted from the total prize pool of each match before distribution to the winner. The contract announces match creation, player joins, result submissions, and prize claims.
source_description: Showdown is a Web3 competitive card game on MegaETH that reinvents poker with strategic deckbuilding and real-stakes gameplay, letting players compete in money games and tournaments using USDm.

description: Create a payments contract based on Spritz Card and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits of various cryptocurrencies to facilitate payments through a linked card service, holding deposited funds in escrow. It maintains individual user account balances for each supported cryptocurrency and a global configuration for fees and supported assets. Callers can deposit supported cryptocurrencies, withdraw their available balance, and link or unlink their payment card. A designated operator can add or remove supported cryptocurrencies, adjust transaction fees, and process payment requests by transferring funds from user balances. The maximum transaction fee is 5% of the transaction value, and a user's withdrawal request will be processed within 24 hours. The contract emits an event upon successful deposits, withdrawals, and payment card linkage changes.
source_description: Spritz Card is a crypto card issuer that allows you to pay for your purchases with crypto.

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on RobinFun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and the newly issued project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their allocated share of project tokens, along with the current state of the launch phase. Callers can deposit tokens during the open phase, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent deposited tokens if the launch fails to meet its minimum threshold. The owner can set the launch parameters, initiate the launch, and finalize it. A launch must raise at least 100,000 units of the deposited token to be considered successful, and the owner can only finalize a launch after a minimum 24-hour participation period. The contract announces when a launch starts, when it ends, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: Launch ideas. Trade narratives. A launchpad for market-born tokens.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Meld Gold and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract mints and burns a token representing physical gold, custodying no assets itself, but tracking the supply of the token. It maintains a total supply of the token and individual account balances. Callers can transfer tokens to other accounts, approve spending by another account, and transfer tokens on behalf of another account. A designated operator can mint new tokens, burn existing tokens, and pause or unpause all token transfers. The total supply of tokens cannot exceed 1,000,000 grams. A transfer fee of 0.1% is applied to all token transfers. The contract announces token transfers, approvals, minting, and burning events.
source_description: One Meld Token equates to one gram of the corresponding precious metal that is fully redeemable and housed in a network of secure vaults and facilities.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Mantle Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain bridge for transferring a specific wrapped token between a Layer-1 network and a Layer-2 network, holding the Layer-1 native token as collateral. It maintains a record of each user's deposited Layer-1 native tokens awaiting transfer to Layer-2, and a total supply of the wrapped token on Layer-2. Callers can deposit Layer-1 native tokens to receive wrapped tokens on Layer-2, and burn wrapped tokens on Layer-2 to withdraw Layer-1 native tokens. A designated operator can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and can update the address of the Layer-2 bridge contract. The maximum single deposit amount is 10,000 Layer-1 native tokens, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events including the depositor's address, the amount, and the Layer-2 recipient address, and withdrawal events including the Layer-1 recipient address and the amount.
source_description: Mantle Network is a Layer-2 (L2) scalability solution built on Ethereum which is the Layer-1 (L1).

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Ispolink and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native token rewards for user engagement, holding a pool of these tokens to distribute. It maintains individual user balances of earned, claimable tokens and a global configuration for reward rates. Callers can register for the platform, claim their earned tokens, and stake tokens for bonus rewards. A designated administrator can set the reward rate for engagement and add tokens to the reward pool. The maximum daily claimable amount per user is 100 tokens, and the base reward rate for engagement is 5 tokens per eligible action. The contract announces when tokens are claimed and when the reward rate is updated.
source_description: Ispolink is a leading ecosystem of AI and Gaming products developing the Future of Work on Web3

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on DogeDollar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract mints and burns a stablecoin, maintaining a reserve of a volatile collateral token. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, a total supply of the stablecoin, and the total amount of collateral held in reserve. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause or unpause minting and burning. The initial collateralization ratio is 150%, meaning 1.5 units of collateral token are required to mint 1 unit of stablecoin. A 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin transfers, which is sent to a treasury address. The contract emits events for all minting, burning, and transfer operations, including the sender, recipient, amount, and any fees.
source_description: An overcollateralized algorithmic stablecoin backed by DOGE on dogechain.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Concentrator and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator that custodies user-deposited tokens and manages their deployment into external yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balances, the total amount of each token held by the contract, and a configuration of approved external strategy contracts. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. Only the owner can approve new external strategy contracts, set the fee percentage for claimed rewards, and initiate emergency withdrawals of all funds. A 0.5% fee is applied to all claimed rewards, and a maximum of 10 external strategy contracts can be approved at any given time. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events, including the user's address, the token involved, and the amount.
source_description: Aladdin concentrator is a platform that boosts rewards for Curve & Convex stakers and liquidity providers alike, all in a simple and easy to use interface.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Sushi Stellar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and custodies user-provided liquidity in token pairs. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool, including the reserves for each token in the pair, the total outstanding liquidity tokens for that pool, and each user's balance of liquidity tokens. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated operator can set the swap fee percentage, which defaults to 0.3% and cannot exceed 1%. The contract announces liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps, including the tokens involved and the amounts.
source_description: SushiSwap on the Stellar chain.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Civitia Game and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a game's property ownership and associated yield, custodying non-fungible tokens representing game properties and the game's native fungible token. It maintains a record of each player's owned properties, their accumulated yield per property, and global game configuration parameters like property prices and yield rates. Callers can purchase available properties, collect accumulated yield from their owned properties, and sell properties back to the game. Only a designated game administrator can set the base price for each property type, adjust the yield rate for each property type, and mint new property non-fungible tokens. A player can own a maximum of 10 properties at any given time. The yield collection action incurs a fixed 1% fee on the collected amount, which is transferred to the game administrator's treasury. The contract emits an event whenever a property is purchased, sold, or when yield is collected.
source_description: A yield strategy appchain inspired by Monopoly.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Axie Infinity and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of unique digital creature tokens, allowing users to own, breed, and battle them. It maintains individual creature token records, including their unique identifiers, genetic traits, battle statistics, and ownership. Callers can acquire new creature tokens from a designated pool, transfer creature tokens to other users, initiate breeding between two owned creature tokens, and engage their creature tokens in battle simulations. Only a designated operator can mint new creature tokens into the pool and set the breeding fee. A breeding operation requires two creature tokens and costs a fixed fee of 0.005 of the native blockchain currency. Each creature token can participate in a maximum of 7 breeding operations. The contract announces the transfer of creature tokens, the creation of new creature tokens, and the outcome of battle simulations.
source_description: Axie Infinity is a digital game that fuses NFT collectibles and blockchain. The game allows users to discover, collect, combine, and battle fantasy creatures called Axies.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Sudoswap V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates efficient, customizable NFT trading by managing liquidity pools for various NFT collections and their associated fungible tokens. It maintains state for each pool, including its NFT collection address, fungible token balance, NFT inventory, and configurable trading parameters like curves and fees. Callers can create new pools, add liquidity to existing pools by depositing NFTs or fungible tokens, remove liquidity, and execute trades by buying or selling NFTs. A designated operator can adjust pool trading curves, update royalty recipient addresses, and set the platform-wide trading fee percentage, which defaults to 0.5% and cannot exceed 2%. The contract announces successful trades, liquidity additions, and liquidity removals to observers.
source_description: SudoSwap V2 includes features like on-chain royalties, adaptable creator settings, ERC-1155 support, and conditional orders, alongside introducing fee streaming and gas optimizations

description: Specify a staking contract based on DoubleZero Staked SOL and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a total amount of staked base assets, and a mapping of each user's liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit base assets to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim staking rewards proportional to their share of the pool. A designated operator can update the exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token based on staking rewards and penalties, and can pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The minimum deposit amount is 0.1 base assets, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, withdrawal, and exchange rate update.
source_description: DoubleZero Staked SOL is a staking pool on the Solana network that allows users to stake their SOL and earn rewards.

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Bridge Mutual and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized risk coverage pool, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing coverage payouts. It maintains records of individual user deposits, active coverage policies, and a global configuration for each covered asset. Callers can deposit stablecoins into coverage pools, request coverage for a specified asset, file claims against active policies, and withdraw their deposited funds. Only a designated operator can approve or reject claims, and only the contract owner can adjust coverage policy parameters or add new covered assets. Each coverage policy has a fixed premium of 0.5% of the covered amount, and a minimum coverage period of 30 days. The contract emits an event whenever a new deposit is made, a policy is created, a claim is filed, or a claim decision is made.
source_description: A risk coverage platform for stablecoins, protocols, smart contracts, exchanges and more.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on SuiMarket and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a prediction market for binary outcomes, custodying user deposits of a designated stablecoin. It maintains a record of each market's question, resolution time, current total staked amounts for "yes" and "no" outcomes, and each user's staked amount and outcome choice per market. Callers can create a new market, stake stablecoins on a "yes" or "no" outcome, withdraw their stake if the market has not resolved, and claim their winnings after a market has been resolved. The contract owner can resolve a market to "yes" or "no" and set the market creation fee. A market creation fee of 5 stablecoins is charged for each new market. Users can only stake stablecoins up to 24 hours before the market's designated resolution time. The contract announces market creation, stake placement, stake withdrawal, market resolution, and winning claims.
source_description: The first prediction market on Sui network

description: Model a payments contract based on Helio and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates one-time and recurring cryptocurrency payments, holding deposited tokens securely until claimed or refunded. It maintains records of each payment stream, including the recipient, amount, frequency, and current status, along with a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can create new payment streams, deposit funds into existing streams, claim payments as a recipient, and cancel their own active streams. A designated operator can pause all new stream creation, update the global fee percentage, and initiate emergency refunds for specific streams. The maximum number of active payment streams per sender is capped at 100, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all successful payment claims. The contract announces events for new stream creation, successful payment claims, and stream cancellations.
source_description: Crypto payments platform

description: Design a price oracle contract based on Orcfax and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized data feed registry and validation mechanism, holding no custodied assets. It maintains a registry of data feed configurations, including their update intervals and data source identifiers, and tracks the latest validated data points for each feed. Callers can query the latest validated data for any registered feed, and designated operators can propose new data points for specific feeds. Only the owner can register new data feeds, update existing feed configurations, or designate new operators. A data feed must be updated at least once every 24 hours to remain active, and a fee of 0.01 native currency is charged for each successful data point submission by an operator. The contract announces the successful validation and update of a data feed, including the new data value and its timestamp, to observers.
source_description: Orcfax provides decentralized oracle feeds on the Cardano blockchain with triangulated data collection and fully auditable logs

description: Design a lending protocol based on Alpaca Leveraged Yield Farming and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged yield farming by holding user-deposited collateral tokens and borrowed asset tokens. It maintains individual user positions, including deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and current leverage ratios, along with a global configuration for supported farming pools and interest rates. Callers can deposit collateral, open leveraged farming positions, close existing positions, repay borrowed assets, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated owner can add new farming pools, adjust interest rate models, and set liquidation thresholds. Leverage ratios are capped at 5x the initial collateral value, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract announces events for position opening, position closing, and liquidations.
source_description: The 1st leveraged yield farming protocol on BSC

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Extra Finance Leverage Farming and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged yield farming positions by managing user-deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains records of each user's active positions, including their deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and the specific yield farm they are participating in, along with global configuration parameters such as available farming strategies and interest rates. Callers can open new leveraged positions, add more collateral to existing positions, partially or fully close positions, and repay borrowed funds. A designated operator can add new farming strategies, update interest rate models, and adjust risk parameters for existing strategies. A maximum leverage ratio of 5x is enforced for all positions, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all borrowed amounts upon position opening. The contract announces events for position openings, closures, and significant changes to position parameters.
source_description: Extra Finance is a community-driven lending & leveraged yield farming protocol built on Optimism.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Origin ARM and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-bearing vault for Ether, custodying deposited Ether and its associated yield. It maintains a total supply of vault shares, a record of each user's deposited Ether balance, and a configuration for the current yield strategy. Callers can deposit Ether to receive vault shares, redeem vault shares for Ether, and claim any accumulated yield. A designated operator can initiate a yield-generating strategy, pause and unpause deposits, and update the strategy configuration. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and deposits are capped at 10,000 Ether per user. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the yield strategy.
source_description: The Origin ARM vault allows users to deposit ETH and earn passive yield. The ARM earns yield by using ETH to buy stETH from the market at a discount and redeeming it 1:1 through Lido’s stETH redemption queue.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Manarium and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's in-game currency rewards and distribution, holding the platform's native token. It maintains individual player balances, a global reward pool, and configuration parameters for reward rates. Players can claim earned rewards, deposit tokens into the reward pool, and transfer their in-game currency to other players. A designated operator can set the daily reward emission rate and pause or unpause reward claims. The daily reward emission rate cannot exceed 10,000 tokens, and a 1% fee is applied to all player-to-player transfers, which is directed to the reward pool. The contract announces when rewards are claimed, when tokens are deposited, and when transfers occur.
source_description: Manarium is a unique blockchain gaming platform with play to earn games.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on DogeClaw and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's in-game currency and NFT assets, holding deposited tokens and tracking ownership of unique digital items. It maintains individual player balances for the in-game currency, a registry of all minted NFTs with their current owners, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can deposit tokens to acquire in-game currency, purchase NFTs from a designated marketplace, transfer NFTs to other players, and withdraw their in-game currency back to tokens. A designated operator can mint new NFTs, set the price for NFTs in the marketplace, and adjust the conversion rate between deposited tokens and in-game currency. The maximum supply of any single NFT type is capped at 10,000 units, and a 2% fee is applied to all NFT transfers between players. The contract announces events for token deposits, NFT purchases, NFT transfers, and token withdrawals.
source_description: Dogeclaw is a play to earn Gamefi NFT platform on Okex chain

description: Define a lending protocol based on Loopscale and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a lending market for a specific collateral token and a specific borrowable token, holding deposited collateral tokens and minted borrowable tokens. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral and borrowed amounts, a global pool of available borrowable tokens, and configuration parameters for interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay borrowed amounts, and withdraw their excess collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust interest rate models, set liquidation thresholds, or pause new deposits. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a 0.5% liquidation penalty is applied to the collateral of liquidated positions. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Loopscale is a modular lending platform for the next-generation of onchain assets. Markets for any asset, at the best rate, with less risk

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Sophon Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance for each supported token, and a global configuration for supported tokens and their associated transfer fees. Callers can deposit tokens, initiate a withdrawal request for their deposited tokens to a specified destination chain, and claim their tokens on the destination chain after a successful transfer. A designated operator can approve or reject withdrawal requests, and set the transfer fee for each token. The maximum transfer fee for any token is 0.5% of the transferred amount. All withdrawal requests have a mandatory 30-minute delay before they can be approved. The contract emits an event upon successful deposit and another upon successful withdrawal.
source_description: Sophon is a ZK chain

description: Specify a token contract based on hi.market and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages and custodies unique digital assets, allowing creators to tokenize their social presence and offer exclusive access. It maintains per-asset records including its current owner, a list of associated privileges, and a configurable price, along with a global fee percentage and a designated operator address. Callers can purchase an asset, transfer an asset to another address, and redeem privileges associated with an owned asset. The owner can set the global fee percentage, designate a new operator, and withdraw collected fees. The operator can update the price of any asset and add or remove privileges from an asset. The global fee percentage is fixed at 5% of all purchase transactions. Each asset can have a maximum of 10 associated privileges. The contract announces asset purchases, asset transfers, and privilege redemptions.
source_description: Hi.Market is a decentralized and unique SocialFi application. By tokenizing your digital assets on Hi.market, you can communicate with your users and provide them with special privileges. Take a closer look at the future of SocialFi and get to know Hi.market better

description: Model a staking contract based on Binance staked ETH and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking wrapper for a base staked ETH token, holding deposits of the base token and issuing a new wrapper token. It maintains a record of each user's wrapper token balance and the total supply of wrapper tokens, along with a configurable exchange rate between the base token and the wrapper token. Callers can deposit the base staked ETH token to mint wrapper tokens, and they can redeem wrapper tokens to withdraw the base staked ETH token. Only a designated operator can update the exchange rate between the base token and the wrapper token, and only the contract owner can set the designated operator. The initial exchange rate is 1 base token per 1 wrapper token, and the operator can only increase the exchange rate by a maximum of 0.0001 per day. The contract announces an event when new wrapper tokens are minted and an event when wrapper tokens are redeemed.
source_description: A token created by depositing BETH into the BETH wrapper. Each WBETH represents 1 BETH (1:1 to staked ETH) plus all of its accrued ETH2.0 staking rewards

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on OkieLaunch and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and funding of new digital asset projects, holding deposited funds until project milestones are met or a refund is initiated. It maintains a registry of projects, each with its funding goal, current raised amount, and a list of contributors with their individual contributions. Callers can create a new project, contribute funds to an existing project, claim their contributed funds if a project fails to meet its goal, and project creators can withdraw raised funds upon successful completion. Only the contract owner can set the platform fee, which is fixed at 2% of successful project raises, and designate trusted project reviewers. A project must reach at least 75% of its funding goal within 30 days of creation to be considered successful. The contract announces project creation, successful funding, and fund withdrawals.
source_description: OkieLaunch is an open platform for permissionless creation and discovery of both trendy memes and on-chain AI agents

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Pacifica Perps and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders. It maintains individual account balances, open positions with their margin and leverage, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, modify existing positions, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can adjust global risk parameters and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage offered is 50x. A 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing volume. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations.
source_description: Pacifica is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange offering leverage trading through advanced order types and APIs

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Pendle and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes future yield from a designated interest-bearing asset, allowing users to separate the principal from the future yield and trade them independently. It maintains a record of each user's principal tokens and yield tokens, along with the current exchange rate between the underlying asset and its principal token, and a global configuration for fees and maturities. Callers can deposit the underlying interest-bearing asset to mint principal tokens and yield tokens, swap between principal tokens and yield tokens, redeem principal tokens and yield tokens for the underlying asset, and transfer their principal and yield tokens to other addresses. A designated operator can update the exchange rate between the underlying asset and its principal token, and set the fee for swapping between principal and yield tokens. The swap fee is fixed at 0.1% of the swapped amount, and the maximum maturity for any yield token is 365 days from its creation. The contract announces when new principal and yield tokens are minted, when tokens are swapped, and when tokens are redeemed.
source_description: Pendle Finance is a protocol that enables the trading of tokenized future yield on an AMM system.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on STON.fi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token swaps, holding reserves of various fungible tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves and swap fees, along with each user's liquidity provider token balances. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated operator can adjust swap fees and add new token pairs for trading. The maximum swap fee is 0.5%, and adding liquidity to a pool requires depositing both tokens in the pool's current ratio. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the resulting pool state.
source_description: Decentralized automated market maker (AMM) built on the TON blockchain

description: Design a payments contract based on Sablier Flow and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables continuous, time-based transfers of any fungible token from a sender to a recipient. It custodies the tokens being streamed until they are withdrawn. The contract maintains a record for each active stream, including the sender, recipient, token being streamed, start time, end time, and total amount to be streamed. Callers can create new streams, cancel their own active streams, top up an existing stream with more tokens, and withdraw available tokens from any stream where they are the recipient or sender. The contract owner can pause all streaming activity and update the fee percentage applied to new streams. A stream's duration must be at least one minute and cannot exceed five years. A 0.1% fee is deducted from the total amount of each newly created stream, paid to the contract owner. The contract announces stream creations, cancellations, top-ups, and withdrawals.
source_description: Pay at a constant rate. Top up over time

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on AstarFarm and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a farming game where users can stake tokens to earn rewards. It maintains individual user stakes, accumulated rewards, and configured reward rates for different staking pools. Callers can deposit tokens into a staking pool, withdraw their staked tokens, claim their accumulated rewards, and transfer their staked position to another user. Only a designated operator can create new staking pools, set the reward rate for existing pools, and pause or unpause staking for a specific pool. The maximum number of staking pools allowed is 10, and the reward rate for any pool cannot exceed 500 units per block. The contract announces when a user deposits tokens, withdraws tokens, claims rewards, or when a reward rate is updated.
source_description: Astar Farm is a defi & gamefi Dapps works on Astar network.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Dre Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
