description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, minting and burning tokens backed by a diversified basket of collateral assets. It maintains a total supply of the reserve currency, individual balances for each account, and a record of the current collateral assets and their quantities held in the contract. Callers can deposit approved collateral assets to mint new reserve tokens, redeem reserve tokens to withdraw a proportional share of collateral, and transfer reserve tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can add new collateral asset types to the approved list, remove existing collateral asset types, and adjust the collateralization ratio. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all redemption operations, payable in the redeemed collateral assets. The contract announces events for token transfers, minting, burning, and changes to the approved collateral asset list or collateralization ratio.
source_description: $DRE is a decentralized reserve currency backed by a diversified basket of assets. $DRE is unique, community-driven and transparent

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Chain Fusion and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized cross-chain asset transfers, holding wrapped versions of external native assets. It maintains a ledger of each user's wrapped asset balance and a total supply for each wrapped asset type. Callers can deposit native assets on an external chain to mint an equivalent amount of wrapped tokens, and redeem wrapped tokens to receive native assets on the external chain. A designated operator can add new supported external chains and their corresponding native asset identifiers. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all redemption operations, and a maximum of 10 new external chains can be added per month. The contract announces events for successful deposits, redemptions, and the addition of new supported chains.
source_description: Chain Fusion allows the Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) to interconnect with multiple blockchains in a decentralized manner, eliminating the need for a single trusted intermediary such as a bridge. The ability of ICP smart contracts to utilise threshold signature schemes to sign and submit transactions directly to other chains enables Chain-key tokens. Each Chain-key token on ICP is backed 1:1 by the native asset and is redeemable at any time. The native wallets are managed by a smart contracts on ICP, there are no intermediaries or centralized bridges. Chain-key tokens begin with ck (e.g. ckBTC, ckETH, etc.). They transact quickly (1 second finality) and transaction fees are negligible.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Storm Trade and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages leveraged perpetual futures positions, holding collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user accounts tracking collateral balances, open positions including entry price and size, and a global funding rate pool. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions specifying asset and leverage, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust the funding rate, liquidate undercollateralized positions, and update the list of tradable assets and their associated oracle feeds. New positions require a minimum initial margin of 5% of the position's value, and a 0.1% opening fee is applied to the notional value of each new position. The contract emits an event whenever a position is opened, closed, or liquidated, including the user's address, position details, and the outcome.
source_description: Storm Trade is the first decentralized exchange in the TON blockchain that allows you to trade Crypto, Stock, Forex and Commodities, with leverage, both in Web App and Telegram.

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on tzBTC and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a wrapped token bridge, holding native blockchain assets in escrow to back an equivalent tokenized representation on a different chain. It maintains a total supply of wrapped tokens, a mapping of each user's wrapped token balance, and a record of pending mint and burn requests. Callers can mint new wrapped tokens by initiating a deposit of native assets, transfer wrapped tokens to other users, and burn wrapped tokens to redeem their underlying native assets. A designated operator is privileged to approve minting requests after verifying native asset deposits and to process burn requests by releasing native assets. All minting requests must be approved within 24 hours of initiation, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all burn operations, deducted from the native assets released. The contract announces successful mints, successful burns, and all token transfers to observers.
source_description: tzBTC is a wrapped Bitcoin token on Tezos, backed 1:1 by BTC and issued through a multi-signature keyholder system that enables auditable minting and burning.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Aquarius Stellar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's liquidity pools and facilitates token swaps, holding deposited tokens as custody. It maintains records of token balances within each pool, the current swap fee for each pool, and the total amount of governance tokens allocated for rewards. Callers can deposit tokens into pools, withdraw their deposited tokens, swap one token for another, and claim their share of governance token rewards. Only the designated owner can adjust the swap fee for a pool, add new token pairs to the exchange, or update the reward distribution parameters. The maximum swap fee for any pool is 0.5%, and a minimum of 100 governance tokens must be allocated for rewards in each distribution period. The contract announces successful token swaps, new liquidity pool creations, and reward claims to observers.
source_description: Aquarius is a novel AMM protocol and a liquidity management layer to Stellar. It offers stable and volatile pools with multihop swaps on top, and a community governance tool to distribute rewards between pool liquidity providers based on voting and bribing.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on World Chain and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a bridge for transferring a specific base token from an origin chain to a destination chain, holding deposited base tokens in escrow on the origin chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance awaiting transfer and a configuration for the designated destination chain bridge contract. Callers can initiate a deposit of the base token, which locks their tokens in this contract, and can claim their corresponding bridged tokens on the destination chain once the transfer is finalized. A designated operator is privileged to finalize transfers by providing proof of successful bridging on the destination chain, which updates user balances. The contract imposes a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 base tokens and charges a fixed transfer fee of 0.001 base tokens per transaction. The contract announces when a deposit is initiated and when a transfer is successfully finalized for a user.
source_description: World Chain is a permissionless Layer 2 blockchain on Ethereum, built with the OP Stack, offering scalability, security, Sybil resistance, community governance, and is part of the OP Superchain ecosystem

description: Create a governance contract based on Seamless Vaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for various digital assets, holding deposited tokens from suppliers and loaned tokens to borrowers. It maintains individual account balances for each supplier and borrower, tracks outstanding loan positions, and stores global configuration parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit assets to supply liquidity, borrow assets against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, withdraw their supplied assets, and liquidate undercollateralized loans. Only a designated administrator can adjust interest rate models, update collateral factors, or pause borrowing for specific assets. A borrower's loan-to-value ratio must not exceed 75% at any time, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator's reward. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, withdrawal events, and liquidation events to observers.
source_description: A decentralized, non-custodial liquidity market that creates a more seamless experience for Suppliers and Borrowers.

description: Outline a staking contract based on Adrastea Validator and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a Proof-of-Stake validator, holding user deposits of the native blockchain currency. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total staked amount, and a current validator commission rate. Callers can deposit native currency, request a withdrawal of their staked amount, and claim their share of staking rewards. A designated operator can update the validator commission rate and initiate validator withdrawals from the underlying protocol. The validator commission rate cannot exceed 10%, and a withdrawal request has a mandatory 7-day unbonding period before funds become claimable. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and claimed rewards.
source_description: On-chain staking of user deposits with the Adrastea validator

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Falcon Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized collateralization protocol, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing yield-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral and issued receipt tokens, a global total supply of receipt tokens, and a configurable interest rate. Callers can deposit approved collateral tokens, withdraw their deposited collateral by burning receipt tokens, and claim accrued yield. Only a designated operator can adjust the interest rate, which cannot exceed 10% annually. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, withdrawal, and yield claim, announcing the caller's address, the amount involved, and the current total supply of receipt tokens.
source_description: Falcon Finance is the first universal collateralization infrastructure protocol that creates sustainable yield opportunities.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on DeFindex and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin yield vault, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing earned yield. It maintains individual deposit records for each user, tracking their principal and accrued yield, and also stores the current total stablecoin balance and the yield strategy configuration. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their principal and earned yield, and claim accumulated yield separately. A designated operator can update the yield strategy parameters and initiate yield harvesting, while the owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations and set the operator. A minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins is enforced, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address, the amount, and the transaction hash.
source_description: Unlock stablecoin yield in your wallet or DeFi app

description: Model a prediction market contract based on Nexter and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market, holding collateral for active predictions. It tracks individual user balances, open prediction positions, and global market parameters. Callers can create new prediction markets, place predictions on existing markets, claim winnings from settled markets, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can settle markets by providing the correct outcome and can adjust market creation fees. A market creation fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each new market. All predictions must be placed at least 10 blocks before the market's specified end time. The contract announces market creation, prediction placement, and market settlement events.
source_description: previous Bhavish Finance. Decentralised predictions for crypto, commodities, and sporting events.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Hegic and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-pool options trading, holding deposited collateral tokens to back options. It maintains per-account records of collateral deposits, active option positions, and pool liquidity for each supported asset. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase options with specified strike prices and expiration dates, exercise expiring options, and withdraw unencumbered collateral. A designated operator can adjust option pricing parameters and add or remove supported collateral tokens. A 0.1% fee is charged on option purchases, and options must be purchased at least one hour before their expiration. The contract emits events when options are purchased, exercised, or expire unexercised.
source_description: Hegic is an on-chain peer-to-pool options trading protocol on Arbitrum. You can trade ETH and WBTC ATM / OTM Calls / Puts & One-click Option Strategies on Hegic

description: Outline a token contract based on AlfaClub and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token-gated access system, holding a reserve of a stablecoin for key purchases and redemptions. It maintains a record of each user's key balance for every distinct room, a global stablecoin balance for the reserve, and a configuration for the bonding curve parameters for each room. Callers can purchase keys for a specific room by providing stablecoin, sell their keys back to the contract for stablecoin, and transfer keys to other users. The room creator is privileged and can set the initial bonding curve parameters for their room and withdraw accumulated fees from their room's reserve. Key purchases and sales are subject to a 5% fee on the stablecoin amount, which is directed to the room's reserve. The contract emits an event whenever keys are purchased, sold, or transferred, including the room identifier, the involved users, and the quantity of keys.
source_description: Token-gated rooms on Base. Creators issue keys on a USDC bonding curve; trading rooms pool key fees for a shared fund.

description: Define a price oracle contract based on Pyth Entropy and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a verifiable random number generation service for other smart contracts, and it custodies no assets. It maintains a list of pending random number requests, each with an associated request identifier and the address of the contract that initiated the request. Callers can request a new random number, providing a seed and a callback address, and they can fulfill a previously requested random number by providing the request identifier and the generated random value. A designated operator is the only party permitted to fulfill random number requests. Each request for a random number incurs a fixed fee of 0.01 native currency, which is transferred to the operator upon fulfillment. A random number request must be fulfilled within 100 blocks of its creation. The contract announces the successful fulfillment of a random number request, including the request identifier and the generated random value.
source_description: Pyth Entropy allows developers to quickly and easily generate secure random numbers on the blockchain

description: Design a governance contract based on Enosys Governance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a governance staking system, holding staked governance tokens and distributing yield tokens. It maintains individual account balances for staked governance tokens, accrued yield tokens, and a global configuration for the yield distribution rate. Callers can stake governance tokens, unstake their staked governance tokens, claim their accrued yield tokens, and delegate their voting power to another address. The contract owner can set the yield distribution rate and pause staking operations. Staking requires a minimum of 100 governance tokens, and unstaking incurs a 0.5% fee on the unstaked amount. The contract emits events when tokens are staked, unstaked, yield is claimed, and voting power is delegated.
source_description: Stake governance tokens to influence the platform's future, and earn yield from the APYCloud.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Overtime and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized sports prediction markets and custodies user deposits in a stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction positions, and market configurations for various sporting events. Callers can deposit stablecoins, create new prediction positions on open markets, close existing positions, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can create new prediction markets and resolve market outcomes. A minimum deposit of 10 stablecoins is required to open a new position, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all market winnings. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, position creation, and market resolution.
source_description: Overtime is a decentralized onchain sportsbook ecosystem enabling sports betting and digital options trading. Built on smart contracts with Chainlink data feeds, it operates without centralized control. Features pioneering AMM architecture and trustless liquidity pools for seamless, transparent betting experiences across popular sporting events.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on SyncSwap and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates trustless token exchanges between users and custodies user-deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains records of each liquidity pool's token reserves, accumulated fees, and individual user liquidity positions. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove their liquidity, swap tokens between supported pairs, and collect accumulated fees from their positions. Only a designated administrator can create new liquidity pools and update the protocol-wide swap fee percentage. The maximum swap fee is 0.5%, and all swaps incur a minimum 0.05% fee, which is distributed proportionally to liquidity providers. The contract emits events upon liquidity additions, removals, and successful token swaps, detailing the tokens involved and amounts transferred.
source_description: SyncSwap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on zkSync Era

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Swell L2 Farm and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages pre-launch deposits for a new Layer 2 network, holding deposited Ether. It maintains individual account balances for each depositor and tracks the total amount of Ether deposited into the system. Callers can deposit Ether, withdraw their deposited Ether, and claim any accumulated rewards. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals, and can set the reward rate. The contract will enforce a minimum deposit amount of 0.1 Ether and a maximum total deposit cap of 10,000 Ether. The contract emits an event when Ether is deposited, when Ether is withdrawn, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Pre-launch deposits for Swell L2, the L2 for Restaking

description: Define a lending protocol based on Figure Markets Democratized Prime and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer lending against collateral, holding deposited collateral assets and loaned funds in escrow. It maintains individual loan positions tracking borrower, lender, collateral amount, loan amount, and interest accrued, along with global configuration for acceptable collateral types and interest rate models. Callers can deposit collateral, request a loan specifying collateral and desired loan amount, repay a loan, and withdraw their collateral once a loan is fully repaid. A designated operator can approve new collateral types and adjust interest rate parameters for existing types. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new loans, deducted from the disbursed loan amount. The contract emits an event upon loan origination, repayment, and collateral withdrawal, detailing the involved parties and amounts.
source_description: Democratized Prime connects your cash or crypto with borrowers seeking liquidity on their collateral

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Manifest Trade and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding user deposits of various fungible tokens. It maintains an order book for each trading pair, tracking individual user balances, open orders, and trade history. Callers can deposit tokens, place limit orders, cancel open orders, and withdraw their available balances. A designated operator can add new trading pairs and adjust trading fees. The maximum number of open orders per user is 20, and a flat trading fee of 0.1% is applied to all filled orders. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, order placements, order cancellations, and trade executions.
source_description: Manifest is the 3rd generation CLOB DEX on Solana, the spiritual successor to Openbook and Serum.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on MerlinSwap and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token swaps, holding deposited tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains records of each liquidity provider's deposited amounts and their share of each pool, along with global configuration for swap fees. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove their liquidity, swap one token for another, and collect accrued fees. Only the designated owner can set the swap fee percentage, which must be between 0.01% and 1.00% inclusive, and can pause all swapping activity. The initial swap fee is 0.30%. The contract announces when liquidity is added or removed, and when a swap occurs, including the input and output amounts.
source_description: MerlinSwap is an innovative and highly capital efficient DEX built to support the Merlin ecosystem.

description: Model a staking contract based on Bedrock uniBTC and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies wrapped Bitcoin deposits. It maintains a total supply of its liquid staking token, the amount of wrapped Bitcoin deposited by each user, and a global exchange rate between the liquid staking token and wrapped Bitcoin. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for wrapped Bitcoin, and transfer their liquid staking tokens to other addresses. Only the owner can set the fee for withdrawals, which is capped at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and only a designated operator can update the exchange rate, which must always be non-decreasing. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and exchange rate updates to observers.
source_description: BTC staked into babylon

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Thaw and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a provably fair on-chain prediction game, holding user deposits and game-specific parameters. It maintains individual user balances, a global game treasury, and configuration settings for each game type, including minimum bet amounts and payout multipliers. Callers can deposit funds into their account, place bets on available games, and withdraw their winnings or remaining balance. A designated operator can add new game types, adjust game parameters, and pause or unpause the contract. Each game type will have a minimum bet of 0.01 units of the deposited currency, and a 2% fee is deducted from all winning payouts. The contract announces successful deposits, bet placements, and withdrawal events to observers.
source_description: Provably fair on-chain casino on HyperEVM with 6 games powered by Pyth Entropy for verifiable randomness

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Lista Lending and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool, holding deposited collateral assets and minted stablecoins. It maintains individual user deposit balances, borrowed stablecoin amounts, and global pool parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay borrowed stablecoins, and withdraw their collateral. A designated owner can adjust interest rates, update collateral factors for supported assets, and pause borrowing or depositing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral asset is 75%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin borrows. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the user's address, asset, and amount.
source_description: Lista Lending is a decentralized P2P lending protocol on BNB Chain that uses a vault-based system to pool liquidity and allocate it across lending markets based on supply and demand.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Angstrom and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token pairs, custodying deposited tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains records of each liquidity provider's deposited amounts and their share of each pool, along with global configuration parameters for fees and the current sequencing epoch. Callers can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their liquidity and accumulated fees, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated operator can initiate and finalize sequencing epochs, during which swaps are batched and executed to internalize arbitrage profits, and can update the protocol's fee structure. The maximum fee for any swap is 0.3%, and a sequencing epoch must last at least 10 minutes. The contract announces the completion of each swap, the addition or removal of liquidity, and the start and end of each sequencing epoch.
source_description: Angstrom is a hybrid DEX built on Uniswap V4 that uses app-level sequencing to internalize MEV, allowing LPs to earn arbitrage profits instead of external actors

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Tydro and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a non-custodial lending pool for a single designated digital asset, holding deposited principal and accrued interest. It maintains a record of each user's deposit balance, their borrowed amount, and the current interest rate for both deposits and borrows, along with a global pool's total deposits and total borrows. Callers can deposit assets into the pool, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their available principal and interest. Only a designated operator can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause or unpause borrowing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the designated asset. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the user's identifier and the amount.
source_description: Tydro is a non-custodial lending protocol for onchain capital markets. Powered by Aave and built on Ink

description: Outline a governance contract based on ForgeYields and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits into a cross-chain yield aggregation system, holding deposited tokens in custody. It maintains records of each user's deposited token balances, the total supply of each deposit token, and a mapping of supported tokens to their respective yield strategies. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accrued yield. Only a designated operator can update the list of supported tokens and their associated yield strategies. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of any supported token and charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, detailing the user, token, and amount.
source_description: ForgeYields is a cross-chain yield aggregator. Users deposit into token gateways across multiple chains, and assets are netted and allocated into yield strategies (Curve, Convex, lending protocols, etc.) on Ethereum L1 and L2s

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Ostable and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting and redemption facility that custodies a reserve asset. It maintains a global reserve asset balance, a total stablecoin supply, and per-user stablecoin balances. Callers can deposit the reserve asset to mint stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for the reserve asset, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can adjust the stablecoin minting and redemption fee, which is initially set to 0.1% of the transaction amount. The contract enforces a maximum stablecoin supply of 1,000,000,000 units. The contract emits events when stablecoins are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when the fee is updated.
source_description: Ostable is an advanced stable coin platform powered by bonding curves. It is a collection of autonomous agents that interact with each other to offer various financial products to investors such as interest tokens, stablecoins and stability fund shares.

description: Design a staking contract based on Sceptre Liquid and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies staked base tokens and issues a liquid staking derivative token representing a share of the total staked value. It maintains a global pool of staked base tokens, a total supply of the liquid staking derivative token, and per-user records of their derivative token balances. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive derivative tokens, and they can redeem derivative tokens for base tokens, subject to an unstaking delay. A designated operator can initiate unstaking of base tokens from the underlying network, and they can claim rewards from the underlying network. The owner can set the unstaking delay and the operator address. The unstaking delay is fixed at 7 days. A 0.5% fee is applied to all unstaking operations, deducted from the base token amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events.
source_description: Sceptre is an innovative multi network Liquid Staking solution build by Rome Blockchain Labs, with extensive knowledge and experience in Liquid Staking.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on BackedFi and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes ownership of a specific real-world asset, acting as a vault that custodies the underlying asset and issues an equivalent number of fungible tokens representing fractional ownership. It maintains a total supply of tokens, a record of each user's token balance, and a mapping of each token to its underlying asset identifier. Callers can deposit the underlying asset to mint new tokens, transfer tokens to other addresses, and redeem tokens to withdraw the underlying asset. A designated operator can pause all token transfers and redemptions, and only the contract owner can set the redemption fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the redeemed value. The contract announces all token transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: Fully backed, tokenized real-world assets.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on HypePool and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a gaming protocol that custodies player deposits in a designated ERC-20 token and prize pools for various games. It maintains per-player balances, active game sessions, game configurations including minimum and maximum bets, and a record of past game outcomes. Callers can deposit tokens, join an active game, make a bet within a game, claim winnings from a completed game, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can create new game types, set game parameters, and initiate game rounds, while the contract owner can pause all contract activity and upgrade the contract implementation. A minimum bet for any game is 100 units of the designated ERC-20 token, and a 2% fee is applied to all winnings before distribution. The contract announces game start and end events, player bet placements, and prize distributions to observers.
source_description: The first on-chain game protocol on HyperEVM. Multiple ways to play, with verifiable randomness via Chainlink VRF v2.5 routed through Base via CCIP.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Lighter Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on the source chain and releasing native tokens on the destination chain, effectively custodying wrapped tokens. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped token deposits, a global total supply of wrapped tokens, and a configurable transfer fee. Callers can deposit wrapped tokens, initiate a transfer to a specified destination address on another chain, and claim native tokens on the destination chain after a successful transfer. A designated operator can pause and unpause transfers, and set the transfer fee. The transfer fee must be between 0 and 5% of the transfer amount, inclusive. Each transfer request must be processed within 24 hours of its initiation. The contract announces successful deposits, initiated transfers, and completed claims.
source_description: Lighter is a decentralized trading platform that is designed to deliver unmatched security and scale. Lighter provides verifiable matching and liquidations, while operating at the best-in-class traditional exchange level performances.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on SaucerSwap V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's liquidity pools, holding tokens deposited by liquidity providers. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, the total liquidity shares issued for each pool, and the individual liquidity share balances for each provider. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap tokens between pools, and query pool reserves. A designated operator can adjust the swap fee percentage for each pool, and only the contract owner can pause all swapping operations. The maximum swap fee is 0.5%, and a minimum of 100 units of each token must remain in a pool after any withdrawal. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected addresses.
source_description: SaucerSwap is an automated market maker protocol that leverages the Hedera Smart Contract Service to include Solidity smart contract integration with the Hedera Token Service.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Shibui DAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized exchange for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited non-fungible tokens and the fungible tokens used for bids. It maintains a global registry of listed non-fungible tokens, individual order books for each non-fungible token collection, and balances of deposited fungible tokens for each user. Callers can list non-fungible tokens for sale, place bids on listed non-fungible tokens, accept bids, cancel listings, and withdraw their deposited fungible tokens or unsold non-fungible tokens. A designated operator can set the platform fee and pause trading for emergency situations. The platform fee is fixed at 0.5% of the sale price, and a listing remains active for a maximum of 30 days. The contract announces successful sales, new listings, and cancelled orders.
source_description: The decentralised on-chain exchange and order book for NFTs

description: Design a payments contract based on Playground and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a payment processor for an e-commerce platform, holding deposited stablecoins before they are disbursed. It maintains records of each user's stablecoin balance and a global configuration for fees and disbursement thresholds. Callers can deposit stablecoins, initiate a purchase, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can disburse collected funds to the platform's treasury. A purchase transaction must be for a minimum of 5 stablecoins, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all successful purchases. The contract emits an event when a deposit is received, a purchase is made, funds are disbursed, or a withdrawal occurs.
source_description: E-commerce platform where users purchase products with USDC. Payments are collected via Circle on multiple chains (Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, etc.) and bridged to Aptos via Circle CCTP.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Snuggle and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a concentrated liquidity manager that custodies user-deposited tokens and their corresponding concentrated-liquidity pool positions. It maintains individual user deposit records, active liquidity positions within designated concentrated-liquidity pools, and configurable rebalancing parameters for each pool. Callers can deposit tokens into a managed pool, withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued fees, and claim their share of protocol fees. A designated operator can initiate rebalancing operations for specific liquidity positions and adjust the rebalancing parameters for each managed pool. Only the owner can add new concentrated-liquidity pools for management, set the protocol fee percentage, and pause all user interactions. The protocol fee is fixed at 10% of earned fees, and the maximum number of managed concentrated-liquidity pools is limited to 5. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, rebalancing operations, and changes to the protocol fee.
source_description: Snuggle is an automated concentrated Liquidity Manager for Uniswap V3 on Base. It automatically rebalances LP positions to maximize fee earnings while minimizing impermanent loss

description: Outline a token locking contract based on Team Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, designed to hold and release a specified amount of an arbitrary fungible token over time. It maintains a record for each locked token, storing the token's address, the total amount locked, the beneficiary's address, and a linear release schedule defined by a start time and an end time. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, and beneficiaries can withdraw their vested tokens. The contract owner can set a deposit fee and pause all deposits. A deposit fee of 0.5% of the deposited amount is charged, and tokens are released linearly over a minimum period of 30 days. The contract emits an event when new tokens are locked and when tokens are successfully withdrawn.
source_description: TeamFinance gives you the toolkit to help create and grow a successful token. Don't spend $1000s when you don't need to, instead leverage our non-custodial smart contracts to mint your own customizable token, lock your team tokens or LP liquidity tokens, setup vesting contracts for your team and investors, and create staking pools with customizable rewards. All within one platform and able to be created in seconds!

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Nado Spot and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange settlement layer for spot trading, custodying user deposits of various fungible tokens. It maintains per-user balances for each deposited token and a global configuration for trading parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens, and settle trades by providing a signed order and a matching counter-order. A designated operator can pause all trading and withdrawals, update the fee schedule, and add or remove supported tokens. The maximum fee for any trade is 0.1% of the trade value. All trade settlements must occur within 10 blocks of the signed order's creation. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and trade settlements, including the tokens and amounts involved.
source_description: Nado is a vertically-integrated decentralized exchange for spot and perpetual futures, featuring an off-chain sequencer and on-chain settlement on Ink. The platform delivers a high-performance CLOB experience where trades execute in milliseconds, with deep liquidity powered in part by the NLP (Nado Liquidity Provider) vault.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Parallel and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital assets representing in-game items, holding a reserve of a fungible base token. It maintains a record of each asset's current owner, its unique identifier, and its specific attributes, along with a total supply count for each asset type and a configurable base token reserve for minting. Callers can mint new assets by depositing the required base token, transfer assets they own to another address, and burn assets they own to reclaim a portion of the base token reserve. A designated operator can pause all minting and transfer operations, and can adjust the base token minting cost for each asset type. The minting cost for any asset type cannot exceed 100 base tokens, and a burning operation returns 50% of the original minting cost. The contract announces when a new asset is minted, when an asset is transferred, and when an asset is burned.
source_description: The Parallel is the birth and evolution of an infinitely evolving GameFi metaverse, aiming to bring the world together to craft and launch a massive diversity of social, entertainment, gaming and economic systems

description: Define a token contract based on Chamber Vaults and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a non-custodial vault that holds various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets and their corresponding share of the vault's total value, along with a configurable list of allowed investment strategies. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their share of the vault's assets, and redeem their vault shares for underlying tokens. Only a designated operator can add new investment strategies, update existing strategy parameters, or pause all deposits into the vault. The vault imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions, and new investment strategies must be approved by a 7-day timelock before becoming active. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and strategy update events to observers.
source_description: Chamber, formerly dHEDGE, is a non-custodial vault protocol for creating and managing onchain vaults. The protocol uses smart contracts to manage how vaults interact with supported assets, integrations, and DeFi protocols. Chamber also powers products and strategies across its wider ecosystem, including Toros Finance and mStable.

description: Model a prediction market contract based on OPINION and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market for macroeconomic data, holding user-deposited collateral in an escrow pool. It maintains individual user balances for deposited collateral, open prediction positions, and settled payouts, alongside global market parameters for each prediction topic. Callers can deposit collateral, open a prediction position on a specific outcome, close an open position, and withdraw settled payouts. A designated operator can create new prediction markets, resolve market outcomes, and adjust market fees. A minimum deposit of 100 units of collateral is required to open any position, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all settled payouts, deducted before distribution. The contract announces new market creations, position openings, and market resolutions through events.
source_description: Opinion is building a prediction exchange that enables direct trading of macroeconomic data, predictions, and news as standardized assets, leveraging proprietary on-chain infrastructure, AI Oracle, and trading tools to create new opportunities for retail users, institutions, and global decision makers in democratizing economic insights and risk management.

description: Specify a governance contract based on Gardens and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates community governance by managing voting pools and allocating resources based on collective decisions, holding deposited tokens for voting. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited tokens, their current voting power, and the configuration parameters for each proposal, including a minimum quorum percentage and a voting period duration. Callers can deposit tokens into a voting pool, create new proposals, cast votes on active proposals, and withdraw their tokens after a proposal concludes. Only a designated administrator may adjust the global voting period, which is initially set to 72 hours, or set the minimum quorum for new proposals, which defaults to 20% of total deposited tokens. The contract emits an event when a new proposal is created, when a vote is cast, and when a proposal's outcome is finalized.
source_description: Gardens is a community governance platform optimized for bottom-up decision-making. Built using an enforceable Covenant tied to modular conviction voting pools, Gardens can source decisions and allocates resources to communities and ecosystems securely and intelligently

description: Define a prediction market contract based on PredX Ai and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market, holding collateral deposited by participants. It maintains individual participant balances, active prediction markets with their associated outcomes and collateral pools, and a global configuration for market parameters. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit collateral into existing markets, make predictions on market outcomes, withdraw their share of settled markets, and claim rewards from correct predictions. A designated administrator can pause market creation, settle markets based on external data, and adjust market fees. New prediction markets must have a minimum collateral requirement of 100 units of the designated collateral token, and a fixed fee of 2% is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits events for market creation, prediction submissions, collateral deposits and withdrawals, and market settlements.
source_description: Multichain prediction market, powered by AI.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on YOLO Games and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized, provably fair game where players bet on the outcome of a random number. It custodies player deposits in a single pool of a specified ERC-20 token. The contract maintains each player's current balance, their active bets, and a global record of the total funds available for payouts. Callers can deposit tokens into the game pool, place a bet specifying an amount and a target outcome, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can initiate a new game round and resolve outstanding bets by providing a verifiable random number. The maximum bet per game round is 1000 tokens, and a 1% fee is deducted from all winning payouts. The contract announces when new game rounds begin, when bets are placed, and when bets are resolved.
source_description: The only venue for serious degens seeking serious rewards. Built by a veteran team with a track record of delivering provably fair, fun on-chain games

description: Model a staking contract based on Kinetiq kmHYPE and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing a liquid staking token representing a share of the vault. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the total amount of base asset held, and each user's balance of the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset. A designated operator can initiate a withdrawal of base assets from an external system, which reduces the total base asset held by the vault, and can also deposit base assets into the vault from an external system. The owner can set the redemption fee, which is initially 0.5% of the base asset redeemed, and can also pause all deposits and redemptions. The contract emits an event when base assets are deposited, when base assets are redeemed, and when the redemption fee is updated.
source_description: Kinetiq Markets is a fully onchain perpetuals DEX built on Hyperliquid, powered by kmHYPE — an exchange LST that lets users co-own trading fees and liquidity for global markets.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Buzz Farming and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits into various yield-generating strategies, holding deposited tokens and their accrued yield. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited asset, a record of active strategies, and configuration parameters for each strategy. Callers can deposit supported tokens into a chosen strategy, withdraw their principal and accumulated yield from a strategy, and claim rewards distributed by the protocol. A designated operator can add new strategies, update strategy parameters, and pause or unpause deposits for a specific strategy. The maximum number of active strategies is limited to 10. A 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claims.
source_description: Buzz Farming collaborates with well-known BTCFi projects such as Babylon, Lombard, and Bedrock, as well as prominent blockchains, offering users a variety of multifaceted profit strategies. Users can conveniently select and operate investment strategies through Buzz Farming

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Liquidity House and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market's liquidity, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains individual user balances, total liquidity per market, and market-specific configuration parameters like settlement windows. Callers can deposit collateral, create new prediction markets with specified outcomes, provide liquidity to existing markets, and withdraw their share of settled market funds. A designated operator can pause all market creation and settlement, and also adjust the global fee percentage. The contract enforces a minimum deposit of 100 collateral tokens for market creation and charges a 0.5% fee on all market settlements. The contract emits an event when a new market is created and when a market is settled.
source_description: GambleFi Liquidity Infrastructure Protocol

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Verified Network and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and transfer of tokenized securities, holding no assets itself. It maintains a registry of security identifiers, their associated metadata (like ISIN and maturity date), and the current owner for each issued security. Callers can request to issue a new security, transfer ownership of an existing security, or redeem a security they own. A designated administrator can approve new security types and set global issuance limits, while a designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers. A maximum of 10,000 securities can be issued under any single security type. Transfers of securities are subject to a 0.1% fee, payable in a stablecoin, which is automatically forwarded to the administrator's designated fee wallet. The contract announces the issuance of new securities, successful transfers, and the redemption of securities.
source_description: Verified Network is decentralized, global financial infrastructure for issuing, distributing and servicing tokenized securities

description: Outline a privacy-preserving contract based on PrivCash and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a designated fungible token by allowing users to deposit tokens and later withdraw them to a different address without revealing the link between deposit and withdrawal. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments, a record of spent nullifiers, and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens using a valid zero-knowledge proof, and view the current Merkle root. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and set the withdrawal fee. The maximum deposit amount is 1,000,000 units of the designated token, and the withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.1% of the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events including the commitment hash and withdrawal events including the nullifier.
source_description: PrivCash is a decentralized protocol for private transactions on the Kava network.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Racoon.Bet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized gaming platform, holding deposited funds in a native token. It maintains a global game configuration, a record of each player's active game sessions including their initial bet and current winnings, and a treasury balance for platform operations. Callers can deposit funds, start a new game session by placing a bet, make moves within an active game, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can update the game configuration, including setting the maximum bet amount and the house edge. The maximum bet for any single game session is 100 native tokens, and a 2% house edge is applied to all winning bets. The contract emits an event whenever a new game session is started, a game session concludes, or funds are deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: Racoon.Bet is a fully on-chain gaming platform governed by the Racoon NFTs DAO. It currently operates on 3 different blockchain within the Cosmos Ecosystem.

description: Define a token contract based on SoSoValue Indexes and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of crypto assets, representing a diversified index. It maintains the current composition of the index, including the asset types and their target weights, and records each user's share of the total index value. Callers can deposit supported assets to mint index shares, withdraw assets by burning their index shares, and rebalance the index to adjust asset weights. A designated operator is privileged to update the index composition and initiate rebalances. The contract enforces a maximum of 10 distinct assets in any index composition and charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn assets. The contract announces when the index composition changes and when a rebalance completes.
source_description: The SoSoValue Indexes(SSI) Protocol is a cutting-edge spot index solution designed to make crypto investments simple and secured

description: Outline a staking contract based on Kinetiq kHYPE and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies staked tokens on a Layer 1 blockchain and issues a yield-bearing receipt token. It maintains per-account records of staked balances and corresponding receipt token holdings, a total staked amount, and a current exchange rate between the staked token and the receipt token. Callers can deposit Layer 1 tokens to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their staked tokens by burning receipt tokens, and claim rewards. An owner role is privileged to set the staking reward rate and to pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The minimum deposit amount is 100 Layer 1 tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the sender, amount, and resulting balances.
source_description: Kinetiq is a non-custodial liquid staking protocol that allows users to stake HYPE tokens on Hyperliquid L1 and receive kHYPE, a yield-bearing representation of staked HYPE that is usable in DeFi.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on PinkSale and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of token launchpads, holding deposited tokens for sale and collected funds from purchasers. It maintains a record of each launchpad's configuration, including the token being sold, the sale price, and individual purchaser allocations, along with a global fee configuration. Callers can create a new launchpad, deposit tokens into an existing launchpad, purchase tokens from an active launchpad, and claim purchased tokens after the sale concludes. A designated owner can set global fees, pause all launchpad creation, and withdraw collected fees. The minimum token deposit for a new launchpad is 1000 units of the token being sold, and a 2% fee is applied to all funds collected from purchasers. The contract announces when a new launchpad is created, when tokens are deposited, when a purchase occurs, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: PinkSale is a decentralized launchpad that allows users to launch their own token and create their own initial token sale

description: Model a staking contract based on xALGO Liquid Staking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking protocol, holding staked base tokens and issuing a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the current exchange rate between the liquid staking token and the base token, and the total amount of base tokens held in the staking pool. Callers can deposit base tokens to mint liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw base tokens. A designated operator can initiate a rebase operation to update the exchange rate based on staking rewards. The owner can set the redemption fee, which is capped at 0.5% of the redeemed amount. The contract emits an event whenever base tokens are deposited, liquid staking tokens are minted, or the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: Interest bearing liquid token for Algorand staking.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Bumpin Trade and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in a unified account. It maintains individual user balances for each supported collateral token, open positions including long/short direction, entry price, and size for each trading pair, and global configuration parameters such as funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized accounts. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters, update oracle prices, and pause trading in an emergency. The maximum leverage offered is 50x, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all executed trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, amount, and relevant position details.
source_description: Built on the Solana blockchain, Bumpin Exchange bridges the gap between traditional centralized exchanges (CEX) and decentralized exchanges (DEX). Not just a trading platform, but a full-featured decentralized finance ecosystem. With features like a unified account, coin-margined futures trading, wealth management, copy trading bots, and strategy bots, offer a one-stop solution for trading and asset management.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Overnight Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin yield-generating vault, holding deposited stablecoins and their corresponding yield-bearing tokens. It maintains a total supply of vault shares, individual user balances of these shares, and a record of the underlying stablecoin reserves. Callers can deposit stablecoins to receive vault shares, and redeem vault shares to withdraw stablecoins. A designated operator can rebalance the underlying assets by swapping stablecoins for yield-bearing tokens and vice versa, and can update the strategy's parameters. The vault imposes a 0.1% withdrawal fee on all redemptions. There is a maximum daily withdrawal limit of 1,000,000 stablecoins per user. The contract emits events for deposits, redemptions, and rebalancing operations.
source_description: Overnight Finance is an asset management protocol offering passive yield products based on delta-neutral strategies, primarily for conservative stablecoin investors.

description: Outline a governance contract based on VisionBoard Vault and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a strategy vault for automated trading, holding deposited stablecoins. It maintains a total supply of vault shares, a record of each user's stablecoin deposits and corresponding vault share balances, and a configurable management fee percentage. Callers can deposit stablecoins to receive vault shares, withdraw their stablecoin equivalent by burning vault shares, and redeem all their vault shares for stablecoins. A designated operator can update the vault's net asset value per share and rebalance the vault's capital. The owner can set the management fee percentage and transfer ownership. The maximum management fee is 2% of the vault's net asset value. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay before funds become available. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, net asset value updates, and ownership transfers.
source_description: VisionBoard Vault is a HyperEVM perps strategy vault where users deposit USDC for VBV shares, with capital traded algorithmically on Hyperliquid and vault returns reflected through NAV per share

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Outcome Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized treasury for funding community initiatives, holding various ERC-20 tokens as collateral. It maintains individual account balances for each depositor, a global pool of available funds, and a registry of active funding proposals with their allocated amounts. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens, create new funding proposals, vote on active proposals, and claim their share of approved proposal funds. Only a designated operator can approve or reject funding proposals, and only the contract owner can set the operator address or adjust the proposal approval threshold. A minimum deposit of 100 units of any accepted ERC-20 token is required to create a proposal, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all claimed funds, directed to the contract owner. The contract announces when new proposals are created, when proposals are approved or rejected, and when funds are claimed.
source_description: A Protocol that helps DAO's generate positive Outcomes

description: Model a governance contract based on Government of Bhutan Crypto Reserve and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a sovereign digital asset reserve, holding various approved digital tokens. It maintains records of the total quantity of each approved token held and a historical log of all deposit and withdrawal transactions. Callers can deposit approved tokens into the reserve and, if authorized, initiate a withdrawal of specific tokens. Only a designated treasury multisignature wallet can approve new token types for deposit, set withdrawal limits, and authorize withdrawals. The reserve will only accept deposits of tokens from an approved list, and any single withdrawal transaction cannot exceed 1,000 units of the requested token. The contract announces all deposit and withdrawal events, including the token type, quantity, and the address of the interacting party.
source_description: Royal Government of Bhutan Treasury is a sovereign crypto reserve managed by the Bhutanese government

description: Define a derivatives contract based on FlashTrade and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates synthetic asset trading, holding collateral in a designated vault. It tracks individual user positions, including collateral deposited, open trades, and unrealized profit/loss, along with global configuration parameters like fees and available synthetic assets. Callers can deposit collateral, open new synthetic positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. Only a designated owner can set global fees, add new synthetic assets, or pause trading. A trading fee of 0.1% applies to all position openings and closings, and the maximum leverage allowed for any synthetic asset is 10x. The contract emits events for all collateral deposits, position openings, position closings, and fee updates.
source_description: Asset backed trading with zero price impact and on demand liquidity

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on NoahArkDAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, holding various collateral tokens and its own native stablecoin. It maintains the current reserve backing ratio, the total supply of the native stablecoin, and individual user balances for both staked and unstaked stablecoin, along with a mapping of collateral tokens to their current valuation and minimum acceptable backing percentages. Callers can deposit approved collateral tokens to mint the native stablecoin, stake their native stablecoin to earn rewards, unstake their native stablecoin, and redeem native stablecoin for underlying collateral. A designated operator can adjust the minimum backing percentages for collateral tokens and update the oracle prices for approved collateral. The minimum collateral backing for any minted stablecoin is 120% of its value, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces events for stablecoin minting, staking, unstaking, and redemption, including the amounts involved and the associated user.
source_description: NoahArkDAO is a fork of Olympus on multi-chain, starting from Avalanche. Designed to provide backup for Game-Fi crypto with stablecoins and Proof of Liquidity.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Chainge Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens in escrow on a source chain and releasing corresponding wrapped tokens on a destination chain. It maintains a record of each user's locked token balances per asset, a global configuration for supported token addresses, and a mapping of cross-chain transfer requests awaiting fulfillment. Callers can initiate a cross-chain transfer by depositing tokens, claim tokens on a destination chain after a transfer is processed, and cancel an unfulfilled transfer to recover their deposited tokens. A designated operator is solely responsible for approving cross-chain transfer requests and releasing tokens on the destination chain. Each transfer request must specify a destination chain identifier from a pre-approved list of 29 supported chains, and a minimum transfer amount of 0.001 wrapped ETH is enforced for all transfers. The contract announces an event upon the initiation of a cross-chain transfer, including the source address, destination address, token type, and amount.
source_description: Chainge Finance stands as the most liquid cross-chain aggregated DEX with over 70bn in aggregated liquidity. The mobile app boasts over 20 integrated DEXs and 29 chains. From a cross-chain wallet and instant cross-chain roaming to decentralized earning solutions and smart escrow contracts, Chainge is an DeFi app powered and secured by the innovative Fusion DCRM tech

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Pharaoh V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a concentrated liquidity exchange, holding deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, including token amounts and price ranges, alongside global pool configurations such as swap fees and available token pairs. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, add to existing positions, remove liquidity, and swap tokens between supported pairs. A designated operator can adjust swap fees within a range of 0.01% to 1.00%, add new token pairs, and pause all swapping activity. The contract enforces a maximum of 50 active liquidity pools and charges a fixed 0.3% swap fee on all token exchanges. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the affected tokens, amounts, and the involved accounts.
source_description: Pharaoh is a concentrated liquidity layer and exchange built on the Avalanche C-Chain, powered by the latest metaDEX x(3,3) methodology—a more fluid and accessible version of the popular ve(3,3) model.

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on TopStrike and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a real-time, one-tap digital asset trading game, holding deposited tokens as collateral for player positions. It maintains individual player balances, open positions with associated strike prices and expiry times, and a global game configuration including current asset prices. Callers can deposit tokens, open new positions specifying an asset and direction, close existing positions, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can update asset prices and settle expired positions. A player's maximum open positions are capped at 10, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all position closures. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, position opening, position closing, and price update.
source_description: Real-time, one-tap Football trading game powered by MegaETH

description: Outline a governance contract based on SuperReturn and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a capital allocation vault, designed to receive and manage various ERC-20 tokens on behalf of users. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token, a record of approved investment strategies, and a global configuration for operational parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their available balance, and propose new investment strategies for approval. A designated operator is privileged to approve or reject proposed investment strategies, update the global fee percentage, and pause all withdrawals. The maximum number of active investment strategies is limited to 10. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the approved investment strategies.
source_description: SuperReturn is the intelligent asset manager that will help you allocate your capital in the most efficient way across the entire web3 space

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Meteora DAMM V1 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a dynamic automated market maker pool for two tokens, facilitating swaps and liquidity provision, and custodies the two tokens deposited by liquidity providers. It maintains the current reserves of each token, the total supply of liquidity pool tokens, and individual liquidity provider balances of those pool tokens. Callers can deposit both tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw both tokens by burning their liquidity pool tokens, and swap one token for the other. A designated operator can adjust the pool's amplification factor within a range of 1 to 1000, and only the owner can pause all swaps and liquidity operations. All swaps incur a 0.05% fee, which is added to the pool's reserves, and the amplification factor cannot be changed more than once every 24 hours. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and swaps, including the amounts involved and the addresses of the participants.
source_description: Meteora Pools is building the infrastructure for stable and pegged assets for Solana.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Valos and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin deposits, allowing participants to earn yield from off-chain investments. It maintains each participant's deposit balance, a total deposited amount, and a configuration for yield distribution. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, request a withdrawal of their principal and accrued yield, and claim their share of distributed yield. Only a designated operator can initiate a yield distribution event and set the annual percentage rate (APR) for yield accrual, and only the contract owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. A minimum deposit amount of 100 stablecoins is enforced, and withdrawals are subject to a 7-day waiting period from the request time. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and yield distribution events.
source_description: Institutional-Grade Digital Asset Yield Solutions.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Templar Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates borrowing stablecoins against collateralized non-native assets, holding deposited collateral tokens in escrow. It maintains individual loan positions, tracking each borrower's collateral amount, borrowed stablecoin amount, and accumulated interest, alongside a global stablecoin reserve and configurable protocol parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins, repay loans, and withdraw excess collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust the interest rate model, liquidate undercollateralized loans, or pause borrowing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new stablecoin borrowings. The contract announces loan origination, repayment, and liquidation events, including the involved addresses and amounts.
source_description: Templar is the first Cypher Lending protocol that enables borrowing stablecoins against Bitcoin, or any asset on any chain, without trusting centralized intermediaries. No wrapping, no bridging, no KYC necessary

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on SunX Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain bridge for transferring a specific fungible token between two chains, holding the token in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's locked token balance and a global count of total tokens locked. Callers can deposit tokens to lock them on the source chain, and they can initiate a withdrawal request to unlock tokens on the source chain after a successful transfer on the destination chain. A designated operator is privileged to confirm successful destination chain transfers, which triggers the unlocking of tokens on the source chain. Each deposit must be at least 100 tokens, and the bridge charges a fixed fee of 5 tokens per withdrawal. The contract announces an event when tokens are deposited and when tokens are unlocked.
source_description: SunX is the first top-tier decentralized perpetual contract trading platform on the TRON blockchain, dedicated to providing users with an institutional-grade trading experience and ultimate asset security.

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on edgeX Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the deposit and withdrawal of various fungible tokens for cross-chain transfers, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance for each supported token, along with a global configuration for supported tokens and their associated transfer fees. Callers can deposit supported tokens, initiate a withdrawal request for their deposited tokens, and claim a previously initiated withdrawal. A designated operator can add new supported tokens, update the transfer fee for any supported token, and process withdrawal requests. The maximum transfer fee for any token is 0.5% of the transferred amount. All withdrawal requests have a mandatory 30-minute delay before they can be claimed. The contract emits an event upon successful token deposits, successful withdrawal request initiations, and successful withdrawal claims.
source_description: A high-performance, orderbook-based perpetual DEX with native trading experience

description: Outline a token contract based on Friend3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages customizable subscription groups, holding deposited tokens for group access and distributing them to group creators. It maintains individual user balances, group configurations including membership fees and creator addresses, and a global protocol fee percentage. Callers can create new groups, join existing groups by paying the specified fee, leave groups, and group creators can withdraw their accumulated earnings.
