Only the contract owner can set the global protocol fee, which is capped at 10%, and designate new group creator addresses. Group membership fees must be at least 0.01 native tokens. The contract emits events for group creation, membership changes, and successful withdrawals.
source_description: A social dApp that offers customizable pricing for your groups.

description: Model a governance contract based on MaxShot and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a governance module for an autonomous agent network, holding no custodied assets directly. It maintains a registry of approved agents, their associated configuration parameters, and a record of proposals submitted for network changes. Callers can submit new agent proposals, vote on active proposals, and register new agents if a proposal passes. Only a designated operator can approve new agent proposals for voting, cancel active proposals, or update the contract's configuration parameters. A proposal requires a minimum of 100,000 votes to pass and remains active for a maximum of 7 days. The contract announces when a new proposal is submitted, when a vote is cast, and when a proposal's status changes.
source_description: Maxshot AI is an AI Agent Factory that builds an open network of autonomous agents. These agents specialize in DeFi strategies and other automatable tasks, forming a collaborative network that efficiently deploys capital, executes trading strategies, and automates complex workflows. By continuously optimizing both processes and agent-to-agent collaboration, Maxshot AI empowers users to achieve effortless returns and let intelligent agents work for them.

description: Design an NFT contract based on InfinityName and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized domain name registry that custodies unique domain names as non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each domain's owner, its associated resolver address, and its registration expiration timestamp. Callers can register new domains, transfer ownership of their domains, renew their domain registrations, and set the resolver address for their owned domains. The contract owner is privileged and can update the base registration price and the renewal price. A domain registration costs 0.01 ether and is valid for 365 days from the time of registration or renewal. The contract announces when a domain is registered, transferred, renewed, or has its resolver updated.
source_description: InfinityName is a decentralized domain name system that allows users get a lifetime blockchain domain with no renewal fees. One payment, and it's purchased forever across multiple networks.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on cap and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting and redemption facility, holding collateral tokens and newly minted stablecoins. It maintains individual user collateral balances, total collateral in the system, the current stablecoin supply, and system configuration parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their deposited collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and withdraw unencumbered collateral. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause minting. The collateralization ratio must always be between 120% and 200%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces all collateral deposits, stablecoin mints, stablecoin redemptions, and collateral withdrawals as events.
source_description: Cap is a stablecoin protocol that provides credible financial guarantees via two products: the dollar-denominated cUSD and the yield-bearing stcUSD.

description: Outline a token locking contract based on UNCX Network Solana and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquidity locker designed to secure fungible tokens, preventing their removal from a designated decentralized exchange liquidity pool for a specified duration. It maintains records of each locked position, including the token amount, the lock-up end time, and the beneficiary of the locked tokens. Callers can create a new lock, extend the lock-up period of an existing position, transfer ownership of a lock to another address, and, once a lock has expired, withdraw the locked tokens. A designated owner can set the fee for creating a new lock and for extending an existing lock, and can also designate an address to receive all accumulated fees. The minimum lock-up duration for any position is 30 days, and the maximum lock-up duration is 1095 days. The contract emits an event whenever a new lock is created, a lock's duration is extended, ownership of a lock is transferred, or tokens are withdrawn from an expired lock.
source_description: Locked Liquidity on Solana.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on GoldFinger and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gold-backed, yield-bearing digital asset, holding a reserve of a stablecoin that represents physical gold. It maintains each user's balance of the gold-backed asset, the total supply of the asset, and a global yield rate configuration. Callers can mint new assets by depositing stablecoins, redeem assets for stablecoins, and transfer assets between accounts. A designated operator can update the global yield rate and pause all minting and redemption operations. The contract imposes a 0.5% redemption fee, and the minimum redemption amount is 10 units of the gold-backed asset. The contract announces asset transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: ART (Aurum Reserve Token) is gold-backed, yield-bearing token on BSC. Each ART is redeemable for physical gold reserves and automatically accrues daily yield from gold-related portfolio, enabling seamless DeFi composability while preserving gold's store-of-value properties.

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Paxos Gold and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues tokens representing ownership of physical gold held in secure vaults. It maintains individual token balances for each account and tracks the total supply of tokens. Callers can transfer tokens between accounts, redeem tokens for physical gold, and mint new tokens. A designated operator can pause transfers, freeze individual accounts, and set the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.03% of the redeemed amount. A minimum of 0.01 tokens must be redeemed at a time. The contract announces token transfers, minting, and redemption events.
source_description: PAXG offers investors a cost-effective way to own investment-grade physical gold with all the benefits of the blockchain. Each Pax Gold (PAXG) token is backed by one fine troy ounce of gold, stored in LBMA vaults in London. If you own PAXG, you own the underlying physical gold, held in custody by Paxos Trust Company

description: Model a lending protocol based on Summer.fi Pro and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged yield farming positions, holding user-deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration parameters for each supported asset pair. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay borrowed amounts, adjust their leverage by swapping assets, and close their positions by withdrawing all assets. A designated operator can update the allowed collateral and borrow assets, set interest rates, and adjust liquidation thresholds. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 5x, and a 0.1% flash loan fee is applied to all instant borrow operations. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and position liquidations.
source_description: Borrow, Multiply and Earn on the assets you hold across multiple protocols. Take advantage of powerful automation strategies and simple UX.

description: Outline a payments contract based on Angel Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of stablecoins and interest-bearing tokens for charitable organizations, enabling sustainable fundraising. It maintains a registry of approved charities, each with a designated stablecoin deposit balance and an associated interest-bearing token balance, alongside a global configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the treasury for a specific charity, withdraw stablecoins from their designated charity balance if approved, and claim accrued interest from their charity's interest-bearing token balance. A designated operator can approve charity withdrawal requests, adjust the interest-bearing token conversion rate, and update the list of approved charities. The contract imposes a 1% fee on all stablecoin deposits, and a charity's stablecoin withdrawal requests must be approved within 72 hours by the designated operator. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal approvals, and interest claims to observers.
source_description: Angel Protocol transforms how your charity fundraises allowing them to thrive from decentralized financial products, without the complexity

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Base Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the secure transfer of fungible tokens between two distinct blockchain networks, holding deposited tokens in escrow on the source network. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance and a global configuration for allowed token types. Callers can deposit approved tokens, initiate a withdrawal request for their deposited tokens to the destination network, and claim their tokens on the destination network after a successful transfer. Only a designated operator can approve new token types for bridging and finalize withdrawal requests after verification on the destination network. A minimum deposit amount of 0.001 Ether-equivalent is enforced for any token, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all successful withdrawals. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit and each completed withdrawal, including the user's address, the token type, and the amount.
source_description: Base Bridge enables the transfer of certain digital assets and other data back and forth between Ethereum and Base.

description: Outline a token contract based on templ.fun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes and manages on-chain communities, each with its own token and treasury, and custodies all community-specific tokens and treasury funds. It maintains a record of each community's configuration, including its token address, fee structure, and member list, alongside individual member balances for each community's token. Callers can create a new community, join an existing community, transfer community tokens, deposit funds into a community treasury, and withdraw funds from a community treasury. The community creator is privileged and can update the community's fee percentage, set the community token address, and remove members. A newly created community must specify an initial fee percentage between 0% and 10%, and all community token transfers incur a 1% fee, which is directed to the community treasury. The contract announces community creation, token transfers, and treasury deposits through events.
source_description: templ.fun lets communities launch on-chain groups ("templs") with a shared treasury, member pool, chat room, and configurable governance. Each templ has its own token, fee splits, and referral program; the protocol is permissionless and admin-free at the templ level

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Copump and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of new token launches, holding deposited base currency and newly minted tokens for distribution. It maintains a record of each launch's configuration including its funding goal, the total tokens offered, and the current amount raised, alongside individual participant contributions and their allocated token shares. Callers can initiate a new token launch, contribute base currency to an active launch, claim their allocated tokens after a successful launch, or withdraw their contributions if a launch fails to meet its goal. Only a designated operator can approve new token launches, set the base currency contribution limit for each participant to a maximum of 10 units, and finalize a successful launch to enable token claims. Each launch must achieve at least 50% of its funding goal within a 72-hour period from its creation to be considered successful. The contract announces the creation of new launches, every contribution made, and the final status (success or failure) of each launch.
source_description: Meme launchpad on multiple EVM chains

description: Model a token contract based on Chat3 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token economy, custodying the native platform token. It maintains individual user balances, a global total supply, and a configurable fee rate. Callers can purchase tokens, transfer tokens to other users, and sell tokens back to the contract. Only a designated administrator can mint new tokens, burn existing tokens, or update the fee rate. The maximum token supply is fixed at 1,000,000,000 tokens, and a 5% fee is applied to all token sales. The contract announces token purchases, token transfers, and token sales.
source_description: Chat3 is Web3's premier live-streaming and socialfi platform

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Piku Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin vault, holding deposited stablecoins and issuing an interest-bearing receipt token. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, the stablecoin balance for each depositor, and a global configuration for fees and limits. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint receipt tokens, redeem receipt tokens for stablecoins, and transfer receipt tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the vault's investment strategy and withdraw funds to external investment vehicles. The owner can set the deposit fee, which is capped at 0.1%, and update the maximum daily withdrawal limit, which is initially 1,000,000 stablecoins. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the amount and the involved accounts.
source_description: Piku Finance is an on-chain yield platform offering USP, a yield-optimized stablecoin, together with institutional-grade Morini Capital vaults focused on market-neutral, foreign exchange arbitrage, carry trade, and basis trade strategies.

description: Create a staking contract based on Vishwa and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding user deposits and managing their staked positions. It maintains individual user balances, total staked supply, and a configurable set of staking parameters. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, stake their deposited tokens, unstake their staked tokens, and withdraw their available balance. The owner can set the staking reward rate, designate approved staking pools, and pause all staking and unstaking operations. A minimum staking amount of 100 tokens is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all unstaking operations, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit, stake, unstake, and withdrawal events, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Vishwa is agent-native banking infrastructure for autonomous capital, built around a pre-execution control layer that verifies and enforces solvency, authorization, policy, and execution constraints before capital moves across chains and execution venues.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Frax FPI and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues a stablecoin pegged to a basket of real-world consumer goods, and it custodies collateral tokens backing the stablecoin. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, a collateral reserve balance, and a redemption fee rate. Callers can mint the stablecoin by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateral ratio within a range of 100% to 120%, and only the owner can update the list of approved collateral tokens. Minting stablecoins incurs a 0.1% fee, and redemptions are subject to a 0.2% fee. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the amount and the involved accounts.
source_description: The Frax Price Index (FPI) is the second stablecoin of the Frax Finance ecosystem. FPI is the first stablecoin pegged to a basket of real-world consumer items as defined by the US CPI-U average. The FPI stablecoin is intended to keep its price constant to the price of all items within the CPI basket and thus hold its purchasing power with on-chain stability mechanisms.f locking the asset.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Gains Network and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange for synthetic assets, holding collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions including leverage, collateral, and profit/loss, alongside global configuration parameters like available trading pairs and funding rates. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, add collateral to positions, remove excess collateral, and claim realized profits. Only the owner can add new trading pairs, adjust global leverage limits, or update the stablecoin address. A maximum leverage of 100x is enforced for all positions, and a 0.1% opening fee is charged on the notional value of each new position. The contract emits an event whenever a position is opened, closed, or modified, detailing the user, trading pair, and relevant financial changes.
source_description: Gains Network is building the decentralized finance ecosystem of the future. Our goal is to build the most advanced and optimised suite of DeFi products in the space.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on HypeMarket and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a prediction market for real-world events, holding collateral in a native platform token. It maintains a record of each market's current outcome share balances, the total collateral pooled for each market, and the market's configuration parameters. Callers can create new markets, deposit collateral to trade outcome shares, buy and sell outcome shares, and claim winnings after a market's resolution. A designated oracle operator is privileged to resolve markets by declaring the final outcome. New markets must specify a minimum collateral deposit of 100 native tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all share trades, distributed to market creators. The contract announces market creation, share trades, and market resolution with the winning outcome.
source_description: HypeMarket is a community-driven, on-chain prediction market on Supra L1. It uses an LS-LMSR (Liquidity-Sensitive Logarithmic Market Scoring Rule) automated market maker: users trade outcome shares of real-world events against a per-market collateral pool, and anyone can create markets. Markets are denominated in native SUPRA and settled on-chain using Supra's native oracle and automation services

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on DigiFT and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and trading of tokenized real-world assets, holding no direct custody of underlying physical assets but representing their ownership. It maintains per-asset records including total supply, current price, and a list of authorized investors, along with a global configuration for trading fees and issuance limits. Callers can issue new asset tokens, transfer tokens between authorized investors, redeem tokens for the underlying asset (off-chain), and swap tokens via an automated market maker. A designated administrator is privileged to register new asset types, approve investors, set trading fees, and pause all trading activity. A maximum of 10,000 units of any single asset token can be issued, and a fixed 0.25% trading fee is applied to all swaps. The contract announces events for all token issuances, transfers, redemptions, and price updates.
source_description: DigiFT is the first regulated exchange for on-chain real-world assets, approved as a Recognised Market Operator with a Capital Markets Services license by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. DigiFT allows asset owners to issue blockchain-based security tokens and investors can trade with continuous liquidity via an AMM.

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Spark Savings and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages stablecoin deposits for a yield-generating savings product, holding deposited stablecoins. It maintains each user's deposited balance, the total stablecoins deposited, and a configurable annual percentage yield (APY) rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their deposited stablecoins, and claim accrued yield. A designated operator can update the APY rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The APY rate must be between 0.01% and 10.00% inclusive. Withdrawals are subject to a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Allows users to deposit stablecoins into USDS Savings to tap into the Sky Savings Rate, which grants users a predictable APY in USDS.

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Rush Sports and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a sports prediction market, holding user deposits and payouts in a stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction positions, and market-specific liquidity pools for each event. Callers can deposit funds, create new prediction markets, place predictions on active markets, provide liquidity to market pools, claim winnings, and withdraw their deposited funds. Only a designated operator can create new prediction markets and resolve market outcomes. A minimum prediction amount of 10 stablecoins is enforced, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits an event for every new market created and every market outcome resolved.
source_description: Rush Sports is an on-chain live sports prediction protocol on Solana with LP-backed liquidity and automated settlement.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on PirateDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve-backed stablecoin, holding various collateral assets in its treasury. It maintains balances of the stablecoin for each account, tracks the total supply of the stablecoin, and stores configuration parameters like the collateralization ratio and bond terms. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, redeem stablecoins for underlying collateral, and stake their stablecoins to earn protocol rewards. The owner can add new collateral types, adjust the collateralization ratio, and pause minting or redemption operations. The contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 150% for all minted stablecoins, and a 0.5% redemption fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract emits events for all minting, redemption, and staking actions, as well as changes to critical configuration parameters.
source_description: PirateDAO is a OHM fork on avalanche network

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on SPOT Cash and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract mints and burns a stable asset, backed by a reserve of a stablecoin. It maintains the total supply of the stable asset, the current reserve balance of the backing stablecoin, and a per-account balance for each stable asset holder. Callers can mint new stable assets by depositing the backing stablecoin, and they can redeem stable assets for the backing stablecoin. A designated operator can adjust the redemption fee and pause or unpause minting and redemption. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount. The contract enforces a maximum stable asset supply of 1,000,000,000 units. The contract announces events for minting, redemption, and changes to the redemption fee.
source_description: The first durable decentralized flatcoin. SPOT is an inflation-resistant stable asset. Holders of SPOT benefit from durable long-term stability. Any SPOT holder can pair it with USDC to generate volume-based fees without impermanent loss by staking on Uniswap.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on RealT RMM Marketplace V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real estate collateral, holding deposited collateral tokens and borrowed stablecoins in escrow. It maintains individual records for each user's deposited collateral, borrowed amount, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration for interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral tokens, borrow stablecoins up to their collateral limit, repay borrowed amounts, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and collateral factors, and pause borrowing or depositing in emergencies. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any collateral token is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new stablecoin borrows. The contract emits events for collateral deposits, stablecoin borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and changes to the interest rate or collateral factor.
source_description: RMM V3, building on Aave V3, is a specialized platform for lending and borrowing that leverages RealTokens - tokens tied to real estate assets - as collateral. Users can use these RealTokens to borrow stablecoins, merging real estate investment with the DeFi space. This innovative approach offers a streamlined way for property investors to maintain liquidity and leverage their investments in the digital finance realm.

description: Specify a governance contract based on Ember Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized investment fund, holding various approved ERC-20 tokens deposited by investors. It maintains individual investor balances, a list of approved investment strategies, and a record of the fund's total asset value. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their share of the fund, and propose new investment strategies. A designated operator can approve or reject proposed strategies and initiate rebalancing operations. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of any approved ERC-20 token is enforced. It emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and changes in approved strategies.
source_description: Ember is the investment platform and infrastructure for launching, accessing, and distributing traditional and onchain financial products through crypto capital markets.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on DOOAR V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding reserves of two distinct tokens for each trading pool. It maintains a record of each trading pool's token balances and a global trading fee percentage. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated operator can adjust the global trading fee, which is capped at 0.5% and must be set in increments of 0.01%. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected pool.
source_description: DOOAR is a multi-chain DEX built by Find Satoshi Lab for STEPN users and beyond.

description: Create a token contract based on Drawtech and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a drawing game, holding deposited tokens as prizes. It maintains a record of each player's current drawing, their deposited tokens, and a global list of active drawings. Callers can deposit tokens to fund a drawing, submit a drawing for review, vote on submitted drawings, and claim prizes if their drawing wins. A designated operator can approve or reject submitted drawings and set the fee for submitting a drawing. Each drawing submission requires a 0.01 token fee, and a maximum of 100 active drawings can exist at any time. The contract announces when a new drawing is submitted, when a drawing wins, and when prizes are claimed.
source_description: An fully onchain drawing game.

description: Outline a governance contract based on RAGE Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of a base asset and an interest-bearing receipt token, enabling users to acquire the receipt token using the base asset and later redeem it. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, a record of each user's deposited base asset, and a configuration for the fee percentage. Callers can deposit base assets to mint receipt tokens, redeem receipt tokens for base assets, and withdraw their share of accumulated fees. The owner can set the fee percentage and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The fee percentage must be between 0% and 5%, inclusive. A minimum deposit of 100 base asset units is required for each deposit operation. The contract emits events for deposits, redemptions, fee withdrawals, and fee percentage updates.
source_description: The Rage Buying Protocol (RBP) re-imagines the MicroStrategy and ETH Strategy investment strategies through an innovative smart contract that features a Peapods integration

description: Define a governance contract based on ETH Strategy and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a treasury accumulation protocol designed to provide leveraged exposure to a base asset, without directly holding the base asset. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, their current leveraged position, and global configuration parameters for the protocol. Callers can deposit collateral, open a leveraged position, increase or decrease an existing position, and withdraw their collateral and any accrued profits. Only a designated operator can adjust the leverage factor within a predefined range of 1.5x to 3.0x, and only the owner can set the protocol fee, which is capped at 0.5% of all profits. A 24-hour time lock applies to any changes to the protocol fee. The contract announces when a new position is opened, when a position is modified, and when collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: ETH Strategy is a treasury accumulation protocol designed to provide leveraged exposure to Ethereum (ETH) without the traditional risks associated with margin liquidations or volatility decay

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Cega V1 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for structured investment products, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains records of each user's deposited collateral, their active positions in various structured products, and the configuration parameters for each product. Callers can deposit collateral, subscribe to an open structured product, withdraw available collateral, and claim payouts from matured products. A designated operator can open new structured products, adjust product parameters, and initiate product maturity and settlement. A minimum deposit of 100 base units of collateral is required to subscribe to any product. A 0.5% fee is applied to all payouts from matured products. The contract announces product openings, product closures, and user deposit and withdrawal events.
source_description: Cega offers safer and transparent yield strategies as defi's first exotic options protocol.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Ignix and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch and distribution of new digital assets, holding deposited base currency and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's base currency contribution and their allocated share of project tokens, along with a global configuration for each launch event. Callers can contribute base currency to an active launch, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent base currency if a launch fails to meet its minimum. The contract owner can initiate a new launch, set its parameters including the project token address and the minimum and maximum contribution thresholds, pause or unpause contributions, and finalize a launch to enable token claims. A launch must have a minimum contribution target of 100 base currency units and a maximum individual contribution limit of 10,000 base currency units. The contract announces when a new launch is started, when contributions are received, when a launch is finalized, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: Universal asset launchpad for AI-agent assets, RWA-backed tokens, and community assets on X Layer

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Evedex and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for collateral deposits used to open and maintain perpetual futures positions. It maintains individual account balances for each collateral token deposited, global aggregate position data, and system configuration parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust trading fees, update oracle addresses, and pause trading in an emergency. Each position requires a minimum initial margin of 10% of its notional value, and a liquidation fee of 0.5% of the position's notional value is charged upon liquidation. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations as events.
source_description: Perpetual DEX & Next-Gen Web3 financial ecosystem built on its own L3 blockchain

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Brickken and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and lifecycle of digital tokens representing fractional ownership of real-world assets, and it custodies the underlying asset data and ownership records. It maintains per-token records including its total supply, the asset it represents, and a list of authorized token holders, along with a global configuration for issuance parameters and transfer restrictions. Callers can purchase new tokens, transfer tokens to other authorized holders, and redeem tokens for the underlying asset. Only the contract owner can configure new asset types, set the maximum token supply for an asset, or authorize new token holders. A maximum of 1,000,000 tokens can be issued for any single asset, and a transfer fee of 0.5% is applied to all token transfers. The contract announces when new tokens are minted, when tokens are transferred between accounts, and when tokens are redeemed.
source_description: Brickken enables businesses to create digital tokens backed by tokenized Real World Assets (RWA). Through the Token Suite, Clients can raise private or public capital by creating their own custom white-label token store & token offering.

description: Create a staking contract based on Hubra Staked SOL and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a base asset, which custodies deposited base assets and issues a liquid staking token representing staked value. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a total amount of base assets deposited, and a per-account balance of the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit base assets to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards. Only a designated operator can initiate staking of deposited base assets with an external validator set and unstake base assets from that set. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.01 base asset units. The contract announces the current exchange rate between the liquid staking token and the base asset, and the total amount of base assets currently staked.
source_description: SOL liquid staking on Hubra

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Stacks sBTC and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset bridge, enabling the representation of an external blockchain's native currency as a fungible token on this blockchain. It custodies the fungible tokens minted to represent the external asset. The contract maintains a total supply of the fungible token, individual account balances, and a mapping of external asset deposit addresses to internal account addresses. Callers can deposit external assets to mint fungible tokens, transfer fungible tokens between accounts, and burn fungible tokens to initiate a withdrawal of external assets. A designated operator can pause all minting and burning operations. The maximum supply of fungible tokens is capped at 21,000,000 units. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the external asset amount. The contract announces successful minting, burning, and transfer events to observers.
source_description: sBTC is a SIP-010 token on the Stacks blockchain that represents Bitcoin (BTC) in a 1:1 ratio. It enables Bitcoin holders to participate in DeFi applications and other smart contract functionalities while maintaining a peg to the underlying Bitcoin.

description: Define a staking contract based on DFDV Staked SOL and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking token for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native tokens and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a record of each user's liquid staking token balance, and a configuration for the staking reward rate. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens for native tokens. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and manage the underlying native token stakes. Only the owner can upgrade the contract logic. There is a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.1 native tokens. The contract emits an event whenever native tokens are deposited or redeemed, and whenever the staking reward rate is updated.
source_description: dfdvSOL is a liquid staking token (LST) that represents staked SOL delegated to DFDV's validators.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Saturn and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting and redemption facility, custodying a reserve asset. It maintains per-account balances for the stablecoin and its yield-bearing variant, the current exchange rate between the two, and a global reserve asset balance. Callers can deposit the reserve asset to mint stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for the reserve asset, and convert stablecoins into the yield-bearing variant or vice-versa. A designated operator can adjust the stablecoin's peg to the reserve asset and pause all minting and redemption operations. The stablecoin's peg can only be adjusted by a maximum of 0.05% in any 24-hour period. A 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces successful minting, redemption, and conversion events, along with the amounts involved.
source_description: Saturn is a dual-token Bitcoin-backed credit protocol where USDat is a stablecoin backed by tokenized treasuries and sUSDat is a yield-bearing version backed by digital credit exposure.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on Ape.Store and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized token launchpad, holding deposited tokens and raised funds for projects. It maintains a record of each project's launch configuration, including sale parameters and allocated token amounts, alongside individual user commitments to ongoing sales. Callers can create a new project launch, commit funds to an active project sale, claim purchased tokens after a sale concludes, and withdraw their unspent committed funds if a sale fails. The designated owner can pause all sales, update the platform fee, and designate new project creators. The platform charges a 2% fee on all successfully raised funds, and each project sale has a maximum fundraising cap of 500 ether. The contract emits an event when a new project is launched, when a user commits funds, and when a sale concludes.
source_description: Launch and Trade Your Tokens with Ease and Low Fees

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Parcl V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange for real estate indices, holding user collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user accounts with balances, open positions including entry price and size, and global configuration parameters such as funding rates and market definitions. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can add new real estate index markets, adjust market-specific parameters like maximum leverage, and pause trading for emergency maintenance. The maximum leverage for any market is 20x, and a trading fee of 0.05% of the notional value is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations, including the affected user, market, and amount.
source_description: Parcl v3 is a perpetuals dex that offers real estate index markets for speculating or hedging

description: Design a smart account contract based on Binance Wallet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a simple, non-custodial wallet for holding and transferring a single type of fungible token. It maintains a record of each user's token balance. Callers can deposit tokens into their account, transfer tokens to another account, and withdraw their tokens. A designated owner can pause all transfer and withdrawal operations, and can set a maximum daily withdrawal limit. The maximum daily withdrawal limit for any single account is 1000 tokens, and transfers between accounts within the contract incur a flat fee of 1 token, deducted from the sender. The contract announces successful deposits, transfers, and withdrawals, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Binance Wallet is a self-custody (non-custodial) crypto wallet built by Binance.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on death.fun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction game where users wager an ERC-20 token on a grid-based game, with the contract holding all active wagers in escrow. It maintains individual game states for each player, including their current wager, multiplier, and position on the game board, along with a global configuration for game difficulty and payout ratios. Callers can initiate a new game by placing a wager, advance their current game to the next tile, and cash out their accumulated winnings at any point. A designated operator is privileged to set the game's difficulty parameters and the maximum payout multiplier. Each game must have a minimum wager of 100 units of the ERC-20 token, and a 2% fee is deducted from all successful cash-outs, sent to a treasury address. The contract announces events for game starts, tile advances, and cash-outs, including the player's address, the wager amount, and the resulting payout.
source_description: Death.fun is an onchain mines game where users wager, advance through tiles for higher multipliers, and cash out before hitting the death tile.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Deri Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral and settlement funds. It maintains individual user account balances, open positions for each trading pair, and global configuration parameters such as funding rates and margin requirements. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, modify existing positions, and withdraw available funds. Only a designated operator can adjust global trading parameters, add new trading pairs, or initiate emergency settlements. A minimum initial margin of 10% of position value is required for all new positions, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position changes, and funding rate updates.
source_description: Deri, your option, your future! Deri Protocol is a decentralized protocol for users to exchange risk exposures precisely and capital efficiently. It is the DeFi way to trade derivatives: to hedge, to speculate, to arbitrage, all on chain

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on dTRINITY dUSD and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin, holding a reserve of yield-bearing collateral tokens to back the stablecoin's value. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, individual stablecoin balances for each account, and a record of the current reserve ratio. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio within predefined limits and pause or unpause minting and redemption operations. The contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 110% and a maximum minting fee of 0.5% of the minted amount. It emits events for all minting, redemption, and transfer operations, as well as changes to the collateralization ratio.
source_description: dTRINITY (short for "DeFi Trinity") is the world's first subsidized stablecoin protocol, a new DeFi primitive designed to supercharge on-chain credit markets. At its core is dUSD, a decentralized stablecoin fully backed by exogenous, yield-bearing reserve assets. Rather than paying yield to passive stablecoin holders or stakers, dTRINITY distributes its reserve earnings as interest rebates to subsidize dUSD borrowers directly. By stimulating credit, the protocol is able to raise its natural supply-demand equilibrium, unlocking greater yields and capital efficiency for stablecoin users.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on FstSwap and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an automated market maker for exchanging two distinct fungible tokens, holding reserves of each token in liquidity pools. It maintains a separate pool for each supported token pair, tracking the quantity of each token held within that pool, and a global trading fee percentage. Callers can add liquidity to a pool by depositing both tokens in proportion to the current pool ratio, remove liquidity by burning their proportional share of the pool and receiving both tokens, and swap one token for another by depositing one token and receiving the other from a pool. Only the owner can set the global trading fee, add new token pairs, or pause all trading activity. A 0.3% trading fee is applied to all swaps, deducted from the input token amount. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added or removed, or a swap occurs, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: FstSwap is an automated market maker (AMM) that allows the exchange of two tokens on Binance Smart Chain. It's fast, cheap, and allows anyone to participate.

description: Define a token contract based on scoop and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a marketplace for creator shares, holding all deposited funds in its custody. It maintains individual balances for each user, a total supply for each creator's shares, and a global community fund. Callers can buy shares in a creator, sell shares they own, and claim their accumulated earnings. The contract owner can set the base price for new creator shares and withdraw funds from the community fund. A 5% fee is applied to all share purchases, and creators receive 2% of every share sale. The contract emits an event when shares are bought, sold, or earnings are claimed.
source_description: Scoop lets users buy their favorite creators. The more engagement they receive, the more users earn from the community pool. Creators also get a cut of every trade

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Aster Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a perpetual exchange settlement layer that custodies user collateral and synthetic asset positions. It maintains individual user collateral balances, open long and short positions for various synthetic assets, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, withdraw available collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. Only the owner can adjust global configuration parameters, such as adding new synthetic assets or modifying margin requirements. A minimum initial margin of 10% of the position value is required to open any position, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all position opening and closing operations. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, amount, and relevant fees.
source_description: Aster is a decentralized perpetual exchange built for everyone. It offers MEV-free, one-click trading with up to 1001x leverage in Simple Mode, and full-featured, pro-grade tools in Pro Mode. Backed by YZi Labs, Aster is building the future of DeFi: fast, flexible, and community-first

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Ara Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding collateral assets to back the issuance of a stable digital currency. It maintains individual account balances for the stablecoin, records of deposited collateral for each user, and a global pool of all collateral. Callers can deposit approved collateral, mint stablecoins against their deposited collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem collateral, and withdraw unencumbered collateral. A designated administrator can add or remove approved collateral types, adjust the collateralization ratio, and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces stablecoin minting, burning, and collateral deposit and withdrawal events.
source_description: Ara Finance is building a community-owned decentralized financial infrastructure to bring more stability and transparency for the world.

description: Outline a staking contract based on Veno Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base network token, holding deposited base tokens and issuing liquid staking tokens in return. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base token balance, their minted liquid staking token balance, and the current exchange rate between the base token and the liquid staking token, along with a global pool of staked base tokens. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their base tokens by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards. A designated operator can update the total amount of staked base tokens and the total rewards accumulated, and can set the withdrawal fee. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 base tokens and a withdrawal fee of 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to the exchange rate.
source_description: Easy and Reliable Liquid Staking on Cronos chain

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Windfall and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss prize pool, holding user deposits of a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total pooled balance, and a record of active prize rounds with their associated prize amounts. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their principal at any time, and claim prizes if they are randomly selected as a winner. Only a designated operator can initiate new prize rounds, fund prizes from an external source, and trigger the random winner selection process. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is required to participate in any prize round, and prize rounds occur weekly, always on Mondays at 12:00 UTC. The contract announces when a new prize round has started, when a prize has been funded, and when a winner has been selected for a specific round.
source_description: No-loss prize gaming generated via decentralized pooled lending

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Sudo Perps and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposits and maintaining open positions. It stores per-account records of collateral balances, active long or short positions for each trading pair, and global funding rates. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized accounts. A designated operator can update oracle prices, adjust trading pair parameters, and pause trading in an emergency. The initial margin requirement for opening a new position is 10% of its notional value, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations, including the affected account, asset, and amount.
source_description: Sudo is the first perpetual dex on Sui that offers you sub-second and zero price impact trading experience on-chain.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on LazyFi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of a specific fungible token, enabling users to deposit and withdraw it for use in gaming activities. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance and a global total of all deposited tokens. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim rewards earned from their participation. Only a designated operator can initiate reward distributions to eligible users, pause all deposit and withdrawal operations, and update the reward distribution rate. The maximum individual deposit allowed is 1000 tokens per transaction, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is sent to a designated treasury address. The contract announces when a deposit or withdrawal occurs and when rewards are distributed to a user.
source_description: We build online games that clients can configure with learning and rewards.

description: Create a lending protocol based on BitU Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for a USD-pegged stablecoin, holding deposited stablecoins and collateral tokens. It maintains individual account balances for deposited stablecoins, collateral amounts, and accrued interest, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit stablecoins, deposit collateral tokens, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay borrowed stablecoins, and withdraw their stablecoin deposits or collateral after full repayment. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate and the collateralization ratio. The minimum collateralization ratio for any loan is 150%, and the maximum annual interest rate for borrowing is 10%. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, borrow, and repayment action, including the affected account, asset type, and amount.
source_description: BitU Protocol offers a USD-pegged stablecoin primitive that provides stability and embedded yield. Through our Active Liquidity Management Module, we leverage on-chain transparency and off-chain capital efficiency to deliver resilient yield to support accessible ecosystem growth.

description: Design a governance contract based on Kal Mydas and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages five distinct strategy vaults, each holding deposited stablecoins and tracking individual user balances within those vaults. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance per vault and the total stablecoin balance for each of the five vaults. Callers can deposit stablecoins into any of the five vaults, withdraw their deposited stablecoins from a vault, and claim rewards distributed to a vault. A designated operator can allocate deposited stablecoins from a vault to an external trading venue, redeem allocated stablecoins from the external trading venue back to the vault, and distribute rewards to a vault. The contract owner can set the designated operator for each vault and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals for all vaults. Each vault has a maximum deposit capacity of 10,000,000 stablecoins. A 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event when stablecoins are deposited, when stablecoins are withdrawn, when rewards are distributed, when rewards are claimed, when funds are allocated by an operator, and when funds are redeemed by an operator.
source_description: Kal Mydas is a decentralized protocol on Base mainnet built around gold and bitcoin. USDC deposited into one of five strategy vault pools (HORIZON, VALKYRIE, REVOLUTION, TREASURY, ORION) is allocated to an off-chain operator that opens positions on gTrade (Gains Network) on the XAU/USD pair

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Strata Markets and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a principal-protected yield strategy, holding deposited base tokens and issuing junior and senior tranche tokens representing claims on future yield and principal respectively. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base tokens, the total principal deposited into the strategy, the current yield generated, and the current allocation ratio between junior and senior tranches. Callers can deposit base tokens, withdraw their principal and earned yield, claim their share of generated yield, and redeem their tranche tokens for the underlying principal. A designated operator can update the external yield strategy's parameters and initiate a new yield generation cycle. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all principal withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 base tokens. The contract emits events when new deposits are made, when withdrawals occur, and when the yield generation cycle is reset.
source_description: Strata is a generalized risk-tranching protocol designed to offer structured yields via tokenized senior and junior tranches across diverse on-chain and off-chain yield strategies.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on KiloEx and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders and liquidity providers. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including their size and average entry price, and a global pool of available liquidity for each supported asset. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close long or short positions, add or remove liquidity from the pools, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can adjust trading fees, list new tradable assets, or liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all position opening and closing volume. The contract announces when a position is opened, closed, or liquidated, and when collateral is deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: Next generation perp DEX. Lightning-fast trades,risk-neutral positions and LP-friendly solutions.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Tether Gold and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract tokenizes ownership of physical gold bars, with each token representing a specific weight of gold held in secure vaults. It maintains individual account balances for the gold-backed tokens and tracks the total supply of tokens, which directly correlates to the total physical gold held. Callers can transfer their tokens to other accounts, redeem tokens for physical gold, and deposit physical gold to mint new tokens. A designated operator can pause all token transfers in emergencies and adjust the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.25% of the gold value being redeemed, and a minimum redemption quantity of 100 grams of gold is enforced. The contract announces all token transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: Tether Gold (XAUt) is a token that provides you ownership of real physical gold. By putting gold on a Blockchain, we unlock a variety of characteristics that typically only crypto assets possess

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Kamigotchi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the lifecycle and attributes of unique, non-fungible digital pets, holding custody of the pet tokens themselves. It maintains individual pet records including their current level, experience points, and a list of learned skills, along with a global configuration for pet creation parameters. Callers can mint new pets, feed their pets to gain experience, initiate skill learning for a pet, and evolve a pet once it meets specific criteria. Only a designated operator can set the base cost for minting new pets and approve new skills for pets to learn. Minting a new pet requires a payment of 0.05 ether, and a pet must reach level 5 before it can evolve. The contract announces when a new pet is minted, when a pet gains a level, and when a pet learns a new skill.
source_description: Kamigotchi is a fully on-chain MMORPG where players mint, raise, and interact with NFT virtual pets called Kamis on the Yominet blockchain

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on Vesq and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized reserve currency protocol that custodies a basket of approved digital assets and issues a native token backed by these reserves. It maintains a global reserve balance for each approved asset, a total supply of the native token, and individual account balances for the native token. Callers can deposit approved assets to mint the native token, transfer the native token between accounts, and redeem the native token for a proportional share of the underlying reserves. A designated operator can add or remove approved reserve assets and adjust their collateralization weights, and can also pause or unpause all minting and redemption operations. The minimum deposit amount for any approved asset is 10 units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all native token redemption operations. The contract announces when new reserve assets are approved, when collateralization weights are updated, and when minting or redemption operations are paused or unpaused.
source_description: VESQ is a decentralized reserve currency protocol available on the Polygon (MATIC) Network based on the VSQ token.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Realms World and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and ownership of unique digital assets representing in-game territories, which it custodies. It maintains a record of each territory's owner, its coordinates, and its current status (e.g., active, claimed, or under development), along with a global counter for the total number of territories minted. Callers can claim a new territory, transfer ownership of an existing territory to another account, or initiate development on a claimed territory. Only a designated administrator can mint new territories beyond the initial allocation, set the fee for claiming a territory, or pause all territory-related operations. A maximum of 10,000 territories can be minted in total, and the initial claiming fee for any territory is 0.01 units of the native currency. The contract announces when a new territory is minted, when ownership of a territory changes, and when a territory's status is updated.
source_description: The premier onchain gaming ecosystem built on Starknet. Play games, earn rewards, and participate in the future of onchain gaming.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on PsyOptions and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of asset-settled options, holding the underlying collateral for active option series. It maintains records of each option series' parameters (strike price, expiration, underlying asset, quote asset), the total collateral locked for each series, and individual user positions detailing their purchased options and written options. Callers can create new option series, deposit collateral to write options, purchase options, exercise options before expiration, and withdraw unexercised collateral after expiration. Only the owner can set the global option creation fee, which is 0.1% of the notional value of each new option series created. The owner can also designate operators who are authorized to pause and unpause trading for individual option series. A maximum of 100 active option series can exist at any time. The contract emits an event whenever a new option series is created, an option is purchased, an option is exercised, or collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: Trade on-chain, asset settled, American style options for $BTC & $ETH

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on xStocks and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues and manages a tokenized representation of real-world assets, specifically shares in a company, which it custodies off-chain. It maintains a record of each user's token balance and a global total supply, along with a mapping of each token to its underlying off-chain asset identifier. Callers can mint new tokens, burn existing tokens, transfer tokens to other users, and approve other users to spend their tokens. A designated operator is privileged to mint new tokens and burn tokens from any account, while the owner can set the operator and pause all token transfers. A maximum of 100,000 tokens can ever be minted, and each token transfer incurs a 0.1% fee, deducted from the sender. The contract announces all token transfers, approvals, minting events, and burning events to observers.
source_description: All xStocks are freely transferable tokens. They can be used in lending protocols, on DEXs, or any DeFi app. Hold them in your own wallet, or buy on one venue and sell on another. xStocks are built to be usable.

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Landshare and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractional ownership of real estate assets, holding a designated stablecoin as collateral for each share. It maintains a record of each investor's stablecoin balance, their proportional ownership in each property, and a global pool of available shares for each property. Callers can deposit stablecoins to purchase shares, transfer shares to another investor, and redeem shares for stablecoins. Only a designated operator can register new real estate properties, set the price per share for each property, and withdraw stablecoins from the contract's reserves. A minimum deposit of 10 stablecoins is required to purchase shares, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all share redemptions. The contract announces share purchases, share transfers, and share redemptions to observers.
source_description: Landshare is a tokenized real estate ecosystem that leverages the power of blockchain technology to provide a new way to invest in real estate. With minimum investments of just over $1, Landshare strives to make real estate investment accessible to everyone

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on AFX LP and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquidity provider vault for a decentralized exchange, holding various token pairs as liquidity. It maintains records of each user's deposited tokens, their share of the total liquidity, and configurable parameters for each token pair. Callers can deposit tokens into available liquidity pools, withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued fees, and claim any earned rewards. Only the designated owner can add new token pairs, adjust the trading fees for each pair, or pause all deposits and withdrawals. A maximum of 100 distinct token pairs can be supported at any time, and a 0.2% fee is applied to all withdrawals, directed to the protocol treasury. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, fee changes, and the addition of new token pairs.
source_description: AFX LP Vault is the protocol-level vault that provides liquidity to the AFX exchange.

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Stobox and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a digital asset registry for tokenized real-world assets, specifically equity shares in private companies, and custodies no native tokens itself. It maintains a record of each shareholder's ownership percentage and the total authorized shares for each registered asset. Callers can subscribe to new share issuances, transfer their owned shares to another registered shareholder, and redeem their shares for the underlying real-world asset. A designated administrator can register new real-world assets, set the total authorized shares for an asset, and approve or reject share transfer requests. The contract enforces a maximum of 1,000,000 authorized shares per asset and charges a 0.1% fee on all share transfers, payable in a pre-configured stablecoin. The contract announces successful share transfers and new asset registrations through emitted events.
source_description: Stobox is a turnkey tokenization technology provider delivering regulated digital asset infrastructure for compliant security tokens and real-world assets. We build enterprise-grade platforms that enable businesses to issue, manage, and scale tokenized assets with embedded compliance, automation, and regulatory alignment. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance and blockchain by making regulated tokenization seamless, secure, and accessible for companies at every stage.

description: Model a prediction market contract based on DeeppDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a non-custodial prediction market where users can stake tokens on the outcome of future events. It maintains event definitions, user positions for each event, and a pool of staked tokens for each outcome. Callers can create new prediction events, stake tokens on an outcome, withdraw their stake if an event is cancelled, and claim winnings after an event concludes. A designated operator can resolve an event with a specific outcome, and only they can cancel an event before resolution. New event creation is limited to a maximum of 10 events per day. A 0.5% fee is applied to all winning payouts, which is directed to a treasury. The contract announces event creation, stake placement, event resolution, and payout claims.
source_description: Prediction market. Non custodial. Transparent. Trustless. Community owned.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Reti Pooling and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool that custodies a native blockchain asset. It maintains a total pooled balance, individual user deposit records, and a list of approved validator addresses with their current stake amounts. Callers can deposit the native asset to receive a proportional share of the pool's liquid staking token, withdraw their deposited native asset plus accrued rewards by burning their liquid staking token, and claim their share of rewards. A designated operator can add or remove validator addresses from the approved list, and update the commission rate charged on staking rewards. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the native asset. The commission rate on staking rewards is fixed at 5% and can only be changed once every 30 days by the designated operator. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal, and reward distribution, detailing the amount and the affected user.
source_description: The Réti Pooling protocol is a decentralized, non-custodial solution that enables users to pool their Algorand stake, allowing anyone to trustlessly stake with Validators and earn rewards

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on Yearn Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator vault that custodies various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount and the total assets under management for each supported token. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their principal, and claim accumulated yield. Only a designated operator can add new yield strategies or rebalance existing ones, and only the owner can set the withdrawal fee. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and a minimum of 100 units of any supported token must be deposited in a single transaction. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address, the token, and the amount.
source_description: Yearn.finance is an aggregator service for decentralized finance (DeFi) investors, using automation to allow them to maximize profits from yield farming.

description: Specify a governance contract based on Peppercoin and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized autonomous organization's governance, holding a native governance token. It maintains individual account balances of staked tokens, vote delegations, and active proposals with their associated votes. Callers can stake tokens, unstake tokens, delegate voting power, submit new proposals, vote on active proposals, and execute successful proposals. Only the owner may set the minimum staking amount for proposal submission and designate new proposal creators. A minimum of 1,000 tokens must be staked to submit a proposal, and a voting period for proposals is fixed at 72 hours. The contract announces when tokens are staked, unstaked, voting power is delegated, new proposals are created, and votes are cast.
source_description: Peppercoin is the home of Pepper Inc., empowering the community to stake, vote, and shape the future of PEPPER

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on AveForge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital gear items for a mech combat game, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a registry of all minted gear items, including their unique identifier, current owner, and a set of immutable attributes like power, defense, and rarity, along with a configurable maximum supply for each gear type. Callers can mint new gear items, transfer ownership of their gear items, and burn gear items they own. A designated operator can define new gear types and their associated attributes, and can pause all minting operations. The total supply of any single gear type cannot exceed 10,000 items, and a 0.01 ether fee is charged for each new gear item minted. The contract announces when new gear items are minted, when gear ownership changes, and when gear items are burned.
source_description: Ave Forge is a MegaETH mech battler where players upgrade and trade gear, compete in arena matches, and earn rewards through leaderboards and tournaments

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Camelot V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity pools for token pairs, holding deposited tokens within those pools. It maintains records of each liquidity position, including its token amounts, price range, and accumulated fees, along with global pool configurations like swap fees and tick spacing. Callers can create new liquidity positions, add to existing positions, remove liquidity, and swap tokens within a pool. A designated owner can set the base swap fee for new pools, which must be between 0.01% and 1%, and can also pause all swap operations across the protocol in emergencies. The contract emits events when liquidity is added or removed, and when a token swap occurs, including the tokens involved and the amounts exchanged.
source_description: Concentrated liquidity AMM on Arbitrum

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Diamond Coin and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a fungible token, serving as the primary utility token for a gaming platform. It maintains individual token balances for all accounts and a total supply.
