Callers can transfer tokens to other accounts, approve spending limits for other accounts, and burn their own tokens. A designated operator can mint new tokens, update the maximum total supply, and pause or unpause all token transfers. The initial maximum total supply is set at 100,000,000 tokens. No more than 1,000,000 tokens can be minted in any 24-hour period. The contract announces all token transfers, approvals, minting events, and burning events.
source_description: Diamond (Diamond) tokens are native to the Fantoon NFT platform, of the Pumpkittens GameFi ecosystem. It's a rare, utility driven token launched through a community LGE with Fantom's DEX SpiritSwap.

description: Design a prediction market contract based on DoubleUp and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction game where participants bet on the outcome of a future event, holding user deposits of a single fungible token. It maintains individual user balances, a total pool balance for each active game round, and a global configuration including the current game round identifier and the house edge. Callers can initiate a new game round, place a bet on a specific outcome within an active round, and claim winnings after a round concludes. Only a designated operator can initiate new game rounds and resolve the outcome of a game round. The minimum bet amount is 100 units of the fungible token, and a 5% house edge is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits an event when a new game round begins, when a bet is placed, and when a game round is resolved with its winning outcome.
source_description: Defi gaming platform on Sui Network

description: Model an NFT contract based on NFTEarth and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the buying and selling of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and custodies deposited NFTs and associated payment tokens. It maintains a record of active listings, including the listed NFT, its price, and the seller, along with a configurable platform fee percentage. Callers can list an NFT for sale, purchase a listed NFT, cancel their own listings, and withdraw payment tokens from successful sales. The owner can set the platform fee percentage, which must be between 0% and 5%. The owner can also designate operators who can pause and unpause trading activity for all listings. When an NFT is successfully sold, the contract emits an event detailing the NFT identifier, the seller, the buyer, and the final sale price.
source_description: Buy and Sell NFTs on L2.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Vesu and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending pool, holding deposited tokens and tracking outstanding loans. It maintains individual user deposit balances, borrowed amounts, and accrued interest for each supported asset, alongside global pool liquidity and utilization rates. Callers can deposit tokens to earn interest, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their available balance. A designated owner can add new supported assets, adjust interest rate models, and pause borrowing or depositing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.05% fee is applied to all successful loan repayments, directed to the protocol's treasury. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, and repayments, including the user's identity, the asset involved, and the amount transacted.
source_description: The Future of Lending on Starknet - Vesu is a modular and permissionless lending protocol allowing anyone to earn, borrow and create markets.

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on Memeta and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and launch of new token projects, holding deposited funds for bonding curve liquidity. It maintains a record of each project's bonding curve parameters, its associated token, and the total funds contributed to each project. Callers can create a new project by defining its bonding curve and initial token supply, contribute funds to an active project, and claim their share of tokens from a project once it launches. Only the contract owner can pause all project creation and funding, or set the platform fee. A project's bonding curve must be defined with at least two points, and the platform charges a 1% fee on all funds contributed to projects. The contract announces when a new project is created, when funds are contributed to a project, and when a project launches.
source_description: Memeta is a meme coin launchpad on the Manta Network where creators set custom bonding curves to determine each coin’s market value, allowing dynamic liquidity and trading on DEXs to drive user engagement and transaction growth in a decentralized ecosystem.

description: Model a lending protocol based on Flying Tulip Lend and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for a single fungible token, holding deposited tokens as collateral and issuing new tokens as loans. It maintains individual account balances for deposits and borrows, a global pool of available liquidity, and configuration parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit tokens, borrow against their collateral, repay loans, and withdraw their unencumbered deposits. A designated operator can adjust interest rate models and collateral factors, and can pause all lending and borrowing activity in emergencies. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a liquidation penalty of 5% is applied to the seized collateral value. The contract announces all deposit, borrow, repay, and withdraw events, including the affected account, token amount, and current total supply or borrow.
source_description: Flying Tulip Lend is a custom lending market live on Sonic and Ethereum.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Tensor and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized NFT marketplace, holding deposited NFTs and associated bids or listings. It maintains a record of each user's deposited NFTs, active listings with their prices and expiration times, and open bids with their amounts and expiration times. Callers can deposit NFTs, list NFTs for sale, make bids on listed NFTs, accept bids, cancel listings, and withdraw their NFTs or funds. A designated operator can adjust the marketplace fee and pause all trading activity. The maximum marketplace fee is 2%, and all listings expire after 7 days if not sold. The contract announces NFT deposits, NFT withdrawals, new listings, listing cancellations, new bids, accepted bids, and fee updates.
source_description: Stewarding critical infrastructure for NFT trading. Growing a community of Solana NFT creators & builders.

description: Define a staking contract based on BlazeStake and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool for a proof-of-stake blockchain, holding deposited native tokens and issuing a liquid staking derivative token in return. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking derivative, an exchange rate between the derivative and the native token, and a record of each user's deposited native tokens and issued derivative tokens. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive derivative tokens, unstake derivative tokens to receive native tokens after a delay, and claim their unstaked native tokens once available. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on staking rewards and penalties, and can also set the unstaking fee. The unstaking fee is fixed at 0.5% of the native tokens unstaked. Unstaking requests have a mandatory 3-day waiting period before native tokens can be claimed. The contract announces the current exchange rate and any changes to the unstaking fee.
source_description: BlazeStake is an innovative liquid staking protocol designed to support the Solana ecosystem. Delegators can choose to stake their SOL either through the standard delegation pool (which balances stake across hundreds of validators to support decentralization) or to any validators of their choice, all while receiving the liquid staking benefits of bSOL (access to instant unstake liquidity, increased staking yields through DeFi, Solana ecosystem token airdrops, and more).

description: Create a payments contract based on UniVoucher and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables the creation of crypto gift cards, holding deposited Ether or ERC20 tokens until redemption or cancellation. It maintains a record for each active gift card, including its unique secret hash, the asset type and amount, and its creation timestamp. Callers can create new gift cards by depositing assets, redeem existing gift cards using their secret, and cancel their own unredeemed gift cards to reclaim the deposited assets. The contract owner can set the fee for creating gift cards and designate allowed ERC20 tokens. A gift card creation fee of 0.001 Ether is applied to all new cards, and a maximum of 10,000 gift cards can be active simultaneously. The contract announces events for gift card creation, redemption, and cancellation, including the card's unique identifier and the value transferred.
source_description: UniVoucher allows users to create crypto gift cards with ETH or ERC20 tokens that can be redeemed by holders of card secrets. The TVL represents the total value of all active (unredeemed/uncancelled) gift cards across all supported chains

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on EnterDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for metaverse land parcels, holding non-fungible tokens representing digital land. It maintains a record of which land parcels are deposited by each user and tracks the total number of parcels available for rent. Callers can deposit their land parcels, withdraw their deposited land parcels, and rent available land parcels for a specified duration. A designated operator can set the rental fee percentage and approve new land parcel collections for deposit. The rental fee is fixed at 5% of the rental price, and the maximum rental duration is 30 days. The contract announces when land parcels are deposited, withdrawn, or rented, and when rental fees are updated.
source_description: Through a lineup of core products, EnterDAO aims to empower users, metaverse land owners, investors, brands, and degens of all kinds by tackling pain points like access to metaverse land, its capital efficiency, as well as UX and onboarding of metaverse games.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Quarry and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages liquidity mining programs, holding deposited tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount for each program, the total deposited amount per program, and the configuration parameters for each program including its reward token and distribution rate. Callers can deposit tokens into a program, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim their accumulated rewards. A designated owner can create new programs, update a program's reward rate, and pause or unpause a program. A program's reward rate cannot be changed more than once every 24 hours. The maximum number of active programs is 50. The contract emits events when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, rewards are claimed, and when a program's status or configuration is updated.
source_description: Quarry is an open protocol for launching liquidity mining programs.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Core Markets and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by users to back their open positions. It maintains individual user accounts with their collateral balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and a global configuration for market parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify leverage on open positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can add new trading pairs, adjust funding rates, and pause trading for specific markets. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and margin modifications.
source_description: Core Markets is a perpetuals intent-based platform on Blast

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Untangled RWA and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin collateral that backs real-world asset loans, enabling fractionalized ownership of these loans. It maintains per-loan records including the outstanding principal, interest accrued, and the current loan status, alongside a global pool balance and configuration parameters for loan origination. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim their share of repaid principal and interest from loans they have funded. A designated operator can originate new loans, approve loan repayments, and mark loans as defaulted. The contract enforces a maximum loan-to-value ratio of 75% for all new loans and charges a 0.5% origination fee on the principal of each new loan, payable to the protocol treasury. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, loan origination, loan repayment, and loan default.
source_description: Untangled is an institutional-grade RWA credit protocol for fintechs around the world. The protocol has pioneered the first RWA credit oracle infrastructure, enabling dynamic pricing of RWAs with AI-driven risk models and zero-knowledge proof

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Vaulta REX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the lending and borrowing of two distinct, fungible digital resources, Resource A and Resource B, and custodies user deposits of these resources. It maintains individual account balances for deposited Resource A and Resource B, records of active loans for each resource including principal and interest accrued, and a global configuration for interest rates and loan durations. Callers can deposit Resource A, deposit Resource B, borrow Resource A, borrow Resource B, repay loans for Resource A, repay loans for Resource B, and withdraw their deposited resources. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate for Resource A loans, adjust the interest rate for Resource B loans, and pause all new loan originations. The maximum loan duration for either resource is 30 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all loan originations, payable in the borrowed resource. The contract announces when a new loan is originated, when a loan is repaid, and when interest rates are updated.
source_description: REX (Resource Exchange) used for lending and borrowing CPU & NET resources and earning system protocol income (RAM fees, Name Bids, CPU/Net loans, PowerUp fees).

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Arcadia V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged yield farming by holding user-deposited collateral and borrowed assets, managing their positions in external liquidity pools. It maintains individual user records for each farming position, including deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and accrued rewards, alongside a global configuration for supported assets and leverage limits. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, open new farming positions, close existing positions, add or remove collateral from a position, repay borrowed amounts, and claim rewards. A designated operator can pause all user operations, update supported asset configurations, adjust borrowing interest rates, and liquidate underwater positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 5x the deposited collateral, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all borrowed amounts. The contract announces events for position openings, position closures, liquidations, and reward claims, including the user's address, the position identifier, and the relevant asset amounts.
source_description: Leverage farming protocol on base

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Rhea Dex and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token swaps, holding deposited tokens within its pools. It maintains records of token balances for each user, configuration parameters for each trading pair, and the current state of liquidity pools. Callers can deposit tokens into pools, withdraw their deposited tokens, swap tokens between supported pairs, and add or remove liquidity from pools. Only the owner can add new token pairs, set trading fees, or pause all trading activity. A maximum of 100 distinct token pairs can be active simultaneously, and the default trading fee for all pairs is 0.3%. The contract announces all token deposits, withdrawals, and successful swaps to observers.
source_description: Rhea Finance merges Ref Finance and Burrow Finance to create NEAR’s most powerful DeFi hub, connecting Bitcoin, NEAR, and EVM ecosystems. By consolidating liquidity, lending, and trading under one entity, Rhea Finance unlocks a seamless DeFi experience for institutional and retail users alike.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on zkSync Era txBridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a cross-chain messaging bridge, enabling the transfer of arbitrary data and value between a Layer 1 and a Layer 2 network, and it custodies no assets directly, only tracking pending transfers. It maintains a record of each message's status, including whether it has been sent from Layer 1, processed on Layer 2, or finalized back on Layer 1, and stores a configuration for the trusted Layer 2 messaging contract. Callers can initiate a message transfer from Layer 1 to Layer 2, finalize a message transfer from Layer 2 back to Layer 1, and retrieve the status of any message by its unique identifier. Only a designated operator can update the address of the trusted Layer 2 messaging contract. A message initiated from Layer 1 must include a minimum transfer fee of 0.001 native Layer 1 tokens, and there is a mandatory 24-hour delay before any Layer 2 to Layer 1 message can be finalized. The contract announces the initiation of a new Layer 1 to Layer 2 message and the finalization of a Layer 2 to Layer 1 message, including the sender, recipient, and message data.
source_description: Imagine a platform where zksync enthusiasts and developers all come together to learn, create, and innovate

description: Outline an on-chain insurance contract based on Cozy V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer risk protection, holding deposited collateral in various approved tokens. It maintains individual user balances for collateral and protection policies, a global pool of available protection, and configurable parameters for each protection market. Callers can deposit collateral, purchase protection for a specified duration and asset, provide liquidity to protection pools, and withdraw their available collateral or earned yield. A designated administrator can create new protection markets, adjust market parameters like pricing curves, and pause or unpause the contract's core functionality. The maximum protection duration for any policy is 365 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all protection purchases, distributed to liquidity providers. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, protection purchases, and policy expirations.
source_description: With Cozy v2, you can buy protection to hedge against risks like smart contract hacks, depegs, and more. Or you can earn yields by providing protection, backing an index of markets

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on DODO AMM and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange pool designed to facilitate efficient token swaps between two distinct assets, holding reserves of both tokens. It maintains state for each trading pair, including the current balance of each token in the pool, a dynamic price curve, and a set of configurable parameters. Callers can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their deposited tokens, and swap one token for the other. A designated owner role can adjust trading fees, update the price curve parameters, and pause all trading operations. The maximum trading fee is 0.3%, and the minimum liquidity deposit is 100 units of either token. The contract emits an event for every swap operation, detailing the tokens exchanged, their amounts, and the final price.
source_description: Trade crypto assets with market-leading liquidity

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Bondlink Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for stablecoins, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing them as loans. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, their outstanding loan balance, and the total stablecoins available in the pool. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, request a loan against their deposited collateral, repay their outstanding loan, and withdraw their deposited stablecoins. Only a designated operator can approve loan requests and initiate loan liquidations. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75% of the deposited collateral value. A 0.5% fee is applied to all loan originations. The contract announces events for stablecoin deposits, stablecoin withdrawals, loan originations, loan repayments, and loan liquidations.
source_description: An Omnichain stable coin infrastructure that aggregates private lending opportunities in emerging economies combined with DeFi.

description: Outline an on-chain insurance contract based on iTrust Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pooled insurance fund, holding various stablecoins and protocol-specific tokens as collateral. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a global pool of staked assets, and configuration parameters for fees and rewards. Callers can deposit stablecoins to receive coverage, stake protocol tokens to earn rewards, withdraw their deposits and accumulated rewards, and claim against their coverage if an insured event occurs. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate, pause deposits, and initiate payouts for valid claims. A minimum deposit of 100 units of any stablecoin is required for coverage, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all successful coverage claims. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, claim, and reward distribution.
source_description: iTrust Finance creates mutually beneficial relationships between stakers and insurance protocols by maximising rewards and growing cover capacity for all participants of the DAO, and the wider DeFi community.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Antarctic and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each trader, a global configuration for trading parameters, and a pool of funds for liquidations. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, adjust leverage on open positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions, and the owner can update global trading parameters and pause trading. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.05% taker fee is applied to all trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations.
source_description: Antarctic Exchange (AX) is a high-performance decentralized perpetual futures DEX delivering CEX-grade trading with deep liquidity, low fees, and a clean, self-custodial UX.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on BakerDAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collateralized debt position (CDP) system, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing a stablecoin token. It maintains individual user positions including deposited collateral amounts, issued stablecoin debt, and liquidation thresholds, alongside global system parameters like collateral ratios and stability fees. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust system parameters such as the minimum collateralization ratio and the stability fee, and can pause or unpause borrowing. The minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and a 0.5% stability fee is applied annually to outstanding debt. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrowings, repayments, and liquidations.
source_description: BakerDAO combines token economics, collateralized lending, leverage, and Proof-of-Liquidity into a single cohesive financial ecosystem

description: Define a lending protocol based on Kava Mint and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a collateralized debt position system, holding various approved digital assets as collateral and minting a stablecoin against them. It maintains individual user positions tracking deposited collateral, borrowed stablecoin, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration for each collateral type including its oracle price, liquidation ratio, and interest rate. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoin, repay stablecoin, withdraw collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. Only a designated operator can update collateral asset configurations, including adding new collateral types, setting their oracle addresses, or adjusting their liquidation ratios and interest rates. A minimum collateralization ratio of 150% is enforced for all active loans, and a 5% liquidation penalty is applied to the collateral of liquidated positions. The contract announces events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Kava.io is the first cross-chain DeFi hub providing applications and services to the worlds largest cryptocurrencies.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Figure Markets Exchange and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for spot trading, holding deposited tokens from users. It maintains individual account balances for each token, a global order book for each trading pair, and configuration parameters like trading fees. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens, place limit orders, cancel open orders, and fill existing orders. A designated operator can pause trading for specific pairs and update trading fees. A trading fee of 0.1% is applied to all filled orders, and a single account cannot have more than 100 open orders across all pairs. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, order placements, order cancellations, and order fills.
source_description: A crypto exchange designed for traders who demand more. Benefit from the security and asset control of decentralized custody with the ease and liquidity of a centralized exchange

description: Specify a governance contract based on Turtle Club and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of a single designated base token, distributing rewards to participants who lock their base tokens. It maintains each participant's locked amount, their accumulated rewards, and a global reward rate configuration. Callers can deposit base tokens to lock them, withdraw their locked base tokens and accumulated rewards, and claim only their accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate, which must be between 0.001% and 0.1% per block. The owner can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and can set the designated operator. Withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn base token amount, which is sent to a treasury address. The contract announces when a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the reward rate is updated.
source_description: Liquidity Distribution Protocol.

description: Model a governance contract based on Concrete and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for managing user deposits of a single fungible token, aiming to generate yield through external strategies, and it custodies user-deposited tokens and any accrued yield. It maintains individual user balances, a total deposited amount, and a list of approved external strategy contracts along with their allocated capital. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their principal and any earned yield, and redeem their vault shares for the underlying token. A designated operator can add new external strategy contracts, update the capital allocated to existing strategies, and initiate rebalancing operations between strategies. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of the underlying token, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and strategy allocation change, including the user's address, the amount, and the timestamp.
source_description: Concrete provides full-stack yield infrastructure for DeFi, powering automated, risk-managed vault products across major ecosystems. Concrete combines quantitative modeling, modular architecture, and cross-chain integrations to deliver institutional-grade vaults with transparent, sustainable performance.

description: Define a lending protocol based on Frankencoin and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user collateral balances, stablecoin debt positions, and global configuration parameters like collateral types and their associated ratios. Callers can deposit approved collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and set system fees. The minimum collateralization ratio for any loan is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin borrowing operations. The contract announces all collateral deposits, stablecoin mints, and stablecoin burns.
source_description: Frankencoin is a collateralized, oracle-free stablecoin that tracks the value of the Swiss franc.

description: Design a lending protocol based on SparkLend and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin lending pool that custodies deposited stablecoins. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, borrowed amount, and accumulated interest, along with the total stablecoins available in the pool and the current, governance-defined borrow interest rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay their loans, and withdraw their deposits. A designated owner can set the borrow interest rate and pause or unpause borrowing and depositing. The maximum borrow-to-collateral ratio is 80%, and the borrow interest rate is fixed at 3% per year. The contract announces deposit, borrow, repay, and withdraw events, including the user, amount, and updated balances.
source_description: SparkLend is a stablecoin lending market. Unlike other lending protocols where rates fluctuate based on utilization or loan size, SparkLend offers governance-defined rates that do not vary based on those factors. This is made possible by Spark’s Liquidity Layer (SLL), which supplies consistent stablecoin liquidity to the protocol

description: Design an NFT contract based on NFPrompt and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an AI-generated art NFT platform, custodying the minted NFTs and their associated prompt data. It maintains a record of each minted NFT's unique identifier, its creator, its current owner, the prompt text used for generation, and a reference to the off-chain image data. Callers can mint a new NFT by providing a prompt, transfer ownership of an NFT they own, and retrieve the prompt associated with any NFT. The designated platform operator can set the minting fee and pause all minting activity. A minting fee of 0.01 ether is applied to each new NFT creation, and the maximum length for a prompt is 256 characters. The contract announces when a new NFT has been minted, when an NFT's ownership has changed, and when the minting fee has been updated.
source_description: NFPrompt is the first Prompt Artist Platform in Web3, which lets you mint your imagination into an AI-Generated NFT. Collectors and enthusiasts can buy/sell the NFT together with the prompt that was used to generate the image.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Propbase and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractionalized ownership of real estate assets, holding wrapped tokens representing underlying property deeds. It maintains a registry of each property's total token supply, the current owner of each fraction, and a configuration for each property including its unique identifier and associated fees. Callers can purchase fractions of properties, transfer their owned fractions to other accounts, and redeem fractions for the underlying wrapped deed tokens once a property is fully acquired. A designated operator can register new properties, set their initial token supply, and update property-specific fees. Property registration requires a minimum initial token supply of 1000 units. A 0.5% fee is applied to all fraction transfers, payable in the property's native token. The contract announces when new properties are registered, when fractions are purchased, and when fractions are transferred.
source_description: Propbase is an Aptos-based real-world asset (RWA) protocol that fractionalizes real estate ownership using Move smart contracts and DAO-LLC structures—enabling trustless, tokenized investment in regulated property assets with transparent yield, global standardization, deep liquidity, and modular DeFi integration

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on zkBob and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables private transfers of a stablecoin, holding user deposits in a shielded pool. It maintains individual account balances as encrypted notes, a global Merkle tree of nullifiers to prevent double-spending, and a configuration for fees and deposit limits. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw stablecoins to a specified recipient, and transfer stablecoins privately between accounts within the pool. Only a designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and nullifier set, and only the owner can adjust the deposit limit or the withdrawal fee. The maximum single deposit is 10,000 stablecoins, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the Merkle tree root is updated.
source_description: A stablecoin-based zkprotocol designed for simplicity, privacy and utility.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Degen Express and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates permissionless token launches, holding newly minted tokens and deposited base currency. It maintains a record of each launch's configuration, including its token address, launch start time, and collected base currency, alongside individual user contributions to each launch. Callers can create a new launch by depositing a specified amount of the new token and setting launch parameters, contribute base currency to an ongoing launch, and claim their proportional share of the new tokens and any unspent base currency once a launch concludes. A designated operator can pause all contributions to launches in an emergency. Each launch must have a minimum of 100 base currency contributed to be considered successful, otherwise all contributions are refunded. A 2% fee on all base currency contributions is automatically directed to a treasury address. The contract announces the creation of new launches, individual contributions, and the finalization of each launch, including its success status and total collected base currency.
source_description: Degen Express is the place where memecoins are born, and degens are made. At its core, Degen Express is a permissionless decentralized fair launch platform. It provides a haven for nascent tokens and creators to get their footing in the DeFi world, while being a one-stop shop for degens looking to get in on projects at the earliest, pre-launch stage

description: Design a lending protocol based on NAVI Lending and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an overcollateralized lending and borrowing platform, holding deposited digital assets as collateral and borrowed digital assets. It maintains records of each user's deposited collateral, active loans, and accrued interest, as well as global pools for each supported asset and system-wide configuration parameters. Callers can deposit assets, borrow assets against their collateral, repay loans, withdraw collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated owner can add new supported assets, adjust interest rates, and update oracle addresses. A user's total borrowed value cannot exceed 80% of their total collateral value, and a liquidation penalty of 5% is applied to the liquidated amount. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and liquidations, including the user's address, asset type, and amount.
source_description: NAVI offers over collateralized lending/borrowing for SUI, USDC, USDT, wETH and wBTC and supports features like isolated pool, flash loan and soon to come crosschain lending/borrowing.

description: Outline a payments contract based on Tria Card and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user-controlled payment accounts, holding deposited stablecoins and other approved tokens. It maintains individual account balances for each user, a global registry of approved tokens, and a system-wide fee configuration. Callers can deposit tokens into their account, withdraw tokens up to their available balance, transfer tokens to another account, and initiate payments to external addresses. Only a designated operator can approve new tokens for deposit, set the transfer fee, or pause all transfers. A transfer fee of 0.1% is applied to all outgoing transfers, and a maximum of 10 approved tokens can be registered at any time. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and transfers, including the sender, recipient, token, and amount.
source_description: Self-custodial neobank unifying spend, trade, and earn.

description: Design a token contract based on Etherberry Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking derivative vault, holding staked Ethereum and issuing a yield-bearing receipt token. It maintains individual balances of the receipt token for each user, a total supply of the receipt token, and a record of the total staked Ethereum held. Callers can deposit Ethereum to receive receipt tokens, withdraw staked Ethereum by burning receipt tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can initiate staking of deposited Ethereum and unstaking of previously staked Ethereum. The maximum total supply of receipt tokens is 1,000,000,000. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals of staked Ethereum. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events, each including the user's address and the amount of tokens involved.
source_description: Etherberry, an organic DeFi farm, is committed to improve Ethereum staking experience by enabling seamless swaps of staked Ethereum across different protocols. By planting your Ether with us, you can effortlessly earn and harvest $BERRY in addition to your staking rewards, all while contributing value to the Ethereum/Arbitrum ecosystem.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Kinetiq Earn and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating vault for two distinct tokens, let's call them Token A and Token B, and custodies user deposits of both. It maintains individual balances for each user's deposited Token A and Token B, a total supply of a receipt token representing shares in the vault, and a configuration for the underlying yield strategy. Users can deposit Token A or Token B, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accrued yield. An owner can set the deposit fee, which is capped at 5%, and update the address of the external yield strategy. Only a designated operator can pause and unpause deposits and withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the user's address, the amount, and the token type.
source_description: Kinetiq Earn puts your HYPE and kHYPE to work across leading DeFi protocols on HyperEVM, optimizing for the best risk-adjusted returns. Powered by Veda.

description: Specify a token contract based on Nested and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages investment strategies as non-fungible tokens, holding various crypto assets including fungible tokens and other non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record for each strategy NFT, detailing its asset composition, current value, and associated royalty fee, along with a global registry of all created strategies. Callers can create new strategies, deposit assets into an existing strategy, withdraw assets from a strategy they own, copy an existing strategy to create a new one under their ownership, and claim royalty payments from copies of their strategies. A designated owner can set the global base royalty fee, pause all strategy creation, and update the address of the external price oracle. Each strategy NFT has a unique identifier, and the platform charges a 0.5% fee on all strategy copy operations, distributed as royalties. The contract emits an event whenever a new strategy is created, assets are deposited or withdrawn, or a royalty payment is claimed.
source_description: Nested is the ideal place for your crypto journey to start 🧩 On Nested, you can build, share, and copy strategies. Earn 50% of the platform’s fees every time someone copies your strategy - our royalties scheme will become your favorite passive income! When you create or copy a strategy, your NFT comes to life and represents it - called a NestedNFT. It's your time to make your mark and appear on the top of our leaderboard!

description: Outline a token contract based on Elyx Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized investment fund, holding deposited principal tokens and distributing earned yield. It maintains individual balances for each investor, a total fund value, and a record of active investment strategies. Investors can deposit principal tokens, withdraw their share of the fund, and claim earned yield. A designated fund manager can approve new investment strategies and rebalance assets across existing strategies. A 0.5% management fee is deducted annually from the total fund value, and withdrawals are subject to a 7-day delay after a request is initiated. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, yield claims, and changes to approved investment strategies.
source_description: Elyx is a decentralized fund management platform

description: Model a token locking contract based on Kerberus and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a registry of security policies for user accounts, holding no custodial assets itself. It maintains a record for each registered account, storing its assigned policy identifier and an optional expiration timestamp. Callers can register their own account, update their account's policy, or remove their account's registration. A designated operator can register or update policies for any account, and can also define new policy identifiers with their associated parameters. The contract imposes a registration fee of 0.01 ether, payable upon initial account registration. Each policy update for an existing account incurs a delay of 24 hours before becoming active. The contract emits an event whenever an account's policy is registered, updated, or removed, and when a new policy definition is added.
source_description: Web3 security extension

description: Model a payments contract based on Karta Card and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages asset-backed credit lines, holding collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual credit line records for each user, including their collateral balance, outstanding debt, and approved credit limit. Users can deposit collateral, draw funds up to their credit limit, and repay their outstanding debt. A designated operator can adjust individual credit limits and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The contract enforces a minimum collateralization ratio of 150% for all active credit lines and a maximum credit limit of 100,000 stablecoins per user. It emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, credit limit changes, and liquidations.
source_description: Karta is a premium US charge card for global users, offering globally recognized card access backed by asset-based credit lines.

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Hyperbeat Earn and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-optimizing vault for a single designated base asset, holding deposited tokens and their corresponding yield-bearing derivatives. It maintains a total balance of the base asset, a record of each user's deposited share, and a configuration of approved external yield strategies. Callers can deposit the base asset into the vault, withdraw their share of the vault's assets, and claim any accrued rewards. A designated strategist can allocate deposited assets to approved yield strategies and rebalance positions between them. The owner can set the deposit fee, which is capped at 0.5%, and add or remove approved yield strategies. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the user's address and the amount of tokens. A minimum deposit amount of 100 base asset units is enforced.
source_description: Automated vaults that optimize your returns from top DeFi protocols with just one click

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on PumpBTC and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid restaking solution for a Bitcoin staking protocol, holding staked Bitcoin deposits and issuing a yield-bearing receipt token. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total amount of Bitcoin staked, and a configurable staking reward rate. Callers can deposit Bitcoin to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their staked Bitcoin and accumulated rewards by burning receipt tokens, and transfer receipt tokens to other accounts. Only a designated operator can update the staking reward rate and initiate a rebase operation to distribute accumulated rewards to receipt token holders. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.001 Bitcoin and charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on the total amount withdrawn. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and rebase operation, detailing the affected account and amounts.
source_description: PumpBTC serves as a Liquid Restaking Solution for Babylon. PumpBTC aims to help BTC holders maximize yields through Babylon's liquid staking - essentially rebuilding WBTC with native yield

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on XUSD Money and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a partially collateralized stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a volatile collateral asset and minting a stablecoin token. It maintains individual stablecoin balances for each account, tracks the total supply of the stablecoin, and records the current collateral ratio. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target collateral ratio, initiate a system-wide rebase operation, and pause or unpause minting and redeeming. The minimum collateral ratio is 10%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract emits events for stablecoin mints, redemptions, transfers, and collateral ratio updates.
source_description: Fairly launched partial-collateralized stablecoin.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Rysk V12 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a covered call options vault, holding deposited base assets and selling options against them to generate yield. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base assets, their share of the vault's total assets, and the current configuration parameters for option selling. Callers can deposit base assets, withdraw their share of base assets, and exercise options they hold. A designated operator can initiate new option sales, settle expired options, and adjust the vault's risk parameters. The vault imposes a 0.1% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals, and options can only be sold with an expiry date no more than 30 days in the future. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, option sales, and option settlements to observers.
source_description: Rysk V12 introduces a new way to earn high, sustainable yield on ETH, BTC, and any volatile asset in DeFi. DeFi’s biggest gap has been obvious: scalable, efficient returns on its core assets. These assets are held by everyone, yet their yields remain low and unsustainable. Rysk fixes this by reimagining covered calls, a proven strategy from traditional finance, and making it work for DeFi.

description: Create an NFT contract based on FarmCats Market and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace for non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and custodies listed NFTs and sale proceeds. It maintains a record of listed NFTs with their prices, the seller, and the associated collection, along with a configurable fee recipient and a fee percentage. Callers can list an NFT for sale, buy a listed NFT, or delist an NFT they previously listed. Only the contract owner can set the fee recipient and adjust the marketplace fee. The marketplace fee is fixed at 1% of the sale price and is paid in a designated stablecoin. The contract will emit an event when an NFT is listed, when an NFT is sold, and when an NFT is delisted, including the NFT identifier, seller, buyer (if sold), and price.
source_description: NFT marketplace on Tempo blockchain supporting multiple collections. 1% fee on every sale paid in pathUSD.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Bitbond Sales and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates token sales for new projects, holding the project's native tokens and collected stablecoins in escrow. It maintains a record of each participant's stablecoin contributions and the corresponding token allocation, along with the overall sale configuration including start and end times, and the token price. Callers can contribute stablecoins to the sale, claim their allocated tokens after the sale concludes, and withdraw their stablecoins if the sale fails to meet its minimum target. The project owner is privileged and can set the sale parameters, start and end the sale, and withdraw collected stablecoins and unsold tokens. The minimum contribution per participant is 100 stablecoins, and the maximum contribution is 10,000 stablecoins. The contract announces when a contribution is made, when tokens are claimed, and when the sale status changes.
source_description: Launch your crowdsale in a few clicks - no coding required

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on CHATEAU and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for institutional-grade tokenized assets, holding wrapped representations of real-world assets. It maintains individual balances for each user's deposited assets and a global record of total assets under management, along with configurable operational parameters. Callers can deposit supported tokenized assets, withdraw their deposited assets, and redeem their assets for the underlying real-world equivalent through an off-chain process. A designated operator can add new supported asset types, set the redemption fee, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The owner can upgrade the contract logic and transfer ownership. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed value. A user must hold a minimum of 100 units of a tokenized asset to initiate a redemption. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and redemption requests to observers.
source_description: Chateau is a DeFi protocol built to democratize access to institutional assets and private markets through stable-value assets and blockchain-native investment vehicles.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Rising Undead and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the minting and ownership of unique in-game land parcels, holding no custodial assets itself. It maintains a record of each land parcel's unique identifier, its current owner, and its specific coordinates within the game world. Callers can mint new land parcels, transfer ownership of a parcel they own to another account, and query the owner of any specific parcel. Only a designated operator can mint new land parcels, and they are limited to minting a maximum of 100 parcels per day. The contract announces when a new land parcel has been minted and when a land parcel's ownership has been successfully transferred.
source_description: Rising Undead is a real-time war strategy game that takes place in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies

description: Model a lending protocol based on Tectonic and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for a single specified digital asset, holding user deposits and originated loans. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, borrowed amount, and accumulated interest for both, alongside a global pool liquidity balance and configuration parameters for interest rates. Callers can deposit assets into the pool, withdraw their deposited assets, borrow assets against their collateral, repay their outstanding loans, and liquidate undercollateralized loans of other users. A designated administrator can adjust interest rate model parameters, pause borrowing, and upgrade the contract implementation. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75% of the collateral's value, and a 0.05% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator's reward. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, withdrawal events, and liquidation events, including the affected user, asset amount, and current pool state.
source_description: Tectonic is a cross-chain money market for earning passive yield and accessing instant backed loans

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Ethena USDe and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic dollar protocol, holding collateral tokens in a vault to back the value of a stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances for the synthetic dollar, the total supply of the synthetic dollar, and a global configuration for collateral types and their associated parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral to mint synthetic dollars, redeem synthetic dollars for collateral, and transfer synthetic dollars between accounts. A designated operator can add or remove approved collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and pause or unpause minting and redemption. The minimum collateralization ratio for any approved collateral type is 100%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all redemption operations, payable in the redeemed collateral. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol built on Ethereum

description: Design a governance contract based on Rootstock Collective and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a community treasury for ecosystem development, holding a native blockchain asset. It maintains a record of proposals, including their status, associated funding requests, and the votes cast for each. Callers can submit new proposals, vote on active proposals, and claim approved funds. A designated administrator can approve or reject proposals, and set the minimum voting threshold. Proposals require a minimum of 100 votes to be considered valid, and approved funds must be claimed within 30 days of approval. The contract emits an event when a new proposal is submitted and when a proposal's status changes.
source_description: RootstockCollective is a DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization) designed to develop the Rootstock ecosystem by empowering and rewarding builders and users of Rootstock, and RIF token holders

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on Bounce Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token launches through a fixed-price auction mechanism, holding deposited tokens for sale and collected stablecoins from successful bids. It maintains a record of each auction pool's configuration, including the token being sold, its quantity, the fixed price, and the stablecoin accepted, along with the current state of bids for each pool. Callers can create new auction pools, deposit tokens into an existing pool for sale, place bids for tokens in an active pool, and claim purchased tokens or retrieve unsold tokens and stablecoin refunds after an auction concludes. A designated owner can set a platform fee percentage, pause and unpause the contract, and withdraw accumulated platform fees. Each auction pool has a maximum duration of 7 days, and the platform fee is fixed at 1% of all successful bids. The contract announces when a new auction pool is created, when a bid is successfully placed, and when an auction concludes.
source_description: From customized auction pools to seamless on-chain settlements, Bounce Finance provides the tools you need to unleash the full potential of decentralized auctions.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on FlareBank and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding collateral in a designated reserve pool. It maintains individual user collateral balances, outstanding stablecoin debt, and global system parameters like the collateralization ratio and stability fee. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoins, and withdraw collateral. A designated operator can adjust the stability fee and the minimum collateralization ratio. The minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and the stability fee is 0.5% per year, applied continuously. The contract announces events for collateral deposits, stablecoin minting, repayments, and collateral withdrawals.
source_description: FlareBank is a dApp built on the Flare Network, designed to create a dividend-driven ecosystem centered around its native token, $BANK

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on SparkDEX V4 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token swaps and liquidity provision, holding deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains records for each liquidity pool, including token reserves and swap fees, and tracks individual liquidity provider positions, recording their deposited amounts and earned fees. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove their liquidity, and swap tokens between supported pairs. A designated operator can create new token pairs and adjust the swap fee percentage for any pool. The maximum swap fee percentage is 0.3%, and new pools must be initialized with at least 100 units of each token. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the affected pool, amounts, and involved addresses.
source_description: First AI-driven DeFi ecosystem on Flare Network.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on AUTOfinance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield optimizer that custodies various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users into strategy vaults. It maintains records of each user's deposited amount per vault, the total assets under management for each vault, and configuration parameters for each integrated yield strategy. Callers can deposit tokens into a chosen vault, withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued yield, and claim any available rewards. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, update strategy parameters, and initiate rebalancing operations across strategies. The maximum number of integrated yield strategies per vault is limited to 5. A 0.5% performance fee is applied to all yield generated before distribution to users. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and rebalancing operations.
source_description: AUTOfinance maximizes returns through Autopools by autonomously routing liquidity across integrated DeFi destinations while preserving composability.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on SX Bet and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits and payouts for various event outcomes. It maintains records of each user's deposited funds, their active predictions including the event, chosen outcome, and staked amount, and a global pool of all funds awaiting distribution. Callers can deposit funds into their account, place predictions on open events, withdraw their available balance, and claim winnings after an event concludes. A designated operator is privileged to create new prediction events, set their outcomes, and resolve them, and can also adjust the contract's fee percentage. A maximum of 100 predictions can be active for any single event, and a 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts. The contract announces when new events are created, when predictions are placed, and when events are resolved.
source_description: Web3 sports betting platform

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on MatrixDock XAUM and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues a digital token representing ownership of physical gold held in secure vaults. It maintains a record of each account's token balance and the total supply of tokens, along with a configurable fee percentage for transfers. Callers can transfer tokens to other accounts, and a designated operator can mint new tokens or burn existing ones. Only the owner can set the transfer fee percentage or designate a new operator. The transfer fee is fixed at 0.1% of the transferred amount, and the maximum total supply of tokens is capped at 1,000,000 units. The contract announces all token transfers, minting events, and burning events to observers.
source_description: Launched in 2024, XAUm is a digital gold token issued by Matrixdock. XAUm provides investors with a secure and efficient way to own and trade gold digitally, with each token representing one fine troy ounce of LBMA-certified physical gold securely stored in vaults.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Lorenzo sUSD1+ and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting and redemption facility, custodying deposited stablecoins. It maintains each user's balance of the minted stablecoin, the total supply of the stablecoin, and the current exchange rate between the deposited stablecoins and the minted stablecoin. Callers can deposit approved stablecoins to mint new stablecoins, and redeem minted stablecoins for an equivalent value of deposited stablecoins. A designated operator can add new stablecoins to the list of approved deposit tokens and update the exchange rate. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on all minting operations. The minimum deposit amount for any stablecoin is 100 units. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and exchange rate updates as events.
source_description: sUSD1+ is a value-accruing yield-generating stablecoin developed by Lorenzo Labs. Users can mint sUSD1+ by depositing major stablecoins such as USD1, USDT, or USDC

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Linea Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain message passing between two distinct blockchain environments, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a record of sent messages, including their unique identifiers, the originating chain, the destination chain, the sender on the originating chain, and the recipient on the destination chain. Callers can initiate a message transfer, claim a received message on the destination chain, and prove the existence of a message on the originating chain. A designated relayer is privileged to finalize message claims on the destination chain. Message transfers are subject to a minimum gas limit of 100,000 units on the destination chain, and messages must be claimed within 7 days of their proven existence. The contract announces the initiation of a new message transfer and the successful finalization of a message claim.
source_description: The main bridge, on a technical level, in Linea is the Canonical Message Bridge. This is the underlying set of smart contracts which keep track of receiving requests to move tokens to the other layer, and of sending the message that those tokens should be transferred.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Byreal and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for real-world asset tokens, facilitating their trading and providing liquidity. It maintains records of token balances for each user, a global trading fee percentage, and a list of supported asset token addresses. Callers can deposit supported asset tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and swap one supported asset token for another. The owner can update the global trading fee percentage and add new supported asset token addresses. The global trading fee is fixed at 0.25% of the swapped amount, and a maximum of 100 supported asset tokens can be registered. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and swaps, including the asset tokens involved and the quantities.
source_description: Byreal is the ultimate liquidity layer built for real assets, delivering unmatched liquidity for users. It integrates DEX, Launch, and Vault into a unified smart routing architecture, forming a full-cycle growth engine that supports asset discovery, trading, and yield generation on Solana

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Nexus BTC and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a Bitcoin-backed token bridge that custodies native Bitcoin on a separate blockchain and issues an equivalent amount of wrapped tokens on this chain. It maintains a total supply of wrapped tokens, a mapping of user balances, and a record of all pending withdrawal requests including the recipient address and amount. Callers can deposit native Bitcoin to mint wrapped tokens, transfer wrapped tokens to other users, and burn wrapped tokens to initiate a withdrawal of native Bitcoin. Only a designated operator can approve and process withdrawal requests, which involves sending the native Bitcoin and reducing the wrapped token supply. The maximum amount of wrapped tokens that can be minted in a single transaction is 100 wrapped tokens. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawal requests. The contract announces when tokens are minted, transferred, or burned, and when a withdrawal request is approved.
source_description: NexusBTC is a wrapped Bitcoin token designed to facilitate cross-chain transactions within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Avalon Superearn and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a principal-protected yield-generating vault, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing earned yield. It maintains individual deposit records for each user, tracking their principal and accumulated earnings, alongside a global pool of all deposited assets and a configuration for the current yield rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their principal and earned yield, and claim only their earned yield. A designated operator can update the yield rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. Deposits must be at least 100 stablecoins, and withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the yield rate is updated.
source_description: Earn yield with real-time APY.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on MemeJob and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of new, instantly tradable tokens for a fixed cost, custodying the base currency paid for token creation and the newly minted tokens until claimed. It maintains a record of each created token's unique identifier, its creator, the total supply, and whether it has been claimed. Callers can create a new token, claim their created token, and transfer ownership of an unclaimed token. Only the owner can set the token creation fee and withdraw accumulated base currency. Each token creation costs exactly one unit of the base currency, and a maximum of 10,000 tokens can be created in total by the contract. The contract announces when a new token is created and when a token is claimed.
source_description: Launch instantly tradeable coins for 1$,A pump fun of a different breed, Built on HBAR

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Adrena Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral in stablecoins. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, modify existing positions, and withdraw available margin. A designated operator can adjust global risk parameters, pause trading, and initiate liquidations for undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed is 100x, and the liquidation fee is a flat 0.5% of the position's notional value. The contract announces all position openings, closures, liquidations, and significant parameter changes.
source_description: Solana Perps DEX. 100x Leverage. 0% Slippage. 100% Rev Share. Open Source. Community Owned.

description: Model a staking contract based on JagPool Staked SOL and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to deposit their native blockchain tokens to receive an equivalent amount of liquid staking tokens, which represent a claim on the staked assets and their accumulated rewards. It maintains a global total of deposited native tokens, a global total of minted liquid staking tokens, and a per-user balance of liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit native tokens, withdraw their native tokens by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim staking rewards. Only a designated operator can update the staking reward rate and initiate a rebase operation to distribute rewards to liquid staking token holders. The minimum deposit amount is 0.1 native tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, paid in native tokens. The contract announces a Deposit event and a Withdrawal event, each containing the user's address and the amount of tokens involved.
source_description: JagPool Staked SOL is a liquid staking protocol on Solana that allows users to stake their SOL and earn rewards.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Vesper and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding deposited principal and accrued yield. It maintains a total supply of vault shares, the total principal deposited, and each user's share balance. Callers can deposit tokens to receive vault shares, withdraw their principal and accrued yield by burning shares, and redeem all their shares for tokens. The owner can set the yield strategy and update the fee percentage. The vault charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on the total amount withdrawn. The minimum deposit amount is 100 of the underlying ERC-20 token. The contract announces deposit events including the depositor's address and the amount deposited, and withdrawal events including the withdrawer's address and the amount withdrawn.
source_description: Vesper is a platform for easy-to-use DeFi products.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on PredPred and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users can bet on the outcome of future events, holding a reserve of a base currency to back all outstanding predictions. It maintains individual user balances for each prediction outcome, a global pool of the base currency for each market, and configuration parameters for each market including its resolution status and outcome probabilities. Callers can create new prediction markets, place bets on specific outcomes, claim winnings after a market resolves, and redeem their unspent base currency. A designated operator can resolve a prediction market by declaring the winning outcome and can adjust the fee percentage for new markets. Each prediction market will have a maximum of two possible outcomes, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from all winning payouts. The contract will emit an event whenever a new market is created, a bet is placed, or a market is resolved.
source_description: PredP.red is the first unlimited liquidity Prediction Market with bonding curve, powered by SeiNetwork.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Snake Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a two-token algorithmic stablecoin system, holding reserves of a volatile base token and minting/burning a stable token pegged to a fiat currency. It maintains a global supply of the stable token, a global reserve balance of the base token, and a per-account record of each user's stable token balance. Callers can mint stable tokens by depositing base tokens, burn stable tokens to redeem base tokens, and transfer stable tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the base token collateral ratio and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The initial base token collateral ratio is 1000 base tokens per 1 stable token. A 0.5% fee is applied to all stable token minting operations, deducted from the base token deposit. The contract announces stable token minting events, stable token burning events, and stable token transfers.
source_description: Snake Finance, an Algorithmic Stablecoin where 1 $SNAKE is equivalent to 1 $S. Algorithmic stablecoins are non-collateralized tokens designed to follow the price of their pegged asset, offering greater capital efficiency than traditional collateralized stablecoins

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Scrub Invest and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating investment pool, holding deposited tokens from users. It maintains individual user balances, the total pool balance, and a configurable investment strategy identifier. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued yield, and claim rewards from successful investment cycles. Only the owner can update the investment strategy, adjust the withdrawal fee, or pause deposits. A withdrawal fee of 0.5% is applied to all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 base units of the accepted token is enforced. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and strategy update.
source_description: Scrub Invest allows investors to leverage the power of the Scrub Invest Smart Contracts in order to earn passive income from their crypto assets. Powered by Scrub Money and currently available on Kava EVM Blockchain, with many more to come. Join Scrub Invest today and experience a whole new, effortless way of investing!

description: Model a staking contract based on stHYPE and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing a liquid staking token representing a claim on these assets plus accrued yield. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a total amount of base assets deposited, and for each user, their balance of liquid staking tokens and their share of the total base assets. Callers can deposit base assets to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their share of base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards that have been distributed. The owner can set the staking reward rate, pause deposits, and upgrade the contract logic. There is a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit amount of 0.01 base assets is required.
