The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events, including the amounts involved and the participants.
source_description: The Hyperliquid liquid staking platform.

description: Model a lending protocol based on Curve LlamaLend and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes an isolated lending market for a specific collateral token, holding deposited collateral and borrowed stablecoins. It maintains per-account records of collateral deposited, stablecoins borrowed, and market-wide configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay borrowed stablecoins, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated market creator is privileged to set initial market parameters and adjust certain risk parameters within predefined bounds. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to partially liquidated positions. The contract announces all deposit, borrow, repay, and liquidation events, including the affected addresses and amounts.
source_description: Curve's isolated lending market infrastructure enables users to borrow or lend using stablecoin $crvUSD along with permissionless markets created from crypto-tokenized collaterals, where markets may be created permissionlessly. Positions are managed passively: if the collateral's price decreases, the system automatically sells off collateral in a ‘soft liquidation mode’. If the collateral's price increases, the system recovers the collateral.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Reservoir Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for a stablecoin, holding deposited stablecoins and managing loans against them. It maintains individual loan positions for each borrower, tracking their collateral, borrowed amount, and accrued interest, alongside a global pool balance and configuration parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins to earn yield, borrow stablecoins against approved collateral, repay their loans, or withdraw their deposited stablecoins. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and approve new collateral types. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new loans, deducted from the borrowed amount. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, borrow, or repayment occurs, including the affected address and amounts.
source_description: Reservoir is a pioneering stablecoin protocol designed to be the most trusted and scalable solution in decentralized finance. Offering a suite of products, including the rUSD stablecoin, srUSD liquid yielding asset, and trUSD term-based yielding asset, Reservoir is at the forefront of DeFi innovation. With a focus on real-world asset integration and consistent yield generation, Reservoir is poised to play a crucial role in onboarding the next trillion dollars of assets into the decentralized economy.

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on SaharaDAO and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a fractional-algorithmic synthetic token pegged to the value of one unit of a base asset and one unit of a stablecoin, holding reserves of both assets. It maintains a total supply of the synthetic token, the current reserve ratio, and individual balances for each synthetic token holder. Callers can mint new synthetic tokens by depositing the base asset and stablecoin, burn synthetic tokens to redeem the underlying assets, and transfer synthetic tokens between accounts. A designated operator can adjust the target reserve ratio within a range of 10% to 100% and pause minting or burning in emergencies. The contract enforces a minimum minting amount of 10 synthetic tokens and charges a 0.5% fee on all burning operations, deducted from the redeemed assets. The contract emits events for all minting, burning, and transfer actions, including the amounts involved and the addresses of the participants.
source_description: Fractional-Algorithmic Synthetic Token pegged to the value of 1 MMF & 1 MUSD on Cronos Chain.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Proxy and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized staking mechanism for a governance token, holding deposited governance tokens and distributing rewards in a wrapped Bitcoin token. It tracks each staker's deposited amount of governance tokens, their accumulated rewards in wrapped Bitcoin, and their last interaction timestamp. Callers can deposit governance tokens, claim their accumulated wrapped Bitcoin rewards, and withdraw their staked governance tokens. A designated operator can adjust the reward rate for wrapped Bitcoin distribution, and only the owner can pause all staking operations. The minimum deposit amount for governance tokens is 100 units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all wrapped Bitcoin reward claims. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and reward claim, including the staker's address, the amount involved, and the current total staked balance.
source_description: Proxy Finance (PRXY) offers a Bitcoin Yield Strategies utilizing DeFi 2.0 including (3,3) Staking, (1,1) Bonding and (2,2) Programs for other assets. The Proxy Finance network consists of BTCpx token which is a BTC Wrapper as well as the PRXY Governance Token. Staking value of Proxy includes PRXY locked in the PRXY staking contract as well as PRXY staked in the farmProxy contract to earn BTCpx rewards

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on wTAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a bridge for a native asset, custodying the locked native tokens on a separate blockchain and issuing an ERC-20 representation on Ethereum. It maintains a total supply of the ERC-20 token, a mapping of Ethereum addresses to their ERC-20 balances, and a record of each bridge request's status and associated native chain transaction ID. Callers can deposit native tokens to mint an equivalent amount of ERC-20 tokens (mint action), or burn ERC-20 tokens to initiate a withdrawal of native tokens (redeem action). A designated operator is privileged to confirm native token deposits, enabling the minting of ERC-20 tokens, and to process native token withdrawals after ERC-20 burning. The maximum amount of ERC-20 tokens that can be minted in a single transaction is 10,000 units. A 0.5% fee is applied to all redemption requests, deducted from the burned ERC-20 amount. The contract announces successful minting events, successful redemption requests, and any changes to the designated operator.
source_description: Bridge that locks native TAO on Bittensor and mints an ERC-20 representation (wTAO) on Ethereum 1:1.

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on Blend Backstop and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes a pooled insurance fund to cover potential losses in a lending market, holding a single designated stablecoin. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total pooled capital amount, and a configuration for the maximum coverage ratio allowed for any single lending market. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the fund, withdraw their deposited stablecoins if no active claims are outstanding against their share, and stake their deposited stablecoins to earn a share of protocol fees. A designated operator can initiate a claim against the fund for a specific lending market, distribute protocol fees to stakers, and adjust the maximum coverage ratio. The maximum coverage ratio for any single lending market is capped at 20% of the total pooled capital. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals from the fund, which is then distributed to stakers. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, claims initiated, and fee distributions.
source_description: Insurance pool for lending markets created with Blend.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Scatter and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the launch of new digital collectible series, holding deposited funds from participants and the digital collectibles themselves before distribution. It maintains a record of each participant's committed funds for each launch, the total funds raised for each launch, and the configuration parameters for each launch. Callers can commit funds to an active launch, claim their allocated digital collectibles after a successful launch, and withdraw any unspent committed funds if a launch fails or is cancelled. The owner can initiate new digital collectible launches, set the parameters for each launch, cancel a launch, and withdraw collected launch fees. A launch must have a minimum funding goal of 100 base units of the accepted currency, and the platform fee for a successful launch is 5% of the total funds raised. The contract announces when a new launch is initiated, when funds are committed to a launch, when a launch succeeds or fails, and when digital collectibles are claimed.
source_description: An Artist-First NFT Launchpad

description: Design a payments contract based on Stablecoin for Impact and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits of stablecoins, directing a portion of the yield generated from those deposits to designated impact projects. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total amount allocated to each project, and a global configuration for yield distribution. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their principal, and designate a specific impact project to receive yield from their deposit. A designated administrator can add new impact projects, set the percentage of yield directed to projects, and update the administrator address. The yield percentage directed to projects must be between 1% and 100%, and new impact projects must be added at least 24 hours before they can receive yield. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and changes in project yield allocations.
source_description: Stablecoin for Impact (SFI) is a decentralized philanthropic platform that turns stablecoins into active capital for social good using Aave supply yield. SFI lets you deposit stablecoins into Aave lending markets and direct a percentage of the yield to fund social or environmental projects. Your capital remains intact throughout and you can withdraw the principal at any moment. Every project reports impact data so you can see exactly where the money goes

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Aster USDF and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for a yield-bearing stablecoin, which custodies an equivalent amount of a designated reserve stablecoin. It maintains individual balances for each stablecoin holder, a total supply of the yield-bearing stablecoin, and a configurable exchange rate for converting between the two stablecoins. Callers can deposit the reserve stablecoin to mint the yield-bearing stablecoin, redeem the yield-bearing stablecoin for the reserve stablecoin, and transfer their yield-bearing stablecoin balances to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the exchange rate and pause or unpause redemptions. The exchange rate for redemption is capped at 1.05 reserve stablecoins per yield-bearing stablecoin, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: USDF is a yield-bearing stablecoin issued by Aster, convertible with USDT at a 1:1 ratio. Underlying USDT funds are used to create and maintain delta neutral positions that back USDF and generate asUSDF yields

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on Boardwalk and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fair token launches by holding deposited funds and newly minted tokens in escrow, ensuring participants receive their allocation or a refund. It maintains records of each participant's deposited amount, their allocated token amount, and the current state of each launch event (e.g., open, closed, finalized). Callers can deposit funds into an open launch event, claim their allocated tokens after a successful launch, or withdraw their deposited funds if a launch fails. Only the owner can create new launch events, set the launch parameters, and finalize a successful launch, while a designated operator can pause and unpause deposits for a specific launch event. Each launch event has a minimum funding goal of 1000 units of the deposited currency, and a successful launch requires at least 80% of the target token supply to be sold. The contract announces when a new launch event is created, when funds are deposited, when tokens are claimed, and when a launch event is finalized or refunded.
source_description: Boardwalk is a permissionless, community-centered fee-protection protocol for launching, discovering, and participating in token economies.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Pinyottas and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract defines a non-fungible token that acts as a container for other fungible tokens, ensuring that the contained tokens transfer with the NFT. It maintains a mapping of each NFT's unique identifier to a list of fungible token addresses and their corresponding amounts, representing the contents of that specific NFT. Callers can mint new container NFTs, deposit fungible tokens into an NFT they own, withdraw fungible tokens from an NFT they own, and transfer ownership of an NFT to another address. A designated operator can set a maximum number of fungible token types that can be held within a single NFT, which is initially set to 5. The contract announces when an NFT is minted, when tokens are deposited into an NFT, when tokens are withdrawn from an NFT, and when an NFT's ownership is transferred. A 0.1% fee is applied to all token withdrawals, payable to the contract owner.
source_description: Pinyottas are NFTs that hold a collection of different fungible assets (a.k.a. ERC-20 tokens), so when a pinyotta is transferred to a new owner, the ERC-20 tokens move along with the pinyotta.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Meridian Predict and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market for real-world assets, holding user deposits in a stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances, open positions for each market, and general market configuration parameters. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit stablecoins, place bets on market outcomes, claim winnings, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can create new markets, and only the owner can adjust the stablecoin deposit fee. A market creation fee of 0.5% of the initial market liquidity is charged, and the maximum number of open markets at any time is capped at 100. The contract emits events for market creation, bet placement, and winner payouts.
source_description: RWA-focused perps and prediction markets with a full derivatives stack. Powered by Robinhood Chain.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Neverland and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for a single collateral asset and a single borrowable asset, holding deposited collateral and borrowed funds. It maintains per-user records of their deposited collateral, borrowed amount, and accumulated interest, along with a global pool balance for both assets and a configuration for interest rates. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay their loans, and withdraw their available collateral. The owner can set the interest rate model parameters and pause all borrowing operations. The maximum loan-to-value ratio is 75%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to seized collateral. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, borrow, repayment, or withdrawal occurs, detailing the user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Neverland is a next-generation, Monad-native lending protocol fusing the most secure, battle-tested lending technology with proprietary veTokenomics that allow users to direct 100% of protocol revenue. Featuring self-repaying loans, flexible and tradable governance locks, and automated yield strategies, each designed to maximize capital efficiency and long-term alignment

description: Model a token contract based on fan.tech and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token-based social network, custodying native tokens deposited by users to acquire "shares" in other users. It maintains per-user records of their total shares held, their share price, and the native token balance available for withdrawal. Callers can buy shares in another user, sell their own shares, and withdraw their available native token balance. Only a designated operator can set the initial share price for new users, which must be at least 0.001 native tokens. A 10% fee is applied to all share purchases and sales, with 5% going to the user whose shares are traded and 5% to a protocol treasury. The contract announces when shares are bought, when shares are sold, and when native tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Build a network, grow your networth. Fantech is redefining relationships in a hyperfinancialized world.

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Sanctum Reserve and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a reserve pool for a native asset, holding a quantity of the native asset and a quantity of a liquid staking derivative. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking derivative, a total quantity of the native asset available for withdrawal, and individual account balances for both the native asset and the liquid staking derivative. Callers can deposit native assets to receive liquid staking derivatives, and they can redeem liquid staking derivatives to receive native assets. A designated operator can add native assets to the pool and remove native assets from the pool. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on all native asset withdrawals. The minimum deposit amount for native assets is 0.05 units. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the operator.
source_description: The Reserve, also known as Sanctum Reserve Pool, is a pool of idle SOL that accepts staked SOL and gives SOL from its pool in return.

description: Define a privacy-preserving contract based on Ghost Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract implements a privacy-enhancing mixer, holding deposited tokens temporarily. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a set of nullifiers for spent deposits. Callers can deposit tokens to generate a commitment, withdraw tokens using a valid zero-knowledge proof and a nullifier, and verify the validity of a nullifier. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and add new supported token addresses. The maximum deposit amount for any single transaction is 1000 tokens. A 0.1% fee is charged on all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and Merkle tree root update, including relevant proof data and amounts.
source_description: Privacy mixer on Monad using zero-knowledge proofs.

description: Design a staking contract based on Puffer Stake and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates liquid restaking, holding deposited liquid staking tokens and issuing a yield-bearing receipt token in return. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, the balance of receipt tokens for each user, and a mapping of deposited liquid staking tokens to their corresponding receipt token value based on an exchange rate. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens to receive receipt tokens, and redeem receipt tokens for the underlying liquid staking tokens. A designated operator can update the exchange rate between the liquid staking token and the receipt token, and can pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The exchange rate can only increase or remain stable, never decrease, and redemptions are subject to a 0.1% fee on the amount of liquid staking tokens withdrawn. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, when tokens are redeemed, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: Puffer operates as a decentralized native liquid restaking protocol native to its ecosystem. Prior to its mainnet launch, pufETH serves as a yield-generating token, mirroring the yield of wstETH, while also providing users the opportunity to accumulate both Puffer and EigenLayer points.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on DeepLock and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, designed to custody fungible tokens for a specified duration, preventing their transfer until the lock period expires. It maintains a record for each locked token deposit, tracking the amount, the depositor, the token's contract address, and the unlock timestamp. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, extend the duration of an existing lock, or withdraw their tokens once a lock has expired. A designated owner is privileged to set a deposit fee, which is a percentage of the deposited amount, and to withdraw collected fees. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.5% of the deposited token amount, and the minimum lock duration for any deposit is 24 hours. The contract announces to observers when a new lock is created, when an existing lock's duration is extended, and when tokens are successfully withdrawn.
source_description: DEEPL0CK is the ultimate one-stop platform to launch projects on the Binance Smart Chain in a safe way, and for keeping digital assets safe on #BSC.

description: Create a yield strategy contract based on Lulo and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending aggregator that custodies user-deposited tokens. It maintains per-user records of deposited amounts, chosen risk profiles, and current lending pool allocations, alongside a global registry of available lending pools and their associated yield strategies. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, adjust their risk profile, and claim rewards. A designated operator can add or remove lending pools from the registry and update their yield strategies. The contract imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all principal withdrawals, and users must wait at least 24 hours after a deposit before initiating a withdrawal. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes in a user's lending pool allocation.
source_description: Lulo is a decentralized lending aggregator, which automatically optimizes users deposits by migrating their deposits to the lending pool with the best yield, while allowing for personalized risk settings

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Origami Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages leveraged yield farming positions, holding user-deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains individual user positions, tracking their collateral, borrowed amounts, and accrued interest, alongside global configuration parameters for each supported asset pair. Callers can open new positions, add collateral to existing positions, withdraw excess collateral, repay borrowed amounts, and close positions. A designated operator can pause all user operations and update supported asset pair configurations, including interest rates and liquidation thresholds. New positions require a minimum initial collateral of 0.01 ether equivalent, and a 0.5% protocol fee is applied to all borrowed amounts. The contract emits events for all position openings, closures, and significant state changes like collateral additions or withdrawals.
source_description: Origami is a first-in-class automated leverage protocol launching on Ethereum and 🐻

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on Limitless Exchange and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market where users can bet on the outcome of future events, holding user deposits in a designated base currency. It maintains a record of open prediction markets, each with its own total staked amount for each outcome, and individual user positions detailing their stake and chosen outcome for each market. Callers can create a new prediction market, deposit funds into an existing market to back a specific outcome, and withdraw their winnings or remaining stake after a market resolves. A designated operator can resolve a prediction market by declaring the winning outcome and initiating payout calculations. A market creation fee of 0.01 base currency is charged for each new market, and the total number of open prediction markets is capped at 100. The contract announces market creation, user deposits, market resolution, and user withdrawals to external observers.
source_description: Prediction market on Base

description: Model a token contract based on Obyte Friends and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social referral game, holding a reserve of the native blockchain currency to reward participants. It tracks each participant's current balance, their referrer, and the number of referrals they have successfully made. Callers can register as a new participant, refer another new participant, and claim their accumulated rewards. The contract owner can set the daily reward rate and withdraw excess funds from the reserve. A participant can only register once, and a referral reward is issued only if the referred participant registers within 24 hours of the referral. The contract emits an event whenever a new participant registers, a referral is successfully made, or rewards are claimed.
source_description: Make 1% a day by making friends every day and spreading the word about Obyte’s unstoppable, censorship-resistant tech.

description: Design a governance contract based on Lombard Vaults and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault that custodies a liquid staked token representing Bitcoin and a wrapped Bitcoin token, allowing users to earn yield. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token, a total deposited amount for each token, and a configuration for approved yield strategies. Callers can deposit either of the accepted Bitcoin-backed tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens plus any accrued yield, and claim any available rewards. A designated operator can add or remove approved yield strategies, adjust strategy allocations, and initiate rebalancing of funds between strategies. The contract imposes a maximum deposit limit of 1000 units of either accepted token per user per 24-hour period, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to strategy allocations.
source_description: Lombard’s DeFi Vault is designed to bridge the gap between bitcoin and DeFi, by offering LBTC holders one-click access to DeFi yields without any of the complexities. It accepts LBTC, a liquid staked token representation of Bitcoin, as well WBTC and seeks to capture the highest risk-adjusted yields derived from multiple DeFi strategies.

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on cVault Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a deflationary yield-farming token, holding no external assets directly but controlling the supply and distribution of its own native token. It maintains a total supply of the native token, individual account balances, and a set of parameters for burning and reward distribution. Callers can transfer tokens, approve spending for other accounts, and participate in a burning mechanism by sending tokens to a designated burn address. A designated operator can adjust the burn rate, set the reward distribution schedule, and pause token transfers in emergencies. The initial total supply of the native token is 1,000,000 units, and each transfer incurs a 2% burn fee. The contract announces all token transfers, approvals, and changes to the burn rate.
source_description: First high yield farmable deflationary DeFi token.

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Huma Finance V2 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for real-world payment streams, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing them as loans. It maintains individual borrower credit scores, a global pool of available funds, and per-loan repayment schedules. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, request a loan against their credit score, repay an outstanding loan, and withdraw their available balance. Only the owner can adjust the maximum loan-to-value ratio or designate new credit score providers. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 80%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all loan originations. The contract announces loan originations, loan repayments, and credit score updates.
source_description: Permissionless DeFi yield, powered by real-world payment flows.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Apiary and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of a specific governance token, accumulating it through a liquidity provision mechanism. It maintains the total supply of a stablecoin, the collateral ratio for each stablecoin unit, and a record of each user's stablecoin balance. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing the governance token, burn stablecoins to redeem the governance token, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can adjust the stablecoin's target peg and pause minting or burning operations. The minimum collateral ratio for minting is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces all minting, burning, and transfer events, including the amount and the involved accounts.
source_description: Treasury-backed protocol designed to perpetually accumulate $BGT (Berachain Governance Token) through Berachain's Proof of Liquidity (PoL)

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Mountain Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a rebasing stablecoin, holding no assets itself but tracking balances that represent claims on an external reserve. It maintains a total supply and individual account balances, along with a current exchange rate between the stablecoin and the underlying reserve asset. Callers can mint new tokens by providing an equivalent amount of the underlying reserve asset, redeem tokens for the underlying reserve asset, and transfer tokens between accounts. A designated operator can update the exchange rate to reflect yield accrual in the underlying reserve, and can pause or unpause all minting and redemption operations. The exchange rate can only be updated once every 24 hours, and the maximum daily exchange rate increase is limited to 0.01% of the current rate. The contract announces when tokens are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: Mountain Protocol presents USDM—a cutting-edge, yield-bearing, rebasing stable coin. Rooted in the stability of Treasury Bills and enhanced by the promise of returns, USDM is more than just a crypto token—it's a gateway to trusted and compliant decentralized finance. With its fully regulated, permissionless design, engage with a crypto experience that combines the best of tradition, innovation, and security.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Grail.xyz and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for unique digital collectibles, holding deposited non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and the native currency used for purchases. It maintains individual balances of the native currency for each user, records of active listings including the listed NFT and its asking price, and a global fee percentage. Callers can list their NFTs for sale, purchase listed NFTs, and withdraw their native currency balance. The contract owner can adjust the global fee percentage and pause all marketplace activity. The listing fee is fixed at 0.5% of the sale price, and the maximum number of active listings per user is 20. The contract emits an event whenever an NFT is listed, purchased, or delisted, and when the fee percentage is updated.
source_description: A marketplace for discovering, collecting, and trading tokenized sports collectibles.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Sovryn Dex and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized exchange of tokens, holding deposited tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains records of each user's deposited balances, the current token reserves for each trading pair, and global configuration parameters like trading fees. Callers can deposit tokens into liquidity pools, withdraw their deposited tokens, swap one token for another, and provide or remove liquidity. A designated operator can adjust the trading fee percentage and add new tradable token pairs. The maximum trading fee is 0.5%, and all swaps incur a 0.1% fee that is distributed to liquidity providers. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and successful token swaps, including the amounts involved and the addresses of the participants.
source_description: Sovryn is a non-custodial and permission-less smart contract based system for bitcoin lending, borrowing and margin trading.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Altura and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin vault managing user deposits, which are then deployed into various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance and their share of the vault's total assets, along with a list of approved yield strategies and their allocated capital. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their stablecoins and accrued yield, and redeem their vault shares for the underlying stablecoins. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, remove existing strategies, and adjust the capital allocation to each strategy. The vault charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions. New strategies must be approved by a multi-signature wallet before being added, and the total capital allocated to all strategies cannot exceed 95% of the vault's total stablecoin holdings. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes in strategy allocations.
source_description: Altura is an on-chain capital management protocol offering a multi-strategy stablecoin vault on HyperEVM.

description: Model a payments contract based on RedotPay Card and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user balances for a prepaid crypto debit card system, holding various approved digital assets. It maintains individual user accounts, each tracking their deposited asset balances and an aggregated total of all assets held by the contract. Users can deposit approved digital assets into their accounts and initiate withdrawals of their available balance, which are then processed by an off-chain system. Only a designated operator can approve new digital assets for deposit and set the daily withdrawal limit for all users. The maximum daily withdrawal limit for any user is 1000 units of any approved asset, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces when a deposit is received and when a withdrawal request is initiated.
source_description: RedotPay is a crypto card issuer that allows you to pay for your purchases with crypto.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on NOME Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a synthetic stablecoin minting facility, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's deposited collateral, their minted stablecoin debt, and the current collateralization ratio for their position. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, and withdraw excess collateral. Only the owner can adjust the collateral token's oracle address, set the minimum collateralization ratio, or pause all minting and withdrawal operations. The minimum collateralization ratio for any position is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract emits an event whenever a position's collateralization ratio falls below a specified threshold or when a new stablecoin debt position is opened.
source_description: Synthetic algostable

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Ondo Yield Assets and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized representation of an investment in short-term U.S. government debt, holding no assets directly but representing claims on an external investment vehicle. It maintains a total supply of tokens, a balance for each token holder, and a redemption rate that reflects the underlying asset's value. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new tokens, redeem their tokens for stablecoins, and transfer tokens between accounts. A designated operator can update the redemption rate and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The redemption rate can only be updated once every 24 hours, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract emits events for all token transfers, minting of new tokens, redemptions, and changes to the redemption rate.
source_description: This share class provides liquid exposure to an ETF of short-term U.S. Treasuries

description: Design a staking contract based on Kelp and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid restaking protocol that custodies staked Ether and other liquid staking tokens. It maintains individual user deposit records, a total pool of staked assets, and a configuration for accepted staking tokens. Callers can deposit supported liquid staking tokens, claim rewards, and withdraw their original deposits along with accumulated rewards. The owner can set the fee percentage and add or remove supported liquid staking tokens. The maximum fee percentage is 5%, and a minimum of 0.01 Ether must be deposited per transaction. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events.
source_description: Kelp is the second largest liquid restaking protocol with ~$2B+ in TVL. Its liquid restaked token, rsETH, is live across 10+ major L2s and 40+ DeFi platforms, allowing users to restake while maintaining full liquidity.

description: Create a governance contract based on Veda and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized vault for yield-bearing assets, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited asset, a global total for each asset, and a configuration for each supported asset including its associated yield strategy. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accumulated yield. A designated operator can add new supported assets, update the yield strategy for an existing asset, and pause or unpause deposits for a specific asset. The contract enforces a maximum deposit fee of 0.5% and a minimum withdrawal delay of 24 hours for certain assets. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and yield claim, including the user's address, the asset, and the amount.
source_description: Veda is the leading DeFi vault platform, enabling crypto applications, asset issuers, and protocols to build consumer-grade cross chain yield products. Veda's technology is powering many of DeFi's largest vault products, including ether.fi Liquid, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Vault Street primeUSD and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a permissioned vault for institutional yield, holding a stablecoin representing US dollar value. It maintains individual account balances for deposited stablecoins and records of each user's accrued yield. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the vault, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, and transfer their vault shares to another permitted address. A designated operator can pause all deposits and withdrawals, and only the owner can update the list of permitted addresses. A minimum deposit of 1,000 stablecoins is enforced, and a 0.1% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or transfer of vault shares occurs, and when the permitted address list is updated.
source_description: Vault Street is on-chain distribution infrastructure for institutional yield. It packages real-world asset strategies into permissioned, investable products that allocators and integration partners can access directly

description: Design a derivatives contract based on SynFutures V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral tokens deposited by users to back their trading positions. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including their margin and leverage, and global market configurations for each trading pair. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, adjust position leverage, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can add new trading pairs, update oracle addresses for price feeds, and adjust trading parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all executed trades. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and liquidations, including the affected account, asset, and amount.
source_description: SynFutures is a leading decentralized protocol for perpetual futures, democratizing the derivatives market by empowering users to trade any asset and create arbitrary futures contracts within seconds. Its V3 oAMM introduces the industry's first-ever integration of a unified AMM and on-chain matching order book model.

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Railgun and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a privacy-preserving transaction system, holding deposited tokens in a shielded pool. It maintains a Merkle tree of nullifiers and commitments for each user, along with a global configuration for fees and parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens to a specified recipient, or transfer tokens privately between shielded accounts. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root and process batched transactions. The contract charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit amount of 0.001 ether is enforced. The contract emits an event for every successful deposit and withdrawal, including the amount and the recipient's public key hash.
source_description: RAILGUN secures privacy for DEX trading and lending. Built without any bridge or layer-2, RAILGUN is a smart contract system that gives zk-SNARK privacy to any transaction or smart contract interaction on Ethereum.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Opyn Convexity and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages European-style, cash-settled options that automatically exercise at expiration, holding the underlying collateral asset. It maintains per-option series records including strike price, expiration date, and collateral asset, and per-user records of minted options and deposited collateral. Callers can mint new options by depositing collateral, exercise options at or after expiration to receive the payout, and burn options to reclaim collateral before expiration. A designated operator can create new option series and settle exercised options by disbursing payouts. Each option series has a fixed strike price, and the collateral requirement for minting options is 100% of the strike value. The contract emits events upon option minting, exercise, and burning, and when new option series are created.
source_description: Opyn offers European, cash-settled options that auto-exercise upon expiry.

description: Specify a token contract based on Amun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an index token that represents a basket of other tokens, and it custodies the underlying constituent tokens. It maintains a list of constituent tokens and their target weights, the total supply of the index token, and each user's balance of the index token. Callers can mint new index tokens by depositing the required constituent tokens, redeem index tokens by burning them to receive the underlying constituents, and transfer their index tokens to other addresses. A designated operator can rebalance the index by adjusting the constituent tokens and their target weights, and can update the fee for minting or redeeming. The minting fee is fixed at 0.1% of the value of the minted tokens, and the redemption fee is fixed at 0.2% of the value of the redeemed tokens. The contract announces events for all minting, redeeming, and transferring actions, and for any changes to the constituent tokens or their weights.
source_description: Amun is a leading provider of index tokens across multiple blockchains, enabling token holders to gain broad exposures to different smart contract platforms and DeFi sectors. The indexes are rebalanced regularly, and token holders own fractions of the underlying constituents. Our index tokens can be redeemed by burning the token on our platform to receive the underlying tokens.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Meridian Perps and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures market, holding collateral tokens deposited by traders. It maintains individual account balances for collateral, open positions including long or short direction, entry price, and size for each market, and global market configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, partially adjust position size, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can update market parameters and initiate liquidations for undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing operations. The contract emits an event whenever a position is opened, closed, or liquidated, detailing the market, trader, and position parameters.
source_description: RWA-focused perps and prediction markets with a full derivatives stack. Powered by Robinhood Chain.

description: Outline a staking contract based on Solayer Restaking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing a liquid staking token representing staked value. It maintains individual user balances of the liquid staking token and tracks the total amount of base asset staked across all users. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw their proportional share of the base asset. A designated operator can adjust the staking rate, and only the owner can set the operator address. The minimum deposit amount is 0.01 units of the base asset, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits events for deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the operator address.
source_description: sSOL is the universal liquidity layer for delegates [dApps] and LRTs on Solayer. Every unit of SOL can be perceived as a unit of blockspace lent towards dApps, securing network bandwidth and TPS.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on AlphaFi Lending and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for a single fungible token, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains a global configuration for interest rates, a total supply of receipt tokens, and per-account records of deposited collateral and borrowed amounts. Callers can deposit tokens to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens by burning receipt tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rate parameters and pause or unpause borrowing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, borrow, repayment, and liquidation events, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: AlphaLend is a DeFi protocol on the Sui blockchain that enables permissionless lending and borrowing of digital assets. By depositing assets into the protocol, users can earn interest or use their holdings as collateral to access liquidity. Designed with security and composability in mind, AlphaLend provides essential financial primitives for building and interacting with decentralized applications.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Basenames and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a naming service that allows users to register and manage human-readable onchain names, holding no custodied assets. It maintains a mapping of registered names to wallet addresses, along with registration expiration dates and associated resolver addresses. Callers can register a new name, renew an existing name's registration, transfer ownership of a name, and set the resolver for a name. Only the owner of a name can transfer its ownership or set its resolver. New name registrations have a minimum length of 3 characters and a maximum length of 64 characters. The initial registration fee for any name is 0.005 ether per year. The contract announces name registrations, renewals, transfers, and resolver updates to observers.
source_description: Basenames is Base’s ENS-based naming service that lets users register human-readable onchain names for wallet addresses and use them across Base and other EVM apps

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Morpho Blue and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates permissionless, isolated lending markets, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains records for each market, including total collateral and total borrowed amounts, and for each user within a market, their individual collateral and borrowed balances. Callers can create new markets by specifying a collateral asset, a borrowable asset, an external price oracle, and an interest rate strategy; supply collateral to a market; borrow assets from a market against their supplied collateral; repay borrowed assets; and withdraw their collateral. A designated operator can pause all borrowing and lending operations across all markets. Each market must specify a liquidation threshold between 100% and 150% of the collateral value, and a maximum loan-to-value ratio of 80% of the collateral value. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, and when a user supplies, borrows, repays, or withdraws assets.
source_description: Morpho Blue is a trustless and efficient lending primitive with permissionless market creation

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on WisdomTree and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized fund representing fractional ownership of real-world assets, holding the underlying asset tokens in custody. It maintains a record of each investor's balance of fund tokens, the total supply of fund tokens, and the current net asset value per fund token. Callers can deposit approved stablecoins to mint new fund tokens, and they can redeem their fund tokens for the equivalent value in stablecoins. A designated operator can update the fund's asset holdings and the net asset value, and can pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces when new fund tokens are minted and when fund tokens are redeemed.
source_description: WisdomTree Connect is designed to offer seamless access to WisdomTree’s tokenized real world assets (RWA) for a range of investors and businesses. The WisdomTree Connect platform integrates the features of blockchain technology with the investment needs of both traditional and crypto-native financial institutions. By simplifying access to tokenized funds and digital assets, WisdomTree Connect paves the way for a new era in financial services

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on CreateMyToken and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and deployment of new fungible tokens on various blockchain networks, without custodying any tokens itself. It maintains a registry of deployed token contracts, recording the network, token address, and creator for each. Callers can initiate a token deployment by providing desired token parameters, and they can query the status of their deployments. A designated operator is privileged to approve or reject deployment requests and to set the deployment fee. A deployment fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each successful token creation, and a maximum of 10 tokens can be deployed per unique creator address within a 24-hour period. The contract announces the successful deployment of a new token, including its network and address, and the rejection of any deployment request.
source_description: Create your own token in just 1 minute and deploy it on Solana, Ethereum, Base, BNB Smart Chain and more! No code, no setup, no login, and free.

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Beefy and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator vault that custodies user-deposited tokens and automatically compounds their yield from an external farming strategy. It maintains individual user balances, total deposited amounts for each supported token, and configuration parameters for the active farming strategy. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their principal and accumulated yield, and claim any rewards distributed by the underlying strategy. Only a designated operator can update the farming strategy, adjust the performance fee, or pause deposits and withdrawals. A 10% performance fee is applied to all harvested yield, and the maximum number of supported tokens is limited to 5. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy updates to observers.
source_description: Beefy automates yield farming to make DeFi easy, safe and efficient for all. By autocompounding your tokens, Beefy unlocks higher returns so you earn more of what you love.

description: Create a token locking contract based on TrustSwap and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token vesting schedule, holding a specified amount of an ERC-20 token for distribution over time. It maintains individual vesting schedules for each recipient, including the total amount to vest, the start time, the duration, and the amount already released. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract to fund vesting schedules, create new vesting schedules for specific recipients, and claim their vested tokens. The contract owner can pause all vesting schedules, upgrade the contract logic, and set a universal vesting fee. A vesting schedule cannot be created for a duration less than 30 days, and the maximum vesting fee is 5% of the claimed amount. The contract announces when new vesting schedules are created, when tokens are claimed, and when the contract owner updates the vesting fee.
source_description: TrustSwap is building foundational layers in the rapidly-emerging decentralized finance landscape with services like SmartLocks, Mint, Launchpad, Swappable (NFT interface), Farming as a Service, and Vesting as a Service

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Vidya and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native token rewards, custodying deposited tokens for distribution. It maintains individual player balances, a global reward pool, and configurable reward rates. Callers can deposit tokens into the reward pool, claim their accumulated rewards, and register new game achievements. Only a designated operator can adjust the reward rate, which is capped at 100 tokens per achievement, and only the owner can pause all reward distributions. A 24-hour delay is enforced between a reward rate adjustment and its activation. The contract announces when a player claims rewards and when the reward rate changes.
source_description: Vidya is a GameFi project bridging the gap between cryptocurrency and traditional gaming.

description: Define a payments contract based on MonarchPay and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages recurring cryptocurrency payments for subscriptions, holding deposited funds in escrow until payment dates. It maintains records of active subscriptions, including their start dates, payment intervals, and the amount due per period, alongside a balance for each subscriber. Callers can subscribe to a service, cancel an existing subscription, or deposit funds to cover future payments. A designated operator can register new services, update service pricing, or withdraw accumulated service fees. The minimum subscription period is 7 days, and a 1% service fee is applied to each successful payment. The contract announces successful payments, subscription cancellations, and new service registrations.
source_description: Subscription payments with cryptocurrencies. Instant access to recurring payments from any non-custodial wallet. Currently available on Kava

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on SUBFROST and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized signing network's vault for issuing wrapped Bitcoin and wrapped USD, and it custodies the underlying Bitcoin and USD collateral. It maintains a global total of issued wrapped Bitcoin, a global total of issued wrapped USD, and for each user, their individual balances of wrapped Bitcoin and wrapped USD. Callers can deposit Bitcoin to mint wrapped Bitcoin, deposit USD to mint wrapped USD, redeem wrapped Bitcoin for Bitcoin, redeem wrapped USD for USD, and transfer their wrapped tokens to other users. A designated operator can pause all minting and redeeming operations, and only the owner can update the collateralization ratio for wrapped USD. The maximum amount of wrapped Bitcoin that can be minted is 21,000 units, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all redemption operations. The contract announces when wrapped Bitcoin is minted, when wrapped USD is minted, when wrapped Bitcoin is redeemed, when wrapped USD is redeemed, and when wrapped tokens are transferred.
source_description: SUBFROST is a decentralized signing network that issues frBTC and frUSD, trust-minimized assets which power the ultimate UX on Bitcoin L1. SUBFROST's portfolio of apps deliver this UX directly to end-users, and its API products enable developers to build the next generation of advanced crypto applications.

description: Outline a payments contract based on Kast Card and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin-denominated balance for each registered user, enabling them to make payments and receive refunds. It maintains a record of each user's current stablecoin balance and a global configuration for fees. Callers can deposit stablecoins into their account, transfer stablecoins to another registered user, and withdraw stablecoins from their account. The owner can set the transfer fee percentage and designate an operator who can pause and unpause all transfers. A transfer fee of 0.5% is applied to all outgoing transfers, and the maximum daily withdrawal amount per user is 10,000 stablecoins. The contract announces when a deposit, transfer, or withdrawal occurs.
source_description: Kast Card, a stablecoin-powered crypto card with 500K+ users across 160+ countries.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Danzo App and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gamified token staking and borrowing system, holding deposited tokens and borrowed tokens. It maintains individual user balances for staked tokens, borrowed tokens, and earned rewards, along with global pools for available liquidity and a configuration for borrowing rates. Callers can deposit tokens into the staking pool, withdraw their staked tokens, borrow tokens against their staked collateral, and repay their outstanding loans. Only a designated operator can adjust the borrowing interest rate and add new supported collateral tokens. The maximum borrowing ratio is 50% of the staked collateral value, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces events for successful deposits, withdrawals, loans, and repayments.
source_description: Danzo App is a gamified DeFi platform which includes the Danzo Arena where users can deposit tokens, borrow against holdings, and share in trading and withdrawal fees and the Danzo Casino, a one-of-a-kind degen’s paradise built on Cardano.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on flaunch and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of new digital assets, holding deposited base currency for trading and fees. It maintains a registry of created assets, tracking their creator, associated trading pool, and accumulated fees, alongside a global configuration for platform parameters. Callers can create new assets, deposit base currency into their associated trading pools, withdraw their share of trading pool liquidity, and claim accumulated fees from their created assets. A designated operator can set the base trading fee percentage, update the address of the fee recipient, and pause or unpause asset creation. The base trading fee is fixed at 0.25% of each trade, and new asset creation is limited to 10 assets per creator per 24-hour period. The contract announces asset creation events, liquidity provision events, and fee claim events to observers.
source_description: Buy, sell and launch memes. 100% of trading fees go to creators and buybacks. Powered by Uniswap V4.

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Spicy DAO and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve-backed stablecoin, holding various approved reserve assets and minting or burning the stablecoin based on their value. It maintains a record of each user's stablecoin balance, the total supply of the stablecoin, and a configurable list of approved reserve assets with their respective target allocations. Callers can deposit approved reserve assets to mint stablecoins, burn stablecoins to redeem a proportional share of reserve assets, and stake stablecoins into a bonding mechanism to earn protocol tokens. A designated operator can adjust the target allocation for each reserve asset, and the owner can add or remove approved reserve assets. The stablecoin's total supply is capped at 1,000,000 units, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces when new stablecoins are minted, when stablecoins are burned, and when reserve assets are deposited or withdrawn.
source_description: OHM fork and nodes on AVAX

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Aerodrome V1 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for token swaps and liquidity provision, holding deposited tokens within its liquidity pools. It maintains records of each token pair's reserves, accumulated swap fees, and liquidity provider positions for each user. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove their liquidity, swap tokens between supported pairs, and claim accumulated trading fees. A designated operator can create new token pair pools and adjust the swap fee percentage for any pool, which defaults to 0.3% and can be changed to any value between 0.05% and 1%. The contract emits an event for every token swap, liquidity addition, and liquidity removal, including the tokens involved and their respective amounts.
source_description: A central trading and liquidity marketplace on Base.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Sphere Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a treasury for governance tokens, holding various designated external governance tokens. It maintains a record of each supported governance token's balance within the treasury and a list of approved governance tokens. Callers can deposit approved governance tokens into the treasury and view the current balance of any supported governance token. Only a designated operator can add new governance tokens to the approved list, remove governance tokens from the approved list, and initiate a transfer of any held governance token out of the treasury. The treasury will only accept deposits of governance tokens that are on its approved list, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of any approved governance token is enforced. The contract announces when a new governance token is added to the approved list and when a transfer of governance tokens out of the treasury occurs.
source_description: Sphere Finance is an innovative protocol that brings benefits and value to $SPHERE token holders through governance tokens acquisitions, slowly turning $SPHERE holders into proxy governance holders of various protocols as we aim to black hole governance tokens into our treasury.

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Arcus pTokens and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues transferable ERC-20 tokens representing shares in a managed perpetual trading account. It custodies a single type of base asset, which is used for all trading activities. The contract maintains a total supply of shares, the base asset balance for each share holder, and a record of the current leverage, market, and direction settings for the underlying perpetual account. Callers can deposit base assets to mint new shares, withdraw base assets by burning shares, and transfer shares to other addresses. Only a designated operator can adjust the leverage, market, or direction of the underlying perpetual account, and only the owner can set the operator address. A deposit fee of 0.1% is applied to all deposits, and a minimum of 100 base assets must be deposited to mint new shares. The contract emits an event whenever shares are minted, burned, or transferred, and whenever the perpetual account's settings are updated.
source_description: Arcus pTokens are transferable ERC-20 vault shares representing proportional exposure to managed Arcus perpetual accounts with predefined markets, directions and leverage

description: Specify a governance contract based on Avant avBTC and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the staking of a bitcoin-pegged token into a yield-bearing staked token, holding the deposited bitcoin-pegged tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's staked balance, their earned rewards, and the current staking reward rate. Callers can deposit bitcoin-pegged tokens to receive staked tokens, withdraw their staked tokens to redeem the underlying bitcoin-pegged tokens, and claim their accrued rewards. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and pause or unpause all staking and unstaking operations. The maximum staking reward rate is 0.05% per day, and a 0.1% unstaking fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and changes to the staking reward rate.
source_description: Avant is a DeFi platform established in June 2024 with the mission to create a more inclusive financial system through DeFi-powered stable-value tokens. The platform introduces avBTC, a bitcoin-pegged token, and savBTC, its staked, yield-bearing counterpart.

description: Create a staking contract based on WEMIX.FI Staking and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a single fungible token, enabling users to deposit and earn rewards. It maintains individual user balances of staked tokens, accumulated rewards, and a global pool of all staked tokens. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their staked tokens and earned rewards, and claim only their earned rewards. A designated operator can set the reward rate and distribute rewards to the pool. The reward rate cannot exceed 0.05 tokens per staked token per day. Withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee on the principal amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: Stake your assets in staking products guaranteed by WEMIX and earn stable profits. Receive various rewards through various programs.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on StonkBrokers and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and the newly minted project tokens. It maintains per-participant records of deposited funds, allocated project tokens, and withdrawal statuses, along with a global pool of project tokens and configuration parameters for each launch. Callers can deposit funds into an active launch, claim their allocated project tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their deposited funds if a launch fails. The owner can create new launches, set launch parameters including the token address and allocation ratio, and finalize or cancel a launch. A launch must have a minimum funding goal of 1000 units of the deposit token, and the project token allocation ratio cannot exceed 1000 project tokens per 1 unit of deposit token. The contract emits an event when a new launch is created, when funds are deposited, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: StonkBrokers is a DeFi suite on Robinhood Chain with token launches, token swaps and LPs, an NFT AMM marketplace, and covered-call options

description: Outline a smart account contract based on Ambire Wallet and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a non-custodial smart account, holding any fungible or non-fungible tokens sent to its address. It maintains a list of authorized signers, a sequence number for each transaction, and a configuration for transaction batching. Callers can initiate transactions, which may include transfers of tokens held by the account, interactions with other contracts, or changes to the account's configuration. Only an authorized signer can approve a transaction, and a transaction is only executed if it has a valid signature from an authorized signer and its sequence number matches the account's current sequence number. The account allows for a maximum of 5 authorized signers. Each transaction incurs a base fee of 0.001 ether, payable to the deployer of the account. The contract announces the success or failure of each executed transaction and any changes to its authorized signers.
source_description: The First Non-Custodial DeFi Wallet with Email Authentication, Available on Ethereum, Avalanche, Polygon, Fantom, BSC, Moonbeam & more.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on T RIZE and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the tokenization of real-world assets, specifically U.S. Treasury bills, and custodies the corresponding asset-backed tokens. It maintains individual user balances of these tokens, a global registry of approved real-world asset issuers, and configuration parameters for fees and operational limits. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new asset-backed tokens, transfer their tokens to other users, and redeem their tokens for stablecoins. Only a designated operator can approve new real-world asset issuers and adjust the redemption fee, which is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount. The maximum number of asset-backed tokens that can be minted in a single transaction is 1,000,000. The contract announces events for token minting, token burning, and changes to the redemption fee.
source_description: T-RIZE is an institutional-grade RWA tokenization platform enhanced by decentralized machine learning.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Kodiak V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange with concentrated liquidity, holding deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains records of individual liquidity positions, global pool configurations including fees, and protocol-wide parameters. Callers can create new liquidity positions, add or remove liquidity from existing positions, swap tokens within a pool, and collect accrued fees. A designated operator can update pool fee tiers and set the protocol-wide swap fee, which is fixed at 0.05% of the swapped amount. The maximum number of distinct fee tiers per pool is limited to 5. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps.
source_description: Uniswap V3 fork on Berachain

description: Model a governance contract based on Lagoon and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a vault for users to deposit and manage their digital assets, specifically ERC-20 tokens, which it custodies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance within the vault, a global total of assets under management, and a configurable fee structure. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens into the vault, request a withdrawal of their deposited tokens, and execute a withdrawal after a delay. A designated curator role is privileged to approve or reject withdrawal requests and to rebalance assets held by the vault. The maximum deposit amount per user is 100,000 units of any supported token, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all successful withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal requests, and successful withdrawals to observers.
source_description: LAGOON provides open, general-purpose, secure vault infrastructure to build and scale on-chain yield products. Powered by the ERC-7540 standard, curators manage deposits and withdrawals asynchronously, while users can join any public vault to start earning on their assets.

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Sherwood and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a privacy-preserving mixer and shielded exchange, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments, a mapping of nullifiers to booleans indicating spent status, and a configuration for supported token addresses and their associated mixing fees. Callers can deposit tokens, generate and submit zero-knowledge proofs to withdraw tokens to a new address, and submit shielded orders to exchange tokens privately. Only the designated owner can update the list of supported tokens or adjust the mixing fee, which is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited amount for all tokens. Each withdrawal must include a valid nullifier that has not been spent before. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and shielded order placement, including the token address and amount.
source_description: Sherwood is a privacy mixer + shielded DEX on Robinhood chain.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Robinhood Chain Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain bridge for a native asset, holding wrapped versions of the asset on a secondary chain. It maintains a total supply of wrapped tokens, a mapping of user balances for the wrapped token, and a configuration for bridge operators. Callers can deposit native assets on the primary chain to mint wrapped tokens on the secondary chain, and they can burn wrapped tokens on the secondary chain to withdraw native assets on the primary chain. Only designated bridge operators can approve minting and burning requests, and they can set the bridge fee. The maximum single deposit or withdrawal is 1,000,000 units of the native asset, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces successful minting and burning events, including the user's address, the amount, and a unique transaction identifier.
source_description: The canonical bridge for Robinhood Chain.

description: Model a staking contract based on OpenGDP Shared Security and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a shared security pool for a decentralized network, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains individual user deposit records, the total staked amount, and configuration parameters like slashing percentages. Callers can deposit collateral tokens, withdraw their unstaked collateral, and delegate their staked collateral to network validators. A designated operator can initiate slashing events against specific validators, and the owner can update the slashing percentage and add or remove designated operators. The minimum deposit amount is 100 collateral tokens, and a 10% slashing penalty is applied to a validator's delegated stake upon a valid slashing event. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and slashing events, including the affected validator and amount.
source_description: The universal restaking layer powered by the entire cryptoeconomy.

description: Outline a governance contract based on UltraYield Vaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
