description_long: This contract manages a set of yield-generating vaults, holding deposited tokens and their accumulated yield. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount per vault, the total assets held by each vault, and a global configuration for fees and vault parameters. Callers can deposit tokens into an existing vault, withdraw their share of tokens and yield from a vault, and claim any accumulated rewards. A designated owner can create new vaults, pause deposits or withdrawals for a specific vault, and update the fee structure. The owner can set a maximum of 10 active vaults. A withdrawal fee of 0.5% is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces when a new vault is created, when tokens are deposited, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Vault Curator & Infrastructure Provider

description: Design a token contract based on Frensly and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token bonding curve, holding the native blockchain currency deposited by users. It maintains a record of each user's purchased social tokens and the total supply of social tokens for each unique social token identifier. Callers can purchase social tokens by depositing native currency, sell social tokens to redeem native currency, and transfer their social tokens to another address. A designated operator can create new social token identifiers, setting their initial price and a maximum supply limit. The purchase fee is fixed at 5% of the native currency deposited, and the sell fee is fixed at 5% of the native currency redeemed. The contract emits an event when social tokens are purchased, sold, or transferred, and when a new social token identifier is created.
source_description: The next-generation SocialFi app focused on effective trading features and users' on-chain identity. Built on Base.

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on Hexal and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized investment fund, holding various digital assets contributed by participants. It maintains individual balances for each participant, a total asset pool, and a configuration for investment strategies. Callers can deposit funds into the pool, withdraw their share of assets, and propose new investment strategies for community vote. A designated governance committee can approve or reject proposed strategies, and can set the management fee, which is capped at 2% of the total assets under management annually. All withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour waiting period after initiation. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and strategy approvals through public events.
source_description: A comunity governed hedge fund powered by DeFi.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on B2 Buzz and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a cross-chain staking event, holding deposited assets from various external chains. It maintains individual user balances of deposited assets, a total count of "Parts" earned by each user, and a global configuration for Part issuance rates. Users can deposit supported assets, claim earned Parts, and withdraw their original deposits. Only a designated operator can update the Part issuance rates for each asset and pause or unpause deposits. The contract will support a maximum of 10 distinct deposit assets. For every 1 unit of a deposited asset, a user earns 100 Parts per day. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, Parts are claimed, or a withdrawal occurs, including the user's address, the asset type, and the amount.
source_description: Launched by B² Network, B² Buzz is a staking event where a user can deposit major cryptocurrency assets from Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon. By doing so, a user will receive a certain amount of Parts which can be used to assemble Mining Rigs. Mining Rigs are employed to mine B² native tokens.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Resolv USR and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin, holding collateral ETH and minting a dollar-pegged token. It maintains individual balances for the stablecoin and collateral, a global total supply of the stablecoin, and a configurable collateralization ratio. Callers can deposit ETH to mint stablecoins, burn stablecoins to redeem ETH, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio, which must always be between 120% and 180%, and can pause all minting and burning operations. A 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions, and this fee is directed to a designated insurance pool contract. The contract announces events for stablecoin minting, stablecoin burning, and collateralization ratio updates.
source_description: Resolv is a protocol that maintains USR, a stablecoin fully backed by ETH and pegged to the US Dollar. The stablecoin’s delta-neutral design ensures price stability, and is backed by an innovative insurance pool (RLP) to provide additional security and overcollateralization.

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Flux Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a permissioned lending pool for a single collateral asset, holding deposited tokens and tracking individual user balances and borrowing positions. It maintains per-account records for deposits, borrows, and accrued interest, along with global configuration parameters like interest rates and the collateral factor. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated administrator can adjust interest rate models, set the collateral factor, and pause borrowing or depositing in emergencies. The maximum collateral factor is 80%, meaning users can borrow up to 80% of the value of their deposited collateral. A fixed 0.05% fee is charged on every borrow operation. The contract announces events for deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and any changes to critical configuration parameters.
source_description: Flux Finance is a decentralized lending platform supporting permissioned assets

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Biswap V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange router facilitating token swaps and managing liquidity provider positions. It maintains records of token balances for each user, the reserves within each trading pair pool, and the liquidity positions held by each provider. Callers can swap tokens, add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and approve spending of their tokens by the router. A designated operator can pause all trading activity and update the protocol fee percentage. The protocol charges a 0.2% fee on all token swaps, and liquidity providers receive 80% of this fee. The contract emits an event whenever tokens are swapped, liquidity is added, or liquidity is removed.
source_description: Biswap is a multichain DEX that allows trades across BNB, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base Chains with low slippage. Liquidity providers get 80% of trading fee. By providing liquidity on BNB Chain they can also earn BSW. Core stats: 2.7M+ Users, 600K+ Community, $48B+ Total Trading Vol

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Minswap DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token swaps and liquidity provision, holding deposited tokens in various liquidity pools. It maintains records of individual user liquidity positions, the balances within each token pair's liquidity pool, and global configuration parameters like swap fees. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove their liquidity, swap tokens between supported pairs, and query pool reserves or their own position details. A designated operator can create new token pair pools and adjust the swap fee within a predefined range. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and a minimum of 1000 units of each token is required to create a new liquidity pool. The contract announces successful swaps, liquidity additions, and liquidity removals, including the amounts involved and the affected token pairs.
source_description: Minswap aims to be the best liquidity provider on the market by integrating the best asset pool models from across the DEX ecosystem into one protocol.

description: Design a governance contract based on CrystalClear and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a stablecoin, holding deposited funds and tracking each user's share of the total. It maintains records of each user's deposited balance and the total stablecoin held, along with a configuration for an external trading agent. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their share, and redeem their shares for the underlying stablecoin. A designated operator can initiate trades through a separate trading system, and the owner can update the trading agent's address. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay after the request is made. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the amount redeemed. The contract emits events upon deposits, withdrawals, and when the trading agent's address is updated.
source_description: ERC-4626 USDC vaults on HyperEVM. Deposits trade Hyperliquid perpetuals via a delegated agent

description: Model a prediction market contract based on Sport.fun and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractional shares of real-world sports player performance, holding a stablecoin as collateral for these shares. It maintains individual user balances for each player's shares, a total supply for each player's shares, and a global stablecoin reserve. Callers can purchase shares using stablecoin, sell shares back for stablecoin, and transfer shares to other users. A designated operator can mint new shares for a player, burn existing shares, and update the stablecoin reserve balance. Share purchases and sales incur a 0.5% fee, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event whenever shares are bought, sold, or transferred, including the player identifier, the amount, and the involved accounts.
source_description: Sport.fun is a Base chain fantasy soccer protocol where users trade fractional player shares backed by actual football performance, using Gold pegged to USDC, with limited-use contracts and active market-driven gameplay

description: Create a governance contract based on Theoriq AlphaVault ETH and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating vault that custodies deposited Ether. It maintains a record of each user's deposited Ether balance, a total Ether balance across all strategies, and a configurable list of approved external yield strategies with their current allocations. Callers can deposit Ether into the vault, withdraw their deposited Ether and accrued yield, and claim any rewards distributed by the vault. Only a designated operator can adjust the allocation of Ether across the approved yield strategies, add new yield strategies, or remove existing ones. The maximum number of active yield strategies is limited to 5. A 0.5% performance fee is applied to all yield generated and is deducted upon withdrawal. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and reward claim events, including the user's address and the Ether amount involved.
source_description: AlphaVault is Theoriq's AI-managed ETH yield vault-of-vaults. It deploys deposited ETH across multiple sub-vault strategies, including Pendle fixed-yield positions and Aave-based leveraged looping. Users deposit once and gain access to the full strategy stack without needing to monitor or switch between venues.

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Phygitals and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and trading of unique digital representations of physical collectible items, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a registry of each digital item, its current owner, its associated physical item identifier, and a royalty percentage for each item. Callers can mint new digital items, transfer ownership of their digital items to another address, and list their digital items for sale at a specified price. Only a designated operator can mint new digital items and set the royalty percentage for newly minted items, which is capped at 10%. The contract emits an event when a new digital item is minted, when ownership of a digital item changes, and when a digital item is listed for sale or a sale is completed.
source_description: Phygitals is a Solana marketplace for trading digitized versions of vaulted collectible cards, with built-in royalties and portfolio tracking.

description: Create a staking contract based on Renzo and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid restaking vault, holding deposited Ether and issuing a receipt token representing a share of the vault's total assets. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, the Ether balance of each depositor, and a record of the current restaking strategy. Callers can deposit Ether, withdraw their deposited Ether and accrued rewards, and redeem their receipt tokens for Ether. A designated operator can update the restaking strategy and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The contract imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions, and a minimum deposit amount of 0.1 Ether is required. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy updates.
source_description: Renzo is an institutional-grade onchain platform for staking, restaking, and capital deployment, offering transparent, secure access to advanced yield strategies through modular products: Reserve Vaults, Staking Suite, and Enterprise Suite.

description: Design a token contract based on Tribe.run and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token system, holding an ERC-20 token supply for distribution. It maintains per-account records of an individual's "influence score" and their staked token balance, along with a global configuration for emission rates. Callers can stake tokens to increase their influence score, claim earned tokens based on their influence, and unstake their previously staked tokens. The owner can adjust the daily token emission rate and designate operators who can reset an individual's influence score. A user's influence score cannot exceed 10,000, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all token unstakes. The contract announces when tokens are staked, unstaked, or claimed, and when an influence score is updated.
source_description: Crypto social on Solana

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Dopple Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin lending and borrowing pool, holding deposited collateral tokens and minted stablecoins. It maintains records of each user's collateral deposits, stablecoin debts, and the current interest rates for both lending and borrowing. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, withdraw collateral once debt is cleared, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rate parameters and update the external price oracle address. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for borrowing is 75%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin borrowing operations. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, withdrawal events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Stablecoin DeFi Ecosystem on #BSC

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Lista RWA and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a marketplace for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), holding deposited crypto assets as collateral for RWA purchases. It maintains individual user balances of deposited crypto assets, records of purchased RWA tokens, and a global configuration for marketplace parameters. Users can deposit crypto assets, purchase available RWA tokens, and redeem their RWA tokens for the underlying crypto assets upon maturity or sale. A designated operator can list new RWA tokens for sale and set their initial price, and the owner can adjust the global purchase fee and the maximum RWA token supply. The global purchase fee is fixed at 0.5% of the RWA token value, and users must hold RWA tokens for a minimum of 7 days before they can be redeemed. The contract emits events for every deposit, purchase, redemption, and RWA token listing.
source_description: Real-World Asset (RWA) marketplace allows users to purchase tokenized RWAs like short-term U.S. treasuries and collateral loan obligations with crypto assets.

description: Design a token locking contract based on DaVinciGraph and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, custodying fungible tokens for a specified duration. It maintains records of locked token amounts, unlock dates, and the original depositor for each lock. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, extend the unlock date of an existing lock, and withdraw tokens once their lock has expired. A designated operator can set the fee percentage for new locks and designate new operators. The maximum lock duration is 730 days from the deposit date. A 0.5% fee is applied to all new token deposits, deducted from the deposited amount. The contract announces when a new lock is created, when an existing lock's duration is extended, and when tokens are successfully withdrawn.
source_description: DavinciGraph is a token management suite on the Hedera Network, offering services such as token and LP locking, token creation, burning, and soon, token vesting and launchpad functionalities.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on DerivaDEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in various approved tokens. It tracks individual user balances, open positions including margin and leverage, and global funding rates for each market. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, adjust leverage, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can list new perpetual markets, update oracle prices, and adjust risk parameters like initial margin requirements. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 20x, and a 0.05% trading fee is applied to all market orders. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and funding rate updates.
source_description: The next generation of derivatives trading.

description: Specify a privacy-preserving contract based on Tonic Cash and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private token transfers by accepting deposits of a specified token and allowing withdrawals to a different address without linking the two. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a list of spent nullifiers. Callers can deposit tokens by providing a commitment hash, and they can withdraw tokens by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof that corresponds to an unspent commitment and a nullifier. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root. Deposits must be in fixed denominations of 0.1, 1, 10, or 100 units of the specified token. A withdrawal fee of 0.1% of the withdrawn amount is applied. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, including the commitment hash and the deposit amount.
source_description: Tonic is a decentralized privacy protocol that enhances the privacy of token transfers on an EVM-based blockchain, making it harder to track them. Forked from Tornado Cash, it currently supports Klaytn and WEMIX as the first-ever crypto mixer protocol.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Suigar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits and payouts for various prediction events. It maintains a record of each user's current balance, their active predictions, and the overall state and outcome of each prediction event. Callers can deposit funds, place predictions on open events, claim winnings from resolved events, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can create new prediction events, resolve event outcomes, and set the contract's operating fee. The contract imposes a minimum prediction amount of 100 units of the deposited asset, and a 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits an event whenever a new prediction is placed, an event is resolved, or a payout is made.
source_description: Suigar, a provably-fair on-chain casino on Sui mainnet, and its bankroll protocol SweetHouse.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Tinyman and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an automated market maker (AMM) that facilitates token swaps between two distinct fungible tokens, holding reserves of both tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, the total supply of liquidity provider tokens for each pool, and the current swap fee percentage for each pool. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap one token for another within a pool, and query the current reserves and swap fee for any pool. Only a designated operator can create new liquidity pools and set the initial swap fee for a newly created pool. The maximum swap fee for any pool is 0.5%, and the minimum liquidity to create a pool is 100 units of each token. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected pool.
source_description: Tinyman is a next-generation decentralized AMM on the Algorand blockchain.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on IDEX V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a centralized order book and settlement layer for an off-chain exchange, holding user deposits of various fungible tokens. It maintains individual balances for each user and for each supported token, along with a global fee percentage. Callers can deposit tokens into their account, withdraw their deposited tokens, and request a trade to be settled by a designated operator. Only the owner can add new supported tokens, change the global fee percentage, or designate an operator. The maximum global fee percentage is 0.5% of the trade value. A trade request must specify a taker address and a minimum received amount to prevent front-running. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, or when a trade is successfully settled.
source_description: The fastest, most secure decentralized exchange.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on ZKasino and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits in an escrow. It tracks each user's current balance, open bets, and historical winnings, along with the current odds and outcomes for all active prediction events. Callers can deposit funds, place bets on open events, claim winnings from resolved events, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can create new prediction events, resolve event outcomes, and update event odds. The minimum bet amount is 0.01 units of the deposited currency, and a 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts. The contract emits an event when a new prediction event is created and when an event's outcome is resolved.
source_description: A decentralised betting platform with tokenised ownership on ZK-Rollups.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Fuel Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a two-way bridge for transferring a specific token between a Layer 2 rollup and Ethereum, holding deposited tokens in escrow on Ethereum. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balance awaiting withdrawal to the Layer 2, and a total escrowed balance. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract, initiate a withdrawal request to the Layer 2, and claim tokens on the Layer 2 after a successful withdrawal. A designated operator is privileged to finalize Layer 2 withdrawal requests, releasing the escrowed tokens. Each deposit must be at least 100 units of the token. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the amount claimed on Layer 2. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, when a withdrawal request is initiated, and when a withdrawal is finalized.
source_description: Bridge between Fuel Ignition and Ethereum

description: Model a governance contract based on Abacus and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid wrapper for a vote-escrowed governance token, holding the underlying vote-escrowed tokens and managing their voting power. It maintains a record of each user's deposited wrapped tokens, the total supply of wrapped tokens, and the current voting power accumulated from the underlying vote-escrowed tokens. Callers can deposit the underlying vote-escrowed tokens to mint wrapped tokens, withdraw their underlying vote-escrowed tokens by burning wrapped tokens, and claim their share of accumulated rewards. A designated operator can initiate a vote with the aggregated voting power and distribute collected fees and bribes to wrapped token holders. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit of 100 underlying vote-escrowed tokens is required to mint wrapped tokens. The contract announces when wrapped tokens are minted, when wrapped tokens are burned, and when rewards are distributed.
source_description: Abacus is an optimization layer built on ve(3,3) protocols. We aim to pool our collective resources to bolster the ecosystems, and to provide a seamless integration for all users. Abacus deploys a liquid wrapper token system that unlocks veTOKENs, provides yield on top of them while building up it's own vePOSITION to vote with. Abacus votes every week with it's veNFT position, capturing fees and bribes from the exchange, and streaming them to it's users. Abacus's veNFT position grows steadily as exchange users exit their veTOKEN positions, enabling Abacus to capture more of the exchange's fees and bribes.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Nawa Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a Shariah-compliant yield vault that custodies stablecoin deposits. It maintains individual account balances for deposited stablecoins, an aggregate pool of all stablecoin deposits, and a record of each user's shares in the vault. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the vault, withdraw their stablecoin deposits, and redeem their vault shares for stablecoins. A designated operator can initiate a rebalancing of the vault's underlying assets and can adjust the yield distribution parameters. The vault imposes a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all withdrawals, and the maximum individual deposit size is capped at 1,000,000 stablecoins. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and share redemption events to observers.
source_description: Nawa Finance is a Shariah-compliant yield protocol. Its flagship stable vaults accept USDT on Ethereum and USDC on ZIGChain and issue onchain vault shares, with yield generated from a real-economy remittance financing and private credit strategy curated by ZIGMarkets

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Tornadao and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized reserve currency protocol that custodies various asset tokens in its treasury. It maintains a global treasury balance for each accepted asset, a total supply of its native reserve token, and individual account balances for the native reserve token. Callers can deposit accepted asset tokens to mint the native reserve token, and redeem the native reserve token for a proportional share of the treasury assets. A designated operator can add new accepted asset tokens and adjust their backing parameters. The protocol requires a minimum backing ratio of 1.1:1 for the native reserve token against its treasury assets, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all redemption operations. The contract announces the current total supply of the native reserve token and the treasury balance of each accepted asset.
source_description: Tornadao is a decentralized reserve currency protocol available on the Avalanche (AVAX) Network based on the NADO token. Each NADO token is backed by a basket of assets (initially with MIM, and MIM/NADO) in the Tornadao treasury

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Entropyfi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction game where participants deposit stablecoins to predict the outcome of external events. It maintains individual participant balances, the total prize pool for each prediction round, and configuration parameters for ongoing games. Callers can deposit stablecoins into a round, make a prediction for that round, and after the round concludes, claim their winnings if their prediction was correct or withdraw their initial deposit if the round was cancelled. The owner can initiate new prediction rounds, set the oracle address for outcome resolution, and pause all contract operations. A minimum deposit of 10 stablecoins is required for each prediction, and a 5% fee is deducted from all winning payouts. The contract emits an event when a new round is started, when a prediction is made, and when winnings are claimed.
source_description: SEntropyfi is a decentralized platform that can potentially enable Defi users to amplify their yield for 10x by playing lossless games (e.g., market prediction, insurance, etc.).

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Syncus and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a treasury of various reserve assets and mints a stablecoin pegged to a fiat currency. It maintains the total supply of the stablecoin, the balance of each reserve asset held, and a mapping of stablecoin balances for each user. Callers can deposit approved reserve assets to mint stablecoins, and redeem stablecoins for an equivalent value of reserve assets, subject to availability. A designated operator can add new reserve assets, adjust the redemption fee, and pause or unpause minting and redemption. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount, and the contract must always maintain a minimum of 100,000 units of its primary reserve asset. The contract announces stablecoin minting and burning events, and changes to the redemption fee.
source_description: A treasury-backed DeFi protocol designed to be the cornerstone of a new cross-chain economic system.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Valantis STEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for swapping various digital assets, holding deposited tokens in liquidity pools. It maintains records of token balances within each pool, the total liquidity provided by each user, and global configuration parameters like swap fees. Users can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their liquidity, and swap tokens between different pools. A designated operator can adjust the swap fee, add new token pools, and pause trading in emergencies. The maximum swap fee is 0.5% and the minimum deposit amount for any token is 100 units. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, and swap operation, detailing the assets involved and the quantities exchanged.
source_description: The Modular DEX. Live on HyperEVM with STEX, a next-gen AMM design built specific for staked assets

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Raydium AMM and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract establishes an automated market maker for token swaps, holding reserves of two distinct tokens for each trading pair. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, the total liquidity tokens minted for that pool, and per-user balances of liquidity tokens. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap one token for another, and retrieve current pool information. A designated operator can adjust the swap fee. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the input token amount. Adding or removing liquidity requires providing both tokens in the current pool ratio. The contract emits an event upon every liquidity addition, removal, and token swap, detailing the affected pool, amounts, and involved addresses.
source_description: An on-chain order book AMM powering the evolution of DeFi.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Basis Cash and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized algorithmic stablecoin system's bond mechanism, holding a reserve of the stablecoin itself. It maintains a record of each user's purchased bonds, including the amount of stablecoin locked and the timestamp of purchase. Callers can purchase bonds by depositing stablecoin, redeem mature bonds for stablecoin, and claim rewards from a separate distribution mechanism. Only a designated operator can pause or unpause bond purchases and redemptions. Bonds mature exactly 24 hours after purchase. A maximum of 10,000 stablecoins can be purchased as bonds in a single transaction. The contract emits an event whenever a bond is purchased, redeemed, or a reward is claimed.
source_description: Basis Cash is a censorship-resistant and fairly distributed implementation of the Basis Protocol.

description: Specify a token contract based on Vimen and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of underlying tokens, representing a fully-backed index. It maintains each user's balance of the index token and the total supply, along with a mapping of underlying token addresses to their current weights within the basket, and a rebalancing cooldown period. Callers can deposit a proportional set of underlying tokens to mint new index tokens, withdraw underlying tokens by burning their index tokens, and transfer their index tokens to other users. A designated operator can adjust the weights of underlying tokens in the basket, but only after a 24-hour rebalancing cooldown has passed since the last adjustment. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, deducted from the underlying tokens. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, and rebalancing operations.
source_description: Vimen, a fully-backed index basket protocol on Robinhood Chain.

description: Outline a token contract based on Index Coop and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of diverse digital assets, representing a themed investment strategy, and custodies the underlying tokens. It maintains the current composition of the basket, including the quantity of each constituent token, and a total supply of basket shares. Callers can mint new basket shares by depositing the required constituent tokens, and redeem basket shares to receive the underlying tokens. The designated manager can adjust the basket's composition, adding or removing constituent tokens, and update the target weight of each token. The manager can also set a minting fee, which is currently 0.1% of the value of minted shares, and a redemption fee, which is currently 0.2% of the value of redeemed shares. The contract emits an event whenever new shares are minted, shares are redeemed, or the basket's composition is updated.
source_description: Index Coop creates and maintains the world's best crypto index products.All index products are always fully collateralized.

description: Define a privacy-preserving contract based on ShadeCash and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables private transfers of a designated fungible token by obscuring the link between deposits and withdrawals. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a nullifier set to prevent double-spending, along with a record of the current fee rate and minimum deposit amount. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens to a specified recipient after providing a valid zero-knowledge proof, and submit a zero-knowledge proof to claim a reward for relaying a withdrawal. Only the owner can update the fee rate, set the minimum deposit amount, or designate a new owner. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on each withdrawal, and the minimum deposit amount is fixed at 100 of the designated fungible token. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, withdrawal, and fee update, including relevant parameters like the deposit commitment or the withdrawal recipient.
source_description: Shade.Cash is a decentralized protocol for private transactions on the Fantom Opera network.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on BMX Freestyle and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized derivatives trading platform, holding collateral deposited by users and maintaining records of open positions. It tracks individual user balances, active trading positions, and global configuration parameters for various trading pairs. Callers can deposit collateral, open new derivative positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds, and the owner can upgrade the contract logic. All new positions require a minimum initial margin of 5% of the position's notional value, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closings, including the affected user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Freestyle is a SYMMIO (intent-based) frontend for derivatives trading that we operate alongside our Classic GMX spot and margin markets

description: Specify a price oracle contract based on Nest Protocol Staking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized price prediction market by accepting deposits of a base token and rewarding accurate price submissions. It custodies deposited base tokens and maintains individual account balances for deposited tokens, pending rewards, and active price submissions, along with a global configuration for parameters like submission windows and reward multipliers. Callers can deposit base tokens, submit price predictions for a specified asset pair, claim earned rewards, and withdraw their base token deposits. A designated owner role can adjust core parameters such as the minimum deposit amount, the reward multiplier, and the duration of the price submission window. The minimum deposit for a price submission is 100 base tokens, and a submission fee of 1 base token is deducted from each successful prediction. The contract emits events when a new price prediction is submitted, when rewards are claimed, and when a deposit is made or withdrawn.
source_description: The NEST oracle solves the problem of price on-chain through a decentralized incentive solution, that is, the price predictor.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on MON Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a gaming platform, holding a single fungible token. It maintains individual user balances of staked tokens, total staked tokens in the pool, and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their staked tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust the reward rate and pause/unpause staking. The minimum deposit amount is 100 tokens, and the reward rate can be changed a maximum of once every 24 hours. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, reward claim events, and reward rate updates.
source_description: Monprotocol is a gaming project on Ethereum, offering staking, rewards, and NFT integration. It enables secure asset ownership, transparent payouts, and a decentralized in-game economy for players and developers.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on PredictStreet and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users can trade shares representing binary outcomes for real-world events, collateralized by a stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances of stablecoin collateral, open positions for each market outcome, and a global record of active prediction markets with their current state and resolution. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit stablecoin collateral, buy shares for a specific outcome, sell existing shares, and claim their winnings after a market has been resolved. A designated operator is privileged to resolve prediction markets by declaring the winning outcome and to pause all trading activity in an emergency. Each prediction market must have a minimum of 100 stablecoins in total collateral before trading can begin, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all share purchases, deducted from the stablecoin collateral. The contract announces when a new prediction market is created, when shares are bought or sold, and when a market is resolved.
source_description: PredictStreet is a prediction-market exchange where users trade binary (YES/NO) outcome shares on real-world events — sports and beyond — and earn a return when their forecast is right. Every position is fully collateralized by USDC.e and settled on-chain on ADI Chain.

description: Create a governance contract based on Lendle Earn and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault allocator, enabling users to direct their deposited tokens to various managed investment vaults. It custodies deposited tokens until they are allocated or withdrawn. The contract maintains a record of each user's total deposited balance, their allocated balance per vault, and the current allocation weight for each approved vault. Callers can deposit tokens, allocate their deposited tokens to specific vaults, reallocate tokens between vaults, and withdraw unallocated tokens. The owner can add new vaults, set the maximum allocation weight for any vault, and pause all allocations. A user's total allocated balance across all vaults cannot exceed their total deposited balance, and the maximum allocation weight for any single vault is capped at 50%. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, allocated, or withdrawn, and when a new vault is added or an allocation is paused.
source_description: Lendle Vault Allocator allows users to allocate their funds to managed vaults

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Stellar DeFi Hub and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating vault for a single designated asset, holding user deposits of that asset. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total deposited amount, and a configuration for the annual reward rate. Callers can deposit the designated asset, withdraw their deposited asset and any accrued rewards, and claim only their accrued rewards. The owner can set the annual reward rate and designate an operator to pause and unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum annual reward rate is 10%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, withdrawal, and reward claim, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Stellar DeFi Hub is a platform that allows users to deposit Stellar-based assets into secure vaults and accrue rewards

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Lista DEX and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized exchange aggregator, holding user-deposited tokens temporarily during swap operations. It maintains records of available liquidity pools, their token pairs, and current balances, but does not track individual user positions or balances beyond the duration of a swap. Callers can initiate token swaps, query available swap routes, and approve token spending for swaps. A designated operator can add new liquidity pools, remove existing pools, and update the routing algorithm configuration. The maximum slippage tolerance for any swap is 0.5%. A flat fee of 0.05% is applied to the value of the output tokens for every successful swap. The contract announces the completion of a swap, including the input and output tokens, their amounts, and the address of the recipient.
source_description: Smart Swap aggregates liquidity across pools to automatically select the best route and price, minimizing slippage and fees.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Arrakis Modular and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a universal vault for managing two-sided liquidity positions within concentrated liquidity pools, and it custodies deposited tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited token balances, their active liquidity positions, and global configuration parameters for fees and operational limits. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, create new liquidity positions, adjust existing positions by adding or removing liquidity, and withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued fees. A designated operator can set the base fee percentage for all positions, which must be between 0.01% and 1.00%, and can pause all user-facing operations in an emergency. The contract enforces a maximum of 10 active liquidity positions per user and charges a 0.15% management fee on all collected swap fees. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when a new liquidity position is created or adjusted.
source_description: Arrakis Modular represents the next evolution of the Arrakis liquidity management smart contract framework, aiming to overcome the limitations of previous versions (V1 and V2). Arrakis Modular introduces a universal Meta Vault standard. This modular framework allows Arrakis to create entirely different two-sided LP Vault integrations, which all reuse the same Meta Vault infrastructure and interfaces.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on ApeSwap AMM and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange automated market maker that custodies pairs of arbitrary ERC-20 tokens. It maintains a record of the reserves for each token pair, the total liquidity tokens minted for each pair, and each user's balance of liquidity tokens. Callers can add liquidity to a pair, remove liquidity from a pair, and swap one token for another within a pair. The owner can set the swap fee, add new token pairs, and pause all trading activity. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the input token amount. A minimum of 1000 units of each token must be deposited to create a new liquidity pool. The contract announces liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the addresses of the participants.
source_description: ApeSwap is a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) that offers a full suite of tools to explore and engage with decentralized finance opportunities. Using the products within our DeFi Hub, users and partners can tap into this new wave of financial innovation in a secure, transparent, and globally accessible way.

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on Velhalla and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the distribution of in-game rewards, holding a fungible token for this purpose. It maintains a record of each player's accumulated rewards balance and a global configuration for reward rates. Players can claim their accumulated rewards, and a designated operator can deposit more tokens into the contract and update the reward rate. Only the contract owner can designate a new operator. The maximum reward rate is 1000 tokens per unit of game activity, and the contract must always maintain a minimum balance of 5000 fungible tokens. The contract announces when rewards are claimed and when the reward rate is updated.
source_description: Velhalla - The Velas MetaVerse Viking mythology meets a hyper-futuristic universe.

description: Define a prediction market contract based on PoolTogether V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss prize game where users deposit an ERC-20 token to earn chances to win prizes, with the contract holding all deposited tokens in a single pool. It maintains a record of each user's total deposited amount, the total amount deposited across all users, and the current prize configuration. Callers can deposit tokens into the prize pool, withdraw their deposited tokens at any time, and claim any prizes they have won. A designated operator can initiate a new prize drawing and set the prize distribution parameters. The maximum single deposit allowed is 10,000 tokens. A 1% fee is deducted from each prize awarded, allocated to a treasury address. The contract announces when new deposits are made, when withdrawals occur, and when prizes are awarded.
source_description: PoolTogether is an open source and decentralized protocol for no-loss prize games

description: Model a token locking contract based on Pocket Universe and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a registry of malicious addresses, serving as a public blacklist for security applications; it custodies no assets. It maintains a mapping of addresses to a boolean indicating their malicious status and a timestamp of their last update. Callers can query the malicious status of any address. A designated operator can add an address to the blacklist, remove an address from the blacklist, or update an existing entry's timestamp. Only the designated operator may modify the blacklist. The blacklist is capped at 10,000 entries, and an address cannot be added or removed more frequently than every 24 hours. The contract announces when an address's malicious status is updated, including the address and its new status.
source_description: A browser extension that protects users from scams and wallet drainers

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Resupply and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin protocol, holding collateral tokens and minting a protocol-native stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral and minted stablecoins, global collateralization ratios, and configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoins, withdraw collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and liquidation thresholds, and the owner can pause all operations and upgrade the contract. The maximum stablecoin mintable per unit of collateral is 90% of its value, and a 0.5% fee is charged on all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, mints, repays, and liquidations, including the affected accounts and amounts.
source_description: A decentralized stablecoin protocol, leveraging the liquidity and stability of lending markets

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Ruby Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic stable asset, pegged to a fluctuating base asset, and custodies user deposits of the base asset. It maintains individual user balances of the synthetic asset, the total supply of the synthetic asset, the current peg ratio, and a reserve of the base asset. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint the synthetic asset, redeem the synthetic asset for the base asset, and transfer the synthetic asset to other users. A designated operator can adjust the peg ratio within a predefined range and initiate emergency shutdowns. The contract enforces a minimum deposit of 10 base units for minting and charges a 0.5% fee on all redemptions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Ruby Finance is the first innovative algorithmic token pegged to $KAVA running on KAVA network.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Arena Launch and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates token launches for new projects within an ecosystem, holding deposited tokens from participants and the project's launch tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their allocation of launch tokens, along with the total amount of tokens raised and the total launch tokens distributed for each project. Callers can deposit a specified token to participate in a launch, claim their allocated launch tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent deposited tokens if the launch fails to meet its minimum. A designated operator can create new launch events, set the launch parameters, finalize a successful launch, or cancel a failed launch. The minimum deposit amount for any participant is 100 units of the deposit token, and the maximum number of participants per launch is capped at 5000. The contract announces when a new launch is created, when a participant deposits, and when launch tokens are claimed.
source_description: A Launchpad for The Arena ecosystem

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on sDAI and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-bearing wrapper for a stablecoin, holding user-deposited stablecoins in a vault. It maintains a total supply of its own wrapper token, a balance of wrapper tokens for each user, and a global exchange rate between the wrapper token and the underlying stablecoin. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint wrapper tokens, and they can redeem wrapper tokens to withdraw stablecoins. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on external yield accrual. Only the owner can pause deposits and withdrawals, and only the owner can set the designated operator. The minimum deposit amount is 10 stablecoins. The exchange rate must always be greater than or equal to 1. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address, the amount of stablecoins, and the amount of wrapper tokens.
source_description: All the DAI bridged to Gnosis Chain is earning interest at MakerDAO. This interest is redirected to the sDAI holder. You can use sDAI in Defi like you would normally use xDAI.

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Metis Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain token transfers between a Layer 2 network and a Layer 1 network, holding deposited tokens in escrow on the Layer 1 side. It maintains a mapping of Layer 2 transaction hashes to their corresponding Layer 1 deposit amounts and recipient addresses, along with a total balance of all bridged tokens. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract for transfer to Layer 2, and a designated operator can finalize withdrawals of tokens from the contract back to Layer 1 after a successful Layer 2 transaction. Only the owner can set the designated operator and update the minimum deposit amount. A minimum deposit of 100 units of the bridged token is enforced for all transfers, and a withdrawal delay of 12 hours is imposed before tokens can be released to the Layer 1 recipient. The contract emits an event upon every successful deposit, including the deposit amount, the Layer 1 sender, and the intended Layer 2 recipient.
source_description: Bridge between Metis and Ethereum

description: Outline a token contract based on SharesGram and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social engagement token, facilitating the creation and trading of personalized share tokens representing individual users. It maintains a registry of all issued share tokens, each with its current price, total supply, and a bonding curve configuration, alongside individual user balances of the main platform token and their owned share tokens. Callers can buy a share token, sell a share token, claim their share token earnings, and create their own share token. The contract owner can set the base price for new share tokens and adjust the trading fee percentage. A new share token creation requires a minimum initial purchase of 100 platform tokens, and a 5% fee is applied to all share token buy and sell transactions, deducted in the platform token. The contract announces when a share token is created, when a share token is bought, and when a share token is sold.
source_description: Experience the real SocialFi on Telegram. Unlock the full potential of your shares.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Rho X and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized interest rate derivatives market, holding deposited collateral tokens to back user positions. It maintains individual user balances of collateral, records of active long and short interest rate swap positions including their notional value and fixed rate, and global configuration parameters like the funding rate and available collateral tokens. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short interest rate swap positions, close existing positions, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust the funding rate within a predefined range and add new collateral tokens to the approved list. The maximum leverage for any position is set at 10x the collateral deposited for that position, and a 0.1% fee is charged on the notional value of each new position opened. The contract announces all position openings and closings, as well as changes to the funding rate.
source_description: Rho Protocol is a cryptonative interest rates market. The platform uniquely offers trading of staking, lending, and perpetual future funding rates all in one venue, as well as allowing users to passively earn yield by depositing into Rho's vaults

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Jiko and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-optimized staking pool for a gaming platform, holding deposited tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains individual account balances for staked tokens, accumulated rewards, and a global configuration for reward rates and pool status. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their staked tokens and accrued rewards, and claim only their accrued rewards. A designated operator can adjust the reward rate and pause or unpause deposits, while the owner can upgrade the contract logic. The maximum deposit per account is 100,000 units of the staked token, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all reward withdrawals. The contract emits events for successful deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and changes to the reward rate or pool status.
source_description: JIKO is a yield optimizer powering a PvP idle card game. With single-staked pools, we maximize yields via Proof of Liquidity (PoL) on Berachain, making finance both fun and profitable

description: Define an NFT contract based on Mint Park and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a marketplace for digital collectibles, holding escrowed collectibles and cryptocurrency payments during trades. It maintains a registry of listed collectibles, their prices, and the seller for each, alongside a configurable platform fee percentage. Callers can list a collectible for sale, purchase a listed collectible, or cancel their own listing. Only a designated administrator can set the platform fee, pause all trading activity, or withdraw accumulated platform fees. The platform fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price for each successful trade, and a listed collectible must remain available for purchase for a minimum of 24 hours before its listing can be cancelled by the seller. The contract announces successful purchases and new listings.
source_description: NFT marketplace built for Bitcoin L2 networks. launching, trading, and bridging NFTs across BTC L2 networks

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Bitwise USCC and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating fund that holds stablecoins and issues fungible tokens representing shares in the fund. It maintains a total supply of shares, the stablecoin balance held by the fund, and individual share balances for each participant. Callers can subscribe by depositing stablecoins to receive shares, redeem shares to withdraw stablecoins, and transfer their shares to other participants. A designated operator can adjust the fund's stablecoin balance to reflect external investment activities and set the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the stablecoin value redeemed, and a minimum subscription amount of 1000 stablecoins is enforced. The contract emits events for every share subscription, share redemption, and share transfer.
source_description: The Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund (the Fund) offers Qualified Purchasers access to crypto basis strategies, which aim to take advantage of the difference between spot and futures prices. The Fund seeks to optimize the yield and manage the risk of crypto cash-and-carry trades across multiple crypto assets and U.S. Treasury securities. Ownership in the Fund is via the USCC token or book-entry record keeping. Subscriptions and redemptions are facilitated through USD or USDC, with liquidity each market day.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Zircuit Staking and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a new blockchain network, holding deposited collateral tokens that represent a claim on future network rewards. It maintains individual user balances of deposited collateral, the total staked amount, and a global reward rate. Callers can deposit collateral tokens, withdraw their deposited collateral, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate and initiate reward distributions. The minimum deposit amount is 0.1 collateral tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events.
source_description: The Zircuit staking is designed to reward participating users and communities that help bootstrap native, day-one liquidity to Zircuit. Zircuit is a modular zk rollup with AI-enabled security at the sequencer level

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Securitize Tokenized AAA CLO Fund and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized fund representing fractional ownership of a diversified portfolio of high-rated debt instruments, specifically Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs), and custodies the underlying stablecoin collateral. It maintains per-investor records of their token balances, a total supply of fund tokens, and configuration parameters like the management fee and redemption fee. Callers can deposit stablecoins to mint new fund tokens, transfer their fund tokens to other addresses, and redeem their fund tokens for stablecoins. A designated operator can pause or unpause deposits and redemptions, adjust the management fee, and update the redemption fee. The management fee is fixed at 0.5% annually, and the redemption fee is 0.1% of the redeemed amount. The contract announces events for token minting, token burning, and fee collection.
source_description: This Fund provides digital, tokenized exposure to a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs), with a focus on tranches rated AAA.

description: Create a staking contract based on Valdora Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies deposited base tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base tokens and their corresponding issued liquid staking tokens, along with a global pool of staked base tokens and a configuration for staking parameters. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for base tokens, and transfer liquid staking tokens to other accounts. Only a designated operator can initiate staking of deposited base tokens with the underlying protocol and unstaking from it, and only the owner can set the redemption fee. A redemption fee of 0.1% is applied to all redemptions, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 base tokens is enforced. The contract announces when a deposit occurs, when a redemption occurs, and when the redemption fee is updated.
source_description: Valdora Finance is the liquid staking protocol built on ZIGChain, offering secure, non-custodial, and decentralized staking through its flagship token — stZIG.

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Ample and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a prize-linked savings vault, holding user deposits of a stablecoin. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total pooled balance, and configuration parameters for prize distribution. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their full deposit at any time, and claim prize winnings if selected. A designated operator can initiate new prize rounds, fund prizes from accrued yield, and select prize winners using an on-chain randomness source. The minimum deposit amount is 10 stablecoins, and prize rounds occur weekly, distributing 80% of the accrued yield as prizes. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and prize winner selections.
source_description: Ample is a prize-linked savings protocol where users deposit USDC, retain their principal with no lockups, and pool yield to fund rewards distributed via verifiable on-chain randomness.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Spacebar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming-focused points system, holding deposited tokens that represent a player's stake. It maintains individual player balances of deposited tokens, accumulated points, and records of completed missions, alongside a global configuration for mission definitions and point multipliers. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, claim earned points, and submit proof of mission completion. Only a designated operator can define new missions, adjust point multipliers, and distribute bonus points to specific players. A player must have at least 100 deposited tokens to participate in any mission, and mission completion submissions are only accepted within 24 hours of the mission's official start time. The contract announces when tokens are deposited, when tokens are withdrawn, when points are claimed, and when a mission is successfully completed by a player.
source_description: Onchain Playground to Stake, Play, Complete Missions, and Earn Points across Blast ecosystem. Backed by Yield Guild.

description: Design a governance contract based on Sharpe Earn and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and staking a specific ERC-20 token, holding the deposited tokens securely. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount and their accumulated rewards, along with a global reward pool balance and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, stake their deposited tokens to earn rewards, claim their accrued rewards, and withdraw their original deposited tokens. Only the owner can set the reward rate, which must be between 0.01% and 1.00% of the total staked amount per day, and pause or unpause staking. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 tokens and a 7-day unbonding period after unstaking before tokens can be withdrawn. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, when tokens are withdrawn, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Sharpe is an AI-powered DeFi automation and execution environment designed for pro-traders and institutions. Our unified platform streamlines DeFi asset management, execution, and custody and provides traders with a comprehensive environment for earning yields, building strategies, advanced DEX trading, lending automation and so much more.

description: Design a staking contract based on Hipo and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract custodies deposited native tokens and issues a liquid staking derivative token in return, representing a share of the total staked assets and accrued rewards. It maintains a global total of deposited native tokens, the total supply of the liquid staking derivative token, and a configuration for the current staking ratio and fees. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive derivative tokens, withdraw native tokens by burning derivative tokens, and claim rewards. A designated operator can initiate staking of native tokens to an external validator set and unstaking from it, and update the staking ratio based on validator performance. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 0.5 native tokens and charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, which is deducted from the native tokens returned. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the depositor's or withdrawer's address, the amount of native tokens, and the amount of derivative tokens.
source_description: Hipo is a decentralized liquid staking protocol on TON.

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on SplitSwap and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private, peer-to-peer token swaps by holding deposited tokens in escrow until a swap is completed or cancelled. It maintains a record of each swap request, including the asset to be sent, the asset to be received, the amount of each, a cryptographic commitment from the initiator, and the current status of the swap. Callers can initiate a swap by depositing the "send" token and providing a commitment, fulfill an existing swap by depositing the "receive" token and revealing the secret, or cancel their own pending swap. The contract owner can pause all swap operations in an emergency and can update the swap fee. A swap fee of 0.3% of the "send" token amount is charged upon successful fulfillment. A swap request automatically expires and can be cancelled by anyone if it remains unfulfilled for more than 24 hours. The contract announces when a swap is initiated, when it is fulfilled, and when it is cancelled.
source_description: Privacy enhanced swap.

description: Define an on-chain game contract based on Worldle and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a daily word-guessing game, holding an escrow of reward tokens for winners and duel participants. It tracks each player's current streak, their total wins, and their pending reward balance. Players can submit a guess for the daily puzzle, claim their accumulated rewards, or initiate a head-to-head duel by staking tokens against another player. A designated operator is solely responsible for setting the daily word puzzle and resolving duel outcomes. The daily puzzle must be set exactly once per 24-hour period, and a duel requires each participant to stake a minimum of 100 reward tokens. The contract announces when a new daily puzzle is available and when a player successfully claims rewards.
source_description: Worldle turns your daily wordle fix into real crypto rewards. Solve puzzles, build your streak, and duel others where winner takes all

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Bitget bgBTC and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a wrapped asset token, backed 1:1 by an external asset held in custody by a designated operator. It maintains each account's current balance of wrapped tokens and a global total supply. Callers can mint new wrapped tokens by depositing the underlying asset with the designated operator, burn wrapped tokens to redeem the underlying asset from the designated operator, and transfer wrapped tokens to other accounts. Only the designated operator may mint or burn tokens, and they are also responsible for maintaining the 1:1 backing. A minimum deposit of 0.0001 underlying asset units is required for minting, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all redemptions, payable in the underlying asset. The contract announces all minting, burning, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Backed 1:1 by Bitcoin (BTC) on Bitget, BGBTC is designed to help you earn more while keeping your assets flexible and secure. By staking BTC, you can earn stable returns and collect BGPoints, which can be used to claim airdrops from various Bitcoin ecosystem projects

description: Design a payments contract based on Hedgey and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages token vesting schedules, holding tokens in escrow until they are released according to predefined terms. It maintains individual vesting schedules for each recipient, including the total amount to be vested, the start time, and the duration, along with a global configuration for a designated operator. Callers can create new vesting schedules, claim vested tokens, and view their individual vesting status. Only the designated operator can set the fee for creating new vesting schedules and pause all vesting claims. The fee for creating a new vesting schedule is 0.01 ether, and a vesting schedule cannot be shorter than 30 days. The contract announces when new vesting schedules are created and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: Hedgey helps teams create & manage employee token vesting, investor lockups, & community token claims

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Nad.fun V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates token launches by holding deposited tokens for sale and managing the distribution of newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's committed funds, the total funds raised for each launch, and configuration parameters for ongoing sales. Callers can deposit funds into a sale, claim their allocated project tokens after a successful sale, and withdraw their unspent funds if a sale fails or is canceled. The contract owner can initiate new sales, set sale parameters including the token to be sold and its price, pause or cancel active sales, and withdraw collected funds after a sale concludes. A launch sale must raise at least 100 units of the deposited currency to be considered successful, and the platform charges a 2% fee on all successfully raised funds. The contract announces when a new sale begins, when funds are deposited, when tokens are claimed, and when a sale concludes.
source_description: Launchpad on Monad.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Volo LST and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains a global pool of staked base assets, a total supply of the liquid staking token, and a record of each user's liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their staked base asset by redeeming liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards accrued to their staked position. A designated operator can adjust the staking rate for the base asset and initiate unstaking requests with the underlying protocol. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the base asset. The contract announces all deposit and withdrawal events, including the amount and the participant's address.
source_description: Volo is the go-to Earn Hub for all your assets on Sui that offers much more than its established status in offering its fully decentralized LST Sui (vSui). Volo is expanding to offering vaults of all major assets on Sui especially BTCFi-related token that allows users to simply earn yield on their assets with one click.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on ShiftDollar and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a supply-elastic token, expanding and contracting its total supply to maintain a target value, and it custodies no other assets. It maintains each account's token balance, the current total supply, and a target token price. Callers can transfer tokens, approve spending by other accounts, and permit spending by other accounts. A designated operator can initiate supply expansions or contractions, and only the owner can update the target token price. The maximum supply expansion or contraction in a single operation is 5% of the current total supply. A supply contraction operation burns 0.1% of the contracted amount as a protocol fee. The contract announces when the total supply changes and when an account's balance changes.
source_description: The SHIFT is designed to expand contract supply similar to the way central banks trade fiscal debt to stabilize purchasing power, without any rebates or collateral risk.

description: Create an NFT contract based on AirNFTs and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of non-fungible tokens, holding the tokens themselves in escrow during active listings. It maintains a record of all listed tokens, their current seller, the asking price, and the token's unique identifier, alongside a global platform fee percentage.
