Callers can list a token for sale, purchase a listed token, and cancel their own active listings. Only a designated administrator can set the platform fee, which must be between 0% and 10% inclusive. A token can only be purchased if the buyer sends exactly the asking price. The contract announces when a token is listed, when a token is sold, and when a listing is cancelled.
source_description: Multichain NFT marketplace that connects artists and collectors.

description: Model a lending protocol based on EVAA Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized lending and borrowing, holding deposited collateral tokens and borrowed asset tokens. It maintains individual user deposit and borrow balances, the total reserves for each asset, and global configuration parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit tokens as collateral, borrow available assets against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated owner can adjust interest rate models, update collateral factors, and pause borrowing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a 0.05% protocol fee is applied to all borrow operations, deducted from the borrowed amount. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the user's address, asset type, and amount.
source_description: The first decentralized lending protocol on TON that lets users lend or borrow assets without going to a centralized intermediary.

description: Create a governance contract based on Knightrade and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and withdrawing a single ERC-20 token, enabling users to participate in various investment strategies. It maintains individual user balances, a total deposited amount, and a list of approved strategy contracts along with their allocated capital. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their available balance, and approve strategy contracts to pull funds from their share of the vault. A designated operator can add new strategy contracts, remove existing ones, and adjust the capital allocation for each strategy. The maximum number of active strategy contracts is limited to 10. A 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal, and strategy allocation change, detailing the affected user or strategy, the amount, and the new balance or allocation.
source_description: Knightrade is the on-chain, multi-strategy hedge fund platform, run by verified traders from top hedge funds and investment banks

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Ridotto and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits in an escrow. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction positions, and global configuration parameters like market creation fees and minimum stake amounts. Callers can create new prediction markets by specifying an outcome and duration, place bets on existing markets, and claim winnings once a market resolves. Only a designated operator can resolve a market by declaring its final outcome. The market creation fee is 0.01 ether, and the minimum bet amount is 0.001 ether. The contract announces market creation events, bet placements, and market resolutions, including the winning outcome and total payout.
source_description: Ridotto decentralizes crypto gambling via permissionless casino ownership and open-source bankrolling, introducing a GambleFi ecosystem. Built on Multi-Chain, our approach is to provide an open protocol driven by the community, where users can play, build, and even bankroll casino games.

description: Define a governance contract based on Makina and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages operator-driven yield strategies, holding deposited funds in various tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited tokens and their share in active strategies, along with a global configuration of approved strategies and their associated parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their share, and propose new strategies for approval. Only a designated operator can initiate or close a strategy, and only the contract owner can approve new strategies or modify global parameters. A minimum deposit of 100 units of any supported token is required to participate in a strategy, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces strategy initiations, closures, and all deposit and withdrawal events.
source_description: Makina the most advanced DeFi Execution Engine empowering sophisticated Operators to execute onchain yield strategies which maximize risk-adjusted return.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on 1776.MEME and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a token launchpad, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base tokens, their allocated project tokens, and a global configuration for active launches. Callers can deposit base tokens to participate in a launch, claim their allocated project tokens after a launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent base tokens. Only the owner can initiate new token launches, set launch parameters, or pause all contract operations. Each launch has a minimum deposit amount of 100 base tokens and a maximum allocation of 5000 project tokens per participant. The contract emits an event when a new launch is initiated and when project tokens are successfully claimed.
source_description: 1776.MEME is a launchpad for meme-driven tokens, built on Ethereum and powered by the $USD1 and $WLFI tokens from World Liberty Finance.

description: Model an NFT contract based on Drip.Trade and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the high-frequency exchange of non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposited NFTs, their outstanding bids and offers, and a global order book for each NFT collection. Callers can deposit NFTs, place bids, place offers, cancel bids, cancel offers, and withdraw their NFTs. Only a designated operator can execute trades between matching bids and offers. The contract imposes a 0.1% fee on all executed trades, paid by both the buyer and the seller. A user cannot have more than 100 active bids or offers at any given time. The contract announces when an NFT is deposited, when an NFT is withdrawn, and when a trade is executed.
source_description: The first high frequency NFT exchange, on Hyperliquid

description: Model a prediction market contract based on XO Market and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a prediction market for binary outcomes, holding collateral in a stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions, the total collateral for each outcome, and market configuration parameters. Callers can create new markets, deposit collateral into an outcome, withdraw collateral from an outcome, and resolve a market once its outcome is known. A designated operator can pause all market operations and set the market resolution. The maximum number of open markets at any time is 100. A 0.5% fee is applied to all collateral withdrawals. The contract announces market creation, collateral deposits, collateral withdrawals, and market resolution events.
source_description: XO Market is a permissionless prediction market protocol on its own Celestia-based EVM rollup, letting users create, trade, and resolve Yes/No "conviction markets" with USDC.e as collateral

description: Model a governance contract based on veDelegate and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a governance delegation vault, holding users' governance tokens to participate in a voting system on their behalf. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens, the total delegated voting power, and a configurable delegation target for voting. Callers can deposit governance tokens into the vault, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim any voting rewards accrued to their share of the vault. The owner can set the delegation target, adjust the fee percentage applied to claimed rewards, and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. A minimum deposit of 100 governance tokens is required, and a 5% fee is applied to all claimed rewards. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, reward claims, and changes to the delegation target.
source_description: veDelegate is a DeFi application within the VeChain B3TR ecosystem, designed to simplify and optimize governance participation. It allows users to stake their tokens to earn voting rewards without the need for weekly manual voting.

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on Namada Shielded Pools and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a shielded asset pool, holding various fungible tokens and tracking their shielded balances for each user. It maintains a Merkle tree of nullifiers and commitments, along with a registry of supported token addresses and their associated configuration parameters. Callers can deposit tokens into the shielded pool, generating a new commitment; transfer shielded tokens to another user, consuming existing commitments and generating new ones; and withdraw shielded tokens to a public address, consuming a commitment and nullifying it. A designated operator can add new supported tokens to the registry, update a token's configuration, and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The maximum number of supported tokens is 100. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, paid in the withdrawn token. The contract emits an event for every deposit, transfer, and withdrawal, detailing the token, amount, and relevant commitment or nullifier.
source_description: Namada is an L1 proof-of-stake blockchain with a ZK-powered multi-asset shielded pool serving as the composable privacy layer for the multichain

description: Design a stablecoin contract based on Based V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic asset pegged to a target asset, holding reserves of the target asset to back the synthetic asset. It maintains a record of each user's synthetic asset balance, the total supply of synthetic assets, and a configuration for peg stability parameters. Callers can mint synthetic assets by depositing the target asset, redeem synthetic assets for the target asset, and stake synthetic assets into a dedicated pool. Only a designated operator can adjust the target peg ratio, which is initially set to 1:1, and initiate epoch transitions. A 0.5% redemption fee is applied to all redemptions, and redemptions are subject to a 6-hour cooldown period per address after each redemption. The contract announces events for mints, redemptions, stakes, and peg ratio adjustments.
source_description: An innovative fork of tomb.finance, pegged to the price of 1 TOMB via seigniorage.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Lisk Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens representing assets on a connected blockchain. It maintains a registry of wrapped token balances for each user and a global count of total wrapped tokens issued. Callers can deposit native tokens to mint wrapped tokens, burn wrapped tokens to initiate a withdrawal of native tokens, and claim their native tokens after a successful withdrawal. A designated operator can approve withdrawal requests and pause or unpause the contract's deposit and withdrawal functions. A maximum of 10,000 wrapped tokens can be minted per deposit transaction, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawal requests. The contract announces when wrapped tokens are minted, when wrapped tokens are burned, and when native tokens are released to a user.
source_description: We offer Web3 founders in Emerging Markets the ultimate ecosystem to bring their real-world applications to life.

description: Design a staking contract based on Jito Restaking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates liquid staking for multiple proof-of-stake assets and custodies the deposited principal assets. It maintains per-account records of deposited principal, issued liquid staking tokens, and accrued rewards, along with a global mapping of supported principal assets to their corresponding liquid staking token contracts, and a configuration for each asset's staking parameters. Callers can deposit supported principal assets to receive liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for their underlying principal, and claim accrued rewards. A designated operator can add new supported principal assets, update staking parameters for existing assets, and initiate withdrawals of staked principal from the underlying consensus layer. A maximum of 10 supported principal assets can be configured, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all reward claims. The contract announces deposits, withdrawals, and reward distributions as events.
source_description: Jito Restaking is a multi-asset staking protocol for node consensus networks. The protocol tokenizes staked assets as vault receipt tokens for enhanced liquidity and composability

description: Create a token contract based on Alongside and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an index token representing a diversified portfolio of other crypto assets, holding a basket of specified underlying tokens. It maintains the current composition and weight of each underlying asset in the index, along with the total supply of the index token and the balance of index tokens held by each user. Callers can mint new index tokens by depositing the required underlying assets in the correct proportions, and they can redeem their index tokens to receive the corresponding underlying assets. Only a designated operator can update the index composition, adjusting the types and weights of the underlying assets. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the value of the redeemed assets, and the index composition can be updated at most once every 24 hours. The contract announces all minting and redemption events, as well as any changes to the index composition.
source_description: AMKT is a crypto index designed to track the crypto market in a single token.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Perpl and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including their size and entry price, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and trading fees. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close leveraged positions on various assets, add margin to existing positions, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can update asset configurations, adjust funding rate parameters, and pause trading in emergencies. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a flat trading fee of 0.1% is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closings, including the account involved and the relevant amounts.
source_description: Perpl is a perpetual futures exchange on Monad.

description: Outline a token contract based on Clink and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social token system, holding user-deposited base tokens and issuing corresponding social tokens. It maintains a record of each user's base token deposits, their issued social token balance, and a global configuration for the platform. Users can deposit base tokens to mint social tokens, transfer their social tokens to other users, and burn social tokens to withdraw their underlying base tokens. A designated operator can adjust the platform's base fee percentage and set the minimum deposit amount. The minimum deposit amount for base tokens is 0.001 ether, and a 5% fee is applied to all social token transfers, payable in social tokens. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, and social token transfers, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: SocialFi platform on Base

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Spiko and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages tokenized money market fund shares, representing fractional ownership of a portfolio of short-term government debt instruments. It maintains individual account balances for the tokenized shares, a total supply of shares, and configuration parameters such as the redemption fee and the minimum redemption amount. Callers can deposit supported stablecoins to mint new shares, transfer shares to other accounts, and redeem shares for the underlying stablecoins. A designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers and redemptions, update the redemption fee, and add or remove supported stablecoins. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount, and the minimum redemption amount is 100 shares. The contract announces all share transfers, minting events, and redemption events.
source_description: Spiko USTBL / EUTBL are Tokenized Money Market Funds regulated by the French Financial Markets Authority that invest in US T-Bills / Eurozone T-Bills

description: Create a lending protocol based on Suilend and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lending and borrowing pool for various digital assets, holding deposited tokens as collateral and loaned tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposits, borrows, and collateralization ratios, along with global pool statistics like total liquidity and utilization rates for each supported asset. Callers can deposit tokens into a pool, borrow tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, withdraw their deposited collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can add new supported assets to the protocol, adjust interest rate models, and pause borrowing or depositing for specific assets. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset is 75%, and a 0.05% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidator. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, withdrawals, and liquidations, including the user's identity, asset, and amount.
source_description: Suilend is a lending protocol on Sui, built by the team behind Solend.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on Pump Party and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming platform's native token, holding a reserve of the token for game payouts and operational expenses. It maintains individual player balances, a global game round identifier, and configurable game parameters such as payout multipliers and entry fees. Players can deposit tokens, participate in game rounds by committing tokens, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can initiate new game rounds, set game parameters, and distribute game winnings to players. The contract enforces a minimum game entry of 100 tokens and a maximum game duration of 120 seconds. It emits events for deposits, withdrawals, game round starts, and game round results.
source_description: Pump Party is a gaming studio which combines industry leading visually evocative gameplay with provably fair gameplay mechanics powered by onchain real-time RNG. Chain multipliers, push your luck, and launch bunnies out of cannons at the speed of real-time

description: Design a payments contract based on Parallel Polkadot DAOfi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a lending pool for a specific fungible token, custodying user deposits of that token. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total amount of the token available for borrowing, and a global interest rate configuration. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens plus accrued interest, and borrow tokens against collateral provided in a separate system. A designated operator can adjust the borrowing interest rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum borrowing interest rate is 20% annually, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address and the amount.
source_description: Parallel Finance is a Decentralized Money Market Protocol that offers lending, staking, and borrowing in the Polkadot ecosystem. Depositors can lend and stake simultaneously to earn double yield on their staked coins, and borrowers can collateralize to borrow.

description: Model a smart account contract based on Humanity and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages unique, non-transferable identity tokens representing proof of personhood, without custodying any other assets. It maintains a record for each identity token, storing its creation timestamp, the address of its owner, and a hash of the biometric proof used for its issuance. Callers can request issuance of a new identity token, revoke an existing identity token they own, and verify the existence and validity of any identity token. A designated operator is privileged to set the fee for new identity token issuance and to pause or unpause issuance. The issuance fee is fixed at 0.001 ether per token and a maximum of one identity token can be issued per unique biometric proof hash. The contract announces events for new identity token issuance, identity token revocation, and changes to the issuance fee or contract pause status.
source_description: Humanity is a decentralized identity protocol that uses palm-based proof-of-personhood, verifiable credentials, and zero-knowledge proofs to let apps verify users without storing personal data.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on JupUSD and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a reserve-backed stablecoin, holding a basket of approved collateral assets. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, individual user balances, and a record of approved collateral types with their respective maximum allocation percentages. Callers can deposit approved collateral to mint stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for an equivalent value of collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust the maximum allocation percentage for existing collateral types, and pause or unpause minting and redemption. The maximum allocation for any single collateral type is 50% of the total collateral value. A 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: JupUSD is a Solana-native, reserve-backed stablecoin pegged to the U.S. dollar, built by Jupiter in partnership with Ethena.

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Derive V2 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures contracts, custodying user collateral in various approved tokens. It maintains individual user accounts with balances, open positions, margin requirements, and a global order book for each trading pair, alongside a configurable set of trading pairs and their parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify existing orders, and settle funding payments. Only a designated operator can add new trading pairs, adjust margin requirements, or pause trading for specific pairs. A maximum of 50 distinct trading pairs can be active at any time, and a flat trading fee of 0.05% is applied to all executed trades. The contract announces all executed trades, funding rate updates, and liquidations to observers.
source_description: Trade options, perps and spot on the most powerful self-custodial exchange.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Printr and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens from participants and distributed tokens from projects. It maintains a record of each participant's staked belief tokens, their allocated project tokens, and global configuration parameters for each launch including the bonding curve type and fee structure. Participants can stake belief tokens, claim project tokens after a launch, and withdraw their unstaked belief tokens; project creators can initiate a new token launch by depositing project tokens and configuring its parameters. A designated owner can set global launch fees, pause launches, and upgrade the contract logic. The maximum staking duration for belief tokens is 180 days, and the platform charges a 2% fee on all project token distributions, paid in the distributed project token. The contract announces when a new launch is created, when participants stake belief tokens, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: Omnichain token launchpad with Proof of Belief staking, configurable fee distribution, custom bonding curves, and anti-PVP mechanics across 8 chains.

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Ondo Global Markets and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the tokenization and trading of real-world equity assets, holding no custody itself but representing ownership of underlying securities held by a regulated custodian. It maintains individual account balances for each tokenized stock, a global configuration for fees, and a whitelist of authorized participants. Callers can deposit funds to purchase tokens, transfer tokens between whitelisted accounts, and redeem tokens for the underlying assets. Only a designated operator can add or remove participants from the whitelist, set the redemption fee, and pause or unpause token transfers. A redemption fee of 0.1% is applied to all redemptions, and transfers are limited to a maximum of 1,000,000 tokens per transaction. The contract announces successful token purchases, redemptions, and transfers.
source_description: Stocks on chain

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on AO Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates secure, cross-chain message passing to a decentralized computation network, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a registry of approved message senders and a nonce for each sender to ensure message ordering. Callers can register a new message sender, update an existing sender's configuration, and dispatch a message to the computation network. Only a designated operator can register or update message senders, and they may set a maximum message size of 1024 bytes. Each dispatched message emits an event containing the sender's address, the message nonce, and the message payload. The contract enforces a minimum delay of 60 seconds between consecutive messages from the same sender.
source_description: A decentralized supercomputer built on top of Arweave's permanent data storage.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on Tessera V and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange with a proprietary automated market maker, holding reserves of two distinct fungible tokens for each trading pair. It maintains a record of each liquidity provider's share of each pool, the current price curve parameters for each pool, and a global fee configuration. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap one token for another within a pool, and query current pool states. A designated operator can adjust the fee percentage for swaps and update the price curve parameters for any pool. Swap fees are fixed at 0.3% of the input amount, and liquidity removal is subject to a 24-hour cooldown period after adding liquidity to prevent rapid arbitrage. The contract emits an event for every liquidity addition, removal, and swap, detailing the tokens and amounts involved.
source_description: Prop AMM on Solana

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on Opyn Gamma and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized options market, holding collateral tokens deposited by option sellers. It maintains records of each user's deposited collateral, active options positions, and the market's overall configuration parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, mint new options, exercise existing options, and withdraw available collateral. A designated owner can adjust the collateral requirement ratio for new options and set the exercise fee. The collateral requirement for minting a new option is fixed at 120% of the option's strike value in the underlying asset. A 0.1% fee is charged on the value of each exercised option, paid in the underlying asset. The contract emits an event whenever an option is minted, exercised, or expires.
source_description: Options market

description: Outline an NFT contract based on Gemint and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation, ownership, and trading of unique digital collectible cards, and it custodies the cards themselves. It maintains individual card ownership records, a global collection of all minted cards, and a configuration for various card attributes and pack contents. Callers can mint new card packs, open packs to reveal cards, trade cards with other users, and burn cards. Only the owner can configure card rarities, set pack prices, and designate approved artists. A maximum of 10,000 unique card designs can exist. Opening a pack incurs a 2% fee on the pack's purchase price, payable to the owner. The contract announces card minting events, pack opening results, and card transfers.
source_description: Gemint is a trading-card platform where users rip packs, battle live, and collect or trade graded cards across TCG and sports categories.

description: Model a prediction market contract based on JackCo and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a no-loss prize savings pool, holding USDC stablecoins deposited by users. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total pooled deposit balance, and configuration parameters for prize draws. Callers can deposit USDC into the pool, withdraw their principal at any time, and claim any prizes they have won. A designated operator can initiate new prize draws, distribute prizes to winners, and update the external yield-generating strategies. The minimum deposit amount is 10 USDC. Prize draws occur weekly, and the prize amount is 90% of the yield generated in the preceding week. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, prize draw initiations, and prize distributions.
source_description: JackCo is a no-loss prize savings protocol on Base. Users deposit USDC which is deployed across Aave, Morpho, and Pendle to generate yield. The yield funds a weekly prize draw (using Chainlink VRF) while 100% of principal is always withdrawable.

description: Specify a payments contract based on Avici and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateral for a crypto-backed spending service, holding deposited stablecoins to secure credit lines. It maintains individual user accounts, each tracking their deposited collateral balance, their current credit line utilization, and a unique account identifier. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw available collateral, and repay outstanding credit line balances. A designated operator can open new user accounts, adjust a user's credit limit based on their collateral, and freeze an account in cases of suspected fraud. The maximum credit line extended to a user cannot exceed 80% of their deposited collateral. A 0.5% fee is applied to all credit line repayments. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or credit line repayment occurs, including the user's account identifier and the amount.
source_description: Avici is a crypto-backed card issuer that lets users deposit crypto, open secured Visa cards, and spend through self-custodial credit lines with Apple Pay and Google Pay support.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Hyperliquid Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the bridging of a specific stablecoin from an external Layer 2 network to a Layer 1 network, holding stablecoin deposits in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance and a total supply of bridged stablecoins. Callers can deposit stablecoins from the external Layer 2, initiating a bridge, and can withdraw their bridged stablecoins back to the external Layer 2. A designated operator can finalize bridge deposits after verification on the Layer 1, and can also pause all bridging operations. The minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces the successful finalization of a deposit and the initiation of a withdrawal.
source_description: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Native USDC is minted on Hyperliquid via CCTP, and USDC is bridged from Arbitrum.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Lavarage and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized spot margin trading platform, holding user collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains individual trading positions for each user, records of available liquidity in various asset pools, and a global configuration for trading parameters. Callers can open new leveraged positions, add collateral to existing positions, close positions, and deposit or withdraw assets from the liquidity pools. Only a designated operator can adjust trading fees, update supported asset pairs, or pause trading for emergency maintenance. A maximum leverage ratio of 10x is enforced for all trades, and a flat 0.1% trading fee is applied to the notional value of each opened or closed position. The contract emits events for every new position opened, every position closed, and every significant change in a user's collateral balance.
source_description: Lavarage is a decentralized spot margin trading platform that enables leveraged token trading on DEXs, backed by stakers and lenders. While it supports a wide range of assets, Lavarage specializes in providing access to long-tail assets, such as memecoins, offering unique opportunities for traders seeking high-potential markets.

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Jupiter Lend DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for lending and borrowing various digital assets, holding deposited tokens as collateral. It maintains per-asset lending pools, per-user borrow and supply positions, and global configuration parameters like interest rate models. Callers can deposit assets to supply liquidity, borrow assets against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their supplied assets. A designated operator is privileged to adjust interest rate model parameters and list new assets, but cannot withdraw user funds. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any asset pair is 75%, and a 0.05% protocol fee is applied to all borrow interest payments. The contract announces asset deposit and withdrawal events, as well as loan origination and repayment events.
source_description: Jupiter Lend DEX, the AMM on Jupiter Lend's shared liquidity layer

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Typhoon Cash and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables private transfers of a fungible token by allowing users to deposit funds and later withdraw them to a different address without linking the deposit and withdrawal. It custodies deposited fungible tokens in a pool. The contract maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a record of spent nullifiers. Callers can deposit funds with a commitment, withdraw funds by providing a valid Merkle proof and nullifier, and relay withdrawals for others. A designated operator can update the Merkle tree root. The maximum deposit amount is 1000 units of the fungible token. A 0.1% fee is charged on each withdrawal, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces deposit commitments and withdrawal nullifiers to observers.
source_description: A New Protocol for Yield-Capable Private Transactions.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on RaiseHood and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract orchestrates fixed-price token launches, holding raised funds and newly minted tokens in escrow until launch conditions are met. It maintains records of individual participant contributions, the total amount raised for each launch, the total supply of tokens offered, and the current state of each launch (active, funded, failed). Callers can contribute funds to an active launch, claim their purchased tokens after a successful launch, or request a refund if a launch fails to meet its funding goal. A designated operator is privileged to initiate new launches, set their parameters, finalize successful launches, and cancel failed launches. Each launch has a minimum funding goal of 100 base units of the accepted currency and a maximum token allocation of 500,000 tokens. The contract emits events for new launch creations, successful contributions, token claims, and refund disbursements.
source_description: Fair-raise token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: fixed-price presales paired with ETH, USDG, or Robinhood stock tokens. Settlement auto-seeds V3 liquidity that is time-locked in the protocol's fee vault, and buyers get mutually exclusive claim-or-refund outcomes

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Frax USD and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting and redemption system, backed by off-chain cash equivalents held by a designated custodian. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, and for each user, it tracks their individual stablecoin balance. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing an equivalent value of a specified collateral token, and they can redeem stablecoins for the collateral token. A designated operator is privileged to update the collateral token address and to pause or unpause all minting and redemption operations. The collateral token must always be a recognized ERC-20 token, and the redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount. The contract announces all minting and redemption events, including the user's address, the amount, and the transaction hash.
source_description: Frax USD (frxUSD) is a fully collateralized stablecoin issued by Frax Finance, combining off-chain custodians holding cash-equivalent reserves with on-chain minting and redemption mechanisms

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Boson Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and fulfillment of commitments to exchange real-world assets for digital tokens, holding digital tokens in escrow until commitments are fulfilled. It maintains a record of each commitment, including the digital token amount, the associated real-world asset identifier, the current status (e.g., pending, fulfilled, disputed), and the participants' addresses. Callers can create new commitments by depositing the required digital tokens, fulfill commitments by confirming real-world asset transfer, dispute commitments within a specified window, and withdraw their digital tokens if a commitment is canceled or resolved in their favor. A designated operator can resolve disputes, cancel commitments under specific conditions, and adjust the dispute resolution fee. The dispute resolution fee is fixed at 0.01 of the committed digital token value. Commitments must be fulfilled within 30 days of creation, or they are automatically canceled. The contract announces when a new commitment is created, when a commitment's status changes, and when a dispute is initiated or resolved.
source_description: Civilization-scale infrastructure for the decentralized exchange of any assets between any agent, human or AI, from everyday commerce to high-value RWAs

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on B-Lucky and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lottery system, holding user ticket purchases and prize funds. It maintains the current lottery round number, the total prize pool for the active round, and a record of each participant's purchased ticket numbers for the current round. Callers can purchase tickets for the current round, claim prizes if their ticket numbers match the winning numbers for a concluded round, and view their past ticket purchases. Only a designated operator can initiate a new lottery round, set the winning numbers for a concluded round, and withdraw accumulated fees. A ticket purchase costs 0.01 units of the native blockchain currency, and a maximum of 100 tickets can be purchased per transaction. The contract announces when a new lottery round begins and when winning numbers are drawn.
source_description: B-Lucky is revolutionizing the lottery industry by bringing it fully on-chain. Unlike traditional lotteries that operate behind closed doors, our protocol is completely transparent, trustless, and permissionless. Built on the Binance Smart Chain, B-Lucky leverages blockchain technology to ensure fairness, transparency, and instant payouts. Every draw, every ticket, and every prize is verifiable on-chain.

description: Design a payments contract based on Sablier Lockup and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates time-locked token distributions, holding custody of deposited ERC-20 tokens until their scheduled release. It maintains individual vesting schedules for each recipient, tracking the total amount deposited for them, the amount already released, and the start and end times of their vesting period. Callers can create new vesting schedules, deposit tokens into existing schedules, and claim their vested tokens. A designated owner can pause all claiming operations and update the contract's fee percentage. A vesting schedule must have a duration of at least one day and at most five years. When claiming tokens, a 0.5% fee is deducted from the claimed amount and transferred to the owner. The contract emits an event whenever a new vesting schedule is created, tokens are deposited, or tokens are claimed.
source_description: Token distribution protocol for onchain vesting and airdrops

description: Define a yield strategy contract based on YO Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault of user-deposited tokens, optimizing their yield across various strategies. It maintains per-user records of deposited amounts and earned yield, and a global configuration for active strategies and their allocations. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, and claim rewards. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, adjust allocations between existing strategies, and pause or unpause deposits. Deposits are capped at a total of 10,000,000 units of the base token, and a 0.5% performance fee is applied to all yield withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to strategy allocations.
source_description: Set it and forget it. YO is your secure multi-chain yield optimizer, continuously rebalancing to deliver the best risk-adjusted yield in DeFi.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Bonker and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding newly created tokens and collected base currency for distribution. It maintains a record of each launched token's configuration, including its total supply, the base currency collected, and the creator's designated reward address. Callers can launch new tokens, contribute base currency to active launches, and claim their purchased tokens once a launch concludes. A designated operator can finalize a launch, initiate token distribution, and update the launchpad's base currency fee. Only the designated operator can set the launch fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of all base currency contributed. Each token launch has a maximum contribution period of 72 hours. The contract announces when a new token launch begins and when a launch concludes, including the total base currency raised and the final token price.
source_description: Creator-first token launchpad on Base with locked liquidity, Uniswap v4 hooks, launch-time MEV protection, and on-chain creator rewards.

description: Define a token contract based on Asymmetry Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking vault for a base asset, issuing a yield-bearing receipt token in return, and custodies deposited base assets and accrued yield. It maintains a total supply of the receipt token, a record of each user's deposited base asset balance, and a current exchange rate between the base asset and the receipt token. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive receipt tokens, redeem receipt tokens for the base asset, and transfer receipt tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on external yield generation and can pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The owner can set the designated operator and can set a protocol fee, which must be between 0% and 5% inclusive. Redemptions are subject to a 24-hour unbonding period after the request is made. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and exchange rate updates to observers.
source_description: Asymmetry Finance is a protocol that creates hybrid liquid staking products with real yield.

description: Define a lending protocol based on BTCFi CDP and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateralized debt positions, holding deposited wrapped Bitcoin and issuing a stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions tracking deposited collateral, minted stablecoin debt, and a global stablecoin supply, alongside configuration parameters like the collateralization ratio and liquidation penalty. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin to open a position, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The owner can set the collateralization ratio, the liquidation penalty, and the address of the price oracle. A position must maintain a minimum collateralization ratio of 150%, and liquidations incur a 10% penalty on the liquidated debt. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, stablecoin mints, stablecoin burns, and liquidations, including the affected user, amounts, and updated position state.
source_description: BTCFi is a decentralized crosschain Bitcoin asset management platform offering native Bitcoin collateralization to mint a Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, BtcUSD.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Solstice and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic stablecoin system, holding collateral tokens and issuing synthetic stablecoins against them. It maintains records of each user's deposited collateral, their minted stablecoin debt, and global system parameters like collateralization ratios and fees. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoins, and withdraw their collateral once debt is cleared. A designated operator can adjust the minimum collateralization ratio and the minting fee, and can pause or unpause minting and withdrawals. The minimum collateralization ratio is fixed at 150%, and a 0.5% fee is charged on all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, mints, and repayments, including the user, asset, and amount.
source_description: Solstice is a synthetic stablecoin protocol built on Solana

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Djed Stablecoin and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a crypto-backed stablecoin, holding reserve tokens and issuing stablecoins. It maintains a global reserve ratio, the total supply of stablecoins, and the total amount of reserve tokens held. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing reserve tokens, burn stablecoins to redeem reserve tokens, and deposit or withdraw reserve tokens as a reserve provider. A designated operator can adjust the reserve ratio target and pause or unpause minting and burning. The minimum reserve ratio must always be at least 400%, and the maximum reserve ratio is capped at 800%. The contract emits events for stablecoin minting, stablecoin burning, reserve token deposits, reserve token withdrawals, and changes to the reserve ratio target.
source_description: Djed is an autonomous crypto-backed stablecoin protocol that has been implemented in multiple smart contract programming languages and deployed to multiple blockchains. The Djed Alliance is a global and open network of contributors with the mission to bring stability to the cryptocurrency industry. It is the steward of the Djed Stablecoin Protocol.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Republic Note and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized representation of a diversified portfolio of private assets, holding no custodied assets itself but reflecting ownership of off-chain holdings. It maintains a total supply of the token, individual balances for each holder, and a record of the current distribution rate for future payouts. Callers can transfer tokens to other addresses, burn tokens they own, and redeem tokens for their underlying value during specific redemption windows. A designated operator is privileged to mint new tokens, pause and unpause transfers, and update the distribution rate. The maximum total supply of tokens is capped at 1,000,000,000 units, and redemptions are only permitted during quarterly windows, each lasting exactly 7 days. The contract announces token transfers, token minting, token burning, and changes to the distribution rate.
source_description: One asset, broad exposure to venture & crypto

description: Specify a governance contract based on Kestrel and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages tokenized DeFi strategies, holding deposited base assets and issuing yield-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains a global total of deposited assets, a redemption price for the receipt token, and per-user balances of issued receipt tokens. Callers can deposit base assets to receive receipt tokens, redeem receipt tokens for base assets, and transfer receipt tokens to other users. A designated operator can update the redemption price based on external strategy performance and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The contract enforces a minimum deposit amount of 100 base asset units and charges a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, deducted from the redeemed base assets. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or redemption occurs, including the user's address, the amount of base assets, and the amount of receipt tokens involved.
source_description: Kestrel turns DeFi strategies into tokens on Solana. Users deposit an asset, receive a yield-bearing token, and redeem it later at the on-chain redemption price

description: Define an NFT contract based on Shiny and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and ownership of unique digital collectible items, representing physical trading cards, and custodies no other assets. It maintains a record of each item's owner, its unique identifier, and a reference to its immutable metadata. Callers can mint new items, transfer ownership of items they possess, and burn items they own. Only a designated operator can mint new items, up to a maximum supply of 10,000 items per unique card type. Item transfers incur a fee of 0.01 ether, payable to the contract owner. The contract announces item minting, item transfers, and item burning events to observers.
source_description: Shiny is a physical trading card game on Base and Abstract

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on Mint Club V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad that custodies base tokens deposited into bonding curve pools. It maintains a record of each created token's bonding curve parameters, including its base token, initial supply, and curve type, along with the current reserves and virtual supply for each pool. Callers can create new tokens, deposit base tokens into a token's bonding curve pool to mint new tokens, and burn tokens to withdraw base tokens from the pool. A designated operator can adjust the platform-wide creation fee and the maximum allowed creator royalty percentage. The platform charges a 0.5% fee on all base token deposits into bonding curve pools, and the maximum creator royalty percentage is capped at 10%. The contract announces token creation events, token minting events, and token burning events.
source_description: Mint Club provides a seamless platform for creating bonding curve-backed tokens or NFTs, using any ERC20 token as the base asset in the bonding curve pool. It facilitates easy tokenization with a completely no-code solution, offering highly customizable bonding curve designs, adjustable creator royalties, a variety of creator tools, and a user-friendly interface for trading bonding curve assets.

description: Design a token launchpad contract based on MerryForge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fair token launches and custodies deposited tokens and native currency for active launch campaigns. It maintains a record of each launch campaign's configuration, including its bonding curve parameters, total supply, and current native currency balance, alongside individual participant balances and their locked liquidity positions. Callers can create new launch campaigns, deposit native currency into active campaigns, claim their purchased tokens after a campaign concludes, and withdraw their share of native currency from completed campaigns. A designated operator can pause or unpause the contract, and only the creator of a launch campaign can finalize it. Each launch campaign must have a minimum native currency deposit of 100 units to activate, and a 2% fee is applied to all native currency withdrawals from completed campaigns. The contract emits an event upon the creation of a new launch campaign, when native currency is deposited, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Fair launches, fixed supply, bonding curves, creator bonds & locked liquidity.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Sierra and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized reserve currency protocol that mints a stablecoin and custodies various reserve assets. It maintains a total supply of the stablecoin, individual account balances for the stablecoin, and a mapping of reserve asset types to their held quantities. Callers can deposit approved reserve assets to mint new stablecoins, redeem stablecoins for a proportional share of the reserve assets, and transfer stablecoins to other accounts. A designated operator can add new reserve asset types and adjust their collateralization ratios, and can also pause or unpause stablecoin minting and redemption. The minimum collateralization ratio for any reserve asset is 100%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions, paid in the redeemed reserve asset. The contract announces all stablecoin minting, redemption, and transfer events, along with any changes to reserve asset types or their collateralization ratios.
source_description: Sierra is a decentralized reserve currency protocol available on the Avalanche Network based on the SRA token.

description: Design a governance contract based on Mitosis and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquidity management vault for programmable liquidity, holding deposited tokens and issuing receipt tokens representing staked positions. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens and receipt tokens, a global pool of all staked tokens, and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their deposited tokens, transfer their receipt tokens to other users, and redeem their receipt tokens for the underlying staked assets. Only a designated operator can adjust the fee structure, pause deposits, or upgrade the contract logic. A deposit fee of 0.1% is applied to all deposits, and a minimum deposit amount of 100 units of the deposited token is enforced. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and receipt token transfers to observers.
source_description: Mitosis is an L1 network designed for programmable liquidity that enhances the liquidity provision experience for both DeFi projects and liquidity providers. With Mitosis, DeFi projects can conduct targeted marketing to attract liquidity. Liquidity providers can trade tokenized LP positions on the Mitosis chain, allowing users to easily trade yield positions..

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Balancer V3 and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a flexible vault for managing and swapping diverse digital assets within various customizable liquidity pools. It maintains a global registry of all created pools, their configurations including swap fees and asset weights, and individual user balances for each asset held within the vault. Callers can deposit assets into the vault, withdraw their deposited assets, initiate swaps between assets in available pools, and create new liquidity pools with specified parameters. A designated operator has the exclusive privilege to pause all swap operations and to update the protocol-wide base swap fee. The maximum number of assets allowed in any single liquidity pool is 8. All swap fees are capped at 1.0% of the swap amount and are directed to a protocol treasury address. The contract announces events for every asset deposit, asset withdrawal, swap execution, and new pool creation, including the relevant asset identifiers, amounts, and participant addresses.
source_description: Balancer V3 is a decentralized AMM protocol featuring a flexible vault architecture and customizable pools with dynamic swap fees and hooks for tailored liquidity management.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Organic Growth and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the instant launch of new, tradeable tokens by automatically pairing them with a base currency. It custodies the base currency provided by token creators and the newly minted tokens until they are traded. The contract maintains a record of each deployed token's total supply, its current base currency balance, and the creator's address. Callers can create a new token, which automatically establishes a base currency trading pair, and trade existing tokens against the base currency. Only the contract owner can set the base currency pair creation fee, which is fixed at 2 units of the base currency. The contract emits an event whenever a new token is created, including the token's address and its initial supply.
source_description: Launch a coin that is instantly tradeable without having to seed liquidity. Deploy a coin for 2 XTZ in one click.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on FerdyFlip and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market where users bet on the outcome of a binary event, specifically a coin flip, and custodies user deposits and winnings. It maintains individual user balances, a total contract balance for payouts, and a configurable house edge percentage. Callers can deposit funds, place a bet specifying their prediction and wager amount, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can update the house edge percentage and initiate a contract shutdown, preventing new bets. The minimum bet amount is 0.01 ether, and the house edge is fixed at 2.5% of every wager. The contract announces when a new bet is placed, the outcome of a flip, and when a user's balance changes due to a win or withdrawal.
source_description: Decentralized casino with revenue share. No KYC and instant settlements.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Enosys Loans and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages collateralized debt positions, holding deposited collateral tokens and minting a stablecoin token. It maintains individual debt positions for each borrower, recording their deposited collateral, minted stablecoin debt, and a dynamic liquidation price, alongside global system parameters like the collateralization ratio and stability pool balances. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoins to reduce their debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust system parameters, such as the minimum collateralization ratio, and pause borrowing in emergencies. The minimum collateralization ratio is 110%, and a 0.5% stability fee is charged on new stablecoin mints. The contract announces events for new collateral deposits, stablecoin mints, repayments, liquidations, and parameter changes.
source_description: Liquity V2 fork on Flare

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on P2PFlip and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer coin flip challenges and custodies player stakes in supported tokens. It maintains a record of active challenges, including the challenger, the challenged, the token and amount staked by each, and the outcome once resolved, along with a list of supported tokens and their associated protocol fees. Callers can initiate a challenge, accept an existing challenge, reveal their chosen outcome for a challenge they accepted, and claim winnings from a resolved challenge. A designated operator can add or remove supported tokens and adjust the protocol fee for each token. Each challenge requires both players to stake an identical amount of the chosen token, and the protocol fee is fixed at 1% of the total pot. The contract announces when a new challenge is created, when a challenge is accepted, and when a challenge is resolved with a winner.
source_description: A peer-to-peer gambling protocol on Matchain where users can create and accept coin flip challenges with supported tokens. Players stake equal amounts, with the winner taking the pot minus a small protocol fee. The platform features Express Mode for gasless gameplay through session-based deposits and an automated relayer system for faster user experience.

description: Define a lending protocol based on Pando Leaf and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a collateralized debt position manager, holding deposited collateral tokens and issuing a new debt token against them. It maintains individual user positions tracking deposited collateral amounts, minted debt amounts, and a global configuration for collateral types and their parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral, borrow debt tokens against their collateral, repay outstanding debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated administrator can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and set liquidation thresholds. Each collateral type must maintain a minimum collateralization ratio of 150%, and the maximum debt that can be minted against any single collateral type is capped at 1,000,000 debt tokens. The contract emits events when collateral is deposited, debt is borrowed, debt is repaid, and collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: Pando Leaf: a decentralized financial network to minting stablecoins

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Token Mill and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of new token launches, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base tokens, their allocated project tokens, and the current state of each launch pool, including its total base token deposits and the project token supply. Callers can deposit base tokens into an active launch pool, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch period, and withdraw any remaining base tokens if a launch is cancelled. A designated owner can create new launch pools, set their parameters, initiate the launch period, and cancel a launch, while a designated operator can only update the project token allocation ratio before a launch begins. Each launch pool has a fixed duration of 7 days and a maximum project token supply of 1,000,000 units. The contract announces when a new launch pool is created, when a user deposits base tokens, and when a user claims project tokens.
source_description: Token Mill is Trader Joe's new DEX live on Avalanche and Solana.

description: Design a token contract based on xWin Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for yield-generating strategies, holding various ERC-20 tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user balances, a total value locked for each strategy, and configuration parameters for approved strategies. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens into a chosen strategy, withdraw their share of deposited tokens and accrued yield, and view their current balance and the vault's total assets. A designated operator can add new strategies, update existing strategy parameters, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals for specific strategies. A 0.5% performance fee is deducted from all yield generated before distribution to users. Withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour cooldown period after a deposit into the same strategy. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy updates.
source_description: xWIN Finance is a decentralized finance platform that brings innovation and accessibility to the world of crypto investments. With our unique robo-advisor engine, anyone can create a personalized portfolio of cryptocurrency assets and strategies with just a few clicks.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Shinjo and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a principal-protected prize game, holding user deposits of a specified ERC-20 token. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total prize pool, and a configuration for game rounds. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their principal after a round concludes, and claim prizes if they win. A designated operator can initiate new game rounds, distribute prizes to winners, and update the maximum number of winners per round. Each deposit must be at least 100 units of the ERC-20 token, and a new round cannot be initiated until 24 hours after the previous one ended. The contract announces when a new round begins, when prizes are distributed, and when a user deposits or withdraws.
source_description: Principal-protected optionality. Shinjo is a a game to 'get ahead' that doesn't punish players: deposits → yield → random prize distributions.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on WAX.FUN and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the fair launch of new tokens by managing a temporary liquidity pool and distributing the newly minted tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited Ether and their corresponding share of the new tokens, along with the total Ether contributed and the total new tokens to be distributed. Callers can contribute Ether to the pool, claim their allocated new tokens after the launch period, and withdraw any remaining Ether if the launch conditions are not met. Only the contract owner can set the launch parameters, including the minimum Ether required for launch and the total supply of new tokens, and initiate the token distribution. The launch period is fixed at 24 hours from the time the minimum Ether threshold is met, and a 1% fee on all contributed Ether is automatically transferred to a designated treasury address upon successful launch. The contract announces the start of the launch period, the successful completion of the launch, and the distribution of tokens to participants.
source_description: WAX.FUN is a fair-launch token creation platform with no presale or team allocation

description: Outline a payments contract based on Unlock Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages on-chain memberships, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a record of active memberships for each user, including their expiration date, and stores configuration parameters for each membership type, such as its price and duration. Callers can purchase new memberships, extend existing ones, and transfer their memberships to another user. Only a designated operator can create new membership types and adjust their pricing. Each membership purchase must be for a minimum duration of 7 days, and a 5% protocol fee is applied to all new membership purchases. The contract emits an event whenever a new membership is purchased or an existing one is transferred.
source_description: Unlock is an open source protocol for onchain memberships & subscriptions

description: Create a staking contract based on Lista Liquid Staking and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism for a base asset, holding deposited base assets and issuing a yield-bearing liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the total amount of base asset deposited, and a mapping of each user's liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset. A designated operator can adjust the staking yield rate, and only the owner can upgrade the contract or pause all operations. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.1% of the redeemed amount, and a minimum deposit of 0.01 base asset is required. The contract announces deposit and redemption events, including the user's address and the amounts involved.
source_description: Lista Liquid Staking is the yield bearing & liquid staking token for Lista DAO, which appreciates against BNB in line with BNB's staking APR.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Stakee and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking pool for a native asset, custodying deposited tokens and distributing staking rewards. It maintains a global record of the total staked amount, the current reward rate, and each user's individual deposit balance and accumulated rewards. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their principal and earned rewards, and claim only their accumulated rewards. Only a designated operator can update the reward rate and initiate a new staking period. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the native asset, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from all withdrawals. The contract announces a "Deposit Made" event and a "Withdrawal Processed" event, each including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Earn TON with best APY at most profitable staking service.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Lista CDP and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a collateralized debt position (CDP) manager, holding various approved crypto assets as collateral and minting a stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral amounts, borrowed stablecoin amounts, and each position's health factor, along with global system configuration like approved collateral tokens and their parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral, borrow the stablecoin against their collateral, repay borrowed stablecoin, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate unhealthy positions. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and pause borrowing or liquidations. The minimum collateralization ratio for any position is 150%, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied to the liquidated amount. The contract announces collateral deposits, stablecoin mints, stablecoin burns, and liquidations.
source_description: Lista DAO functions as a open-source liquidity protocol for earning yields on collateralized Crypto assets (BNB, ETH, Stablecoins, and other cryptocurrencies) and borrowing of our decentralized stablecoin, lisUSD. It uses and expands the proven MakerDAO model for a decentralized, unbiased, collateral-backed destablecoin

description: Design a governance contract based on Treehouse Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and redemption of fixed-rate debt instruments, holding underlying collateral tokens. It maintains a record of each user's outstanding debt positions, the total supply of each debt instrument, and a global configuration for issuance parameters. Callers can create new debt positions by depositing collateral, redeem their debt positions by repaying the principal and accrued interest, and transfer their debt positions to other users. Only a designated operator can adjust the interest rate for new debt instruments or pause all new debt issuance. The maximum duration for any debt instrument is 365 days, and a 0.1% origination fee is applied to all new debt positions, paid in the underlying collateral. The contract announces when a new debt position is created, when a debt position is redeemed, and when the interest rate for new instruments is updated.
source_description: Treehouse is a decentralized application that introduces Treehouse Assets (tAssets) and Decentralized Offered Rates (DOR), new primitives that enable fixed income products in digital assets.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Anome and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of fractionalized NFT derivatives and manages their lending and borrowing. It custodies original ERC-721 NFTs deposited by users and ERC-20 tokens used as collateral or borrowed. The contract maintains a record of each deposited NFT's unique identifier and its associated derivative token supply, per-user balances of derivative tokens, active loan positions including principal, interest rate, and collateral, and global configuration parameters such as interest rate models and fee percentages. Callers can deposit NFTs to mint derivative tokens, borrow ERC-20 tokens against their derivative tokens, repay loans, liquidate undercollateralized loans, and redeem derivative tokens for the underlying NFT. A designated operator can adjust global interest rate parameters and set the platform fee, which is fixed at 0.5% of all interest payments. The contract enforces a minimum loan-to-value ratio of 50% for all active loans. The contract announces events for NFT deposits, derivative token minting, loan originations, loan repayments, liquidations, and NFT redemptions.
source_description: Anome is a NFT derivative issuance and lending platform that is firstly applied in fully on-chain gaming scenarios.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Gearbox and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a leveraged lending pool, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains individual account records for each borrower, tracking their deposited collateral, outstanding debt, and current health factor, along with global pool balances for each supported asset and a list of approved collateral tokens. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow assets against their collateral, repay outstanding debt, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. Only a designated owner can add or remove supported collateral tokens, adjust interest rates, or pause borrowing. A borrower's health factor must remain above 1.05 to avoid liquidation, and a liquidation penalty of 5% is applied to the liquidated collateral. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events, including the affected account and asset amounts.
source_description: Gearbox Protocol is building a permissionless credit layer. Designed for seamless wallet integrations, reimagining traditional lending. So you can lend, borrow, or 10x leverage - directly inside your favorite wallets in one click.

description: Design a prediction market contract based on CatsLuck and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits and payouts for various event outcomes. It maintains records of active prediction events, their possible outcomes, the total staked amount for each outcome, and individual user stakes per outcome, alongside a global fee treasury. Callers can create new prediction events, stake funds on an outcome, withdraw their staked funds before an event concludes, claim winnings after an event resolves, and deposit funds into the fee treasury. Only a designated operator can resolve an event by declaring a winning outcome and setting a resolution timestamp. A 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts, which is directed to the fee treasury. Each prediction event has a maximum of 8 possible outcomes. The designated operator cannot resolve an event until at least 24 hours after its creation.
