The contract announces event creation, stake placement, stake withdrawal, event resolution, and winning claims.
source_description: CatsLuck is a prediction market platform allowing everyone to bet on events, play the lottery and more.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on OpenDAO and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a stablecoin minting protocol that custodies various collateral tokens. It maintains a global configuration for acceptable collateral types and their associated parameters, and per-user records of deposited collateral and minted stablecoins. Callers can deposit approved collateral, mint stablecoins against their deposited collateral, repay stablecoins to unlock collateral, and withdraw their unlocked collateral. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and set stability fees. The minimum collateralization ratio for any collateral type is 120%, and a 0.5% stability fee is charged on all minted stablecoins. The contract announces successful stablecoin minting events, collateral deposit events, and collateral withdrawal events.
source_description: The Permissionless Stablecoin Minting Protocol, Mint USDO with the tokens you own. Trade USDO for the tokens you want.

description: Define a decentralized exchange contract based on HawkFi and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates automated, concentrated liquidity provision for two token pairs, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users. It maintains per-user records of deposited token amounts, active liquidity positions, and accrued fees, alongside global configuration parameters for each token pair. Callers can deposit tokens, create new liquidity positions, adjust existing positions, claim accrued fees, and withdraw their deposited tokens. A designated operator can adjust the fee tier for new positions, whitelist new token pairs, and pause all user interactions in an emergency. The maximum number of active liquidity positions per user is limited to 10. A 0.1% protocol fee is levied on all claimed fees. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, position creations, position adjustments, and fee claims, including the user's identifier, token amounts, and position details.
source_description: HawkFi is the leading analytics & automation platform for on-chain market makers to get the smartest yield on Solana memecoins and ecosystem tokens. HawkFi currently automates market making for Meteora DLMM (Dynamic Liquidity Market Making) and Orca CLMM (Concentrated Liquidity Market Making).

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on Sentry and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token launchpad, custodying newly minted ERC-20 tokens and the liquidity provider tokens representing a concentrated-liquidity pool. It maintains a record of launched tokens, their associated concentrated-liquidity pool addresses, and the protocol treasury's accumulated fees. Callers can launch a new ERC-20 token, providing an initial supply and a base currency for the liquidity pool, and claim their share of collected liquidity provider fees. The owner can set the protocol fee percentage and designate a treasury address to receive protocol fees. A newly launched token must have an initial supply between 1,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 units, and the protocol fee for collected liquidity provider fees is fixed at 35%. The contract announces when a new token has been launched and when protocol fees have been collected.
source_description: Sentry is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: one-click ERC-20 launches with a Uniswap V3 pool seeded at launch and the LP position permanently locked in the factory. LP fees split 65/35 between the token creator and the protocol treasury.

description: Specify a derivatives contract based on WaterX and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in various approved digital assets. It maintains individual user accounts with collateral balances, open positions (long/short, asset, size, entry price), and a global configuration for trading parameters and approved assets. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated administrator role can add or remove approved collateral assets, adjust trading fees, and pause all trading operations. Each trading pair will have a maximum leverage of 50x, and a flat trading fee of 0.05% of the notional value is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closings, including the affected user, asset, amount, and relevant position details.
source_description: AI-native trading engine on Sui Network

description: Create a derivatives contract based on GMTrade and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual derivatives exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders. It maintains individual account balances, isolated liquidity pools for different trading pairs, and open positions for each trader. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify leverage, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading parameters, add new trading pairs, and initiate emergency shutdowns. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and parameter changes.
source_description: GMTrade is a perpetual DEX built on Solana that supports both crypto and RWA markets. The protocol utilizes isolated liquidity pools combined with a cross-pool coordination system that optimizes liquidity utilization. It aims to provide a seamless trading experience with fast execution and low fees while maintaining security and decentralization.

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on ShibaSwap V1 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding staked tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains a total staked balance, a per-staker record of their staked amount and accumulated rewards, and a global reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens to stake, withdraw their staked tokens and any accumulated rewards, and claim only their accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate, and only the owner can pause all staking operations. The minimum staking period for any deposit is 7 days. A 0.5% fee is applied to all reward withdrawals, deducted from the rewards themselves. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, reward claim events, and reward rate updates.
source_description: SHIB, LEASH, and BONE, come together to create ShibaSwap, the next evolution in DeFi platforms. ShibaSwap gives users the ability to DIG (provide liquidity), BURY (stake), and SWAP tokens to gain WOOF Returns through our sophisticated and innovative passive income reward system.

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Bubblegum and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market launchpad, holding deposited collateral for market creation and user predictions. It maintains individual user balances of deposited collateral, the current bonding curve parameters for each prediction market, and the total collateral locked per market. Callers can create new prediction markets by depositing a minimum of 100 units of collateral, buy "YES" or "NO" shares for existing markets, sell "YES" or "NO" shares back to the bonding curve, and claim winnings after a market resolves. Only a designated operator can resolve a prediction market, declaring the outcome as "YES" or "NO". A 0.5% fee is applied to all share purchases and sales, directed to a treasury. The contract emits an event whenever shares are bought or sold, including the market identifier, the user's address, the share type, and the amount.
source_description: Bubblegum is a prediction-market launchpad on Solana (pump.fun-style bonding curves that graduate into YES/NO prediction markets)

description: Specify a payments contract based on Gnosis Pay and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user payment accounts and their associated balances, holding deposited stablecoins. It maintains individual account balances for each user, a global fee treasury balance, and a configurable transaction fee percentage. Callers can deposit stablecoins into their account, transfer stablecoins to another account, and withdraw stablecoins from their account. A designated operator can set the transaction fee percentage and withdraw accumulated fees from the treasury. The maximum transaction fee percentage is 0.5%. All transfers incur a 0.1% fee, deducted from the sender's amount. The contract announces successful deposits, transfers, and withdrawals, including the amounts and involved accounts.
source_description: Gnosis Pay is a decentralized payments infrastructure.

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Spiral Fi Mixer and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a single designated fungible token by allowing users to deposit tokens and later withdraw them to a different address, obscuring the link between deposit and withdrawal. It maintains a list of unspent commitment hashes and a record of nullifiers that have been spent. Callers can deposit tokens by providing a commitment hash, and can withdraw tokens by providing a valid proof, a nullifier, and a recipient address. A designated operator can update the designated fungible token address and set the deposit fee. The deposit fee is fixed at 0.1% of the deposited amount. Each withdrawal must be for the exact amount of the initial deposit, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 of the designated fungible token. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, indicating the commitment hash and the deposit amount, and an event upon each successful withdrawal, indicating the nullifier and the recipient.
source_description: Spiral finance is a fully decentralized non-custodial protocol allowing private transactions on-chain.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on BusinessBuildersNFTs and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and distribution of unique digital assets representing virtual businesses within a gaming ecosystem, holding no custodied funds itself. It maintains a registry of all minted business assets, each with an assigned owner, a specific business type, and a unique identifier. Callers can mint new business assets, transfer ownership of their owned business assets to another address, and query the details of any existing business asset. Only a designated operator can mint new business assets, and they can also pause all transfers of business assets. A maximum of 10,000 business assets can ever be minted, and a transfer fee of 0.01 units of the platform's native currency is applied to each successful transfer. The contract announces the minting of new business assets and the transfer of existing ones through events.
source_description: BusinessBuildersNFTs is a ecosystem based on the blockcchain and NFTs technologies. You can build your own city, create your own business hiring and firing employees and create your own community in our DAPPs. We created an scalable ecosystem including new projects and integrations little by little improving the main project sustainability.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Stellar DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for trading various digital assets, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users. It maintains individual account balances for each asset, a global order book for each trading pair, and configuration parameters for fees. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens, create offers to buy or sell assets at a specific price, and cancel their existing offers. A designated operator can adjust the trading fee percentage and pause all trading activity. The maximum number of active offers per user is 100. A flat trading fee of 0.1% is applied to the taker of each trade. The contract announces offer creations, offer cancellations, and successful trades to observers.
source_description: The Stellar network acts as a decentralized distributed exchange that allows users to trade and convert assets with the network's Offer operations

description: Design a governance contract based on Prime Vaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages principal-protected, minimum-yield deposits for a single designated base token, acting as a vault for user funds. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total principal deposited, and a global configuration for yield parameters. Callers can deposit base tokens, withdraw their deposited principal and accrued yield, and claim their share of the guaranteed yield. A designated operator can adjust the minimum guaranteed yield rate, which must be between 0.5% and 5.0% annually, and initiate a yield distribution event. The contract owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the user's address, the amount, and the new balance.
source_description: An on-chain savings account with principal protection and minimum yield guarantee (higher than Aave V3 supply rate)

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on vfat.io and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator vault that custodies user-deposited tokens and manages their deployment into various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, their share of the vault's total assets, and a configuration for each approved yield strategy. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their share of assets, and claim any accrued rewards. A designated operator can add new yield strategies, update existing strategy parameters, and pause all deposits. The maximum number of active yield strategies is limited to 10. A 0.5% performance fee is applied to all harvested yield before distribution. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and strategy rebalances.
source_description: vfat.io is a yield aggregator, underpinned by Sickle, a smart contract wallet for yield farming. It reduces complex operations such as entering/exiting positions, compounding, or rebalancing into single transactions, while maintaining self-custody

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on BlackDoor and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages geo-anchored prediction markets, holding deposited stablecoins as collateral for market outcomes. It maintains a record of each market's location, resolution status, total liquidity, and individual user positions, alongside global configuration parameters like market creation fees and resolution delays. Callers can create new markets, provide liquidity to existing markets, make predictions by swapping between outcome tokens, and redeem their winnings after market resolution. A designated operator can resolve markets by providing an outcome, and the owner can adjust global fees, market creation parameters, and designate new operators. Each market creation requires a fixed fee of 10 stablecoins, and market resolution is delayed by at least 24 hours after the designated operator submits an outcome. The contract emits an event whenever a new market is created, liquidity is added or removed, a prediction is made, or a market is resolved.
source_description: Geo-anchored prediction markets on Arbitrum One. Each market is pinned to a real-world location on an interactive globe. Powered by FPMM, settled in USDC

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Anvil and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a collateral manager, holding various ERC-20 tokens as collateral for issued credit. It maintains individual collateral balances for each user, a global debt ceiling, and a list of approved collateral tokens with their respective collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw excess collateral, borrow against their collateral, and repay their outstanding debt. A designated administrator can add or remove approved collateral tokens, adjust collateral factors, and set the global debt ceiling. The maximum collateral factor for any token is 90%, and the global debt ceiling is fixed at 1,000,000 units of the stablecoin used for borrowing. The contract emits an event whenever collateral is deposited, withdrawn, or when debt is borrowed or repaid.
source_description: Anvil is a DeFi protocol for onchain collateral management that allows users to issue fully secured credit.

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Poly Network and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates secure cross-chain asset transfers, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow during transit. It maintains a record of each user's deposited assets awaiting transfer, a global mapping of supported token addresses on each connected chain, and a queue of pending cross-chain operations. Callers can deposit tokens for transfer, initiate a cross-chain transfer specifying the destination chain and recipient, and claim transferred tokens on the destination chain. A designated operator is privileged to approve new supported token mappings and to finalize cross-chain transfers after verification. The maximum number of tokens that can be transferred in a single operation is 1,000,000 units of any supported token, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all cross-chain transfers. The contract announces an event upon every successful token deposit and another event when a cross-chain transfer is successfully completed.
source_description: Poly Network is a global cross-chain protocol for implementing blockchain interoperability and building Web3.0 infrastructure. Poly Network has also integrated over 20 blockchains.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on nest CL and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized exchange of tokens through a network of smart pools, holding deposited tokens within these pools. It maintains records of each pool's token reserves, the current exchange rate for each token pair, and configuration parameters such as fees and minimum deposit amounts. Callers can deposit tokens into a pool, withdraw tokens from a pool, swap one token for another, and query current pool states. A designated operator can adjust pool parameters, such as the swap fee, and add new token pairs to the exchange. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and the minimum deposit for any token into a pool is 100 units of that token. The contract emits an event upon every successful swap, detailing the tokens exchanged and their amounts.
source_description: NEST is built for Hyperliquid. Smart pools and efficient swaps power onchain rewards that compound value back to voters and the ecosystem.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on Hedgehog Markets and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market where users can stake tokens on the outcome of future events, holding user deposits in escrow until market resolution. It maintains individual user balances for each market outcome, a total staked amount for each outcome, and configuration parameters for each market. Callers can create new markets, deposit tokens into an outcome, withdraw tokens from an outcome before it closes, and claim their winnings after a market is resolved. A designated operator can create new markets and resolve existing markets. Each market must have at least two and no more than ten possible outcomes. A 5% fee is applied to all winning payouts, deducted from the payout amount. The contract announces market creation, deposit events, withdrawal events, and market resolution with winning outcomes.
source_description: Hedgehog Markets is the first Prediction Market market platform on Solana. They offer various markets types and markets that cover any and all topics

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on ArrowPad.fun and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates token launches, holding deposited tokens from participants and the new project tokens from the project creator. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and their allocated project tokens, along with the total project token supply and the current launch phase. Callers can deposit funds during the open phase, claim their allocated project tokens after the launch concludes, and withdraw any remaining deposited funds if the launch is canceled. The owner can set the project token address, define the launch phases, and cancel a launch. The project token allocation ratio is fixed at 1000 project tokens per 1 unit of deposited currency. A minimum deposit of 10 units of deposited currency is required for participation. The contract announces when a launch phase changes and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: ArrowPad.fun is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain

description: Define a privacy-preserving contract based on Sherpa Cash and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a single specified fungible token by allowing users to deposit funds and later withdraw them to a different address without linking the two transactions. It maintains a Merkle tree of deposit commitments and a record of spent nullifiers, preventing double-spends. Callers can deposit tokens, generating a unique commitment, and later withdraw tokens by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof that corresponds to an unspent commitment and a unique nullifier. A designated relayer can submit withdrawal transactions on behalf of users, receiving a small fee. Only the contract owner can update the Merkle tree verifier contract address or pause deposits. The deposit amount is fixed at 1 AVAX for all deposits, and the relayer fee is 0.01 AVAX per withdrawal. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, including the commitment hash, and another event upon each successful withdrawal, including the nullifier.
source_description: A fully decentralized protocol for private transactions on Avalanche.

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on OpenTrade and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoins for lending to approved borrowers, holding deposited stablecoins as collateral. It maintains individual account balances for each depositor, a global pool of available stablecoins, and a record of active loans with their terms. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim earned yield. Approved borrowers can request new loans, repay outstanding loans, and draw down approved loan tranches. The contract owner can set the interest rate, approve new borrowers, and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 80%, and the minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit is made, a withdrawal occurs, or a loan is issued.
source_description: Fintechs around the world use OpenTrade to power safe, compliant stablecoin yield products.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on ZEROBASE CeDeFi and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin staking pool, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing yield-bearing tokens. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoins, their corresponding yield-bearing token shares, and the total stablecoins held in the pool, along with a global configuration for the yield distribution rate. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their deposited stablecoins and accrued yield, and claim their yield-bearing tokens. A designated operator can adjust the yield distribution rate and pause deposits in emergencies. The minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events.
source_description: ZEROBASE introduces the first zk-powered staking product on stablecoins

description: Create a token contract based on Amigo and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables users to acquire and trade fractional ownership in creator economies, holding a fungible token representing a share of a creator's future revenue. It maintains a registry of creators, each with an associated bonding curve that determines token price, and tracks each user's token balances for every creator. Users can buy creator tokens by depositing the base currency, sell creator tokens to receive the base currency, and claim their share of collected creator revenue. A designated operator can register new creators, update creator revenue distributions, and set the platform-wide trading fee. The maximum supply for any single creator's token is capped at 1,000,000 units. A 0.5% trading fee is applied to all token purchases and sales, which is distributed proportionally to token holders. The contract emits events when tokens are bought, sold, or when revenue is distributed to holders.
source_description: Own a stake in creators you believe in.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Compound V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending pool for a single base asset, holding deposited base assets and any accrued interest. It maintains per-account records of deposited base assets, borrowed base assets, collateral supplied in various accepted collateral assets, and accumulated interest for both deposits and borrows, alongside global configuration for interest rates, collateral factors, and asset listings. Callers can deposit base assets, withdraw base assets, supply collateral assets, withdraw collateral assets, borrow base assets, repay borrowed base assets, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated administrator can list new collateral assets, set interest rate models, adjust collateral factors, pause specific operations, and upgrade the contract's logic. The maximum collateral factor for any asset is 80%, and a 0.5% liquidation bonus is applied to liquidators. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, liquidations, and configuration changes.
source_description: Compound is an algorithmic, autonomous interest rate protocol built for developers, to unlock a universe of open financial applications.

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Usual ETH0 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues a synthetic token representing a claim on an equivalent amount of a liquid staking derivative token, which it custodies. It maintains the total supply of the synthetic token, the balance of the synthetic token for each account, and the current exchange rate between the synthetic token and the underlying liquid staking derivative. Callers can deposit the liquid staking derivative to mint the synthetic token, withdraw their synthetic tokens to redeem the underlying liquid staking derivative, and transfer synthetic tokens to other accounts. A designated operator can update the exchange rate between the synthetic token and the underlying liquid staking derivative. The contract enforces a minimum deposit of 0.01 liquid staking derivative tokens and charges a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals. The contract emits an event when tokens are minted, redeemed, or transferred, and when the exchange rate is updated.
source_description: ETH0 is a synthetic Ethereum-based asset fully collateralized by Lido’s wrapped staked ETH (wstETH).

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Astros Perp and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding user collateral in a vault to back open positions. It maintains individual user accounts with their collateral balances, open positions including leverage and direction, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and supported trading pairs. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, modify leverage on open positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading pair parameters, update oracle addresses, and pause trading for specific pairs. A maximum leverage of 100x is enforced for all positions, and a 0.1% opening fee is charged on the notional value of new positions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and significant configuration changes.
source_description: Astros Perp DEX is the next-generation on-chain perp dex on the Sui Network to deliver unmatched performance and scalability.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on OCTOplace and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited tokens and escrowed funds for sales. It maintains a record of listed items including their seller, price, and current status, as well as balances for each user's escrowed funds. Callers can list a non-fungible token for sale, cancel an existing listing, make an offer on a listed item, accept an offer, and withdraw their available escrowed funds. The owner can set the marketplace fee and pause all trading activity. A listing fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each new listing, and the maximum number of active listings per user is 50. The contract announces when an item is listed, an offer is made, an offer is accepted, and an item is purchased.
source_description: Multi-chain social NFT marketplace

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Neo Tokyo and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token-gated membership system for a decentralized gaming community, holding a designated membership token. It maintains a record of each member's entry date and their current membership status, along with a global configuration for membership tiers. Callers can apply for membership by depositing the required tokens, renew their membership, or withdraw their deposited tokens if their membership has expired. A designated operator can set the required token amount for each membership tier and revoke memberships for cause. Membership requires a minimum deposit of 100 membership tokens, and renewal extends membership by 365 days. The contract emits an event when a new member joins and when a membership is revoked.
source_description: The Crypto Gaming Illuminati - Builders, Developers, Founders, and Investors creating the metaverse from the heart of The Citadel

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on BetFolio and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market where users bet on the future performance of baskets of digital assets, holding deposited collateral tokens to back user positions. It maintains individual user balances of collateral, records of open prediction positions including their strike prices and expiration dates, and a global configuration for market parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, open new prediction positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated administrator can set market fees, pause market operations, and resolve expired prediction positions. A 0.5% fee is applied to all collateral deposits, and positions must be opened at least 24 hours before their expiration. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and position resolutions.
source_description: A Prediction Market for Crypto Portfolios.

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Pillar and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and redemption of a decentralized stablecoin, holding a reserve of a designated collateral asset. It maintains individual stablecoin balances for each user, the total supply of the stablecoin, and a global collateral reserve. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and pause or unpause stablecoin minting. The collateralization ratio must always be between 120% and 180%, and the minimum collateral deposit for minting is 100 units of the collateral asset. The contract emits events for stablecoin minting, redemption, and transfers, and for changes to the collateralization ratio.
source_description: A decentralized protocol to govern stablecoin issuance on the Zilliqa Blockchain.

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Odyssey Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user deposits for automated yield strategies, holding various ERC-20 tokens. It maintains individual user balances for each deposited token, a record of active strategies, and global configuration parameters. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and initiate a new yield strategy with their deposited funds. A designated operator can add new supported ERC-20 tokens, update strategy parameters, and pause all deposits. The maximum number of active strategies per user is limited to 5. A 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event when a deposit occurs and when a withdrawal is processed.
source_description: Odyssey is a DeFi super-app that uses ERC-4337 smart accounts to let users run gasless, cross-chain strategies with tools like Loopr, Bundlr, and Yieldr, all in one interface

description: Create a token contract based on YIEDL Vaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a single ERC-20 token, holding user deposits and distributing investment returns. It maintains individual user balances, a total deposited amount, and a current investment strategy identifier. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their principal and accrued returns, and claim their share of any distributed rewards. A designated operator can update the investment strategy identifier, initiate a distribution of rewards to depositors, and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. Deposits must be at least 100 units of the ERC-20 token, and withdrawals incur a 0.5% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events, including the amount and recipient.
source_description: YIEDL presents an innovative solution to the limitations of traditional asset management systems, leveraging AI and blockchain to provide users with access to high-performing investment strategies, low fees, and a transparent investment experience. The decision-making impacting the investment layer is driven by a collective intelligence where a global community of data scientists participates in a decentralized and distributed AI competition, in which they will be directly rewarded or penalized for their ability to forecast the market.

description: Specify a governance contract based on Sherpa and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating vault that custodies a stablecoin. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, the total stablecoin deposited in the vault, and a configuration for various operational parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the vault, request a withdrawal of their deposited stablecoins, and claim accrued yield. Only a designated operator can initiate a rebalance of the vault's underlying strategies and adjust the fee percentage. The minimum deposit amount is 100 stablecoins, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events to observers.
source_description: A managed multi-chain yield vault generating returns on USDC through delta-neutral strategies including positive carry capture, basis trading, volatility hedging, and other strategic arbitrage opportunities.

description: Specify a staking contract based on ShMonad and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies a base token and issues a liquid staking token representing staked positions. It maintains individual user balances for the base token deposited, the liquid staking token minted, and accumulated rewards, alongside a global pool of staked base tokens and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit base tokens to mint liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for base tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can adjust the reward rate and initiate withdrawals from the global staked pool to an external validator set. The reward rate can be adjusted by the operator a maximum of once every 24 hours, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all redemptions of liquid staking tokens. The contract announces when base tokens are deposited, when liquid staking tokens are minted or burned, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Stake MON, get shMON—the liquid staking token that keeps earning + MEV rewards while you commit it to programmable policies. One token secures the network and backs your favourite dApps, all without sacrificing liquidity.

description: Design a payments contract based on EtherFi Cash Liquid and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking derivative, holding deposited Ether and issuing a yield-bearing receipt token. It maintains a record of each user's deposited Ether, their corresponding receipt token balance, and the total Ether staked across all users. Callers can deposit Ether to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their deposited Ether by burning receipt tokens, and claim rewards accrued from staking. A designated operator can initiate staking operations with deposited Ether and distribute rewards to receipt token holders. The minimum deposit amount for Ether is 0.1 Ether, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and reward distributions as events.
source_description: Take control of your crypto. Save, grow, and spend. Start now at www.ether.fi

description: Outline a staking contract based on Bonk Staked SOL and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract enables users to stake a base asset and receive a liquid staking token representing their staked position, custodying the deposited base asset. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the total amount of base asset staked, and a mapping of each user's liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset, and transfer liquid staking tokens to other users. A designated operator can update the exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all redemptions, deducted from the base asset returned to the user. Redemptions are subject to a 24-hour unbonding period, during which the base asset cannot be withdrawn. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: Liquid staking on Solana

description: Design a prediction market contract based on NarBet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates provably fair, on-chain prediction markets by holding user deposits in an escrow-like manner. It maintains individual user balances for each market, the current state of each prediction market (open, closed, resolved), and the total pooled funds for each outcome within a market. Users can create new prediction markets, place bets on market outcomes, and claim winnings from resolved markets. Only a designated operator can resolve a market, setting the winning outcome and initiating payout calculations. A minimum bet amount of 0.01 native currency is enforced for all wagers, and a 2% fee is applied to all winning payouts, which is directed to the contract owner. The contract announces market creation, bet placements, and market resolutions through events.
source_description: Provably Fair On-Chain Betting on Monad

description: Design a prediction market contract based on MegaMoon and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized lottery, holding deposited funds until a drawing occurs. It maintains a list of active lotteries, each with a pool of collected funds, a set of participant entries, and a designated winning number. Callers can purchase entries for an active lottery, claim prizes from a completed lottery, and withdraw their unclaimed prize funds. A designated operator can start new lotteries, close active lotteries, and draw winning numbers for closed lotteries. Each lottery must have at least 10 entries before a drawing can occur, and a 5% fee is deducted from the total prize pool before distribution. The contract announces when a new lottery begins, when a winning number is drawn, and when prizes are claimed.
source_description: A leading decentralized lottery platform on Polygon Chain.

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Paradex Bridge and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the deposit and withdrawal of a single designated ERC-20 token, acting as a secure escrow for funds intended for cross-chain perpetual trading. It maintains individual user balances for the designated ERC-20 token, a total deposited amount, and a configuration for the withdrawal fee. Callers can deposit the designated ERC-20 token, initiate a withdrawal of their deposited funds, and cancel a pending withdrawal. A designated operator can set the withdrawal fee, which must be between 0 and 100 basis points, and finalize withdrawals after a mandatory 24-hour delay from initiation. The contract announces deposit events including the depositor and amount, withdrawal initiated events including the user and amount, and withdrawal finalized events including the recipient and amount.
source_description: Trade perpetuals on a high-performance DEX with deep liquidity, capital efficiency and low fees

description: Create a cross-chain bridge contract based on Grvt Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a cross-chain asset bridge, holding locked tokens on one chain that represent equivalent tokens minted on another. It maintains a record of each user's locked balance and a global total of all locked tokens, along with a configurable bridge fee percentage. Callers can deposit tokens into the contract, initiate a withdrawal request for their locked tokens, and claim their tokens after a successful cross-chain transfer confirmation. A designated operator can confirm cross-chain transfers, releasing the corresponding locked tokens, and can also update the bridge fee. The bridge fee is capped at 0.5% of the transfer amount. Withdrawal requests must be confirmed within 24 hours of initiation, otherwise they expire. The contract emits an event whenever tokens are deposited, a withdrawal is requested, or a transfer is confirmed.
source_description: Grvt is the preeminent DEX for onchain financial privacy that is powered by zero-knowledge technology, ensuring private, trustless, scalable and secure infrastructure

description: Model a token contract based on SongTech and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for unique digital song compositions, holding ownership records for each song. It maintains a registry of all listed songs, their current owner, their price, and any active bids, alongside a global fee percentage. Callers can list a new song for sale, make an offer on an existing song, accept an offer, or purchase a song outright. Only the owner can set the global marketplace fee, which is capped at 5%, and they can also withdraw accumulated fees. The contract emits an event when a new song is listed, when a bid is placed, and when a song changes ownership. All song purchases incur a 2% marketplace fee, and a song cannot be listed for less than 0.01 ether.
source_description: Market for Songs

description: Outline a staking contract based on SpringSui and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking protocol that custodies a base asset and issues a liquid staking token representing staked positions. It maintains individual user balances of the liquid staking token, the total amount of the base asset staked, and a configurable staking reward rate. Callers can deposit the base asset to receive liquid staking tokens, unstake their liquid staking tokens to receive the base asset, and transfer their liquid staking tokens to other addresses. Only the owner can set the staking reward rate, which must be between 0.01% and 10% annually, and only the owner can pause and unpause the contract's deposit and unstake functions. Unstaking incurs a 0.5% fee on the base asset amount, which is directed to a designated treasury address. The contract announces events for deposits, unstakes, and changes to the staking reward rate.
source_description: Spring Staked SUI (sSUI) is the first LST built using the SpringSui standard. It offers significant improvements over existing LSTs, most notably instant unstaking. Instant unstaking allows for infinite liquidity when unstaking, enhancing safety by reducing the risk of depegging. In the future, other teams will be able to deploy their own LSTs on the platform permissionlessly and at no cost using the SpringSui Standard

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Folks Finance Lending and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for a single fungible token, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains a global pool balance, a per-user record of deposited principal and accrued interest, and a global interest rate configuration. Callers can deposit tokens to receive receipt tokens, withdraw their deposited principal plus accrued interest by burning receipt tokens, and claim accrued interest without withdrawing principal. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum annual interest rate is capped at 20%, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user, amount, and timestamp.
source_description: Innovative DeFi platform to lend, borrow, trade and manage digital assets.

description: Create a price oracle contract based on RedStone Oracles and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a data feed registry, allowing data providers to register and update data feeds for various assets. It custodies no assets directly. The contract maintains a record for each registered data feed, including its current value, the timestamp of its last update, the identity of its designated data provider, and a minimum update interval. Callers can retrieve the current value and timestamp for any registered data feed. Designated data providers can update the value and timestamp of their registered data feeds. The owner can register new data feeds, designate their initial data providers, and set the minimum update interval for any feed, which must be at least 60 seconds. The owner can also transfer ownership of the contract. The contract emits an event whenever a data feed's value is successfully updated, including the feed's identifier, its new value, and the update timestamp.
source_description: RedStone is a modular, multi-chain blockchain oracle protocol delivering secure, gas-efficient price feeds—including for liquid staking and real-world assets—across a variety of plug‑and‑play integration models (push, pull, AVS), with ultra-fast variants like Bolt and seamless compatibility via decentralized DDL

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on Hydration DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's liquidity pools, holding deposited tokens for trading. It maintains records of each pool's token reserves, the current exchange rate, and each liquidity provider's share of the pool. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, and swap one token for another within a pool. A designated administrator can adjust trading fees and add new token pairs to the exchange. The maximum trading fee is 0.5%, and a minimum of 100 units of each token is required to create a new liquidity pool. The contract emits events for every token swap, liquidity addition, and liquidity removal, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: Hydration unites swaps, lending and the Hollar stablecoin under the roof of a scalable appchain.

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Estate Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractional ownership shares of real estate properties, acting as a registry for tokenized property interests. It maintains a record of each property's total token supply, the current owner of each token, and configuration parameters for each property. Callers can purchase available property shares, transfer their owned shares to another address, and redeem their shares for underlying assets when a property is liquidated. Only a designated operator can register new properties, set the initial token supply for a property, and initiate a property liquidation. A minimum purchase amount of 50 units of the designated stablecoin is enforced for all property share acquisitions. A 0.5% fee is applied to all share transfers, payable in the stablecoin, and this fee is directed to a treasury address. The contract announces property registration events, share transfer events, and property liquidation events to observers.
source_description: Estate protocol offers investors access to fractional ownership of real estate in the most sought-after markets in the world with secure, globally recognized asset protection. Estate Protocol enables cross-border investments with minimal barriers, allowing anyone to invest in high-quality real estate with as little as $50.

description: Design an NFT contract based on NeftyBlocks and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a marketplace for digital collectibles, holding deposited non-fungible tokens and the native currency for sales. It maintains individual account balances for the native currency, records of listed non-fungible tokens with their sale prices, and a global marketplace fee percentage. Callers can list their non-fungible tokens for sale, purchase listed non-fungible tokens, cancel their own listings, and withdraw their native currency balances. Only a designated operator can set the marketplace fee, which is capped at 5%, and only the contract owner can pause all marketplace operations. A successful purchase of a non-fungible token requires the buyer to pay the listed price plus the current marketplace fee, and the seller receives their proceeds after the fee deduction. The contract announces all successful non-fungible token sales, including the buyer, seller, and sale price.
source_description: NeftyBlocks is a trade to earn marketplace for buying, selling and creating digital collectibles. Explore the power of NFTs today using a wide range of community-driven tools.

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on Puppyfun and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the launch of new token projects, holding deposited funds and newly minted tokens for distribution. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount, their allocated token share, and the current project phase. Participants can deposit funds during the funding phase, claim their allocated tokens after the distribution phase begins, and withdraw any unspent deposited funds if the launch fails. The project owner can set the funding goal, approve projects, and initiate the distribution phase. A minimum deposit of 0.1 BNB is required for participation, and a 2% fee is applied to all successfully raised funds, payable to the project owner. The contract emits an event when a new project is approved, when funds are deposited, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: Launchpad on BNB Chain

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Ethereal DEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures, holding collateral in a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. It tracks individual user positions including margin, open orders, and realized profit/loss, along with global market data like funding rates and oracle prices for each trading pair. Users can open and close positions, deposit and withdraw collateral, place and cancel limit orders, and claim realized profits. A designated operator can update oracle prices, adjust funding rates, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage offered is 50x, and a 0.10% trading fee is applied to all executed trades. All position openings, liquidations, and funding rate updates are broadcast as events.
source_description: Ethereal is a non-custodial DEX for spot and perpetual contracts built on the Ethena Network, using USDe as the primary collateral and engineered for CEX-level performance with DeFi security

description: Create a token contract based on KeySea and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and trading of unique, non-fungible digital assets representing access keys on a new blockchain. It maintains a record of each key's owner, its unique identifier, and its current trading status, along with a global counter for the total number of keys minted. Callers can mint new keys, transfer keys they own to other accounts, list keys for sale at a specified price, and purchase listed keys. Only the contract owner can set the base price for minting new keys and designate approved minters. The maximum number of keys that can ever be minted is 10,000. A 2% fee is applied to all key sales, deducted from the seller's proceeds. The contract announces when a new key is minted, when a key is transferred, and when a key is listed for sale or purchased.
source_description: Your gateway to the newest KEYs trading experience on the Linea blockchain

description: Model a payments contract based on Roketo and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables continuous, time-based token transfers, holding deposited tokens in escrow until streamed. It maintains individual stream records detailing sender, recipient, token type, total amount, start time, and end time, along with a global configuration for fees. Callers can create new streams, deposit tokens into existing streams, withdraw available tokens from streams they are recipients of, and cancel their own active streams. A designated administrator can set the global streaming fee and pause all new stream creation. The maximum duration for any single stream is 365 days, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from the total amount of each new stream upon creation. The contract emits an event when a new stream is created, when tokens are withdrawn from a stream, and when a stream is cancelled.
source_description: Roketo is a financial platform that increase token utility of NEAR-based projects with transfers distributed over time.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Mode Bridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates bridging of a specific ERC-20 token from a source blockchain to a destination blockchain, holding the bridged tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a total supply of bridged tokens on the destination chain, a mapping of source chain deposit hashes to destination chain mint transaction hashes, and a configurable bridging fee. Callers can deposit tokens on the source chain to initiate a bridge, and a designated relayer can mint corresponding tokens on the destination chain after verifying the source deposit. Only the owner can set the bridging fee, which defaults to 0.1% of the bridged amount, and can designate new relayer addresses. Each deposit on the source chain must be at least 100 of the bridged token. The contract announces deposit events on the source chain and mint events on the destination chain.
source_description: Bridge between Ethereum and Mode Network.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on RISEx and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders to back their positions. It maintains individual account balances, open positions including leverage and margin, and global configuration parameters for each trading pair. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close long or short positions, adjust leverage, and withdraw available margin. A designated operator can update funding rates and liquidate undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage allowed is 50x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position changes, and liquidations.
source_description: RISEx is a fully onchain perpetuals exchange built on RISE Chain.

description: Outline a token launchpad contract based on g8keep and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the creation and lifecycle of new token launches, holding deposited funds and newly minted tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each launch's configuration, including its sale stages and participant allocations, and tracks individual user contributions and token claims. Callers can contribute funds to active launches, claim their purchased tokens after a launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent contributions if a launch fails. A designated operator can create new launches, update launch parameters before a sale begins, and finalize launches. The maximum number of sale stages per launch is 5. A 2% fee is applied to all successful token sales, deducted from the contributed funds before token distribution. The contract announces when a new launch is created, when a contribution is made, and when tokens are claimed.
source_description: Safely deploy, discover, and trade tokens. Currently on EVM.

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on Nayms and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a marketplace for risk transfer agreements, holding deposited collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances for each participant, a global registry of active risk agreements, and configurable marketplace parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, propose new risk agreements specifying terms like coverage amount and premium, accept existing proposals, pay premiums, and claim payouts for covered events. A designated operator can approve new risk agreement proposals, resolve claims by authorizing payouts, and adjust the marketplace fee, which is capped at 5% of all premiums. Each risk agreement proposal must specify a coverage period not exceeding 365 days. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, new risk agreement proposals, accepted proposals, premium payments, and claim resolutions.
source_description: Regulated insurance marketplace

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on fx Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin, minting and burning it against collateral tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, borrowed stablecoin, and accrued interest for each account, along with global parameters like interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow stablecoin, repay stablecoin, and withdraw collateral. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and add or remove supported collateral tokens. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 7x the value of the deposited collateral, and a 0.05% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, and repayments, including the user's address, the token involved, and the amount.
source_description: f(x) Protocol is a decentralized on-chain trading platform that enables stress-free leverage on ETH and WBTC while delivering the highest organic & sustainable yield on stablecoins. By utilizing an innovative mechanism, we offer up to 7X long or short exposure with minimum liquidation risk & funding costs. To fuel the leverage positions, the protocol mints fxUSD, a scalable & decentralized stablecoin with a strong peg to the dollar and backed by wstETH and WBTC.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on Tori Finance and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic dollar stablecoin, referred to as the "stablecoin", and its yield-bearing staked version, the "staked stablecoin", custodying both tokens. It maintains each user's stablecoin balance, staked stablecoin balance, and a global record of the total stablecoin supply and total staked stablecoin supply, alongside a configuration for yield distribution. Callers can mint stablecoins by depositing collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, stake stablecoins to receive staked stablecoins, and unstake staked stablecoins to receive stablecoins. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and distribute yield to staked stablecoin holders. The initial collateralization ratio for minting stablecoins is 1.05, meaning 1.05 units of collateral are required for 1 unit of stablecoin, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all stablecoin redemptions. The contract announces all minting, redemption, staking, and unstaking events, including the user involved and the amounts transferred.
source_description: Tori Finance is a synthetic dollar protocol where trUSD is backed by delta-neutral trading positions and can be staked into strUSD to earn yield from those market-neutral strategies.

description: Model a staking contract based on Mantle Restaking and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a liquid restaking service for a base asset, custoding deposited base assets and issuing a liquid restaking token representing the user's share. It maintains a total supply of the liquid restaking token, the total amount of base asset deposited, and a mapping of each user's liquid restaking token balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint liquid restaking tokens, and they can redeem liquid restaking tokens for the base asset. The owner can set the fee percentage for redemptions and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. A redemption fee of 0.1% is applied to all withdrawals, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.01 of the base asset. The contract emits an event upon each deposit, redemption, and fee update.
source_description: Liquid Restaking on Ethereum

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Algomint and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the minting and redemption of a synthetic asset, backed by a reserve of a different base asset held within the contract. It maintains a record of each user's synthetic asset balance, the total supply of the synthetic asset, and the current reserve ratio. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint the synthetic asset, transfer the synthetic asset to other users, and burn the synthetic asset to redeem the base asset. A designated operator can pause all minting and redemption operations, and can adjust the minting fee. The minting fee is fixed at 0.5% of the base asset deposited. The maximum daily redemption volume for any single user is capped at 10,000 units of the base asset. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amount.
source_description: Next generation blockchain infrastructure combining interoperability and liquidity consolidation.

description: Model a governance contract based on Kvants and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the distribution of governance tokens to participants who stake their tokens, holding the staked governance tokens in custody. It maintains a record of each participant's staked amount, their accumulated rewards, and the total supply of staked tokens. Callers can stake governance tokens, unstake their tokens, and claim their accumulated rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate per block and pause or unpause staking and reward accumulation. The maximum reward rate per block is 1000 units of the governance token. Staked tokens are subject to a 7-day unstaking delay before they can be withdrawn. The contract announces when tokens are staked, unstaked, and when rewards are claimed.
source_description: Kvants is an AI-driven quantitative asset management platform offering on-chain and CeFi trading vaults powered by advanced quant strategies. It enables non-custodial execution across exchanges and DEXs, combining transparency, automation, and risk-adjusted performance. $KVAI is the ecosystem token used for governance, strategy participation, and value accrual through protocol rewards and buybacks.

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Bluefin Pro and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral funds deposited by users. It maintains individual user accounts with their collateral balances, open positions, and trading history, alongside global configuration parameters for markets and a risk engine's state. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw available collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and liquidate undercollateralized accounts. Only a designated operator can adjust market parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds, or pause trading in an emergency. A maximum of 10 distinct perpetual markets can be active at any time, and all trades incur a 0.05% taker fee. The contract announces all successful deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and liquidations as events.
source_description: Bluefin Pro is the upgraded, high-performance version of the Bluefin decentralized derivatives exchange, built on the Sui blockchain

description: Create a prediction market contract based on stETH.win and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prize pool for a gamified donation system, holding a yield-bearing deposit receipt token. It tracks each participant's deposited amount and the total yield accumulated, along with the current designated charitable cause. Callers can deposit the yield-bearing token, withdraw their deposited principal, and claim any prizes won. A designated operator can initiate a prize draw, distribute prizes, and set the designated charitable cause. The contract must maintain a minimum of 100 units of the yield-bearing token as a reserve. Each prize draw must allocate exactly 50% of the accumulated yield to the designated charitable cause and 50% to the winners. The contract emits an event when a deposit occurs, when a withdrawal occurs, when a prize is awarded, and when the designated charitable cause is updated.
source_description: The stETH.win project is a PoolTogether v3 community-built pool which gamifies good cause donations. People can deposit the yield-bearing stETH token, and all generated yield is pooled together. Each week, 50% of this yield is directed to a selectable good cause and 50% is won and divided amongst two randomly chosen depositors.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Stargaze and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a collection of non-fungible tokens, holding the token metadata and ownership records for each unique item. It maintains a registry of all minted tokens, their current owner, and a mapping of approved transfer operators for each token. Callers can mint new tokens, transfer tokens they own to another address, approve another address to transfer a specific token on their behalf, and revoke such approvals. Only the designated owner of the contract can set the base URI for token metadata or pause all transfer operations. A maximum of 10,000 tokens can ever be minted, and a royalty of 5% of the sale price is automatically applied to all secondary sales, payable to the contract owner. The contract emits an event whenever a token is transferred or an approval is granted.
source_description: A decentralized, community-owned app chain for NFTs. 100% carbon neutral. ZERO gas. Powered by CosmWasm and $STARS.

description: Model an NFT contract based on OpenSea V1 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the peer-to-peer exchange of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) for Ether or other ERC-20 tokens, holding deposited NFTs and payment tokens in escrow during active listings. It maintains a record of active listings, including the seller, NFT identifier, payment token, price, and expiration time for each, along with a global fee percentage and a designated fee recipient. Callers can create a listing, cancel their own active listing, and fulfill an active listing by paying the listed price. Only a designated administrator can update the global fee percentage and change the fee recipient. The maximum listing duration is 30 days, and a 2.5% fee is deducted from each successful sale, paid to the designated fee recipient. The contract announces listing creations, listing cancellations, and successful sales, including all relevant details.
source_description: OpenSea is the world's first and largest web3 marketplace for NFTs and crypto collectibles.

description: Specify a privacy-preserving contract based on Common and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a privacy-enhancing mixer for a single ERC-20 token, holding deposited tokens temporarily. It maintains a list of unspent zero-knowledge proof commitments and a record of nullifiers that have been spent. Callers can deposit tokens, generating a secret commitment, and later withdraw tokens to a new address by providing a valid zero-knowledge proof that consumes a nullifier. The owner can set the deposit fee, which is initially 0.1% of the deposit amount, and can also pause all withdrawal operations. Each deposit must be a minimum of 0.01 tokens. The contract emits an event when a deposit is made, including the commitment, and another event when a withdrawal occurs, including the nullifier and the recipient address.
source_description: Common Web App is a dapp that allows users to break the traceability of their crypto activity — without using centralized exchanges. In just a few clicks, anyone can connect any wallet, deposit into a private shielder contract, and withdraw to a new, unlinkable wallet address.

description: Design an NFT contract based on BlastName and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the registration and ownership of unique, human-readable names within a decentralized naming system, holding no custodied assets itself. It maintains a registry of all registered names, their current owner, their expiration timestamp, and a resolver address for each name. Callers can register a new name, renew an existing name, transfer ownership of a name, and set the resolver address for a name. A designated operator can pause new registrations and renewals, and can set the base registration price and renewal price. New name registrations have a minimum length of 3 characters and a maximum length of 64 characters, and the initial registration fee for a 5-character name is 0.01 ether per year. The contract announces when a name is registered, renewed, transferred, or when its resolver is updated.
source_description: The 1st decentralized domain name built on Blast

description: Design an NFT contract based on Salvor and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer loans collateralized by non-fungible tokens, holding deposited non-fungible tokens and the native blockchain currency in escrow. It maintains records of active loan offers, outstanding loans including their principal and interest, and the collateral associated with each loan. Callers can create loan offers specifying terms, accept existing offers by depositing collateral, repay loans, and claim their collateral upon full repayment. A designated operator can pause and unpause all lending activity, and the contract owner can set the loan origination fee and the maximum loan duration. The loan origination fee is fixed at 0.5% of the principal amount, payable by the borrower, and the maximum loan duration for any offer is 30 days. The contract announces when a new loan offer is created, when a loan is taken out, when a loan is repaid, and when collateral is reclaimed.
source_description: Salvor is an innovative NFT marketplace tailored for traders, offering a unique Peer-to-Peer Lending protocol. Users can easily borrow AVAX by using their NFTs as collateral, blending the worlds of digital art and finance.

description: Specify a token locking contract based on Coinscope and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a token locker, designed to custody various fungible tokens for predefined periods. It maintains records of individual lock-ups, each detailing the locked token's address, amount, unlock time, and the beneficiary's address. Callers can create new token locks, extend the unlock time of an existing lock, and claim unlocked tokens. Only the contract owner can set the fee percentage for creating new locks and designate an address to receive these fees. A lock-up must be for a minimum of 7 days, and the fee for creating a new lock is fixed at 0.5% of the locked token's value, payable in the locked token itself. The contract announces when a new lock has been created and when tokens have been successfully claimed.
source_description: Coinscope lockers offer a versatile solution that allows project owners to lock all types of tokens and liquidity on most blockchain networks. The platform supports a variety of features from custom vesting schedules, total locked tokens visualisation and the ability to seamless claim tokens from different wallets.

description: Create an on-chain game contract based on CockFights Game and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized competitive gaming platform, holding deposited funds used for match entry fees and prize distribution. It maintains individual player balances, records of active matches including participating players and their chosen competitors, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can deposit funds into their account, create a new match by specifying an entry fee and competitor choices, join an existing match by paying the entry fee, declare the outcome of a match they participated in, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can set the match entry fee, which is fixed at 0.01 units of the native currency, and resolve disputes for matches. A match must have exactly two participants, and the winner receives 95% of the total match entry fees, with the remaining 5% being a platform fee. The contract announces when a new match is created, when a player joins a match, and when a match outcome is declared.
source_description: The first eSports cockfighting simulator using blockchain technology

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on PancakeSwap Infinity and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized token swaps and yield generation through various liquidity pools, custodying deposited tokens from liquidity providers. It maintains records of individual user liquidity positions, including deposited amounts and accumulated fees, along with the configuration parameters for each distinct liquidity pool. Callers can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their liquidity and accumulated fees, swap tokens between supported pairs, and claim earned rewards. A designated operator can adjust pool parameters like swap fees and reward distribution rates, and the owner can upgrade the contract logic. The maximum swap fee for any pool is 0.3%, and a minimum of 10% of all swap fees collected are automatically allocated to a protocol treasury. The contract announces successful swaps, liquidity additions, and liquidity removals to observers.
source_description: Multiple pool types for capital efficiency & low price impact

description: Outline an NFT contract based on BlueMove Staking and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking program for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and distributing rewards. It maintains individual records of staked NFTs per user, the total reward pool balance, and a configurable reward distribution rate. Callers can deposit NFTs into the staking pool, withdraw their staked NFTs, claim accumulated rewards, and unstake NFTs to forfeit rewards. Only a designated operator can replenish the reward pool and adjust the reward distribution rate, which is capped at 0.05 units of reward token per NFT per day. A minimum of 10 days must pass after an NFT is deposited before it can be withdrawn without penalty.
