The contract announces NFT deposit and withdrawal events, reward claims, and changes to the reward distribution rate.
source_description: The leading Multi-chain NFT Marketplace on Aptos & Sui Blockchain.

description: Design a token locking contract based on JustLock and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a digital asset locker, designed to custody fungible tokens for a specified duration. It maintains records of each lock, including the depositor, the locked token type, the amount, and the unlock timestamp. Callers can deposit tokens into a new lock, extend an existing lock's duration, or withdraw their tokens once a lock has expired. A designated operator can set the fee percentage for new locks and can pause all new deposits. The minimum lock duration is 24 hours, and the fee for creating a new lock is 0.5% of the deposited amount. The contract announces the creation of new locks, extensions of existing locks, and successful withdrawals.
source_description: JustLock is an open source locker that advertises that you can Lock Your Digital Assets on #Radix with Confidence

description: Define an NFT contract based on Namoshi Name Service and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized naming service, registering and resolving human-readable names ending in ".citrea" and ".btc" to blockchain addresses, and it custodies the non-fungible tokens representing these domain name registrations. It maintains a record for each registered domain, storing its owner, resolver address, and expiration date, along with a global configuration for registration fees and the designated operator. Callers can register a new domain, renew an existing domain, transfer domain ownership, set the resolver for their domain, and query domain information. Only the designated operator can update the registration fee schedule, withdraw accumulated fees, or pause new registrations. New domain registrations have a minimum length of 3 characters and a maximum length of 63 characters, and the initial registration fee for a ".citrea" domain is 0.005 units of the native currency per year. The contract announces events for successful domain registrations, renewals, transfers, and resolver updates.
source_description: Namoshi is a decentralized naming service on Citrea, enabling .citrea and .btc domain registrations.

description: Create a staking contract based on Mellow Restaking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for restaked assets, allowing users to deposit and withdraw principal while earning yield from various strategies. It maintains individual user deposit balances, records of active strategies and their allocated capital, and global configuration parameters such as fees and limits. Callers can deposit supported tokens, request withdrawals of their principal, and claim accumulated rewards. A designated operator can add or remove approved yield strategies, adjust strategy allocations, and update protocol fees. The contract enforces a maximum of 10 active strategies at any time and charges a 5% performance fee on all yield generated, which is distributed to the protocol treasury. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, strategy changes, and fee collections.
source_description: Mellow Protocol is a permissionless system for active liquidity management and building trustless automatic DeFi strategies

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Tangible RWA and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized real estate portfolio, holding various non-fungible tokens representing fractional ownership of real-world properties. It maintains a ledger of each user's share of the total portfolio, a total supply of the fungible asset representing ownership claims, and a configuration for daily rebase rates. Callers can deposit stablecoins to acquire the fungible asset, redeem the fungible asset for stablecoins, and claim accumulated rebase rewards. Only a designated operator can adjust the daily rebase rate, which must be between 0.01% and 0.05% per day, and can initiate the daily rebase distribution. A 0.5% fee is applied to all redemptions, deducted from the stablecoin amount. The contract emits events when deposits occur, when redemptions occur, and when the daily rebase is successfully applied.
source_description: Tangible is an NFT marketplace for Real World Assets. Tangible is also the creator of Real USD, the first stablecoin backed by tokenized, yield-producing real estate.Rental income from Real USD’s backing is paid out to Real USD holders in the form of a daily rebase projected to range between 10 - 15% APY.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Osmosis DEX and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is for an automated market maker (AMM) that facilitates token swaps and custodies deposited tokens within liquidity pools. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, swap fees, and liquidity provider shares, along with a global configuration for base swap fees and administrative addresses. Callers can add liquidity to existing pools, remove liquidity from pools they participate in, and swap tokens between supported pairs. Only the designated owner can create new liquidity pools or update the base swap fee. The maximum swap fee for any pool is 0.5%, and the minimum liquidity to create a new pool is 100 units of each token. The contract emits an event whenever liquidity is added or removed, and when a token swap occurs, detailing the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: Osmosis DEX is the advanced automated market maker (AMM) protocol at the core of the Osmosis blockchain.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Hemi Staking and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a single designated ERC-20 token, holding staked amounts and distributing rewards. It maintains individual records of each staker's deposited amount, accumulated rewards, and a points balance, alongside a global reward rate and a total staked token supply. Callers can deposit tokens to stake them, withdraw their staked tokens and any accrued rewards, claim only their accrued rewards, and transfer their staking position to another account. A designated operator can update the global reward rate and distribute new reward tokens into the contract. The contract enforces a minimum staking duration of 7 days before staked tokens can be withdrawn, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all reward withdrawals. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, reward claim, and position transfer.
source_description: Stake your assets to earn rewards and boost your points

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Across and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fast, capital-efficient cross-chain transfers by escrowing user funds on a source chain and releasing them on a destination chain, holding transferred tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of each user's outstanding transfer requests, the total liquidity available for each supported token, and configurable parameters for fees and delays. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing tokens, provide liquidity to earn fees, or claim a completed transfer. A designated operator can approve or reject transfer requests after an optimistic challenge period, and the owner can update system parameters like the minimum transfer amount or the challenge period duration. All transfers incur a 0.1% fee deducted from the transferred amount, and the optimistic challenge period for any transfer is precisely 4 hours. The contract emits an event upon every transfer initiation, liquidity provision, and transfer settlement, detailing the involved addresses, token, amount, and a unique transfer identifier.
source_description: Across protocol is a novel bridging method that combines an optimistic oracle, bonded relayers and single-sided liquidity pools to provide decentralized instant transactions from rollup chains to Ethereum mainnet.

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Pareto Credit and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a private credit marketplace, holding deposited collateral tokens and facilitating loans. It maintains individual records for each borrower's outstanding loans, collateral amounts, and repayment schedules, along with a global configuration for marketplace parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, request loans specifying terms, repay loans, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated administrator can set global loan terms, approve or reject loan requests, and initiate liquidations. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 70%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new loans, payable in the borrowed asset. The contract announces loan requests, loan approvals, loan repayments, and liquidations to observers.
source_description: Pareto is a private credit marketplace that connects institutional lenders and borrowers, offering scalable yield opportunities and bridging institutional capital with on-chain credit markets.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on SynStation and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a prediction market, holding collateral tokens deposited by participants. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, open positions for each prediction event, and a global configuration for market parameters. Callers can create new prediction events, deposit collateral, place bets on event outcomes, claim winnings after an event concludes, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can resolve prediction events, setting the winning outcome, and can adjust the market fee percentage, which is capped at 5%. The contract charges a 1% fee on all winning payouts, and each prediction event must remain open for betting for a minimum of 24 hours. The contract announces when new prediction events are created, when bets are placed, and when events are resolved.
source_description: Sony backed Prediction Market for Asian Entertainment

description: Model an NFT contract based on ZNS Connect and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized naming system, registering and resolving human-readable names to blockchain addresses, and custodies the ownership records for each registered name. It maintains a mapping of registered names to their associated blockchain addresses, the expiration date for each name, and the current owner of each name. Callers can register a new name, renew an existing name's registration, transfer ownership of a name, and update the blockchain address associated with a name. A designated owner role can set the registration fee and withdraw collected fees. New name registrations have a minimum length of 3 characters and a maximum length of 15 characters, and a registration fee of 0.01 ether is charged for each year of registration. The contract emits an event whenever a name is registered, renewed, or transferred, including the name, the new owner, and the expiration date.
source_description: ZNS Connect is a decentralized ID platform that simplifies Web3 by providing user-friendly and memorable domain names through its decentralized naming system

description: Create a lending protocol based on Blend Pools V2 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a lending market for a single collateral asset and a single borrowable asset, holding deposited collateral and borrowed funds. It maintains a record of each user's collateral deposits, outstanding borrows, and accrued interest, alongside global market configuration including interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit collateral, borrow funds against their collateral, repay outstanding borrows, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can update interest rate parameters and the collateral factor, and pause or unpause borrowing and depositing. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new borrows. The contract announces events for deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the user's address, asset amounts, and the market's new state.
source_description: Lending markets created with Blend.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on Manta CeDeFi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregator that custodies user-deposited stablecoins, specifically USDC, and invests them into various yield-generating strategies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, their share of the total pool, and a global configuration for active strategies and their allocation percentages. Callers can deposit USDC, withdraw their share of USDC, and claim any accumulated yield. Only the owner can add new investment strategies, adjust the allocation percentages between existing strategies, or pause deposits and withdrawals. A minimum deposit amount of 100 USDC is enforced, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or yield claim occurs, including the user's address and the amount involved.
source_description: Manta CeDeFi: offering more opportunities for Manta users through a diversified approach to earning yield through CeFi and DeFi.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Paintswap on Sonic and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an NFT marketplace that custodies non-fungible tokens and the native currency of the blockchain. It maintains individual account balances for native currency and non-fungible tokens, a global listing of active NFT sales with associated prices, and a configuration for marketplace fees. Callers can list their non-fungible tokens for sale at a specified price, purchase listed non-fungible tokens, and cancel their own active listings. The owner can set the marketplace fee percentage and designate an operator who can pause all marketplace operations. The marketplace fee is fixed at 2.5% of the sale price, and the maximum number of active listings per account is 50. The contract announces successful NFT sales, new listings, and listing cancellations to observers.
source_description: Paintswap is the ultimate open decentralized NFT Marketplace to buy and sell NFTs utilizing the latest NFT technology. Creators of Sonic Airdrop fNFT Order Book, NFT Marketplace & Launchpad, PaintswapVRF, Click Royale, and Estfor Kingdom. Home of $BRUSH

description: Define a prediction market contract based on Perfect Pool and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages prediction game pools and custodies user entry fees. It maintains a record of each player's predictions for an active game, the total entry fees collected for each game, and the current state of each game (e.g., open for entries, in progress, finalized). Callers can enter a game by submitting their predictions and an entry fee, and once a game is finalized, participants can claim their winnings. A designated operator is privileged to create new games, update game results based on external data provided by an oracle, and finalize games. Each game has a fixed entry fee of 0.01 ether, and a game must have at least 10 participants to be considered valid for prize distribution. The contract announces when a new game is created, when a participant enters a game, and when a game's results are updated or finalized.
source_description: Perfect Pool is a blockchain-powered protocol for conducting bracket-style prediction games. It is designed with a focus on entertainment, communal participation, and skillful play. The platform seeks to overcome the common challenges associated with traditional bracket games, such as organizational complexity, trust issues, and opaque processes for tracking results and distributing winnings. The project gets games update data from external APIs, using an Oracle.

description: Specify a staking contract based on Hyperbeat LST and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking token for a base asset, custodying deposited base assets and issuing an equivalent amount of the liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the amount of base asset each staker has deposited, and a global exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint the liquid staking token, withdraw their base asset by burning the liquid staking token, and claim rewards accrued from staking. A designated operator can update the exchange rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all rewards claimed, and the minimum deposit amount is 0.01 units of the base asset. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, reward claims, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: beHYPE is Hyperbeat's liquid staking token for HYPE, built in collaboration with Etherfi

description: Outline a price oracle contract based on Geodnet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the registration and reward distribution for a decentralized network of high-precision positioning reference stations, holding no custodied assets directly. It maintains a registry of active reference stations, each with its unique identifier and the operator's associated wallet address, along with a global configuration for reward parameters. Callers can register a new reference station, update their station's operational status, and claim accrued rewards. Only a designated operator can pause reward distribution or update the global reward rate. A new station registration requires a minimum uptime commitment of 30 days, and the reward distribution is capped at 1000 units per station per day. The contract announces station registration events and reward claim events to observers.
source_description: RTK (Real-Time Kinematics) enables a 100x improvement in position accuracy as compared to standalone GPS. GEODNET's global RTK Network naturally complements on-device sensors such as Cameras, LiDAR, and IMU's to power AI-based Autonomous Systems.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Kodiak Islands and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquidity manager for a decentralized exchange, holding deposited tokens on behalf of users and managing their liquidity positions in various trading pools. It maintains per-user records of deposited tokens, active liquidity positions, and accrued fees, alongside global configuration parameters for each managed pool. Callers can deposit tokens, create new liquidity positions, adjust existing positions, claim accrued fees, and withdraw their deposited tokens. A designated operator can add new trading pools, update pool-specific parameters, and pause all user interactions in an emergency. The maximum number of active liquidity positions a single user can hold is 10. A 0.1% fee is charged on all claimed fees, which is directed to a treasury. The contract emits an event whenever a new liquidity position is created, an existing position is modified, or fees are claimed.
source_description: Liquidity Manager for Kodiak DEX

description: Model a derivatives contract based on Hypersurface and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for covered call options, holding deposited collateral tokens and minted option tokens. It maintains records of each user's deposited collateral, their active option positions, and the overall pool's total collateral and outstanding options for each strike and expiry. Callers can deposit collateral tokens, mint new call options against their deposited collateral, exercise their owned call options, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust the option strike prices and expiry dates for new options, and can initiate a settlement process for expired options. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting new options is 1.25, meaning 125% of the option's notional value must be held as collateral. A 0.1% fee is charged on all option minting operations, deducted from the collateral. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, option mints, option exercises, and option settlements.
source_description: DeFi structured products platform offering volatility yield through covered calls and cash-secured puts.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Cetus CLMM and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages concentrated liquidity pools for token swaps, holding deposited tokens as reserves. It maintains a record of each liquidity provider's deposited amounts, their active price ranges, and the total reserves for each token pair within a pool. Callers can create new liquidity pools, add liquidity to existing pools, remove liquidity, and swap tokens. The owner can set the swap fee percentage and pause all trading activity. A swap fee of 0.3% is applied to all token exchanges, and a pool must always maintain at least 100 units of each token as minimum liquidity. The contract announces all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected pool.
source_description: Cetus is a pioneer DEX and concentrated liquidity protocol focusing on Move-based ecosystems like Aptos and Sui. It works as a crucial part of the ecosystem infrastructure to satisfy the comprehensive needs of traders, LPs, upper applications and an increasing DeFi population.

description: Define a staking contract based on SolvBTC LSTs and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This is a liquid staking contract for Bitcoin-backed assets, holding wrapped Bitcoin tokens. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a total supply of the liquid staking token, and a global configuration for fees and operators. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their wrapped Bitcoin by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim staking rewards. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and pause deposits. A 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, and the maximum staking reward rate cannot exceed 5% annually. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward distribution events.
source_description: SolvBTC LSTs, including xSolvBTC and SolvBTC.CORE, let you stake Bitcoin to secure blockchain networks while earning rewards, and 1:1 backed by Bitcoin. Unlike traditional staking, your assets remain liquid, ready to trade, lend, or provide liquidity - maximizing your Bitcoin’s earning potential.

description: Design a token contract based on TonsOfFriends and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages access keys for various social groups and custodies the native currency paid for these keys. It maintains a record for each group, including its current key price, the total supply of keys, and a treasury balance, along with per-user records of owned keys for each group. Callers can purchase keys for a specific group, sell keys they own back to the contract, and transfer keys to other users. The designated owner can update the base price for any group's keys and withdraw accumulated treasury funds. A 5% fee is applied to all key purchases, which is directed to the group's treasury, and the price of a key increases by 0.1% for every 10 keys sold for that group. The contract announces when keys are purchased, sold, or transferred, and when the owner updates a group's base price.
source_description: An ecosystem first on the TON blockchain, we offer a seamless SocialFi experience, easily providing groups and channels the means to list their platforms and allows users to buy and sell keys for access, all without ever needing to leave the Telegram app!

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on Crocodile Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding a reserve of a base asset to back a pegged stablecoin. It maintains the total supply of the stablecoin, the base asset balance held in reserve, and a record of each user's stablecoin balance. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing the base asset, burn stablecoins to redeem the base asset, and transfer stablecoins to other users. A designated operator can adjust the minting and burning fees, and pause or unpause the contract's operations. The minting fee is fixed at 0.5% of the base asset deposited, and the burning fee is 0.75% of the stablecoins redeemed. The contract emits an event whenever stablecoins are minted, burned, or transferred.
source_description: Crocodile Finance, an Algorithmic Stablecoin where 1 $CROC is equivalent to 1 $AVAX. Algorithmic stablecoins are non-collateralized tokens designed to follow the price of their pegged asset, offering greater capital efficiency than traditional collateralized stablecoins

description: Model a staking contract based on Bybit Staked SOL and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism for a base asset, creating a synthetic derivative that represents staked value and accrued rewards. It maintains a global pool of the base asset, a total supply of the synthetic derivative, and a per-user record of their synthetic derivative balance. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint the synthetic derivative, redeem the synthetic derivative to withdraw the base asset, and transfer the synthetic derivative to other accounts. A designated operator can initiate staking and unstaking operations with an external validator set, and can update the staking reward rate. The contract charges a 0.5% fee on all base asset withdrawals. A minimum deposit of 0.1 base asset is required to mint the synthetic derivative. The contract emits an event upon every deposit, withdrawal, and transfer of the synthetic derivative, and when the staking reward rate is updated.
source_description: Liquid Staking SOL

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on ARCx and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized identity scoring system, holding no custodied assets. It maintains a numerical credit score for each unique address, along with a timestamp of the last score update and a configuration of scoring parameters. Callers can request a score assessment for any address, and designated operators can update an address's credit score. Only the owner can adjust the scoring parameters, which include a maximum score of 1000 and a minimum score of 0. The contract announces an event whenever a credit score is updated, including the address and its new score.
source_description: ARCx is a decentralized scoring protocol that powers on-chain identity through the issuance of a DeFi Passport. The first element in the DeFi Passport is an on-chain credit score, which is issued to an identity based on an assessment of the address’ on-chain activity

description: Model a token contract based on WeDeFin and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user-defined investment strategies, holding various ERC-20 tokens on behalf of users. It maintains individual user balances for each token within their chosen strategies, along with a global registry of available strategies and their underlying asset allocations. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens into a strategy, withdraw their tokens from a strategy, rebalance their holdings within a strategy according to its current allocation, and create new strategies. Only a designated operator can approve new strategies for public use and update the asset allocations of existing strategies. A strategy must contain at least two different ERC-20 tokens, and the total allocation percentages for any strategy must always sum to exactly 100%. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when a strategy's allocation is updated.
source_description: WeDeFin is a non-custodial index and portfolio app that lets users follow community-ranked crypto strategies, rebalance through DEXs, and route supported assets into Aave for yield.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Bracket Vaults and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized investment vehicle, holding various ERC-20 tokens as its underlying assets. It maintains a record of each investor's share balance, the total supply of shares, and the current asset allocation within the vault. Callers can deposit supported ERC-20 tokens to mint new shares, redeem their shares for a proportional amount of the underlying assets, and transfer their shares to other addresses. A designated operator can adjust the vault's asset allocation and add or remove supported ERC-20 tokens. The owner can set the management fee, which is a percentage of the vault's net asset value, and can pause all deposit and redemption operations. The management fee is capped at 2% annually, and deposits must be at least 100 units of the deposited token. The contract announces all share minting, share burning, and asset allocation changes.
source_description: Bracket’s vaults are tokenized investment vehicles that follow predefined strategies and constraints, offering users exposure to actively managed portfolios with transparent NAV and accounting

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on DumpFlow and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a decentralized token launchpad, allowing anyone to create and manage a new token with an associated liquidity pool, and it custodies the base currency deposited into these pools. It maintains a record for each launched token, including its total supply, the current base currency reserve, a configurable sell-lock timestamp, and parameters for dynamic price adjustments. Callers can launch a new token, buy tokens from a pool, sell tokens into a pool, and withdraw their creator fees. Only the contract owner can update the platform fee wallet address or adjust the base platform fee percentage. A newly launched token must have a minimum virtual base currency reserve of 100 units. All token sales are subject to a 1% platform fee on the base currency, and an additional 5% fee on the base currency is applied to all token sells, split evenly between the token creator and the platform. The contract emits an event for every token launch, every buy, and every sell, including the token identifier, the amount of tokens, and the amount of base currency involved.
source_description: DumpFlow is Dumpfun's bonding-curve token launchpad on Solana. Anyone can mint a meme token with a configurable virtual SOL reserve, sell-lock period, and dynamic ramping limits. Buys/sells route SOL through a per-token liquidity pool; a 1% SOL fee accrues to the platform fee wallet and sell-side fees split 2.5%/2.5% to creator/company

description: Specify a governance contract based on Spectra MetaVaults and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a set of curated investment vaults, each holding a specific ERC-20 token. It maintains a record of each user's deposits within each vault, the total assets under management per vault, and configuration parameters for each vault. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens into a chosen vault, withdraw their deposited tokens and accrued yield, and claim rewards. A designated operator can add new vaults, update vault strategies, and pause or unpause individual vaults. The owner can set the operator address and upgrade the contract. Each vault has a maximum deposit capacity of 10,000,000 units of its underlying token, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and vault strategy updates.
source_description: Curated vaults for optimized performance and automated rollovers.

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on keep.coffee and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a refundable token launchpad, holding newly issued tokens and deposited funds for participants. It maintains a record for each launch event, including the total tokens offered, the raised funds, individual participant deposits, and their allocated tokens. Callers can participate in a launch by depositing funds, withdraw their deposited funds if the launch conditions are not met, and claim their allocated tokens after a successful launch. The contract owner can create new launch events, set the token and funding goals for each launch, and finalize successful launches to enable token claims. A launch event must raise at least 100 units of the funding token to be considered successful, and participants have a 7-day window to withdraw their funds if the launch fails to meet its funding goal. The contract announces the creation of new launch events, successful fund deposits, and the finalization of launch outcomes.
source_description: keep.coffee is a refundable token launchpad on Solana and Robinhood Chain.

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on eesee and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gamified asset listing and sale mechanism, holding listed digital assets in escrow. It maintains a record of each listed item's current status, the participants in its associated game, and the configuration parameters for the listing process. Callers can list an asset for sale, participate in an active listing's game by committing funds, claim their winnings if they participated in a successful game, or withdraw their uncommitted funds. Only a designated operator can adjust the listing fee percentage, which is initially set at 0.5% of the asset's value, or pause and unpause the contract's core listing functionality. A listing must remain active for a minimum of 24 hours before it can conclude. The contract announces when an asset is listed, when a game participant commits funds, and when a listing concludes with a winner.
source_description: Gamified liquidity solution and marketplace for digital assets, tokens and RWAs on Blast_L2

description: Outline an on-chain game contract based on Crabada and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming ecosystem for idle player-versus-player games, holding the in-game currency and non-fungible game assets. It maintains individual player balances for the in-game currency, ownership records for unique game assets, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can initiate game sessions, claim rewards from completed sessions, purchase game assets using in-game currency, and transfer game assets between players. A designated operator can adjust game parameters, mint new game assets, and distribute rewards to players. Game sessions have a fixed duration of 2 hours, and a 5% fee is applied to all in-game currency transfers. The contract announces when game sessions are started, when rewards are claimed, and when game assets are transferred.
source_description: Crabada is an idle game, which means that you'll be able to play it anytime and anywhere with minimal disruption to your everyday life. Crabada is bringing forth a new revolution in play-and-earn games with its unique PvP (Player Versus Player)-infused idle gameplay.

description: Design a token contract based on AlfaFrens and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fan subscriptions for content creators, holding no custodied assets directly. It maintains a record of each creator's active subscribers, their subscription tier, and the associated monthly fee, along with a global list of registered creators and their designated payment recipient addresses. Callers can subscribe to a creator, unsubscribe from a creator, and creators can register their profile or update their payment address. Only the contract owner can set the global platform fee, which is fixed at 5% of all subscription payments. A creator must be registered for at least 24 hours before they can receive their first subscription payment. The contract announces new subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and creator profile updates.
source_description: Social subscriptions app that helps content creators connect with their fans

description: Specify a staking contract based on NEOPIN Staking and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a specific fungible token, holding deposited tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens, accumulated rewards, and a global total of staked tokens, along with a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their unstaked tokens, and claim their accrued rewards. A designated operator can update the reward rate and initiate reward distributions to the contract. The minimum deposit amount is 100 tokens, and rewards are distributed daily at a rate of 0.05% of the total staked tokens. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, reward claim, and reward distribution.
source_description: Earn rewards by safely delegating your crypto assets to one of the leading node validators NEOPIN.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Flooring Protocol and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the fractionalization of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) into fungible micro-tokens, holding deposited NFTs in escrow. It maintains records of each deposited NFT's unique identifier, its associated micro-token supply, and the owner of each micro-token share. Callers can deposit an NFT to mint new micro-tokens representing its fractional ownership, withdraw an NFT by burning all its associated micro-tokens, or transfer micro-tokens to other accounts. Only a designated operator can set the fractionalization ratio for new deposits, which is fixed at 1000 micro-tokens per NFT. A 0.5% fee is applied to all micro-token transfers, payable to a treasury address. The contract announces events for NFT deposits, NFT withdrawals, micro-token transfers, and changes to the fractionalization ratio.
source_description: The Flooring Protocol is a platform that allows people to fractionalize their NFTs into micro-tokens called μ-Tokens. This improves affordability and liquidity. Users can deposit NFTs into the Vault to relinquish unique ownership of that NFT or into Safeboxes to maintain ownership using a Safebox Key.

description: Design a staking contract based on LiNEAR Protocol and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking mechanism for a base network token, holding staked amounts and issuing a liquid staking derivative token representing a claim on those staked assets plus accumulated rewards. It maintains a total amount of base network tokens staked, a total amount of liquid staking derivative tokens minted, and a per-user record of their liquid staking derivative token balance. Callers can deposit base network tokens to receive liquid staking derivative tokens, withdraw base network tokens by burning liquid staking derivative tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. An owner role can set the staking reward rate and pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The staking reward rate is fixed at 5% annually, compounding continuously, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract emits an event whenever base network tokens are deposited, liquid staking derivative tokens are minted, base network tokens are withdrawn, or liquid staking derivative tokens are burned.
source_description: Highest Yield, Instant Liquidity.

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Frax and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized stablecoin system, holding reserves of a collateral token and minting a stablecoin token. It maintains a global collateral ratio, a total supply of the stablecoin, and individual user balances for both the stablecoin and staked collateral. Callers can deposit collateral to mint stablecoin, redeem stablecoin for collateral, and stake their stablecoin to earn rewards. A designated operator can adjust the collateral ratio within a range of 80% to 100% and can pause minting or redemption in emergencies. The system charges a 0.1% fee on all stablecoin redemptions, and a 24-hour delay is imposed between a collateral ratio adjustment and its activation. The contract announces all minting, redemption, and collateral ratio changes as events.
source_description: FRAX is a dollar-pegged stablecoin that uses AMO smart contracts and permissionless, non-custodial subprotocols as stability mechanisms. The two internal subprotocols used as stability mechanisms are Fraxlend, a decentralized lending market and Fraxswap, an automated market maker (AMM) with special features. The external subprotocol used as a stability mechanism is Curve. Additional subprotocols and AMOs can be added with governance allowing FRAX to incorporate future stability mechanisms seamlessly as they are discovered

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Kea Credit and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin collateral to facilitate short-term, high-yield loans to real-world entities, acting as a bridge between decentralized finance and traditional lending. It maintains a record of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, their accrued interest, and the total outstanding loan principal, alongside configuration parameters like interest rates and loan terms. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim accrued interest. A designated operator can initiate new loans, approve loan repayments, and adjust the interest rate within a predefined range. The maximum loan term is 90 days, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all interest payments, deducted before distribution to depositors. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, loan origination, and loan repayment to observers.
source_description: Kea is a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol focused on creating a programmable liquidity layer that bridges DeFi liquidity with traditional lending markets. By issuing short-term bridge financing and lending, Kea enables consistent high-yield returns and provides users with access to short-term liquidity

description: Specify a decentralized exchange contract based on Joe DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized exchange for swapping tokens, holding deposited token liquidity in various pools. It maintains token balances for each liquidity provider, and a configuration for each trading pair including swap fees and price accumulation data. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap tokens between pools, and query current token prices. Only the owner can set the swap fee for a given pair, or add new trading pairs. The maximum swap fee for any pair is 0.3%, and the minimum liquidity to create a new pool is 1000 units of each token. The contract announces liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and token swaps.
source_description: Let's F***ing Joe is your one-stop decentralized trading platform on the Avalanche network.

description: Model a token launchpad contract based on HEDGEhog Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates permissionless token launches and custodies deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each launched project's configuration, including its associated project token, the amount of base tokens contributed by each participant, and the current state of its launch phase. Callers can initiate a new project launch, contribute base tokens to an active launch, claim their allocated project tokens after a successful launch, or withdraw their base tokens if a launch fails. An owner role exists, and only the owner can set the base token address and a platform fee percentage. Each project launch must raise a minimum of 100 base tokens to be considered successful, and a platform fee of 0.5% of all raised base tokens is automatically deducted upon a successful launch. The contract emits an event when a new project is launched, when base tokens are contributed to a project, and when project tokens are claimed.
source_description: Permissionless meme token launchpad on Sonic with protocol-owned permanent liquidity

description: Model a smart account contract based on Trust Wallet Wallet and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a non-custodial multi-chain wallet, enabling users to manage their digital assets across various blockchain networks without the contract holding custody of any funds. It maintains a record of each user's associated public keys for different chains and their current authorization settings. Callers can add new public keys, remove existing public keys, and sign transaction payloads using their registered keys. A designated owner is privileged to set a maximum number of public keys allowed per user, which is capped at 5, and can also impose a minimum time delay of 24 hours between adding and removing public keys. The contract announces when a public key is added or removed for a user.
source_description: Non-custodial crypto wallet

description: Create a governance contract based on Exponent Strategy Vaults and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-generating strategy vault, holding deposited base tokens and investing them into various yield sources. It maintains a record of each user's deposited base token balance, a total supply of vault shares, and a configuration for each allowed investment strategy. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive vault shares, withdraw their base tokens by redeeming vault shares, and claim any accumulated yield. A designated operator can add new investment strategies, update existing strategy parameters, and initiate rebalancing of funds between strategies. The contract enforces a maximum of 10 active investment strategies at any time and charges a 0.5% withdrawal fee on all redemptions, which is directed to a designated treasury address. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, including the user's address, the amount of tokens, and the share amount.
source_description: Strategy Vaults are managed yield strategies built on top of Exponent's interest rate markets and/or combined with leading protocols on Solana

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Navigator and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized liquidity marketplace for derivative instruments, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains individual account balances for each user's collateral, a global configuration for supported assets, and aggregated statistics on open positions. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions specifying instrument and leverage, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. Only a designated operator can adjust trading parameters like maximum leverage, which is capped at 100x, or add new supported collateral tokens, each requiring a minimum deposit of 100 units. The contract announces all position openings and closings, and all collateral deposits and withdrawals, including the affected account and value.
source_description: Decentralized Liquidity Marketplace. Effortless trading, continuous liquidity. Across Crypto, Forex, and beyond

description: Specify a token launchpad contract based on SunPump and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fair launches of new tokens by managing a deposit pool and distributing the new tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited funds and their allocated new tokens, along with a global configuration for launch parameters. Participants can deposit funds during a specified window, claim their allocated new tokens after the launch, and withdraw any unspent deposited funds if the launch conditions are not met. The contract owner can set launch parameters, initiate the launch, and retrieve any remaining funds after a successful launch. A minimum deposit amount of 100 units of the deposit token is enforced for each participant. Upon a successful launch, the contract emits an event detailing the total funds raised and the total new tokens distributed.
source_description: The First Meme Fair Launch Platform on Tron

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on TurboFlow Perps and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures market, holding deposited collateral in a designated stablecoin. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each market, and global market configuration parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close long or short positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust market parameters such as funding rates and liquidation thresholds, and initiate liquidations. The maximum leverage offered is 50x. A 0.05% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing actions. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position changes, and liquidations.
source_description: TurboFlow is an on-chain trading ecosystem focusing on the convergence of Perpetual Contracts and Prediction Markets. Everyone gets a seat at TurboFlow.

description: Define an NFT contract based on Monster and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and ownership of unique digital collectible cards, which are non-fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each card's unique identifier, its current owner, and its specific attributes, along with a total supply counter. Callers can mint new cards, transfer cards they own to other accounts, and burn cards they own. Only a designated operator can mint new cards, up to a maximum total supply of 10,000 cards, and burning a card permanently removes it from circulation. The contract emits an event when a card is transferred and when a new card is minted.
source_description: A physical trading card game on MegaETH

description: Design a staking contract based on marginfi LST and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking solution that custodies staked native tokens and issues a corresponding liquid staking token. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, a mapping of each user's liquid staking token balance, and a record of the total native tokens staked. Callers can deposit native tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens to withdraw native tokens. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and initiate native token withdrawals from the underlying staking mechanism. The maximum daily deposit amount is 1000 native tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all native token withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and staking reward rate changes.
source_description: Liquid Staking solution on Solana to get exposure to SOL, $LST is built on mrgn's validator network and Jito's MEV rewards.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Particles Money and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic Ether-pegged token, which is partially backed by Ether and partially by a stability pool. It maintains individual balances of the synthetic token for each user, the total amount of Ether held as collateral, and the current balance of the stability pool. Callers can mint new synthetic tokens by depositing Ether, burn synthetic tokens to redeem Ether, and deposit or withdraw Ether from the stability pool. A designated operator can adjust the collateralization ratio and initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions. The minimum collateralization ratio is 0.8, meaning at least 80% of the synthetic token's value must be backed by Ether. A 0.5% fee is applied to all synthetic token minting operations. The contract announces when new synthetic tokens are minted, when synthetic tokens are burned, and when collateral is added to or removed from the stability pool.
source_description: Particles Money is a decentralized solution developing synthetic ETH with a fractional collateralized system

description: Specify a lending protocol based on Blur Lending and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates non-fungible token backed loans and buy-now-pay-later purchases, holding non-fungible tokens as collateral and loan principal in ether. It maintains a record of active loans including collateral held, outstanding principal, and interest accrued for each borrower, alongside a global configuration for interest rates and loan terms. Callers can initiate a new loan by depositing collateral, repay an existing loan, or liquidate an undercollateralized loan. A designated operator can pause new loan originations and adjust interest rate parameters, but cannot access user funds. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 60%, and a 0.5% origination fee is applied to all new loans, deducted from the disbursed principal. The contract emits an event upon loan origination, loan repayment, and liquidation, detailing the affected loan and relevant financial amounts.
source_description: Blur Lending(aka Blend) enables NFT owners to borrow ETH against their assets and offers a Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) feature to purchase NFTs with partial payment upfront.

description: Create a token contract based on Words.art and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation, ownership, and transfer of unique, text-based digital collectibles, custodying the ownership records for each collectible. It maintains a registry of all created collectibles, including their unique text string, current owner, and a historical record of previous owners, along with a per-collectible price if listed for sale. Callers can create new collectibles, list their owned collectibles for sale at a specified price, purchase listed collectibles from other owners, and transfer ownership of their collectibles to another address. A designated operator can set the base creation fee for new collectibles and can pause all purchasing and selling operations. New collectibles can only be created if their text string is between 3 and 12 characters long, inclusive, and a 2% fee is applied to every successful sale, deducted from the seller's proceeds. The contract announces when a new collectible is created, when a collectible is listed for sale, when a collectible is purchased, and when ownership of a collectible is transferred.
source_description: Buy and Sell WORDS. ALPHA is live. Invite Only

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Wise Token and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin yield-generating vault, holding deposited stablecoins and distributing earned yield. It maintains individual user deposit balances, accumulated yield for each user, and a global configuration for the current yield rate and fee percentage. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the vault, withdraw their principal and accrued yield, and claim only their accrued yield. A designated operator can update the yield rate and the fee percentage, and can initiate a global yield distribution. The maximum deposit amount per user is 1,000,000 stablecoins, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all yield withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield rate updates.
source_description: A stable coin yield protocol, one of several powering WISE: the ETH-backed neutral reserve asset with the largest LP on Uniswap, and a Burn Alliance.

description: Create a staking contract based on Hylo LSTs and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to stake a base asset and receive a liquid staking token representing their share of the total staked amount. It maintains a global record of the total base asset staked, the total liquid staking tokens minted, and each user's balance of liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit the base asset to mint liquid staking tokens, redeem liquid staking tokens for the base asset, and claim rewards. A designated operator can update the staking reward rate and add or remove validator nodes. The maximum staking reward rate is 10% per year, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all redemptions. The contract announces deposit, redemption, and reward claim events, including the user's address and the amounts involved.
source_description: Liquid staking on Solana

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Tardly and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract implements a no-loss lottery, holding deposited digital assets and accumulating yield from an external source. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount and their share of the total pool, along with a global epoch number, the current total accumulated yield, and the address of the designated randomness provider. Callers can deposit digital assets into the pool, withdraw their deposited assets at any time, and at the end of an epoch, trigger the lottery drawing. A designated operator can initiate a new epoch, which resets the accumulated yield and selects a winner based on weighted stake using a verifiable random function. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the digital asset. A new epoch can only be initiated after the previous epoch has concluded and at least 24 hours have passed since its conclusion. The contract emits an event when a new deposit is made, when a withdrawal occurs, and when a winner is selected, including the winner's address and the amount won.
source_description: The Tardly No Loss Lottery is a yield lottery utilizing an on-chain verifiable random function to select a winner. Users stake ALGO into a pool that accumulates yield to a smart contract over an epoch. At the end of an epoch, the smart contract uses Algorand's Randomness Beacon to trustlessly select a winner of accumulated reward based on users' weighted stake. Users can withdraw their initial deposit at any time.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Kinetic and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for a single ERC-20 token, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual deposit balances, accrued interest for each depositor, and a global pool utilization rate. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens plus accrued interest, and repay outstanding loans. A designated operator can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause deposits or withdrawals in an emergency. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for collateral is 75%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and loan repayment events, including the involved addresses and amounts.
source_description: Kinetic is an ecosystem-tailored money market enhanced with an optional work-to-earn element.

description: Model a real-world asset tokenization contract based on LandX Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and redemption of tokens representing future agricultural harvests, custodying no assets directly but tracking entitlements. It maintains per-account records of harvest token balances and a global configuration for harvest parameters. Callers can acquire new harvest tokens by providing capital, transfer their harvest tokens to other accounts, and redeem their harvest tokens for a share of actual harvests when available. A designated operator is privileged to set the current harvest yield ratio and to initiate harvest distribution events. The contract enforces a minimum capital contribution of 1000 units of the stablecoin for new harvest token issuance, and harvest token redemption is only possible during a 7-day redemption window following a harvest distribution event. The contract announces events for new harvest token issuance, harvest token transfers, and harvest token redemptions.
source_description: Bridging the agriculture financing gap, LandX provides upfront capital to farmers in return for a percentage of their future harvests. The financing is secured by the underlying farmland, offering investors an opportunity to earn sustainable yield backed by tangible assets

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on DexLaunch and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited tokens for presales and liquidity provision. It maintains a list of active presales, each with its own configuration including the token being sold, the presale price, and the soft cap and hard cap for fundraising. Callers can deposit funds into a presale, claim purchased tokens after a successful presale, and withdraw their deposited funds if a presale fails to meet its soft cap. The contract owner can create new presales, set the presale price, and finalize successful presales to initiate liquidity creation. A presale must reach at least 50% of its hard cap to be considered successful, and the presale token price is fixed at 0.00001 ether per token. The contract emits an event when a new presale is created and when a presale successfully concludes.
source_description: DexLaunch is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: fixed-price presales that auto-list their raise as locked DEX liquidity, pump.fun-style bonding curves that graduate to Uniswap V3, and instant single-sided V3 launches

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Alchemix V3 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation of synthetic tokens representing future yield, holding user-deposited stablecoins as collateral. It maintains individual records for each user's collateral deposit, their synthetic token debt, and the current configuration of yield generation parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins, mint synthetic tokens against their collateral, repay their synthetic token debt, withdraw their collateral once debt is cleared, and claim generated yield. A designated operator can adjust the maximum synthetic token minting ratio, which is initially set at 50% of the collateral value, and update the external yield source address. The contract announces deposit events, synthetic token minting events, and synthetic token repayment events, including the user's address and the amounts involved. The minimum stablecoin deposit allowed is 100 units.
source_description: Alchemix is a DeFi protocol that allows for the creation of synthetic tokens that represent the future yield of a deposit. It enables users to retrieve near instant tokenized value against temporary* deposits of stablecoins.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Clearpool TPOOL and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a pool of stablecoin deposits dedicated to generating yield from off-chain treasury investments, custodying deposited stablecoins and distributing earned yield. It maintains a total stablecoin balance for the pool, individual deposit balances for each liquidity provider, and a configurable fee percentage. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their deposited stablecoins and accumulated yield, and claim their share of the distributed yield. The owner is privileged to set the fee percentage, initiate off-chain investment operations, and distribute earned yield back into the pool. The maximum deposit amount per transaction is 100,000 stablecoins, and the withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield distribution events to observers.
source_description: This USDX pool is dedicated to investing in or purchasing treasuries and distribute the resulting yield to liquidity providers

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Wagmi Memepad and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a token launchpad, holding deposited base tokens and newly minted project tokens. It maintains a record of each participant's base token contributions and their allocated project token share for each launch. Callers can contribute base tokens to an active launch, claim their allocated project tokens after a launch concludes, and withdraw any unspent base tokens if a launch fails. The owner can initiate new launches, set launch parameters, and finalize successful launches. Each launch has a minimum base token contribution of 100 base tokens and a maximum total raise cap of 1,000,000 base tokens. The contract announces when a new launch begins, when a launch concludes successfully, and when a launch is cancelled.
source_description: Wagmi is revolutionising meme token pre-sales on TON with our unique True Sale mechanics—putting the power back in the hands of the community and creators. This isn’t just another platform; it’s a game-changer designed to make meme launches truly fair and transparent. Now, we’re bringing top KOLs onboard to help spread the word, and we have an exciting offer for you.

description: Define a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Mantle Index Four Fund and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a diversified crypto index fund, holding various digital assets including staked tokens and stablecoins. It maintains records of each investor's deposited principal, their share of the fund, and the current allocation weights for each underlying asset. Callers can deposit supported tokens to acquire fund shares, redeem their shares for underlying assets, and view their current balance and the fund's total value. Only a designated operator can adjust the asset allocation weights, rebalance the fund's holdings, and update the management fee. The management fee is fixed at 1% annually, deducted from the fund's total value, and the fund rebalances quarterly. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, along with any changes to the fund's asset allocation or management fee.
source_description: This fund offers diversified exposure to leading cryptocurrencies by tracking a market-cap-weighted index of top Layer 1 and Layer 2 tokens, including assets like BTC, ETH, and SOL. Designed to function as the crypto equivalent of the S&P 500, it allows investors to access broad crypto beta without managing wallets or selecting individual assets. The portfolio is rebalanced quarterly and includes a fixed USD allocation, while the remaining assets are weighted by market cap within set limits. Enhanced yield potential is achieved through the use of staked instruments such as mETH, bbSOL, and sUSDe. Structured for institutional investors, the fund features traditional administration, a 1% management fee, and simplified access to digital assets and stablecoins

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Bancor V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding reserves of various fungible tokens. It maintains a record of each token's reserve balance, a trading fee for each pool, and a global protocol fee. Callers can deposit tokens to provide liquidity, withdraw their share of deposited tokens, and swap one token for another within a supported pair. A designated administrator can add new token pairs, update trading fees for existing pairs, and pause all trading operations. The maximum trading fee for any pair is 0.5%, and the protocol fee is fixed at 0.1% of all swaps. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or swap operation is successfully completed, including the tokens involved and their amounts.
source_description: Bancor is an on-chain liquidity protocol that enables automated, decentralized exchange on Ethereum and across blockchains.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Spectra V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables users to secure future yield at a fixed rate by depositing a yield-bearing token, which it custodies. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, their fixed yield rate, and the maturity date of their position, along with a global configuration for available fixed rates and their corresponding durations. Callers can deposit yield-bearing tokens to open a fixed-rate position, claim their principal and accrued fixed yield upon maturity, and withdraw any unlocked principal before maturity, subject to a penalty. A designated operator can add new fixed-rate offerings and adjust existing ones, while the owner can set the operator address and update the penalty fee percentage. The penalty for early withdrawal is fixed at 5% of the withdrawn principal. New fixed-rate offerings must specify a duration between 30 and 365 days. The contract announces events for new deposits, withdrawals, and position settlements.
source_description: Secure your future yield at a fixed rate.

description: Model a payments contract based on MetaMask Card and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates instant, crypto-backed payments via a linked card, holding user-deposited stablecoins as collateral. It maintains individual user balances of deposited stablecoins and a global configuration for payment processing. Callers can deposit stablecoins, initiate a payment request, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can approve payment requests and set the stablecoin conversion rate. A payment request must be approved within 10 minutes of its initiation, and a 0.5% fee is deducted from the user's stablecoin balance for each approved payment. The contract announces successful deposits, approved payments, and withdrawals.
source_description: Instant spending direct from your crypto wallet, anywhere Mastercard is accepted.

description: Define an NFT contract based on YourGrails and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the lifecycle of digital collectibles representing physical graded trading cards, including their ownership, associated metadata, and the outcomes of pack openings and battles. It maintains records of individual card ownership, the current state of unopened packs, and a registry of card attributes and rarities. Callers can open sealed packs to reveal cards, initiate battles between owned cards, transfer card ownership, and list cards for sale on an internal marketplace. A designated operator is privileged to mint new packs, register new card types, and adjust marketplace fees. The marketplace imposes a fixed 2.5% fee on all successful sales, and a maximum of 100 cards can be held by a single account at any given time. The contract announces events for pack openings, card transfers, battle outcomes, and marketplace sales.
source_description: YourGrails is an on-chain physical TCG platform for graded-card pack openings, pack battles, marketplace sales, and instant buybacks.

description: Define a governance contract based on Felix Vaults and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for depositing a specific ERC-20 token, which it custodies, and then lends these tokens to an external lending protocol to earn interest. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, their share of the vault's total assets, and the current total assets and total shares outstanding. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and redeem their shares for the underlying tokens. The owner can set the lending protocol address, update the interest rate strategy, and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. A 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals, and the vault will not accept deposits if the total assets exceed 10,000,000 units of the underlying token. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, share redemptions, and changes to the lending protocol address.
source_description: Deposit assets to be lent via Morpho Vaults to earn interest.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Anoncoin and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and launch of new, anonymous tokens, holding deposited collateral tokens during the launch phase. It maintains a registry of launched tokens, each with its associated collateral pool and configuration parameters. Callers can initiate a new token launch by depositing collateral, claim their share of launched tokens after a successful launch, and withdraw their collateral if a launch fails. A designated operator can approve or reject new token launches and set global launch parameters. Each token launch requires a minimum collateral deposit of 100 base units of the collateral token, and a 2% fee is applied to all collateral deposits, which is directed to the operator. The contract announces when a new token launch is initiated, when a launch is approved or rejected, and when tokens are claimed or collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: Anoncoin is a launchpad that enables users to create meme coins anonymously

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Asgard Dao and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized reserve currency, holding a basket of approved collateral tokens. It maintains a global reserve ratio, a list of approved collateral tokens with their individual target weights, and a record of each user's deposited collateral and minted stablecoins. Callers can deposit approved collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, redeem stablecoins for collateral, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust the target weights of approved collateral tokens, add new collateral tokens, and remove existing collateral tokens. The total minted stablecoins cannot exceed 80% of the value of the collateral held, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces when collateral is deposited, stablecoins are minted, stablecoins are redeemed, and collateral is withdrawn.
source_description: Asgard is a decentralized reserve currency built on Binance smart chain

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Pods Finance and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and trading of tokenized options, holding collateral tokens as security for minted options. It maintains records of each user's collateral deposits, active option positions including strike price and expiration, and a global configuration for supported underlying assets and collateral types. Callers can deposit collateral, mint new options against their collateral, exercise options they hold, and redeem collateral from expired or unexercised options. A designated operator can adjust the option issuance fee and add new supported underlying assets. The maximum option issuance fee is 0.5% of the option's value, and the minimum collateralization ratio for minting options is 120% of the option's value. The contract announces events for option minting, option exercise, and collateral redemption.
source_description: Pods is a decentralized non-custodial options protocol that allows users to create calls and/or puts and trade them in the Options AMM.

description: Create a decentralized exchange contract based on Dano Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized exchange of a specific bond token against a base currency, holding custody of both the bond token and the base currency deposited by users. It maintains individual account balances for both assets, a global trading fee percentage, and a record of all active limit orders, each containing the order creator, bond token amount, base currency amount, and a unique identifier. Callers can deposit base currency, deposit bond tokens, withdraw their deposited base currency, withdraw their deposited bond tokens, place new limit orders, cancel their own active limit orders, and fill existing limit orders. The contract owner is privileged to set the global trading fee percentage and to pause all trading operations. The trading fee is fixed at 0.25% of the base currency amount exchanged in a filled order. A limit order must specify a minimum bond token amount of 100 units. The contract announces when new limit orders are placed, when limit orders are filled, and when limit orders are canceled.
source_description: Dano Finance is a decentralized CARDANO exchange for listing and trading Bond Token issued by Optim without central intermediaries.

description: Design a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Gold DAO and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the issuance and redemption of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that represent ownership of physical gold, acting as a custodian for these gold-backed digital assets. It maintains a record of which account owns which specific gold-backed NFT, along with a total count of issued NFTs and the current price of gold in a stablecoin. Callers can mint new gold-backed NFTs by depositing an equivalent value of stablecoin, transfer their owned NFTs to other accounts, and redeem their NFTs for the corresponding amount of stablecoin. Only a designated operator can update the gold price oracle, and only the contract owner can set the stablecoin address or pause all minting and redemption operations. A minting fee of 0.5% of the stablecoin value is applied to each new NFT minted, and the maximum number of NFTs that can be minted in a single transaction is 10. The contract announces events for NFT minting, NFT redemption, and gold price updates.
source_description: Gold DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that combines the traditional value of gold with blockchain technology.
