It utilizes GLD NFTs to represent real, high-quality gold stored in Switzerland, ensuring ownership of physical gold is transparent, secure, and easily transferable. The NFTs can be swapped into GLDT gold token and to create a 100% physical gold backed stablecoins

description: Create a payments contract based on Aelin and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates decentralized fundraising rounds, holding deposited funds and distributing them to project creators or returning them to participants. It maintains records of each participant's deposited amount, the total raised for a specific project, and the project's funding goal and duration. Callers can create new funding rounds, deposit funds into an active round, withdraw their deposited funds if a round fails, and claim their allocated tokens if a round succeeds. Only a designated administrator can create new funding rounds and set their parameters, and only the project creator can finalize a successful round to receive the raised capital. A funding round must raise at least 50% of its goal to be considered successful, and a 2% fee is applied to all successfully raised funds before distribution to the project creator. The contract announces when a new funding round is created, when funds are deposited, and when a round concludes successfully or unsuccessfully.
source_description: Aelin is a fundraising protocol built on Ethereum and launched on Optimism.

description: Design a yield strategy contract based on CIAN Yield Layer and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield aggregation vault, designed to custody various yield-bearing tokens and their underlying assets. It maintains records of each user's deposited assets, their proportional share of the vault's total assets, and configuration parameters for various yield strategies. Callers can deposit supported tokens, withdraw their share of assets, and claim accrued yield. Only a designated operator can adjust the allocation of assets among different yield strategies, and only the owner can set the operator or upgrade the contract. A deposit must be at least 0.01 units of the deposited token, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, including the user's address, the token involved, and the amount.
source_description: Redistribute Yield Sources For Sustainable DeFi & Optimized APY For Your Assets

description: Design a prediction market contract based on Random Reward and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a random reward pool that custodies deposited Ether. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited amount and a total pool balance. Callers can deposit Ether to participate, and after a reward period concludes, they can claim their randomly assigned reward or withdraw their initial deposit if not selected. The contract owner can initiate a new reward period and set the reward distribution parameters. A minimum deposit of 0.01 Ether is required to participate, and a reward period lasts exactly 7 days. The contract announces when a new reward period begins and when a participant receives a reward.
source_description: Random Rewarder accepts incoming ETH transfers, signing up any address who sends a sufficient amount of ETH for a random reward at the end of a period.

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on Lucky38 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding user deposits in an escrow pool. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction rounds with their respective outcomes, and a global configuration for fees and round durations. Callers can deposit funds into their account, place predictions on open rounds, claim winnings from concluded rounds, and withdraw their available balance. Only the designated operator may initiate new prediction rounds, declare round outcomes, or adjust the prediction fee, which is fixed at 2% of each prediction. The minimum prediction amount is 0.01 units of the deposited currency. The contract emits an event when a new prediction round begins, when a prediction is placed, and when a round's outcome is declared.
source_description: On-chain games for Openclaw on Base

description: Outline a price oracle contract based on Pyth Core and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides a decentralized, on-chain price oracle for various assets, holding no user funds directly. It maintains a mapping of asset identifiers to their latest price data, including the price, confidence interval, and publication timestamp. Callers can query the current price data for a specific asset identifier. A designated operator can update the price data for any asset identifier, and only the owner can add new asset identifiers to the system or remove existing ones. Price updates must occur at least every 300 seconds for an asset to remain considered "fresh," and the confidence interval must always be less than 10% of the reported price. The contract emits an event whenever an asset's price data is successfully updated.
source_description: Decentralized price feeds for DeFi and TradFi builders with deterministic on-chain delivery.

description: Create a prediction market contract based on Precog Markets and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a prediction market, holding collateral tokens for active markets. It maintains a record of each market's total collateral, the amount staked on each outcome, and the current market state (open, resolved, or closed), along with a global fee rate. Callers can create new markets, stake collateral on an outcome, redeem winning shares after resolution, and withdraw their unstaked collateral. A designated administrator can resolve markets by declaring a winning outcome and set the global fee rate, which is capped at 5%. Market creation requires a minimum initial collateral of 100 base tokens. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when collateral is staked, when a market is resolved, and when funds are withdrawn.
source_description: Precog is a prediction market protocol where you can launch, invest, and trade on markets about future outcomes.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Musical Chairs and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a game of reaction, holding player stakes in an escrow pool. It maintains a record of active game rounds, each with its participants and their staked amounts, and a global configuration for game parameters. Callers can join an active game round, initiate a new game round as a host, and claim winnings from completed rounds. Only a designated operator can pause game functionality or update global game parameters. Each game round requires a minimum of 5 participants to start, and a 5% commission is applied to all winnings. The contract announces the start of new game rounds and the completion of existing ones, including the winner's address and the total payout.
source_description: Musical Chairs is a provably fair on-chain game of reaction and skill, designed for Web3 mass adoption. It features a radically accessible stake, low commission, a high 4-to-1 winner-to-loser ratio and lifetime passive income with on-chain referral system. Available on Arbitrum, Base, and Ethereum.

description: Specify a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Solv RWA and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenized real-world asset vault, holding an underlying asset that represents fractional ownership of a revenue-generating real-world asset. It maintains a record of each user's deposited asset amount and the corresponding fractional ownership tokens they hold, along with a total supply of these tokens. Callers can deposit the underlying asset to mint fractional ownership tokens, transfer these tokens to other users, and redeem their fractional ownership tokens for the underlying asset. A designated operator can pause and unpause all transfers and redemptions, and can set the redemption fee. The redemption fee is fixed at 0.5% of the redeemed amount. A minimum deposit of 100 units of the underlying asset is required for new deposits. The contract announces token transfers, deposits, and redemptions to observers.
source_description: Leveraging its proprietary ERC-3525 token standard, Solv expands the DeFi ecosystem by tokenizing real-world assets. Solv RWA provides exposure to diverse revenue streams traditionally unavailable to crypto participants, all in a decentralized and transparent manner.

description: Design a payments contract based on Compx Streaming and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables continuous, time-based token transfers between accounts, holding deposited tokens that are actively being streamed. It maintains a record for each stream, including the sender, recipient, token type, start time, end time, and total amount to be streamed, along with the current balance of each token type held by the contract. Callers can create a new stream, deposit tokens into an existing stream, pause a stream, resume a stream, and withdraw available tokens from a stream. A designated operator can set the streaming fee percentage and can pause or unpause all streaming activity on the contract. The maximum streaming duration for any single stream is 365 days, and a 0.1% fee is applied to the total amount streamed upon stream creation, deducted from the sender's deposit. The contract announces when a stream is created, when a stream is paused or resumed, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Token streaming platform on Algorand.

description: Define a stablecoin contract based on Tulip and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin pegged to a reference asset, minting and burning the stablecoin based on seigniorage and holding no custodied assets directly. It maintains the current stablecoin supply, the target price of the stablecoin relative to the reference asset, and a record of outstanding bonds and their redemption values. Callers can mint new stablecoins by purchasing bonds, redeem mature bonds for stablecoins, and burn stablecoins to purchase bonds when the stablecoin price is above target. Only the owner can adjust the seigniorage rate, which is capped at 0.05% per epoch, and only a designated operator can update the reference asset price from an external oracle. Bonds mature after a fixed period of 7 days, and the contract emits an event whenever stablecoins are minted or burned.
source_description: The first algorithmic stablecoin on Emerald ParaTime, pegged to the price of 1 ROSE via seigniorage.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on NEAR Intents and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain intent fulfillment, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow until intents are resolved. It maintains a record of each active intent, including the user's requested action, the target chain, the deposited token and amount, and the current fulfillment status. Callers can create new intents by depositing tokens, cancel their own pending intents, and fulfill intents by providing proof of completion on the target chain. A designated operator can pause new intent creation and adjust the fulfillment fee. The maximum number of active intents at any time is 10,000, and a 0.1% fulfillment fee is applied to all successful intent resolutions. The contract emits an event when a new intent is created, when an intent is canceled, and when an intent is successfully fulfilled.
source_description: NEAR Intents are a new type of transaction that allow information, requests, assets, and actions to be exchanged between AI agents, services, and end users

description: Model a stablecoin contract based on Oin Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and management of collateralized stablecoins, holding deposited collateral tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking their deposited collateral and minted stablecoin debt, alongside global configuration parameters such as the collateralization ratio and stability fees. Callers can deposit collateral, mint stablecoins against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can adjust the stability fee and the minimum collateralization ratio, and can pause all minting and withdrawal operations in an emergency. The minimum collateralization ratio is 150%, and a 0.5% stability fee is applied annually to outstanding stablecoin debt. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, stablecoin mints, and stablecoin repayments.
source_description: A robust turnkey stablecoin issuance platform built for the multi-chain universe

description: Define a derivatives contract based on Avantis and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders and liquidity providers. It maintains individual trader accounts with open positions, margin balances, and funding rate accruals, alongside global pools for each supported asset and configuration parameters for fees and risk limits. Callers can deposit collateral, open and close positions, modify existing positions, and withdraw available margin. A designated operator can adjust trading parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds, and an owner can pause all trading activity or upgrade the contract. Each trading pair has a maximum leverage of 50x, and a 0.05% fee is charged on all trades, deducted from the collateral. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and liquidations.
source_description: Avantis is a onchain perpetuals DEX built offering advanced risk management for LPs, loss protection for traders, and access to trading leverage crypto and synthetic real world assets. Avantis is built on and backed Base, and other investors such as Pantera Capital and Galaxy Digital.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Rocket Vault and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a community-governed treasury, holding various digital assets contributed by participants. It maintains a record of each participant's deposited assets, a global pool of all assets, and configurable operational parameters. Callers can deposit supported assets, withdraw their deposited assets, and propose or vote on governance actions. A designated operator can initiate market-making strategies and execute liquidations, while the owner can set the operator and adjust operational parameters like fees. A minimum deposit of 100 units of any supported asset is required, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and changes to operational parameters.
source_description: This is a community-owned and protocol-run pool that provides liquidity to RocketFi, runs market making strategies, and handles liquidations

description: Design a payments contract based on Flexa and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a collateral manager for a payment network, holding a designated fungible token to back instant transactions. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, a global pool of available collateral, and a configuration for network parameters. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and stake their tokens to specific network validators. Only a designated operator can allocate staked collateral to a validator, deallocate staked collateral from a validator, and claim rewards from staked collateral. A minimum deposit of 100 tokens is required for staking, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, and changes in staking allocations.
source_description: Collateral for fast and efficient value transfer

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on xDAI Stake Bridge and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain bridge for a stable token, custoding the stable token on the source chain and minting an equivalent wrapped token on the destination chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount on the source chain, a total supply of wrapped tokens on the destination chain, and a configurable bridge fee. Callers can deposit stable tokens on the source chain, initiate a withdrawal request on the destination chain, and claim their stable tokens on the source chain after a successful withdrawal. A designated operator is privileged to confirm withdrawal requests and mint or burn wrapped tokens. The bridge imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and a withdrawal request must be confirmed by the operator within 24 hours of its initiation. The contract announces successful deposits, initiated withdrawal requests, and completed withdrawals to observers.
source_description: The first-ever USD stable blockchain and multi-chain staking token.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Contango V2 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged, looped positions on various assets, holding deposited collateral and borrowed assets. It maintains per-user records of active positions, including collateral amounts, borrowed amounts, and associated asset types, alongside global configuration parameters for each supported asset. Callers can open new positions by depositing collateral, add collateral to existing positions, partially or fully close positions, and repay borrowed assets. A designated operator can pause all position-opening actions and update supported asset configurations. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 10x the initial collateral value. A 0.1% fee is charged on all borrowed amounts at the time of borrowing. The contract announces events for position openings, closures, collateral additions, and liquidations.
source_description: Contango lets you loop anything on-chain. You can create leverage (re)staking positions, arb rates differentials, farm points, or simply go long or short like a perp at low funding

description: Create a governance contract based on Hidden Hand and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace for governance incentives, holding various fungible tokens deposited as bribes. It maintains per-bribe records including the target governance proposal, the associated voting token, the bribe amount, and the distribution period. Callers can deposit bribes for specific governance proposals, claim their share of distributed bribes, and withdraw their voting tokens after a proposal concludes. A designated operator can create new bribe listings and initiate bribe distributions. Bribe distributions occur no more frequently than once every 24 hours, and a 5% fee is applied to all claimed bribe amounts, directed to a treasury address. The contract announces when new bribes are deposited, when bribes are claimed, and when a bribe distribution has completed.
source_description: Hidden Hand is a marketplace for governance incentives. Protocols can leverage Hidden Hand to enable more efficient governance processes and to engage their voters, while users can earn extra yield on their favorite vote escrowed governance tokens through bribes.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Agni Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a concentrated liquidity automated market maker for two ERC-20 tokens, custodying deposited token pairs. It maintains per-pool records of token reserves, liquidity positions for each user, and global configuration parameters like the protocol fee. Callers can create new token pair pools, add or remove liquidity to existing pools within specified price ranges, swap tokens between pools, and collect accrued fees. A designated operator can adjust the protocol fee percentage and pause all swapping activity. The protocol fee is fixed at 0.3% of each swap, and new pools must be initialized with a minimum of 100 units of each token. The contract announces events for liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the amounts involved and the affected addresses.
source_description: Agni Finance is a high-capital efficiency, AMM-based DEX and launchpad built to support the Mantle Network ecosystem.

description: Model a payments contract based on Superfluid and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables continuous, per-second value transfers between accounts, holding no custodial funds itself but orchestrating transfers of an ERC-20 compliant token. It maintains a record for each sender-receiver pair, tracking the current transfer rate and the last updated timestamp. Callers can initiate a new transfer stream, update an existing stream's rate, or stop a stream entirely. A designated operator can pause all streaming activity in an emergency, and can also update the base fee for stream operations. Each new stream or rate update incurs a fixed fee of 0.01 units of the streamed token, payable by the sender. Streams cannot be initiated with a negative transfer rate. The contract emits an event whenever a stream is created, updated, or deleted, including the sender, receiver, and new rate.
source_description: Programmable Cashflows. Handle subscriptions, salaries, rewards and any composable stream of value, with continuous settlement and per-second netting for extreme capital efficiency.

description: Outline a cross-chain bridge contract based on Wrapped and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on the source chain and issuing corresponding tokens on the destination chain. It maintains a mapping of each user's wrapped token balance and a global reserve of the underlying asset. Callers can deposit native assets to mint wrapped tokens, and redeem wrapped tokens to withdraw native assets. A designated operator can pause all transfer operations and update the fee percentage. The maximum fee percentage is 0.5% of the transfer amount, and each transfer must be confirmed by the operator within 24 hours. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and fee updates.
source_description: Your favorite assets on every blockchain. wrapped.com is a cross-chain institutional bridge. Designed for high-performance and speed.

description: Outline a token contract based on Polly Finance and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages user-created tokenized baskets of other tokens, holding the underlying tokens within each basket. It maintains records for each basket, including its constituent tokens and their proportions, and tracks the total supply of each basket token. Callers can create new baskets by depositing underlying tokens, redeem basket tokens for their underlying constituents, and transfer basket tokens. A designated operator can adjust the fees associated with basket creation and redemption. Basket creation incurs a 0.5% fee on the value of deposited tokens, and redemption has a 0.2% fee. The contract emits events when new baskets are created, when tokens are deposited into or withdrawn from baskets, and when fees are updated.
source_description: Polly Finance allows users to create their own "nests" (a token that represents a basket of underlying tokens) to manage diverse assets, purchase them easily, and automate their farming.

description: Design an NFT contract based on Courtyard and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a tokenization service for physical collectibles, custodying unique digital tokens that each represent a specific real-world item. It maintains a registry of each token's unique identifier, its associated physical item's metadata (e.g., description, image URI), and the current digital owner's address. Callers can mint new tokens for verified physical items, transfer ownership of existing tokens, and burn tokens when the corresponding physical item is no longer represented. A designated operator is privileged to mint new tokens and update the metadata for any token, while an owner can set the operator address. A maximum of 10,000 tokens can ever be minted, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all token transfers, payable in the native blockchain currency to the owner's address. The contract announces when a new token is minted, when a token's ownership changes, and when a token is burned.
source_description: Courtyard.io is a marketplace and tokenization service that enables anyone to easily own and trade physical collectibles on the blockchain, unlocking transparency, liquidity, and a new form of ownership for collectors.

description: Create an NFT contract based on Zonic and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a decentralized marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited NFTs and associated payment tokens in escrow. It maintains a record of listed NFTs including their seller, price, and current status, alongside individual account balances for payment tokens. Callers can list NFTs for sale, purchase listed NFTs, cancel their own listings, and withdraw their available payment token balances or unsold NFTs. A designated operator can pause all marketplace activity and update the marketplace fee percentage. The marketplace charges a 2% fee on all successful sales, and the maximum number of NFTs a single account can list concurrently is 10. The contract announces when an NFT is listed, when an NFT is sold, and when a listing is cancelled.
source_description: NFT Marketplace for Optimism and Arbitrum by the team of Apetimism

description: Model a cross-chain bridge contract based on Multichain and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset router that custodies various fungible tokens. It maintains per-token liquidity pools on each supported chain, along with configuration parameters for each bridgeable asset. Callers can deposit tokens into a pool on one chain, initiate a cross-chain transfer, and withdraw tokens from a pool on a different chain. A designated operator can add new tokens for bridging, adjust transfer fees, and pause transfers for specific tokens. The maximum transfer fee for any token is 0.5% of the transfer amount, and a minimum of 100 units of any token must be deposited to initiate a cross-chain transfer. The contract announces successful deposits, initiated transfers, and completed withdrawals to observers.
source_description: Cross-Chain Router Protocol (CRP), envisioned to be the ultimate router for Web3.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Save and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a decentralized lending pool for a single specified ERC-20 token, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains a record of each user's deposit balance, the total pool liquidity, and the current interest rate configuration. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, borrow tokens against their collateral, and repay their outstanding loans. Only the owner can adjust the interest rate model parameters and pause all borrowing operations. A user's loan-to-value ratio must not exceed 75% of their collateral value, and a 0.5% liquidation fee is applied when a loan is liquidated. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events, including the affected user, token amounts, and new balances.
source_description: Save (formerly Solend) is an algorithmic, decentralized protocol for lending and borrowing on Solana. Lending and borrowing has proven itself as being key in a DeFi ecosystem. However, current products are slow and expensive. On Solana, Solend can scale to being 100x faster and 100x cheaper. Solend aims to be the easiest to use and most secure solution on Solana.

description: Design a payments contract based on MoveFlow and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the scheduled distribution of a single specified fungible token from a central pool to multiple recipients over time. It maintains a record for each recipient detailing their total allocated amount, the amount already released to them, and the start and end times for their vesting schedule. Callers can create new vesting schedules, release vested tokens to a recipient, and cancel an unstarted vesting schedule. Only a designated operator can create new vesting schedules or cancel them. A vesting schedule must have a duration of at least 30 days and cannot exceed 365 days. The contract announces when a new vesting schedule is created, when tokens are released to a recipient, and when a vesting schedule is cancelled.
source_description: MoveFlow is a token management platform for token vesting, airdrop, payroll and subscription.

description: Create a token launchpad contract based on Aerodrome Ignition and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a token launch mechanism, holding newly issued project tokens and a stablecoin for liquidity provisioning. It maintains a record of each project's launch configuration, including the project token address, the stablecoin address, and the total amount of both tokens committed for initial liquidity. Callers can deposit project tokens and stablecoins into a specific project's launch pool, and after a designated launch period, they can claim their share of the initial liquidity pool tokens. A designated operator can initiate a project launch, setting the initial token allocation and the duration of the deposit period, and only the operator can finalize the liquidity pool creation. Each project launch must commit at least 10% of its total token supply to the initial liquidity pool, and the deposit period for any project cannot exceed 7 days. The contract announces when a new project launch is initiated, when deposits are made, and when liquidity is finalized.
source_description: Aerodrome Ignition is a DEX-native token launch mechanism on Base that bootstraps liquidity by depositing 10-20% of a project's token supply into Aerodrome pools, allowing veAERO holders to direct emissions incentives and enabling fair, market-driven price discovery and distribution without presales or private allocations

description: Define a token launchpad contract based on HoodMint and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the launch of new tokens on a bonding curve, holding the newly minted tokens and the collected base currency. It maintains a record of each token's bonding curve parameters, the total supply of each token, and the base currency balance for each token launch. Callers can create a new token launch, buy tokens from a bonding curve, sell tokens back to a bonding curve, and finalize a token launch to move collected base currency into a permanent liquidity position. Only a designated operator can create new token launches and finalize them. Each token launch has a maximum supply of 1,000,000,000 units, and a 1% fee is applied to all buy and sell transactions on the bonding curve, which is directed to the designated operator. The contract announces when a new token launch is created, when tokens are bought or sold, and when a token launch is finalized.
source_description: HoodMint is a memecoin launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Tokens launch on a pump.fun-style bonding curve; on graduation the raised ETH moves into a permanently locked Uniswap V3 position

description: Specify a price oracle contract based on Umbrella Network and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized data oracle, aggregating and validating off-chain data points, and it custodies no assets directly. It maintains a registry of approved data sources, a history of submitted data values for each data point, and a configuration for each data point including its aggregation method and update frequency. Callers can submit new data points, query the latest aggregated value for a data point, and propose new data sources for approval. Only a designated operator can approve new data sources, set data point configurations, and remove existing data points. Data point values must be updated at least once every 24 hours, and a minimum of 3 distinct data sources must contribute to each aggregated data point. The contract announces when a new data point value has been successfully aggregated and when a new data source has been approved.
source_description: Umbrella is the first truly decentralized oracle service providing low cost, massively scalable, and secure solutions for smart contracts.

description: Design a decentralized exchange contract based on THORChain DEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates native cross-chain asset swaps without wrapped assets, holding deposited assets in liquidity pools. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's asset balances, swap fees, and the current asset ratio for each pair. Callers can deposit assets into a pool, withdraw their share of assets from a pool, and initiate a swap between two assets. A designated operator can adjust the swap fee percentage and pause all swap operations. The swap fee is fixed at 0.3% of the swapped amount, and a minimum of 100 units of each asset must be present in a pool for a swap to occur. The contract announces successful swaps, liquidity pool deposits, and liquidity pool withdrawals to observers.
source_description: THORChain is a decentralized exchange (DEX) enabling native cross-chain swaps without wrapped assets or bridges. All trades occur on-chain and are permissionless.

description: Create an on-chain insurance contract based on InsurAce and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract provides decentralized insurance coverage for digital assets, holding deposited premium tokens and collateral tokens. It maintains individual policy records including coverage amount, covered asset, and expiration, along with global pools for different collateral types and a configuration for premium rates. Callers can purchase new policies, file claims against existing policies, and deposit or withdraw collateral. A designated operator can approve or reject claims, and adjust premium rates within predefined limits. Policy purchases require a minimum premium payment of 0.01 ETH, and claims must be filed within 7 days of the covered event. The contract announces new policy issuances, claim submissions, and claim resolutions.
source_description: InsurAce is a leading decentralised insurance protocol, providing reliable, robust and secure insurance services to DeFi users, allowing them to secure their investment funds against various risks. Being the 1st in the industry to offer cross-chain portfolio-based covers, InsurAce enables users to get unbeatable low premium. Users can also get sustainable investment returns through InsurAce’s investment portal and gain rewards though the mining program. InsurAce has a live product launched on Ethereum in April 2021 and have built a full-spectrum cross-chain insurance product line, covering protocols, CEX and IDO platform running on Ethereum, Solana, BSC, Heco, Polygon, Fantom and more in the future.

description: Define a cross-chain bridge contract based on Gravity by Galxe and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a cross-chain asset bridge settlement layer, holding deposited tokens awaiting transfer to a destination chain. It maintains records of each user's deposited assets, their corresponding destination chain and address, and a global configuration for supported tokens and chain identifiers. Callers can deposit tokens for bridging, initiate a withdrawal of previously deposited tokens if a transfer has not been finalized, and claim transferred tokens on the destination chain upon proof of settlement. Only a designated operator can finalize a cross-chain transfer by submitting a valid zero-knowledge proof, and only the contract owner can update the list of supported tokens or adjust the bridging fee. A minimum deposit of 100 units of any supported token is required for bridging, and a fixed bridging fee of 0.1% of the transfer amount is deducted from each successful cross-chain transfer. The contract announces events for successful deposits, initiated withdrawals, finalized transfers, and claimed tokens.
source_description: Gravity, built by Galxe, is an omnichannel settlement layer designed for mass adoption. It uses Zero-Knowledge Proofs, staking architecture, and advanced consensus mechanisms for high performance.

description: Model a lending protocol based on 3Jane Lending and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a credit-based lending pool, holding deposited stablecoins and tracking individual credit lines. It maintains records of each user's deposited stablecoin balance, their outstanding credit line usage, and a global pool of available stablecoins for lending. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, request a credit line up to their approved limit, repay their outstanding credit, and withdraw their available stablecoin balance. A designated administrator can set the interest rate and approve or adjust individual credit limits for users. The maximum credit line for any single user is 100,000 stablecoins, and the interest rate for borrowed funds is fixed at 5% per annum. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, credit line adjustment, or repayment occurs.
source_description: 3Jane protocol is a peer-to-pool credit-based money market enabling algorithmic, real-time uncollateralized USDC credit lines for yield farmers, traders, businesses, and/or AI agents

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on cBridge and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding deposited tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount for each token, and a global configuration for each supported token including its destination chain identifier and transfer fee. Callers can deposit supported tokens, initiate a transfer to a specified destination address on a supported chain, and claim transferred tokens on the destination chain once the transfer is finalized. A designated operator can add or remove supported tokens, update transfer fees, and finalize cross-chain transfers. The maximum transfer fee for any token is 0.5% of the transfer amount, and a transfer cannot be initiated for less than 1 unit of the token. The contract announces when a transfer is initiated and when it is finalized.
source_description: Celer cBridge is a multi-chain network that enables instant, low-cost and ANY-to-ANY value transfers within and across different blockchains, such as Ethereum and Polkadot, and different layer-2 scaling solutions on top, such as Optimistic Rollup, ZK Rollup and sidechains

description: Define a token contract based on Babylon Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages community-governed investment pools, holding deposited tokens on behalf of members. It maintains a record of each member's deposited balance within each pool, the total capital locked in each pool, and the current configuration parameters for each pool. Callers can create new investment pools, deposit tokens into existing pools, propose investment strategies for a pool, vote on proposed strategies, and withdraw their deposited tokens and any accrued earnings. The pool creator is privileged and can set the initial fee structure for their pool, and pause deposits or withdrawals in an emergency. Each investment pool has a minimum deposit amount of 100 base tokens, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, which is distributed to active strategy voters. The contract announces when a new pool is created, when tokens are deposited or withdrawn, and when a strategy proposal is submitted or voted upon.
source_description: Babylon is a community-led asset management protocol that enables users to invest in DeFi together. It's built on the Ethereum network and it's non-custodial, transparent, permission-less, and governed by the community. Babylonians can create investment communities (called 'Gardens') and invite people to deposit capital. Members participate in the garden by joining the telegram chat, suggesting investment Strategies and voting on Strategies. Members receive rewards based on their contributions.

description: Create a lending protocol based on Defi Saver Asset Management and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a leverage management vault, holding deposited collateral tokens and borrowed debt tokens on behalf of individual users. It maintains individual user positions, tracking each user's collateral amount, debt amount, and configuration for automated leverage adjustments. Callers can deposit collateral, withdraw collateral, borrow additional debt, repay debt, and configure their individual automation parameters. A designated operator can pause all automation for maintenance and adjust the automation service fee, while the owner can upgrade the contract logic. The maximum leverage ratio allowed for any position is 3.0x, and the automation service fee is capped at 0.5% of the adjusted debt amount. The contract announces events for all deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and changes to automation configurations.
source_description: DeFi Saver is a one-stop management solution for decentralized finance with advanced leverage management tools and unique automated management features.

description: Outline a governance contract based on Sova and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for an interest-bearing wrapped Bitcoin token, holding deposited wrapped Bitcoin and issuing a vault share token representing proportional ownership. It maintains a total supply of vault share tokens, the balance of wrapped Bitcoin held by the vault, and each user's individual balance of vault share tokens. Callers can deposit wrapped Bitcoin to receive vault share tokens, withdraw their wrapped Bitcoin by redeeming vault share tokens, and transfer their vault share tokens to other users. A designated operator can pause deposits and withdrawals in an emergency, and can update the address of the underlying wrapped Bitcoin token. The vault imposes a 0.1% fee on all withdrawals, deducted from the wrapped Bitcoin amount. The vault will always maintain a minimum of 10 wrapped Bitcoin as operational liquidity. The contract announces deposit, withdrawal, and transfer events, including the sender, recipient, and amounts involved.
source_description: Sova is a cross-chain Bitcoin liquidity protocol with a live Base ERC-4626 vault that accepts cbBTC and issues svBTC

description: Specify a prediction market contract based on Zethr and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract enables users to create and participate in prediction markets, holding deposited collateral in escrow until market resolution. It maintains records of individual market parameters, user positions within each market, and the total collateral locked per market. Callers can create a new market, deposit collateral into an existing market, make a prediction by allocating their deposited collateral, withdraw their unallocated collateral, and claim their winnings after a market resolves. A designated operator can resolve a market by providing the outcome, and can pause all market creation. Each market has a creation fee of 0.01 ether, and predictions must be made at least 10 blocks before the market's specified resolution block. The contract emits an event when a new market is created, when collateral is deposited, when a prediction is made, and when a market is resolved.
source_description: Zethr is a decentralized prediction market where you can be the house

description: Outline a prediction market contract based on LunaFi and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized prediction market, holding deposited collateral in a stablecoin to back user predictions. It maintains individual user balances, active prediction market pools with their associated outcomes, and global configuration parameters like fees. Callers can create new prediction markets, deposit collateral, place predictions on market outcomes, claim winnings from resolved markets, and withdraw their available balance. Only a designated operator can resolve a prediction market, determining the winning outcome, and only the contract owner can adjust the market creation fee, which is initially set at 10 stablecoins. All prediction markets must remain open for at least 24 hours before resolution. The contract announces market creation, prediction placements, and market resolutions to observers.
source_description: The decentralized betting protocol where you can become the house.

description: Specify a privacy-preserving contract based on Arcium and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized confidential computation network, holding user deposits of a specified ERC-20 token which are used to pay for computation. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance, their pending computation requests, and the network's current fee schedule. Callers can deposit tokens, request confidential computations by specifying an encrypted program and encrypted inputs, and withdraw their available balance. A designated operator can update the network's computation fees and register new computation providers. The maximum computation request size is 1024 bytes for encrypted inputs. A 0.5% fee is applied to all computation requests, deducted from the user's deposit. The contract emits an event when a new computation request is successfully submitted and when a user's balance changes.
source_description: Arcium is a decentralized confidential computing network that uses multi-party computation (MPC) to let Solana applications process encrypted data without exposing inputs to individual compute nodes.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on XRPL DEX and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange for token pairs, holding deposited tokens within its liquidity pools. It maintains records of each liquidity pool's token reserves, the total liquidity tokens minted for each pool, and individual user balances of liquidity tokens. Callers can create new liquidity pools, add liquidity to existing pools, remove liquidity from pools, and swap tokens between pools. A designated operator can adjust the swap fee percentage for each pool and pause all trading operations. The initial swap fee for any new pool must be set between 0.1% and 1%, inclusive, and the contract enforces a minimum liquidity deposit equivalent to 100 base tokens for pool creation. The contract emits events for all liquidity additions, removals, and token swaps, including the affected pool, amounts, and the user's address.
source_description: AMM pools for the XRP Ledger Blockchain

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Quickswap V3 and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized exchange's concentrated liquidity pools, holding deposited token pairs. It maintains individual liquidity positions for each user, tracking their deposited amounts, collected fees, and associated pool range. Callers can deposit tokens to create new liquidity positions, add to existing positions, remove liquidity from their positions, and collect accumulated fees. A designated operator can adjust the protocol-wide trading fee, which is initially set at 0.3% and can be changed by no more than 0.05% in a single operation. The contract announces events for new liquidity positions, liquidity additions, liquidity removals, and fee collections.
source_description: QuickSwap is a decentralized exchange that runs on Polygon Network to offer cheaper and faster transactions. Its automated market maker integrates upgradeable smart contracts on Ethereum and renders intermediaries obsolete. The exchange is based on open-source software and prioritizes decentralization, censorship resistance and security. It benefits from ultra-low gas prices compared to Ethereum, as well as fast and simple trading execution

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on Hyperlane and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates secure, cross-chain message passing and asset transfers, serving as a registry for trusted message senders and receivers across different networks, but it custodies no assets directly. It maintains a record of each registered domain's unique identifier and the address of its designated message dispatcher, alongside a mapping of message IDs to their processing status (pending, approved, rejected). Callers can register a new domain, update the dispatcher for an existing domain, dispatch a new message to a registered domain, and confirm the receipt of a message. A designated operator can pause all message dispatching and unpause it, and can also unilaterally reject a pending message. A message dispatch operation requires a minimum gas limit of 100,000 units to be specified, and a message confirmation must occur within 24 hours of its dispatch. The contract emits an event upon the successful registration of a new domain, and another event when a message is successfully dispatched, including its unique identifier and destination domain.
source_description: Open interoperability across 150+ chains | Bridge + issue tokens + build interchain apps.

description: Outline a yield strategy contract based on YieldFi and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for depositing and earning yield on a single designated ERC-20 token. It maintains records of each user's deposited balance, their accumulated yield, and the total amount of the designated token held in the vault. Callers can deposit the designated token, withdraw their deposited principal and earned yield, and claim only their earned yield. A designated operator can adjust the yield rate and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. The maximum yield rate that can be set is 10% annually, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and yield claim events, including the user's address and the amount of tokens involved.
source_description: YieldFi: The First Streamlined Asset Management Platform

description: Design a staking contract based on Sanctum Validator LSTs and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid staking pool, holding deposited base tokens and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a record of the total base tokens deposited, the total liquid staking tokens minted, and a mapping of each user's liquid staking token balance. Callers can deposit base tokens to receive liquid staking tokens, and they can redeem liquid staking tokens for base tokens. A designated operator can adjust the staking reward rate and pause or unpause deposits and redemptions. The maximum staking reward rate is 5% per year, and redemption requests are subject to a 7-day unbonding period. The contract announces deposit events, redemption events, and changes to the staking reward rate.
source_description: A Sanctum validator LST is a type of LST for which stake pools were deployed with the SanctumSPL Program.

description: Design an on-chain game contract based on Alien Worlds and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming metaverse's in-game currency distribution and NFT item assignment, holding a reserve of the native game token and various NFT item types. It maintains a record of each player's accumulated mining power, their claimable token balance, and their assigned NFT items, alongside a global configuration for mining difficulty and NFT drop rates. Callers can initiate a mining operation, claim their accumulated token rewards, and transfer NFT items they own to other players. A designated operator can adjust mining difficulty parameters, mint new NFT items into the contract's reserve, and pause all token claiming operations. Mining operations are limited to one per player every 10 minutes, and a 5% fee is deducted from all claimed token rewards. The contract announces when a player successfully mines, when tokens are claimed, and when NFT items are transferred.
source_description: Alien Worlds is a virtual metaverse game that allows players to earn by playing. It is an application that uses the Play-to-Earn model by incentivizing the participation of users by giving them NFT packs from the game or currencies like Trilium (TLM).

description: Define a lending protocol based on Liquity V1 and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates overcollateralized, interest-free loans against deposited Ether, holding the deposited Ether as collateral and the minted stablecoin as debt. It maintains individual loan positions tracking deposited Ether collateral and minted stablecoin debt for each borrower, along with system-wide totals for collateral and debt, and a global minimum collateralization ratio. Callers can deposit Ether to open a new loan position, mint stablecoins against existing collateral, repay stablecoin debt, withdraw excess collateral, and liquidate undercollateralized positions. A designated operator can adjust the system's stability fee and the minimum collateralization ratio. The minimum collateralization ratio for any loan position is 110%, and liquidations incur a 0.5% stability fee on the liquidated debt. The contract announces events for new loan positions, stablecoin mints, debt repayments, collateral withdrawals, and liquidations, including the affected borrower, collateral amount, and debt amount.
source_description: Liquity V1 is a decentralized and immutable borrowing protocol that allows you to draw 0% interest loans against Ether used as collateral.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Thrive On Mars and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a resource allocation system for a Martian settlement simulation, holding a fungible token representing "Martian Credits" that players use to acquire and upgrade in-game assets. It maintains individual player balances of Martian Credits, records of owned settlement plots, and the current upgrade level for each plot. Callers can deposit Martian Credits, purchase new settlement plots, initiate plot upgrades, and transfer Martian Credits to other players. A designated operator can mint new Martian Credits, set the price for new settlement plots, and approve new upgrade tiers. New settlement plots have a fixed purchase price of 100 Martian Credits, and plot upgrades require a 24-hour waiting period before completion. The contract announces when a new settlement plot is purchased and when a plot upgrade is successfully completed.
source_description: An interoperable game ecosystem to make humanity multiplanetary. Players manage an economic simulation that’s based on real Mars science through a real-time strategy game and an open-world RPG. Every move informs our Data Platform to drive R&D for humans-to-Mars missions.

description: Create a stablecoin contract based on Creditum and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a collateralized debt position manager, holding various approved collateral tokens and minting a pegged stablecoin. It maintains individual user positions, tracking supplied collateral, minted stablecoin debt, and a global system configuration including approved collateral types and their associated parameters. Callers can deposit approved collateral, mint stablecoin against their collateral, repay stablecoin debt, and withdraw excess collateral. A designated administrator can add or remove approved collateral types, adjust collateralization ratios, and set system-wide fees. Each collateral type must have a minimum collateralization ratio of 150%, and a stability fee of 0.5% is charged annually on all outstanding stablecoin debt. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, mints, and repayments, including the user's account, asset type, and amount.
source_description: Creditum is a lending & borrowing protocol that allows users to mint cUSD, a stablecoin pegged at $1, by supplying collateral.

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Meteora vaults and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a yield-generating vault that custodies user-deposited ERC-20 tokens, dynamically allocating them to external lending platforms. It maintains a record of each user's deposited amount, the total assets under management, and the current allocation strategy across approved lending platforms. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens plus accrued yield, and claim any accumulated rewards from external platforms. A designated operator can adjust the allocation strategy among approved lending platforms, add new approved lending platforms, and remove inactive ones. Deposits must be at least 100 units of the deposited token, and withdrawals incur a 0.1% fee on the withdrawn amount. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes in the allocation strategy to observers.
source_description: Meteora Dynamic Yield Layer allows any protocol, including wallets, treasuries, and Automated Market Makers (AMMs), to build on top of this layer to generate more returns for their Liquidity Providers (LPs). The liquidity of any protocol built on this yield infra can be dynamically allocated to various lending platforms.

description: Create a derivatives contract based on Decibel and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a trading engine for derivatives, holding user-deposited collateral. It maintains individual account balances, open positions for each account, and global configuration parameters like trading fees and maximum leverage. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated owner can adjust trading fees, update supported collateral types, and pause all trading operations. The maximum leverage for any position is 10x, and a flat trading fee of 0.1% is applied to all position opening and closing volumes. The contract emits events for every deposit, withdrawal, position opening, and position closing, including the account involved and the relevant amounts.
source_description: Decibel is a composable, onchain trading engine for spot, perps, and yield opportunities.

description: Design a governance contract based on Shift Protocol and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for a yield-generating strategy, holding deposited USDC stablecoins. It maintains each user's deposited amount, their share of the vault, and the total assets under management. Callers can deposit USDC into the vault, withdraw their share of USDC, and claim earned yield. Only the designated strategy operator can update the underlying yield strategy, and only the owner can set the operator or adjust the withdrawal fee. A withdrawal fee of 0.5% is applied to all withdrawals, and a minimum deposit of 100 USDC is enforced. The contract emits an event for every deposit, withdrawal, and yield distribution.
source_description: Shift is a DeFi protocol offering a suite of yield products built on top of leading on-chain perpetual futures exchanges (Perp DEXs). Our mission is to make high-yield strategies available to anyone through transparent, on-chain vaults

description: Outline a staking contract based on JPool and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking pool for a base asset, responsible for holding deposited base assets and issuing corresponding liquid staking tokens. It maintains a total supply of the liquid staking token, the current exchange rate between the base asset and the liquid staking token, and individual user balances of deposited base assets and issued liquid staking tokens. Callers can deposit base assets to receive liquid staking tokens, withdraw their deposited base assets by burning liquid staking tokens, and claim rewards accrued from the staking operations. A designated operator can update the exchange rate based on the performance of the underlying staking activities and transfer accumulated rewards to the pool. Only the owner can set the designated operator and pause or unpause deposits and withdrawals. A minimum deposit of 0.01 base assets is required, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: JPool is a stake pool on the Solana blockchain network enabling safe, secure, high-yield rewards on your staked SOL.

description: Create a payments contract based on Streamflow and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates streaming payments of fungible tokens, holding the tokens designated for active streams. It maintains individual stream records, each detailing the sender, recipient, token, total amount, start time, and end time. Callers can create new streams, deposit funds into existing streams, cancel their own active streams, and withdraw available funds from streams where they are the recipient. A designated operator can pause all new stream creation and can also unpause it. Each stream must have a minimum duration of 60 seconds and a maximum duration of 31,536,000 seconds (one year). The contract announces when a new stream is created, when funds are deposited into a stream, when a stream is canceled, and when funds are withdrawn from a stream.
source_description: Streamflow exponentially grows on-chain economies by providing infrastructure for creation, distribution, and incentive alignment of tokens.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on Wasabi Perps and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged perpetual futures trading for various assets, holding collateral deposited by traders. It maintains individual trader accounts tracking collateral, open positions (long or short), and profit/loss, alongside global configuration settings for each trading pair. Callers can open new positions, close existing positions, deposit additional collateral, or withdraw excess collateral. A designated operator can list new trading pairs, adjust funding rates, and set trading fees. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 20x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position openings and closings. The contract announces all position openings, closings, and significant collateral changes to observers.
source_description: Wasabi is a leverage trading protocol: Long, short, and earn on your favorite long tail assets such as memecoins and NFTs. Wasabi’s asset-backed perps keep the position value closely pegged to the underlying asset, reflecting the true price action on your PnL. It also generates additional downstream effects such as moving the spot price with leverage, listing pairs as soon as they launch, and generating low-risk yield opportunities through single sided staking

description: Model a governance contract based on ether.fi Liquid and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a vault for liquid staking derivative tokens, specifically designed to automate their deployment into a yield-generating strategy. It maintains a record of each user's deposited liquid staking tokens, the total amount of liquid staking tokens held in the vault, and the current strategy configuration. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accrued yield. A designated operator can update the active yield strategy, pause or unpause deposits, and adjust the fee percentage. The maximum fee percentage for yield claims is 10%, and a strategy update requires a 48-hour timelock before activation. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, yield claim events, and strategy changes.
source_description: Liquid is an automated DeFi strategy vault that provides ether.fi users a simple access point to use their eETH in the DeFi ecosystem

description: Outline a governance contract based on stash.fun and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a multi-asset vault that custodies user deposits of a stablecoin. It maintains individual user balances, a total vault balance, and a mapping of market allocations for diversified exposure. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their share of the vault, and claim any accrued profits. A designated operator can adjust market allocations and initiate rebalancing trades. The vault imposes a 0.1% deposit fee, and the maximum allocation to any single market is capped at 25% of the total vault value. The contract announces deposit and withdrawal events, along with any changes to market allocations.
source_description: stash.fun is a multi-asset vault protocol on HyperEVM (Hyperliquid EVM, Chain ID 999). Users deposit USDC into ERC-4626 vaults that provide diversified exposure to 40+ markets — stocks, crypto, commodities, forex, and indices — via perpetual futures traded on Hyperliquid.

description: Outline a token contract based on Stars League and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages fractional ownership of creator access tokens, holding the underlying creator tokens in escrow. It maintains individual balances of fractional shares for each user and a total supply for each creator token, alongside a configurable trading fee and a minimum share price. Callers can purchase fractional shares using an accepted stablecoin, sell their fractional shares back for stablecoin, and transfer fractional shares to other users. A designated operator can add new creator tokens to the platform and adjust the trading fee, which is capped at 5% of the transaction value. The contract emits events for every purchase, sale, and transfer of fractional shares, including the buyer, seller, creator token identifier, and amount.
source_description: Buy, Sell & Trade Access to your favorite creators, athletes & artists

description: Specify a cross-chain bridge contract based on pNetwork and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers by holding wrapped tokens on behalf of users, enabling their movement between different blockchain networks. It maintains a record of each user's wrapped token balance, a global fee configuration, and a list of authorized bridge operators. Callers can deposit native tokens to mint wrapped tokens, redeem wrapped tokens for native tokens, and transfer wrapped tokens to other users. Only a designated owner can update the fee configuration, add or remove authorized bridge operators, and pause or unpause the contract. A transfer fee of 0.1% is applied to all cross-chain transfers, and the maximum number of authorized bridge operators is limited to 10. The contract announces events for token deposits, token redemptions, and successful cross-chain transfers.
source_description: pNetwork is a protocol that enables cross-chain operations, such as transferring assets from one blockchain to another. It is designed to provide interoperability between different blockchain networks, allowing users to take advantage of the unique features and capabilities of each network while still being able to access and use their assets on other networks.

description: Model a decentralized exchange contract based on Orca DEX and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract is an automated market maker for token swaps, holding reserves of two distinct fungible tokens for each trading pair. It maintains a record of each liquidity pool's token reserves, a cumulative price oracle observation, and configuration parameters for each pool. Callers can add liquidity to a pool, remove liquidity from a pool, swap one token for another within a pool, and collect accrued trading fees. A designated operator can create new trading pools, update the swap fee percentage for a pool, and pause or unpause trading for a pool. Each liquidity pool must maintain a minimum of 100 units of each token after any operation. The swap fee for any pool is fixed at 0.3% of the input token amount. The contract announces when liquidity is added, when liquidity is removed, and when a swap occurs.
source_description: AMM

description: Outline a derivatives contract based on Boros and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates leveraged yield trading by holding user-deposited collateral and managing corresponding yield-bearing asset positions. It maintains individual account balances for deposited collateral, records of open positions including principal and leverage, and a global configuration for fees and parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, open new leveraged yield positions, close existing positions, and withdraw their available collateral. A designated operator can adjust the trading fee percentage and update the address of the external yield-bearing asset contract. The maximum leverage for any position is capped at 10x the collateral, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to the principal of each new position opened. The contract announces events for deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and any changes to the trading fee or the yield-bearing asset contract address.
source_description: Boros is a yield-trading platform on margin by Pendle

description: Outline a real-world asset tokenization contract based on Hastra and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a Real-World Asset (RWA) lending pool, holding stablecoin deposits and issuing yield-bearing tokens representing a share of the pool's assets. It maintains individual user deposit balances, the total stablecoin deposited, the total yield-bearing tokens minted, and a configuration for lending parameters. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw stablecoins, and redeem their yield-bearing tokens. A designated operator can initiate a loan, repay a loan, and adjust the lending interest rate. Only the owner can pause all deposits and withdrawals, upgrade the contract, or change the designated operator. A minimum deposit of 100 stablecoins is required, and a 0.5% withdrawal fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, loan origination events, and loan repayment events.
source_description: Hastra.io is a decentralized finance protocol on the Solana blockchain that connects institutional-grade real-world assets with the crypto ecosystem. Developed in partnership with the financial services company Figure, Hastra allows users to earn sustainable yields from audited, real-world lending operations.

description: Outline a token contract based on Earlyfans and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized social fan club, holding a reserve of a base currency to back the club's fan tokens. It maintains individual fan token balances for each member, a total supply of fan tokens, and a configurable fee percentage for all transactions. Callers can buy fan tokens by depositing the base currency, sell fan tokens to redeem the base currency, and transfer fan tokens to other members. Only a designated operator can adjust the transaction fee percentage and pause or unpause token transfers. The transaction fee is fixed at 5% of the base currency amount for buys and sells, and the maximum total supply of fan tokens is capped at 1,000,000. The contract announces when fan tokens are bought, sold, or transferred, and when the transaction fee is updated.
source_description: SoFi on Blast

description: Define an on-chain insurance contract based on Cork V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a tokenized risk market, holding collateral in a stablecoin to back insurance policies. It maintains individual policy records including coverage amount and expiration, a global pool of stablecoin collateral, and configurable parameters for each risk market. Callers can create new policies by depositing stablecoin collateral, claim against an active policy if a covered event occurs, and withdraw their collateral if a policy expires without a claim. A designated operator can pause all policy creation and claims, and adjust the premium rate for new policies. The premium for a new policy is always 0.5% of the coverage amount, and a policy cannot be created for less than 100 stablecoins of coverage. The contract announces when a new policy is created, when a claim is paid, and when a policy is cancelled.
source_description: The tokenized risk protocol. Hedge, trade, and earn on the risk that stablecoins, LSTs, & LRTs lose their peg

description: Create a real-world asset tokenization contract based on International Stable Currency and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a yield-bearing stablecoin, holding a basket of tokenized real-world assets as collateral. It maintains individual balances for each stablecoin holder, a global collateral reserve, and configuration parameters for fees and asset weights. Callers can mint new stablecoins by depositing approved collateral, burn stablecoins to redeem underlying collateral, and transfer stablecoins between accounts. A designated administrator can add or remove approved collateral types, adjust collateral weights, and set the minting and burning fees. The maximum minting fee is 0.5% and the maximum burning fee is 0.75%. The contract announces events for stablecoin minting, burning, and transfers, as well as changes to collateral types or fees.
source_description: International Stable Currency (ISC) is yield-bearing stablecoin pegged to a basket of real world assets

description: Define an NFT contract based on Baked Bazaar and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a marketplace for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited tokens awaiting sale or pickup. It maintains a record of listed tokens with their prices and sellers, and a balance of the native currency for each user. Callers can list a token for sale, purchase a listed token, cancel their own listing, and withdraw any native currency owed to them. A designated operator can set the marketplace fee, which is capped at 5% of the sale price. The contract announces when a token is listed, when a token is sold, and when a listing is cancelled.
source_description: NFT marketplace on Cookie Chain. Trade, collect, and celebrate with the COOK community.

description: Create a payments contract based on Tuyo Card and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a stablecoin payment system, holding user stablecoin deposits. It maintains individual user balances, a global fee rate, and a list of approved payment processors. Callers can deposit stablecoins, withdraw their own stablecoins, and initiate payments to other users or external addresses. A designated operator can update the global fee rate and add or remove approved payment processors. Payments to external addresses incur a 0.1% fee, and withdrawals are subject to a minimum amount of 10 stablecoins. The contract announces successful deposits, withdrawals, and payments, including sender, receiver, and amount.
source_description: Tuyo is a self-custodial stablecoin app with a Visa card, global transfers, trading, and DeFi earning features.

description: Model a derivatives contract based on LeverUp and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a perpetual futures exchange, holding collateral deposited by traders. It maintains individual trader accounts, open positions including their size and entry price, and global configuration parameters for available trading pairs. Callers can deposit collateral, open new long or short positions, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust trading pair configurations, such as maximum leverage and funding rates. The maximum leverage for any trading pair is 1000x, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all profitable position closures. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, and position closures, including the trader's identity and the relevant amounts.
source_description: LP-free perps DEX. Unlimited OI. 1001x leverage. Zero fees on losses. 100% fees to traders.

description: Specify an NFT contract based on nftperp and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a decentralized perpetual futures exchange for non-fungible tokens, holding deposited collateral in a stablecoin. It maintains individual user account balances, open positions including long or short status, entry price, and leverage, and global configuration parameters like funding rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, open new positions, close existing positions, add or reduce collateral to a position, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust global configuration parameters, initiate liquidations for undercollateralized positions, and upgrade the contract logic. The maximum leverage allowed for any position is 10x, and a 0.1% trading fee is applied to all position opening and closing volume. The contract emits events for all deposits, withdrawals, position openings, position closures, and liquidations, including the affected user, asset, and value changes.
source_description: Perpetual futures DEX for NFTs

description: Outline a price oracle contract based on WitSwap and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a wrapped token representing an asset on an external blockchain, holding the underlying assets in custody.
