It maintains a total supply of the wrapped token and individual balances for each account. Callers can mint new wrapped tokens by depositing the underlying asset, burn wrapped tokens to redeem the underlying asset, and transfer wrapped tokens between accounts. A designated operator is privileged to adjust the minting and burning fees, and to pause or unpause all operations. The maximum minting fee is 0.5% and the maximum burning fee is 0.75%. The contract announces token transfers, minting events, and burning events.
source_description: The Witnet network is a decentralized blockchain-agnostic oracle that is true to the censorship resistant nature of blockchains. It runs on its own blockchain using the WIT coin as its native currency. A bridge has been built to handle data requests from the Ethereum blockchain. Bridges from othher networks are planned in the future. The eWIT token is a custodial, wrapped version of the Witnet coin managed by the WitSwap plaform. The token is minted by the WitSwap team whenever someone wants to convert WIT coins to eWIT tokens and kept in custody. A user on the Ethereum network can also opt to swap his eWIT tokens back to WIT coins. The intent of this token is to allow decentralized trading on Ethereum DEXs and, in the future, to pay independent bridge operators with it if they choose to accept it.

description: Model a privacy-preserving contract based on FOOM Cash and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates a privacy-preserving prize game, holding deposited funds in an escrow pool. It maintains a record of each player's deposit amount, a unique nullifier for each withdrawal, and the current game's prize distribution configuration. Callers can deposit funds into the pool, generate a cryptographic proof of their eligibility, and withdraw their winnings or initial deposit using a valid proof and nullifier. The owner can set the game's prize distribution percentages and designate a relayer address for gasless withdrawals. A minimum deposit of 0.01 ether is required to participate, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all withdrawals, directed to the owner. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and updates to the prize distribution configuration.
source_description: FOOM Cash is a privacy-focused game built on Ethereum and Base. It uses advanced zk-SNARK cryptography to allow users to play for three simultaneous prizes—without revealing the user's identity

description: Model a token contract based on Enzyme Finance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract serves as a decentralized investment fund, custodying various ERC-20 tokens and other supported digital assets deposited by investors. It maintains a record of each investor's proportional share of the fund, the current portfolio of assets held by the fund, and a configuration for allowed assets and investment strategies. Callers can deposit assets into the fund, redeem their proportional share of assets, and propose new investment strategies. A designated fund manager is privileged to execute approved investment strategies, add new allowed assets to the fund's whitelist, and adjust the management fee. The maximum management fee is 2% per year, and a minimum of 5 distinct investors must approve a new investment strategy before it can be executed. The contract announces all deposits, withdrawals, and changes to the fund's asset holdings.
source_description: Fast & cost-effective way to build, scale and monetize investment strategies.

description: Define a staking contract based on ExinPool and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a staking pool for a proof-of-stake asset, holding deposited tokens and distributing staking rewards. It maintains individual user balances of deposited tokens, a total pool balance, and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens into the pool, withdraw their deposited tokens, and claim accumulated rewards. Only a designated operator can adjust the reward rate and initiate reward distribution, and only the contract owner can pause all deposit and withdrawal operations. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the staked token, and the maximum reward rate adjustment per day is 5%. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or reward claim occurs, and when the reward rate is updated.
source_description: ExinPool is a staking platform of Exin in Mixin Network

description: Create a privacy-preserving contract based on Garble.Money and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates private transfers of a designated ERC-20 token by allowing users to deposit tokens and later withdraw them to a different address without linking the deposit and withdrawal. It maintains a list of unspent note commitments, a total deposit amount, and a total withdrawal amount. Callers can deposit tokens, withdraw tokens using a valid zero-knowledge proof, and submit a new verifier contract address. Only a designated administrator can update the verifier contract address. The minimum deposit amount is 100 units of the designated ERC-20 token, and a 0.1% fee is applied to all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn amount. The contract emits an event upon each successful deposit, indicating the deposited amount and the new note commitment, and another event upon each successful withdrawal, indicating the withdrawn amount and the nullifier used.
source_description: Fully-Decentralized Privacy Wallet on Tron Network.

description: Design a token contract based on Nami Index and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract issues and custodies fully backed on-chain asset indexes, holding various ERC-20 tokens as collateral. It maintains a registry of each index token's constituent assets and their target weights, a record of each user's index token balances, and a configuration for fees and operational parameters. Callers can mint new index tokens by depositing the required constituent assets, redeem index tokens for their underlying assets, and rebalance an index by adjusting its constituent asset holdings. Only a designated operator can update the constituent assets and their target weights for an index, and only the owner can set the redemption fee, which is capped at 0.5%. The contract charges a 0.2% redemption fee on all redemptions. The contract announces when an index token is minted, when it is redeemed, and when an index's constituent assets or weights are updated.
source_description: Nami Index is a decentralized protocol on Thorchain, built for issuing fully backed on-chain asset indexes

description: Specify a stablecoin contract based on Hylo Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a two-sided stablecoin system, holding liquid staking tokens as collateral. It maintains individual user balances for a stablecoin and a leveraged asset, along with a global collateral pool, a system-wide collateralization ratio, and a configuration for various fees and parameters. Callers can deposit liquid staking tokens to mint either the stablecoin or the leveraged asset, redeem the stablecoin for underlying collateral, or redeem the leveraged asset for underlying collateral. A designated operator can adjust system parameters, such as the minting fee and the minimum collateralization ratio, and can pause all minting and redemption operations. The minting fee for the stablecoin is 0.1% of the minted amount, and the minimum collateralization ratio for the leveraged asset is 150%. The contract emits events when liquid staking tokens are deposited, stablecoins are minted or redeemed, and leveraged assets are minted or redeemed.
source_description: Hylo splits yield-bearing assets into two complementary products: hyUSD - a stable USD-denominated asset with access to sustainable yield, and xSOL - leveraged SOL exposure with zero liquidation risk and no funding costs. Users can deposit LSTs to mint either asset

description: Outline a decentralized exchange contract based on Kumbaya and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates peer-to-peer token swaps, holding deposited tokens temporarily during the swap process. It maintains a record of open swap orders, including the amount of tokens offered, the desired tokens, and the exchange rate for each order. Callers can create new swap orders, cancel their own open orders, and fill existing swap orders by providing the requested tokens. A designated operator can pause and unpause all swap operations, and can update the swap fee percentage. The maximum number of open swap orders at any time is 1000. A 0.25% fee is applied to the token amount received by the taker of a swap. The contract announces when a new swap order is created, when an order is cancelled, and when an order is filled.
source_description: Decentralized exchange on MegaETH.

description: Create a token contract based on Anon Social and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a social media platform's native token, holding all undistributed token rewards. It maintains a global reward pool, individual user balances, and configuration parameters for reward distribution. Callers can post content, like content, and withdraw their earned tokens. The platform owner can adjust the reward rate for posts and likes, and can pause all reward distributions. Posting content costs 0.01 tokens, which are burned, and users can only withdraw tokens if their balance is at least 0.05 tokens. The contract announces when new content is posted, when content is liked, and when tokens are withdrawn.
source_description: Anon Social is the new Crypto Twitter, focused on rewarding its users.

description: Define a token contract based on Phuture and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a basket of diverse digital assets, functioning as an automated index fund, and custodies the underlying tokens contributed by users. It maintains a record of each user's share balance within the fund, the current composition and weights of the underlying assets, and a global total value locked. Callers can deposit supported tokens to acquire fund shares, withdraw their proportional share of the underlying assets, and redeem their shares for the current basket of tokens. A designated operator can adjust the target weights of the underlying assets and add or remove supported tokens from the index. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, deducted from the withdrawn assets. The maximum number of distinct assets allowed in the index at any time is 10. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit or withdrawal occurs, and when the index composition is updated.
source_description: Phuture is a decentralised crypto index platform that simplifies investments through automated, themed index funds on Ethereum.

description: Design a token locking contract based on FlokiFi Locker and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a digital asset locker, designed to securely custody various ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 tokens, including liquidity pool tokens. It maintains records of each locked asset, including the locker's owner, the token type and amount, the lock duration, and a unique identifier for each lock. Callers can initiate a new lock for supported tokens, extend the lock duration of an existing lock, and withdraw their locked assets once the lock duration has expired. A designated operator can set the locking fee percentage and designate supported token addresses. Only the designated operator can set the locking fee, which is a percentage of the locked amount, and it must be between 0.1% and 5.0%. The minimum lock duration for any asset is 30 days. The contract emits events upon successful locking of assets, extension of a lock, and withdrawal of assets.
source_description: FlokiFi Locker is the industry's most innovative protocol for securing digital assets. Securely lock Liquidity Pool (LP) tokens, NFTs, fungible tokens, and ERC-1155 tokens in just a few clicks. FlokiFi Locker is audited by industry leader CertiK and backed by the strong Floki brand.

description: Design a cross-chain bridge contract based on Orderly Bridge and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates cross-chain asset transfers, holding user-deposited tokens in escrow on the source chain. It maintains a record of each user's deposited balance per token and a mapping of unique transfer identifiers to their current status. Callers can initiate a transfer by depositing tokens and specifying a destination chain and recipient address, and they can claim transferred tokens on the destination chain using a valid proof. A designated operator can finalize transfers on the source chain after successful processing on the destination. The contract owner can set the transfer fee, which is currently 0.1% of the transfer amount, and can also pause all transfer operations. Each transfer must have a unique identifier, and the maximum transfer amount for any single transaction is 1,000,000 units of the deposited token. The contract announces when a transfer has been initiated and when it has been finalized.
source_description: Orderly is an omnichain CLOB infrastructure.It’s the ultimate trading lego for seamless integration by any builder on any blockchain. Give your app the transparency and composability of DEXs, with the speed and performance of CEXs.

description: Specify a token contract based on Cryptex V1 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a synthetic asset, collateralized by a basket of approved cryptocurrencies deposited within it. It maintains per-account records of synthetic asset balances and collateral deposits, along with a global pool of approved collateral and a configuration defining valid collateral types and their weights. Callers can mint new synthetic assets by depositing approved collateral, burn synthetic assets to withdraw their underlying collateral, and transfer synthetic assets to other accounts. A designated operator can add new collateral types, adjust collateral weights, and pause or unpause minting and burning operations. The minimum collateralization ratio for minting is 150%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all synthetic asset transfers, payable in the synthetic asset itself. The contract announces events for all minting, burning, and transfer operations, including the amounts involved and the accounts affected.
source_description: Cryptex Finance is a multi-network DeFi protocol with the mission of making crypto-native markets tradable. The protocol uses Ethereum smart contracts, Perennial derivatives vaults, and Chainlink data oracles to provide secure and decentralized trading for users.

description: Model an on-chain insurance contract based on Neptune Mutual and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a parametric risk coverage pool, holding various stablecoins deposited by users. It maintains individual user deposit balances, a global coverage capacity for each supported risk type, and configuration parameters for payout percentages and incident resolution. Callers can deposit stablecoins into the pool, withdraw their available balance, and claim payouts if an incident affecting their covered risk type is resolved. A designated operator can declare an incident for a specific risk type, triggering payouts, and also resolve an incident, which finalizes the payout process. The owner can set the payout percentage for each risk type, which must be between 50% and 100%, and can also designate new operators. Payouts for a declared incident are distributed proportionally to each policyholder's coverage amount for that risk type, with a maximum payout cap of 10,000 stablecoins per incident per policyholder. The contract announces when a deposit is made, when a withdrawal occurs, when an incident is declared, and when payouts are distributed.
source_description: Neptune Mutual follows a parametric insurance model, meaning it provides payout on the basis of parameters instead of individual claim assessments. Upon the resolution of an incident, all the policyholders of the affected protocol will receive the payouts. Neptune Mutual eliminates individual claim assessments which makes policy easy to claim, faster, and much more reliable.

description: Model a staking contract based on Frax Ether and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a liquid staking derivative for Ether, holding staked Ether and issuing a corresponding receipt token. It maintains a record of each user's deposited Ether, their accrued rewards, and the total Ether staked, along with a configurable commission rate and a designated operator address. Callers can deposit Ether to receive receipt tokens, redeem receipt tokens for Ether, and claim accrued rewards. Only the owner can set the commission rate, which must be between 0% and 10%, and designate the operator. The operator can initiate staking and unstaking operations with an external staking provider. A minimum deposit of 0.01 Ether is required for new deposits. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and commission rate changes.
source_description: Frax Ether is a liquid ETH staking derivative designed to uniquely leverage the Frax Finance ecosystem to maximize staking yield and smoothen the Ethereum staking process for a simplified, secure, and DeFi-native way to earn interest on ETH.

description: Define a staking contract based on Helius Staked SOL and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This liquid staking contract allows users to deposit a base asset and receive a liquid staking derivative token representing their staked position, which it custodies. The contract maintains a total supply of the liquid staking derivative token, a record of each user's deposited base asset, and an exchange rate between the base asset and the derivative token. Callers can deposit the base asset, withdraw their deposited base asset, and claim rewards. Only the owner can adjust the staking parameters, set the withdrawal fee, or pause deposits. The withdrawal fee is fixed at 0.5% of the withdrawn amount, and a minimum deposit of 0.1 base asset units is enforced. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and reward claim events to observers.
source_description: Liquid staking on Solana

description: Define a governance contract based on Superloop and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a leveraged lending vault, holding user-deposited collateral tokens and borrowed tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited collateral, borrowed amounts, and accumulated interest, alongside global configuration parameters like the maximum leverage factor and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit collateral, initiate a leveraged loop, add more collateral to an existing position, partially or fully withdraw their collateral, and repay borrowed tokens. A designated operator can adjust the maximum leverage factor within a predefined range and update the external price oracle address. The maximum leverage factor is capped at 5x, and a 0.5% performance fee is charged on profits when a user closes a leveraged position. The contract emits an event whenever a deposit, withdrawal, or liquidation occurs, detailing the user, token, and amount.
source_description: Loop Strategy Vaults are smart vaults that use a looping (leveraged lending) strategy to help you earn more from your deposits. Instead of simply supplying tokens to a lending market, the vault borrows against your collateral and re-supplies it multiple times to increase exposure and amplify returns — all in a safe, automated way

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Oasys and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a gaming blockchain's native token staking and rewards, holding staked tokens in escrow. It maintains individual user stake balances, accumulated reward balances for each staker, and a global configuration for reward distribution. Callers can stake tokens, unstake tokens, claim accumulated rewards, and delegate their staking power to another account. A designated operator can adjust the reward rate and pause/unpause staking operations. The minimum stake amount is 100 native tokens. A 0.5% unstaking fee is applied to all unstake operations. The contract announces stake events, unstake events, reward claims, and delegation changes to observers.
source_description: Oasys combines the best of public and private blockchain technologies to deliver a seamless, speedy, and zero-gas-fee blockchain gaming experience. Discover how Oasys is building a community of gamers and developers to pioneer the future of fun.

description: Define a lending protocol based on Alpaca Finance 2.0 and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a leveraged yield farming vault, holding deposited base tokens and borrowed debt tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking deposited amounts, borrowed amounts, and accumulated interest for each user, along with global configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit base tokens, borrow debt tokens against their deposits, repay borrowed amounts, withdraw their base tokens, and close their leveraged positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rates, set liquidation parameters, and update the external price oracle address. The maximum leverage allowed is 5x the deposited base token value, and a 0.1% fee is charged on all borrowed amounts. The contract announces deposit events, borrow events, repayment events, withdrawal events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Alpaca Finance offers a simple way for both beginners and professionals to earn high yields in DeFi through Lend & Stake

description: Outline a lending protocol based on Curvance and describe its main flows at a high level.
description_long: This smart contract manages a lending pool for a single base asset, holding deposited tokens and issuing interest-bearing receipt tokens. It maintains individual account balances for deposits and borrows, a global pool balance, and configuration parameters for interest rates and collateral factors. Callers can deposit tokens, borrow against their collateral, repay outstanding loans, and withdraw their deposited collateral. A designated operator can adjust interest rate models and collateral factors, and the contract owner can pause all lending and borrowing activity. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any borrow is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new borrows, deducted from the borrowed amount. The contract emits events for all deposits, borrows, repayments, and withdrawals, including the affected account, asset amount, and new balance.
source_description: Curvance is Monad's hyper-efficient lending layer, helping users earn more yield and access simple, one-click leverage.

description: Design a derivatives contract based on GammaSwap Open Interest and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates the creation and settlement of perpetual options, holding collateral tokens deposited by users. It maintains individual user balances of collateral, records of active option positions including strike price and expiration, and a global configuration for fees and parameters. Callers can deposit collateral, open new option positions specifying a strike and duration, close existing positions, and withdraw available collateral. A designated operator can adjust global parameters like the maximum leverage ratio and the settlement fee, and can initiate emergency settlements. The maximum leverage for opening a new position is 10x the collateral provided. A settlement fee of 0.1% of the notional value is applied upon position closure. The contract announces events for new position openings, position closures, and parameter updates.
source_description: Trade perpetual options using DEX liquidity

description: Model a yield strategy contract based on Sierra Protocol and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a liquid yield token (LYT) that represents staked assets, allowing users to earn yield while maintaining liquidity. It maintains each user's deposited asset balance, their minted LYT balance, and a global exchange rate between the underlying asset and the LYT. Callers can deposit an approved underlying asset to mint LYT, withdraw their underlying asset by burning LYT, and redeem their LYT for the underlying asset at the current exchange rate. A designated operator can update the exchange rate, and only the owner can set the operator address. The maximum daily exchange rate increase is capped at 0.005%, and a 0.1% redemption fee is applied to all withdrawals. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and exchange rate updates.
source_description: The Sierra Protocol reimagines money by issuing SIERRA, a Liquid Yield Token (LYT) built to deliver the best user experience across CeFi and DeFi

description: Specify a yield strategy contract based on Mole and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a leveraged yield farming vault, holding deposited base tokens and borrowed leverage tokens. It maintains individual user positions, tracking each user's deposited base tokens, borrowed leverage tokens, and accrued yield, alongside a global pool of available leverage tokens and configuration parameters like interest rates and liquidation thresholds. Callers can deposit base tokens, borrow leverage tokens against their deposits, repay borrowed leverage tokens, withdraw their base tokens, and close their leveraged positions. A designated operator can adjust interest rates and liquidation thresholds, and initiate liquidations of undercollateralized positions. The maximum leverage ratio allowed is 3:1 (meaning 3 units of borrowed tokens for every 1 unit of deposited base tokens), and a 0.5% fee is applied to all borrowed leverage tokens upon origination. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, borrow events, repayment events, and liquidation events.
source_description: Mole is a DeFi protocol provided leveraged yield farming, hedge fund and savings.

description: Model an on-chain game contract based on Lympo and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a staking vault for a fungible token, custodying deposited tokens and distributing rewards. It maintains individual user balances of staked tokens and earned rewards, a global reward pool balance, and a configurable reward rate. Callers can deposit tokens into the vault, withdraw their staked tokens and accumulated rewards, and claim only their accumulated rewards. A designated operator can add tokens to the reward pool and set the reward rate. The maximum staking duration is 365 days, and the reward rate cannot exceed 0.1% per block. The contract emits an event when tokens are deposited, withdrawn, or rewards are claimed, and when the reward pool is topped up or the reward rate is adjusted.
source_description: The SPORT token was launched in 2022 and became the primary Lympo utility token to mint, stake and purchase sports collectibles (NFTs). The SPORT token is also the main currency of the Lympo Treasury, which will be governed by a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) made of Lympo community members.

description: Design a lending protocol based on Fira and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract facilitates fixed-rate lending and borrowing of a single designated ERC-20 token, holding deposited principal from lenders and collateral from borrowers. It maintains individual loan records for each borrower and lender, including principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date, alongside a global configuration for available loan terms. Callers can deposit funds to lend, borrow against deposited collateral, repay loans, withdraw available principal, and liquidate undercollateralized loans. A designated operator can adjust the maximum loan-to-value ratio and add new fixed-rate loan terms. The maximum loan-to-value ratio for any loan is 75%, and a 0.5% origination fee is charged on all new loans, deducted from the principal disbursed to the borrower. The contract announces loan origination, loan repayment, and liquidations to observers.
source_description: Fixed-rate lending and borrowing, onchain. Lock rates. Sell yield. Exit anytime.

description: Specify an on-chain game contract based on Heroes of Mavia and describe its core behavior at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages the distribution of a premium in-game currency, called "Ruby", earned by players for achieving specific milestones within the game, and custodies the total supply of Ruby available for distribution. It maintains a record of each player's earned Ruby balance, a global pool of undistributed Ruby, and a configuration for the maximum daily Ruby distribution. Callers can claim their accumulated Ruby balance, transfer Ruby to other players, and stake Ruby for in-game benefits. The designated operator can deposit new Ruby into the contract's distribution pool and adjust the maximum daily Ruby distribution limit. The maximum daily Ruby distribution is capped at 10,000 Ruby, and a 2% fee is applied to all Ruby transfers between players, which is burned. The contract announces events for Ruby claims, Ruby transfers, and changes to the maximum daily distribution limit.
source_description: Heroes of Mavia is a mobile multiplayer Web3 strategy game where players use their base and army to battle other players. Players are able to earn in-game “Legendary Items” through our “Mass Ownership” model, powered by Ruby - our flagship premium earn-only currency.

description: Outline a stablecoin contract based on Ethereum Classic Stable Dollar and describe its core mechanism at a high level.
description_long: This contract is a crypto-backed stablecoin protocol that custodies a reserve asset and issues a stablecoin pegged to a fiat currency. It maintains individual account balances for both the stablecoin and the reserve asset, as well as a global reserve pool and a configuration for collateralization ratios and fees. Callers can deposit the reserve asset to mint stablecoins, burn stablecoins to withdraw the reserve asset, and redeem stablecoins for the reserve asset. There are no privileged roles; the contract operates autonomously. The minimum collateralization ratio for the reserve asset must always be at least 400%, and a 0.5% fee is applied to all stablecoin minting operations. The contract announces all minting, burning, and redemption events, including the amounts involved and the addresses of the participants.
source_description: Ethereum Classic Stable Dollar is a crypto-backed stablecoin backed by ETC and pegged to USD. It is fully autonomous, immutable and zero governance. It is based on the Djed stablecoin protocol, a peer-reviewed, formally verified and battle-tested protocol since 2020. ECSD belongs to the Djed Alliance, along with various other Djed-based stablecoins

description: Design an on-chain insurance contract based on Cozy Earn and describe its primary function at a high level.
description_long: This contract manages a vault for users to deposit and earn yield on ERC-20 tokens, acting as a custodian for deposited assets. It maintains per-user records of deposited amounts and accrued yield, along with a global configuration for approved yield strategies. Callers can deposit ERC-20 tokens, withdraw their principal and earned yield, and claim their share of a designated insurance fund. A designated operator can add or remove approved yield strategies and adjust strategy parameters. The contract imposes a 0.5% fee on all withdrawals, and a maximum of 10 approved yield strategies can be active simultaneously. The contract announces deposit events, withdrawal events, and changes to approved strategies.
source_description: Assets deposited in Euler vaults curated by Cozy
